(93)be/:rerjes mig stun sheste /nyekrung da rag pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

rgyud 'bum/ sgromi (93)0717 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/ 3shākya'i dge slong rin chen grub gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(140) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(150)0718 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 151paṇ+ḍi ta mdzi shrī warma dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis kyang bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(156) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(157)0719 sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ 158bsdur mchan/(164) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(165)

0720 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 166paṇ+ḍi ta mdzi shrī warma dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(176) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(176)0721 byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang / mig stong dang / ldan pa'i cho ba/ stunib ces/ 177bsdur mchan/(244) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(250)0722 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 251zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(335) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(354)0723 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 3552

dang po/ sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi le'u/ 355gnyis pa/ thams cad byams shing mos bar 'gyur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 360gsum pa/ gzhan dag la byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman a ka ta sbyor ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 363bzhi pa/ sman mur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 364lnga pa/ mig gi sman gyi le'u/ 366drug pa/ sbyin sreg hom gyi cho ga sman sbyor ba'i le'u/ 370zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(374) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(378)0724 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 379rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo snyidang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(384) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(386)0725 'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i rig sngags kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 387zhu chen gyi mkhan po lots+tsha ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban+de chos grub kyis sduX /pe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(406) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(408)3

0726 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po/ 409bsdur mchan/(410) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(410)0727 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs cenis dra/ ba 411bsdur mchan/(413) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(413)0728 'phags pa nī la kuṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 414bsdur mchan/(418) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(420)0729 'phags pa snying rjes mi bshol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 421bsdur mchan/(423) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(425)0730 'phags pa kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 426rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(432) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(433)0731 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa/ 434rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzam bha la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing 4

gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(447) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(450)0732 pad+ma cod pan zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 451dang po/ gleng gzhi dang sku bstan pa'i le'u/ 451gnyis pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 453gsum pa/ cho gas bsgrubs pa'i le'u/ 455bzhi pa/ 'khor lo'i le'u/ 459lnga pa/ bya ba'i le'u/ 460drug pa/ yongs su bsrung ba'i le'u/ 462bdun pa/ yo byad dang dam tshig la brten pa'i le'u/ 464brgyad pa/ dug rnams rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i le'u/ 464dgu pa/ bsrung ba 'khor lo'i le'u/ 466bcu pa/ ser ba bsrung ba'i le'u/ 466bcu gcig pa/ pad+ma cod pan zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u/ 467rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(469) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(477) 0733 song ge sgra'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 478rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā kā ra dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi zhus shing bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(481) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(482)0734 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i 5

gzungs / 483kha che'i yul dur khrod 'bris ka rang byung gi mchod rten rtsar/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i rje btsun ma rdo rje sems ma dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba 'gar shes rab 'byung gnas zhes bya bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(497) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(500)0735 seng ge sgra'i gzungs/ 501rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang /klogs skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/bsdur mchan/(502) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(502)0736 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 503bsdur mchan/(508) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(511)0737 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 512bsdur mchan/(516) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(517)0738 'phags pa lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 518rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu 6

chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(522) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(524)0739 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba 525rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(529) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(531)0740 gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen mo/ 532bsdur mchan/(533) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(533)0741 stong 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 534bsdur mchan/(536) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(536)0742 sha lo ka brgya lobs pa 537bsdur mchan/(538) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(538)0743 sha lo ka brgya lobs pa 539bsdur mchan/(540) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(540)

0744 sha lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ 541bsdur mchan/(542) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(542)0745 sha lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ 543bsdur mchan/(544) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(544)0746 sha lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ 545bsdur mchan/(546) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(546)0747 sha lo ka sum stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ 547bsdur mchan/(548) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(548)0748 mi brjed pa'i gzungs/ 5gabasdur mchan/(550) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(550)07ga shes rab skyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 551rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra so ha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de de ba tsan+d+ras zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(553) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(554)8

0750 shes rab skyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 555rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sau ha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de de ba tsan+d+ras zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(556) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(556)0751 thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ 557bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(558)0752 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 559rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhidang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(605) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(606)0753 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/ 607bsdur mchan/(611) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(612)9

0754 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i gzungs phan yon mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 613dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/bsdur mchan/(621) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(623)0755 ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rtog pa chen po/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa le'u rab 'byam las bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/ 624dang po/ 'dus pa'i le'u/ 624gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rab 'byam gyi le'u 677gsum pa/ sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rab 'byam gyi le'u/ 725bris sku dang po/ 728ras ris kyi cho ga bar ma/ 745bzhi pa/ ras ris kyi cho ga rab 'byam/ 749lnga pa/ ras ris kyi cho ga rab 'byam 752drug pa/ mchog gi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga las kyi 'bras bu/ 760bdun pa/ las mchog sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga 764brgyad pa/ ras ris mchog gi sgrub pa'i le'u/ 771dgu pa/ ras ris bar ma'i cho ga rab 'byam 784bcu pa/ bgrang phreng gi cho ga'i le'u/ 817bcu gcig pa/ bgrang phreng srad bu'i cho ga'i le'u/ 823le'u rab 'byams bcu gnyis pa/ 83010

rkang pa gcig pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po/ 842rtsa ba'i rtog par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 848dkar mo chen mo'i rtog pa/ 851sems can thams cad rjes su son par byed pa po zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 855 gser 'od ces bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chos pa'i 857sangs rgyas bcu gnyis kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 859lhag par mos pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po/ 861bsdur mchan/(864) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(884):dkar chag gi zur mchan/ chos tshan (0722)(0723)(0752)(0755)pa'i mtshan byang rgyas drags pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod yod/
ci ci pa gi' — tshamalaX shaXci r+sha la tsho ci dbyu/ /'gro sgrol thugs ba/skyed ches 'phags pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ba〈pe gcig zhal/ /

cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po/1༄༅gi /de nas hūṃ zhes bya ba dran pas khro bo'i rgyal po gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /las 'grub pa ston pa dang mthong ba sbyin pa dang 'dod pa'i mchog thams cad rab tu sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /'on te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang khro bo'i rgyal po spyan drang bar 'dod na/ shing su ra bis me sbar la / 'bras yos dang / pad+ma dang ut+pa la dang / yungs kur dang / tsan+dan dang / zho dang sbrang rtsi rnams mar dang sbyar te brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rig ((sngags 'chang bas khrus legs par bya zhing gos gtsang ma bgos te gtsang bar bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang khro bo'i rgyal po'i sku mdun na bzhugs shing rig sngags 'chang ba dbugs 'byin par mdzad do / /mchog gang 'dod cing gsol ba'i mchog de thams cad sbyin par mdzad do / /phyag g.yas pa mgo bo'i spyi bor 'jog par mdzad do/ /gal te skal ba 93—3

chung ba zhig ste mngon du zhal mi mthong na de'i tshe rmi lam du bstan te/ thams cad bka' stsol cing ji ltar 'dod pa'i mchog sbyin te/ gsang sngags grub pa chen po dang / cho ga zhib tsho1)mo grub pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya dang /rim par phye ba grub par sbyin no/ /dam tshig grub pa chen po rab tu ston to/ /dbang phyug thob par bya na/ 'bras so ba stu ra sa dang / zho dang sbrang rtsi rnams mar dang sbyar te sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas na dbang phyug so sor thob par 'gyur ro/ /grong thob par bya na/ tan tu li ya kha dang zho dang sbrang rtsi rnams mar dang sbyar te lan brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na grong thob par 'gyur ro/ /yul gyi bdag por bya na 'bras sā (2 lu dang ras bal sa bon rnams mar (5)dang bsres te brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg 45byas na yul thob par 'gyur ro/ /mi snang bar bya 55rin/ ske tshe dang lan tshwa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /nam mkha' (7la 'gro bar bya na / sha 7)ta pad tri ku'i me tog gis 'dasbyin sreg bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong bar bya na/ shi li dang tsan+dan gyi phye ma dang / tu ruṣ+ka 6)rnams til dang sbyar te lan brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rig yi )sngags 'chang ba legs so legs so zhes gsung nyunyezhing dbugs 'byin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis mgo bo'i / spyi bor phyag 'jog cing mchog grub pa chen po stsol (stebar mdzad do/ /thams cad du mchod pa 'os pa lachen por 'gyur ro/ /shi nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten kun gyi bla mar 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad gzhom par 'dod na 'bras ma grugs pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gter 93—4

bsgul hunyen de nas don yod pa chen po'i spyan sngar (0brjod par bya ste/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i dngos grub chen po sgyu ma'i dngos grub bla na med pa/ bklags pas grub pa so sor bstan pa'i dngos grub bla na med pa/ grub pa rig sngags 'chang gi rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa lhur len pa bde ba skyed pa la mkhas pa rnams kyi rig sngags 'chang gi dngos grub kyi de kho na nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mchog tu gsang ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ ngogs su zhugs pa rnams kyi rab tu sgrub pa/dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams rnam par sel ba/ don gyi stegs mchog tu grub pa/ mal cha dang stan ( samed pa rnams kyi gos sems can thams cad kyi mchod par bya ba chen po/ thams cad du (gelas thams cad legs par grub pa/sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad 'phrog pa/ gdug (5༄pa thams cad 'joms pa/rgyal po mnyes par byed pa/ rnam par thar pa dang dul ba'i grong khyer nyid de/dge bsnyen rnams kyi mchog tu skyid pa/ dge bsnyen ma rnams kyi dga' ba 'phel bar byed pa/ rig (6)pa'i rgyal po'i yon tan rmad du byung ba'i de kho na nyid sgrub pa grub pa rnams gtsang ma gtsang sbrar spyod pa/ gos gtsang ma bgos te/bza' ba mchog shin tu gsang ba dang / bag yod cing bden par smra ba/dkon mchog gsum la mchog tu dad pa ri/ bla ma la gus pa/ rtag par rgyun du byams pa'i sems la mnyam par gzhag 85pa/ sems can thams cad la brtse bar gyur pa/ sbyin pa la mngon par dga' ba'i yid can/ 'byung po thams cad la brtse ba'i sems dang byams pas bla na med pa'i sgrub pa 'di bya'o/ /bslab pa dang sdom pa blangs pa/ don yod pa chen po'i sgyu ma bla na med pa ni 93—5

'di'o / /gi wang dang / spro tsho1)ka dang / pu shel tse (nanadang / tsan+dan dang /ldong ros dang / shing kun dang / spang spos dang / na la da dang / ru rta ①dang bcas pa dang / de bzhin du 'bras dgang ste ④'di rnams thams cad cha mnyam ste55ri/ phye mar byas nas/ thams cad zhib mor btags la/ ga bur dang / gla rtsis bsgos snyo te/ snyigs ma 'di dag tsha ba'i til mar gyis btsos (3)pa / nye'u shing dang / bil rinarab dang / me tog brgya pa dang / puska ra dang /gan+dha pri yang ku dang / rgya spos dang / sa mu sta dang / pra puṇ+ḍa 6)dri ka dang /shing mngar rnams chu bre bdun gang bar sbyin par bya ste drug cha nyu )lhag mar lus pa dang / snyigs ma bre gang dang 'o ma'i snyigs ma bor te/ til mar srang gnyis la rtag tu btso 11bar bya'o/ /legs par grub pa'i gsang sngags bzlas brjod byas la gtor ma dang / dkyil 'khor du me tog dang / dri bzang po'i bdug pa dang / til mar btso 12ba'i cho ga bzhin du rab tu sbyar la gang las grub pa khyad par du bskyed cing babs pa'i til mar byas pa srung ba'i cho ga bya ste/ snod rgyunagatsang ma bkang nas slar yang gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas brjod byas nas gsang ba'i gnas su gzhag 7par bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad byed du gzhug ste/ rig sngags 'chang khrus legs par byas pa/ dris bsgos pa'i til mar rtag tu lus la byugs pa 'dis/ lus de mi snang zhing dngos po med par ston par byed do/ /ngag thos la reg par mi byed do/ /gang gis lus ṅkakhrus ma byas kyi bar de srid du bdag nyid mi snang ste lus mi mthong ngo / /dpral bar thig le byas nas/ yan lag dang / nying lag rnams la reg stes/gsang sngags lan cig 1 bzlas brjod byas na nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur te/93—6

skad cig la dga' bar byed pa dang / lha dang bcas pa'i rig sngags 'chang gi dbang po mkha' la spyod pa rnams kyis lhan cig tu til mar mgo la byugs pas mdog sngo ba 93)dang / skra cung zad li zhing 'khyil bar 'gyur ro/ /til mar grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur (2)ba'i mnga' bdag tu 'gyur ro/ /reg pa tsam gyis tshe bskal pa khri thub par 'gyur ro/ /lus pad+ma dkar sham lta bur 'gyur ro/ /lus rdo rje ltar brtan pa dang / gnas kyi sgo thams cad bye ste (gu'adug go/ /gang du 'dod par 'jug par byed do/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub (4)pa'i dus su rig sngags 'chang la thig le byas nas lag tu rdo rje dang nor bu byas na5)/ nam mkha' la 'phur bar 'gyur te/ mod la dkyil 'khor grub pa ston par byed do/ /til mar gyis rkang pa la byugs na/ nam mkha' la 'ong bar byed do/ /lus la byugs na mi snang bar ston par byed do/ /mtshal dang til mar lhan cig sbyar te/ yan lag dang / nying lag la thig le byas na/ lus 'bar ba'i snying po mthong bar byed do/ /'di dag rig sngags 'chang gi rnam 'phrul so sor bstan pa'o/ /yungs kur la bzlas te/ lan cig 6bskus sam/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gtor na/ dkyil 'khor g.yo bar 'gyur te / 'khor lo bzhin du bskor bar byed do/ /gtor ma'i snod gang ba rnams dang / bum pa gang ba rnams sor mo brgyad kyi tshad du nam mkha' la 'phags te 'dug go/ /rang nyid se gol gyi sgras yongs su 'don par byed na/ slar yang snod nam mkha' la 'phags te 'dug pa rang rang gi gnas su 7gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di rnams dkyil 'khor dgos pa bla na med pa'i dngos grub bo/ /de nas seng ge'i khrag dang til mar lhan cig sbyar te/ bdag nyid kyi lus la 93—7

byugs na/ mi yi seng ge chen po'i gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur te/ ji srid lus khrus ma byas pa de srid du mi'i seng ger kun tu gnas so/ /gzhan yang ji ltar bsams (1pa bzhin du/ nam mkha' la 'phags te 'dug pa dang / mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / me 'bar ba ston par byed do/ /phag gi khrag dang sbyar na/ phag gi gzugs su ston par byed den/ shugs dang stobs chen por ston par byed do/ /glang po che'i khrag dang sbyar bas tshogs kyi dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su ston par byed do/ /rta'i khrag dang sngon po lhan cig sbyar ba lus la byugs pa tsam gyis rta mgrin gyi ri gzugs su ston par byed de ji srid khrus ma byas pa de srid du mthong bar byed do/ /ba lang gi mkhris pa dang lhan cig sbyar na / /khyu mchog chen po la zhon par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /nya'i mkhris pa dang lhan cig sbyar na/ klu'i rgyal po chu bdag chen po'i gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur ro / /sprul dmar po'i khrag dang bsres nas sbyar na/ sprul chen po'i gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /ra'i khrag dang bsres pas/ ra chen po'i gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i lo ma dang / phye ma dang / rtsa ba dang bcas pa dang / 'dab 4ma dang me tog dang sdong bu dang bcas pa til mar gyis 555lhan cig sbyar bas yungs kur la bskus te lus la byugs la til mar gyis 56nithig le bya'o ri / /mkhas pas yan lag dang nying lag la byug pa byas na rgyal po chen po'i cha lugs su mthong bar 'gyur te/ ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas yongs su bskor bas dgos pa sna tshogs pa dang / rgyal po'i dgos pa rnams byed par 'gyur ro/ /yid la bsams 8pa'i dgos pa thams cad sgrub par 9 byed par 'gyur ro/ /ldong ros kyi mig sman dang lhan cig bsres nas mig la byugs na/93—8

'khor chen po'i dbus su/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rig 0)pa'i rgyal po bzlas te yungs shar de nam mkha' la gtor na/ 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi char 'bab par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma'i snying pos sbyar na/ pad+ma chen po'i char 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ut+pa la sngon po'i khu bas sbyor na/ ut+pa la sngon po chen po'i char 'byung ba mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar me tog gi khu bas sbyar ba (5)de lta de ltar me tog gi char chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar yid la 'dod pa'i gzugs dang / kha dog dang / rtags dang / dbyibs su mthong bar 'dod pa de lta de ltar lha'i til mar rnying pa dang lhan cig sbyar na dī/ri de lta de ltar de dang de nyid kyi gzugs su mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhal yas khang yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lag pas nor bu gcig blangs te/ yid la rjes su dran par byas na/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa du ma'i bdag nyid du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gos dang / rgyan sna tshogs pa rnams ston par byed do/ /lag pas snod la gzung can/ snod sna tshogs pa bton tshozhi)par byed do/ /lag pas bum pa la gzung 6rin/ bum pa brgya stong phrag ston par byed do/ /rkang pa'i mthil la bskus na/ gang du rdo ba la rkang pa bzhag pa de dang de nyid du rkang pa'i rjes 'jog par byed de/ mar gsar la nye bar 'jog pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ mar gsar mnyen pa bzhin du rdo ba yang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /gtun shing 7la byugs na/ rtags 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su zhugs na/ ma mo'i lha rnams kyi so so 8tha dad pa'i rdul bzung ste 9ratil mar dang lhan cig sbyar nas so so'i gdong la byugs na/lha de dang de lta bu'i gzugs su ston par byed do/ /gzhan yang dgos pa rnam pa 93—9

sna tshogs pa rnams rang gi 'dod pa'i blos las bya'o/ /de nas blo 'phel bar byed pa ni/ til mar dang / 'o ma lhan cig zos na/ blo dang dran pa chen po 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /nub gsum gyi 41)sbyor bas tshigs su bcad pa stong klog par byed cing 'dzin par byed do/ /zhag bdun gyi sbyor bas blo gros rgya mtsho chen po lta bu 'phel bar byed cing sogs 25par byed do/ /zhag bcu bzhi'i sbyor bas tshe lha'i lo stong du 'gyur ro/ /zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sbyor bas/ bcud len sgrub pa'i dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur te/ gnyer ma dang / skra dkar spangs pa dang / skra cung zad 'khyil bar 'gyur ro/ /lus 'jam zhing mnyen pa dang / pad+ma'i kha dog dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes nas lo bcu lon pa dang 'dra bar gzugs dang lang tsho 4)dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /glang po che stong phrag bcu'i stobs su 'gyur ro/ /zhag nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi sbyor bas glang po che sa srung gi stobs su 'gyur ro/ /zhag sum cu so lnga'i sbyor bas nam mkha' lding chen po'i stobs su 'gyur ro/ /zhag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sbyor bas lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan dang 'dra bar brtson 'grus dang stobs chen por 'gyur ro/ /zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i sbyor bas ri rab lhun po chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bos yongs su bskor ba/mi g.yo zhing mi bsgul bar/ reg par bya ba ma yin zhing mi mthong ba mi ma yin pa rnams kun tu spyod pa/ lha rnams thams cad kyis 6phyag byas shing /phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ drang srong rnams kyis 7bstod pa'i 'os su gyur pa/gnod sbyin dang srin po rnams kyi phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs 8kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ byang chub 903—10

sems dpa' thams cad kyi rab tu bsngags pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang po thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig grub pa/ lha'i dbang po rnams kyis lhan cig 'gran pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi mngon du smra ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ klu'i dbang po thams cad kyi nye bar bgrod 1par bya ba ste/ de ltar don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i khro bo'i rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba til mar gyi rgyal po'i rnam par 'phrul pa yon tan chen po rmad du byung ba brgya stong phrag gis gang ba'o/ /til mar gyi rgyal po'i rig sngags 'chang 'dis/ til mar gyi rgyal po ral gri la byugs na/ byugs pa tsam gyis ral gri 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur nabar 'gyur te/ ral gri'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur ba thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje la byugs na rdo rje 'bar bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 4ba nam mkha' la 'gro zhing / rdo rje'i (5)rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 96bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo la byugs na 'khor lo 'bar bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /blta na sdug pa'i 'khor lo'i rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 7bar mod la 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad rab tu 'joms so / /mdung rtse gsum pa la byugs na 'bar bar 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor los sgyur 8bar 'gyur te/ nam mkha' la gnas par byed do/ /stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon pa dbang phyug chen po dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang / me dbal dang / shu ba dang / mdze dang / rkang shu dang / rtsa'i rma dang /93—11

mgul pa 'gags pa dang / rna ba'i rtsa nad dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang /dmu 1chu dang / skran dang / rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang /'dus pa nyid la yang / mkhas pas chu dron mo 'thungs pa tsam dang / byugs pa tsam gyis nad thams cad sel lo/ /til mar gyis nad thams cad sel ba de bzhin du/ rtsib (5logs na ba dang / tshad pa dang / snying na ba dang /mchin pa na ba dang / bshang ba 'khyim pa dang / pho ba'i nad kyi nyes pa de rnams thams cad 'thungs pa tsam gyis rnam par 'jig (gepar the tsom ④med do/ /nyams pa dang / zad pa dang / de bzhin du rgyal po'i dpal bcom pa dang / gso dpyad glingan pa rnams bskus pa tsam mam zos pa tsam gyis stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lus rnams rgyas pa dang / mgu ba dang / spro ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /gdon rnam pa sna tshogs par bsrung 46chib dang / brjed byed mi bzad pa la yang / reg pa tsam gyis de dag thams cad rnam par 'jig (7par the tshom med do/ /byad mi bzad pa dang / sdug bsngal dang / dug dang /sbyar dug nyid kyang reg pa tsam gyis rnam par 'jig 98)par 'gyur ro/ /brtan 6nyepa dang / g.yo ba'i dug gang yin pa dang / mche ba'am/ sbrul go ṇa sa dang /sdig pa yang rung / srin bu dang / phye ma leb gdug pa'am/ nor rgyas kyi bu dang / 'jog po'am/ sbrul gyis mthong ba'i dug gam/ dbugs kyi dug mi bzad pa gang yin pa dang / reg pa'i dug gang yin pa dang / hā la hā la'i gdug 1 pa 11gang yin pa dang / gzhan da ra da'i dug gang yin pa dang / rtsa ⑫ba'i dug gang yin pa dang / sdong bu'i dug dang / 'dab ma'i dug dang /me tog gi dug dang / mdangs kyi dug gang yin pa dang / gzhan dug rnam pa 93—12

sna tshogs pa de rnams thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /til mar reg pa tsam gyis/ lam mchog dang / lam gol bar song ba rnams dang /rgyal po'i sgo drung du song ba yang rung / bsad 6)par 'os par gyur pa gang yin pa dang / bcings par gyur pa gang yin pa dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod (shepa dang —/ 'gyed pa gang yin pa dang / gzhan yang dgra'i gzeb dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa nyid dang / mi mdza' ba dang / phyir rgol ba gang yin pa yang til mar 'di mngon par sbyar bas skad cig de la thams cad 'joms so/ /rgyal po khros (0pa gang yin pa 'dzum bzhin du bka' stsol to/ /g.yul 'gyed pa'i nang du'am/ phan tshun 'thab ④bzhin pa thams cad la til mar rgyal po bla na med pas rtag tu rgyal ba ster ro(5)/ /mkhas pas mig la byugs na / mi thub cing thams cad du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyis kyang dgos pa thams cad la rab tu sbyar bar bya ste/ dngos grub kyi gnas thams cad kyi mchog yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas khro bo lcags kyu bla na med pa/ sdig pa (6)thams cad sel ba/ mod la gdug pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mod la thams cad du grub pa bla na med pa/nad thams cad zhi ba/ de kho na nyid khro bo lcags kyu bla na med pa'i ras ris kyi sku gzugs brjod par bya ste/ ras ris kyi sku gzugs bla na med pa 'di mthong ba tsam gyi mod la/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po thob pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par 'gyur ba dang / rig pa'i gnas thams cad rtogs par khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 93—13

dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mthong ba dang / mchod pa dang / rim gror bya ba dang /zhe sar bya ba dang / bla mar byas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi spyan sngar bsod nams kyi phung po chen po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / ras ris kyi sku gzugs gang yin pa 'di mthong ba tsam gyi mod la/mthas miklas pa tsam dang 'di mtshungs par 'gyur te/ 'di dang mtshungs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /ras gru bzhi pa gru bzhir cha mnyam pa/ shin tu thags bzang ba/ shin tu gsar ba/ shin tu 'jam pa mchog tu mdzes pa/khru gnyis pa'i tshad kha tshar ma bcad pa/ skra dang bral ba'am/ yang na dar gtsang ma gru bzhi shin tu rnam par 'byes pa la/ ri mo mkhan gtsang ma smyung bar gnas pas/ lhag ma ma yin pa'i tshon snod gsar par bzhag la/ tshon sna tshogs rnam par 'byes pas/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i khro bo nyananilcags kyu bri bar bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa/ zhal dang po ni zhi ba/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od dpag med cod pan du 'chang ba/ zla bas nye bar mdzes pa/ phyag bzhi pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ g.yas pa'i zhal drag po'i gzugs can 'jigs par byed pa/ tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ dbu skra gyen du brjes pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan la pa/ g.yon pa drag po chen po mche ba gtsigs 5pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ dbu skra 'khyil zhing gyen du brjes pa'i ral pa kun tu bcings pa/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ drag tu 93—14 ri

bzhad pa'o/ /zhi ba'i zhal ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan ༅)pa'i steng du/ sku phyed pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po 'bar ba'i snying por chud pa bya ste/ sku ut+pa la sngon po'i kha dog can/ dbu skra dmar po cung zad 'khyil ba/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi gcig gis ral gri dang / gnyis pas tho ba 'bar ba can bya'o/ /phyag gcig gis pad+ma 'chang ba ste/ pad+ma'i ge sar 'bar ba'i snyen rin pa can no/ /gnyis pas lcags kyu dang mdung rtse gsum ste / g.yas pa na'o/ /g.yon pas khro bo chen po drag po drag tu rgod pa'i gzugs can/ don yod pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas pa dbugs 'byin pa'i rin po che chen po'i char 'bebs pa/ phyag thams cad 'bar ba'i snying po 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa bya ste/ pad+ma'i gdan la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa bya'o/ /rgya mcho'i snying por ri rab la gnas pa/klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bos dkris pa bya'o/ /nya dang chu srin dang / nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis dkris 4pa/ pad+ma dang / ut+pa la dang / ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar pos gcal (5du bkram pa/ ngang pa dang /bzhad dang / ngur pa dang / shang shang te'us khyab pa bya'o/ /g.yas logs su lha mo sgrol ma/ dbu cung zad dud pa/ thal mo sbyar ba 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'dzem bag dang bcas pa bya'o/ /dkar sham chen mo 56)thal mo sbyar te cung zad 'dud pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'dzem bag dang bcas pa bya'o/ /srin mo chen mo ral pa gcig ma khrag 'dzag pa'i thod pa dang / drag mo drag tu rgod pa bya ste/ 'bar ba'i snying por khro bo lcags kyu la blta 7bzhin pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ lag na ral gri dang /93—15

dgra sta dang / zhags pa dang / rdo rje thogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs su gnod sbyin gyi dbang po bya ste/ zhal khro gnyer can drag po/ dbu skra gyen du brjes pa/ 'jigs par byed pa/'bar ba'i snying por pus mo g.yas pa btsugs pa/ ral gri dang / dgra sta thogs pa/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po lcags kyu la nges par blta bzhin pa/ kho ra khor yug tu 'od 'dom gang ba/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba bya'o/ /lcags kyu dang bcas pa'i kho ra khor yug gi steng du/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / gshin 91)rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po bya ste/ me tog sna tshogs kyi phur ma thogs te/ mchod pa byed bzhin pa bya'o//khro bo'i rgyal po don yod 52lcags kyu'i rgyab tu/ rin po che sna bdun las byung ba'i shing ljon pa bya ste/ yal ga dang / 'dab ma dang / lo ma rnam par bkra ba 4bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i zhabs kyi drung du/ rig sngags 'chang bya ste/pus mo btsugs 5pa me tog sna tshogs thogs shing / lag na bgrang phreng 'dzin pa / khro bo'i rgyal po la steng 6)du blta bzhin pa bya'o/ /zhabs gnyis pa'i drung gi gnas su pho nya mo bya ste/ zur mig can drag mo/ lag na ral gri thogs pa/rnam par 'gyur ba phyag thal mo sbyar ba rgyan thams cad kyis (7 rnam par brgyan pa bya'o / /ras ris kyi sku gzugs kyi bya ba yongs su mthar phyin nas/ byin gyis brlabs te/ de'i 'og tu gsang ba'i gnas su gzhag 8)par bya'o/ /de'i drung du gtsang mas zas mi bza' bar/ de'i spyan sngar khro bo lcags kyu brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya ste/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mchod yon dang /93—16

zhabs bsil ji ltar rnyed pa dbul bar bya'o/ /ras ris kyi sku gzugs sgrub pa'i cho ga 'dis sgrub pa'i cho ga rgyas pa gzhan yang bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang gis nyi ma re rer ras ris kyi mdun du/ gtsang mas zas mi za bar / de'i spyan sngar me tog dang / bdug spos phul nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po lan gcig 0)bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas (kyilas thams cad dang dgos pa thams cad bya'o/ /'di ni de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub bklags pas grub ri pa ste/rig sngags 'chang gis④/ gsang ba mchog gi las bsgrub pa (55bya'o/ /de nas sku gzugs mthong ba tsam la sogs pas mtshams med pa lnga dang / mnar med pa la gzhol ba dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams 'di mthong ba tsam gyis thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa thams cad dang / sgrib pa thams cad dang / sngon gyi sgrib pa bsags pa dang bcas pa dang / bskal pa brgyar bsags pa'i sdig pa de dag thams cad rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /nad dang 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro56/ /sdig pa thams cad dang / dgra thams cad dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad dang / mi mdza' ba rnam par 'jig 57 par 'gyur ro/ /ras ris kyi sku gzugs shin tu chung ba byed pa gang yin pa de yang phan pa 585byed par 'gyur te/ me tog gam/bdug pa dang / dri'am/ byug 59)pa'am/ dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa byed pa'am / khrus kyi bum pa gang bkod pa'am/ rdul sel bar byed pa tsam yang rung ste/ rig sngags 'chang de'i/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu 93—17

rtsa dgu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro / /bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par yang 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga rnam par sbyangs shing bskal pa'i mthar thug par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gzigs 'dod par 'gyur ro/ /skye ba brjes nas kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur te/pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skye ba'i skye ba dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po/ don yod pa'i khro bo lcags kyu'i gzungs 'di yang mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par kha ton du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba rnams dang /gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang /dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo thams cad mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par yang 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par sdud par yang 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi bla mar yang 'gyur ro/ /tshig btsan par yang 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad dga' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du mchod par 'os par yang 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags thams cad grub 1par 'gyur ro/ /yid la bsams po pa thams cad 93—18

yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing / dgos pa thams cad grub par yang 'gyur ro / /thams cad du thogs pa med pa mkhas zhi)pa'i blo ru 'gyur ro/ /de nas khro bo'i lcags kyu'i dkyil 'khor/ cho ga zhib mo thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor dang /gsang ba'i phyag rgya bla na med pa bshad par bgyi'o/ /khor 50yug tu them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ sa dang ba byung ba sres pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bya ste/gzings kyi rgya dang tshad mnyam pa/ shin tu tshad la bab cing legs par rnam par 'byes pa/ legs par byugs shing shin tu 'jam pa/ 'jam shing mnyen pa dang ldan pa'o/ /tshon sna tshogs pas rnam par phye ba dang / dkyil 'khor mchog gi thig btab la/ /sna tshogs tshon rtsis rnam par dbye/ /sgo bzhi shin tu rnam 'byes pa/ /khor 5)yug them skas bzhi dang ldan/ /rta babs bzhi 4yis brgyan (5)pa ste/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor snying por yang / /shin tu rnam 'byes tshad la bab/ /khru yi tshad du bya ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi mnyam pa yi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor dbus su yang / /mkhas pas shin tu rnam 'byes pa'i/ /pad+ma 'dab (6)ma bcu gnyis bya/ /lcags kyu phyogs dang rtse gsum dang / /ge sar pad+ma'i khor yug tu/ /snying por gyur pa'i dbu ri mchog la/ /khro bo zhags pa yang bya'o/ /drag po'i gzugs can 'jigs par byed/ /ral gri dang ni dgra sta'i phyag /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan cing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyanas/ /lus phyed ri9pa dang / zhags pas kun nas dkris pa/mdung rtse gsum pa/ nam mkha' la phyir phyogs pa/ pad+ma dang bcas pa byas pa la / grwa grwar 7'bar ba'i gdong bya'o/ /mdung rtse gsum dang pad+ma la rab tu gnas pa/ drag po'i zhal 'jigs par byed pa chen po mche ba rnam par gtsigs 93—19

pa / zhal 'jigs su rung ba 'bar ba'i snying por chud pa'o/ /nang gi ri mo la/lcags sgrog dang / mdung rtse gsum pa'i gdong bri bar bya ste/ 'bar ba'i snying po dang bcas pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshon rtsis bya'o/ /ri mo gnyis pa'i nang du/ pad+ma kha phyed 1)bye ba ge sar 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i pad+ma bya'o/ /ri mo gsum pa'i nang du/ 'khor lo'i rnam pa'o/ /mu khyud kyi phyi rol tu lag pa'i phyag rgya yang bri bar bya ste/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ral gri dang /zhags pa dang / mdung rtse gsum dang / tsa ba la dang / mdung rtse gnyis/dung dang / tir+ya dang / 'khor lo dang / rtse gsum kha gdengs dang / tho ba dang / mdung dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / mdung rtse gsum dang /mda' bo che dang / las kyi rdo rje dang / rtse lnga dang / par+sha sru la dang / rdo rje zur gsum dang / pad+ma dang / rtse gsum dag kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba bri bar bya'o/ /kha khyer gyi rnam pas brgyan pa la kha khyer gyi phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su mtshan ma sna tshogs bri bar bya ste/rigs chen po bzhi thun mong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya bri bar bya'o/ /shar gyi gnas su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya yang bri bar bya'o / /lho ru pad+ma yangs pa'i mtshan ma dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /nub kyi gnas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ nor bu'i rigs kyi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya rnams kyang bri bar bya'o/ /byang du rdo rje'i rigs kyi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya yang dag par bri'o/ /shar gyi sgo ru/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo'i rgyal po sgo ru bri bar bya'o / /lho ru pad+ma yangs pa'i ②dkyil 'khor gyi khro bo rnams so/ /nub tu nor bu (gerigs kyi khro bo'o/ /byang du rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo bri bar bya'o/ /khro bo 93—20

thams cad kyi gzugs 'bar ba'i snying po/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa bya'o/ /ri rab la gnas pa/ skyil mo krung phyed pa lus cung zad bskum pa bya'o/ /phyi'i ri mo'i dkyil 'khor du/ nor bu dang / rdo rje dang / me tog dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dag go/ /khor 91)yug tu kha khyer 'bar bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu brgyan pa'o/ /lhab lhub dang / ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan dang /tshon sna lnga pa'i skud pas kun nas dkyil 'khor la yang dag par brgyan tsho pa'o/ /ro bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa'i gtor mas gang ba'i snod ci 'byor pa dang /gtor ma'i las kyi cho gas 'byor pa dang / rjes su mthun 5par gzhag ri nopar bya'o / /bum pa gang ba dang / pog por dang / bum bu dang / bum pa dang /gtor ma dkar pos bkang ba dang / 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa nyid dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug sa7pa dang / me tog kun nas gcal 6du dgram mo / /'bras yos dang / yungs kur gyis gtor bar bya'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi grwar/ mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil gyi snod dang / rin po che sna bdun rab tu dgram mo/ /dri'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa dang / legs par brgyan (7pa'i bum pa byas nas/ mkhas pas dar bzang po bcings te/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhag (85par bya'o/ /sgo bzhir dri chab kyis 99)gang ba'i bum pa dar gyis bcings pa gzhag tu tshopar bya'o/ /mkhas pas sgo dang / sgo ru ni/ bu ram dang / sha kha nyu1ra dang / sbrang rtsi'i ro dang / gtor ma gzhag 12par bya'o / /mdung rtse gsum la/ zho dang / 'o ma dang / zan dang / mchog gi bza' ba ma nyams pas/ shin tu mdzes pa'i gtor ma gzhag par bya'o/ /de 93—21

bzhin du/ 'khur ba dang / 'khur ba zlum po nyid dang / snum 'khur dang /be ṭi ma ka dang / sa (1)rā'i la du dang / mud ga'i la du dang / hwags dang /kha yā ni bzang po rnams gzhag (gepar bya'o/ /gtor ma'i las la/ khor yug tu me tog bzang po dgram zhing / phreng bas brgyan par bya'o/ /'bru'i rnam pa sna tshogs pa gzhag (8)par bya'o/ /'bras bu'i ngo bo rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang /ne'u gsing ril sngo bsangs dang / lo ma mdzes pa bkram ste gzhag (5)par bya'o/ /khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang / de bzhin du/ a ga ru dang / tsan+dan spro ka tshodzidang / tu ruṣ+ka 57dang / dpal gyis dkris pa dang / gu gul dang /kun tu ru dang / sbrang rtsi dang / hwags sbyar ba'i bdug pa ste/ bdug pa 'di dag dbul bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu bdug pa 'thul ba'i pog phor gzhag 8par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /phyogs bcings pa dang / dkyil 'khor bcing ba bya ste/ gtsug tor bcing zhing / bdag srung ba dang / gzhan bsrung 9ba bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'jug par bya'o/ /rig sngags dkyil 'khor mchog samathong ba dang / phyag bya zhing /bskor ba nyid dang / dam tshig kyang sbyin par bya'o/ /rtag tu bsang 1lhaba'i las byas te/ de kho na bzhin du gsang sngags bzlas pa yang bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tshad ma las/ dgos pa 'di dag thams cad byas nas/ de'i 'og tu rig sngags 'chang gis las thams cad kyi dngos grub bla na med pa'o/ /rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i 12yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa de dag thams cad ni / 'gro ba bzang por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du bde ba can du/'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar the tsom 1 med do/ /lha'i 93—22

gzugs shin tu mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub chen po thob par 'gyur te/ 'di la the tsom 91༄mi bya'o / /'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub bla na med pa dang / cho ga zhib mo'i dngos grub dang / phyag rgya'i dngos grub dang / khro bo'i rgyal po dngos grub bla na med pa dang / sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad sel ba deng / mod la gdug pa thams cad 'jig pa dang / dgra thams cad bzlog 2pa dang / mod la nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang / dgos pa thams cad dang / thams cad du dngos grub bla na med pa gang yin pa grub par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dang rtag tu dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rgyal po dang / blon por bcas pa rnams kyis dus rgyun du bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ljongs thams cad blta dzo zhing mchod pas rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro//de bzhin nyid du yang dge sbyong rnams dang / bram ze rnams dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u ri rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / skyes pa dang /bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu tshig btsan pa dang / rtag tu lha rnams kyis 5mngon par bsrungs pa dang / skabs gsum gyi dbang po dang / rdo rje 'chang ba nyid dang / rdo rje snying po bdag nyid chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / gzhon nu dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha nyid dang / de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong ba la yang 93—23

dus rtag tu srung ba dang / rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur te/ the tsom 91)mi bya'o/ /yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ rtag tu smra ba nyung zhing mkhas pa dang / thams cad du dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / 'jug pa la dga' bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang dgyes pa dang bcas pas byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas dbugs 'byin par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'di ni de rnams kyi mngal gyi gnas su skye ba'i tha ma yin no/ /rtag tu skye ba'i (na skye ba dran par 'gyur te/ 'di la the tsom (/stemi bya'o//sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu 'gro ba dang / rtag tu rgyal ba rnams kyi de kho na nyid mthong ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad la mngon sum du chos nyan par the tsom 4med do/ /'di ni skye ba'i tha ma yin te/ ji srid du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dgos pa gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / khro bo lcags kyu'i las brgya phrag stong rnams rang gi 'dod pa'i blos bya'o/ /thams cad du lan cig 5bzlas brjod byas la/ thams cad du las thams cad bya'o/ /bklags pas 'grub pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas te/ bzhin 'dzum pas khro bo chen po lcags kyu'i gzungs kyi kun tu snang bzhin pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba'i snying po lus las phyung ngo / /gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu snang bar byas so/ /'od zer gyi snang ba 93—24

gang gis/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su rin po che sna bdun gyi char 'bab pa'i snying po rab tu 'bebs par 'dod pa'i don dang /lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa'i don dang / lha'i dri dang mthun par gsal ba'i dri dang rjes su mthun pa'i dri rnam par bkra ba'i char rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phab bo / /rab tu dgyes pa'i thugs kyis lha'i chu gsal zhing rgya che ba/ dri 1'phro bas rnam par mdzes pa'i dpral ba'i chu mu tig dang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa/ dza 2ti'i 'bras bu dang 'dra bar rnam par mdzes pa'i dpral ba'i lha'i chus yongs su dbang bskur te/ thigs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bzhu ba'i mig 'bras las lhung ba'i chu skar ma las rab tu lhung ba'i gos/ de lta bu'i dpral bar thig le 'bar ba nyi ma dang / smig rgyu rnam par mdzes pa'i 'od zer sa la lhung ste /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar zhabs kyi drung du lhung ngo / /pad+ma'i 'dab lam brgya stong phrag kha bye ba ltar rab tu 'dzum pas rnam par mdzes pa/ pad+ma'i ze 'bru ltar mnyen pa byung bar gyur to/ /be+e ḍūr+ya'i sdong bu nyi ma brgya stong phrag pas lhag pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i 'od zer snang bas 'bar bzhin pa/ bcom ldan 'das la mi gang gi tshad lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /de nas rig 5pa 'dzin pa'i dbang po chen po rdo rje 'chang gis/ chu'i thigs pa 'dab 6rim mnyam pa / be+e ḍūr+ya mchog tu mdzes shing 'bar ba pad+ma kha bye ba de mthong nas/thugs ngo mtshar dang / ya mtshan skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems dpa' 93—25

chen po shin tu ngo mtshar ba mthong lags so/ /rmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul chen po mthong lags so/ /sems dpa' chen po bdag gis/ ltad mo'i mchog mthong lags so/ /sems dpa' dag pa chen po/ khyod kyis bdag gi ltad mo'i the tsom 1med par mdzod cig ces so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag nan rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lag na rdo rje/ bdag la don yod pa pad+ma dri ma med pa chu skyes kyi zhabs kyi lcags kyu zhes bya ba/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang /phyag rgya dang / lha rnams yod de/ de bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khor chen po'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar yongs su bsgrag par bgyi'o/ /de'i mthu dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i mthu stobs kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa 'di mthong ngo / /de'i mthus pad+ma 'di byung ngo / /rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di bdag gi dpral ba nas phyung bas cho 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul ba rgya che zhing che ba dang yang dag par ldan par gyur to/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas/ lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ mchod pa byas nas song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su song nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste / byis pa'i cha byad bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das la bsil yab g.yob par byed bzhin du 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 942—26

dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po don yod pa (1)pad+ma na dri ma med pa chu skyes kyi zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang / phyag rgya dang / lha rnams smros shig /gang gis smras pa tsam gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags 'di rnam par dbye ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /sgrib ri — pa med par dkyil 'khor mthong ba kun tu gnas par byed do/ /cho ga zhib mo thams cad dang /gsang sngags dang / dam tshig dang / phyag rgya rnams rjes su mthun par phyogs te gnas par byed do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid dang /rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i lha thams cad mdun na nye bar gnas par byed do/ /sgrub pa'i de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang phyis kyang rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad sgrub pa'i cho ga rnams la legs par sgrub pa'i cho gar yang 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rig sngags 'chang gi larjes su 'brang zhing / phyi bzhin phyi bzhin lhan cig 5 rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar rig nas/sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse ba'i don du/ rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi mchog gi sgrub pa bklags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 6spyan sngar 'khor chen po'i dbus su/ bzhin 'dzum zhing mig mi 'dzums 7pas rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di smras so/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing na bzhugs pa'i 93—27

sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab 'byam (1)thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rab 'byam (2rgya mtsho rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa 3rigs thams cad kyi gsang ba dang / rig sngags 'chang gi dbang por bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gsang ba thams cad dang /rig sngags kyi 4rgyal po chen po'i sgrub pa grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po can/ rig sngags thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po'i bdag nyid chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa grub pa rnams dang phyag rgya thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/oṃ bi ma le/ bi ma la gar+bhe/ bi ma la am+bu dza pad+me srur+ya brtsa se/ sa ha sra rasmi ki ra ṇi ma hā rasmi dzā la a ba bhā ṣi te/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sañtsa ra pad+mo da ri pad+ma gar+bhe/ pad+ma bhu dze/ su bi ma la am+bu dza bi ma le ma ṇi 55ka ṇa (6)ka badz+ra bai ḍūr+ya in+d+ra nī la ma ra ka ta/ pad+ma rā ga bi bi dha ma hā ma ṇi rat+na 0༄lo kṛ ta sha rī re/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā pad+ma dha ra/ pa ra pa ra pa ra shu pā sha dha ra/ sa ra sa ra sa man+ta bai ro tsa na/ sarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ ku la sa ma ya pa ri pū ra ṇi/ ba ra ba ra/ badz+ra dzā nal mā lā gar+bhe/ badz+re badz+re badz+ra 5)a dhiṣ+ṭha ta pad+me hūṃ hūm̐/ ma ṇi ma ṇi ma hā ma ṇi tsin+ta 1 )ma ṇi pā sha dha ra/ hu ru hu ru pad+ma pad+ma go re pad+ma pā ṇi ba ra de/ a mo gha pad+me/ oṃ pad+me 67ni pad+ma ma ṇi badz+ra dha rā/93—28

sarba ta thā ga ta ku la sā nā mya sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ ma hā bi pu la bhu dze/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra/ bhu ru bhu ru bhu ri ṇi/ bhi ri bhi ri/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki ta bīr+ya 1rā dze pra sa ra pra sa ra san+ta bi ma le/ sarba bit+yā sgyusnyemaṇ+ḍa la de ba tā na maskṛ te/ta ra ta ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya/ sa man+ta pa ri pū ra ṇi sarba bo dhi satwa das bhi ṣe 4tsa ni sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha a bhi disti a bhi ṣiñtsa ya rma sarba bibyā maṇ+ḍa la ku la/sa ma ya a bhi ṣe (5dkaḥ96nyesarba ta thā ga ta pā ṇi ba ra de/ pad+ma gau re pad+ma pra bhe/pad+ma bi ka tsam+bu 57)dza gar+bhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+re badz+re/ badz+re pad+me 87ta thā ga ta ku la a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ a mo gha ba ra de/ sar+pā 59)sā pa ri pū 1 tshor ṇi sarba pā pa duḥnya1kha pra sha ma ni / a mo gha ṣ+ṭṛ da ya sid+dhi sā dha ya bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ba ra de pad+ma bhu dze na mastu 'o te pad+ma su te swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ don yod pa dri ma med pa pad+mo'i chu skyes kyi pad+ma'i lcags kyu don yod zhags pa'i snying po rigs kyi rgyal po gzungs chen po kun nas rnam par snang bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i snying po 'di smras pa'i de ma thag gi 'og tu pad+ma ze 'bru dang bcas pa'i ge sar gsal bar rnam par bye ste/ dper na grong khyer gyi phyogs gcig gi sgo bye nas rgyal mo byung ba bzhin du/ lha'i gzugs blta na sdug pa 'od mtha' yas pa phyag bzhi pa rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan 1 pa/ phyag na pad+ma/ don yod zhags pa'i ngo bo'i zhags pa'i phyag dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyal mtshan chen po'i phyag dang / mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag /spyan gsum pa/ zhal gsum pa 1 zla ba'i cod pan 'chang ba zhi ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal/ sku la 'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba'i snying po/ pad+ma dang / seng 93—29

ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ pad+ma kha bye ba'i snying por bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste tsho)/ mig mi 'dzums 25par blta zhing 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas/ don yod pa pad+ma dri ma med pa chu skyes kyi zhags pa'i lcags kyu rig sngags kyi rgyal po bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can dag pa chen po khyod ci'i phyir mig (༄mi 'dzums tshanapar blta/ mchog ci don du gnyer bzhin du 'khod ces so/ /rig sngags kyi (6rirgyal mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi spyi'i phyag rgya dang / sngags dang / dam tshig gsang ba'i rjes su 'jug par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis (7)'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo nyon cig /khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis thams cad du/ dam tshig gi 8dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i gsang bar lung bstan cing / khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mchog tu lung bstan no/ /ngas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya'i dam tshig thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur bar lung bstan no/ /tuṇ+ḍa dang /kur 9sham dang / sgrol ma dang / khro gnyer can dang / pad+ma rigs mdzes ma dang / lha mo chen mo 1 rikyi lī ki lī 11dang / rdo rje pho nya mo dang / dri med byed ma dang / pad+ma'i spyan ma dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma dang / rdo rje khro gnyer can 93—30

dang / lha mo pad+ma rab snang ma dang / pad+ma spyod byed ma dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo don yod pa'i phyag dang / longs spyod ldan ma dang / dpal mo dang / 'jigs ma dang / dpe med ma dang / dbyangs can ma dang / ral gcig ma spyan stong pa/ phyag stong pa/ dbu stong pa/ don yod pa'i pad+ma dang /rin chen lha mo dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid dang / rig pa'i dbang phyug nyid dang / lha mo chen mo phyag rgya'i dbang phyug dang / rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo dang / hu hwa bzlas pa'i sbyin sreg dang / zhi ba'i las dang / lha mo rigs mdzes ma dang / rig sngags 'chang chen mo rdo rje mdzes ma 1nyid dang / phyag na 'khor lo grub pa dang / de bzhin du ral gri bzang po'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang / khro bo nyid dang / khro bo'i rgyal po dang / dus kyi mtshan mo dang / zhal rnam par 'gyur ma dang / mche ba gtsigs nam dang / ser skya ma nyid dang / rang gsal ma dang / phyag na rin chen ma nyid dang / sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo dang / de bzhin du rdzas yongs su 'dzin pa'i lha mo dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil dang / gtor ma nyid kyi lha dang / a gri ṇi dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa'i lha dang / thams cad du rjes su song ba'i lha mo khyod dang /gsang sngags thams cad la dbang sgyur ma dang / bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i mchog sgrol bar byed pa dang / bdag gi gsang sngags thams cad 'dzin pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo'i mchog ma dang / rig sngags 'chang gi dbang mo dang / rigs kyi gsang sngags dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen po 4nges par sbyin pa 93—31

'jig rten dbang phyug skyes pa nyid du dpral ba'i smin ma'i bar du lha'i chu'i dngul las nges par skyes shing byung ba/ skar ma'i rnam pa dang mtshungs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can du gyur pa'o/ /zhes las sna tshogs dang / dbyangs can gang yin pa 'di 'chang bar byed do/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa dang du blangs nas gsungs so/ /rig sngags thams cad kyi dngos grub mnyam par skyob pa thob pa dang / de bzhin du cho ga zhib mo'i sgrub pa dang /phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags thams cad kyi dngos grub rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang /don yod pa'i dngos grub kyang thob par byed do/ /don yod pa'i 'bras bu mthong ba dang / bklags pas grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan dang / thams cad du rigs spyi'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi phyir dang / spyi'i dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya'i dam tshig nyid kyang 'di dran pa tsam gyis thams cad thob par byed do/ /dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang /lha de dag thams cad kyang dran pa tsam gyis rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur bar the tsom ((rimed do/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor dang lha rnams dam tshig la kun tu gnas par byed do/ /de lta bas na/ 'bad pa thams cad kyis zung cigasno/de bzhin du thub pa rnam par snang /rimadzad 4skudang / shākya'i rgyal pos rig sngags kyi rgyal por lung bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ming kun tu gzigs shing thams cad du rjes su 'gro ba ste/ de'i phyir spyan ras gzigs pad+ma zhes bya ba rig sngags kyi rgyal po bla na med pa/ rdo rje'i dngos grub dngos grub chen po/ pad+ma'i 5 rigs kyi dngos grub bla na med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub sgrub pa grub pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rigs dang nor bu 93—32

chen po'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub sgrub pa grub pa/ don yod pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du mchog gi dngos grub/ mchog gi dang po rdo rje'i rigs su bstan pa/ rdo rje rtse mo chen po'i lha 0)dang / de bzhin du rdo rje sa 'og dngos grub kyi phyir rdo rje phreng ba rim par phye ba'i grangs dang rdo rje mchu'i mchog gi dngos grub rnams la spyan ras gzigs pad+ma dang / pad+ma mdzes pa dang /de bzhin du'am/ ming smos pa tsam gyi (5)mod la rjes su 'brang zhing 'ong bar byed do/ /de bzhin du rdo rje dbang po dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / lag na rdo rje dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na/ rtag tu shes pas rig sngags smra ba dang / ming gang gi mchog 'dzin pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pas rtag tu rnam par gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin nyid du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / thub pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis rtag tu lung ston par 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di lung bstan ma thag tu sa rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos so/ /g.yos rab tu g.yos/ 'gul rirab tu 'gul/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ chem chem rab tu chem chem mo/ /lha'i me tog gi char bab ste no/ 'di lta ste/ zla ba mdog mdzes dang / dri med mdog mdzes dang / mdog mdzes chen po dang / mas ra ba dang / man+d+ra pa ra ba chen po dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu da phyiradang / pad+ma dkar po dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / ut+pa la dmar po dang / mya ngan 'tshang 7dang / skya nar dang / pun+ta ga dang / gan+dha ga hāk+ṣi nadaka dang / kon+ta dang / a dhi muk+ta ka dang / pa (9lha sha dang / mthon ka dang / mthon ka chen po dang / tsaspa ka 93—33

dang / sau (1)garnyi ka dang / san+dha tshon)bā ra ṇa ( nodang / nā ga put+pa dang / sna ma dang / yu thi ka dang / na 54)ba mā li ka dang / ta ra ṇa dang / ma ru ba ka dang / ku bya kya'i 55)me tog gi char 'bab pa'i don dang / tshon 46)rtsi sna tshogs pas btsos pa'i lha'i 7gos kyi char 'bab pa'i don dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi lha'i rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / rgyan cha'i char 'bab pa'i don dang /lha'i gser gyi 85me tog gi char 'bab pa'i don dang / lha'i dri tsan+dan dang /ta mā la dang / ga bur dang / gla rtsi dang / gur gum dang / lha'i gos dang /dri bzang pos bsgos 59pa'i phye ma'i char 'bab pa'i don dang / lha'i dri chab kyi char 'bab pa'i don dang / ma dkrol 1 ribar nam mkha'i mthil du rol mo'i sgra 'byung ba dang / sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i ris kyi lha'i bu me tog sna tshogs 'thor bar byed pa dang / gos dang / rin po che sna tshogs 'tsher bar byed pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i ris kyi lha'i mu tig gi do shal dang / gdu bu dang /dpung rgyan dang / rgyan zla gam can dang / mu tig dmar po dang / ka shi ku'i gos sna tshogs pa 'thor bar byed par gyur to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / gzhon nu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /dbang phyug la sogs pa lha'i bu 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus lha'i gzhal yas khang rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / lha'i gos dang me tog dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa rnams dang / rin po che sna bdun las byung ba'i gdugs sna tshogs pa rnams nam mkha'i mthil du kun tu gtor nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje 93—34

dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i 'khor la (1)mchod pa'i sprin chen por gyur te mchod pa chen po byed par gyur to/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i cho 'phrul chen po mthong bar gyur to/ /dngos grub chen po'i mtshan ma byung bar gyur pa rnams yang dag par mthong ngo / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag par mthong bar gyur to / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kun tu yang dag par bye'o/ /lha'i gzhal yas khang sna tshogs pa byung 2tshobar gyur pa mthong ngo / /de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su song nas lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te rdo rje gsor bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod nas bzhin 'dzum pas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa riche zhing che ba yang dag par snang ba dang / mchod pa'i sprin gyi char che zhing che ba rab tu 'bab pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dngos grub kyi mtshan ma che zhing che ba snang ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma 4yin pa'i 'khor chen po 'dus par gyur pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po skyes par mthong bar snang ba dang / cho 'phrul che zhing che ba snang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rig sngags chen po 'byung bar snang ba ni/ bcom ldan 93—35

'das rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/ 'di ci'i mthus sngon gyi mtshan ma yang dag par snang ba lags/ 'di rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa gang zhig yang dag par snang ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 6)sems la the tsom ( de skyes par gyur pas/ de nges par bstan du gsol/ zhu ba lung ston par 'gyur ba gang gis/ bdag gi dun)dogs pa rnam par sel ba dang / som nyi rnam par sel bar byed pas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs dbye ru gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje nges par bstan par bya'i sa ninyon cig /lag na rdo rje 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gaṅgā'i 5 klung gi bye ma snyed bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mthus rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul snang bar byed do/ /don yod pa rnam par 'phrul pa/kun tu snang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang / phyag rgya dang (6)/ cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags dang / gzungs dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rig sngags kun tu snang ba dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po rnam par snang bar byed do/ /de'i mthus snang ba 'di dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul 'di snang ngo / /lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di mthong ba dang / ming bzung ba tsam gyis kyang / de bzhin 93—36

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i 6)klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa mngon sum du mthong ba dang / mtshan gzung (0ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po chen po (5)dang ldan pa yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig dang / rig sngags dang /phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / snying po'i mthu rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gsang bar rab tu zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi cho ga zhib mo'i rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di lan cig 4ribazlas pa de rnams kyang /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi drung du/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig dang /gsang sngags chen po rim par phye ba'i sgrub pa la rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di ni/ rdzu 'phrul che ba'i phyir te/ 'di lta ste/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du/ snying po dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / dkyil 'khor gsang ba la rab tu zhugs shing dbang bsgyur ba'i rjes su zhugs pa ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i snying por gyur pa gcig pu'o/ /'di lta ste/ 'o ma dang chu yang dag par 'byung ba bzhin no/ /snying po gcig po 'di/ rigs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo'i rjes su zhugs 93—37

pa'o / /des na lag na rdo rje khyod kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ kun nas rjes su 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje rgyu des na/ rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di0)/ ming lan cig gzung 9geb tsam gyis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi drung du/gsang ba thams cad kyi snying po dang / gzungs dang / gsang sngags dang /phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo rab tu ston pa dang / mtshan gzung bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi drung du/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su gzung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' legs so zhes bya ba stsol )bar 'gyur ro/ /don yod pa yangs pa chen po'i dngos grub rab tu stsol gabar 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu grub pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub so sor rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rig sngags kyi snying po dang / ting nge 57'dzin dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi yul dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi rgyan dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rjes su song bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad rjes su sbyor zhing dam tshig gi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro / /lag na rdo rje de bzhin du/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i mthu chen pos rnam par 'phrul pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 9byin gyis brlabs pa/93—38

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /lag na rdo rje/de bas na/ de rnams rig sngags kyi rgyal po'i mthu chen po'o/ /lag na rdo rje/rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ me tog gam/ bdug pa'am/ dri dang byug (1)pa dang / rol mo gcig gis mchod pa dang / lan cig (na tsam gyis kyang / dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi snying po gsang ba dang /mchod pa rnams byas pa dang / mnyes par byas pa dang / klog par byas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / gzungs tshonadang / rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po mchod pa 0byas par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dran pa tsam gyis/ gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / bgegs dang / log par 'dren pa dang / bdud kyi rigs kyi lha de rnams thams cad phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su 'bros par byed do/ /yams thams cad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa rnams thams cad dang /gtam ngan gyi 'jigs 5 pa rnams rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /gdug 67pa thams cad dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad dang / mi mdza' 7ba rnams rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par grol bar byed do/ /mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa rnams rnam par grol bar byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis na dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 93—39

dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams thams cad kyis kyang kun tu srung bar 'gyur ro / /lag na rdo rje rig sngags 'chang gi dbang po rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur zhing / srung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sbed par byed do/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje bcu rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang dpung dang bcas/ 'khor dang bcas pas kun nas phyogs bzhir srung bar byed do/ /thams cad du cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub mchog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig gi dngos grub chen po sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i snying po rnam par grol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gsang ba don yod pa'i de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /srin po thams cad kyang rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi drung du mchod pa chen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /bkra shis dang yid la bsams 91pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gshed byed dang /byad stems dang / gsang sngags dang / ro langs dang / sems bsgyur (2ba dang / sbod gtong gi sbyor ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams thams cad 'byer bar byed do/ /dug dang / sbyar dug dang / phye ma'i sbyor ba rnams thams cad 'byer bar byed do/ /rims rnams thams cad 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / mtshan gcig pa dang / nyin gcig pa dang / grang ba'i rims 93—40

dang / rlung las gyur pa 51)dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / mgo gzer dang / phol mig dang / g.yan pa dang / mig nad dang / gzhogs tshan phyed na ba dang / ma ro ( tsa ka dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / pho ba'i nad dang / bshang ba 'khyil ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / mchin pa na ba dang / tshad pa dang / gcin nad dang / gsud 4pa dang / lto ba na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang /nying lag na ba de dag thams cad dran pa tsam gyis rnam par 'jig par byed do/ /sha bkra dang / mdze dang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang / lhog pa dang /rkang shu dang / me dbal dang / shu ba dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / rma dang /mgrin pa 'gags pa de dag thams cad byabs pa tsam gyis rnam par 'jig par byed do/ /phyis kyang nam yang tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di de ltar go skabs yangs la rgya che ba yin no/ /lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po don yod pa pad+ma dri ma med pa'i chu skyes kyi zhags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 5)byin gyis brlab6/ rdo rje gsang ba'i snying po/ dam tshig byin gyis rlob pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas yang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rjes/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar zhus nga/'i dge mtshan dang / bkra shis pa gsang ba byin gyis rlob pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa thos nas tshim pa dang / mgu ba dang / yi 7rangs pa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom 93—41

ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi mchog sbyin par byed pa 'di ni shin tu dkon no/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad dang / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig gi dngos grub bla na med pa thams cad yang dag par rdzogs par byed pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po mchog tu dkon te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang mnyam par blta bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang mnyam pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 1dpral ba'i bar nas nges par byung ba ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa de dag thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / dngos grub mthong ba'i de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa grub pa na ched du 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba mchog tu nye bar bsags par 'gyur ba las gzhan ma yin no/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dran pa tsam gyis bsod nams kyi phung po dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs gzhal du med pa dang / tshad med pa dang /grangs med pa nye bar bsags par 'gyur gyi gzhan du ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das nyin mtshan du yang rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dran par bgyi skad cig kyang mi brjed par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ci ste slar yang snga dro'am/ nyin mo'am / mtshan mo'am/ zla ba'am/ lor yang rung ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di brjed na/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad brjed par 'gyur/ yongs su dor bar 'gyur/ bsod nams kyi tshogs thams cad yongs su dor bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya 93—42

thub pas bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje de de bzhin no/ /ji ltar khyod kyis smras pa de de bzhin te/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di lag tu son par 'gyur ba'i sems can de ni dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu skyed pa ma yin no/ /lag na rdo rje gaṅgā'i 91klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma mthong ba dang / bsnyen bkur ma byas pa dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / dam tshig dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po ma thos shing ma zhugs (0pa gang yin pa des nitsho ri/ lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di de'i lag tu phyin par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi thos shing mi mthong la/ ming gi sgra grags pa tsam du'ang mi 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje 47rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/gang gi lag tu son par 'gyur ba des ni/ lag na rdo rje gaṅgā'i 5klung gi bye ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams de'i lag tu son par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi drung du/rigs kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / snying po dang / gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo thams cad lag tu son par 'gyur ro/ /gnas thams cad du song zhing rjes su zhugs par 'gyur ro / /thams cad rjes su song zhing / dam tshig shes par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags thams cad dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / phyag rgya yang dag par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi mchog dang /gtso bo dang thu bor 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams thams cad kyi 93—43

drung na/ sras kyi gtso bor dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 1lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar ston pa dang /bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ gang gi lag tu son cing thob par 'gyur ba'i sems can gang yin pa de ni/ de'i yon tan dang / phan yon gzhal rdo du med pa hūṃ —3thob par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ gang gi lag tu son par 'gyur ba de/ sangs rgyas kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad so sor rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di smras nas/ rang gi gzugs kyi bdag nyid kyi dngos po pad+ma'i ze 'bru'i dbus su rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'phags par bltas nas/ don yod pa yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od ces bya ba nor bu rin po che chen po rig sngags kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das la phul bar gyur to/ /oṃ a mo gha tsin+ta cam ṇi ba ra da pad+me dz+wa la dz+wa la na bhu dze hūm̐/ 'di ni don yod pa pad+ma dri ma med pa'i chu skyes kyi zhags pa'i rtsa ba'i snying po'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das la phul ba'i de ma thag pa de nas rig sngags kyi rgyal po thams cad/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na/ bcom ldan 'das la spyan mi 'dzums /5par blta zhing 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas don yod pa yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od rig sngags kyi rgyal po nor bu rin po che chen po de la yang / rig sngags kyi rgyal pos spyi bo nas dbang bskur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'dis dbang bskur ma thag tu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi 93—44

khams ri dang / nags dang 'brog (17dgon par bcas pa rnams rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos so/ /phyogs bcu kun nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar gyur to/ /des na dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings su rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la 2)legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ shākya thub pa mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba'i mngon par dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po 'dis mngon par dbang bskur ba 'di legs so legs so/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa snga ma rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du rig pa'i rgyal po 'dis dbang bskur ro/ /nged thams cad kyis kyang tshig gcig tu mthun pas don yod pa yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od la rig sngags kyi rgyal po chen pos mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyang phyag gser gyi kha dog can brkyang nas/ de rnams thams cad la rig pa'i rgyal pos spyi bo'i gtsug nas mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni mngon par dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya mngon par dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa'o/ /oṃ a mo gha bai ro tsa na ma hā mu dā ma ṇi pad+me dz+wa la pra bsgo 4ya hūm̐/ phyag rgya chen pos mngon par dbang bskur ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rig pa'i rgyal po de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyag rgyas dbang bskur ba rig nas/bcom ldan 'das la g.yas su bskor ba gsum byas nas thal mo sbyar ba btud de9de / phyag byas nas spyan sngar 'dug ste 6sems par gyur to/ /de nas bcom 943—45

ldan 'das rig sngags 'chang de'i rig pa'i rgyal po sems par gzigs nas/ji ltar da 1)ltar yid la byed pa yang dag par rab tu gsal bar mdzad do/ /oṃ a mo gha maṇ+ḍa la pad+ma a bhi ṣe na)rka ma ṇi badz+re sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe dunasake hūm̐/rig pa'i rgyal po des dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur bas mngon par dbang bskur ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (shegasang ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs thun mong ba'i dam tshig rdo rje chen po'i tshul gyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / pad+ma'i rigs dang /rdo rje'i rigs dang / nor bu'i rigs rnam par thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar cher 'khrigs pa'i dkyil 'khor du brtags pa mthong ngo / /rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa bas rig pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor pa'i lha thams cad mthong ngo / /rmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul che zhing che ba dag byung ngo //don yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po shin tu ngo mtshar ba dag mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'di lta bu mthong nas don yod pa'i mchod pa'i nor bu rdo rje byin gyis rlobs gepa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon par dbang bskur ba bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang ba dang ldan pa'o/ /o a mo gha pū 96dza ma ṇi pad+ma badz+re ta thā ga ta 〉bi lo ki te rinanges man+ta (9) pra sa ra hūm̐/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis don yod pa mchod pa'i nor bu'i snying po byin ma thag tu mchod pa rgya chen po rnam pa sna tshogs pa du ma rab tu byung ste1 / ji ltar rang rang gi cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du mchod pa chen po rnams rab tu 11byung ngo / /lha rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnam par bkra ba yangs 93—46
