dang / don yod pa dri ma med pa'i bdag po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /don yod pa zab mo'i sgra sgrogs 0)pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge ②'dzin dang / don yod pa'i dngos grub kyi zhags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / don yod pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 'od kyi snang ba rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te(kye/ 'di rnams la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mang po rnams so sor thob cing ting nge 'dzin gzhan/ 'jig rten las 'das pa brgya stong phrag bklags pa dang / bzlas pa tsam gyis grub ④par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i gzungs kyi snying po 'di yon tan che ba dang /phan yon che ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa che ba ste/ don yod pa lcags kyu'i cho ga zhib mo la/ don yod pa nor bu'i mchod pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i gzungs gsungs pa/ sems can thams cad la phan pa rjes su 'brang ba/dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skye bar byed pa/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong bar byed pa/ gzungs kyi tshig gi snying po gang zhig bklags pa tsam dang bzlas pa tsam gyis 'di rnams byed pa'i dngos grub so sor thob pa'o5ge /sgrub pa 'di rnams thams cad ni las kyi rnam par 'phrul du 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang de smyung bar gnas te/ bzlas pa gcig dang bklags pa'i dngos grub kyis de lta bu'i rgyas shing gsal ba thob bo/ /de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub yang 465so sor thob steci ra/ don rgya che ba dang / longs spyod dang ldan pa dang / gzungs kyi dngos grub chen po so sor thob bo/ /bkod pa yangs pa rnam par lta 8chib zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi gsang ba so sor 93wa 96

thob bo/ /dpag bsam gyi shing yang dag par gang ba'i char 'bebs pa dang /gzungs kyi 6)rnam par 'phrul pa'i bkod pa so sor thob bo/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgya mtsho dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi char 'bebs pa dang /kun nas kun tu gzigs pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi gzungs kyi gsang ba'i char 'bebs pa'i dngos grub so sor thob bo/ /kun nas gser gyi rgyal mtshan gyi char 'bebs pa'i gzungs kyi bkod pa rnam par bltas pa dang / don yod pa'i bkod pa rab 'byam gyi 97dngos grub rab tu thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par lta ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi gzungs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa so sor thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po dang / dkyil 'khor rnam par lta (khuba'i dngos grub so sor thob bo/ /rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa thams cad so sor thob bo/ /phan yon chen po dang / rnam par 'phrul pa chen po byin gyis brlabs pa 'di rnams so sor thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob pas libyin gyis brlabs pas don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs gang bklags pa tsam gyis yon tan dang phan yon rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa chen po so sor thob bo/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje mchog tu dga' ba skyes shing mchog tu skyi 55bung zhes byed pa skyes nas/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhabs la btud de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsungs pa'i don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs gang yin pa 'di mchog tu rnyed par dka'o/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bur 93—97

gyur pa'i snying po'i gzungs gang yin pa ni mchog tu rnyed par dka'o/ /mthu chen po dang / phan yon chen po dang / yon tan chen po skyed pa dang mthun pa rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul che bar blta bar bya'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po de (1 rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am / dge sbyong ngam/ bram za'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ bud med dam/skyes pa'am/ khye'u'am bu mo yang rung ste/ lan cig 92)bzlas pa dang / dran pa tsam dang bklags pa tsam gyis bsod nams kyi phung po dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das sdig pa thams cad zad par gyur pa de ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten pa rnams grub ris par 'gyur ba ci lags / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yongs su dag par 'gyur ba ci lags/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs par 'gyur ba ci lags/bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 4rirtag tu mchog stsol pa ba de ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la de'i skabs dbye bar mdzad du gsol/ de lta bu'i phan yon phul du byung ba ni bcom ldan 'das mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /lag na rdo rje mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dri ba dris pa de ngas ji lta ba bzhin du da lta bshad par bya yi nyon cig /lag na rdo rje 'di ni bklags pa tsam gyi mod dang / brjod pa tsam gyi mod la byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu dga' ba dang bcas pas phyag g.yas pa spyi bor 'jog par byed do/ /mngon sum du rang gi gzugs kyis 93—98

mdun na nye bar gnas te dbugs 'byin par yang byed do/ /de ci ( 1)ltar zhe na / 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang bzhin gyis lus yongs su dag pa gzung ba'i gzungs kyi snying po'o/ /'di ni don yod pa'i rang bzhin gyi snying po'o/ /'di ni sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rang bzhin mthong ba'o/ /'di ni bcu gcig zhal mthong ba'o/ /'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sna tshogs pa'i (5)gzugs mthong ba'o/ /'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sprin mthong ba'o/ /'di ni mgrin pa sngon po dang / sred med kyi bu'i gzugs mthong ba'o/ /'di ni 'jig rten gsum mthong ba'o/ /rta mgrin mthong ba'o/ /'di ni pad+mo yangs pa'i (5)gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /'di ni rdo rje'i snying po chen po mthong ba'o/ /'di ni mgo'i snying po chen po'o/ /'di ni sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyi rang bzhin mthong ba'o/ /'di ni don yod pa'i gzugs dang don yod pa'i dngos grub kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /'di ni des thams cad du 'gugs pas na zhags par brjod par bya'o/ /don yod pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs su brjod par bya ste/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dam par gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku gzhan du gyur pa mthong ba mtshungs pa ste/ don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'di dag mthong ba dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /bklags pa dang brjod pa tsam gyi mod la dus gsum du gshegs pa de bzhin 93wa 99

gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi sras gcig pur 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yongs su dag pa'i sku shin tu dri ma med cing yongs su dag pa dang mnyam par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i skur yang 'gyur ro / /dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis phyir mi ldog par lung ston cing / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par 'gyur ro / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha thams cad kyis yang dag par dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /bdud la sogs pa dang / gdug (1)pa'i rmi lam dang / log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad par byas par 'gyur ro/ /bcing ba lngas bcings shing gzir ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / yi dgas 9kyedang / grul bum dang / brjed byed dang / tshangs pa'i ① srin po rnams thams cad ring du 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /rims thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / 'bras dang / phol mig dang / rtsog shu dang /lhog 54༄pa dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / g.yan pa dang / mdze dang /rkang shu thams cad rnam par nyams par 55༄byed do/ /lus kyi gzer thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /ji ltar shel (6)yongs su dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /tshig btsan par yang 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags dang / cho ga zhib mo thams cad kyi dngos grub tu yang 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad dga' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / khyim bdag gis cher mchod par bya bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi mchod par 'os pa gcig pur 'gyur 93—100

ro / /nor dang 'bru 'phel bar yang 'gyur ro/ /bsam pa dang yid kyi shing rta thams cad yongs su rdzogs par yang 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun dang / g.yo can dang / rkun pos rnam par skrag pa dang / gcan gzan (1)khro bo dang / g.yang sa dang / khyim rdib ②pa dang / gsod pa dang / 'chi (khub dang / gcan gzan 0khro bo'i 'jigs pa rnams thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /me dang chus dus byed pa dang / rlung dang / tshad pa dang / sad dang / ser ba rnams kyis (9mi tshugs so/ /dgra thams cad kyis 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /thams cad byams pa'i yid du 'gyur ro/ /bud med dang / skyes pa dang /khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad dbang du gyur par byed do/ /'di ni bklags pa tsam gyis 'jig rten pa rnams kyi yon tan chen po bskyed pa dang / rnam par 'phrul par 'gyur ro/ /de 'chi 'pho ba'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur te/rigs kyi bu tshur shog /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su song dang /khyod kyis lam yongs su dag par byas pa'o/ /'chi ba'i dus su gyur pa na bsams 6)pa nyid kyi mod la pad+ma 7)las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / tshe rabs dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med mngon sum du mthong ba tsam gyis phyir mi ldog par 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor dang pad+mo yangs pa'i gsang ba mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo mngon du 'gyur zhing kha ton du kun tu gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 93—101

gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rjes su dran par byed do/ /thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon sum du mtshungs par lhan cig lung ston pa so sor thob ste/ nam du yang phyir zhing rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang / ji srid du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu bstan pa'i bar dang /ji srid du yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i lus su gyur gyi bar du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan yon dang / rnam par 'phrul pa bklags pas grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bzlas pa tsam gyis dngos grub bshad par bya ste/ snga dro gcig bzlas pa tsam gyi mod la mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa dang / mnar med pa'i mthar gtugs pa'i sdig pa dang / ri rab lhun po chen po bdun gyi tshad tsam ba spu'i khung 1bu re rer sgrib pa bsags pa dang / bskal pa stong phrag tu bsags pa'i sngon gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa de rnams thams cad snga dro gcig bzlas pa tsam gyis 2sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa rnam par nyams par byed de(gyi/ zad pa dang yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal ba'i 'gro ba chen po bcu drug tu gzhol ba de rnams thams cad skad cig gcig gis yongs su grol lo/ /smyung bar 4gnas pa gcig gis bzlas pas 45 dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su kun tu bzang po chen po nyid thob bo/ /gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / pad+mo yangs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / don yod zhags pa'i snying po thams cad du dngos su rjes su 'jug par byed do/ /thams cad du dam tshig chen po yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi gzugs kyis dngos su mthong ba sbyin par byed do/ /dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 93—102

rnams rang gi gzugs kyis dngos su mthong bar nye bar gnas par byed do/ /dkyil 'khor ba'i lha thams cad dngos su rjes su 'brang zhing gnas te/ rtag tu rnam par lta 0)bar 'gyur zhing cher bcings par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyang rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing dngos su mthong bar gnas par byed do / /brgya stong phrag bzlas pa tsam gyis (0lce rdo rje ltar brtan (kyepar 'gyur zhing /rdo rje'i snying po dang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa dang / pad+ma'i 'dab 54)ma lta bu'i kha dog dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ phyir zhing de'i lus la reg pa ngan pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phyir zhing lus 'pho bar yang mi nus shing / yongs su dag cing dri ma med pa'i lus su 'gyur ro/ /lus pad+ma dkar po'i kha dog dang mtshungs par yang 'gyur ro/ /gdug pa thams cad dang / phyir rgol ba dang / dgra thams cad dang / 'byung po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad dang / bgegs dang / log par 'dren pa rnams dang / klu ma rungs pa mi bzad pa dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha thams cad kyis lus dang phung po la bza' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus pad+ma dkar po'i kha dog dang mtshungs par 'gyur te57/lha rnams lhan cig tu rjes su rgyu bar byed do/ /kha nas lha rdzas kyi ut+pal sngon po'i dri 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lus la lha rdzas kyi tsan+dan gyi dris bsgos par 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa dang lag pa gzhon sha can du 'gyur ro/ /mig gis legs par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ro / /snyan pa thos par yang 'gyur zhing lha rdzas kyi dri tshor bar yang 'gyur ro/ /bzang po la reg 567pa'i lus su yang ( 'gyur ro/ /skra bung ba dang mtshungs pa la ri rizhing 597'khyil ba'i skra ru 'gyur ro/ /nam yang phyir zhing lus kyi nang gi rlung gi 93—103

las dang / dri ngan pas bsgos par mi 'gyur ro/ /dri ma 0)thams cad bsal bar 'gyur ro9ge/ /'jam pa dang / snyan pa dang / mnyen pa'i ngag tu yang 'gyur ro/ /lha'i nga ro dang / nga ro bzang ba dang / nga ro zab dusnyan cing mnyen pa dang / mi 'am ci'i sgra lta bu dang / ka la ping ga'i sgra dbyangs su 'gyur ro/ /mdzes par 'gro ba dang / zab par 'gro bar yang 'gyur ro/ /lag mthil gtan du ge'ajam pa dang / sor mo ring ba dang / lag pa'i ri mo shin tu rnam par bkra bar yang 'gyur ro/ /seng ge'i 'gros dang rtsal gyis ( de'agro bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i 'gros su 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi gtso bo gcig pur mchod pa'i 'os su yang 'gyur ro/ /ne dpal 7rnam thos sras rjes su mthun par rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /tshig mi mthun pa yang rjes su mthun par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du ngag rnam par dag par yang 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa'i bzlas pa'i dngos grub bo/ /'jig rten las 'das pa ni skye ba brjes nas/ pags (8༄pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang / bsams 9pa nyid kyi mod la skye bar 'gyur te/ 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar mdun gyi pad+ma'i snying po las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur zhing / rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / tshe rabs dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis /dzo )lung bstan pa dang / mngon par dbang bskur ba'i mchog byang chub tu lung ston pa dang mngon par dbang bskur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa byin gyis rlob pas kyang byin gyis brlabs so zhes pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzlas pa'i cho ga'i dngos grub bo/ /de nas bsod nams kyi phung po brjod par 93—104

bya ste/ 'di bzlas pa tsam gyis bsod nams kyi phung po dang dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang yang rung bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ nor bu rin po che chen po sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang bar byas pa dang / gser gyi me tog dang /dngul gyi me tog gis yongs su bkang nas/ dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nyi ma re re zhing de bzhin gshegs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba la/ nor bu rin po che chen po sna bdun dang /gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog gis bkang nas phul ba de bas kyang /dge ba dang bsod nams kyi phung po ches mang bar bskyed do/ /gang zhig dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa mchod cing / nyi ma re re zhing 1de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa de kho na bzhin du 'di bzlas pa tsam gyis ri dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams gang gis nor bu rin po che chen po byin pas de rnams kyi dge dab bcu drug gi char yang mi phod do/ /de bzhin du bsod nams kyi phung po dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /'jig rten pa'i cho ga sna tshogs pa'i tshogs dang / 'jig rten las 'das la 4bsod nams kyi phung po stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya stong phrag rnams nor bu rin po che chen po sna bdun gyis bkang ba/ rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog dang / gser dang / dngul gyi me tog gisari bkang ba rnams kyis dus gsu ma pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re zhing la yang / stong 93—105

gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu bkang nas phul bar 'gyur ro / /mchod pa'i sprin chen por 'gyur te/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mthar thug gi bar du mi zad de de lta bu'i bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur zhing / bsod nams kyi phung po chen por yang 'gyur te/bsod nams kyi phung po chen po 'chidang ldan par yang 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzlas pa'i dngos grub dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phan yon chen po dang / rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang /90 sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba chen po gang yin pa dang / bzlas pa'i cho ga chen po dang / mchod pa'i sprin chen por 'gyur ro//de bzhin du yon tan bskyed pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho ga'i khyad par so sor thob bo/ /dus rtag par rgyun du bzlas pa'i cho ga dang ldan par 'gyur bar bya'o / /rtag tu yang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong 'dod par 'gyur ro / /rtag tu yang dge ba'i rtsa ba dang yang dag par 'grogs par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje gang yang rig pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo 'di hūṃ nodon yod pa'i mchod pa'i 4nor bu'i snying po 'di tha na sgra tsam yang rna ba'i bu gar ltung bar 'gyur ba dang / bris pa rnams blta ba dang / po ti'am/ —yi ge'am/ rtsig pa'am gyang (5 la bris pa lta (nerabar byed pa de mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa thams cad yongs su zad cing yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /sngon bsags pa'i mnar med par gzhol ba'i sdig pa dang / sgrib pa de thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do/ /yongs su gtugs (7da/par 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar 'gyur te/ pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur 93—106

rol/ /nam yang phyis mngal du gnas pa'i dri mas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du byang chub la mthar lhonyethug gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du pad+ma las skye bar 'gyur zhing tshe rabs dran par yang 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci ②ltar cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'di bri bar bya/ bcom ldan 'das 'dri ( nobazhin pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu bskyed pa ci lags/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci dang yang dag par ldan par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje 'di'i yon tan dang phan yon dpag tu med de/ don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i rig pa'i rgyal po 'di'i don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'dri sku)bzhin pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu skye ste/ phan yon dpag tu med pa dang yon tan dpag tu med pa las byung ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa so sor thob bo/ /gang yang don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyu rig pa'i rgyal po don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'di 'dri rdo5)bar 'gyur ba nyon cig /lag na rdo rje rgya mtsho chen po'i 'og tu dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa chu (6)dang zheng du dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa de las chu'i thigs pa'i tshad kyi thigs pa re re'i grangs su byed 57ci'adod pa'am/ de lta bu'i tshad kyi ngos gnyis par mtsho chen po las thigs pa re re nas bcu bar bya ste/ de la thigs pa re re nas bgrangs te gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas rgya mtsho chen po chu'i thigs pa'i grangs kyis zad par 'gyur zhing chu skam par byed do/ /mtsho chen po gnyis pa las chus yongs su gang bar 'gyur gyi/ don yod pa'i lcags kyu rig pa'i rgyal po 'di 93—107

dang / don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs kyi cho ga zhib mo de 'dri 1bzhin pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni gzung bar nus pa ma yin no//de ltar rgya che ba/ de ltar zab pa/ de ltar yangs pa'i yon tan bskyed par bya ba ni/ don yod pa nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs (yikyi cho ga zhib mo'i cho ga'i rgyal po'o/ /lag na rdo rje 'on kyang ri'i rgyal po ri rab chen po ni dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'og tu rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du nub bo/ /dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi steng nyid du gnas so/ /skyes bu stobs chen po dang ldan par gyur pa gang la la ri'i rgyal po ri rab chen po gang yin pa yang yungs kur gyi 'bras bu'i tshad tsam du byed pa dang / ngos gnyis par rgya mtsho chen po'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab chen po cho ga de lta bus 4yungs kur gyi 'bras bu tsam du byas pa las slar yang ri'i rgyal po ri rab du 55gnas par byed par nus kyi cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po gang yin pa 'di 'dri 56bzhin pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni mi nus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ⑦spyan dang / de'i gsung gi 8tshad gzung bar mi nus so/ /de bzhin du yon tan dang / phan yon rgya che zhing bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su 'dzin te/dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo dang /phyag rgya 'di ci 9ltar bri 1 bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 47stsal pa/lag na rdo rje nyon cig /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam / dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ dge sbyong ngam / bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/ rje'u 12rigs sam/ dmangs rigs 93—108

sam / bud med dam/ skyes pa'am/ khye'u'am/ bu mo gang la la cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po 'di 'dri (1༄bar byed pa de/ phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim gshepar phye ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi las dang / yo byad dang bcas pa'i cho gas don yod pa'i nor bu'i pad+ma zhags pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'khor lo dkyil 'khor chen po dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i klu'i zhags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'di 'dri ①bar byed do/ /des yongs su dag pa'i ngag dang yid kyis dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / gus pa dang bcas pa dang / yid der gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i mchog dang / gus pa la sogs pa'i 'dri (gemakhan gyis (5)bri bar bya'o/ /mchog tu gus pa dang / zhe sa dang bcas pas kha zas mi mthun pa spangs te/ legs par yongs su rdzogs pa'i kha zas ro bro ba'i mchog dang / legs par 'dus byas shing yid dga' ba'i me tog dang 'bras bu'i btung ba gus pa dang bcas pas/ gnas su gi wang 56)gi dkyil 'khor dang / me tog gcal 'a༄du bkram nas dri yis (8)bdugs tsa)te/dar gyis spras pa'i chos kyi stan la 'dug 7pas bri bar bya'o/ /legs par khrus byas shing mgo la dris byug /lus la gos bgos 31la mchod pa hurtebya'o/ /tshes brgyad dam bco lnga la so so'i cha shas dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par phye nas gtor ma dang / nye bar spyod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i yid kyis bya ste/ yon dang bcas pas gser gyi rna 12rgyan sbyin par bya'o/ /bri bar bya ba yongs su ma spangs par don yod par bya'o/ /lag pa brkyang bas bya'o/ /legs par sbyang ba ④byas pas bya'o8/ / 'di yi tshecho gas 'dri yo tshobar byed pa gang 93—109

yin pa des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi gsang ba'i dam tshig dang / dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya rim par phye ba dang / gsang ba bris 6)par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang / nor bu'i rigs dang / pad+ma'i rigs dang / rdo rje'i rigs gang ci yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po de thams cad 'dri 2bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ chu gang yin pa thams cad chu gang richen po dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i rjes su zhugs nas ro gcig tu 'gyur ro//'di lta ste nyi ma shar ba na mun pas ldongs pa thams cad kun tu snang bar byed do//de kho na bzhin du don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i rig pa'i rgyal po'i snying po 'di dang /don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po 'di dang / don yod pa'i zhags pa'i nor bu pad+ma'i snying po'i (4)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po dang / rnam par 'phrul pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang / dkyil 'khor chen po dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor ba'i klu'i zhags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa 'di thams cad du mtshungs par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang (deba'i rjes su 'jug go/ /dam tshig dang / phyag rgya dang / snying po rnams mtshungs par dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su rab tu skyes pa'o/ /thams cad du mtshungs par mchod pa'i sprin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /gang yang dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab dang lhan cig pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi tha snyad kyi (65de kho na nyid yang dag pa'i 7༄snying po'o/ /don yod pa nor bu mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs dang / don yod pa nor bu pad+ma'i zhags pa'i snying po dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 93—110

snying po dang / gzungs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / 'khor lo dang / dkyil 'khor chen po dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor ba dang / klu'i zhags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs pa de thams cad gsang ba'i dam tshig gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so/ /rgyu de'i phyir 'di ni don yod zhags pa'i don yod pa'i las sgrub par byed pa'i mthu stobs kyi dngos grub ste༅/ don yod zhags pa'i snying po dang / don yod zhags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'o/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'dri 2 bzhin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / bsod nams kyi phung po chen po yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dang /mtshungs pa gcig 4 gis mtshungs pa'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i lcags kyu'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mor byin gyis brlabs so/ /'dri 5 bar byed pa dang /'don par byed pa dang / klog par byed pa dang / bzlas pa ni mchod pa'i sprin du byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i phyir 'di ni rig sngags 'chang gis legs par rab tu dang ba dang las la spro zhing brtson pas bya'o/ /shin tu gsal ba dang / spro ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / dad pas bri 6bar bya'o/ /shin tu 'bad pas phyag rgya dang gsang sngags kyi snying po dang / gsung 7dang /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor dang / klu'i zhags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bri bar bya/bklag par bya/ mnyan par bya'o/ /mthu stobs kyis mnyan par bya'o/ /mthu stobs kyis 585bri bar bya/ /mthu stobs kyis mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /mthu stobs kyis (9 dam pa'i chos mchod pa dang / gus pas 'dri bar byed pa po dang / 'dri 7bzhin pa la bsnyen bkur dang / bla ma la sri zhu byed par bya'o/ /93—111

'di ni mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /don yod zhags pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gsang ba'o/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kye gsang ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / gzungs kyi gsang ba byin gyis brlabs pa ni gnyis te 17/ gcig ni don yod pa'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs so/ /gnyis pa ni don yod pa'i nor bu'i pad+ma zhags pa'i snying po'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po rnam par 'phrul pa dang / 'khor lo dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i klu'i zhags pas rnam par 'phrul pas sprul pa'o / /'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che chen por 'gyur ba ste/ don yod pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gi mchod pa chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po don yod pa'i zhags pa'i gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 2byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dam par gyur pa'i snying po don yod pa'i yid bzhin gyi du rinor bu ste/ 'di ni gnyis par rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi nor bu rin po che chen po ste/ don yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa yin no/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi dbang po du ma rig sngags 'chang brgya stong phrag gis yongs su bskor ba dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i lha brgya stong phrag du ma dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha brgya stong phrag du ma dang /dbang po dang / lha'i dbang po dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / gtsang ma'i gnas kyi ris kyi lha'i bu brgya stong phrag rnams dang / gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang / lha dang /93—112

klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i tshogs stong phrag rnams kyis de lta bu'i gsung gi sgra dbyangs thos nas/ dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / yi (1)rangs pa dang / rab tu mgu (2ba dang / dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes par gyur to/ /de bzhin du gnyis par nor bu rin po che chen po nyan pa la de rnams thams cad lhan cig tu mthun par rgyal po chen po bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / rol mo dang ske/ pheg rdob pa sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed par gyur to/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de la yang mchod pa byed (5)par gyur cig /rig pa'i rgyal po de la yang mchod par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya 94)stong phrag du mas 5ribaskor ba byas nas legs so zhes rjod 56)par byed de/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba gang yin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das gnyis par nor bu rin po che chen po don yod zhags pa'i snying po rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzam bu'i 7gling du rab tu bzhag go zhes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs so/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsungs pa'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying por gyur pa thun mong bar mtshungs pa'o / /thams cad du gsang ba phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa mchog tu rnyed par dka' bar gsungs 93—113

pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das bdag de dag thams cad mthun par gyur pas lhan cig pa kho nar rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing / rig pa'i rgyal po 'di yang dag par rjes su 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /'di yongs su bsrung 0)bar bgyi'o/ /'di lta ste/'dzin pa dang / 'don pa dang / mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / bri rinab dang / 'drir 55)'jug pa dang / nyan pa dang / bzlas pa'i las su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /rig sngags 'chang de la yang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung 4ba dang / bskyab 5pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /dngos grub kyang stsal 6bar bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ dge sbyong ngam/bram ze'am/ rgyal 7rigs sam/ bud med dam/ skyes pa'am/ khye'u'am/bu mo gang yin pa de 8yang cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po 'di'i ming thos pa tsam gyis kyang / de la bdag cag thams cad mthun tsho7par rtag tu rjes su 'brang bar bgyi / bsrung 1 ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang / stobs dang /brtson 'grus dang / mdangs dang / dga' ba bsgrub /lhapar bgyi/ sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi/ nad thams cad bsal hu bar bgyi / 'jigs pa dang / thab 1 mo dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi/ yams dang / nye bar 'tshe ba dang /nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / mu ge dang / mi ngas dang / 'brog dgon pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad so sor phyir bzlog par bgyi/ bde ba la yang dag par reg pa dang / mchog tu dga' ba bsgrub mupar bgyi/ bsrung skabar bgyi / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ don med pa yang so sor bzlog par bgyi/93—114

don la yang yang dag par sbyar bar bgyi/ don thams cad rjes su stsal 0)bar bgyi / rtag tu mchog stsal (gebar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shin tu rgyas pa'i cho ga cho ga zhib mo'i yo byad du dgongs pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje sngon du 'gro bas rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / rigs (7pa'i rgyal po'i lha de rnams dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye ④rnams la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so legs so drang srong chen po de lta bu byed pa de rnams yongs su bskyang bar bya/ bsrung bar bya/ dngos grub kyang sbyin par bya'o/ /ngas cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dang / gsang sngags dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mo 'di yongs su srung 95)ba'i ched dang / sems can de rnams thams cad yongs su srung (6)ba'i ched dang / sems can thams cad sung (rnyaba'i ched dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i ched du grogs po rnams la rjes su gtad do / /'di yang bsrung bar bya'o zhes so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor gyi rim par phye ba'i cho ga smros shig /don yod pa'i nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs kyi gsang ba dang / rig sngags 'chang thams cad kyi snying po'i gsang ba mchog gi dngos grub 'di thams cad du thun mong ba'i snying po grub pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis don yod pa lcags kyu'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po'i rig pa'i rgyal po don yod pa nor bu mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya dang /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / ras ris rnams gsungs pa/ de nas 'di'i 93—115

dkyil 'khor bshad par bya'o/ /don yod pa mchod pa'i nor bu'i snying po bla na med pa ni dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas te/ kun nas shin tu rnam par phye ba sa dang ba byung gis legs par byugs shing shin tu 'jam pa la/ tshon sna tshogs pas bkra ba'i srad bus char gzhal cing bcad la dkyil 'khor bla na med pa'i dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por bdag gi khru'i chatshad kyis kun nas khru bzhi pa sgo bzhi rnam par phye ba bya'o/ /thams cad du gsang ba thun mong ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por yang pad+ma bya ste/ pad+ma stong phrag gis po shin tu mdzes pa lnga lnga'o/ /pad+ma dkar po bla na med pa la ze 'bru dang / ge sar gyi tshad la bab pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i ge sar dang / ze 'bru bkra ba'i dra ba'i snying po lus dang lag tu 'chang zhing lag pa'i phyag rgya g.yon pa dang g.yas pas bya'o/ /dar dpyangs dang 'khyil pas spa ba/ zur zur du dpag bsam gyi shing shin tu tshad la bab pa cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du byed du gzhug go / /snying po'i 'khor gyi re khā ①yang cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du shin tu tshad dang ldan par bya'o/ /me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pa bya zhing de nas me tog gi bar du re khā ④bya'o/ /rgyan sna tshogs kyis phyinam par brgyan pa/ gos sna tshogs pas (6)mdzes pa'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyi phyi rol tu pad+ma dang / ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba'i ri mo'o/ /ut+pa la sngon po'i phyi rol tu nor bu rin po che sna tshogs pas rnam par bkra ba'i ri mo 'bar ba'i phreng bas mdzes pa'o/ /me tog sna ma dang / tsam pa ma'i phreng ba dag la sngags kyi nor bu'i ri mo yang bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi khor yug tu snam bu'i rnam pa bya'o/ /ri bo la sna tshogs pa'i ljon shing dang lcug ma bkram pa dang me tog sna tshogs kyis nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /khor yug 93—116

tu chu 'bab pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di bri 6)zhing phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu'ang bri bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor bla na med pa phyag rgya sna tshogs dang /me tog sna tshogs dang / bum pa dang mchod pa'i rin po che'i snod sna tshogs pa dang / gang ba'i bum pa sna tshogs pa bri'o/ /mtshan ma dang / phyag rgya dang /rin po che sna tshogs pa'i yal ga dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pa la 'chang ba 95gos dang rgyan sna tshogs pa thogs pa bya'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu me tog sna tshogs pa ku mu da dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / man dā ra ba dang / a ti muk+ta ka dang / lāk+ṣi dud ka dang / tsam pa ka dang / ut+pa la sngon po dang / sna ma dang / skya snar (4nodang / yu thi 5ka dang / ka dam pa'i me tog gi phreng bas mdzes par bya'o/ /sgo bzhi'i gnas su rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan par bya ste/ rin po che'i lcug ma sna tshogs pa dang / bum pa gang ba thogs par bya'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi snying por ba dan gyis brgyan par bya'o/ /gang ba'i bum pa yongs su bsags pa dang / me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pa dang /sna tshogs pa'i gzugs dang bza' ba'i kha zas ro bro ba'i mchog gzhag par bya/sna tshogs pa'i bdug pas bdugs 6la/ bdug pa'i pog 7phor yongs su bsham par bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya legs par khrus byas shing dri bzang po'i dris bsgos te/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bdug pas bdugs 58)la/ 'byung 9lngas nye reg bya ste don yod pa nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas par bya'o/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa yid la bya/ rmo / mthedzad pa'i sprin chen po yid la bya zhing bzla ste phyogs bcu kun nas 93—117

sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi nang du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi zhing re re'i dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rdul phra rab rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis ji ltar dkyil 'khor du yongs su bsags shing rnam pa sna tshogs su gzhal du med pas 0ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su bsags pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa re re yang dkyil 'khor chen po gzhal du med pa brgya stong phrag yongs su bsags pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin chen po byed do/ /sna tshogs pa'i gos dang / sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang / lhab lhub dang / lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs pa nanodang / lha rdzas kyi dri sna tshogs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi bdug spos sna tshogs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi 'bras bu dang / me tog sna tshogs pa dang / ro brgya pa'i kha zas kyi mchog ro bro ba'i mchog rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / sgron ma'i shing sna tshogs pa brgya stong phrag rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa'i sprin chen po byed do/ /yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i lha rdzas kyi rol mo'i sgra rnams kyi namachod pa'i sprin byed do/ /de lta bu'i cho ga rnams phyogs bcu rnams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing re re'i de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i mchod pa'i sprin chen pos dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rdul phra rab kyi grangs rnams mchod par 'gyur te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad du lhun grub tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor chen po gzhal du med pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par byed do/ /gang yang dkyil 'khor chen po der rjes su zhugs pa'i sems can dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u 4rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang /93—118

bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo gang yin pa de rnams thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de la mthong bar 'dod pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / lhan cig 'gro ba'am/ tha na thos pa tsam gang yin pa de thams cad phyir mi ldog 91)par 'gyur zhing pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa chen po yongs su gtong ba yongs su btang (2)bar 'gyur ro( dī/ /bsod nams kyi phung po dang dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /sems can re re'i yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i 945klung gi bye ma phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang mnyam pa de'i drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bsod nams kyi phung po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyi (5)mod la6/ rjes su yi rang ba tsam gyi mod la 'phral nyid du mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad las yongs su grol bar yang 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi bla ma gcig pur 'gyur ro/ /'chi 'pho zhing skye ba brjes pa'i 75dus su son te 'chi ba'i mthar thug pa nanon/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mngon sum du ston zhing snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lam nye bar ston par byed cing dbugs 'byin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs pa rnams su skal ba mnyam pa nyid kyi skye bar byed de9ri/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 1 par pad+ma las 11 brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa tsam gyi mod la/ skye ba thams cad rjes su dran 12par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags rim par phye ba dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / don yod zhags pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rdzogs par kha ton du gnas par byed do/ /93—119

ji srid sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la mthar thug gi bar du thams cad rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bcings te gnas par byed do zhes so/ /'di ni skye ba'i tha mar 'gyur te/mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i ri dgas 1dang bya de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ mir gyur pa rnams kyi 52)lta ci smos so / /de ltar yon tan dang phan yon chen po'i mchod pa chen po dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o/ /don yod pa nor bu'i mchod pa'i snying po'i gzungs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang phan yon gyi cho ga'i sgrub thabs so// //de nas rig pa'i rgyal po'i ras ris bshad par bya ste/ sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa sdig pa thams cad sel ba 'phral du nad thams cad zlog par byed pa dngos grub thams cad byed pa'i gnas mchog thams cad sbyin pa bshad par bya'o/ /ras sam gos gzhan nam/ rgya dar la kun nas khru bzhi pa la gtsang mas gtsang ma'i gnas su ri mo mkhan gtsang ma nyid kyis khrus byas gos gtsang ma bgos 4te/ dri sna tshogs pas bdugs la/ tshon sna tshogs pa rnam par bkra zhing lhag ma ma yin pa snod gsar par bzhag pas ras ris bla na med pa bri bar bya'o/ /dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa bya ste/ gzhal yas khang gi khang pa brtsegs par seng ge'i khri la pad+ma'i rdzing bur klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la me tog 'thor bar byed bzhin pa'o/ /g.yon du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bya ste/don yod zhags pa gaskyil krung phyed 6pas bzhugs pa ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa tshangs pa'i cha byad 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/93—120

'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mdung rtse gsum 'dzin pa (1pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / zhags pa 'dzin pa dang / nor bu rin po che 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das la nye bar 'dud par byed bzhin pa'o/ /g.yas su rig pa'i rgyal po bya ste/ phyag bzhi pa 'phags ma sgrol ma'i cha byad 'chang ba 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dang zhags 2pa dang / ral gri 'chang zhing nor bu rin po che chen po'i rgyal mtshan thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la nye bar 'dud par byed pa skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs da dbang phyug gi rgyab tu lha mo sgrol ma bya ste/ thal mo sbyar ba smad pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i rgyab tu gos dkar mo bya ste/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam lapar brgyan pa rab tu bzhad cing smin ma dpral bar g.yo zhing / bcom ldan 'das la zur mig gis lta 5bar byed pa bya'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i rgyab tu 'phags pa dpal mdzes pa bya ste/rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la lta 6bar byed bzhin pa sna tshogs pa'i me tog gi phur ma 'chang bar byed pa'o/ /thams cad la pad+ma'i gdan bya ste/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa bya'o/ /gos dkar mo'i 7rgyab tu khro bo chen po lcags kyu bya'o/ /dkar po'i gzhogs su don yod pa'i lcags kyu bya'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i 'og tu ral pa gcig ma bya ste/ phyag brgyad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa gyen du brjes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis 8rnam par brgyan pa/ mtshon 9cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa ste/ ral gri dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa dang / ral gri dang / mdung rtse gsum 93—121

dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma 'chang ba bya zhing sdigs 1mdzub byed pa bya'o/ /steng du phyogs la rinaskyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa bcom ldan 'das la lta 54)bar byed bzhin pa'o/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'i steng du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun bya ste/'od dpag med kyang dbus su bya'o/ /lhas mchod pa byed bzhin pa bya'o/ /phyag g.yon dang g.yas su rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das la zas gsar pa 'dren par byed bzhin pa'o/ /gzhogs g.yas dang g.yon du khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'chang ba bya'o/ /'og gi gzhogs g.yas su rgyal po chen po bzhi bya'o/ /gzhogs g.yon du/ gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan po dang /gzhon nu rnams rang rang gi mtshon cha 'dzin pa bya ste/ thams cad glu len bzhin pa bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'og phyogs kyi rdzing bu'i g.yas logs su rig sngags 'chang pus mo btsugs pa bya ste/ bdug pa'i pog phor 5dang / me tog 'dzin cing bgrang phreng thogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das la lta 6bar byed bzhin pa bya'o/ /ras ris kyi kho ra khor yug tu ri bo bri bar bya ste/ sna tshogs me tog gi mgo lcogs 7bkram zhing / rin po che'i shing ljon nasna tshogs pas brgyan 9pa/chu bo 'bab cing rjes su spyod pa/ ri dgas 1 dang / byas yang dag par brgyan pa 11bya'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i ri'i lha dang / shang shang te 'us kun tu khyab pa/rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i klu'i gdengs ka dang mtshungs pa gnas su gnas pa bya'o/ /de nas yongs su sbyang ba byas te 1 zin pa dang / ras ris la tshon sna tshogs pas bkra bar bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas gos gtsang ma bgo bar bya'o / /legs par khrus bya ste/ skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ smra ba bcad la/don yod zhags pa'i snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i 93—122

gzungs lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas so(1)/ /de'i tshe ras ris 'bar bar 'gyur ro / /'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'byin par byed de/ phyogs bcu kun tu snang bar byed do/ /rig sngags 'chang dga' zhing 'dod par 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang gis bdag gi don yod zhags pa'i snying po dang / don yod zhags pa'i lcags kyu dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i snying po 'di'i dngos grub tu shes par bya'o / /de nas las thams cad nabyed du gzhug cing / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ rgyal po'am/ blon po'am/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam/khyim bdag gam/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ bud med dam/skyes pa'am/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo gang ras ris chen po 'di mthong nas /mthong ba tsam gyi mod la mtshams med pa lnga'i sdig pa rnam par sbyangs shing thun tshags su 'gyur ro/ /mnar med pa'i sdig pa dang cisgrib pa rnams 'phral du yongs su grol lo/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor 5'dod pa thams cad dang yid kyi shing rta dang / 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad dang / rigs thun mong 6pa la 'jug pa'i thams cad thun mong ba'i dam tshig dang / de kho na nyid dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 7byin gyis rlob pa dang / thams cad du dngos grub byed pa'i gnas/ rdo rje'i gdan gyi dkyil 'khor mchog byang chub kyi snying po nye bar bgrod 85par byed pa de kho na nyid kyi chos kyi 'khor lo skor 9bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor phyir mi ldog par 'jug par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs 93—123

pa thams cad kyi (1)gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gnas thams cad du son pa'i dngos grub/ cho ga zhib mo'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug par byed pa/phyag rgya thams cad 'gugs par byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rab tu 'jug par byed pa bshad par bya'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gis 2gnas yongs su brtags te/ sa'i cha mdzes par/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ dgon pa'am/ gnas gnyis samadzo ra/ ri phug gam/ tshang tshing ngam / rgyal po'i gnas sam/ lam gyi bzhi 95mdo 'am/ gzhan yang brang sa'am / dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba'am/ skyed 96)mos tshal lam/ nags 'dab nyid dang / kun dga' ra ba'am/ chu klung ngam/ lteng 97rika'am/'bab chu'i dngo 'aman/ mtsho bran 9rinam/ mtshe'u 1 )dag dang / rdzing bu rnam par bkra ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshon nam/ ne'u gsing 11sngon po'am/me tog skyes pa'i 12gnas sam/ thams cad du rjes su mthun par brtag par bya'o / /gnas gtsang mar ma nyams pa'i mod la/ dkyil 'khor der dgod par bya ste/ sa dang / ba byung dang / yang dag par ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya'o/ /khor yug tu khru bzhi pa/ legs par byugs shing shin tu 'jam pa / bai ḍūr+ya'i kha dog tu bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor la tshon sna tshogs pa mdzes pas phye ba'i thig gdab ste15/ cha mnyam par phye nas zur bzhi pa logs bzhi pa/sgo bzhi rnam par phye ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog gi thig gdab bo/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying por yang / dkyil 'khor khru'i tshad la re khā kyi snalnga byas pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs mdzes pas thig gdab bo/ /pad+ma'i ri mo dang / mdung rtse gsum pa 15dang / rdo rje'i ri mo gsum pa dag go/ /ut+pa la bzhi pa'am/ nor 93—124

bu rin po che chen po ni lnga par bshad do/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor (1 yug tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba byed du gzhug go/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas so(ge / /pad+ma dkar po zhes bya ba 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa ri/ ge sar dang /ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i pad+ma bya ste/ de la rig pa'i lha mo gzugs ji ltar mdzes pa dgod par bya'o/ /ji ltar ras ris 'di la/ gzugs pad+ma dkar po zhes bya ba de lta bu bris nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mdzes pa dang / zhi ba dang / khro gnyer can ma / drag po sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ji lta ba bzhin du'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ gos sna tshogs pa 'chang ba skyes pa lo bcu drug pa'i gzugs dang / bu mo ri55lo bcu drug pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa bsres pa rtag tu bris nas/ pad+ma'i gdan gyis brgyan 76cing / thams cad pad+ma 'chang ba byed du gzhug go/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhi ru 7)rgyal po chen po bzhi byed du gzhug ste na / go cha dang ya lad bgos 9)pa/ drag po'i gzugs 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba bya ste/ khor yug tu mtshan ma'i phyag rgya thams cad la pad+ma'i gdan 'chang ba'o/ /sgo bzhi'i gnas rnams su dkyil 'khor gyi lha bya'o/ /gang gā 1 dang / shī tra 11dang / 'jigs ma dang /dpe med ma dang / nor bu bzang po dang / ki lī 12kyi la nyanadang / gtsigs zhal ma ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams bri bar bya'o/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nyu khor yug tu ri bo'i phreng ba dag la me tog dang / ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i lcug 32mas khyab cing / tshon sna tshogs pas rnam par mdzes 17pa bri bar bya'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba legs par mthar phyin pa dang / de nas dkyil 93—125

'khor gyi rgyan la kho ra khor yug tu tshon sna lngas mdzes pa'i ba dan brgya dang /sna tshogs pa'i gzugs mdzes pa dang / rnam par bkra ba'i bum pa gang ba dang /gtor ma dang / dril bu mdzes pa dang / gang ba'i bum pa dang / bum bu dang / dri sna tshogs kyi chus yongs su gang ba dang / ro sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma bzhag nas/ kham por dang / ril ba gang ba dang / dri sna tshogs kyis (17byug pa dang / bdug pa sna tshogs pas mdzes pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba gcal du bkram pa dang / 'bras yos dang / yungs kur nyid dang / sna tshogs pa'i 'bras bu rnams dang / bza' ba'i rnam pa gzugs 9 sna tshogs pa bzhag nas/'bras bu sna tshogs mdzes pa rnams bzhag ste/ khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang / gser dang / dngul las byung ba'i snod dris gang ba rnams bzhag dgo //thams cad ji ltar 'byor pa bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gzhal du med pa las dman pa nyid du mi bya'i lhag pa nyid byed du gzhug 4go/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las rnams ji lta ba bzhin du gus pa dang / stobs dang brtson 'grus kyis bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang gis gtsang bar gyur nas/ legs par khrus byas te gos gtsang ma bgos nas/ srung ba'i cho gas phyogs bcing ba dang / dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / mtshams bcing ba dang / sung ba chen po yang byed du gzhug go/ /de nas gsang sngags nakyi las dang / phyag rgya'i las bla na med par bya'o/ /de nas sems can gzhug par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gang 'dod par bcug nas thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / phyag rgya sbyin du gzhug 6)go/ /phyag bya ba (7dang /bskor ba la thams cad bcug nas/ snyan gsan dbab pa dang spyan drang bar bya/las kyi cho gas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ me tog dang bdug pa dbul bar bya/93—126

bzlas pa'i las rnams dang / las thams cad mdor bsdus pa byas nas/gshegs su gsol ba 'dir bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor na gnas pa'i lha rnams la gtor ma'i las kyi cho ga dang / de bzhin du me tog dang bdug pa phul ba nas dkyil 'khor na gnas pa rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ /gang gi tshe/ gsang sngags rnams dang / cho ga zhib mo chen po'i gzungs rab tu 'jug pa na sa'i mthil du ras ris 'bar ba'i mod la 'od zer 'byin par byed de/ dkyil 'khor mthong zhing gsang 1sngags 'chang yang bar snang la gnas so/ /de'i skad cig la ting nge 'dzin thob sten/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i mod la/ cho ga zhib mo'i dngos grub bla na med pa dang / dngos grub thams cad rtag tu myur du 'byung la rig 3pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra thos par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i dngos grub bla na med pa dang don yod zhags pa'i dngos grub brjod do/ /ji ltar yid la byed pa thams cad myur du 'dzin no / /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thob ste riga'adi la the tsom 6med do/ /sems can dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa gang yin pa de rnams thams cad phyir mi ldog pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par yang 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying por 'dug nas chos kyi 'khor lo skor 7bar byed do/ /sems can gang dkyil 'khor de mthong nas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang / mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa rnams dang / mnar med par gzhol ba de thams cad rnam par nyams par byed cing bde blag tu sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro'o// //de nas don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i cho ga zhib mo chen po dang / khro bo lcags 93—127

kyu dang / rig pa'i rgyal po dang / don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru1ci/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs thun mong pa'i phyag rgya dge ba'i las thams cad byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad skrag par byed pa / gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad 'bros par byed pa/ bgegs thams cad rnam par skrag par byed pa/ 'dod pa'i rig narnams sreg par byed pa / gdug pa'i klu rnams 'khrug par byed pa/ sa'i mthil g.yo bar byed pa/lha'i me tog dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa dang / lha'i gos dang lhab lhub kyi char 'bebs par byed pa/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yang dag par skul bar byed pa/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la snyan gsan 'bebs par byed pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas na gnas pa'i lha thams cad spyan 'dren nga/ra byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbugs 'byin par byed pa/ rig pa'i rgyal po dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad 'gugs nga/ra byed pa/ bde ba thams cad dang phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob par byed pa/ bla na med pa byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar byed pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor cabar byed pa/ chos kyi sgron ma 'bar bar byed pa / chos kyi dung 'bud par byed pa/ phyag rgya dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgreng bar byed pa/ cho ga zhib mo dang / gsang sngags bla na med pa thams cad grub pa / 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ phyag rgya dang / mchog thams cad sbyin par byed pa/ gsang sngags thams cad 'chang ba/ gzungs rnams kyi 5khyad par grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug par byed pa/ gang gis rnam par snang mdzad 93—128

dang / thub pa brgyad pa'i dam tshig gi (1ciganas thams cad la gnas pa/ sdig pa thams cad nyams par byed pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par byed pa / kun nas nyon mongs pa rnams sreg par byed pa/ rtag tu 'khor ba las 'don par byed pa/ bdud dang ma rungs pa rnams las sgrol ba po/ rtag tu chos kyi zam stegs mchog /rga ba dang / skye ba tshonasadang / 'chi ba las grol bar byed pa5gu/ srid pa mi bzad pa ston par nus pa/ tshul khrims dang /gtong ba dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang /ting nge (de'adzin rnams kyi dri zhim po sbyin zhing srung bar byed pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ sbyin pa'i rin po che'i phung po chen po rtag tu sbyin pa/ rin po che'i phung po rtag tu sbyin par/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha thams cad la mchod pa 65byed pa/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya byin gyis rlob pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad ston par byed pa/ gzugs sna tshogs dang / rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mthong bar byed pa/ rdzu 'phrul yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/chos kyi dbyings kyi phyag rgya rab tu ston par byed pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po 'di la gnas par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa / ma rungs pa thams cad dang / gdon dang nad thams cad rtag tu rnam par 'jig par byed pa/ phyir rgol ba dang / dgra dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad zlog 7par byed pa/ sgrub par byed pa'o/ /'jigs pa rnams thams cad dang / 'jigs pa mi bzad pa brgyad po rnams kyis 'jigs 9(3—129

pa med pa'o/ /dug dang / byad stems dang / phye ma'i sbyor ba thams cad nyams par byed par the tsom tsho)med pa zhes bya ba bshad par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis bzlog (minas/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bo'i sor mo dang / sdigs (gemadzub gnyis carabaskums la sor mo gsum brkyang 5)la snying ga'i (6)gnas su gzhag (7par bya ste / 'di ni don yod pa'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang mnyam par mchog sbyin pa ste/ phyag rgya brgya stong phrag bye ba gnyis tsam du bcings par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya dang / pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang / rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya gang yin pa dang / nor bu'i rigs kyi phyag rgya gang yin pas te/ phyag rgya so so so so ba 'di rnams thams cad phyag rgya bye ba brgya stong phrag rnams su 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu byed do/ /phyag rgya 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mchog sbyin pa po 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon po don yod pa'i snying po'o/ /shin tu gsang ba'i las thams cad du don yod pa'o/ /dus gsum pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa dang / rigs thun mong 8)pa'i gsang ba dang / dam tshig thams cad du mthong ba'o/ /phyag rgya 'di'i da ltar ba'i 'dod pa thams cad dang / yid kyi shing rta yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'o / /mchog thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ba'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid kyis/gung mo'i sor mos mthe bong gi sor mo bskums 9la/ sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par bya/ ming med dang / mthe chung dag gcig tu brkyang la/ sen mos sen mo mnyam par bzhag nas/ snying ga'i 1 tshoganas su 1lhabazhag ste/ khro bo'i lta 12ba dang mtshungs par bzhag pas hūṃ yig gis btsir 1 bar bya'o/ /'di ni khro 93—130

bo'i zhi)lcags kyu'i phyag rgya khro bo thams cad kyi mchog dang gtso bor brjod par bya ste / rigs bye ba (mistong phrag rnams kyi thun mong ba'i phyag rgya thams cad rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'dzin pa tsam gyis khro bo'i phyag rgya dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su brjod pa dang / de bzhin du pad+ma'i rigs gang yin pa dang / rdo rje'i rigs su brjod pa gang yin pa dang / khro bo'i rdo rje drag pos 'jigs par byed do/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'di ni thams cad du khro bo'i rgyal por brjod par bya ste/ nor bu'i rigs gang yin pa'i khro bo rnams kyi phyag rgya rnams gdug pa rnams 'jigs pa sbyin pa'o/ /thams cad du phyag rgya'i gtso bo zhes bya ba/ khro bo'i rgyal po bla na med pa'o/ /de bzhin du khro bo'i (5)lcags kyu'i phyag rgya 'di 'ching bzhin pa/ ri rab lhun po brgya stong phrag dang / rgya mtsho yang skems 4)par byed do/ /ri rab lhun po'i ri ni rdul phra rab ji lta bar rnam par 'thor bar byed do/ /rgya mtsho thams cad kyang skems 5par byed do/ /ri dang ri bo yang nyams par byed do/ /lha ma yin ma rungs pa rnams dang /lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan dang / de'i gnas kyi klu ma rungs pa rnams sreg par byed do/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / /'byung po dang /gdon ma rungs pa dang / /bgegs 'byed pa'i lha ma rungs pa gang yin pa dang /bdud kyi rigs rnams gcig tu 'bar bar 'gyur la/ phyag rgya 'dzin pa tsam gyis de rgya skurnams thams cad rtag tu nyams par byed cing / skad cig de la 'jig 985par byed do/ /phyag rgya 'dzin pa tsam gyis phyir rgol ba dang / dgra dang / de bzhin du ma rungs pa'i sems can 'jigs par byed pa de rnams thams cad skyabs su 'gro bar byed do/ /phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang /93—131

dkyil 'khor thams cad du/ bya ba thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /thams cad 'grub pa don yod cing dge ba thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las sdigs 1)mdzub gnyis rdo rje'i rnam par bskums la/ gung mo yud (2)tsam bskums te/ ming med dang / mthe bong gis sor mo'i sen mos (gesen mo mnyam du gzhag 5ste/ mthe'u chung brkyang nas snying ga'i (6)gnas su bzhag pa 'di ni rig pa'i phyag rgya chen po don yod pa'i phyag rgya rmad du byung ba chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du rigs thun mong ba'i phyag rgya rig pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyi bla na med pa 'jig rten gyi khams mgon pos snyan par brjod cing lung bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo zhes brjod pa/ de bzhin du pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo dang /rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo zhes brjod pa dang / de bzhin du nor bu'i rigs kyi 47gtso bo dang / rig 8)pa'i rgyal po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang /dkyil 'khor thams cad du gtso bo ste/ gang gis phyag rgya 'di 'ching ba de(9)/gaṅgā'i 7klung gi bye ma bye ba brgya stong phrag gi phyag rgya rnams ji lta ba bzhin du bcings par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang / nyon mongs pa mi bzad pa dang /gdug pa thams cad rnam par nyams par byed do/ /bsod nams kyi phung po brgya stong phrag bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kun nas bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'dzin pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rnam par gzigs par byed cing dgongs par byed de the tsom 11med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad du mchog sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyis rtag par rgyun du srung 1 bar byed do/ /phyag rgya 'di'i phan yon sngar brjod pas 93—132

gzhal du med cing grangs med la tshad med par rab tu bsgrags shing the com nyamed do/ /phyag rgya 'di mthong ba dang / bcings pa tsam gyis bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu bskyed do/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du gcig brkyangs la/dpung pa bskums (2te/ ming med dang / mthe bong gi sor mo 'dud la mthe chung bskum ②par bya'o/ /ming med kyi mthar reg la/ gung mo bskums 74skul sdigs (gemadzub rab tu brkyangs te/ snying ga'i (6ciganas su 'di g.yo ba tsam mo/ /me tog gam/ dri dang / bdug pa dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang /gos sam/ rgyan dang / spud pa rnams kyang lag pa g.yon du bzung nas dbul 7bar bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / lha rnams dang / de bzhin du rig pa'i rgyal po rnams dang / de bzhin du dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams kyi de rnams thams cad mchod par 'gyur rol/ /lha rdzas kyi (8stemachod pa bla na med pa dang / mchog dang / rab mchog dang / gya rnam pa'i mchod pa 'di rnams byed de/ ro sna tshogs pa'i bza' ba rnams dang / ro brgya pa'i 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa 9dang / btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa bdud rtsi bcud kyis tsho len gyi mchod pa 'di rnams byed do/ /phyogs bcu rnams su 11kun nas rin po che sna bdun gyi char 'byung ngo / /gser dang dngul gyi me tog bla na med pa dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par bkra ba nyi ma dang gzi brjid mtshungs pas 12'bar bar byed do/ /phyag rgya 'dzin pa tsam gyis don yod pa mchod pa'i nor bu'i 1/zhes bya ba 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu ste/ rtag tu phyag rgya'i gsang ba dang / gsang sngags rnams yid kyis bsams sapas de rnams thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag bsam 93—133

gyi shing dang mnyam shing tsho 1)mtshungs par ji ltar yid la bsams (5)pa bzhin du mchod pa thams cad byed de/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma bye ba brgya stong phrag stong rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing (5)re re'i dus gsum pa'i (4)de bzhin gshegs pa rnams phyag rgya 'di'i mthus bla na med pa'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par byed do/ /de'i phyir phyag rgya 'di rtag tu byed pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya bzung 55cibazhin pa niyi/ mchod pa bla na med pa dang / tshegs chung ngus mchod pa chung ngu yang tshad med par rab tu 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtshungs pa med pa byed do/ /ri rab lhun po bye ba brgya stong phrag rnams dang /rin po che sna bdun gyi phung pos/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bkang ste / de bzhin gshegs pa re re la phul ba de bzhin du/ phyag rgya 'dzin bzhin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re la de lta bu'i mchod pa'i cho ga byed do/ /de lta bu'i phyag rgya'i cho ga'i rnam par 'phrul pa ni/ 'dren pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /phyag rgya 'di nyid las sdigs ri rimadzub gung mo la reg pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / mtshams bcing ba dang / spyan drang ba dang / dam tshig la 'jug pa dang / skor (9 ba byed pa dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / de bzhin du dri dang / mar me dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gtor ma 'bul bar byed pa dang /de bzhin du khrus dang / nye reg nyid dang / gos bgo ba dang / gtsug tor bcing ba dang / srung ba dang / gzhan srung ba dang / de bzhin nyid du grogs srung ba dang / bzlas bzhin pa dang mnyam pa nyid dang / skyil mo krung 93—134

bcing ba dang / sbyin sreg gi las dang / gzhan spyan drang ba nyid dang /gsang sngags spyan drang ba nyid dang / dngos grub sgrub pa nyid dang / thams cad nas thams cad du bya ba thams cad phyag rgya 'dis byed de/ gnas thams cad du song ba dang / gnas grub pa dang / bya ba thams cad legs par bsngags pa dang / thams cad du mchog gi phyag rgya don yod pa'i las rab tu grub pa dang / yon tan thams cad 4)bskyed pa dang / thams cad du rigs thun mong ba'i 2dkyil 'khor du/ don yod pa sgrub pa po'i phyag rgya don yod pa'i cho ga zhib mo sgrub par byed pa'o/ /don yod pa'i las zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya 'di / don yod pa'i mchog sbyin pa zhes bya ba brjod par bya'o/ /phyag rgya chen po lnga po 'di rnams rmad du byung ba'i de kho na nyid mthong ba dang / don yod pa thos pa nyid dang / don yod pa'i 'bras bu mthong ba dang / don yod pa'i bsod nams bsags pa'i de kho na nyid dang / don yod par sdig dpa nyams pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad zad pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag rgya dang / don yod par sangs rgyas rnams mthong ba dang / don yod par sangs rgyas kyi zhing mthong ba dang / don yod par tshe 'phel bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / don yod par dngos grub kyi mchog sbyin par byed pa mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /snying po dang / phyag rgya 'di 'jig rten dbang phyug gis sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don du bsgrags pa'o/ /rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis khyad par du/ nyin mtshan du dang / thun mtshams su yang / phyag rgya 'di 'ching na/ bkra shis pa'i mchog /bsod nams dang /dag pa dang / sdig pa nyams pa dang / don yod pa'i dngos grub dam par 93—135

gyur pa'i mchog sbyin par byed do/ /'di ni thar pa mchog gi gnas mya ngan las 'das pa mchog tu dge ba'o/ /phyag rgya'i gsang sngags rnams su 'gyur te/ oṃ a mo s+t+waṃ ku sha dzā 91)lo hūṃ/ oṃ a mo gha gro dha desne hūṃ/ oṃ (5)bibyā rā dza pad+me dz+wa yaṃ hūṃ/oṃ a mo gha bi bi dha /a mo gha tsin+ta ma ṇi pra bsto (4༄ya hūṃ/ o a mo gha sarba tra sā dha ya shi be hūṃ/ phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i sngags so/ /de nas dge ba'i las thams cad byed pa'i gsang sngags thams cad du sgrub pa'i thabs kyi de kho na nyid kyi gnas thams cad la 'jug par byed pa bshad par bya ste/ oṃ a mo gha maṇ+ḍa le hūṃ/dkyil 'khor bcing ba'o/ /oṃ sa man+ta shu bhi pri thi bī sa hā hūṃ/ sa yongs su sbyong ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha pa ri sho dha ni hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyong ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha pri thi bī sa rastu le hūṃ/ sa dang ba byung gi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha dza laḥ5)sha ba ṇi hūṃ/ chu'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha a mṛ ta ba re swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha bi bhak+ta bha ba na ba re hūṃ/ thig rnam par dbye ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ nā nā rat+na ba re dz+wa la hūṃ/ tshon rtsi'i ri mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ dz+wa la bi ma le a mo gha shudhe hūṃ/ khrus kyi sngags so/ /oṃ sid+dhi dza 6le a mo gha bud+dhi hūṃ/ nye reg gi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha bste sgro tsho nod hūṃ / gos bgo 8ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha ma ṇi hūṃ/ gtsug tor bcing ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha rak+ṣa ṇa ba ra da hūṃ/ bdag srung ba'i sngags so/ /o satwa rak+ṣa ṇi a mo gha desne 9rgyu/ thams cad du gzhan sasrung /lhazhing bde ba'i ched du srung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha pra bi sha bhu ba ne hūṃ/ gnas su 'jug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ na mo a mo gha ba ti hūṃ/ phyag byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha tsakre hūṃ/ bskor ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sa ma ya sidhe 12a mo gha ba ti hūṃ/ dam 903—136

tshig gi sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha dukhye pra ba tsa garnyi ni dza ya swā hā/ me tog dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / bdug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha sa ra saṃ pū ra ṇi ra sa ra sā 1gra pa ti hūṃ/ thams cad du gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha tu ṭi swā hā/ mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mo gha ba ti tsa ra bi tsa ra sañtsa ra swā hā/ thams cad du gnas pa dang / gnas thams cad du song ba na rig pa'i rgyal pos bya'o/ /thams cad du las thams cad byed pa rig pa'i gsang sngags sbyar bar bya'o/ /gshegs su gsol ba nyid kyang sngags 'dis bya'o//las shin tu rgyas pa gzhan thams cad ni rig pa'i rgyal pos bya'o/ /legs par byas pa'i las dang / bya ba rnams dang / bya ba thams cad sgrub par byed pa gzhan rnams ni/ don yod pa'i lcags kyu dang / khro bo lcags kyu dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i gsang sngags chen po dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i gsang sngags 'di rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang gi las rnams bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa 'di nyid kyis las thams cad bya'i/ de las phyi rol du gyur pa'i rig pa gzhan ni med do/ /rig pa 'di ni bklags pas grub pa'o/ /de nas de la yangs shing rgya che ba'i brtson pa bya ste/ 'byor pa ji lta ba dang / tshad ji lta ba dang / ji ltar gsal ba rnams/ 'byor pa dang bcas shing yongs su rdzogs pa dang / shin tu gsal bar bya ba rnams bya'o/ /gtsang ma gtsang mas khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgo dbar bya/ dad pa dang / gus pa dang /mchog tu dang ba bskyed par bya/ bden par smra bar bya/ bden par phyi rol du 'byung bar bya/ bden par spro ba dang / brtson pas 'byung bar bya/ lkog tu smra ba dang / phra ma dang / ser sna med par 'gyur bar bya/ lag yangs 943—137

par bya/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi lam dang / bklags pas grub pa'i rig pa 'di sgrub par byed par 'gyur bar bya/ sems can thams cad la brtse ba mchog tu bya/ bri bar bya/ 'drir (1gzhug par bya/ bklag par bya/ kha ton du bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ kun chub par bya/ cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po 'di gsungs pa dang / don yod zhags pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor yang dag par rmad du byung ba 'di/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 2phyag byas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi dam tshig thun mong gi gsang ba dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba thams cad kyi gsang ba/phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags thams cad kyi gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo 'di/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsungs so/ /de nas yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi gang yin pa rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang bcas pa ga la ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du gyur pa ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar song ste/ zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te thal mo sbyar bar gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis gzung bar bgyi'o/ /don yod pa'i lcags kyu/ cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po yang /lhag pa'i rgyal po cho ga zhib mo 'di yongs su srung 4ba'i don dang / mi nub cing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po ji ltar 5rnyed pa de bzhin bris pa 93—138

'di yongs su rdzogs so// //'di ni sngon gyi lots+tsha (1rab mkhas pa bzhi tsam gyis bgos nas bsgyur ba la/bar skabs bar skabs su chad cing mjug ma tshang ba las/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo ba chen po chos grags dpal bzang po'i phyag nas rgya dpe byung zhing / chad pa sob ri pa dang / mjug bsgyur chicig ces bkas bskul ba la brten nas/ bam po bcu pa'i nang du/ las kyi don kun sgrub par byed ces pa nas/ gsang sngags bzlas pa mchog gyis shig ces pa'i bar dang / bam po bcu gnyis pa'i nang du/ bcom ldan 'das 'on kyang don khyad par can gyi ched du zhes pa nas/rig sngags 'chang gi lus 'bar bar 'gyur te/ zhes pa'i bar dang / bam po bcu gsum pa'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di thos pa tsam dang zhes pa nas / mi gang tshad du brko 4bar bya zhes pa'i bar dang / bam po bcu bzhi pa'i 5nang du/ pad+ma dang / chu dang / yungs kur la yongs su bzlas te zhes pa nas/ ras dkar pos bkru bar bya zhing / lan bdun du zhes pa'i bar dang / bam po 6bco lnga pa'i mtshams su/ dngul gyi pog por brgyad dang zhes pa nas/ gnas rnam pa gzhan thams cad du ji ltar yid la byed pa'i bya ba thams cad du byed do/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / bam po bcu drug pa dang /bcu bdun pa'i mtshams su/ de nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga bshad par bya ste zhes pa nas / phyag rgya'i cho ga dang / sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'o zhes pa'i bar dang /bam po bcu bdun pa zhes pa dang / de ma thag par bam po bco brgyad pa'i mtshams su/ de nas rtag tu bzlas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten mgon po'i 'od zer gyi sbyin sreg rab tu grol lo zhes/ 93—139

༄dzo /rgya gar skad du/ da sha bhū 92mi dhā rā ṇi/ bod skad du/ sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang sngags la 'jug pa rnams kyis dgos pa thams cad so sor sgrub per —'gyur ba ni/ o zhes bya ba don yod zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du gsang sngags yi ge gcig po 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar 'bum dran par byas na sa dang po la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sngon sdig pa bsags pa'i sems can dmyal ba mi bzad pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad ji ltar rlung gis phyag dar gtor ba bzhin 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ don thams cad rjes su 'jug par 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / gang dkyil 'khor gyi lha gzhan yang dgyes par 'gyur la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 93—158

rtag tu mchog sbyin par mdzad do/ /gsang sngags oṃ zhes bya ba dran nas tshe 'phos pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags yi ge gcig pa'o/ /oṃ bhuḥyi ge gnyis pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na sa gnyis pa'i yon tan thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar 'dug par 'gyur zhing / mchog thams cad rjes su sbyin par mdzad do/ /sdig pa thams cad kyang rnam par dag par mdzad/ sngon gyi las ngan gyi nad kyang sos par 'gyur/ nor gyi dbang phyug nor bu bzang po'i bu dbang du 'gyur zhing nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /mi gang gis kyang phyir zhing bar chad byed nus par mi 'gyur/ tshe 'phos nas kyang ri gru 'dzin tu skye bar 'gyur / don yod zhags pa'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /yi ge gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ pad+me/ gsang sngags yi ge gsum pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas nas gsum pa la yang dag par 'jug par 'gyur/ pad+ma yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags gang yin pa thams cad la zhugs par 'gyur/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzhin nu'i cha byad can mdun na bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog rjes su sbyin par mdzad do / /don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor ston par mdzad/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams ston par mdzad / thams cad du dngos grub rjes su sbyin par mdzad do/ /yi ge gsum pa'o / /o pad+ma hrīḥgasang sngags yi ge bzhi pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na sa bzhi pa la 'jug par 'gyur/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog gser gyi kha dog can mdun na bzhugs shing dpung pa brkyang nas phyag spyi 93—159

bor 'jog par mdzad la/ rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bya ba rjes su sbyin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang tshur shog khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad yongs su dag ste/ rang gi ngo bo thams cad shin tu dri ma med par yongs su dag go/ /mi'i 'jig rten 'di nas tshe 'phos nas nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'ong zhing tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /phyir zhing nams kyang mngal na gnas pas gos par mi 'gyur/ 'jig rten pa'i dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sa bzhi pa'o/ /oṃ pad+ma bhu dze gsang sngags yi ge lnga pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na sa lnga pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma'i bla ma rab tu ston par mdzad do/ /sgrib pa thams cad yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang la legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra sbyin nga/ra 'gyur te/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so/ /khyod la bsod nams kyi phung po chen po skyes te/ rig sngags 'chang khyod dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po bskyed pas rig sngags 'chang khyod tshe 'phos nas de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi drung du dge ba'i rtsa ba mtshungs par bskyed par 'gyur zhing / nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur / khyod kyis don yod zhags pa'i pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyi snying po dang /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya chen po'i rim 1par bye ba 'grub cing rig sngags 'chang khyod sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad spangs kyis bya ba thams cad gyis shig /yid la bya ba'i sgrub pa thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du de dag thams cad shin tu grub par 'gyur ro/ /sa lnga pa'o/ /oṃ pad+ma lo ki te/gzungs sngags yi ge drug pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas nas drug pa 'thob ste 93—160

'jug par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang bar mdzad par 'gyur / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams gzigs shing mngon sum du ston par mdzad/ dbugs 'byin par mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma gzigs pa'i rgyal mtshan des rig sngags 'chang de la yang dag par dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang khyod nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du byang chub kyi snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du tshur shog /las byas pa shin tu yongs su zad cing / khyod kyis sems can dmyal ba'i sgo rnams bcad/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi sgo rnams ni phye/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sa bon dang rigs spyi ni khong du chud/ khyod kyis don yod pa'i zhags pa'i pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyi snying po dang / gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni grub/khyod kyis thams cad du gnas kyi sgo rnams ni phye bas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las sgrub pa rnams ji ltar yid la byas pa bzhin las thams cad byos shig /oṃ pad+ma dz+wa la hūm̐ jika1 /yi ge bdun pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin pad+ma dri ma med pa sgrib pa dang bral ba dag pa zhes bya ba thob par 'gyur la/ ting nge 'dzin gang thob pas lus shin tu 'bar bar 'gyur zhing / 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs su 'gyur/ sa bdun pa la gnas par 'gyur/ lus kyi snang ba gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi gnas rnams snang bar byed cing /gang dang gang du 'od zer chen po cher 'bar ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag bab pa 93—161

las me tog gi char sna tshogs pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba gser gyi kha dog can dpung pa brkyang ste/ phyag g.yas pa rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 'jog cing legs so zhes bya ba byin nas dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang legs so legs so 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po gsang ba brjod kyi cho ga mchod pa'i mchog yin no/ /'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po gsang ba gces pa'i dkyil 'khor don yod pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po yang dag pa'o/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rdzogs pa dang / pad+ma gtsug tor gyi snying po'i cho ga zhib mo dang / don yod zhags pa'i snying por sprul pa grub kyis/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du song la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gyis shig /oṃ a mo gha ma ṇi pad+me/ gzugs 1kyi snying po yi ge brgyad pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na lus shin tu yongs su dag cing dri ma med par 'gyur/ bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis nor bu rin po che me shel ltar phyi nang shin tu yongs su dag pa ste/ de ltar rig sngags 'chang lus yongs su dag par 'gyur sa brgyad pa la gnas par 'gyur / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang gi lus yongs su dag pa rang gi gzugs kyi ngo bor ston cing / rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du gnas pa la rig sngags 'chang yang dag par dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ phyag g.yas pa mgo'i spyi bor 'jog pa mdzad / legs so zhes bya ba yang sbyin par mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang 93—162

legs so legs so/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod lhag pa'i bsam pa dga' ba la zhugs so/ /rig sngags 'chang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mnyam par 'brel ba'i 'jig rten rnam par lta bar tshur shog /der khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis don yod zhags pa pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyi snying po dkyil 'khor gsang ba grub kyis/ 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa dam pa bya ba thams cad gyis shig /oṃ pad+mo lo tsa ne hu ru hūm̐/gzungs sngags yi ge dgu pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas nas dgu pa la gnas par 'gyur / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sras kyi gtso bor 'gyur/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dgu bcu dag rig sngags 'chang la mngon sum du ston cing / sangs rgyas kyi yul rnam par sprul pa sna tshogs ston par byed de/ rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor thams cad kyi phyag 'jog par mdzad de/ legs so zhes bya ba yang sbyin pa mdzad de/ rig sngags 'chang chen po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis ngal zhing sbyangs pa'i las legs par sgrub par byas so/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa sangs rgyas nyid du sgrub pa grub ste/ don yon zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhib mor sgrub pa dang / mdo sde dang /lung dang bcas pa sgrub pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 'dren pas bstan pa gang yin pa de dag grub pa yin/ oṃ pad+mo 1: ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsang sngags yi ge bcu pa 'bum bzlas brjod byas na phyir mi ldog par gyur nas sa bcu la gnas par 'gyur zhing / lha dang / mi'i skye dgu dag 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod la/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi 93—163
