ldog par 'gyur/ don yod zhags pa pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyi 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur te/ the tshom mi bya'o/ /gsang sngags yi ge bcu pa'i sgrub pa de kho na nyid kyi dngos grub bla na med pa 'di ni don yod zhags pa'i snying po rnam par sprul pa bzlas brjod tsam gyis 'grub pa yin te/ bdag gis sngar bstan pa thams cad lhag par zhen pa gtsang ma/ gtsang sbra spyod pa/ gos gtsang ma bgos pa/ byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje skyes pa0)/ bden par smra ba/ bla ma la gus pa/dkon mchog gsum la dad pa che ba/ bla ma dang slob dpon la rtag tu mchod pa byed pa 'di ni bzlas brjod kyi cho ga yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bla na med par bstan to/ /sa bcu pa'i gzungs phan yon dang rtog pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/158 (1༄mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ (0〈〈zhol 〉〉byu/ ①〈〈zhol 〉〉sprul 16༷ ༵༵/zhol 〉〉rin/161 (1〈〈khu 〉〉sgrika162 1〈〈khu 〉〉gzungs/163 4༄〈〈zhol 〉〉pad+mo/164 (1)〈〈zhol 〉〉par/93—164
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (335) 93wa 165

rgyal po'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1ri༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha kulpa rā dza bi rnyi nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhes bya ba / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das deng bdag cag gis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag bgyis shing bsngags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga zhib mo zhes bgyi ba 'di nyid skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang /rjes su brtse bar bgyi ba'i slad du brjod par bgyi yis gson cig /oṃ pad+ma hasta ma hā a mo gha pā sha sa hā yaṃ sa ma ya ṣ+ṭṛ da lto tsa ra tsa ra hūm̐/ don yod pa'i 93—166

zhags pa'i (1rang bzhin gyi spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po zhes bgyi ste/ las thams cad kyang bgyi ba'o/ /oṃ di bya saṃ pū ra rna ge bi lo ki k+ṣa ṇi hūm̐/ 'khar gsil gyi rig pa ste/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na sgra grag pas sems can rnams ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ pan+t+ra pū ra ya a mo gha ba to sa man+ta pra bho swā hā/ lhung bzed kyi rig pa ste/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'gyur zhing gang gis zos pa rnams ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro / /phyag rgya thal mo lhan cig tu dam du sbyar ba las slar pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis nas mdzub mo nor bu lta bur bgyis te/ gung mo yid tsam bkug pa ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya ste/ lag pa spyi bor bkan nas bzhag pa spyi bor dbang bskur ba'i rig pa 'di lan bdun brjod do/ /oṃ kyai dh+wa ges nu dag ta/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba tre+e ya dhī (4)ke pad+ma ma ṇi su pad+me a mo ghi sarba ta thā ga tā ya a dhiṣ+ṭha te hūm̐/ rig pa 'dis dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rig sngags 'chang la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po chen por yang 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad kyang rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi gtso bo gcig pu'i gnas su yang 'gyur bar the tshom ma mchis so/ /oṃ parlosnri 5niṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las gsang sngags kyi snying po yi ge bcu pa 'di snying rje dang ldan par bgyis te bzlas brjod bgyis na byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba nas sa bcu la gnas pa'i bar du 'gyur 93—167

zhing / lha dang / mi'i skye dgu dag gis 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes brjod par 'gyur la/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur te/ don yod pa'i zhags pa'i pad+ma'i gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur te 'di la the tshom ma mchis so bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags kyi snying po yi ge bcu pa 'di ni yon tan chen po tshad ma mchis pa rnams dang ldan par rig par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu gzungs sngags kyi snying po 'di dag ni yi ge 'bru re re tsam bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur na/ rigs kyi bu gang gis ched du gnyer te/ ches ngal zhing dub par bzlas brjod dang / sgrub pa dang / cho gas tshul bzhin du rgyas par sgrub pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/don yod pa'i zhags pa'i pad+ma'i gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i snying po khro bo'i gzungs sngags rim par phye ba gsang sngags chen po yi ge bcu pa 'di lan cig tsho1)tsam dran nam/ bklags sam/ ming tsam yang bzung ngam/ dus tshigs 'ga' rer dran pa tsam gyis kyang sems can de'i mtshams med pa'i las byas pas mnar med pa'i dmyal bar gzhol ba tshe bskal par gnas par 'gyur ba yang las thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad kyang rang rab tu zad par 'gyur/ lus yongs su dag cing dri ma med par 'gyur / sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur/ tshe 'phos nas kyang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur/ nam yang ngan 93—168

'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ bskal pa bye ba 'bum phrag brgyad cur 'khor los sgyur ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su 'gro bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis rab tu dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba don yod pa'i zhags pa'i pad+ma'i gtsug tor gyi snying po dri ma med pa gsang ba 'di rig sngags 'chang ba'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la las lan cig tsam yang dran pas yid la byed cing / yongs su dag pa'i bdag nyid snying rje chen po dang / byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pas sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba'i blo dang / dmigs pa dang ldan pas sems can gang yang rung ba'i rna khung du brjod na sems can de dag ngan song du skye bar mi 'gyur te de ni gnas med do/ /sems can de dag thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lan gnyis brjod na nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan gsum brjod na rims dang / 'brum bu dang / 'bras dang / lhog pa dang / me dbal dang /g.yan pa dang / rkang shu dang / mdze nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro//lan bzhi brjod na/ dug dang / dbyig dug dang / byad dang / gshed byed thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan lnga brjod na 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / shags su gyur pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan drug brjod na 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gdon thams 93—169

cad dang / rims thams cad dang / pha rol gyi gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun brjod na dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyi 'tshe ba dang / yams thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje de lta bas na sems can thams cad kyi don du nyin re bzhin du tshig gzhan mi smra bar snying po 'di lan bdun bdun bzlas par bya'o / /lag na rdo rje gang la la dag 'di ltar sdig pa mi dge ba bcu rab tu spyod pa / mtshams med pa byed pa/ dam pa'i chos la skur pa 'debs pa/'phags pa'i gang zag la rab tu brnyas pas de dag sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba'i tshe'i dus byas par gyur pa dang / dge slong gang la la dag rang gi bslab pa'i sdom pa dral ba/ tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ral cing zhigs pa dang /mkhan po dang / slob dpon la ma gus shing 'khu ba dang / dam pa'i chos la rma 'byin pas tshe'i dus byas par gyur nas sems can dmyal bar gzhol bar gyur pa de dag gi don du bye ma gtsang ma la lan grangs bdun bdun bzlas nas/dur khrod du bor ba'i ro dang / ro bsregs pa'i rus pa'am/ dur mchad du bcug pa'i ro'am/ rus pa la bye ma des gtor bar bya'o/ /gang dang gang na sems can rnams kyi rus pa gang dag yod pa de dang de dag tu bye ma des gtor ma thag tu/ de dang der bye mas phog pa'i sems can de dag rnams sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas 1dang / dud 'gro dang / sha za'i skye gnas dang /gnod sbyin gyi skye gnas su skyes par gyur na yang de dag de'i mod la tshe brjes nas thams cad mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha dang mi'i gnas su rab tu gzhol bar 'gyur zhing / phyin chad nam yang sems can thams cad dmyal ba dang / yi 93—170

dgas /nyadang / dud 'gro'i 'gro ba rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags yi ge bcu pa 'di nyid gro ga dang / ras sam shog bu la bris te mchod rten gyi nang du bcug na/ gnas der srog chags rkang gnyis pa dang / rkang bzhi pa dang / rkang mangs pa dang / rkang med pa gang dag nye bar 'ongs pa de dag thams cad mchod rten de'i grib ma phog pa tsam gyis de dag gi sdig pa dang /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag cing mtho ris su gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /ri dgas rinadang / bya dang / wa dang / khyi dang / ne'u le dang / grog sbur dang / sbrul dang / rus sbal dang / lag 'gro la sogs pa srog chags phra mo gang dag gis mchod rten de'i grib ma la 'grims pa thams cad kyang grib ma phog pa tsam gyis de dag rnams kyi sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur zhing de dag thams cad kyang mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /bud dung la sogs pa la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas gnas mthon po'i rtse mo nas dung de bus na/ sems can gang dag gis dung de'i sgra thos pa'i skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo'am/ lha'am/ yi dgas /risam/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa de dag thams cad bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du gzhol bar 'gyur zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang phrad nas chos thos te rim gyis mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag sbyin pa la dga' ba dang / gang dag bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas pa dang / gang dag skyabs gsum nye bar gzung ba dang / gang dag tshul khrims yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa dang / gang dag byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas yang dag par bsdams pa de dag gis sgra de thos na/ de dag 93—171

thams cad byang chub las phyir mi ldog cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe de brjes ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan dkar po la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba'am/dkor sa'am/ skye bo'i dbus sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang du bdug par byas na/gang dag de'i dri la bsnams pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par byang bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su rdzogs pa rab tu 'thob pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /chos gos la rab tu bdugs nas lus la gyon na gang zag de'i sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad ma lus par rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /lus la bab pa tsam gyis bag chags kyi dri ma dang / ser sna dang nyon mongs pa'i skyon thams cad spangs par 'gyur ro/ /gos la bdugs te bcangs pa tsam gyis 'jig rten thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro / /bdag gi gos la rab tu bdugs te rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na rgyal po dang / btsun mor bcas pa rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /kun gyi mchod gnas chen por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten thams cad kyi bla mar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su zhugs na dge 'dun thams cad kyi mchod gnas chen por 'gyur ro/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i nang du zhugs na nor dang /longs spyod chen po 'phel bar 'gyur zhing mchod gnas chen po'i 'os su yang 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan gyi bdug pa'i cho ga'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa'i rtog pa las pad+ma'i gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i snying po'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas khro bo'i rgyal po che'i/ /rtog pa rab tu bshad bya ste/ /don yod 93—172

rgyal po rmad byung tshe/ /kun tu dngos grub thogs med cing / /dkyil 'khor kun tu dbang bskur bas/ /sdang ba thams cad rab tu 'joms/ /bdud dang bshegs dpung rnam par 'jig /gnod sbyin srin po gsang ba pa/ /'byung po thams cad rab tu 'bros/ /bsam pa thams cad rab rdzogs byed/ /oṃ skṛ ku ṭi rdas a mo gha sa ma ye/ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ sarba bed a mo gha e 91ga a bhi ṣe ka hūm̐/mi li mi li swā hā/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i snying po'o/ /de nas sku gzugs kyi cho ga ni dngul la khro bo'i rgyal po sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad tsam shin tu mdzes shing tshad dang ldan pa/ gdong gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs tshon can/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ zla ba tshes pa mgo la thogs pa/ gdong gsum gyi dang po khro ba/ g.yas cung zad 'dzum pa/ g.yon gad mo dgod pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po na pad+ma/ 'og ma na ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon dang po na zhags pa/ 'og ma mdung rtse gsum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rgyal po'i rol stangs kyis 'dug pa/ gcan gzan khro bo'i pags pas smad dkris pa'o/ /g.yas phyogs su ni lha mo sgrol ma ut+pa la thogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa'o/ /g.yon phyogs su ni lha mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo nor bu rin po che thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi drung du rig sngags 'chang pus mo btsugs pa lag na spos phor thogs shing bgrang phreng 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das la gyen du blta ba'o/ /yang na ni ri mor bri bar bya ste cho ga bzhin no/ /gzugs brnyan de dag gi drung du ba'i lci bas byug pa byas la/ tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bya zhing gur gum gyis mchod yon bya ste/ me tog la sogs 93—173

pas yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor de'i steng du khro bo'i rgyal po bzhugs su gsol te/ de'i drung du bzlas brjod stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /de nas gzugs brnyan de 'gul zhing g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /rkang pas phan tshun du 'chag par 'gyur/ gzugs las 'od zer 'byung bar 'gyur/ tshig 'byin par 'gyur/ legs so zhes sgra 'byin par 'gyur/ lag pa g.yas pa rig sngags 'chang gi spyi bor 'jog par 'gyur/ yid la bsams so cog thams cad dang / mchog thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzlas brjod rdzogs pa'i mod la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khro bo'i rgyal po rang gi mdun na bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa tsam gyi mod la dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad kyang byed par 'gyur ro/ /bklags pas las thams cad dang / dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / grub pa thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i zhags pa nas bzung ste/ bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas na sngon chad bsags pa'i bsod nams dang / las kyi bgo skal thams cad mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /tshe'i mthar thug gi bar du dpal chen po thob pa dang / che ba nyams su myang (1bar 'gyur ro/ /gdong du bltas te bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas na dbang phyug chen po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma nas bzung ste bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas na nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /ral gri nas bzung ste/ bzlas pa stong rtsa brgyad byas na nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /rtse gsum nas bzung ste/ stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na/ 'jig rten gsum gyi dbang 93—174

phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rked pa nas bzung ste bzlas pa stong rtsa brgyad byas na sngon gyi tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dbang du 'gyur te/ bdag nyid ji srid 'tsho'i bar du nor rnams nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /cod pan la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i dbu la bcings na nges par dbang bskur ba thob par 'gyur te/ 'di la the tshom dang yid gnyis bskyed par mi bya'o/ /bzlas brjod dang / sgrub pa 'di dag gis ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khro bo'i rgyal po'i gzugs kyis rig sngags 'chang gi mdun du byon te/ ci dgos pa thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga las phyung ba rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī warma dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //93—175

bsdur mchan/ 166 0)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/167 6)〈〈zhol 〉〉 zhags pa'i/ ②〈〈zhol 〉〉ṅgā/ ⑧〈〈khu 〉〉tu/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉:/ ⑧〈〈zhol 〉〉pad+mo:/168 6)〈〈zhol 〉〉gcig17༷ 1༄〈〈tu/95 〉〉dwags/171 (1)na ri〈〈'o/la 〉〉dwags/173 91)〈〈zhol 〉〉a/ (ge〈〈khu 〉〉tsugs/ 9)〈〈zhol 〉〉por/174 (1)〈〈khu 〉〉myong /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (336)93wa 176

༄ga /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang / mig stong dang /ldan pa'i cho ga zhib mo/1༄༅sha /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang / mig stong dang 2/ ldan pa'i cho ga zhib mo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ ri gru 'dzin na byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas na/ rin po che bkod pa'i 'khor gyi khyams na bzhugs shing / bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ khri de ni rin po che'i mchog sna tshogs du mas spras pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyal mtshan rnams kyis yongs su brtsegs pa lha'i ba dan dpyangs ripa ste/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs nas 'di snyam dgongs te/ ngas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dzin pa'i gzungs bshad gor ma chag snyam du dgongs so/ /byang 903—177

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po du ma dang / thabs cig 1tu bzhugs pa la na'adi lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi sde dang /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma'i spyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la sogs pa/byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis daspyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi sras sha stag dang thabs cig cago/ /'od sung chen po la sogs zigang dag gis nyan thos dag gi sa bcu spyad par gyur pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dpag tu med pa/grangs med pa/ tshangs pa dung la sogs pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu du ma dang /lha'i bu sa 'tsho la sogs pa lha'i bu du ma dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi 'phags skyes po la sogs pa du ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa du ma dang / klu'i rgyal po nus pa'i dra ba la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po du ma dang / lha'i bu mo gzhon nu'i mig la sogs pa/903—178

'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha du ma dang / dgon pa'i lha du ma 1)yang thabs cig tshadago//'bab chu dang / mtsho dang na / mtsho bran dang / khron pa dang / chu klung dang / chu klung chen po dang / sman dang / rtswa (dedang / shing gel pa dang /nags tshal dang / nags khrod dang / gtsug lag khang dang / khyim dang /chu dang / me dang / rdul gyi ri dang / sa dang / rgyal po'i khab dang /mchod rten dang / dri gtsang khang la sogs pa na gnas pa'i lha thams cad kyang der 'dus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor chen po de'i nang na 'dug pas/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis ma tshor bar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams khyab par snang bar byas shing / stong gsum gyi stong 5 po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang gser gyi kha dog lta bur byas so/ /lha dang klu thams cad dang / lha mchog thams cad kyi khang pa dag kyang khrol zhes g.yos so/ /chu klung dang / chu klung chen po dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang / ri khor yug dang / ri bo ri rab dang / rdul gyi ri dang / ri nag po thams cad kyang shin tu g.yos so/ /zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / rin po che dang / me dang / gza' dang / rgyu 6skar gyi 'od kyang mog mog por byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos ltas rmad du byung ba de mthong nas/ ltas sngon ma mthong ba la the tshom skyes te/ de stan las langs te thal mo sbyar te/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa'i ltas 'di sus bgyis zhes/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas 77zhus pa/ deng su 8byang chub yang dag mthar thug gyur/ /thams cad ldan pa'i 'od zer su yis btang / /'jig rten mgon po ci slad phyogs 903—179

bcu yi/ /zhing rnams gser mchog 'dra bar gnas par gyur(1)/ /stong gsum 'di ni ci slad tshig pa 'dra/ /deng 'dir su zhig gis ni dbang thob lags/ /sngon chad ma byung rdzu 'phrul stobs sus bstan/ /su yis 'dir ni zhing mang g.yos par bgyis/ /ci slad lha dang klu rnams khyim 'khrugs shing / /gzhal med khang mchog dag kyang rab 'gul dang / /thams cad skrag nas rnam par blta zhing mchis/ / ci yi 9nasaslad du stong gsum g.yos pa dang / /gang gis 'khor 'dir the tshom skyes gyur de'i/ /rgyu dang su yi mthu lags ma 'tshal na/ci slad rdzu 'phrul mngon shes bstan bgyis pa/ /rgyal ba byams pa'i thugs can bka' stsal gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la bka' stsal pa/ /kye rigs kyi bu khyod la sogs pa (kyi'adi ltar shes par gyis shig /da ltar 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'di na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ming 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces bya ba zhig yod de/ 'di ni bskal pa du ma nas 'gro ba'i don mthar phyin pa/byams pa dang / snying rje dang thabs la mkhas pa/ bsgoms pas sgrub pa dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la nus pa dang ldan pa ste/ sems can gyi khams thams cad la zhi ba dang / bde bar 'dod pas rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs chen po 'di phyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te / gos legs par bgos nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la thal mo sbyar te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag la snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis cagasang sngags snying ltar bzung ba mchis te/93—180

sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi 1)phan pa dang / bde ba thob par bgyi ba dang / sdig pa'i las thams cad dang / las lci ba rnams 'byang bar bgyi ba dang / bgegs dang mi khom pa rnams yongs su spang bar bgyi ba dang / dge ba'i phyogs bsod nams thams cad 'phel bar bgyi ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / 'jigs pa dang /gnod pa thams cad yongs su spang ba dang / mchog thams cad myur du yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/ bdag da de brjod par 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ thugs rjes nabadag la nges par gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye rigs kyi bu shin tu snying rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod/ sems can rnams la phan pa dang /bde ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags gang brjod par 'dod pa 'di/ da ltar legs par khyod kyis dus la bab kyis tsho myur du smros shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyang rjes su thugs rang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dran pa bskal pa du ma 'das par gyur pa na/'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od zer stong gi rgyal po dag par gnas pa zhes bgyi ba byung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba'i bla ma des bdag la byams pas dran par bgyi ba dang / sems can thams cad la phan par bgyi ba'i slad du/ thugs rje chen pos snying lta bu 'di yongs su rdzogs pa dang / mi zlogs 5pa dang / rgyas par bshad de/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i phyag bdag gi 93—181

mgo la bzhag na1/ 'di skad ces kye rigs kyi bu khyod kyis ma 'ongs pa'i sdig pa can gyi dus kyi sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba chen po bya ba'i phyir/ snying lta bu'i gsang sngags 'di zung tsho shig /ces bka' stsal to/ /bdag ni de'i tshe thog ma nyid du sa dang po la gnas par gyur to/ /'di ltar bdag gis gsang sngags 'di lan cig ri thos pas de nyid na gnas bzhin du sa brgyad pa nges par rtogs par gyur to/ /bdag gis de'i tshe snying la bab pa dang /dga' ba dang / yid bde ba thob nas/ de nyid du bdag gis smon lam 'di skad btab ste/ 'di ltar bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba dang / zhi bar bgyid nus par 'gyur zhe na/da nges par bdag gi 4lus la lag pa stong dang / mig stong yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig ces bgyis pa dang / smon lam de skad btab ma thag tu de nyid na mchis bzhin du/ lag 5stong dang / mig stong yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /phyogs bcu dag tu sa chen po yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis 'od zer stong stong bdag gi steng du bkye ri nas / phyogs bcu'i 7'jig rten gyi khams mtha' 2yas pa snang bar gyur to/ /de slan 9chad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das du ma'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su yang dang yang du rnyed cing thos te/ de dag gi spyan sngar gzungs sngags 'di bzung ngo / /yang dga' ba dang mgu ba du ma skyes par gyur to/ /bdag gis bskal pa du mar skye ba dang / 'chi ba nges par rtogs pa phra mo thob par gyur te10 / de slan 11chad rtag tu brjod cing bzung ste/ bskyud par ma gyur to/ /gzungs sngags 'di gzung ba'i don du bdag gang dang gang du skyes par rtag tu 93—182

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyan sngar pad+ma las rdzus 1te skyes nas/ma'i mngal du skye ba gzung nabar ma gyur to/ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am ri/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo gang la la zhig brjod cing 'dzin par 'tshal ba des/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i bsam pa dang / snying rje'i bsam pa'i sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /thog mar bdag brjod pa'i 'og tu smon lam chen po 'di skad gdab par bgyi ste/ btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par shes rab chen po'i ming thob par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par sems can yongs su skyob par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par myur du thabs la mkhas pa thob par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par shes rab kyi grur zhugs par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par myur du sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las rgal bar gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje chen po cacan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag tshul khrims kyi rkang pa dang ldan zhing lam myur du thob par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje chen po can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par myur du mya ngan las 'das pa'i ri la 'dzeg par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje chen po can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nges par myur du 'dus ma byas kyi khyim du 'jug par gyur cig /btsun 93—183

pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag myur du chos kyi sku dang gcig tu gyur cig /gang gi tshe bdag ral gri'i ri de la 'gro ba na ral gri'i ri de bsnyil zhing zhig par gyur cig /gang gi tshe bdag me ma mur gyi nang du 'gro ba na/ me ma mur de rang med par gyur cig /gang gi tshe bdag sems can dmyal ba'i lam du 'gro ba na/ sems can dmyal ba rnams rang bzhin gyis stongs 1par gyur cig /gang gi tshe bdag gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba na/ yi dgas 5rnams rang tshim par gyur cig /gang gi tshe bdag lha ma yin gyi gnas su 'gro ba na/ de dag gi sems rang dul bar gyur cig /gang gi tshe bdag dud 'gro rnams su 'gro ba na/ de dag ye shes chen po'i de kho na rang thob par gyur cig ces de ltar smon lam de skad btab nas/dad pa ldan zhing sems kyis dran par )bgyis cal/ bdag gi ming brjod par bgyi'o / /de nas yang bdag 5slob dpon 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med rtag tu dran par bgyi'o/ /de nas gsang sngags 'di brjod par rigs so/ /nub gcig la 'di lan lnga brjod na/ bdag nyid kyi skye ba dang /'chi ba bsags pa'i las lci ba stong phrag brgya dang / bye ba stong phrag bcu bsags pa rnams spong bar 'gyur/ byang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha dang mi thams cad snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzungs sngags 6gzhi 'di ji 7lta ba bzhin du brjod cing 'dzin na/ gal te de dag 'gum pa'i dus kyi tshe/ phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams de'i steng du phyag rkyong 8zhing 'di skad ces khyod gang du skye bar 'dod/ gang dang gang du smon lam btab pa der song shig 9ces gsung 93—184

ngo / /yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'am mi ma lags pa gang zhig snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gsang sngags 'di brjod cing 'dzin la/ de gal te ngan song gsum du lhung bar gyur na / bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /gang zhig gis gsang sngags 'di brjod cing bzung la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba ma thob na bdag sangs rgyas su ma gyur cig /yang su zhig gis gsang sngags 'di brjod cing bzung la/ des ting nge 'dzin dang / so so yang dag par rig pa du ma ma thob na/ bdag sangs rgyas su ma gyur cig /yang su zhig gis gsang sngags 'di brjod cing bzung la/ tshe gcig gis yid la bsams 1pa thams cad yongs su ma rdzogs nas/ 'di snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po zhes bgyi ba'i ming thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /su sdig pa bgyid pa dang /ma dad pa ni ma gtogs so/ /bud med su zhig bud med kyi chos la yid byung nas / bdag skyes par gyur cig ces 'tshal te/ snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzungs sngags dgazhi 'di brjod cing bzung la de bud med kyi lus las ma gyur cing / skyes pa'i lus ma thob na/ bdag byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /gal te 'dzin par bgyid pas/ de la the tshom cung zad tsam zhig bgyis na/ gdon mi 'tshal bar yid cal bsams 5pa bzhin du mi 'grub bo/ /gang gis dge 'dun gyi bza' ba dang / thug pa dang /nor dang / 'bru phrogs sam / chud gsan 7te/ gang la sangs rgyas stong gi 8bshags su gnang bas bshags su lags kyang bshags par ma gyur la/ gal te 93—185

gsang sngags 'di brjod kyang 1/ sdig pa thams cad 'byang bar ma gyur na/de'i slad du dge 'dun gyi rdzas ci spyad pa dang / chud gsan pa dang / phrogs 2pa dang / phyogs bcu dag na/ rab tu byung ba thams cad kyi so so'i mdun du mchis la bshags na/ de'i tshe de'i bshags par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ltar gsang sngags 'di brjod par gyur na/ phyogs bcu dag tu gtogs pa'i rab tu byung ba'i 'dus pa rnams de la dbang yin no zhes smra zhing las thams cad kyang bshags par chud par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa bcu po thams cad dang /mtshams med pa lnga dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams la mi snyan pa brjod pa dang / dam pa'i chos spang 4rib dang / dus ma lags par zas 'tshal ba dang /bslab pa nyams pa dang / mchod rten dang / dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang / dge 'dun gyi rdzas chud 5gzon pa dang / tshul khrims yongs su dag par gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi tshul khrims nyams par bgyid pa dang / de la sogs pa'i sdig pa'i las shin tu lci ba thams cad dang / sdig pa thams cad ma lus par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang the tshom 'tshal ba ni ma gtogs te/de'i sdig pa chung ngu dang / las yang ba yang 'byang bar mi 'gyur na/ shin tu lci ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ sdig pa'i 6las shin tu lci ba rnams byang bar ma gyur du lags kyang / yun ring mo 7zhig na/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bgyid nus par 'gyur ro/ /yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gal te mi'am/ mi ma lags pa zhig gis snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po 'di brjod par gyur na/ de skye ba bzang po rnam pa bco lnga thob par 'gyur ro/ /gshes ngan du 'gum pa rnam pa bco lnga ni myong bar mi 'gyur te/93—186

bco lnga gang zhe na/ dang po ni gang ltogs pas sdug bsngal te 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni gang chad pa ngan pas bcad pa'i tshor bas nyam 1thag pa'i gnod pa dag gis 'gum par 2mi 'gyur ba'o/ /gsum pa ni dgra dang / khon mchis pa dang / phyir bzlog 4pa rnams kyi dug dang / mtshon gyis 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni gang dmag gi g.yul 'gyed par zhugs pa'i tshe 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /lnga pa ni gang stag dang / spyang ki la sogs pa gcan gzan 5ma rungs pa rnams kyis bsad pas 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o / /drug pa ni phyogang sprul gdug pa dang / rtsangs pa dang / srog chags u tsi ling 57gas zin nas 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /bdun pa ni gang me dang /chus 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /brgyad pa ni gang dug tu 'gyur ro 'tshal bas/'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /dgu pa ni gang srog chags sna tshogs kyi 8dug gis 'gum par mi 'gyur ro/ /bcu pa ni gang rmongs pa dang / rnam par g.yengs 9pa dang / brjed pa dang / nyal bas 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni gang 1 ri dang / shing dang / g.yang sa dang / gad pa las ltung 11bas 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o12/ /bcu gnyis pa ni gang byad kyis 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o1 / /bcu gsum pa ni gang dag lha g.yon can rnams dang / 'byung po sdig pa can rnams kyis glags 1 bltas pas 'gum par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu bzhi pa ni gang gsor mi rung ba'i nad rnams kyis btab nas 'gum par mi 'gyur rol/ /bco lnga pa ni gang bdag la bdag gsod pas 'gum par mi 'gyur ba ste/ gang snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin can te/ gang snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po 'di brjod cing 'dzin pa de la/ gshis ngan du 93—187

'gum pa rnam pa bco lnga 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bzang po rnam pa bco lnga yang thob par 'gyur te/ dang po ni gang dang gang du skye ba thams cad du chos dang mthun 1pa'i rgyal po rnams dang phrad par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni gang 'phags pa'i yul du skye ba thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /gsum pa ni dus bzang po dang phrad par 'gyur ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni gang rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang phrad par 'gyur ba'o/ /lnga pa ni gang dbang po mtha' dag tshang ba'i lus 'thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /drug pa ni gang dge ba'i phyogs la sems yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'o/ /bdun pa ni gang tshul khrims nyams par mi 'gyur ba'o / /brgyad pa ni gang gnyen bshes 2rnams dang / bran g.yog rnams kyis ri nobye brag shes shing mthun 4par 'gyur ba'o/ /dgu pa ni gang yo byad dang /nor dang / zas rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rnyed par 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu pa ni gang gzhan gyis go 'phang bstod pa dang / mchod pa dang / bkur sti rnyed par 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni gang nor dang / yo byad mi 'phrogs 5par 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni gang bsams 6pa sems dang mthun 57par 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni gang lha dang klu dang / lha ma yin rnams kyis kyang rtag tu srung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /bcu bzhi pa ni gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong zhing chos kyang thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /bco lnga pa ni gang chos thos pa dang / don zab mo shes rab kyis rtogs par 'gyur ba ste/ gang la la zhig snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po 'di brjod cing 'dzin pa des gong du smos pa skye ba rnam pa bco lnga po de dag 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i slad du lha dang mi thams cad kyis rtag tu brjod cing gzung 8bar bgyi ste/ de la skyo 93—188

ba bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis tshig de skad smras nas/ de'i rjes la 'khor mang po'i dbus de nyid du 'dug ste/ lag pa gnyis mnyam par thal mo sbyar nas/sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed de/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin rgyas par byas nas/ rgyas pa chen po kun nas yongs su rdzogs pa thogs pa med pa snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po gzungs sngags chen po gzhi mdzes pa 'di smras so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo rnyi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba ban dha na ts+tsha da na ka rā 1ya/ sarba pā pa sa mu drokhyu ṣa ṇa ka rā ya/ sarba byā snyi pra sha ma na ka rā ya/ sarba i kyu pa dra ba bi 2nā sha na ka rā ya/ sarba bha ye ṣā tā ra ṇa dka rā ya / ta su na maskṛ 5tā/ i rda ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra5/ ta ba nī la kuṇ+ḍa nā 6ma pa ra ma skṛ 7da ya mā brta yi byā /mi/ sarba ar+sha sā dha rna9/ shu bha tse ta rna1 /sarba bhū tā 11rna pā pa mārga bi sho 1 dha rka1 / tar+ya thā/ ā 1 lo ke15/ lo ka ma ti/lo kā 7ti mān+ta: / e h+ye hi ma hā bo dhi satwa1 / he bo dhi satwa19/ he ma hā bo dhi satwa / he 21sri 25ya bo dhi satwa / he ma hā kā 2 ru ṇi ka /sma ra hro da yaṃ/ e h+ye hi / ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā 25ya/ pa ra ma mi tri na tsit+ta kā ru ṇi ka /ku ru ku ru garma / sā dha ya sā dha ya bi ston/ de hi de hi/ me a raṃ ga rma ga rma bi haṃ ga ma/sid dha yo gī shwa ra/ du hu du hu ma hā bīrādhe/ dha ra dha ra dhā rerje shwa ra dz+wa la dz+wa la bi ma la mūrte 8/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra/ krohā 9dzi na dza ṭā mu ku ṭa /a lo kṛ ta 1/ sha rī ra lasba pra lasba bi 82lasba/ ma hā sid dha bibyā dha ra/ ba la ba la/ ma hā ba la/ ma la ma la ma hā ma la / dz+wa la dz+wa la ma hā jardo la/93—189

ku ru rak+ṣa mūrte 1rmā swā hā/ na mo bha ga ba te/ na ma ār+ya nas ba lo ki te shwa rā ya bo /dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya sid rgyan tu me/ man+t+ra 4pa dā ni swā hā/ oṃ hrī mun+t+ra lokya bi dza ya/ a mo gha pā sha /a pra ti ha ta hrīḥpiha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snying po 'di brjod nas sa chen po ni rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul lo/ /'ur 'ur ro/ /bar snang las rin po che dang 'dres pa'i me tog gi char mngon par bab bo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad rjes su thugs rang ngo / /bdud dang gzhan mu stegs thams cad sngangs skrag ste/ spu zing zhes byed par gyur to/ /'khor de thams cad ni so sor 'bras bu thob ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig 7phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kha cig ni sa dang po thob bo/ /kha cig ni sa gnyis pa/ kha cig ni sa gsum pa/ kha cig ni sa bzhi pa/ kha cig ni sa lnga pa nas/ kha cig nas bcu pa'i bar du thob bo/ /gang dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sems can de dag kyang dpag tu med do/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po stan las langs te/ gos legs par bgos nas/ gus pa'i sems kyis thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye kye las mdzad pa 9legs so legs so/ /bdag kyang 'das pa'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa dag gi 'khor khornams su 'dus par gyur te/ bdag gis de dag tu chos kyi rnam grangs dang / gzungs kyi sgo sna tshogs dag kyang thob na/ bdag 943—191

gis snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzung 1sngags gzhi thogs pa med pa rgya chen po 'di ma thos kyisan/ da byang chub sems dpa' las mdzad pa chen po de'i lus dang / rtags dang / tshul dang / mtshan nyid nges par bshad du gsol/bdag la sogs pa 'khor chen po 'di thos par 'tshal zhing smos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ tshangs pa chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye khyod kyis thabs mkhas pasari sems can gyi khams thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir dri ba 'di byas so/ /da nyon cig dang mdor cung zad cig kho bos khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ni snying rje chen po'i sems so/ /'di ni mtshungs/ shing mnyam pa'i sems so/ /'di ni 'dus ma byas kyi sems so/ /'di ni chags shing zhen pa med pa'i sems so / /'di ni stong pa nyid du blta 4ba'i sems so/ /'di ni bsti 5stang du byas shing gus pa'i sems so/ /'di ni ma 'khrugs shing skyon med pa'i sems so /'di ni bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems te/ sems de dag la sogs pa ni snying po 'di'i mtshan nyid dang / tshul yin par de ltar zhes bya'o/ /de ltar tshul 'dis spyad par bya'o/ /bsgom par bya'o/ /tshangs pa chen pos 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag la sogs pa 'khor 'dis snying po 'di'i tshul dang / mtshan nyid de dang 6slan chad ma 'tshal to/ /da slan chad ni blang ngo / /mi bskyud par bgyi'o7 / /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig snying po 'di brjod cing 'dzin na/ des byang chub sems dpa' chen po 93—192

yangs pa bskyed pa'o/ /de ltar yi dam bcas nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi lus gzung 1bar bya'o/ /zas dus dus su bza' ba dang / tshul khrims dang ldan par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /rtag par rgyun du rgyun mi 'chad par gsang sngags 'di brjod par bya'o / /gtsang mar gnas pas gnas par bya'o/ /khrus legs par bya'o/ /gos gtsang ma bgos la lha'i ba dan dang / mar me dang / bdug pa dang /me tog dang / gtor ma la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /sems rtse gcig tu gzung na bar bya'o/ /yang dag par dam yin pa la brtag par mi bya'o zhes de skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar gzung bar bya'o/ /'on tang byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od dang / lha'i drang srong du ma yang der 'gro ste/ dbang byed cing dngos grub kyang sbyin par 'gyur ro / /kho bos 4kyang de'i tshe mig stong gis sgrub pa po de la blta'o/ /lag pa stong gis sba zhing bzung 5ngo / /'jig rten gyi mdo dang / yi ge rnams len cing 'dzin kyang nus par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan mu stegs can thams cad kyi chos dbang du bya ba dang / rig byed rnams kyang nges par rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig gsang sngags 'di brjod cing 'dzin pas ni 'jig rten na 'byung pos phyung 6ba'i nad kyi rnam pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gang su la byung yang rung sos par byed do/ /des zhi bar mi 'gyur ba'i nad gang yang med do/ /yang 'byung po'am / lha rnams la yang rgol ba'i mthu yod par 'gyur ro/ /bdud kyang pham par byed do/ /gzhan mu stegs can rnams kyi phyogs kyang lkugs par byed do/ /gal te ri la gnas pa'am/ dgon pa na gnas pa gang zhig kha ton 7pa la de na 93—193

gnas pa sdig 1pa byed pa nadang / bgegs byed pa dang / gnod pa byed pa'i lha dang / 'byung po sna tshogs gang dag sems 'khrugs dpar byed na/ snying po 'di lan cig ri ribarjod pas de dag thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /gang la la zhig tshul 'di 5bzhin du gsang sngags 'di brjod cing 'dzin na/ srog chags thams cad la snying rje bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i tshe kho bos kyang lha dang /klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la rtag tu de'i phyi bzhin 'brangs la bsrung 6ba 7bgyis te/ phrad par gyis shig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /mig gi 'bras bu dang / rang gi srog ji lta ba bzhin du srung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshigs su bcad pa dag kyang smras pa/ gang zhig dad pas snying po 'di / /kha yis rtag tu 'dzin pa yi/ /sgrub pa po la dus kun tu/ /soms 8la srung ba gyis shig ces/ /khung bu mig dang de bzhin du/ /stobs po che dang lu gu rgyud/ /lha yi dam pa lcags kyu dang / /lag na rdo rje bsgo bar bya/ /kho bo'i snying po mchog 'di ni/ /dad pas rtag tu 'dzin pa yi/ /sgrub pa sdig dang bral ba la/ /khyed cag srungs shig skyongs shig ces/ /dbang phyug che dang khyab 'jug dang / /nor gyi bu dang drag po dang / / kum bi ra 1 dang ser skya dang / /de dag rnams la kho bo bsgo/ /gang zhig rtag tu dad pa yis/ /gsang sngags 'di brjod 11'dzin byed pa'i/ /rig sngags 'chang la mi g.yel bar/ /soms shig srung ba gyis shig ces/ /lngas / rtsen dang ni bde mchog dang / /tsin da la dang su ma la/ /bing ga la dang gshin rje la/ /kho bos lung gis bsgo bar bya/ /gang zhig rtag tu dad pa yi15/ /kho bo'i gsang sngags 'di 'dzin cing / /rtag brjod 1 rig sngags 'chang ba la/ /bsam pa gyis shig srung ba gyis/ /sgrub pa 93—194

po la srungs 91)shig ces/ /bden pa po dang so brtsegs dang / /mi mjed bdag dang lha mo dpal/ /de dag kun la kho bos bsgo/ /gang zhig dad pas kho bo yi/ /gsang sngags 'di ni rtag 'dzin cing / /rjod na)byed rig sngags 'chang ba la/ /soms shig srung ba gyis shig ces/ /lha mo chen mo dbyangs can dang / /lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang / /sum cu gsum dbang ro langs dang / /mang po 'dzin la kho bos bsgo/ /kho bo'i rig sngags 'di 'chang la/ /soms shig srung ba gyis shig ces/ /gnas lnga dag na gnas pa yi/ /gtsang ma'i gnas kyi lha rnams dang / /yang dag shes cadang nor bu bzang / /de dag rnams la kho bos bsgo/ /gang zhig dad pas kho bo yi/ /gsang sngags 'di ni rtag 'dzin cing / /rjod 5byed rig sngags 'chang ba la/ /soms shig srung ba gyis shig ces / /rgyal po rnam thos bu dang ni/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / /yul 'khor srung dang skyong byed dang / /mig mi bzang dang 'phags skyes dang / /skem 0byed gzhon nur gyur pa dang / /de dag rnams la kho bos bsgo/ /gang zhig rtag tu dad pa yis/ /rtag tu gsang sngags 'di 'dzin cing / /rjod 7byed rig sngags 'chang ba la/ /soms shig srung ba gyis shig ces/ / dga' bo 8nye dga' klu gnyis dang / /stobs kyi lha dang rgya mtsho dang / /drang srong nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /de dag rnams la kho bos bsgo/ /gang zhig rtag tu dag 9pa yis//rtag tu gsang sngags 'di 'dzin cing / /rjod 1 byed rig sngags 'chang ba la/ /soms shig srung ba gyis shig ces/ /klu yi rgyal po ut+pal dang / /'phrul chen lto 'phye che rnams dang / /lha min mi ci dri za dang / /de dag rnams la kho bos bsgo / /gang zhig rtag tu dad pa yis/ /rtag tu gsang sngags 'di 'dzin cing //93—195

rjod 17byed rig sngags 'chang ba la/ /so/mas shig sung ba gyis shig ces/ /chu dang me yi lha rnams dang / /sha za rnams dang glog (gedang sprin/ /grul bum dag dang mkha' lding dang / /de dag tsho rikun la kho bos bsgo/ /bde bar byed pa'i lha g.yog 'khor lnga brgya dang ldan pa khyed thams cad dang / de bzhin du lha dang /klu'i rgyal po rnams dang / lha dang / lha'i bu mo la sogs pa dang / gnod sbyin stobs dang ldan pa rnams kyang gang snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po 'di bzlas brjod byed pa de'i phyi bzhin du 'brongs 0shig /gnod pa sol cig /srung ba gyis shig /gal te sngags pa mi zhig ri dang / nags tshal stong pa thibs po dag na/ gcig pur grogs med par nyal na yang / bde bar byed pa'i lha de dag rang gi 'khor dang bcas te srung bar byed do/ /yams kyi nad rnams dang / bgegs rnams kyang zhi bar byed do/ /gal te ri khrod du lam stor bar gyur na/ gsang sngags 'di bzlas brjod byas pa dang 5ci/ bde bar byed pa'i lha dang / klu'i rgyal po de dag mi gzugs kyis de la lam ston par byed do / /gal te ri dang / nags dang / dgon par son la chu dang me med par gyur na/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis de la srung 6ba'i phyir chu dang me ston par byed do / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang rig sngags 'chang de la yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa gzhig cing bsal ba'i phyir/ zhi bar byed pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gal te 'brog dang ri khrod rnams zhig 7tu/ /stag dang spyang ki nagacan gzan ri49khro rnams dang / /sbrul dang rtsangs 1 pa dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ / 'ong yang 11'di thos sngags mthus ldog par 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho chu klung mtsho bran 'gram gnas na/ /93—196

dug ldan sbrul dang sbrul 'dzin byed pa dang / /chu srin gnod sbyin nya dang kum bi —1)ra/ /'ongs snyena'ang gsang sngags thos na 'jigs par 'gyur/ /dmag dpung chen po'i dgra dang 'thab pa dang / /nor 'phrog chom rkun rnams dang phrad na yang / /dad pas rtse gcig sems dang byams pa yis/ /gsang sngags bzlas na sdig byed mi nus ldog /rgyal po'i khrims sacan go rar bcug pa dang / /btson ri nyerar lcags dang shing sgrog bcug na yang / /dad pas gsang sngags 'di ni brjod byas na/ /rgyal po bdag nyid de la dga' bar 'gyur/ /gal te dug can nags sam khyim gang na/ /dug can zas yod der ni son gyur la/ /dad dang ldan pas gsang sngags mchog brjod na/ /dug rnams thams cad gyur nas bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /gal te bud med bus thogs mi phyin cing / /g.yon can bgegs kyis na bar byed na yang / /dad pa drag pos gsang sngags 'di brjod na / /'byung po 'bros shing bde bar btsa' 5bar 'gyur/ /'byung po sdang dang gnod sems klu rnams kyis/ /bsad 6pa'i ched du gnod pa byas na yang / /dad pas gsang sngags 'di ni brjod byas na/ /tshe yang 'phel zhing nad rnams 'byang bar 'gyur/ /gal te 'byung pos skrangs nad byas pa dang / / bas ldags 7nad dang shu ba rnag khrag can/ /dad pas rtag tu gsang sngags 'di bzlas na/ /gsang sngags mthu yis thams cad med par 'gyur/ /sems can rab tu sdang bas bsad 8pa'i phyir/ /g.yo dang sgyu 9yi las rnams byed na yang / /dad pa drag pos gsang sngags 'di brjod na/ /de drung sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'gro mi 'gyur / /dam pa'i chos nyams sems can rnyog pa can/ /'dod chags bcings shing log 1 pas rmongs rnams dang / /nyin mtshan mi drang ma zhi rtog 93—197

ldan zhing / /khyo dang lhan cig mi dga' bud med rnams/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod byas pas 'byin nus te/ /'dod chags me (17zhi sems ni drang bar 72'gyur / /gal te snying po 'di yi mthu brjod na/ /bskal pa gcig gi (khumatha' mir 4phyin ma 95'gyur/ /tshon skud sna lnga pa la snying po 'di lan lnga bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa mgul du gdags (6)so/ /snying po 'di ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed kyis sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir gsungs pa'o/ /gang dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug sgom par byed la yongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba de dag la/myur du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir gsungs so/ /gang dag sangs rgyas nyid du sems ma bskyed pa de dag kyang / byang chub tu sems skyed 77par byed do//gang nyan thos kyi 'bras bu ma thob pa de dag kyang myur du thob par byed do/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ lha'i drang srong gang dag byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa ji snyed 'khod pa de dag kyang sems skyed 8par byed do/ /gang theg pa chen po'i chos la dbang po rnams dad pa ma 1rnyed pa de dag kyang thob par byed do/ /snying po 'di'i mthus theg pa chen po la thar pa'i sa bon gyi myu gu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te dgos pa zhig yod na yang kho bo'i snying rje dang / thabs la mkhas pas thams cad 'grub bo/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ mun pa mun nag gi sems can dmyal ba dag na/ sems can gang dag gnas pa rnams kyang / gal te snying po 'di thos na/ sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sa dang po ma thob pa de dag kyang / sa bcu nas sangs 903—198

rgyas kyi byang chub kyi bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu rnams kyang rang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa can gyi sems can gang dag gis snying po 'di lan cig 1thos na/ drang po'i sems kyi bsam pas mos shing sgom par 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'thob bo/ /gal te de ltar bzod na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phyi nang na yod pa'i ri dang / rdo dang rtsig pa dang ri rab dang /ri khor yug rnams kyang g.yo zhing rdul phra rab bzhin du phye mar 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi yang khol zhing 'thor bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te de dang de'i gam yo na sems can gang dag 'khod pa de dag thams cad ji ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe 'di la dam par gyur pa de dag gis / nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu tshul khrims dang ldan par byas la/ snying po 'di bzlas brjod byas na/ yid la bsams nanopa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma med pa'i tha ma'i mtha'i bar gyi sdig pa'i las gang yin pa de dag thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phyi nang gi sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha'i drang srong dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mi'am lha gang la la zhig gsang sngags 'di kha ton byed pa de 'bab chu'am/ rgya mtshor khrus byas na/ de na srog chags gang dag 'khod pa la des reg pa de dag gi las shin tu lci ba thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ tshe phyi ma la sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par pad+ma las brdzus 93—199

te skye bar 1'gyur/ mngal nas skye ba dang / drod gsher las skye ba dang /sgo nga las skye ba'i nasaskye ba 'dzin par mi 'gyur na/ gang 'di 'dzin pa dang /brjod pa dang / klog pa lta ci smos/ 'don 58)cing brjod pa lta yang ci smos/rlung gang gis rig sngags 'chang la reg pa'i rlung des sems can gang la la la 54noreg par gyur pa'i las lci ba thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dang yang ngan song gsum du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas 'byung bar 55༄skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang shes par bya ste/ gang 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba'i bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa ni/ bsam gyis 6rimi khyab cing dpag tu med do/ /gang la la snying po 'di brjod pa de'i kha nas tshig dge ba'am/ mi dge ba ci byung yang rung ste/ de thams cad bdud dang gzhan mu stegs can dang / srung ba'i lha dang klu dang / 'byung po rnams kyis yongs su dag pa'i chos su thos par 'gyur ro/ /su snying po 'di kha ton byed pa de la thams cad sangs rgyas su 'du shes bskyed cing gus par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab snyed dag gis sdug par dgongs shing yongs su bzung ba de ni sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi snang bas snang bar 'gyur bas/ lus 'od zer dang ldan par shes par bya'o/ /gang snying po 'dis sems can rnams yongs su skyob pa de snying rje'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang gzungs kyi sgo rnams sdud pa de chos kyi mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang la ting nge 7'dzin brgya stong mngon du snang ba de bsam gtan dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis sems can rnams la 93—200

blta ba de nam mkha'i snying po'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang la rtag tu lha dag dang lha rnams kyis kun tu bsrungs pa de mi 'jigs pa'i mdzod du shes par bya'o//gang gi kha nas gzungs kyi sgra rgyun mi 'chad pa de gtam sna tshogs kyi mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang yams kyi nad rnam gsum dang / dus ngan pas chud mi zos pa de rtag tu gnas pa'i mdzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang bdud dang gzhan mu stegs can gyis 1bar du gcod cing bzlog mi nus pa de'i mi'i sha'i mdzod ji lta ba bzhin ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /gang rtag tu snying po 'dis sems can thams cad gso bar byed pa de sman gyi rgyal po'i namadzod du shes par bya'o/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba la 'byung ba de ni mngon par shes par bya ste/de'i bsod nams kyi bsngags pa ni mtha' yas so/ /gal te rigs kyi bu mir gyur pa zhig yun ring por 4'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis skyo zhing bde ba 'dod na/des thog mar bas mtha' dben pa'i gnas btsal bar bya ste/ der 'dug par bya'o / /gtsang mar mtshams legs par 5bya'o/ /gal te chu la bzlas brjod byas sam/ yang na zas sam thug pa'am/ sman nam/ bdug 6pa la so 7sor lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te spyad na tshe ring bar na'agyur ro/ /mthu yod par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams gcod nus par 'gyur ro/ /rjes su mthun pa'i chos len pa'am/ 'dzin nus par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro / /de la mtshams bcad 9pa'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ thog mar ral gri la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la dkyil 'khor gcad 1 par bya'o/ /yang na chu gtsang ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la11/ phyogs bzhir gtor bar bya ste/ 'di ni mtshams so/ /yang na yungs kur la lan nyi shu rtsa 93—201

gcig bzlas brjod byas la phyogs bzhir gtor na mtshams bcad par 'gyur ro//yang na ji tsam 'dod pa sems kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /yang na thal ba gtsang ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ mtshams bcad do1)/ /yang na tshon skud sna lnga pa las 2bzlas brjod byas la phyogs bzhir bres na/thams cad du mtshams bcad par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'dis len cing 'dzin nus par gyur na bdag nyid 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /sus snying po 'di'i ming thos pa de'i bskal pa du ma'i skye ba dang 'chi ba bsags pa'i las lci ba rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur na/ su 'di brjod 45cing 'dzin pa lta ci smos/ gang zhig 'di brjod gcing smra bar nus pa de sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa du ma la mchod cing bsod nams dang dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /gal te cho ga 'dis sems/ can gyi khams sdug bsngal la gnas pa thams cad gdon par byed nus par gyur na/ mi de ni snying rje 6chen po dang ldan zhing ring po mi thogs par sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'thob par rig par bya'o/ /rig sngags 'chang des sems can ji snyed mthong ba dang / sems can so so la brjod pa dang / de la gang dag gis thos pa yang 7byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'chang de'i bsod nams dang dge ba'i mtha' ni brjod mi nus par dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /gal te lus bsdams shing zas dus su za bar gnas la dge zhing drang po'i sems kyis brjod par nus na/ des de'i tshe sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi ched du/ sngon gyi las rnams bshags par bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyang de bzhin du bshags par bya'o/ /gal te de ltar goms shing rgyun mi 'chad par snying po 'di brjod na/ des tshe 'di la dge sbyong gi 'bras bu 93—202

bzhi thob par 'gyur/ dbang po rno ba dang / blo dang ldan pa dang / bsam gtan la blo (1)skye bar 'gyur/ sa bcu'i 'bras bu thob pa la mi dga' bar gyur na / 'jig rten pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu chung ngu 'thob pa lta ci smos/ci dang ci 'dod pa rnams de la yongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying rje chen po dang / smon lam chen po zab cing rgya che ba'i stobs kyis so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis snying po 'di'i mthu stobs rgya chen po tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo yul gang dang gang du yams kyi nad byung la/ yul der gal te rgyal pos chos kyis yul srung zhing rgya che ba dang / gtsang mar bya na sems can rnams stams 2las mi gcod do/ /nyes par ( byung ba rnams la bzod par bya'o/ /rgyal po des lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus dang ldan par byas la/ zhag bdun snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po 'di bzlas brjod byas na/ yul der yams kyi nad ci byung ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lo tog thams cad kyang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro//sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sa ris so sor dag 4rgyun du 'ong zhing yul du gnas pa'i sems can rnams la gnod pa byed pa dang / mi yongs 55mi dga' bar gyur pa dang / der nad byung ba dang / chu dus su mi 'bab pa dang / der zla ba dang nyi ma lam drang por mi 'gro ba dang / gal te sdig pa'i las de snyed byung na/ rgyal po des spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang / mig stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas la/ gang du yams kyi nad byung ba de logs su 6bzhin 7bstan te bzhag 8go/ /shin tu dad pas 93—203

bdug pa dang / me tog dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan sna tshogs dang / zhal zas ro brgya pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po des snying po 'di brjod pa'i phyir/ nyin zhag bdun du brtson 'grus brtan por gnas par 1byas na/ sa ris so sor dgra thams cad de la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyuran / /rang rang gi yul la dga' bar 'gyur/ sems mthun (5)par 'gyur/phan tshun grogs su 'gyur/ mi yongs dang rgyal bu thams cad kyang byas pa gzo zhing / legs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 'khor rnams kyang de la dga' ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang klu rnams kyang yul srung bar byed do/ /char yang dus su 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu dang / lo tog rnams kyang mang zhing grub par 'gyur ro/ /yul na gnas pa rnams 4kyang bde ba dang / yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyim gcig tu nad dang /gnod pa sna tshogs byung ngam/ bdud dang 'byung po g.yon can gnas pas 'khrugs shing smra'am/ skur pa 'debs sam/ gnod pa dag byung ngam/ phyi nang gi mi mthun pa chen po'am/ chung ngu dag byung na de'i tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong 5dang / mig stong dang ldan pa de'i mdun du mchod pa byas la/ shin tu dad pas snying po 'di lan stong bzlas brjod byas na/ gong du smos pa'i gnod pa de dag zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das snying po 'di'i ming ci zhes bgyi/ ji ltar blang bar bgyi/ ji ltar gzung 6bar bgyi/ kun dga' bo snying po 'di'i ming ni mang du yod de/ gcig ni rgya cher dri ma med pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /snying rje chen po thogs pa med 9 2—204

pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /sdug bsngal las yongs su skyob 1pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /tshe 'phel bar byed pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /ngan 'gro'i lam rnam par 'jig napa zhes kyang bya'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa 'joms pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /sems kyi rjes su dmathun 4par dbang ba zhes kyang bya'o/ /sa gong mar myur du nges par rtogs 5par byed pa zhes kyang bya 6ste / kun dga' bo de ltar zung 7shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang snying po drang po 'di ston pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di'i ming ci zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug naces bya'o/ /mdo 'dzin pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'od zer dang mig dang / lag pa stong yod pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu ni dpag tu med cing bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /'di ni 'das pa'i bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga logs su byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos snang ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya'o / /de ni snying rje chen po dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs su snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / klu'i 'khor dang khyed thams cad kyis de la mchod pa gyis shig /de la brnyas par ma byed cig /lha dang mi thams cad kyis rtag tu mchod 9pa gyis shig /ming yang brjod 1 cig dang / dge ba'i rtsa 93—205

ba skye zhing sdig pa du ma yang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa 1)'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye ba 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /su nor bu dang /'bras bu dang / rin po che dang yo byad 'dod pa des/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su nad sna tshogs kyis btab ste/ nad med par 'dod pa des don yod pa'i zhags pa thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su lto na ba des rin po che'i nasalhung bzed thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te bsam par bya'o/ /su 'byung po rnams dang bgegs byed pa'i lha la sogs pa gdul bar 'dod pa des/ rin po che'i /skural gri thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bdud 'dul bar 'dod pa des/ rdo rje thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su dgra tshar gcod par 'dod pa des/ rdo rje can gyi gtun shing thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su thams cad du 'jigs par gyur te/ bde ba ma thob pa des mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i lag pa la blta bar bya'o / /su mig na zhing mthong ba nyams pa des nor bu rin po che me shel thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su tsha ba'i nad kyis btab pa dang /dug 'thungs pa des nor bu rin po che chu shel thogs pa'i lag pa la blta bar bya'o / /su bdag po dang / rnyed 4pa dang / go 'phang 'dod pa des/ rin po che'i gzhu thogs pa'i lag pa la bsam par bya'o/ /su grogs po sdug pa myur du phrad par 'dod pa des/ rin po che'i mda' thogs pa'i lag pa la dmigs par 93—206

bya'o / /su lus la nad sna tshogs kyis btab pa des/ me tog gi snye ma thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su lus la las kyi sgrib pa'i sdig pa rnams zad par 'dod pa des/ rnga yab dkar po thogs pa'i lag pa la blta bar bya'o/ /su nye du dang / gnyen 'dab dang / bu dang / chung ma rnams dang / sems mthun 1par 'dod pa des/ ril ba blang na gar thogs pa'i lag pa la blta bar bya'o/ /su stag dang / spyang ki dang / gcan gzan ma rungs pa spong bar 'dod pa des/ phub thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o / /su phyogs thams cad du dbang phyug rnams kyis glags lta ba yongs su spong bar 'dod pa des/ dgra sta thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o / /su khye'u dang / bu mo dang / bskol bar 'dod pa des/ sor mo la ri thogs pa'i phyag rgya'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su bsod nams dang dge ba'i tshogs byed mi nus pa des/ pad+ma dkar po thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'dod pa des/ pad+ma sngon po thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su ye shes chen po thob par 'dod pa des rin po che'i me long thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mngon sum du mthong bar 'dod pa des/ pad+ma thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su sa'i 'og gi gter rnams thob par 'dod pa des rin po che za ma tog thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su drang srong gi lam tshol bar 'dod pa des/ tshon sna lnga'i sprin thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su tshangs ris kyi lha'i nang du skye bar 'dod pa des/ ril ba spyi blugs thogs 93—207

pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su lha'i nang du skye bar 'dod pa des/me'i mdog lta bu'i pad+ma thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su yul gzhan gyi dgra phyir phyogs par 'dod pa des/ rin po che mdung rtse gsum pa thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su lha dag dang / lha dang / yongs su skyong ba thams cad dgug par 'dod pa des/ dung thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su lha rnams dang / 'byung po rnams la bsgo 1ba byed par 'dod pa des/ khri'i zur shing lta bu thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis myur du lung bstan par 'dod pa des/ bgrang ba'i nor bu thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su skad snyan cing tshangs pa'i sgra lta bu 2'dod pa des/ rin po che'i dril bu thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su dgos pa thams cad dag par 'dod pa dang / lce bde ba dang / mkhas par 'dod nga des/ phyag rgya rin po che thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / rgyal po rnams kyis yongs su srung bar 'dod pa des/ lcags kyu thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su sems can thams cad la byams pa dang /snying rjes khyab par 'dod pa des/ 'khar gsil thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su sems can thams cad kyis bsti stang bya ba dang /dran par 'dod pa des/ thal mo sbyar ba'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su tshe rabs tshe rabs su sangs rgyas dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa des/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su skye zhing skye 903—208

ba na sangs rgyas rgyal po'i gnas dang / khang bzangs su 1skye zhing ma'i mngal du mi skye bar 'dod pa des/ sprul pa'i gzhal med khang thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su mang du nyan pa dang / mang du slob par 'dod pa des/ glegs bam thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su tshe 'di nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar du yid mi ldog rin par 'dod pa des / 'khor lo thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sbyin pa rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba tshim par 'dod pas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams myur du byon te/ phyag gis mgo la nyug cing lung ston par 'dod pa des/ mgo la sangs rgyas sprul pa bzhugs pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o / /su 'bru dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa btab cing bskyed pa rnams phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bar 'dod pa des/ dgun gyi snye ma thogs pa'i lag pa la bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /de la sogs pa 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams rnam pa stong du rig par bya ste/ mdo tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis snying po 'di ci nam 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur bar dge ba'i sems kyis zung shig long shig 4rgyas par ston cig /de ltar na snying po 'di don chen po byed pa yin no/ /khams gsum na sems can ji snyed 'khod pa'i lus la nad gang dag yod pa de gal te gsang sngags 'dis gso bar byed na/ nad med par mi 'gyur ba de gang yang med do/ /snying po 'dis shing skam po la bzlas brjod byas na/ de la yal ga dang / me tog gi snye ma dang /942—209

lo ma dang / 'bras bu rnams 'byung bar 'gyur na/ sems yod pa'i sems can bde bar 'gyur ba 1༄lta ci smos te/ 'di la the tshom za bar mi bya'o/ /kun dga' bo snying po 'di'i mthu stobs ni brtag par mi nus shing bsam gyis mi khyab ste / de bas na yon tan rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin to/ /sngon gyi dus dag na dge ba'i rtsa ba ma skyes pas ni ming yang mi thos na mthong ba lta ci smos/ khyod la sogs pa'i 'khor chen po 'di dang / lha dang / klu dang / mi rnams kyi snying po 'di la rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /gang gis thos la spong ba de ni/ gang gā'i 25klung dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams spong bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig snying po 'di la the tshom bskyed cing yid mi ches pa'i mi de ni/ yun ring po nas rnyed pa las rab tu nyams nas bskal pa chen po brgyad stong du ngan 'gro rnams su 'khyams par 'gyur ba dang /mngon par 'byung bar mi 'thob pa dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas mi mthong ba dang / chos mi mthong ba dang /ca chos mi thos pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams mi mthong bar shes par bya'o/ /de nas lag na rdo rje la sogs pa 'khor chen po de dang /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang klu dang /'byung po gnas pa rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po 'di'i bsngags pa brjod pa thos nas/ thams cad rab tu dga' ste/ bka' bzhin du 'dzin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od kyis rig sngags de srung 5ba'i phyir/ gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu phyag 93—210

'tshal lo/ /sus tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod na/ de sdig pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bgegs byed pa bdud dang mi phrad 1)par 'gyur ro/ /yams kyi nad rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig (2la dus gsum du brjod cing / dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des tshe rabs gzhan na gzugs dang ldan par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od kyis rig sngags 'chang de srung rin)ba'i phyir gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /sha ma ta te (4)tu su te5)/ ādzñā neb te/ u tu te/ shaṃ khri ste/ parma 7 rgya te/ a tu ṭi/ ku la ta te(8)/ khi ma ṭi swā hā/ gsang sngags 'di ni zhal nas gsungs pa'o/ /gsang sngags 'di lan lnga bzlas brjod byas la/ tshon sna bdun pa'i skud pas bcing ba 97bya ste/gsang sngags 'chang gang du na bar gyur pa der bcing bar bya'o/ /gsang sngags 'di ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas gang gā'i 1 5klung bzhi bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis gsungs te/bdag gis kyang da 1lharig sngags 'chang rnams srung 12ba'i phyir smras so/ /bgegs dang yams kyi nad thams cad zhi bar byed do/ /sdig pa thams cad dang nad thams cad byang bar byed do/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa'i gsang sngags 'di ni de bzhin no1snye/ /ma nor ba de bzhin no/ /don yod pa'o/ /su byang chub sems dpa' 'gugs par 'dod pa des/ gu gul gyi bdug pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te bsregs na/ byang chub sems dpa' der 'ong bar 93—211

'gyur ro/ /su zhig byi la'i gdon gyis zin par gyur na/ byi la'i mgo rus blangs te bsregs la sa 1tshogatsang ma dang / thal ba zhib mo dang bsres tsho te chus sbrus la byi la'i gzugs byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' mig stong ldan gyi mdun du ur mo'i ral gri la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ ral gri des byi la'i gzugs de brgya rtsa brgyad du gtubs ri skul dum bu re re la yang lan re bzlas brjod byas shing cadaming nas kyang brjod na/ ji srid 'tsho'i 95)bar du mi ldang ngo / /su zhig ha la ha la'i dug zos na/ des gu gul gyi bdug pa dang / ga bur cha bsnyams te khron pa'i chu lhag mar ma gyur pa dang / bskol ba khyor gang tsam lus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mig stong ldan gyi mdun du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te 'thungs na/ dug las sos par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig sbrul dang / srog chags u tsi ling gas zin par gyur na/ sga phyiraphye la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te ri/ rma khar btab na sos par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig sdig pa'i 'chi ba dang / skur pa 'debs pas mi gzhan la 'chi /rin/ des sa gtsang ma'am / bag phye'am/ spra tshil las de'i gzugs byas la/ byang chub sems dpa' mig stong ldan gyi mdun du ur mo'i ral gri la lan brgya rtsa brgyad dus gcig tu bzlas brjod byas te/ snying po brjod la dum bur gtubs 9note/de'i ming nas brjod cing lan brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na/ dga' bar 'gyur te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mdza' bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig mig nyams te ldongs pa'i bar du gyur pa dang / su zhig mig gi 1 'bras bu'i nyu1steng du ling thog 12byung ba dang / mig tu skyes te mi mthong bar gyur pa des a ru ra gcig dang / ba ru ra gcig dang / skyu ru ra gcig zhib tu btags la sbrang rtsi dkar 93—212

po dang / khye'u nu ba'i 'o ma dang sbyar bar bya ste/ sbyor ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nas brjod cing / bu gsar du btsas pa'i bud med dang / khyi dang /phag gis ma mthong bar byas la ril bur byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' mig stong ldan gyi mdun du lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ gnas dben pa rlung mi 'ong bar 'dug ste/ nyi ma bdun gyi bar du sman de mi'i 'o ma dang /sbrang rtsi dang 1)brdar ba mig tu blugs na/ mig gi 'bras bu skye'o/ /ling thog named par 'gyur zhing legs par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /su grang ba'i rims kyis btab pa'i ched ( skudu/ stag lpags sam/ gzigs ‘ lpags sam/ dred lpags sam / dom lpags sam/ spyang lpags la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te / grang ba'i rims kyis btab pa la bskon na rims sos par 'gyur ro/ /seng ge'i pags 5pa ni thams cad kyi mchog go/ /gal te sbrul gyis zin na mi de nyid kyi skra bcad la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ dug gi rma khar bzhag na sos par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig snying na zhing mi dran nam/ 'chi 'dod par gyur na/ shing sle ma ta ku'i thang chu star 6ka tsam chu gtsang ma dang bskol te phyed du ba dang lan bdun bzlas brjod byas la 'thungs na/ thams cad bde bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med kyis bskol bar mi bya'o/ /su zhig 'byung po'i gdon gyis zin tam/ mi ma yin pas btab pa'i nad kyis btab par gyur na/gu gul gyi bdug pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te snar blugs so/ /yang na ri bong gi rtug pa tsam gyi ril bur byas la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te bza'o/ /sha dang / chang dang / sgog 7pa dang / 'thab namo spang ngo / /'on dang 9sos par 'gyur ro1 / /yang na ldong ros dang / yungs 943—213

kur dang / lan tshwa 1dkar po bsres la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te / nad pa'i mal gyi 'og nas bdugs nan/ nad gtong ba'i 'byung po myur du 'bros te/ lus 'jig cing der 'dug mi nus par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gzhogs phyed na'am/ gzhogs phyed nyams sam/ rna ba 'on nam/ rkang lag 'gul mi nus par gyur na/ til mar gyi nang du ru rta btsos la/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te bskus na sos par 'gyur ro/ /yang na ba mar gcig pu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ bskus ne sos par 'gyur ro/ /bud med la la zhig bu 'byung shin tu dka' na/ til mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ lto ba'am/ lte bar bskus na myur du 'byung ngo / /gang gi mngal du bu 'chi na shing a pa marga srang gcig chu khyor do'i nang du bskol la phyed lus pa dang / de la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te 'thungs na / gnod pa med par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ma 4mi 'byung na yang sman de la bzlas brjod bya'o/ /la la zhig shi la thug 5pa tsam du snying na ste / mnags mi bzod na tu ruska tsidang / dbyi mo cha bsnyams te bsres 7la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te so la bsku zhing mid la skyugs skyugs kyi bar du byas na sos par 'gyur ro/ /sgog pa rnam dgu dang / sha dang / chang spang bar bya'o/ /mes tshig na ba nag mo'i lci ba dron po la 8lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ rma khar glan na sos par 'gyur ro/ /la la zhig srog chags ring po snying la za / rta dkar po'i gcin khyor phyed la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te 'thungs na/ srog chags de 'byung ngo / /gal te nad 1 tshabs che na khyor gang 'thungs na/ srog chags thag pa srig 'byung ngo / / (303—214

gal te 'bras drag po byung na/ rams kyi 1lo ma brdungs te khu ba btsir la de la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 2bzlas brjod byas te rma khar gtor na rtsa ba dang bcas te 'byung ngo / /la la zhig mig la sbrang bus zos par gyur na/ bong bu'i rtug pa gsar du byung ba btsir te/ khu ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ dgongs su 5nyal kur mig tu blugs na sos par 'gyur ro/ /la la zhig lto can na khron pa'i chu lhag mar ma gyur pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas pa'i nang du lan tshwa dkar po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la btab ste/khyor phyed 'thungs na sos par 'gyur ro/ /su'i mig la mig nag chags sam/rab rib bam/ rtsa dmar bar gyur na/ shing sham mya ku'i lo ma btsir te/de'i khu ba la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas la nang du 'gron bu bcug ste/zhag gcig bzhag la nang par yang lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ mig tu blugs na phan no/ /su zhig mtshan mo 6'jigs shing mi bde la skrag na/ skud pa dkar po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bor la mgul du btags na 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /las rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim zhig tu glo 7bur du naganod pa dag byung na/ bal po se'u'i shing gi lcug ma sor gnyis kyi tshad du gtubs 9pa stong rtsa brgyad byas la/ba mar dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi snod cig tu blugs pa drung du 1 bzhag ste/lcug ma'i dum bu cig 1 blangs la lan cig 1 bsngags te/ rtse mo gnyis mar du smyugs 1 la sreg 1 go/ /de bzhin du lcug ma'i dum bu thams cad bsregs na/yams kyi nad thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /las 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bya'o/ /shu dag dkar po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/9(3—215

dpung pa g.yas par thogs na thab 1mo'am/ 'gyed pa'i tshe rgyal bar 'gyur ro//shing sham mya ku'i lo ma dang bcas pa sor gnyis kyi tshad 2)gtubs (8)la cho ga gong ma bzhin du sbyin sreg 4bya'o/ /nyi ma gcig la dus gsum du lan stong rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg 5bya'o/ /gal te nyi ma bdun du de bzhin byas na/ dngos grub 'thob bo / /'phags pa'i lam yang skye'o/ /gal te 'byung po rdzu 'phrul chen po las rgyal bar 'dod na/ lung 6tang gi shing la lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bzlas brjod byas la ba mar dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbyin sreg byas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du bya'o/ /glang dkar po'i gi'u wang srang gcig mthing bu'i snod du bcug la/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya ste/ yan lag rnams la bskus la/ dpral bar thig le byas na/ lha klu dang 'byung po dang / mi thams cad dga' bar 7'gyur ro/ /gang dag nyes byung ste lcags sgrog dang / shing sgrog tu bcug na/ phug ron gyi rtug pa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ lag pa la yang bsku'o/ /lcags sgrog dang / shing sgrog la yang reg par byas na thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyo shug me dang chu ltar mi mthun par gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du ngur pa'i mjug /sgro la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ lus la thogs na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'dum par 'gyur ro/ /gal te srog chags dag lo tog phung bar byed na/ thal ba gtsang ma'am/ bye ma gtsang ma la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ me tog kun tu gtor na/ srog chags rnams phyir ldog par 'gyur ro/ /gal te srog chags dag shing tog 9la za na/ chu la bzlas brjod byas te/ shing rnams la gtor na 'bras bu la mi za'o/ /de'i tshe 903—216

yang bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag tshe rabs snga ma'i bsod nams kyi 1rgyus/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la khyod sems can gyi khams thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed nas/bcing ba dang / 'jigs pa thams cad gcod nus par 'gyur te/ de'i mthus sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rnams las thar bar 'gyur/ zhi ba dang / bde ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan par gyur to/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus lnga brgya pa tha mar gyur pa na/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig snying po chos kyi sgo 'di nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum 'dzin nus na / de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro / /chos thams cad kyi chos nyid 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi bka' drin dran par bgyi ste/ grong khyer ram grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ nags tshal gang na rig sngags 'chang gnas pa la/ gal te de na gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams 'tshe bar bgyid na/ bdag rtag tu der mchi zhing kun tu bsrung 4bar bgyi ste/yongs su spong bar mi bgyid do/ /de'i tshe yang bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i dus lnga brgya pa thams cad sems can phal cher rnyog pa can du 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chung zhing rtag par rgyun du dge ba'i phyogs bgyid mi nus pa dang / gal te 'dzin na yang de'i tshe/ lha dang / 'byung po 'tshe bar 'gyur bas/ bdag gis lha dang mi dang lha ma yin la sogs pa sems can thams cad la sman pa dang / bde ba 942—217
