dang / zhi bar bgyid pa'i slad du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mthu dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis gzungs 'di'i cho ga da 1bshad par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis kyang 'das pa'i bskal pa du mar gzungs 'di la mchod pa bgyis so/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed pa rnams kyis kyang gzungs 'di la brten 2nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes so/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig rtag tu gzungs 'di 'dzin cing 'chang na/ de'i tshe 'di nyid la tshig gi rgyun thogs pa med par 'gyur/ dbang po rno zhing mkhas par 'gyur/spobs pa myur bar 'gyur/ lha dang / mi thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /gang su'i sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / grags pa yang thos shing bde ba dang / dga' bar 3yang 'gyur ro/ /phyag bya ba'i 'os su yang 'gyur ro / /gang dang gang du skyes par yang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun yang mthong bar 'gyur/ tshig la yang yid ches shing yid rton par 'gyur ro/ /de yang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu lags par bgyi yi/bdag nyid kyi ni ma lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod nas/ legs so zhes bya ba yang 5byin te/ khyod ni lha dang mi la sogs pa la phan pa dang /bde ba dang / zhi bas las kyi lam la sbyor bar nus so/ /gal te yun ring por phyir mi ldog pa lta na/ da ngas ye shes kyi phyag rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dran pa bdag ri gru 'dzin (3 2—218

la gnas shing / 'das pa'i bskal pa du mar gzungs sngags kyi chos kyi sgo 'di brjod do/ /de'i tshe bdud der mchis nas bdud des 'khor bsdus nas/ ci nas kyang gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di'i 1'grub par bdag gis chos de la mtho 2btsam par bsams pa dang / de'i tshe bdag gis gsang sngags kyi chos de'i cho gas bdud pham par bgyis/ rnam par pham par bgyis so/ /gsang sngags 'di'i mthu ni brtag mi nus shing bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis lha dang mi rnams la phan pa dang / bde ba thob par bya ba'i phyir snying rjes rtsa ba'i gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba dzñā ya/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo3 4mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyakle bud dhā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā 5ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 6ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo ma hā s+thā ma sabhā 7ya/ bo dhi satā 8ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 9ru ṇi kā ya/na mo bi pu la/ bi ma na su pra tiṣ+ṭha tā 1 saṃ ghā 1 ya/ srur+ya 1 sha ta sa ha sra a ti re ka /pra bhā a ba bhā si ta mūrta ye/ ma hā ma ṇi mu ku ṭa kuṇ+ḍa la/ a lam̐ kā ra dhā 1 ri ṇi/ bha ga ba te/ pad+ma pā ṇa ye/ sarba lo ka a pā ya pra 1 sha ma 1rinā ya/bi bi dha mu kha sa mā be sha /a bhaṣ+ṭa sarba satā 7pa ri mo tsa kā ya/ tabya thā/ o lhur bhu ba swā hā/ ma hā ā lo 17ka ka ra ṇa ta masti mi ra pa ṭa la bi nā sha ka 1 rā ga de 19ga mo ha dz+wa na la sha ma ka /shā 21sa kun /sa mā shā sa na ka ra/ rak+ṣa ka /sarba a pā ya durga ti pra sha ma na ka ra/ sarba sarta 2nas mā shā sa na ka ra/ sarba ā shā 2 pa ri pū ra ka /sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma pa dā na ka ra/ e h+ye hi ma hā bo dhi satwa 5ba ra pad+ma ā lo ka saṃ bhu ta ma hā kā 2 tshoru ṇi ka /dza ṭā ma ku ṭa2 / a 903—219

lang kṛ 1ta/ shi ro ma ṇi ka na ka /rā dza ta badz+ra dbe+e ḍūr+ya a lang kṛ ta/ sha rī ra a mi ratā bha cadzi na ka ma la/ a lang kṛ ta pra bha ra ṇa par dza na sha ta sa ha sra 6a bhi la ṣ+pe ta 7tā ya/ ma hā bo dhi satā 8ya 9ba ra ba ra da/ bi 1 snadha ma bi dha ma/ bi nā sha ya/ bi nā sha ya/ ma hā yan traṃ/ kle 11sha ka bhā 12ta/ a ba ba dha bi bi dha sadzā ri/ sang sā 1 ra tsā 15ra ka /pra ma tha na ka ra/ pu ru ṣa pad+ma/pu ru ṣa nā ga /pu ru ṣa sā ga ra/ pu ru ṣa sing ha/ bī ra bī rā tshadza su daṇ+ḍa tā 1 pa ri bi 1 ti/ dha ma dha 19ma/ sa ma sa ma/ dhu ru dhu ru/ pra shā 2 sa ya pra shā 1sa ya/ ghi ri ghi ri/ bi bi ri bi bi ri 'i ri tsi ri si ri si ri su ru su ru/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi dhi ri bi dhi ri/ bi ri bi ri na/ mu ru mu ru/ mu kha mu kha/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa/ dhu na dhu na/ bi dhu na bi dhu na/ dhu ru dhu ru / gā ya gā ya/ ga dha ya ga dha ya/ sa ha sa ha/ pra sa ha pra sa ha/ nā nā 2dbi bi dha kle shī bā sa na/ 5 ha ra ha ra/ saṃ ha ra saṃ ha ra/ dhu ru tu dhu ru tu/ma hā maṇ+ḍa la ka ra ṇa sha ta pra se ka /a ba bhā si ta bi bi dha bā sa na sha mi ka /shā 26sa ka /rak+ṣa ka /ma hā bo dhi satwa 2 ba ra ba ra da swā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa 2 pad+ma'i phyag gi rgyan gyi yu ba zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lha dang / klu dang / mi 'am ci du mas yongs su bskor bas / rdo rje chen po dang ldan zhing dga' ba'i rgyu las byung ba'i khang bzangs su 29thams cad kyis mchog gi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don du gsungs te/sgrib pa'i ri chen po rnam par 'joms pa'o/ /gang la la zhig gis mnyan pa dang /blta ba dang / bklag 1pa dang / brjod pa thob na/ mi de'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig dad par 903—220

gus pas snga dro brjod na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu de'i slad bzhin 'brang zhing 1srung ba bgyid do/ /gang ci 'tshal ba dag kyang de bzhin du 'grub bo/ /su zhig gal te bdag gi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thob 2par 'tshal ba des/ gcig pu phyogs dben par mchis la/ byang chub sems dpa' 3'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la dran par bgyi zhing gzhan bsam par mi bgyi bar rilagazungs sngags 'di lan bdun brjod na/ yid la bsams 5pa gang rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba de gang yang ma mchis so/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro / /ngan 'gror mchi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rtag tu rjes su mngon du dran na/ bskal pa bye ba phrag du ma 6bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal po stong du tshang ba'i 8bsod nams dag kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gar skyes gar skyes kyang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs chen por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig snyim pa spos kyis bkang ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mdun du gtor la/gzungs sngags 'di yang lan bdun brjod na/ stong gi bsod nams kyi mchog dang / snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin yang 'thob bo/ /de mi'i 'jig rten 'dir yang stobs chen po yongs su rdzogs pa 'thob bo/ /su zhig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gdong du blta zhing / gzungs sngags 'di brjod pa de byang chub sems dpa' mtshan rgyas pa mthong nas/ sa dri ma med pa yang 'thob bo/ /'jig rten na yang snang ba bgyid do/ /tshe gcig gis sangs 943—221

rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang mthong ngo 1ri/ /ji ltar bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs pa de lta bur mchi tshon bar 'gyur ro/ /gar skyes gar skyes kyang sngon gyi tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin pa des/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya ba la bslab pa'i gzhi brgyad bzung ste/ gos gtsang ma bgos la ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du'am/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi spyan sngar tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bgyis la/ der me tog sna tshogs gtor bar bgyi/ bdug pas kyang bdugs par bgyi/ mar me yang bud par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gus pa bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe gzungs sngags 'di yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkyil 'khor der 'dug ste/ mtshams med pa la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa mi dge ba ji snyed mchis pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las rnams kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyang 'thob bo/ /'od zer gyis dbang bskur ba'i stobs kyang 'thob bo/ /sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa yang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te char dbab par 'tshal na/ gyen du nam mkha' la bltas la gzungs sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod na char 'bab bo / /gal te sa la bltas te gzungs sngags brjod na/ sa bon thams cad rnam pa brgyar phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'bab chu skams 4pa'i shul lam 'bab chu chen po'am/ 'bab chu'i dngo 'am mtsho tshogaci'am mtshe'u 'am/mtsho bran gyi 'gram du mchis te brjod na/ chu thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 903—222

'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad kyi don du gzungs sngags brjod de 1lag pas nabyabs na sos par 'gyur ro/ /dran nga nyams pa'i mi'i mdun du brjod na/dran pa slar 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /bru bas nyen pa'am/ skom pas nyen pa'i mi'i gdong du bltas te brjod na/ bkres pa'am skom pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtshams bcad par 'tshal na/ des mtshe'u chu'i nang du zhugs te der mchis la/ gzungs sngags 'di yi ger bris te/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags na/ dpag tshad brgyar mtshams bcad par 'gyur te/ der nyes pa rnams mi 'byung ngo / /mtshams kun tu srung ba rdzogs so// //da 4ni lus thams cad bsdu ba'i phyag rgya brjod par bgyi'o/ /lus drang por 'greng ste5/ rkang pa nye bar mnyam du gzhibs 6la/ rkang pa g.yas pa yid tsam bskums te/ lag pa g.yon pa thur du brkyang / gung mo dang srin lag gnyis lag mthil du dgug /mdzub mo dang / mthe bong dang / mthe'u chung brkyang la lag mthil bkan te bzhag 7go/ /lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /lag pa gnyis ku'i gung mo bkug pa lag pa phrag 8pa dang mnyam par bzhag 9go/ /lag mthil ni mdun du bstan te bzhag 1 go/ /'di ni lus bsdu ba'i phyas/ rgya dang po'o/ /su zhig bdud dang / gzhan mu stegs can dang / dgra rnams pham par bgyi ba dang / lam dang po la gnas par 'tshal na/ phyag rgya 'di bcings la gzungs 'di yang lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bgyi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya / ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ a bta11/ a brte 12pa ri lha bsto1 / e h+ye hi swā hā/ gang gong du phyag rgya ji skad smos pa de bzhin du 903—223

lus gnas par bgyis la/ snying gar 1thal mo sbyar te/ sor mo thams cad phan tshun thad kur bsnol la/ g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams kyis g.yas pa rnams la 'khyud par bgyi/ mdzub mo gnyis gyen du sgreng 2la/ rtse mo gnyis sprad do/ /mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo gnyis kyi tshigs dang po la reg par bgyi'o/ /lag mthil ni ma 'byar bar bgyi'o/ /'di ni gzungs thams cad kyi phyag rgya ste gnyis pa'o/ /bskal pa du mar tshe rabs su bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa mi dge ba thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe phyi ma la ca'agyur ro/ /gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub brnyes par mdzad par brtsams pa'i tshe bdud kyis mtho btsams pa nag/ phyag rgya 'dis btul/ de'i tshe zhi ba'i bde ba dang / bsam gtan dang / snyoms par 'jug pa yang brnyes par 'gyur ro6/ /gzungs sngags 'di yang brjod par bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā / sarba dhā ra ṇi/ maṇ+ḍa lā ya/ e h+ye hi pa ra ma 7shud dha satā ya swā hā/yang thog mar lag pa nagayas pa 'byin pa ltar bgyis/ 'a / pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ mgo bor thal mo sbyar la mdzub 9mo gnyis bkug ste rtse mo sprad/ mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo gnyis kyi tshigs gnyis pa la sbyar ro/ /'di ni chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ rnam par grol bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ bsam gtan dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni phyag rgya gsum pa'o/ /sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang mthun 1 par bsgoms te / de'i tshe bsam gtan rnams dang / snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang /rnam par grol ba brnyes so/ /yang 'di ni gzhan te 'greng la rkang pa gnyis mnyam par gzhib bo/ /lag pa'i gung mo dang / srin lag dang / mthe'u chung 943—224

rgyab sbyar te/ sen mo phrad par bgyi/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste rtse mo phrad par bgyi/ mthe bo 51gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs gnyis pa la reg par bgyi/lag mthil nang nas sor bcu tsam gyis bskyed rnal smin mtshams su gzugs so/ /'di ni mig stong gi phyag rgya ste bzhi pa'o/ /gal te phyag rgya 'di bcings la gzungs sngags brjod na/ skad cig de nyid la 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa/ dkrigs pa bye ba phrag stong mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag rig sngags 'chang de dang lhan cig spyod cing grogs su gyur pa ni zhing re re na yang byang chub sems dpa' dkrigs pa bye ba phrag 'bum dang / bzhi stong nyi shu mchis so/ /gang dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa des ni blta bar mi rigs te/phyag rgya de'i chos nyid do/ /su la rigs zhe na gang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa de nyid la'o/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos kyi sbyin pa ye shes kyis rtogs par 'tshal ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags ni 'di lags te/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ bhu sarba tsak+ṣuḥ kā rā ya dhā 5ra nehā na dā ya swā hā/ yang 'greng la rkang pa mnyam par gzhibs 7te/ lag pa g.yas pa bkan 8la sor mo lnga gzhibs 9te brkyang la/ lag pa g.yon pa yang de bzhin du bgyis te bkan 1 tshol lag pa g.yas pa'i rgyab la sbyar te snying gar 11bzhag 12go/ /'di ni lag pa stong thams cad bsdus pa'i phyag rgya ste lnga pa'o/ /'dis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ bdud dang dgra mchis pa rnams thul lo/ /gzungs sngags 1 'di lags te/ na mo ār+sā 1 ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / tar+ya thā sarba duṣ+ṭa o ha ya 15me swā hā/ yang 'greng ste 1 dzoting pa phrad par bgyis la/ lag pa g.yon pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin par bgyis te/ lag pa g.yas 9(3—225

pa yang de bzhin du bgyis la/ lag mthil bdag logs su bstan par bgyi'o/ /'di ni ting nge 'dzin rab tu rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya ste drug pa'o/ /'dis ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rab 1tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'dis ni 2thams cad kyang 'thob bo/ /gzungs kyi rtsa ba'i gsang sngags snga ma/ na maḥdasarba 5dzñā zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /yang 'greng la rkang pa nye bar gzhibs nate/lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis mthe bo'i sen 6mo mnan to/ /g.yas pa yang de bzhin te mthe'u chung dang / gung mo rnams rtse mo sprad la/ lag rting drang por bsrang ste/ dgug pa ni mdzub mo gnyis dgug go/ /slar btang 7na ni brkyang ngo / /de ltar mchis la sngags brjod par bgyi'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo gnyis ni dgug go/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo gnyis ni slar gtang 8ngo / /mgo'i thon 'khor g.yas nas bskor bar bgyi ste bod 9pa'o/ /g.yon pas ni bsal ba ltar bgyis te slar btang 1 ngo / /phyag rgya 'dis 11ni lha dang klu la sogs pa 'khor brgyad bsdu ba'i slad du dgug pa'i phyag rgya ste bdun pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lags te/ o sarba de ba nā ga a na le swā hā/ phyag rgya snga ma la rtse mo bskyed de/ lag rting gnyis sbyar ba las yud 1 tsam bzung mdzub mos g.yab ste snga ma bzhin no/ /'di ni brgya byin dang / tshangs pa chos mnyan pa'i slad du dgug pa'i phyag rgya ste brgyad pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lags te/o ma hā brah+ma ye/ e h+ye 1 gyi swā hā/ phyag rgya 'di dang / gsang sngags 'di ni gzungs sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / chos kyi sgo du ma gzung ba'i slad du bsdu ba'o / /nyi ma spyang gis zin pa dang / zla ba spyang kyis zin pa'i tshe/ ba mar la 943—226

lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ phyag rgya 'dis phyag rgyas 1btab la 'thungs na dbang po rno bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig bzhin du chos kyi tshigs su bcad pa khri lobs nus 2par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya 'di dang / chos kyi sgo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying pos/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ched du gsungs pa'o/ /yang 'greng ste rkang pa nye bar gzhibs sal/ lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ snying gar bzhag la mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug ste/ rtsa ba'i sngags chen po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rang rang gi nor bu'i yid bzhin lta bu'i phyag rgya ste dgu pa'o/ /'dis nges par lha'i gzhal med khang rnams su 'jug go/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su yang mchi'o / /mchod pa'i don du rin po che brgya stong dag kyang bsams ci pa bzhin rnyed 6par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig chos kyi sgo 'di'i las bgyid nus na/ de nang par sngar langs la khrus bgyi zhing kha gdong bkrus te/ phyag rgya de'i dam tshig bgyis na/ des phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 7klung gi bye ma snyed mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa du mar tshe rabs su bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las lci ba rnams 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya de'i yon tan dang / bsngags pa ni narab tu mang ngo / /yang snga ma bzhin du thal mo sbyar te/ mdzub mo gnyis bkug la mthe bo'i sen mo la bcar te/ mdzub mo gnyis kyi sen 9mo yang phan tshun du rgyab sprad la rtsa ba'i gsang sngags brjod par bgyi'o / /'di nas 10byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems la 'dod pa'i phyag rgya ste bcu pa'o/ /ci 'tshal ba de bzhin du 'grub bo/ /nges par bla na med pa 942—227

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /yang thal mo snga ma las mthe bong dang / mdzub mo so sor brkyang ste lag mthil dbye bar bgyi'o / /'di ni rgyu'i gnas skabs kyi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i 1niklung gi bye ma snyed kyis nasibadag la stsal ba ste/ 'dis bdag byang chub kyi lam rab tu rtogs so/ /'dis rtsa ba'i gsang sngags brjod par bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyag rgya ste/bcu gcig pa'o/ /yang thal mo snga ma las mdzub mo gnyis bskum zhing brkyang bas bskul bar bgyi'o/ /'di byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams 'thob pa'i phyag rgya ste/ bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gzungs sngags ni 'di lags te/ oṃ sarba bud dha sa ma ya e dgye hi pa ra ma shud dha satwa cha swā hā/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong dang ldan pa/ lag pa stong dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor khru bcu drug pa'i cho ga brjod par bgyi'o/ /thog mar ri rnams dang nye ba/ sa gzhi bkra shis pa'i phyogs btsal bar bgyi'o/ /der sa brkos te/ gseg ma dang / gyo mo dang / rus pa dang / mi gtsang ba rnams bsal la/ dri zhim po dang bsres pa'i ba'i gci 5ba dang / 'jim par bsres te byug par bgyi'o/ /der chu 6zheng du khru bcu drug pa'i stegs bu bgyi'o/ /'phang du ni mtho gang gi tshad du bgyis la/ sgo bzhi btod 7den/ shar gyi sgor ni yul 'khor srung / lho'i sgor ni 'phags skyes po'o9/ /nub kyi sgor ni mig mi bzang / byang gi sgor ni rnam thos kyi sras te/ de dag gi gam yor rang rang gi 'khor thams cad bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 903—228

dbang phyug mig stong dang ldan pa lag pa stong dang ldan pa gzhag 1par bgyi'o/ /de'i mdun du khri'u bzhag ste/ khri'u'i 5steng du gzungs sngags kyi cho ga gzhag dpar bgyi'o/ /de la bdug pa sna tshogs kyis bdug go/ /me tog sna tshogs bkram (4)mo/ /lha bshos sna tshogs dbab bo/ /der mchod pa de rnams bzhag ste/sgog pa rnam dgu dang / sha dang chang mi dbab bo/ /gal te rgyun mi 'chad par bgyi na nyin gcig bzhin rimachod pa thams cad kyang sar 6pa gzhan gyis brje'o//cho ga 'dis nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dngos po thams cad kyis mchod par bgyi'o/ /sgrub pa po gang dag sngon mthong ba de dag gis bri bar bgyi'o/ /de sgrub pa po shar phyogs su bltas te/ 'greng la gzungs sngags snga ma dang po nas bcu gnyis kyi bar du brjod par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthar phyin gyi bar du skyo bar mi bgyi'o / /thog mar phyag rgya dang po lan cig 7bcings la gsang sngags kyang lan bdun brjod par bgyi'o/ /bcu gnyis pa'i bar du yang de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /der de'i tshe phyir mi ldog pa brtan po'i sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /cho ga 'dis de bzhin du dgug pa bgyis na/ thams cad 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 8tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyi ched du nges par drang po'i sems kyis drang por mchis par 9bgyi'o / /gsang sngags dang lha thams cad rjes su dran par bgyi ste/ ji ltar na mdun na mig 1 lam na gnas pa lta bu dang phan tshun gnod pa bgyid pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /dmigs pa gzhan la dmigs par mi bgyi'o/ /de'i tshe rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan stong brgyad cu bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /'on tang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kun dga' bo'i gzugs kyis der mchis te/ sgrub pa po la ci 'dod ci slong zhes 'dri 11zhing phan tshun smra bar 93—229

'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa pos bdag nyid kyis mchod pa bgyi bar bsams 1)la/bdag la ji skad dris pa lan gdab par bgyi ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du gzungs sngags kyi rang bzhin 'tshal lo zhes brjod par bgyi'o/ /yang na 'di skad du 'di ni lung bstan pa'i dus lags pa snyam 2bgyid na/ thugs rje dang ldan pas bdag la nges par thugs rje chen po bskyed du gsol/ bdag ni rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / grags pa mi 'tshal gyi/ nam zhig na sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa bzhin du lta ba dang / yongs su skyob par 'gyur snyam du sems so/ /yang 'byung po gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin du gnas par gyur cig snyam du sems so zhes brjod par bgyi'o/ /gal te yid la bsams (4pa 'di thob cing dngos grub de thob na gzhan la mi brjod par bdag nyid kyis 'tshal bar bgyi'o / /gal te cho ga 'di grub ldan bzlas par bgyi/ gcig tu gzung 6bar bgyi'o / /'di ni bslab pa gcig tu gsang ngo / /su zhig sna tshogs 'tshal ba des a ga ru nag po'i chab kyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis la/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /yid la bsams 75pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i phyag rgya bcu pa yang bcing bar bgyi'o/ /'on tang 'tshal ba yongs su rdzogs par rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe glegs bam 'di bzhin du sems shing / su zhig 'di bzhin du mchod pa bgyid na gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //yang cho ga gzhan te su zhig bde ba thams cad thob par 'tshal ba des/yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i phyag rgya dgu pa bcings la rtsa ba'i gsang 943—23()

sngags bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /til nag po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ mer bsregs na ci 'tshal ba bzhin du 'grub bo/ /ci nas rgyal po dga' bar bgyi 'tshal na des rgyal po gnas pa na mchis pa'i shing las lcug ma blangs te/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis la/ rgyal po'i kun dga' ra ba der bor na dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sems can sdig pa can rnams dang / dgra rnams tshar gcod par 'tshal na/ des shing nim pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ mer bsregs na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /yang cho ga gzhan te lha dang / 'byung po ma dul ba de'i slad du/ gu gul dang yungs kur la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te mer bsregs na/ 'byung po thams cad bdag nyid tshul bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang du nad byung na chab kyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis 1te/ der ba mar la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis la/ mer bsregs na nad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mar de nyid las nyung zhig nad pa la blud na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon yul ko bi nar 2nad byung ste/ nad pa rnams gdugs gcig gnyis bro 'tshal nas gum mo//de'i tshe dbus kyi yul gyi mi bden gyur ces bgyi ba der mchis te/ des gzungs sngags 'di'i /cho ga bgyis nas bsgrags pa dang / nad chad do/ /'byung po'i 4rgyal po yang yul de nas byung ngo / /thams cad kyis kyang 'di'i stobs 'tshal te/ gang du rang gi 'khor du pha rol gyi dmag tshogs mchi 5ba der thog ma'i rtsa ba'i gsang sngags bcings la bcangs la6/ gsang sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ dgra bo chom rkun rnams bdag nyid mi rung bar 7'gyur ro/ /su zhig tshe zad pa des 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug 903—231

pa'i phyag rgya bcing 1bar bgyi/ nyin gcig 95)bzhin mchod pa bgyi/ a ga ru nag po'i bdug pas bdugs par bgyi zhing / gsang sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na de tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med gang zhig bu mi phyin na ba mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te/ de la blud na zhi ba dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gang bskyed pa'i bu dang / bu mo dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo bzang po sngon gyi bsod nams rnams kyis brgyan lacing / sems can rnams dga' ba dang / mir skyes pa na rtag tu mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur zhing bde ba mchog rnams myong bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig mig na ba des mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya bcings la gzungs sngags thams cad kyi phyag rgyas mig la phyag rgyas btab na sos par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar steng gi phyogs kyi lha bde ba myong ba rnams mthong ba de lta bu'i mthong ba dang ldan par (ragyur ro/ /da 5ni ri mo bri ba'i cho ga brjod par bgyi ste/ ri mo bri ba'i ched du ras dkar po bgyis la/ byang chub sems dpa' mdog 'dzam bu'i tshigaser lta bu bri bar bgyi'o/ /lag pa stong dang ldan par bgyi'o/ /lag pa so so'i lag mthil na mig re re mchis par bgyi ste/ spyin ma mchis pa'i tshon gyis bri bar bgyi'o/ /tshon rtsi yang ka pid tha dang bsre bar bgyi'o/ /mgo la rin po che sna bdun gyi cod pan bri bar bgyi'o/ /yan lag dang / nying lag rnams su rgyan gyis brgyan par bri bar 7bya'o/ /yang na ras la byang chub sems dpa' srid du khru gang ba bris te/ lag pa gnyis bri bar bgyi'o/ /gong du smos pa'i lag pa stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya lnga pas/ rig sngags 'chang gis mchod pa bgyi'o / /gal te lag pa dang / mig stong dang ldan par ma gyur na/ dpral 9(3—23 2

bar mig gcig bgyi'o/ /yang 'di ni cho ga gzhan te/ su zhig chos kyi sgo 'di mchod par 'tshal na/ thog mar 91ras la bri bar bya'o/ /de ni 'di ltar bri bar bgyi ste/ cho ga snga ma bzhin du dkyil 'khor bgyi'o/ /de nas ri mo mkhan bslab pa brgyad bzung ba chab khung sar mchis te/ slar log nas legs par bkrus dpa gtsang mas bri bar bgyi'o / /tshon rtsi rung bas cho ga bzhin bris la/de'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchis te/ der smyung cab bgyis la nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu mchod pa'i las rgya cher bgyis na/ de na gnas 5byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer gtong ste/ de la the tshom mi bgyi'o/ /slad kyis zla ba dang /nyi ma lta bu'i 'od kyang bgyid do/ /gang dge ba dang dad pas mi bgyid pa des 6ma gtogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' lag pa stong dang ldan pa'i cho ga'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs byung ba'i tshe yang bdag gis bdud 'dul ba'i lus mig stong dang ldan pa sprul pa'o/ /mig re re las kyang sangs rgyas re re sprul te/ de dag ni bskal pa bzang po la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba lags so/ /lag pa stong las lag pa re re la yang 'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal po re re sprul ton / /de dag ni 'khor los sgyur 9ba'i rgyal po stong 'byung ba lags so/ /bdud 'dul ba'i tshogs kyi nang na/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni thams cad kyi mchog go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ngas gsang sngags 'di sangs rgyas kyi mthus rgyas par bshad na/ bskal pa 'das kyang mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das la 1 gsang sngags 'di thos nas 943—233

rab tu dga' ste/ yi rangs 1nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas gzungs sngags 'di brjod do/ /na mo rat+na rasmi tsan+d+ra a lam̐ kā ra mārga te dza purgya tsak+ṣu ra bi ṣa 2ya rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ tabya thā/ rat+na rat+na/ ta ta sha rat+na / rat+na pra ti ma te/ rat+na pra bhā 4rat+na da ka te swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzungs sngags 'di brjod nas/ de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la thug gi bar du/ rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /'og min gyi lha'i ris na/ dbang phyug chen po yang mi bde bar gyur to/ /lha'i gnas der 'jigs pa chen po yang byung ngo / /ngan song du gyur pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal chen po rnyed do zhes sgra chen po 'byin cing /phar 'bros tshur 'bros te/ gar 5song mi shes so/ /de'i tshe sprul pas ngan song du gyur pa'i 'khor chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gal te gsang sngags 'di las 'da' zhing 'gras par byed na mgo bo rdul phra rab bzhin du 'gyes so6/ /gsang sngags 'di'i mthus ni ri 'thor ro/ /rgya mtsho chen po skems so / /lha ma yin gyi dmag pham par bgyid do/ /'byung po rnams tshar gcod do/ /sdig pa can gyi mi rnams kyang tshar gcod do/ /nad chen po dag kyang chad par bgyid don / /yul bsrungs par 9yang 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig gsang sngags 'di brjod cing 'dzin pa de'i gzi brjid dang / stobs yun thung ngus bshad par mi nus so/ /gzungs sngags 'di 'chang zhing brjod pa ni dpa' bar 'gyur ro/ /phyug pa dang / stobs dang ldan pa dang / dbang dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ji srid 9(3—234

'tsho'i 1)bar du rgyal po byams par 'gyur ro/ /ci 'tshal ba thams cad 'grub bo / /su zhig bdud pham par bgyid par 'tshal ba des 2bdug pa gtsang ma la rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /su zhig 'di snyam du bdag la sems can thams cad byams par 'tshal ba des/ so shing la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te mchod dan byams par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig bdag gi tshig thogs pa med par 'gyur bar 'tshal ba des/ shu dag la lan stong rtsa brgyad 4bzlas brjod bgyis la snying gar rabaskus na 'grub bo/ /las de dag la yang rtsa ba'i gsang sngags brjod do/ /phyag rgya yang bcing 6bar bgyi'o / /lag pa gnyis rgyab sprad de sbyar la mthe bong gnyis brkyang ngo / /phyag rgya 'di ni ji ltar bdag srung ba de bzhin du gzhan yang srung ngo / /mtshams bcad pa yang bgyi'o/ /gang zhig tu mchi na chab bam/ thal ba lag par blangs te lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis la/ bdag gi steng du gtor na/phyogs bzhir mtshams bcad par yang 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig 'byung po rnams sam/ bgegs dang / log 'dren rnams kyis mtho btsams 7par gyur na/ bal po se'u 8shing gi lcug ma la gsang sngags bzlas brjod bgyis te/ dal gyis bzhus 9na sos 1 par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i so so'i rig pa'i phyag rgya thogs pa med pa ste/ bcu gsum pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lags te/ na maḥ11sarba bud dha dharma saṃ ghā ya / na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa 1 ra su bo dhe satwa 1 su/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi su/ bo dhi satwa sasu/ tabya thā/ dhu pi dhu pi/ kā ya dhu pi/ pra sha ma ni swā hā/ log par lta ba gzhan mu stegs can rnams 'dul bar nus so/ /su zhig dus gsum 93—235

du gsang sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa re re brjod pa des/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bye ba phrag bcu la mchod pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mchod pa bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /bud med du skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe ngan 'gro gsum po dag las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyis de'i spyi bor phyag bzhag ste/ 'di skad du 1bu ma 'jigs shig /nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir 'ongs so/ /'dir skyes nas dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir 'byung po rnams kyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes gsung ngo / /'greng ste lag pa g.yon pa gru mo bkug pa drang por brkyang ste/mi 'jigs pa sbyin par bgyi/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong lag mthil du bkug la 2sor mo bzhis mnan te/ khu tshur 'di rna ba g.yas pa'i gong du bzhag la mdzub mo sgul dbar bgyi/ brkyang bar bgyi/ bskum par bgyi'o / /phyag rgya 'di ni stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i las rnams 'byang bar bgyi ba'i paslad du smras pa ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni nyin gcig snyobazhin dus gsum du bcings la gsang sngags kyang lan bdun bdun brjod na/mtshams med pa lnga po dag dang / rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang 'byang bar bgyid nus par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed 7na / las kyi rtsa ba thams cad tshig par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe tshe 'di 'dor ba na / sangs rgyas dang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur naba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /dpag tu med cing mi zad pa'i snying po'i gzungs 'thob par 'gyur ro / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin 'thob 9par 'gyur ro/ /lus la ltas 943—236

rnam pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lus la gnod pa mi 'byung ngo / /mig nad dang / rna ba'i nad dang / sna'i nad dang / lce 1nad mi 'byung ngo / /phyi dang nang gi nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las mi dge ba rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te char mi 'bab na til nag po la e raṇ+ḍa'i mar gyis sbrus te/ ril bur bgyis la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te/mtshe 'ur stsal na/ de'i mod la char dbab bo/ /gal te char ches na yungs kur gyi mar gyis sna ma'i me tog sbrus la ril bur bgyis te/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis la mtshe 'ur stsal na char 'chad 2par 'gyur ro/ /sor mo lnga phan tshun bsnol te/ g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams kyis g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams dam du 'khyud la mgo bo'i steng du bzhag ste/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags bzlas brjod bgyi'o / /'di ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten du bdud 'dul ba'i phyag rgya ste bco lnga pa'o/ /phyag rgya 'dis ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du smyung bar bgyi/ gdugs nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du tsan+dan dkar po'i 'dag larigs dkyil 'khor byug /me tog gtsang ma dgram mo/ /de'i tshe khrus bgyis la gos gtsang ma bgos te/ a ga ru nag po'i bdug pas bdug par bgyi'o / /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /'di ni ngar snyems pa 5)bgyi'o/ /de nas yungs kur dang / til nag po lhan cig btags la/ pho gsum 6gang tsam la lan cig 7bzlas brjod bgyis te zhugs su dor ro/ /de ltar gdugs bdun gyi bar du gdugs gcig cing / yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ ci 'tshal ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'greng la rkang pa mnyam par nye bar gzhibs 8te/ lag pa g.yas 903—237

pa thur du thams cad brkyang 1la bkan te/ pus mo'i steng du bzhag /lag pa g.yon pa yang de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i mi 'jigs pa stsol ba'i phyag rgya ste bcu drug pa'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du bcings la/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa 465 nasibar 'gyur ro/ /yang na shu ti'i nas bon dang / yungs kur dang / shu dag dang /nye'u shing dang / 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi spyan snga'amatsho / bla gab med pa'i phyogs su sbyin sreg bgyi'o/ /gsang sngags lan sum cu 5riganyis bzlas brjod bgyi'o / /me tog dang / bdug pas mchod par bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsang sngags kyi cho ga lags te/ ci rtsom pa thams cad de bzhin du 'grub bo/ /gsang sngags gang mi 'grub na/ gsang sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na 'grub bo/ /rmi lam mthong bar 'tshal na/ gsang sngags 'di 6yang brjod cing phyag rgya 'di yang bcings na ci 'tshal ba rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mi bsod nams dang mi ldan pa gang zhig dngos grub mi thob na/ gsang sngags 'di gdugs bdun gyi bar du gdugs gcig kyang dus gsum du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ ci 'tshal ba de bzhin du 'grub bo/ /de'i tshe yang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i khang par 'dug ste chos bshad do/ /der klu sdug bsngal chen po myong ba dag mthong nas / snying rje chen po skyes 7te/ gal te yongs su skyob pa zhig yod na/ sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa rnams las thar bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de'i tshe der klu'i bu mo chos 'dod pa gcig 8gis rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed gcig ri 943—238

ba cig 1phul ba dang / des kyang sdug bsngal thams cad 2yongs su thar bar byed pa'i chos bshad do/ /de'i tshe der gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chu'i snying pos kun tu srung dba'i phyir gsang sngags 'di smras so/ /bi ma le ma hā bi ma le/ o ha re ma hā o ha re/ hu ma re ma hā hu ma re swā hā/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gsang sngags 'di 'dzin na/ de gar mchi bar bdud kyi 'khor gyis sdug bsngal bar bgyid pa'i bar du bdag gis rtag tu kun tu bsrung 4bar bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig glo bur du 'jigs par gyur tam/ rang gi yul lam gzhan gyi yul lamar/ chom rkun dang phyir rgol ba dag byung na/ des tshon skud sna lnga pa bcing bar bgyi ste/ mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bor la/ mdud pa re re zhing yang gsang sngags lan re re bzlas brjod bgyis te/ lag pa g.yon pa la bcing bar bgyi'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag dang / gung mo dang / mdzub mo rnams khu tshur bcangs la mthe bos de dag mnan/ mthe'u chung brkyang ste/ dgra logs su bstan 6la gsang sngags kyang lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i kun tu srung ba'i phyag rgya ste bcu bdun pa'o/ /gsang sngags lan bcu 7bdun bzlas brjod bgyis na/ dgra thams cad ldog par 'gyur zhing / gnod par bgyid 8mi nus so/ /de'i tshe yang byang chub sems dpa' gangs kyi ri la gnas te chos kyang 'chad do/ /der gnod sbyin dang srin po rnams kyi yul na sems can rnams phan tshun za zhing / de dag la dge ba'i sems med par mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du nam zhig na 'dul bar 'gyur snyam nas de'i tshe der song ste/ yul der de dag gi don gyi 943—239

phyir lag pa stong dang ldan zhing mig stong dang ldan pa'i lus sprul nas des bdud rnams pham par byas so/ /der gzungs sngags 'di yang smras so/ /de nas srin po'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i gan du song ste/ las de bshags nas phyag byas so/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang phyag rgya bcu bdun gyis phyag rgyas btab pa dang / de'i mod la byang chub kyi lam thob bo/ /'greng ste rkang pa phan tshun nye bar gzhibs 1la snying gar 2thal mo sbyar te mthe'u chung phan tshun bsnol lo / /g.yon pas g.yas pa la 'khyud par bgyi/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags kyang lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag rgya yongs su rdzogs pa ste bcwa brgyad pa'o/ /yid la bsam pa rnams rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig ngan 'gro drug po dag gi sems can rnams skyob par 'tshal ba des/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcing bar 4bgyi ste/ sor mo bcu rtse sprad la lag rting dbye/ sor mo'i bar yang sor gnyis gnyis tsam gyis ma phrad par bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'dis byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams yongs su thar bar bgyid cing / 'gro ba drug po dag tu zhugs pa dang 'dra bar rig par bgyi ste/ phyag rgya de'i cho ga'o/ /yang skyil mo krung bcas te mchis la lag pa g.yon pa pus mo'i steng du lag mthil bkan te bzhag ru par bgyi'o/ /g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyis la/ lag mthil pus mo'i steng du kha phub ste gzhag par bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dam tshig yongs su rdzogs pa yang dag pa'i byang chub kyi phyag rgya ste bcu dgu pa'o/ /'di ni rang bzhin gyis 'gog pa dang mtshungs te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams phyag rgya ()(3—240

'di gcig pus sangs rgyas kyi byang chub brnyes so/ /phyag rgya 'dis las mi dge ba thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sgrub pa po skyil mo krung bcas te mchis pa la chos rnams mngon du gda' bar ma gyur na/ gdugs bdun gyi bar du dgon pa'i phyogs kyi gnas su phyag rgya 'dis gzungs 'di brjod la shin tu dad pas sangs rgyas la phyag bgyi zhing / gdugs mtshan drug tu las rnams so sor bshags na/ de'i tshe chos mdun 1du gda' bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams dpag tu ma mchis shing grangs ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /yang lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo bzhi khu tshur bcangs la g.yas pa'i sor mo bzhis g.yon pa'i mthe bong bcangs te/ cung zhig mchis la g.yas pa'i mdzub mos g.yab bo/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i rnam pa rnams dgug pa'i phyag rgya ste nyi shu pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lags te/ o ku ṭi ku ṭi/ kun re tsi le 2dzi le tsi li le swā hā / gsang sngags 'di dang / phyag rgya 'di ni lhag par rgya che ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig ci rtsom pa rmi lam du mthong bar 'tshal na / gsang sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ yid la ci bsams 4pa rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig gdugs gcig bzhin du goms par bgyid na/ las rnams byang 5bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi sems mi bskyud do/ /rmi lam bzang po dpal du 'gyur ba dang / byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bar du mthong zhing / byang chub tu lung ston par rmi bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyang kun tu srung bar 'gyur ro6/ /yang 'greng ste rkang pa phan tshun bsnyen la/903—241

lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong lag mthil du bkug ste/ sor mo bzhis khu tshur bcangs la snying gar 1bzhag /g.yas pa yang de bzhin bgyis la/ rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ mdzub mos g.yab bo/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lha dang / klu la sogs pa 'khor brgyad po dag dgug pa'i phyag rgya ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni 'di lags te/ na mo ni gan+dha/ na mo dar+sha 2na swā hā/ na mo nirdza 5la swā hā/ e h+ye hi swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig phyag rgya 'di dang / gsang sngags 'di 'dzin tam/ 'don tam/ klog pa tshe rabs bdun dran par 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gdug pas zin par mi 'gyur ro/ /dug kyang gdug par mi 'gyur ro/ /lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs so/ /rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /bskal 4pa mang por sems can dmyal bar mi mchi'o/ /sdug bsngal nyams su mi myong ngo / /gang brjod par 'byung po rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gcig lhags te/ gsang sngags 'di nyan par 'gyur ro / /gang gi drung du 'byung po mchi ba der skud pa dkar po gdags par bgyi ste/mdud pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bor la/ mdud pa re re la yang lan re bzlas brjod bgyis te mgul tu btags na bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te yul du yams kyi nad byung ste/ sems can mang du 'gum na/ rgyal po'i skyed 5mos tshal nas pad+ma dag bslangs la/ pad+ma re re la yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te / bsregs 6pa bgyis na/ yams kyi nad 'chad par 7'gyur ro/ /yang skyil mo krung bcas te mchis la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang / gung namo rtse mo sprad de/ lag mthil bkan la pus 9mo g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag /g.yas 93—242

pa yang de bzhin du bgyis la/ pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du kha phub ste bzhag 1go//sor mo gzhan bskyed la/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o / /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par grol ba'i phyag rgya ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /ci 'tshal ba de bzhin du 'grub bo/ /sdug bsngal las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis mtshams med pa lnga po'i las dag bgyis pa/ sdig pa re re'i phyir yang / dper na 'dzam bu'i ragling gi sa'i 5rdul phra rab 4mtha' dag re re'i bskal par sems can dmyal bar mchi 'tshal la/ 'byung ba ni nges par mchis par gyur na/ des de'i tshe ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun 5du tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya la/ zas mi 6'tshal bar phyag rgya 'di bcings la / gsang sngags 'di yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ sngon gyi las kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'byang bar bgyid nus par 'gyur te / lhag ma lus pa ni gnas ma lags shing skabs ma mchis so/ /yang 'greng 8ste lag pa g.yon pas rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong chang par bcug la/ lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i lag mthil nas bzung ste/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i dbang dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i phyag rgya ste/ nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o/ /dpag tshad stong gi phyogs su mchi 'tshal na yang dka' ba ma mchis so/ /gsang sngags ni dben par mchis la bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /yang lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung gi sen mo mnan la/ g.yas pa yang de bzhin du 9bgyis te/ sor mo lhag ma gsum gsum mchis pa brkyang la/ lag mthil du bkug ste/ spyi bor bzhag la rtsa ba'i gsang sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems 903—243

dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / dbang gi phyag rgya ste/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ /'gro ba la dbang ba 'thob bo/ /yang thal mo reg par sbyar te/ thal mo'i nang khog 1stong du bgyis la mdzub mo gnyis kyis g.yab (gebo/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal po'i snying po las spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya ste/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni ca'adi lags te/ o ā ro li ka tre+e lokya bi dza ya/ sarba sha hūm̐ pra ma tha na sa ra ya su waṃ phaṭa sta swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang / mig stong dang ldan pa'i cho ga zhib ces rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/177 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ ༷ge〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 95)〈〈snar 〉〉spyangs/178 1〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gcig na〈〈snar 〉〉 la/ ri 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kyi/ (4)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gcig (55〈〈zhol 〉〉/pa /179 15〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 dang / na〈〈snar 〉〉gcig ra〈〈zhol 〉〉 mtsho dang / ④〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ /5)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 chen/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sgyu/ 75〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 85〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉sus/18༷ 1〈〈khu 〉〉'gyur/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉ci'i/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ 4〈〈zhol 〉〉gyi/181 1〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kyis/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ da 〈〈zhol 〉〉kyi/ 555〈〈zhol 〉〉sdog182 1〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉nas/ 5〈〈zhol 〉〉zungs/ ci 〈〈zhol 〉〉gcig (0〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 555〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 pa/ 6〈〈khu 〉〉bgye/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉bcur/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉mthar/ 95〈〈khu 〉〉slad/ 0〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉to/11〈〈khu1 〉〉slad/183 1〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉brdzus/ na 〈〈zhol 〉〉bzung / 〈〈snar 〉〉ma dang / 4〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 chenapo/184 1〈〈zhol 〉〉stong / 2〈〈zhol 〉〉dwags/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 par/ 4〈〈khu 〉〉bgyi ba/ 55〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 gi/6〈〈zhol 〉〉 kyi/ 7〈〈khu 〉〉ji/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉skyong / 9〈〈zhol 〉〉zhig185 1〈〈zhol 〉〉bsam/ 2〈〈zhol 〉〉pa/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉 kyi/ 4ni〈〈snar 〉〉yod/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bsam/93wa 244

1 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 gyi dkyil 'khor/192 (1)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gzungs/ (ge〈〈zhol 〉〉kyi/ (mi〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ (0〈〈zhol 〉〉lta/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉ste/56)〈〈zhol 〉〉deng / 97)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bya'o/193 grangs med pa dang / thabs cig 1tu bzhugs pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' kun 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman mngon par 'phags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' pad+ma'i bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i (gesnying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rgyal po 4chen por 5dbang bskur ba thob pa 6sha stag dang thabs cig 7go/ /gzhan yang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa'i sa bcu /spyad pa tshad med 'grangs med pa khodag dang thabs cig thuste / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po ni gtso bor gyur to/ /gzhan yang (1nyatshangs ris kyi lha tshad med pa snyed dang thabs cig 1 ste/ lha'i bu k+ṣaṇ+ḍa sa ma ra skani gtso bor gyur to/ /gzhan yang lha dang lha'i bu tshad med pa snyed dang thabs cig teste / lha'i bu rku 1 bha ka ni gtso bor gyur to/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha'i rgyal po tshad med pa snyed dang thabs cig 18ste/lha'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung 19ni gtso bor gyur to/ /gzhan yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding 93—252

dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa tshad med pa snyed dang thabs cig tsho1 ste/ klu'i rgyal po chen po ri'i dpal ni gtso bor gyur to9mi/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i bu mo tshad med pa snyed dang thabs cig (4 ste/ lha'i bu mo gzhon nu'i mig ces bya ba ni gtso mor 5gyur to/ /gzhan yang nam mkha'i lha dang / chu bo dang / rgya mtsho'i 565lha dang /chu mig gi lha dang / chu klung gi lha dang 7/ sman gyi lha dang / ljon shing gi lha dang / nags tshal gyi lha dang / khang khyim gyi lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / rlung 48)gi lha dang / sa'i lha dang / ri'i lha dang / gzhal med khang la sogs pa'i lha tshad med pa snyed kyang so so nas 'dus shing lhags 59par gyur to//de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor mang po'i nang du gsang ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'od zer bkye bas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang gser gyi kha dog can du gyur to/ /lha'i gzhal med khang rnams dang / klu'i khang khyim rnams dang / lha'i gtso bo rnams kyi gzhal med khang rnams kyang rab tu g.yos par gyur/ chu bo dang / mtsho dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang 1 / ri khor 11yug dang / ri rab lhun po dang / sa'i ri dang / ri nag po rnams kyang rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / nor bu dang /me dang / rgyu skar dang / gza'i 'od rnams kyang zil gyis mnan te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun 'dzin gyi 12rgyal pos ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ma de dag mthong ba dang / sngon chad nam yang de lta bu ma byung ngo zhes ngo 1lhamatshar du gyur nas/ stan las langs te thal mo sbyar 903—253

nas 'di skad (11ces bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi mtshan ma 'di lta bu 'di dag sus bkye lags zhes gsol nas/ tshigs su bcad de zhu ba zhus pa/ deng (geni su zhig mngon par sangs rgyas na/ /'di ltar 'od zer chen po rab bkye bas/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gser gyi mdog tu gyur/ /stong chen 'jig rten khams kyang de bzhin lags/ /deng ni su zhig rang dbang thob gyur na/ /ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul chen po mthu bkye nas/ /mtha' med sangs rgyas zhing rnams rab g.yos shing / /lha klu gzhal med khang rnams mi bder gyur/ /su yi mthu lags rgyu rkyen ma rtogs pas/ /'khor mang 'di dag the tshom 'tshal gyur na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 4thugs rje chen po yis/ /rdzu 'phrul 'di yi rgyu rkyen bkas bshad gsol / /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun 'dzin gyi rgyal po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyed kyis 'di rig par bya ste/ deng 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dus pa 'dir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras mugazigs dbang phyug ces bya ba zhig yod pa de/ sngon bskal pa tshad med pa nas byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po phun sum tshogs par gyur pa/gzungs kyi sgo tshad med pa snyed shin tu bsgoms shing mngon par bsgrubs par gyur pas/ sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde bar 'dod pa'i phyir gsang ste 'di lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu chen po bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te gos tshags bcos nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te 6bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs rje chen po'i sems zhes 7bgyi ba'i 943—254

gzungs sngags mchis te/ sems can mang po rnams la sman pa dang bde ba 'thob par bgyi 1ba dang / bro nad thams cad bsal 2bar bgyi ba dang / tshe ring bar 'gyur ba dang / phyug cing 'byor pa dang ldan par bgyi ba dang /sdig pa mi dge ba'i las dang kha na ma tho ba lci ba rnams yongs su sbyang zhing bsal 3ba dang / sgrib pa'i bgegs rnams dang 'bral ba dang / chos dkar po'i yon tan thams cad 'phel bar bgyi ba dang / dge ba'i sa bon thams cad phun sum tshogs par bgyi ba dang / 'jigs shing skrag lapa thams cad yongs su spang bar bgyi ba dang / re ba thams cad myur du yongs su 5rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du deng bshad par 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse bar dgongs te gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu khyod snying rje chen pos sems can rnams la phan pa dang / bde ba ( 'dod pa'i phyir rig sngags bshad par 'dod pas deng dus la bab kyis 7myur du smros shig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nga nadang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang rjes su thugs dgyes par mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mngon par dran lags te/ sngon byung ba'i bskal pa 'bum phrag tshad ma mchis pa snyed 'das pa de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od stong gi rgyal po zhi bar gnas pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das des bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du thogs pa ma mchis pa'i thugs rje chen po rgya cher 9yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs lha 'di bka' stsal nas/ phyag gser 943—255

bdag ni chu 1tshan phrad gyur na/ /chu tshan me mur rang zhi shog /sems can dmyal bar bdag song na/ /sems can dmyal ba rang skams nashog /bdag ni yi dgas dganas song na/ /bkres skom cadag ni 'grangs 5par shog /bdag ni lha min gnas song na/ /ngan sems rang ni dul bar shog /bdag ni dud 'gro'i gnas phyin na/ /rang nyid shes rab che thob shog /de skad du smon lam btab nas sems rtse gcig tu bdag gi ming nas 'don cing rjes su dran par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang bdag gi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med rjes su dran par bgyis nas/ de'i rjes la gzungs sngags 'di mtshan gcig la lan bdun tshang bar 0'don par bgyid na/ bskal pa 'bum phrag brgyad stong snyed du 'khor bar 'gyur ba'i kha na ma tho ba'i lci ba rnams yongs su bsal zhing 7'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha'am/ mi gang la la zhig thugs rje chen po'i tshig na'adon cing 'dzin par bgyid na 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams der gshegs nas phyag brkyang 9bar 'gyur bas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing 10gang dang gang 11du skye bar 'tshal ba ji ltar smon pa bzhin du de dag tu skye bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang la la zhig thugs rje chen po'i rig sngags 'di 1 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa dag gal te ngan 'gro gsum po dag tu ltung bar gyur na/ bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i rig / sngags 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa dag gal te sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su skye bar 1 ma gyur na bdag nam yang 93—258

mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i rig sngags 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa dag gal te ting nge 'dzin dang spobs pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed thob par ma gyur na bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o1ri/ /thugs rje chen po'i rig sngags 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa dag gal te tshe 'di nyid la smon pa thams cad ji ltar smon pa bzhin du grub par ma gyur na snying rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs zhes (dmi bgyi lags te/ mi dge ba (5)rnams dang / sems cartse gcig 5tu ma 6bgyis pa ni ma gtogs lags 57 so/ /bud med gang la la zhig bud med kyi lus kyis 8yongs su skyo nas skyes pa'i lus thob par 'tshal ba gang lags pa des thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs kyi tshig 'di 'don cing yongs su bzung 9ribs gal te bud med kyi dngos po las yongs su gyur te/ skyes pa'i lus thob par ma gyur na bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o/ /the tshom gyi bsam pa cung zad cig bskyed 7par gyur na gdon mi 'tshal bar gang smon pa'i 'bras bu de mngon par 'grub par mi 'gyur lags so/ /sems can gang la la zhig dge 'dun gyi zhal zas dang dkor 'phrog cing chud gson pa gang lags pa de dag ni sangs rgyas stong 'jig rten du byung ba dag la (sprugyod pas mthol 11zhing bshags na'ang 1 'byang zhing tshangs par mi 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang thugs rje chen po'i rig nyanasngags 'di bton pa tsam gyis de dag yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ba lags te/dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal zas dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor nor 'phrog cing chud gson pa de dag ni phyogs bcu'i ston pa rnams mngon sum 1 du 15gyur pa'i spyan sngar bshags na gdod yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur lags la10/903—259

thugs rje chen po'i gzungs 'di 'don pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i ston pa rnams der gshegs nas dbang mdzad par 'gyur bas kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa de dag thams cad kyang yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/ mi dge ba bcu 'byedang / mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang / gang zag (rnal skur pa btab pa dang / chos la skur ①pa btab pa dang / gso sbyong bshigs (depa dang / tshul khrims bshigs 6)pa dang / mchod rten bshigs 7pa dang / gtsug lag khang bshigs (8)pa thams cad dang / dge 'dun gyi dkor brkus pa dang / yongs su dag pa'i tshangs par spyod pa sun par bgyis pa 'di lta bu la sogs pa sdig pa'i las lci ba 6)thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /rig sngags 'di la the tshom 'tshal ba'i dngos po gcig ni 1 ma gtogs te/ the tshom 'tshal bar gyur na tha na kha na ma tho ba chung 11bu'i las 12yang ba tsam yang yongs su 'byang bar mi 'gyur na kha na ma tho ba lci ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ kha na ma tho ba lci ba dag yongs su 'byang bar mi 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang byang chub kyi ring ba'i rgyu ni bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha dang mi gang la la zhig thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi tu rig sngags 'di 'don cing 'dzin pa de dag ni dge ba'i skye ba rnam pa bcwa bolnga 'thob thapar 'gyur zhing gshis ngan du 'chi ba rnam tshepa bcwa /ci lnga len par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gshis ngan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba de nyu riyang 'di lta ste/ gang zag de bkres pas nyon mongs te 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / mtshon cha 1gedang lcag dbyug gis 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / 'khon rimachis pa'i dgra'i sug par 'chi na bar mi 'gyur ba dang / g.yul ngor 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / stag 93—260

dang spyang ki dang gcan gzan (1)ma rungs pa'i khar 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang /sbrul gdug (2)pa dang / rtsangs po pa dang / sdig pa'i khar 'chi bar mi 'gyur 4ba dang / chab dang zhugs kyi nang du 'bying zhing tshig stegaci/ 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / dug gis 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / byad stems kyis 6'chi ba'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / smyos nas dran pa nyams 7te 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ri dang / ljon shing dang / ngam grog dang / g.yang sa nas ltung ste (8da'achi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / mi ma rungs pa'i byad kyis 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba dang / log pa'i 'dre gdon ma rungs pas glags /rnyed de 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / nad 1 ngan pas lus la dkris te 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / cha ma lags pas bdag nyid la gnod pa bgyis 37te 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dag lags te/ thugs rje chen po'i rig 9/)sngags 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa de dag ni gshis ngan du 1lha'achi ba rnam pa bcwa 1 lnga po 'di dag gis 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /dge ba'i 15skye ba rnam pa bcwa tshalnga po thob par 'gyur ba 'di lta ste/ skye ba thams cad du 1 rgyal po dge ba dang mjal 1 bar 'gyur ba dang / rtag par yul dge bar skye bar 'gyur ba dang / rtag par dus bzang po dang mjal 19bar 'gyur ba dang / rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal bar 'gyur ba dang / rtag par lus kyi dbang po tshang bar 'gyur ba dang / lam gyi sems la goms par 'gyur ba dang / sdom pa'i tshul khrims nyams par mi bgyid pa dang / 'khor rnams drin gyis 'dris 1zhing 'dum par 'gyur ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams rtag par 'byor cing ldan par 'gyur 943—261

ba dang / rtag par gzhan gyis 1bkur zhing rim gro bgyid par 'gyur ba dang /yo byad bdog pa rnams gzhan gyis 'phrog par mi 'gyur ba dang / yid la smon pa rnams bsam 2pa bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / lha dang klu (5)dge ba rnams kyis rtag tu srung zhing yongs su skyob par 'gyur ba dang / skye ba thams cad cadu sangs rgyas mthong zhing chos thos 5par 'gyur ba dang / yang dag pa'i chos thos nas don zab mo rtogs 6par 'gyur ba dag lags te/ lha'am mi gang la la zhig thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi 7 gzungs 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa gang lags pa de dag ni dge ba'i skye ba rnam pa bcwa 8lnga po 'di dag thob par bgyid par 9'gyur bas lha dang mi thams cad kyis rtag par bton nas yongs su gzung 1 bar bgyi ste le lo bskyed par mi bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis de skad ces smras nas 'khor 'dus pa'i mdun du thal mo sbyar te drang por 'dug nas sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed de11/ 'dzum 12pa'i mdangs kyis thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi tshig gya rnam pa 'di dag smras so/ /na mo rata 1 na 1 tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 'ab lo ki te 4shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya 1 ma hā sa tā ya/ 1 ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya / tar+ya thā/ a sarba ban dha na ts+tsha 19da na ka rā ya/ sarba pā 2 pa 21sa mu dro ts+tsha ṣa ṇa 2 ka rā ya/ sarba byā ge dhi pra sha ma na ka rā ya/ sarba i 2 kyu 25pa dra ba na bi nā sha na ka rā ya/ sarba bha ye ṣā tā ra na ṇa ka rā ya/ ta su/ na ma skṛ tā 1yi rda ār+sā ba lo ki te rishā rā ya/ ta ba nī la kuṇ+ḍa ri nā rim pa ra ma hro ridzid ya mā pasto ri yi byā 9mi/ sanārba 0sā dha rna 1/ shu bha tse ta rna / sarba bhū tā dadzā/903—262

pā pa nyu)mārga bi sho dha rka /tar+ya thā/ ā lo ke2 /a dhi pa ti/ lo ka a ti grwan te/ e h+ye hi ri/ ma hā bo dhi sa twa kyi/ he 5)bo dhi sa twa / he ma hā bo dhi sa twa(7)/ te pri ya bo dhi sa tan/ he ma hā 9ka 1 ru ṇi ka ma hā 11sma ra hre 12da yan / e h+ye / nyi/nga ār+sā ba 415lo ki 7te shwa rā 1 ya/ pa ra ma mi tri tsit+ta 12kā ru ṇi 39ka ku ru ku ru/ kurma 2 sā dha 21ya sā dha yan / bit+yā rnalhan de hi de hi/ me 2 a raṃ ga me 25ga ma bi haṃ ga 27ma/ sid+dha 2 yo gī /shwa ra du hu du hu bīr+yan te ma hā bīr+yan te/na dha ra dha ra/ dha rerje shwa ra ’/ tsa la tsa la bi ma la mūrte na.ār+sā nab lo ki 4te shwa ra/ dzi na kṛt+ta gidza ṭā 7/ mu ku ṭa / a lo /kṛ 9ta sha rī ra/lo ba pra lo ba bi lam̐ ba/ ma hā sid+dha bit+yā dha ra/ ba la ba la ma hā ba la/ ma la ma la 81ma hā ma la/ tsa la tsa la ma hā tsa la/ kṛt+ta bar+ṇa kṛt+ta dpak+ṣa / kṛt+ta 5pāsha / nir+gha ta phan/ he pad+ma hasta/ tsa ra tsa ra ni: re shwa re 7/ kṛt+ta nasarba 9kṛ 5 ta ya rto pa bī ta/ e h+ye hi ma hā bā 51rā ha mu kha tri pu ra da ga ha ne shwa gi ra/nā rā ya ṇa ba la rū ba be ṣa 5 dha ra55/ he nī la kuṇ+ḍa/ e h+ye hi/ ma hā ha la ha la sku'abi ṣa ni rdzi ri ta/ lo ka su/ rā gi ga bi ṣa bi nā sha rnag9/ de ṣa bi ṣa bi nā sha rnasnyo / mo ha bi 61ga bi nā 42sha rna/ nirmo k+ṣa 6 ṇa 6 hu lu hu lu/ muñtsa muñtsa/mu hu mu hu/rna rā hu la zhirā hu la0 / ha la ha zhi lā r+shahā 71re ma hā pad+ma nā bhi na/sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ budh+ya budh+ya na/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bho ridha yā memi ta ba /nī la kuṇ+ḍa/ e h+ye hi nī la kuṇ+ḍa / e h+ye hi bā ma sbi ta ma hā 7 si (ha mu kha/ ha sa ha sa/ muñtsa muñtsa ma hā:sna 8 hā 81su/ e h+ye hi bho bho ma hā sid+dha 82yo gī shwa ra bha ṇa bha ṇa/ bā tsa sā dha ya sā dha yan / bi ṭ+wāṃ 8 sma ra sma ra ྅ lha / he 80bha 8 ga ban tā na lo ka bi lo ka 89྅9 / ta thā ga 91tā rtenarmā/ da dā /nyi 93—263

me 1 dar+sha na kā ma su nanodar+sha ṭ+wāṃ/ pra sā dha ya me (risaswā hā/ sid+dhā (g.ya (geswā hā/ ma hā sid+dhā ya swā hā/6ni sid+dha yo gī 7rishā 85rā 59)ya swā hā/ nī la kuṇ+ḍa (7ya swā hā/ bā yo tsherā ha mu khā ya swā hā/ ma hā bā 15rā ha 1 mu khā ya swā hā/ na ra si yiha mu khā ya swā hā/ma hā na ra si tshoha mu khā ya swā hā/ badz+ra hastu geya swā hā/ ma hā badz+ra hastu ya swā hā/sid+dha 1 bit+yā dha rā ya swā hā/ ma hā sid+dha nyushebibyā 17snya rā ya swā hā/ pad+ma hastu zhu )ya swā hā / ma hā pad+ma hastu 1ya swā hā/ kṛt+ta 2nasarba kṛ du geta ya rnyo pa bī ri tā ya swā hā/ma hā mā la mu 25ku ṭa dha rā ya swā hā/ tsakrā yu dha dha 2nerā ya swā hā/ shaṃ kha shab nirje da na ka rā 2 ya swā hā/ bo dha na ka rā ya swā hā she/ bā tsho 9ma skan+dha zhu )de shasbi ta kriṣ+ṭha na1 dzi nā 2ya swā hā/ bā ma hasta ra byu gh+ra tsarma ri rini bā sa nā ya swā hā/ lo ke (geshwa rā 7ya swā hā/ ma hā lo ke shwa rā da ya swā hā/ sarba sing dhe shwa rā ya swā hā/rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ swā hā/ ku ru rak+ṣa mu dā ṇ+ḍaṃ 1swā hā/ na mo bha ga ba te/ ār+sā 82ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ji ya/ ma hā satā ya ri / ma hā kā ru ṇi sri'i 5ya/sidh+yan+tu me man+t+ra pa /dā ri9ni swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rig sngags 'di smras ma thag tu ni sa chen po yang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos par gyur/ lha rnams kyis kyang rin po che'i me tog gi char mngon par phab par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rjes su thugs dgyes par gyur/ lha'i bu'i bdud dang mu stegs can rnams ni 'jigs shing dngangs 51nas spu zing zhes byed par gyur/ 'khor 'dus pa mang po thams cad las kha cig gis 52ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur5 / kha cig gis ni lan cig 5 phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur / kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur/ kha cig gis 93—264

ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur/ kha cig gis ni sa dang po dang sa gnyis pa dang sa gsum pa dang sa bzhi 1pa dang sa lnga pa thob par gyur nas/ sa bcu pa'i bar du thob par gyur/ sems can tshad med pa snyed ni byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po stan las langs te gos tshags bcos nas gus par thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye skyes bu chen po legs so/ /bdag gis sngon 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa'i na'adus pa tshad med pa snyed dag tu chos rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gzungs rnam pa sna tshogs thos par gyur mod kyi/ sngon chad nam yang thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs chen mo'i rig sngags kyi tshig gya rnam pa 'di lta bu thos par ma gyur na/ skyes bu chen po khyod kyis bdag la gzungs 'di'i dbyings kyi mtshan nyid rgya cher bshad du gsol/ bdag cag 'khor mang po rnams shin tu thos par mos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis natshangs pa chen po la smras pa/ lha'i rgyal po khyod thabs mkhas pas sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i phyir de skad du dris pa yin pas/deng 4khyod legs par nyon cig dang bdag gis khyod la mdo tsam zhig bshad par bya'o / /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ de ni snying rje chen po'i sems yin/ mnyam pa'i sems yin/ 'dus ma byas kyi sems yin/ mngon par zhen pa med pa'i sems yin/ stong pa nyid du lta ba'i sems yin/ gus pa'i sems yin/ dam pa'i sems yin/ 'dres pa med pa'i sems yin/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin te/ de lta bu'i 93—265

sems gang yin pa de dag ni gzungs kyi mtshan nyid yin par rig par bya ste/khyod kyis 'di kho na bzhin du mngon par bsgrub par bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen pos smras pa/ bdag cag 'khor mang po rnams ni deng 1gdod gzungs 'di'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa khong du chud par gyur pas deng phyin cad (5yongs su bzung nas brjed 4par bgyid pa'i thugs mi thub bo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig rig sngags 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa gang yin pa des byang chub kyi sems rgya chen po bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar yi dam 5yang dag par blang bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid gso sbyong dang tshul khrims la gnas nas sems can rnams la mnyam pa'i sems bskyed de/rtag par rig sngags 'di rgyun chad pa med par gdon par bya'o/ /gnas khang gtsang ma'i nang du 'dug ste/ yongs su dag par khrus byas nas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ ba dan dpyangs nemar me sbar te/ spos dang / me tog dang /zhal zas kyi mchod pa byas nas sems rtse gcig tu gtad de/ dmigs pa tha dad pa gzhan la mi dmigs par chos bzhin du 'don cing yongs su 'dzin par byed na/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od lha dang / drang srong tshad med pa snyed dag der lhags nas dbang byed cing mngon rtags kyang ston par gyur la/ bdag kyang de'i tshe mig stong gis de la lta bar byed/ lag pa stong gis ni de la yongs/ su srung 8zhing byin gyis rlob 9par byed pas 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag ji snyed pa de dag kyang yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur/ mu stegs can gyi chos 1 kyi cho ga dang / smrang 11ji snyed pa thams 93—266

cad kyang rtogs shing khong du chud par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin par byed pa gang yin pa des ni 'jig rten na gdon dang 1nad 2rnam pa brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa snedag gsos nas 'tsho 4bar byed do/ /'dre srin thams cad la dbang byed cing lha'i bu'i bdud rnams kyang 'dul bar byed/mu stegs can rnams kyang tshar gcod par byed do/ /gal te ri'am dgon pa na gnas te mdo sde kha ton du 'don pa dang bsam gtan sgom 5pa dang ( ri'i lha dang 'dre srin gnod pa byed pa dag nan 7gyis kyal 8ka byas nas sems mnyam par gzhag tu mi rung bar 9gyur na/ rig sngags 'di lan cig 1 bzlas pa byas na 'dre srin de dag thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te chos bzhin du bzlas brjod 11byas te/ sems can rnams la snying brtse 12ba'i sems bskyed par gyur na bdag kyang de'i tshe dge ba'i lha dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang /lag na rdo rje gsang ba pa rnams la rtag 1 par de'i rjes su 'brang zhing yongs su srung khub gyis shig /de'i nye 'khor na gnas nas mig gi 15'bras bu bzhin du yongs su srungs 7shig /rang gi srog gi dbang po bzhin du yongs su skyobs shig ces bsgo bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag la bsgo bar byed pa bstan 1 pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdag gis gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sme brtsegs lcags kyu can/ /stobs ldan shang ka ra dang sde brgyad dag /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis dbang phyug dang ni mthu chen dang / /ku be ra dang ser skya'i bdag po dag /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis nor srung 1 dang ni chu lha dang / /dge rgyas dang ni pa ri tsi tra dag /btang nas rtag tu nyi 2—267

gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis sa sar hunyetsa dang ma hā ra/ /ku lan+tan+ta dang ni lngas rtsen 2dag /btang nas rtag tu gzungs (5)'dzin srung bar byed / /bdag gis pi pa ka la'i 4rgyal po dang / /dpal ldan pyi tshogeta dang ni swar ha nerā/ /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis tshangs pa dang ni sam ba 7ra/ /gnas gtsang sde lnga dag dang mtshe (8rim dag /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis brgya byin sum cu 59nirtsa gsum lha/ /spobs chen dpal ldan dang ni sa ta na/ /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis rgyal po yul 'khor srung dang ni/ /ma mo lha la sogs pa mthu chen 'khor/ /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang ni/ /mig mi bzang dang rnam thos bu dag kyang / /btang nas rtag tu gzungs nyu ci'adzin sung bar byed/ /bdag gis gser mdog rma bya'i rgyal po dang / /sde dpon nyi shu brgyad dang drang srong 'khor/ /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis nor bu bzang po dag dang ni/ /sde dpon chen po sa 'dzin pu la pa/ /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis dga' bo nyenadang ni bsnyen dga' bo/ /klu rgyal rgya mtsho dang ni e la'i 'dab/ /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis lha ma yin dang dri za dang / /mkha' 15lding mi'am ci dang lto 'phye rnams1 / /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /bdag gis chu dang me dang glog 7gi lha/ /grul bum bdag po dang ni sha za dag /btang nas rtag tu gzungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /dge ba'i lha de dag dang klu'i rgyal po dang ma mo la sogs pa de dag kyang so so nas 93wa 268

'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa dang / mthu chen po dang ldan pa'i gnod sbyin dag gis kyang rtag par thugs rje chen po'i rig sngags 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa de la hu)yongs su bsrung 95)zhing skyob par byed pas/ gang zag de ri dang dgon pa na gcig pu nyal bar gyur dasan yang dge ba'i lha de dag res kyi lamatshan mos de la bsrungs nas bgegs dang bar chad yongs su sel bar byed do/ /gal te gcong 5rong dag tu gnas te 6rilam stor bar gyur pa tsho las rig sngags 'di bzlas par gyur na de'i dbang gis dge ba'i lha dang / klu'i rgyal po dag dge ba'i mi'i gzugs su mngon par sprul nas lam yang dag pa nyid ston par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ri dang nags tshal dang dgon pa dag tu gnas pa las chu dang me dag gis phongs rinasapar 95gyur na yang klu'i rgyal po dag gis yongs su bsrung skyaba'i phyir chu dang me dag 11mngon par sprul par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan yang gzungs 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa dag gi ched du gnod pa dang bgegs yongs su bsal 12ba'i phyir shin tu bsil ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang zhig ri dang 'brog dgon nya song ba las/ /stag dang spyang ki gcan gzan 1 gtum po dang / /rtsangs pa sprul dang 'dre srin phrad gyur kyang / /gzungs 'di 'don pa thos na snyiganod mi nus/ /gang zhig chu bo rgya mtshor zhugs pa las/ /gdug pa'i klu dang chu srin ma rungs dang / /gnod sbyin srin po nya dang ru 7sbal dag /gzungs 'di thos na 1 so sor 'byer 18bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig g.yul sprod 19dgra yis bskor ba'am/ /chom rkun ma rungs nor ni 'phrog 2 tshopa'i tshe/ /rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas na/ /de dag brtse sems bskyed nas ldog par 93—269

'gyur / /gang zhig rgyal po'i gyod la 1)thogs pa dang / /lcags sgrog khong sgril btson 2rar chud pa'i tshe/ /rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas na/ /rgyal pos brtse sems kyis ni gtong bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig byad ri skustems dug mda'i khyim zhugs te/ /zas skom ladug can gyis ni gsod (5)pa'i ma rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas na/ /dug nyid zil dngar zas skom nyid du 'gyur/ /bud med sbrum ma bu ni btsa' ba'i tshe/ /bdud kyis bgegs byas sdug bsngal mi bzod tshe/ /rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i tsho gzungs bzlas na / /'dre gdon byer 7nas bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur/ /klu 8)gdon gtum pos gdug pa'i dbugs btang bas/ /tsha ba'i nad kyis nyen nas 'chir nye tshe/ /rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas na59ri/ /rims nad bsal nas 3 )tshe ni ring bar 'gyur/ /klu gdon rgyu bas gtses te spangs pa dang / /shu 'bras mi bzad rnag khrag 'dzag pa'i tshe/ /rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas nas / /mchil ma lan gsum byugs 11pas spangs pa zhi/ /sems can rtog 32pas mi dbe bskyed pas na/ /byad stems sngags dang dgras ni gtses 12pa'i tshe /rtse gcig 1 thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas na/ /stems gnod de kun gtong ba'i mi 15la 'du/ /sdig 'phel snyigs mas dam chos 'jig pa na/ /'dod pa'i me lochen sems ni rmongs log pas/ / khyo shug 1 so sor gzhan la 'dod zhen nas / /nyin mtshan log bsam rgyun ni mi 'chad tshe/ /gang zhig thugs rje chen po'i gzungs bzlas na/ /'dod pa'i me zhi 12log pa'i sems bsal 'gyur/ /bdag gis gzungs 'di'i 19mthu stobs rgyas rna brjod na/ /bskal par brjod kyang mthar thug yong mi 'gyur/ /rig sngags 'di lan lnga bzlas te tshon sna 903—270

lnga'i skud pa la mdud pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi mdud nas mgul du gdags par bya'o/ /gzungs 'di ni 1'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i naklung gi 3bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis rnal 'byor pa gang dag pha rol tu laphyin pa drug mngon par bsgrub 5pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa dag 6yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub tu sems ma bskyed 7pa dag myur du byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya ba'i phyir dang / nyan thos kyi gang zag gang dag 'bras bu mngon du ma byas pa de dag myur du mngon du bya ba'i phyir stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na drang srong gang dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems ma bskyed napa dag myur du sems bskyed par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can gang dag theg pa chen po 'di la dad pa'i dbang po ma thob 9pa dag gzungs 'di'i byin gyi rlabs kyi 1 mthus theg pa chen po'i sa bon dang chos kyi myu gu 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa yin pas bdag gis 11thabs mkhas pa dang / byams pa dang snying rje'i mthus de dag gis ci dang ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byor bar byed do/ /gzhan yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na mun pa mun nag gi 1 gnas su ngan 'gro gsum po'i sems can ji snyed gnas pa dag bdag gi 1 rig sngags 'di thos par gyur na thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sa dang po ma thob pa dag ni myur du thob par 'gyur la/ sa bcu pa'i bar du yang ma thob pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du'ang 1 phyin par byed pa'i phyir mtshan sum cu 15rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cu 7yang rang gi ngang gis thob 17par 'gyur ro/ /gal te nyan thos kyi 903—271

gang zag gang dag gzungs 'di rna bar lan cig 1)thos par gyur tam/gzungs 'di spyod cing yi ger bris sam/ drang 5po'i sems kyis chochos bzhin du gnas par byed na/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi po dag ma btsal bar rang gi ngang gis thob par 'gyur ro/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na ri dang / chu klung dang / brag dang / rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu ji snyed pa dag kyang g.yo zhing khol cabar nus so/ /ri rab lhun po nas ri khor yug gi bar dag kyang g.yo zhing rdul phran bzhin du 'jig par nus so/ /de na gnas pa'i sems can ji snyed pa 5dag kyang 6thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par nus so/ /sems can gang dag tshe 'di nyid la smon pa rnams mngon par 'grub par 'dod na zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi 7bar du gso sbyong dang /tshul khrims la gnas nas gzungs 'di bzlas brjod byas na nagadon mi za bar smon pa rnams kyang mngon par 'grub par 'gyur/ 'khor ba'i mtha' nas 'khor ba'i mthar thug pa'i bar du'ang /sdig pa'i las thams cad ma lus par 1 yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i nang dang phyi rol na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed cig bzhugs pa rnams dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha dang drang srong dang / klu'i rgyal po ji snyed gnas pa thams cad kyis kyang 11mkhyen cing shes par 'gyur ro/ /lha'am mi gang yang rung ste / gzungs 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa de dag chu klung ngam/ rgya mtshor zhugs te khrus byas pa las de na gnas pa'i sems can de dag ni 1 de dag gis lus bkrus 1 pa'i chus lus la reg par gyur na/ sdig pa'i las dang kha na 903—272

ma tho ba lci ba thams cad yongs su byang nas zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu pad+ma las rdzus 0)te skye bar 'gyur bas mngal dang / drod gsher dang / sgo nga las skye ba'i zhiralus len par mi 'gyur na len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kha ton du 'don pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gzungs 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa de dag lam du zhugs te 'gro ba'i tshe rlung chen po langs te/gang zag de'i lus dang / spu dang / skra dang / gos la bus pa'i rlung dgang yin pa de rdzi phyogs su song ba'i sems can gzhan gyi lus la reg par gyur na/de dag gi sgrib pa dang sdig pa'i las lci ba thams cad ma lus par yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur bas yang ngan 'gro gsum po dag gi rnam par smin pa myong bar mi 'gyur zhing rtag par sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar skye bar 'gyur bas na yongs su 'dzin pa de dag gis 4bsod nams dang 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bya'o/ /gzungs 'di bzlas brjod byed pa'i kha nas ji tsam du tshig tu 5brjod par byung ba dge yang 6rung mi dge yang rung ste/lha'i bu'i bdud dang / mu stegs can dang / lha dang / klu dang / 'dre srin thams cad kyis thos par gyur na de dag thams cad rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings nyid du 'gyur bas/ de la sangs rgyas ji lta ba bzhin du gus pa'i sems bskyed nas bkur sti 7dang / rim gro byed par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gter nyid du rig par bya sten/ sangs rgyas gang gā'i 9klung bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed rnams kyis phangs 1 shing gces par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni 'od can gyi 11lus kyi gter yin par rig par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 1 9(3—27 3

thams cad kyi 'od zer gyis snang bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni byams pa dang / snying rje'i gter yin par rig par bya ste/ 'di ltar gzungs kyis 1sems can yongs su skyob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni dam pa'i chos kyi sde snod yin par rig par bya ste/ gzungs kyi sgo thams cad kun sdud napar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sde snod yin par rig par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong rnams rtag par mngon sum du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni nam mkha'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ rtag par stong pa nyid kyi shes rab kyis sems can la blta 4ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni 'jigs pa med pa'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ lha dang klu dang dge ba'i lha rnams rtag par yongs su bsrung ciraba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni dam pa'i tshig gi mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ kha nas gzungs kyi sgra 'byung ba la rgyun chad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni rtag par gnas pa'i gter yin par rig par bya ste/ 'jigs tshopa gsum gyi bskal pa dag gis gzhig par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni rnam par grol ba'i mdzod yin par rig par bya ste/ lha'i bu'i bdud dang mu stegs can rnams 7kyis bshol bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni sman gyi rgyal po'i mdzod yin par rig par bya 8ste/ rtag par gzungs kyis sems can nad pa rnams kyi nad gso ba'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de ni rdzu 'phrul gyi gter yin par rig par bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su rgyu ba la rang dbang thob pa'i phyir ro / /de bas na gang zag de'i yon tan gyi bsngags pa brjod na nams kyang 9mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig 'jig rten pa'i sdug 903—274

bsngal gyis yongs su skyo nas tshe ring ba'i sman yongs su tshol bar 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su 'dug nas mtshams yongs su dag par bcad de/ gos la sngags kyis btab nas bgo 1bar bya'o/ /chu dang zas dang spos dang sman rnams la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste 2spyod par byed na gdon mi za bar tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te chos bzhin du mtshams bcad de chos bzhin du yongs su 'dzin par byed na thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'gyur te / de la mtshams bcad 4pa'i cho ga ni ral gri la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste55) / sa la ri mo bris nas nematshams gcad 7par bya'o/ /yang na chu gtsang ma 8la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas phyogs bzhir gtor nas mtshams gcad 59par bya'o/ /yang na yungs kur khol lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste nyu7phyogs bzhir gtor nas mtshams gcad 12par bya'o/ /yang na 'du shes kyis gang du phyin pa tshun chad mtshams su 'gyur ro/ /yang na thal ba gtsang ma lha la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 1 mtshams gcad 7par bya'o/ /yang na tshon sasna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 1 phyogs bzhir bskor nas mtshams gcad 1 par bya'o/ /de ltar chos bzhin du 'di yongs su 'dzin par gyur na rang gi ngang gis 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di'i 19ming thos pa tsam gyis kyang bskal pa tshad med pa snyed kyi 'khor ba'i kha na ma tho ba'i lci ba rnams yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur na/ 'don 2 pa dang 'dzin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rig sngags 'di 'don pa'i gang zag gang yin pa de dag ni sangs rgyas tshad med pa snyed la mchod cing rim gro byas nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bskyed pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /gang dag sems can 903—275
