sdug bsngal gyi bgegs la yongs su 'dren pa'i ched du chos bzhin du 'don pa gang yin pa de dag ni snying rje chen po dang ldan pa yin pas ring por mi thogs par mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar (3)'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /ci ②tsam du sems can snang ngo cog gi ched du bzlas brjod byas te/ de dag gi rna lam du grag (5)par byas nas byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bar byed na/ gang zag de dag yon tan tshad med dpag tu med pa dag 'thob (shepar 'gyur bas brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu sems dang lus gso sbyong dang tshul khrims la gnas nas sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi las kyi kha na ma tho ba rnams bshags nas bdag nyid kyis bskal pa tshad med pa nas byas pa'i sdig pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs mthol 95)bshags te/ kha nas gzungs 'di myur du bzlas brjod byas nas sgra rgyun chad pa (6)med par byas na(7)/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi po de dag tshe 'di nyid la thob 85par 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnon po shes rab dang ldan pa sgom pa'i thabs la mkhas pa zhig yin na ni sa bcu'i 'bras bu yang dka' ba med par 'gyur 9non/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams kyis ⑩rnam par smin pa phran tshegs yongs su gnyer ba tsam mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po dang smon lam gyi mthu shin tu zab pa'i phyir dang /lkugazungs 'di'i byin gyi rlabs /rteshin tu rgya che ba'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/yul gang dag na gnod pa byung bar gyur na/ de'i tshe yul de'i rgyal pos yang dag pa'i 1 chos kyis 7yul 'dzin cing / mi rnams bag yangs 7su bkod dotsha / /sems can stangs ’ las mi gcod cing / nyes pa byung ba rnams yongs su 93—276

bskyabs hunyenas nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus bskyed de/ thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs sngags 'di 'don par byed na/yul de'i gnod pa dang bgegs thams cad yongs su bsal (na bar 'gyur/'bru rnams legs shing mi mang po bde bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang phas kyi rgol ba'i dgra dag yang nas yang du 'ongs te gtses pas 'bangs mang po mi bde bar gyur tam blon po chen pos rku (5)bshams nas log par gyur tam/ rims nad byung bar gyur tam/ than chen byung bar gyur tam/ nyi zla rgyu ba nor bar gyur tam de lta bu la sogs pa'i gnod pa 'byung (47bar 'gyur gnon/ de'i tshe snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mig stong pa'i gzugs byas nas de'i phyogs su kha bstan te/spos dang / me tog dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rin po che'i bla re 6)rnam pa sna tshogs dang / ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas dang skom 97gyis sems rtse gcig tu mchod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rgyal po des nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du lus dang sems kyis (8 brtson 'grus bskyed de/ gzungs kyi tshig gya 9rnam pa 'di 'don par byed na/ pas kyi dgra rnams rang dul 1 bar gyur nas slar log ste so so nas tshul bzhin du yul skyong zhing yul yang 'dre bar gnas par byams pa'i sems kyis phan tshun gcig la gcig blta 11bar 'gyur12/ rgyal bu dang blon po rnams kyang sri zhu dang 12drang dkan spyod par 'gyur/ btsun mo dang slas ④rnams kyang rgyal po la sri zhu dang bsnyen tshabakur byed par 'gyur/ lha dang klu dang 'dre srin rnams kyang yul de srung zhing skyong bar 'gyur/ char chu dus bzhin du 'bab cing 'bru rnams legs pas mi mang po rnams kyang rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang khyim du nad chen ma rungs pa dang phrad par gyur sa93—277

tam / ltas ngan sna tshogs byung bar gyur tam/ 'dre srin 1)dang log pa'i bdud rnams kyis khyim dkrugs rinapar gyur tam/ mi ma rungs pa dag gis gleng ( niskur btab nas rku bshams te gnod pa byas par gyur tam/ khyim mi che chung rnams phyi nang mi 'dum par gyur na/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mig stong pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du dkyil 'khor byas nas sems rtse gcig 54)tu byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la byas nas gzungs sngags 'di lan stong tshang bar bzlas na/ gong du smos pa'i dngos po ngan pa de dag thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'di'i ming ci lags/ ji ltar yongs su gzung rabar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rig sngags 'di la ming rnam 6pa sna tshogs yod de/ rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /thogs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su skyob pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /tshe bsring 7ba'i gzungs ri zhes kyang bya'o/ /ngan 'gro yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs zhes kyang 9bya'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o10/ /sems kyi rjes su rang dbang du gyur pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya'o/ /sa gong ma rnams las myur du 'da' ba'i gzungs zhes kyang bya ste11 / de ltar yongs su gzung 1 bar bya'o1na/ /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di'i ming ci lags na/ 'di lta bu'i 93—278

gzungs bstan pa la mkhas par 'gyur 1lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di'i ming ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces kyang bya'o/ /don yod pa'i zhags pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'od stong pa'i mig can zhes kyang dbya ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di'i ming dang gzi byin dang mthu stobs ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/'das pa'i bskal pa tshad med pa'i snga rol nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas mtshan yang de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag pa'i chos kyi snang ba zhes bya bar gyur pa yin yang thugs rje chen po dang smon lam gyi mthus sems can bde bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i lus mngon du bstan pa yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor mang po khyed cadang tshangs pa dang /brgya byin dang / lha dang / klu rnams kyis gus pas bkur 5snyi byas nas brnyas par mi bya'o/ /lha dang mi thams cad kyis rtag par mchod par byas te/sems rtse gcig tu ming nas rjod 6par byed na bsod nams tshad med pa snyed 7'thob par 'gyur/ kha na ma tho ba tshad med pa snyed yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/tshe 'das nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gal te rin po che sna tshogs phun sum tshogs shing phyug por 'gyur bar 'dod na yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i lag la mchod pa 8bya'o/ /mi bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gtses par gyur na/ zhags pa thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ / khong par 9nad rnams yod par gyur na/ rin po che'i lhung bzed thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /'dre gdon thams cad gdul bar 'dod na rin po che'i ral gri thogs pa'i lag 93—279

la mchod do/ /lha'i bu'i bdud thams cad 'dul zhi)bar 'dod na rdo rje thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /pas kyi rgya rgol ba'i dgra gzhom par 'dod na rdo rje tho ba thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i gnas thams cad las thar bar 'dod na 'jigs pa med pa sbyin pa'i lag la mchod do/ /mig mi gsal te 'od dang mi ldan par gyur na me shel gyi nor bu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tsha ba'i rims kyis ༷ nithebs te bsil bar 'dod na chu shel gyi nor bu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /blo ri4༄thabs mthon por (de'adod na rin po che'i gzhu 6thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /grogs po mdza' bshes dang myur du phrad par 'dod na rin po che'i mda' thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lus la nad sna tshogs kyis thebs par gyur na lcug ma thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lus kyi bgegs ma rungs pa bsal bar 'dod na rnga yab dkar po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /thams cad mthun 7)pa'i 'khor du 'gyur bar (8ri 'dod na phyirabum pa thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /stag dang 'phar 7spyang dang dom dred dang 11gcan gzan 1 ma rungs 12pa thams cad spang 8bar 'dod na phub thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /gnas dang dus thams cad du rgyal po'i bgegs las thar bar 'dod na dgra sta thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /bu dang bu mo dang g.yog 'khor gyi phyir skuni shel gyi gdub 'khor 8thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyir ni pad+mo nyu dkar po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do//phyogs bcu'i zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu skye bar 'dod na pad+mo 1 sngon po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /shes rab chen po dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i me long thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 903—280

mngon sum du mthong bar 'dod na pad+ma dmar po thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /sa'i gter 'byin par 'dod na rin po che'i 1za ma tog thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /drang srong gi lam mngon par 'grub par 'dod na sprin sna lnga thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tshangs par skye bar 'dod na ril ba thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lha'i gzhal med khang du skye bar 'dod na pad+ma le brgan 2thogs pa'i lag 55)la mchod do/ /phyogs 4gzhan 5gyi dgra phyir rgol ba bsal bar 'dod na ral gri dang mdung thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /dge ba'i lha 'dre thams cad dgug par 'dod na rin po che'i dung thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /lha 'dre thams cad 'khol bar 'dod na thod pa'i 'khar 6ba thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas myur du gshegs nas phyag gis byug 7par 'dod na bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs mchog dam pa thams cad mngon par 'grub 8par 'dod na rin po che'i dril bu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /tshig gi /spobs pa gya rnam pa dang ldan par 1 'dod na rin po che'i phyag rgya thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /dge ba'i lha dang klu rnams rtag par 'ongs te srung zhing yongs su skyob 11par 'dod na lcags kyu thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /byams pa dang snying rjes sems can thams cad yongs su skyob par 'dod na 'khar gsil 15thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /sems can thams cad kyis rtag par phan tshun gus pas bsnyen bkur byed cing brtse bar sems par 'dod na thal mo sbyar ba'i lag la mchod do/ /skye ba'i skye gnas thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'dod na sprul pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /skye ba'i tshe rabs thams 93—281

cad du rtag par de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang du gnas nas mngal gyi snying por skye bar 1mi 'gyur bar 'dod na sprul pa'i gzhal med khang thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /mang du thos pa'i shes pa na rgya chen po dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i mdo sde'i glegs bam thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /da 4 ltar gyi lus 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi sku la thug pa'i bar du 5rtag par byang chub kyi sems las ldog 6par mi 'gyur bar 'dod na phyir mi ldog pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams myur du gshegs nas spyi bo nas phyag gis byugs te lung bstan par 'dod na spyi bo na sprul pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa'i lag la mchod do/ /shing thog dang 'bru 7rnams grub par 'dod na rgyan 'brum thogs 8pa'i lag la mchod do/ /de ltar mngon par sgrub 9pa'i cho ga stong yod kyang deng 1 mdor bsdus nas mdo tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis shin tu yongs su dad pa'i 11sems kyis gzungs 'di zung 15la 'dzam bu'i 1 gling du rgya cher yongs su spel nas rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /gzungs 'di khams gsum gyi sems can nad kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad la rgya cher phan 'dogs par byed pas gzungs 'dis yongs su gsos na mi 'tsho ba 1 gang yang med do/ /rig sngags chen mo 'dis shing skam po la btab na yang yal ga dang lo ma dang 15/ me tog dang 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur na rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i sems can la 10lta smos kyang ci dgos 1 te/ sems can nad kyis thebs pa rnams gsos na mi 'tsho ba'i gnas nges par med do/ /rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di'i byin gyi rlabs 1 dang mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngags pa 9(3—282

brjod kyang mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngon 'das pa'i dus yun ring po nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bskyed pa ma yin na tha na 'di'i ming tsam yang thos par mi 'gyur na mngon sum 1du mthong ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha dang mi dang klu la sogs pa'i 'khor mang po khyed rnams ngas 2)gzungs 'di'i bsngags pa brjod pa dzo nithos nas thams cad kyis rjes su yi carang bar bya'o/ /gang la la zhig gis rig sngags 'di la skur 5pa btab par gyur na gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas de dag la skur pa btab par 'gyur ro(7)ske/ /gal te gzungs 'di la the tshom dang yid mi ches pa skyes par gyur 7na gang zag de ni phan yon chen po dang gtan du 'bral bar 'gyur bas bskal pa brgya stong snyed du ngan 'gror 'khor zhing 'byung ba'i dus med de/ rtag par sangs rgyas kyang mi mthong / chos kyang mi thos/ dge 'dun yang mthong bar mi 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /'khor der 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang /tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha dang / klu dang / 'dre srin thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs 'di'i bsngags 8pa brjod pa thos nas thams cad kyis 9rab tu dga' zhing mgu bas bka' yang dag par blangs nas mngon par sgrub par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'od kyis thugs rje chen po'i gzungs 'dzin pa dag yongs su bsrung 1 ba'i ched du rig sngags chen po 'di smras so/ /na mo bud dha gu ra 11be/ na mo dharma 12ma ha 1 tes/ na maḥsang gha 1 tra sayā 1 ṇi tri pu pi sā ta 12tam na maḥ19/rig sngags 'di bton 5 na kha na ma tho ba thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/903—283

bdud spong bar byed/ bgegs rnams sel bar 'gyur bas lan re bton nas sangs rgyas la phyag 1lan re bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyin re bzhin dus gsum ⑧du rig sngags bzlas nas sangs rgyas la phyag byas na ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye ba thams cad du yid du 'ong ba'i mtshan shin tu mdzes pa ( swāre re'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od kyis kyang rnal 'byor pa dag yongs su bsrung caba'i phyir gzungs 'di smras so/ /sirnyi (gete du soṣ+ṭa / adzñā 6mi te 7a 8tuṣ+ṭa/ si na khi (9)ta ba li tiṣ+ṭa/ ya mi dzñā ⑩ta o (ཿdhuṣ+ṭa/ku la ti maṣ+ṭa khiṣ+ṭa 15swā hā/ rig sngags 'di lan lnga bzlas nas tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la sngags mdud byas te gang du na bar gdags par bya'o/ /rig yo)sngags 'di ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung bzhi bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa yin pas deng bdag gis kyang rnal 'byor pa dag yongs su bsrung 8ba'i phyir dang / bgegs thams cad yongs su bsal skoba'i phyir dang / nad ma rungs pa 1 (thams cad yongs su bsal ba'i phyir dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / 'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir bstan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bstan pa'i rig sngags 'di ni yang dag par bden te mi bden pa ci yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di'i 1 drung du 'ong bar 'dod na gu gul la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 18bsregs na byang chub sems dpa' 'ong bar 'gyur ro / /gang la la zhig byi la'i gdon gyis zin par gyur na byi la'i mgo rus bsregs pa'i thal ba sa gtsang ma dang bsres te/ 'jim pa la byi la'i gzugs 93—284

byas nas mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi mdun du ur mo'i gri gtsang ma la brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad du bcad nas sngags lan re gdon 6)cing de'i ming nas lan re brjod na gtan du 9ge'atsho bar 'gyur ro/ /byad stems kyis phog par gyur na gu gul dang ga bur cha ( nomanyam par byas te/khron pa'i chu gtsang ma bre gang dang bsres linas bskol te phul gang tsam lus pa blangs nas(snye/ mig stong pa'i gzugs 96)kyi mdun du lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste 'thungs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/7/ /gal te sdig pa dang sbrul gyis zin par gyur na bca' lga'i (85phye ma la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste rma khar (9bskus na 'phral du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi ma rungs pa dag gis rku bshams nas gnod pa byas par gyur na sa gtsang ma'am bag zan nam/ spra tshil la pha rol po'i gzugs byas te mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi mdun du ur mo'i gri la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab nas sngags nyi )lan re brjod de lan re gtubs 3nyanas pha rol gyi ming nas brjod 12de/ bsregs zin nas dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad du byas na pha rol po 1 dga' zhing nam 'tsho'i tshabar du gus pas bkur zhing byams par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mig nad kyis btab stenyadi/ mig gi mi'abras bu lha 7nyams par gyur tam/ ldongs 18par gyur 19tam/ mi gsal 3 bar gyur tam/ ling tog dkar po dang dmar po dag gis khebs te 'od dang mi 2lhaldan par gyur na/ a ru ra dang / ba ru ra dang / skyu ru ra 'bru ma tsha 2re zhib tu btags te/ 'thag lhapa'i tshe gtsang sbra na bya dgos pas bud 25med gsar du bu py-i stobatsas pa dang / khyi dang phag rnams bsnyen par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nas brjod de / sbrang rtsi dkar po dang / mi'i 'o ma dang 93wa 285

sbyar nas mig la bsku 91)bar bya'o/ /'o ma de yang bu khye'u btsas pa'i nu zho rung gi bu mo btsas pa'i nu zho ni 92mi rung ngo / /sman de tsho sasbyar zin nas kyang mig stong pa'i gzugs kyi mdun du lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ mig la bskus nas zhag bdun gyi bar du khang pa dben par rlung bsrungs 4)na mig gi 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur bas ling tog sngon po dang dkar po bsal riganote gsal ba rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gdon rnams kyis btab ste myos ne par gyur na stag dang / 'phar ba dang spyang ki'i pags 7)pa la 8rilan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 7lus la bgos na sos 9par 'gyur ro/ /gal te sprul gyis zin par gyur na gang zin pa'i mi de'i rna spabs/ 11blangs nas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste rma khar glan /2na sos par 'gyur ro/ /gzer thabs ma rungs pas snying la gzer te 'chi la thug na ka pyi ta lag pa tsam chu gtsang 1 ma phul gang 1 dang sbyar te/ bskol 1lhanas phul phyed lus pa la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste cig lacar blud 1 na sos par 'gyur ro/ /sman de yang bud med kyi drung du bskol bar mi bya'o/ /ro langs kyi gdon gyis btab nas rgyun ring du 18na bar gyur na gu gul la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste bsregs te snar bdug par bya'o/ /yang na ri bong 19gi rtug 2 pa'i ril bu 1bdun blangs te lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas mid du 52bcug na sos par 'gyur te/sha dang / chang dang / dku ba rnam pa lnga dang / tshig ngan pa rnams bsrung na dgos so/ /yang na ba bla dang / yungs kur 2 dang lan tshwa ril lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 27nad pa'i khri'i drung du bsregs na gdon de'i lus 'jig na par 'gyur bas 'dug pa'i thugs mi thub ste 'byer bar 'gyur ro/ /903—286

gal te gzhogs phyed na zhing rna ba dang sna subs 1par gyur tam/ rka 2lag sdud mi nus par gyur na ru rta til mar gyi nang du bskol te lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas lus la bskus na gtan du 'tsho cabar 'gyur ro/ /yang na ba'i mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 5lus la bskus na yang sos par 'gyur ro/ /gal te bu btsa' dka' bar gyur na til mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 6bud med sbrum ma'i lte ba dang mo mtshan la bskus na myur du btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med sbrum ma gang dag mngal du bu shi bar gyur na gi'u 75si srang gcig chu phul do'i 8nang du bskol 59te phul gang lus pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas blud na/ sdug bsngal zhing na ba med par 'byung 1 bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ma 'byung du mi btub par gyur na yang sman 'di 'thungs na phan par 'gyur ro/ /glo bur du snying ga 11gzer te mi bzod 1 par gyur na de 1 ni ro nyul gyi gzer thabs 1 zhes 15bya ba yin pas 17kun tu ru 1 dang pog dkar po ma grugs pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste18/ci tsam 'byor ba byin nas glon 19du bcug na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /sha chang dang /dku 2 ba rnam pa lnga bsrung na dgos so/ /mes tshig par gyur na ba lang gi lci ba dron mo 2la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste rma khar lhabaskus na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /srin bu khong par zhugs te na bar gyur 2 na rta dkar po'i gcin phul phyed la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste blud na 25'tsho bar 'gyur ro / /tshabs che ba la phul gang blud na srin bu thag pa gcus 0pa bzhin du rang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shu chen byung ba la 2 leng se'u hwa brdungs pa'i khu ba 29la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste shu ba'i steng du 1drugs na rtsa ba rang 903—287

'byung 1bar 'gyur bas mod nal 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /mig tu sbrang ma zhugs te na bar gyur na bong bu'i rtug dpa btsir ba'i khu ba la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste mtshan mo mig tu blugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /lto ba 54rin bar gyur na khron pa'i chu gtsang ma'i nang du lan tshwa ma grugs pa 'brum bu nyi shu rtsa gcig bor te/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas phul phyed 'thungs na phan par 'gyur ro/ /mig tshag por 5gyur tam/ mig tu sha lhag byung bar gyur tam / ling tog byung bar gyur na ke'u khi 6tshe'i shing gi ri lo ma brdungs te btsir ba'i khu ba la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste/ de'i nang du khar ba'i dong tshe gcig mtshan gcig sbangs nas yang lan bdun sngags kyis btab sten/ mig tu blugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtshan mo 'byung 59'jug gi tshe 'jigs dngangs 1 nas mi bde bar gyur na skud pa dkar po la 12lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste1ri/ mdud pa nyi shu 1 rtsa gcig byas nas mgul du btags na 'jigs shing dngang ba tshadang 'bral 1 bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang bral ba 1 kho nar ma zad kyi 18bsod nams kyang thob la sdig pa rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyim 'khor du ltas ngan byung 19bar gyur na bal po se'u'i 0shing gi yal ga blangs nas dum bu stong rtsa brgyad du gtubs 21te/mgo mjug gnyi 22gar mar dang zho bskus nas sngags lan re bzla zhing na re re bsregs te stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar byas na gdon bgegs thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur te/ de'ang gisangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bya dgos so/ /shu dag dkar po blangs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ dpung pa g.yas pa la btags nas 26g.yul ngor 'thab pa dang 'bel 2 ba'i gtam smra ba'i gnas 93—288

thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ke'u (1)khi (5ciche'i shing gi lo ma'am yal ga yang rung ste dum bur gtubs danas mgo mjug gnyis kur 4ba 5mar yang dag pa dang / sbrang rtsi dkar po dang ba zho bskus te sngags lan re bzla 6zhing dum bu re re sreg (7༄pa stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bya'o/ /nyin gcig la dus gsum du bya zhing / dus gcig la yang lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te zhag bdun tshang bar gyur na sngags mkhan de rang gis mngon par shes pa nyan thob par 'gyur ro/ /gdon mthu bo che gdul bar 'dod na lung tang 79la lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu sngags 1 kyis btab ste/ bu ram 11dang sbrang rtsi bskus nas 'phags pa snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du bsreg 12par bya'o/ / gi'u wang 1 srang gcig bai ḍūr+ya'i 'bum pa'i nang du bcug ste/ 'phags pa snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du bzhag 1lhanas sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis btab ste/ lus la bskus sam dpral bar thig le byas na/ lha dang / klu dang / 'dre srin dang mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ro / /gal te la la zhig btson rar chud par gyur na phyug ron dkar po'i rtug pa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ lag pa la bskus nas btson 7cha la byugs 1 na btson cha 18rang 19grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyo shug ri chu dang me bzhin du mi 'dum 21par gyur ldan bya ngur pa'i mjug ma blangs te/ 'phags pa snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas pa'i mdun du sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis btab nas lus la btags na/ de dag nam 'cho3re da bar du gcig la gcig dga' zhing byams pa dang bkur 2 bar 'gyur ro/ /lo tog dang 'bras bu rnams la srin bu zhugs te za bar gyur na sa'am thal ba'am/ bye ma gtsang ma 903—289

blangs te/ lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab nas zhing gi phyogs bzhir gtor na srin bu rnams 'gyes 1par 'gyur ro/ /chu gtsang ma la sngags kyis btab ste/ 'bras bu'i ljon shing la gtor na srin bu 'bras bu la za ba'i thugs mi thub bo/ /na mo rat+na /tra yā ya/ sha ra ma hā sha ra/ 4tu lu 55ma hā tu lu/oṃ ku me ha ni sha pa6/ 7bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang la la zhig 'bru dkon pa'i gnas su phyin te/ mu ge byung nas zan chad par gyur na khyed kyis mig btsums nas lus drang por bsrang ste/ sems rtse gcig tu gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas mig phye shig 8dang / lha rnams kyis lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa snod bkang nas khyer te 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khyim na gnas pa'i tshe dgos par gyur na snod 1 gtsang ma stong pa mdun du bzhag 11nas mig btsums te kha chus bkang nas lcang ma'i lcug 12ma dang rnga yab dang lhung bzed 1 la gtor bar bya'o/ /chus gtor zin nas mig btsums te gzungs 'di lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bzlas na rang gi ngang gis ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas snod kun gang ba 'byung bar 'gyur bas blangs 1 nas zhag bdun gyi bar du bca' bar bya ste15/ de ltar na sa'adi'i mthu stobs ni bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bya'o/ /zas zos zin 1 nas mis btsums te sa ra kha zhes brjod nas zas kyi 8lhag ma yang spang bar bya'o/ /zas zos te stor mid nas kyang myur du 'ju bar 'gyur bas stobs dang ldan zhing bde ba 'thob par 'gyur/ thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i gzungs ni 1 'di yin te/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā 2 ya/ na maḥsang 2 ghā ya/ na mo ā 2 darji ye na/ uka tsi du 2 uka na tsi du/ ma ti la li spyo/93—290

la lu te na 77mi 5kyiti na mi swā hā/ gzungs 'di 'dzin pas phyogs bzhi nas rgyun chad pa'i ri'i rtse mor dkyil 'khor byas nas mtshams bcad de lus bsrungs nas khar gi ba'i lhung bzed chung 55ngu cig 56khron pa'i chu gtsang mas bkang ste/mdun du bzhag ri tshonas gzungs sngags bzlas na gdon mi za bar skar ma gsal ba cig (8)'ong bar 'gyur bas 'ong ba'i tsho)tshe 'jigs pa mi bskyed par sems 1 bde bar mnyam par bzhag 11nas sems rtse gcig tu gzungs sngags 'don par byed na / dbang po rno zhing shes rab dang ldan par 'gyur bas mi shes pa ci yang med par 'gyur/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi chos kyang mi rtogs pa ci yang med par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa rgyud pa'i tshe skar ma mchog tu gsal ba cig nyu lhung bzed kyi chu'i nang du 'ong bar 'du shes bskyed par bya'o15// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ bam po gnyis pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni sngon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyu dang rkyen gyis/ deng bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la lung bstan par mdzad pa dang 1 / bdag snying rje chen po bskyed nas sems can thams cad la sman par bgyi ba dang / bcing ba mtha' dag gcad 15pa dang / 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur bar bzhed pa lags pas deng bdag gis yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad par 'tshal te/ dus tha ma'i sems can rnams yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs 'di thos pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi 17mthus de dag thams 93—291

cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba yonyenas bde ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dus lnga brgya ②tha ma la yul lam/ grong ngam/grong khyer ram/ grong rdal gang yang rung ba dag tu dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am / rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pas rtag par gdugs mtshan lan drug tu chos bzhin du yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs sngags kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di klog cing 'don pa dang / yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na/bdag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran zhing gzo ba'i slad du rtag par rjes su 'brangs nas gang zag de dag yongs su srung ①bar bgyid cing spong bar mi bgyid pas 'dre srin thams cad kyis gnod par bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang tshe rabs kyi sgrib pa lci ba thams cad kyang dus gcig tu yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/ gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i ri rachos kyi sgo thams cad kyang myur du (45)yongs su rdzogs par 6)'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma'i sems can rnams ni phal cher sdig pa'i dri ma lhun stug ⑦cing bsod nams chung bas yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa zhig mchis na'ang (8༄'dre yodasrin dag gis gnod pa bgyid pas/ deng bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi yibyin gyi rlabs nyu7kyis sems can rnams la rgya cher sman par bgyi ba dang / sems can rnams la bde bar bgyid pa / dang / lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i ched du gzungs kyi chos bshad par 'tshal te/ bdag gis sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed kyi bar du gzungs kyi chos 'di la bsten cing (nyamachod pa bgyis khulags so/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i 93—292

sangs rgyas rnams kyi bar dag kyang yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i rgyus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par brnyes zhu)pa lags pas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig sems rtse gcig tu yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'don cing klog pa dang / yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na de dag tshe 'di nyid la tshig gi spobs pa myur zhing thogs pa ma mchis pa dang / shes rab dang spobs pa mngon par rtogs par 'gyur bas/ lha dang / mi'i 'khor mang po'i nang na mchog tu 'gyur / gang dag thos pa rnams kyang rab tu dga' zhing thams cad kyis 2spyi bo btud de phyag bgyid par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun mthong bar 'gyur gang ci smras kyang rung ste/ thams cad kyis yid ches pas nyan par 'gyur lags te/ de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs 4kyi mthu lags te/ rang nyid kyi mthu ni ma lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la khyod kyis 'di ltar lha dang mi dang lha ma yin la sogs pa de dag thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar bya ba dang / las kyi lam yongs su sbyang ba'i 5ched du smras pa legs so legs so zhes bsngags 6pa brjod nas/ ngas kyang deng ye shes kyi phyag rgyas 7btab nas/ khyod byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po la sogs pa'i sems can 8rnam pa sna tshogs las gtan 795du ldog par mi 'gyur bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 1 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mngon par dran lags te 93—293

'das pa'i bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa nas/ yum zhes bgyi 91)ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su bzung bas (sa ri po ṭa sa)la la mchis pa'i tshe bdud kyi rgyal pos bdud kyi 'khor mang po dang 'grogs nas bdag gi chos dkrug cing / sngags kyi tshig rnams mngon par mi (4)grub /5)par dzibagyi bar bshams pa las/ de'i tshe bdag gis yum zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs 'dis bdud mang po rnams btul nas thams cad so sor gyes par gyur pas/ gzungs 'di'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bgyi lags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byams pa dang / snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad la phan gdags shing lha dang mi rnams bde ba thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor 'dus pa chen po'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa'i yum zhes bya 7ba'i gzungs lus po che'i sngags 'di smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ya / na mo rat+na /tra yā ya/ na mo3 9mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyakli 10bud+dhā ya/ na ma 11ār+sā 12ba lo ki te shwa rā 12ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo ma hās+thāmaḥsamāṣ+ṭha daya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bi pu la bi ma na su sapra tikhri ta saṃ ghā ya / srur+ya sha ta sa 1 ha sra a ti 8re 19ka pra bhā 2 a ba bhā 1si ta mūrta ye ge/ ma hā 2lham ṇi mu ku ṭa 2 kuṇ+ḍa la a lo kā ra dhā ra tī pa/ bha ga ba 7te 2 pad+ma pā ṇa 28ye/sarba lo ka u pa 29sha ma nā ya/ bi bi :dha mu 2kha sa ma ribe ṣa biṣ+ṭa ri sarba satwa gipa ri mo tsa kā 0ya/ tar+ya thā/ o ri byurgyu 2ba/ ma hā lo ka ka 9 ra ṇa / nā 1tha ma sidhe dmi ra bha drwa bi nā 5sha na 0ka rā ya rā 9 ga de ṣa mo ha dz+wa la sha ma 93—294

ka sha sa ka sa mā shā sa na ka ra ka (1sarba pā pa na)durga te pra /sha ma can ka rā 5ya'/sarba ta thā ga ta sasba (7nod 8na ka ra he he ma hā bo dhi satwa 9ba ra da pad+ma 1 lo ki 11saṃ bhu /gta ma hā kā tsho ru ṇi ka dza ṭā mu ku ṭā tshelo kṛ ta sha tsha'i tshar/ ma ṇi ka na ka sha 1 ta/ badz+ra bai ḍūr+sha 18lo kṛ 17ta sha rī ra dī/ a mi tā bha si na 1ka mā 25khā lam̐ kṛ rita pra bha ra ṇa/ la ri tsa na ma hā du na/ na ra na ri 2 sha ta sa ha sra 5/ a bhi la ṣ+pe 27ta kā 2 ya/ ma hā bo dhi satā ya/ bi dha 2nam bi dha ma/ bi nā sha 29ya bi nā sha — ya/ ma hā yan+t+ra 1gle sha ka ba dha 2/ a ba ba dha bi bi dha satwa saṃ sā ra tsā ra ka /pra 'tsham tha 1na/ pu ru ṣa 5pad+ma dzipu ru ṣa nā ga /pu ru ṣa sā ga ra/ pu ru ṣa si ha 8/ bī ra bī rā shā ya 9/ su yan+ta su yan+ta/ ba ra ba ra dha ma dha )ma/ sa ma sa ma/ dhu ru dhu 1ru/ pra shā sa g.ya/ pra shā sa lhaya/ gi ri gi ri45/ bi ri bi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ mu ru mu ru 5/ mu yu mu yu/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa / dhu na dhu na/ bi dhu na bi dhu na/ dhu ru dhu ru/ gā ya gā ya 8/ gā dha ya gā dha 9ya/ ha sa ha sa/ pra ha sa pra ha sa/ bi bhi dha 5 kle sha bā 51sa na/ 52bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'irin/ ri ha ra ha ra/ saṃ ha ra saṃ ha ra / du ru ti du ru ti/ ma hā man+t+ra 55du ru ti/ kuṇ+ḍa 50sha ta pa ra si ka bha ba bi sa na5 / sha ma ka ma hā bo dhi satwa 58ba ra da gi swā hā/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das la pad+ma chen po'i phyag rin po gyi che'i bkod pa'i khar ba'i yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di smras kyi ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'du shes med zhina'adu shes med min gyi lha'i gnas kyi bar dag zhi rnam pa drug tu g.yos0 / rab tu g.yos par gyur 65to/ /lha rnams kyis kyang rin po tsitsi93—295

che'i me tog gi char mngon par phab bo/ /'og min gyi lha dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams kyang g.yo zhing mi bde 1bas shin tu 'jigs shing dngangs 5gepar gyur to/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'dre gdon ma rungs pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal chen po myong ba'i sgra skad chen pos na phyung nas shar nub tu 'byer zhing bros kyang gang du 'gro ba'i gnas kyang rig cing rnyed par ma gyur to/ /de nas sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpas ca'akhor mang po rnams dang / 'dre srin ma rungs pa thams cad la gang gis bdag gi rig sngags las 'da' zhing 55rjes su 'brang bar mi 6byed na/ de dag gi lus kyi yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad rab tu na zhing 7'jig 8par 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags 'dis ni ri rnams 'joms shing rgya mtsho chen po skems 1 par byed do/ /lha ma yin gyi dmag rnams rnam par bcom nas pham par byed do/ /yul 'khor rnams dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal rnams yongs su srung bar byed do/ /'dre gdon dang / nad dang / sman gyi dug dang / srin bu'i dug dang / log pa dang / ma rungs pa'i mi rnams pham zhing rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /sum cu 11rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams btul 15nas rab tu dul bar byed do zhes smras pa dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 1 chen po'i pho brang rab tu dga' ba na bzhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu btsun pa dang / lha dang klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi'am ci la sogs pa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi chos la gnas pa tshad med pa thams cad kyis kyang dus gcig tu bsngags 1 pa brjod par gyur 'ito/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang lo'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 9(3—296

'das rig sngags 'dis ni sgrib pa'i ri bo 1shin tu rgya che ba dag kyang rnam par 'joms napar bgyid pas gang la la zhig nyan tam/ klog gam/ 'don tam/yongs su 'dzin par bgyid dam/ mthong bar gyur dan/ de dag la nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nag po ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag thams cad zhu byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gang la la zhig rtag par nang par langs nas gus pa'i sems kyis 4yum gyi gzungs 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig klog gam 'don par bgyid na/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid rtag par de'i rjes su 'brangs ldanas yongs su srung ba 6bgyid cing yongs su skyob par bgyid do/ /gang la la zhig smon lam rgya chen po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rgya 7chen po thams cad myur du 'grub par 'tshal na/ gcig pu gnas dben par mchis nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la dran par bgyi zhing / gzhan 8yid la mi bgyi bar rtag par gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na smon lam rnams mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi snying drung du sdug par 'gyur/ngan 'gro'i sgo thams cad du ltung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /mchis kyang rung ma mchis kyang rung ste/ rtag par sangs rgyas mdun na bzhugs par 'du shes nye bar bzhag 9par gyur na/ gang zag de skye ba'i gnas bye ba brgya stong tshad ma mchis pa kun tu bsags pa'i sdig pa'i las ci mchis pa de dag thams cad zhu byang bar 'gyur/ gang zag de 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal po stong gi 11bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa dag 1 la longs spyod par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang dus gcig tu skye bar 903—297

'gyur / btsun pa'i khyim dag tu skye bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig rtag par spos sam me tog snyim pa gang tsam byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyi mdun du mngon par gtor nas/ gzungs 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don par bgyid na/ stong chen po'i 1ri'ajig rten gyi khams kyi yon tan dang snying rje chen po'i chos nyid 'thob par 'gyur/ gang zag de 'jig rten na mthar gyis mthu chen po myur du mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig rtag par byang chub sems dpa'i 2gdong dang /mig dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad la rnam par blta ste / gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug myur du lus mngon sum du bstan nas rnal 'byor pas mthong bar 'gyur bas/ dri ma dang bral nas sa dang po dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur bas 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams gsal bar bgyid par 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 5par 'jug pa bzhin du 'chi bar 'gyur bas tshe rabs thams cad du sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes rab 'thob 6par 'gyur/ kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa ci mchis pa thams cad kyang zhu zhing byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzungs 'di yongs su 'dzin par 'tshal ba des rtag par dpyid zla ra ba dang / dbyar zla 'bring po dang / ston zla tha chungs 7tshes gcig nas tshes bcu'i bar du gso sbyong dang / tshul khrims la gnas nas gos dkar po gtsang ma bgos te/ zas dkar gsum 'tshal nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten naman/ ring bsrel gyi mdun du tsan+dan dkar po'i 'jim 9pa las dkyil 'khor khru gang gru bzhi 9(3—298

pa 67bgyis nas/ me tog dang spos rnam pa sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi nang du gtor nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar spos kyis bdugs 2te zhugs mar gtams nas nasangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus pa'i sems bskyed de/ rtag par gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na/ tshes bcwa 4lnga'i nub mo byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid dkyil 'khor gyi nang du mchi bar 5'gyur bas rnal 'byor pas mthong ma thag tu mtshams ma mchis pa lnga'i kha na ma tho ba shin tu lci ba'i sgrib pa ci mchis pa thams cad zhu byang nas lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur bas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang /dbang bskur ba'i sa'i mthu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa'i mthu dang / khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi sa yang 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te dgung 6char dbab par 'tshal bar gyur na/ gnam du bltas nas gzungs 'di stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na zil dngar 7gyi char dus bzhin du 'bab 8par 'gyur lags so/ /dog sa la bltas nas gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar 'don par bgyid na 'bru rnam pa sna tshogs legs par 'gyur lags so/ /gtsang 9po dang / chab mig skams 1 pa'i drung du gzungs 11'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na chab 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur lags so/ /bro nad kyis 12thebs pa thams cad kyi mdun du rang gi sug pa lag pa la sngags 'dis lan bdun bsngags 12te sug pas byabs na 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang dran pa nyams pa'i mdun du gzungs 'di lan stong 1 rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na yang dag pa'i dran pa 'thob par 'gyur lags 903—299

so / /gang dag bkres skom gyis nyen pa'i mdun du de'i gdong la bltas nas gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na bkres skom gyis nyen pa'i 'du shes ngan pa thams cad rab tu bsal 17bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag mtshams dgum par 'tshal na rdzing chab kyi nang du zhugs te/ chos bzhin du gzungs 'di yongs su rdzogs par bris 2nas rgyal mtshan gyi 5)khar btags na dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du gdon bgegs ci yang ma mchis te/ mtshams bkum 4pa nyid du gyur nas yongs su bsrungs par 5'gyur lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig rtag par gdugs gcig bzhin du gzungs 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad 'don par 6bgyid na gang zag de'i bsod nams brjod kyis mi lang bas rig sngags 'dzin pa de dag btsun zhing dbang phyug dang ldan par 'gyur/ gzhan yang skye bo mang po kun gyis byams shing bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur/ smon lam rnams yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag bdud gdul 7bar 'tshal na yum gyi gzungs 'di bzlas te/ gu gul la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas sngags 'di lan re bzlas shing lan cig bsreg par 8 byas nas 9lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na yongs su bsal bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te skye bo mang po thams cad dga' bar 'tshal na rtag par lcang ma'i lcug ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste/ g.yar khar bcas na thams cad kyis byams shing bkur bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag bdag nyid spobs pa dang / shes rab dang ldan par 'tshal na shu dag srang gcig phye mar btags te/ chab mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar nas ril bu 7bgyis te/ yum gyi gzungs 'dis mtshan ma gsum po 9(3—300

'di lta ste/ drod dang / dud pa dang / 'od byung gi bar du sngags kyis 1gdab par bgyi'o(na / /mtshan ma de dag thob nas gdugs re bzhin sman gyi ril bu tshon tsam bdun bdun 'tshal nas snying gar 4yang 55byug par bgyi ste/ de ltar zhag brgya'i bar du 'tshal na thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa 'thob 6par 'gyur bas / bdag nyid kyi lus bsrung 7ba'i slad du gdugs re zhing yum gyi gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas phyag rgya 8rnam pa bcu gnyis kyang bgyi'o/ /de la dang po byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i lus kun tu sdud 9pa'i phyag rgya 7ni 'di lags te/ sngar langs 11nas 'greng 12ste/ lus drang por bsrang nas rkang pa gnyis gshibs 1 te/ rkang pa g.yas pa cung 1 zad cig dgug par bgyi'o/ /sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa thur 15du brkyang nas gung mo dang srin lag gnyis bkug ste/ lag mthil du bzhag sal/ mthe'u chung dang /mdzub 1 mo dang / mthe bong ni yan 18par brkyang ste/ lag mthil bkan nas gyen du phyogs par bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa g.yas pa'ang 19de bzhin du bgyis nas gung mo bkug ste / phrag pa dang mnyam par bgyis nas lag mthil mdun du blta bar bgyi ste/ 'di ni lus kun sdud 1pa'i phyag rgya 2 zhes bgyi'o/ /gal te bdud dang mu 2 stegs can log par lta 2 ba'i thibs po bcom nas yang dag pa'i lam du gzud par 25'tshal na/ phyag rgya 27'di bgyis nas sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na 2 gdon mi 'tshal bar smon pa bzhin du 8grub 29par 'gyur lags so/ /gzungs ni 'di lta ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā sa1ba 2lo ki rite shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/tar+ya thā/ a bat+ta / a bat+ta ci/ pa ri bsto ‘/ e hi e hi swā hā/ de la 903—301

gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i kun 'dzin gyi gzungs kyi 1phyag rgya 92ni 'di lags te/ snga ma'i lus kun sdud ri ripa'i phyag rgya bzhin du thal mo sbyar te snying gar 4bzhag ldanas sor mo lnga bsnol ri mar btang ste/g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan nas mdzub tsho rimo gnyis drang por bsgreng 8ste rtse mo phrad par bgyis la/ mthe bo 9gnyis mdzub 1 rimo gnyis kyi tshigs pa dang po la mnan nas cung zad cig dbye bar 11bgyi ste/ 'di ni kun 'dzin gyi gzungs kyi tsho phyag rgya zhes bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'di'i 1 bgyis par gyur na bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa tshun chad kyi 'khor ba'i sdig pa'i las ci mchis pa thams cad dus gcig btu yongs su byang bar 'gyur15/ slad ma'i dus kyi tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par byang chub tu nye ba'i tshe bdud kyi rgyal pos glags btsal ba dang / kun 'dzin gyi gzungs kyi phyag rgya 'di mdzad pas shin tu bde ba'i bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin brnyes lopar gyur to/ /gzungs ni 'di lta ste/ tabya thā/ sarba dhā ra tī 1 maṇ+ḍa la/ e hi e hi/ pra bhā 12shud+dha satā 19ya swā hā/ de la gsum pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ni 'di lags te / slar 21bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar sa nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ spyi bo /thal mo sbyar nas mdzub 2 mo gnyis bkug ste rtse mo sprad la mthe bo 25gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs gnyis pa'i steng du bkan par bgyi ste/chos kyi phyag rgya 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang / bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya zhes bgyi'o/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 93—302

kyang chos 'di mngon par bsgrubs pas bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /rnam par grol ba brnyes pa lags te/ rig sngags ni snga ma dang mthun 1lags so / /gang la la zhig gdugs re bzhin du phyag rgya 'di bgyis te mchod pa bgyis na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams myur du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la bzhi pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ langs nas 'greng ste rkang pa gnyis gshibs nas sngar gung mo dang srin lag dang /mthe'u chung rnams rgyab sprad la mdzub namo gnyis bsgreng ste rtse mo sprad nas mthe bo caganyis mdzub 5mo'i tshigs 6gnyis pa'i steng du 7mnan te/ lag pa gnyis kyi bar du tshon sna lnga tsam phye nas smin mtshams su gzhag 8par bgyi ste/ 'di ni mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya'i chos kyi sgo 'di bgyis par gyur na sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi 1 khams gya rnam pa bye ba phrag brgya stong snyed mthong bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag bcu dang bzhi stong rnal 'byor pa de'i grogs bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi chos kyi sgor lan gsum ma zhugs 11pa de dag gis ni 1 phyag rgya'i 1 chos kyi sgo 'di mthong du yang mi rung sal cho ga 'di yang bgyir mi rung lags so/ /rtags mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chos dang ye shes kyi mngon par shes pa gsal ba gcig 15lags na ni/ ci dang ci smon pa de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gzungs ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ sarba tsak+ṣuḥsaka rā ya dhā 1 ra tī in+d+ra ya 1 swā hā/ de la lnga pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i lag stong kun sdud 19pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ langs nas sug pa rkang pa gshibs 2 te/903—303

sngar sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'i lag mthil bkang 1nas sor mo lnga so sor phan tshun du bsnyen te/ de'i rjes la 2sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i lag mthil g.yas pa'i steng du mnan nas snying gar 'jog pa gang lags pa 'di ni lag stong kun sdud 4pa'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi ste/ 'dis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bdud ji snyed mchis pa thams cad sdud 5cing 'dul bar bgyid phyilags so/ /gzungs sngags ni 'di lta ste/ tar+ya thā/ a 7ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/sarba duṣ+ṭa o hā ya ni swā hā/ de la drug pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pas 8ting nge 'dzin rtogs 9par 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng ste rting pa gnyis sprad nas/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo bsgreng 1 ste gung mo bkug nas mdun du phul la/ de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'ang 11de bzhin du bgyis nas gung mo bkug ste nang logs su phul ba 'di ni ting nge 'dzin rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya zhes bgyi ba lags te12/ 'dis ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i bkod pa dang / chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang rtogs par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang mngon du bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /rig sngags ni 15snga ma nyid bzla bar bgyi'o / /de la bdun pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pas 1 lha klu sde brgyad dang / 'dre srin rnams dgug cing sdud 15pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te17/'greng nas rkang pa gnyis gshibs 1 te/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis mthe bo'i sen 1 mo la reg par bgyis nas/ de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa yang 19de bzhin du bgyis te/ mthe'u chung dang gung mo gnyis drang por bsgreng ri nas rtse mo phan tshun phrad par bgyis la/ lag ngar gyi tshigs gnyis 943—304

sbyar nas mdzub 517mo ni phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /rig 2sngags ni 'di lta ste/oṃ sarba ri node ba nā ga a na ri swā hā/ de la brgyad pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pas tshangs pa chen po dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po g.yar drang canas chos 'dri ba'i phyag rgya 5ni 'di lags te/ phyag rgya snga nema'i steng du lag ngar gyi tshigs gnyis phye nas sug pa lag pa'i zur sprad de/ lag mthil bkan la mdzub snye mo ni phan tshun rgyu 8bar bgyi'o/ /rig 9sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ma hā prad+mā 1 ya e hi e hi swā hā/ phyag rgya dang rig sngags 'dis ni gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i 11sgo mo tshad ma mchis shing grangs ma mchis pa thams cad yang dag par sdud 12cing 'du bar bgyi'o/ /gal te nyi zla 1ril gza' zhugs par gyur na/ chab mar la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis gdab par bgyi'o/ /yang na lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags bzla bar bgyi'o/ /chab mar 1 phyag rgyas btab ste 'tshal na dbang po rno bar 'gyur bas gdugs gcig la sh+lau ka sakhri lobs par 'gyur lags so/ /phyag rgya'i chos kyi sgo mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa lags so/ /de la dgu pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pa'i rab lotu dga' ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i 1 phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas snying gar 1 thal mo sbyar te/ mthe bo gnyis ka 19lag mthil du bkug nas sor mo gzhan bzhi ni drang por bsgreng 2 ste snying gar 21thal mo sbyar nas rig sngags snga ma 'don par bgyid na/ gdon mi 'tshal bar lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang dag tu 'jug par 'gyur phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su kun tu rgyu zhing rin po che brgyad stong bsams pa bzhin thob nas sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /903—305

gang la la zhig chos kyi sgo 'di mngon par bsgrub 15pa gang lags (2pa des nang par sngar langs nas khrus yongs su dag par bgyis te/ phyag rgya 'di bgyis na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mngon sum du mthong nas/bskal pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed kyi 'khor ba'i las ngan pa'i kha na ma tho ba lci ba rnams yongs su byang 4bar 'gyur bas/ de'i slad du 5)yon tan 'di lta bu'i bsngags pa brjod pa lags so/ /de la bcu pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pa'i smon pa rnams yid bzhin du mngon par 'grub pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du bgyis pa las mdzub 6mo gnyis bkug ste 7rimathe bo rinaganyis kyi sen mo mnan nas mdzub 9mo'i sen mo ni rgyab sprad par bgyi ste1 ci/ rig sngags ni snga ma nyid bzla bar bgyi'o/ /de ltar bgyis na smon pa rnams mngon par 'grub cing gdon mi za bar byang chub kyi lam las ldog par mi 'gyur lags so / /de la bcu gcig pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du bgyis pa las mdzub 1 mo lnga drang por bsgreng ste 12thal mo dbye bar bgyi'o / /phyag rgya 'di ni bdag sngon rgyu'i sa la gnas pa'i tshe 1rigang gā'i klung 1 gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la stsal bas/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam mngon sum du gyur pa lags te/rig sngags ni snga ma nyid bzla bar bgyi'o/ /de la bcu gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas gisangs rgyas spyan 'dren pa'i ting nge la'adzin gyi phyag rgya ni 'di lags te / phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du snying gar 1 thal mo sbyar nas mdzub 19mo gnyis phan tshun 2 rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /rig 21sngags ni 'di lta ste/ o 93—306

sarba zhi)bud+dha sa ma ya e hi e hi brah+ma na)shud+dha satwa /swā hā/ de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dri caba'i cho ga ni 'di lags te(5ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa'i yum gyi dkyil 'khor dang rig sngags dang / phyag rgya'i chos 'dis ri ni dus tha ma'i dus kyi tshe rig sngags 'dzin pa rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig sngags kyi gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad myur du gsal bar mthong bar ri stabagyid pas/ rig 8sngags 'dzin pa'i gang zag gang lags pa des rtag par ngag bsdams ri9te/ bre mo'i 1 gtam rnams smra bar mi bgyi'o/ /gzungs las byung 11ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan ma ya mtshan can rnam pa sna tshogs gang lags pa de dag ma brtags 12par bab col 1 du brgyud 1 par mi bgyi'o/ /yongs 15su dad pa'i 9sems kyis dran pa nye bar bzhag 1 nas skad cig tsam du yang rnam par g.yeng bar mi bgyi'o/ /gal te khe la gdu bas 1 slad rol du gzhan dag la tha dad pa'i mtshan ma ston par bgyid na/ sdig pa'i las sbyong bar 'tshal yang de dag 'grub par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yang dag pa'i 19yongs su dang ba dang / chos kyi bsam pa gang lags pa des bsgom 2 tshopar mi bgyid na/ bgyis pa rnams chab 'tshal zhing don ma mchis par sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba tsam du bas kyi/ nams kyang sgrub 21pa dag mngon par 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/ rtag par nan tan brtson 'grus kyis tshul khrims yongs su dag par bsrungs 2 nas dku da ba rnam pa lnga dang / sha chang 'tshal bar mi bgyi'o/ /gal te dbyen tshig dang / g.yo sgyu'i tshig dang /phrag 25dog gi tshig smra bar gyur tam/ dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang /903—307

rig sngags kyi cho ga rku ba'i nongs pa 'di dag 'byung 0)bar gyur na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis (mispong bar mdzad pas/ 'di skad du ngas khyed 3)spangs pa ma yin yang gzigs shing yongs su bsdu ba'i 'os ma yin no zhes gsung bar 'gyur 45te/ bcom ldan 'das gang zag de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims yongs su dag pa bshig pa dang /dkon mchog gsum dang yang dag pa'i chos dang / dge ba'i mtshan nyid thams cad la skur cing 'jig par bgyid 5)pa lags pas/ de lta bu'i gang zag de dag ni rtag par lha'i bu'i bdud dang / 'dre gdon thams cad dang / mu stegs can rnams dang / bi nā 46 ya ka rnams dang / khams gcig tu bsdu (7)ba dang / las gcig la gnas pa dang / gtan du skyabs ma mchis par gyur pa (8)lags 9pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyis yongs su skyob 'i par mi mdzad cing rtag par sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa dang / lha dang drang srong thams cad kyis smod par 'gyur bar rig par bgyi lags so/ /lam sun 'byin cing chos 'jig par bgyid pa'i gang zag de lta bu de dag gdugs mtshan du rtag par gzungs 11'di rjes su dran par bgyid kyang /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gang zag de dag nams kyang 12'grub par mi 'gyur bar mthong lags te/ de ltar mi 'grub pa de yang bdag gis nongs pa ma lags kyi/ de dag rang nyid kyis 1 nongs skyon 1 lags pas don de'i slad du gzungs 'di yi skacho ga dang / glegs bam de dag gis mthong zhing thos par yang mi bgyi/ 'don cing 'dzin du stsal bar yang mi bgyi ste/ gang dag tshangs par spyod pa yongs su dag pa bsrung 9ba dang / byams pa dang / snying rje'i 93—308

sems dang ldan pa dang 1/ sems can la snying brtse nazhing byang chub yongs su gnyer bar bgyid pa dag gis yi ger bris nas klog pa dang / 'don pa dang /yongs su 'dzin par gyur na/ yum gyi gzungs kyi dkyil 3'khor mngon par 'grub par 'gyur bas so/ /chos kyi cho ga 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 4mchog tu gsang ba'i snying po lags pa'i slad du rig sngags 'dzin pas 5yang dag pa'i sems dang / brtson 'grus kyi sems kyis lus kyi yan lag dang / nying lag dang / rus pa dang /sha dang / rtsa rgyus dang / rkang dang / mgo dang / mig la sogs pa'ang neyongs su spangs nas gzhan dag la stsal te/ chos 'di yongs su gnyer nas rtag par nan tan brtson 'grus kyis mngon par bsgrub par 7'tshal na rin po che dang / 'bru dang / dar zab dang / gos dang / mal cha dang / sman dang /nor rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par grol ba'i yum 8gyi gzungs dang / dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i gzugs 9brnyan gyi chos kyi ched du gtong ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ slob dpon gyi 1 bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems rtse 11gcig tu bsgrub 12par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du 1 zhe na/ rnam par grol ba'i gzungs kyi chos 'di ni slad ma'i 1 dus tha ma'i tshe sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyis nas yang dag pa'i spyod pa dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i brtson 'grus dang / lta glubs bgrod k+ṇi pa'i phyogs dang /rnam par grol ba'i lam mngon par 'grub par bgyid cing de dag dus 'di nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du nams kyang 1 ldog par mi 'gyur bar bgyid pas so/ /dkyil 'khor de yang 903—309

gtsug lag khang gi nang ngam/ ri'am 1/ chab mig tshonasa'abab pa'am/ nags tshal gyi drung du yang rung ste/ nye 'khor kun tu khru gang yan chad ni 4shing gi rtsa ba dang / dog sa ngan pa dang / gyo mo dang / gor ma dang / rus pa la sogs pa ci mchis pa brkos te bsal nas/ dog sa bzang po las rmang khru gang tsam du blangs te brdungs nas mnyam por bgyis la ba lang gi lci ba dang / spos chab dog sa ser po dang bsres nas 'jim pa parabagyis te legs par byug cing zhal zhal bgyis nas gling lngar bgo bar bgyi'o/ /de la dbus kyi gling ni zheng du khru gsum tsam du bgyis te/ dbus kho nar khru do gru bzhi 6nilham par 7rimachis pa'i rin po che'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgya rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa cig na bri bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo'i 9dbus su rin po che'i pad+ma kha bye 1 ba 'dab ma sum cu nyu1 rtsa gnyis mchis pa khru gang pa cig 12bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo'i tha ma 'khor bar 'od 'bar ba bri bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la gling gi grwa 1lhabazhir pad+ma kha bye 1 ba re re bri bar bgyi'o15/ /gzhan yang pad+ma re re'i steng du yid bzhin gyi nor bu re re bris nas nor bu bzhi po'i steng du la'od 'bar ba bri bar bgyi'o1 / /gzhan yang 'dab ma sum cu 1 rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'i pad+ma de'i steng du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs tsan+dan dkar po las bgyis pa zhig gzhag par 19bgyi'o/ /de nas gling gnyis pa ni zheng du khru gang par bgyis nas sngar grwa bzhir pad+ma kha bye ba re re bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang pad+ma de dag re re'i steng du ri rab lhun po'i stan rim pa gsum mchis pa gsum gsum bris nas byang shar mtshams kyi stan la ni 22dbang phyug chen po'i lha bri'o/ /shar lho'i mtshams kyi stan la ni lha mthu chen po bri'o/ /lho nub mtshams kyi stan la 93—310

ni tshangs pa chen po bri'o/ /nub byang mtshams kyi stan la ni brgya byin bri bar bya'o / /gzhan yang ngos bzhir 1ni rin po che'i me tog dang / phreng ba bcu drug bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gling gsum pa ni zheng du khru do napar bgyis te/sa gzhi /sngon po la gser gyi thig bkye ba 'ba' zhig 5bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gling bzhi 6pa ni zheng du khru gang bar bgyis te / ngos bzhi spyi la bar chad nyi shu rtsa brgyad du byas nas nabar chad dum bu re re'i 9nang du yang pad+ma kha bye ba re re bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang go rims 1 bzhin du pad+ma de dag re re'i steng du yang rdo rje tho ba dang / rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang / dgra sta'i phyag rgya dang /gri'i phyag rgya dang / ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / dung 11gi phyag rgya dang / chu gri'i phyag rgya dang / zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / dbyig pa thogs pa'i phyag rgya dang /gdugs kyi phyag rgya dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya dang / gshin rje'i dbyig pa'i phyag rgya dang / bi nā 1 ya ma'i phyag rgya dang / mtshon cha'i phyag rgya dang / 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / sug pa lag pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya rnams so sor bris nas phyag rgya de dag kun la'ang 1 'od 'bar ba dag bri bar bgyi'os / /gzhan yang lho phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni 'thab bral gyi lha bri ba'od/ /nub phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni chu lha bri'o/ /byang phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni ku be ra bri'o/ /shar phyogs kyi chab sgor bar chad bgyis pa'i nang du ni lha gzhon nu bri bar bgyi'ol/ /de nas gru bzhi'i gnas so sor ni rgyal po chen po 1 bzhi khro gnyer can g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas gling lnga pa ni khru gang bar bgyis te/ ngos bzhi kun tu 'bras bu'i ljon shing dang / me tog gi 903—311

ljon shing dang / rin po che'i ljon shing rnam ༅7pa sna tshogs bri bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang grwa 2bzhi kun tu rin po che'i ri rab lhun po re re bri bar bgyi'o/ /chab sgo bzhir ni rgya mtsho chen po'i chab bri bar bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slad nang gi gling rnams kyi sa gzhi ni kha dog sngon por bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang slad nang gi gling rnams kyi nub phyogs kyi chab sgo'i lho'i ngogs 4zur la sngags rimakhan 'byung zhing 'jug pa'i chab sgo tsigacig dbye bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs bgyis pa'i 7 gcig dbus su 8kha shar phyogs su blta bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i mdo sde glegs bam cig 9pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu 7rtsa gnyis mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag 11nas gzugs bgyis pa de'i mdun du gzhan yang tsan+dan dkar po'i dri chab zhal bu bcu drug dang / zhal zas rnam pa sna tshogs dang / zas dkar gsum dang / shing tog la sogs pas bkang ba'i gzhong 12bu nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / spos chab bre gang dang / bum pa dar tshon 1 sna tshogs dang / me tog dang / ljon shing gi yal ga la sogs pas kha brgyan pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / me tog dang phreng ba sna sna nas nyi shu nyi shu dang / mar me nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / byug spos dang / spos kyi phye ma dang / de la sogs pa'i spos deb tshe nyi shu dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs bris pa'i 'phan dang /dar tshon sna tshogs las bgyis pa'i 'phan 1 spyir phreng nyi shu rtsa lnga bsham par bgyi'o / /'di ltar mchod pa bgyid pa'i zhal sder 15dang / snod spyad dang /bum pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad kyang logaser dang / dngul dang / khar 17ba la sogs pa las bgyis pa las sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /gal te yang dag par ma 93—312

mchis na brnyan 1ma yang rung lags so/ /'di ltar yo byad de dag thams cad kyang slad nang gi gling rnams ngos bzhir chos bzhin du bri zhing dgram par bgyi'o/ /gdan dang me tog sna tshogs gzugs shing gtor 2bar bgyi'o/ /'bras sā lu'i me tog dang / yungs kur dang / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gtor bar bgyi'o/ /zhal zas de dag kyang gdugs gcig rabazhin du gsar du bgyis pa bzang po las mchod 6par bgyi'o/ /sngags mkhan de yang 'byung 'jug gi tshe khrus yongs su dag par bgyis nas byug spos kyis byugs te /gos sar 8pa gtsang ma bgo bar bgyi'o/ /zas dkar gsum 'tshal nas tsan+dan dang / a ga ru dang / du ruska 9dang / ga bur la sogs pa bsres te/gdugs gcig la dus gsum du byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 1 mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs bgyis pa la mchod par bgyi'o/ /nang gi gling gsum pa'i nang du mig stong pa'i gzugs gzhag 11pa'i mdun du rang byang chub sems dpa'i 15sdom pa gsum po dag yang dag par blang bar dam bca' bar bgyi'o/ /gdugs mtshan du slad rol gyi gling gi nub phyogs kyi chab sgor skyil 1 mo krung 1 bcas te mchis nas gdugs gcig la yum gyi gzungs lan stong rtsa brgyad bar chad ma mchis par bzlas brjod bgyis nas gdugs nyi shu rtsa gcig gi 7bar du bsam pa gtugs late mchod par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang dus drug tu dkyil 'khor kyi nub ngos kyi 1 zur gyi chab sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas/ gling gsum pa'i nub phyogs kyi chab sgor 'greng ste/ sngar bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang po dang / gnyis pa dang gsum pa nas bcu gnyis pa sangs rgyas spyan 'dren pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar gyi phyag rgya kun bgyis nas sngags lan 903—313

bdun bdun bzla bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya bcu gnyis pa'i bar du bgyis lags nas kyang bdag nyid byang chub chen po'i smon lam shin tu bstan 1pa las phyir mi ldog par bgyi'o zhes smon lam btab nas g.yar 'dren par bgyid na/ thams cad nye bar mchi bar 2'gyur bas lus drang por bsrang ste mchis nas nges pa'i sems kyis lha 'dre thams cad sgrib cing mchod pa ma mchis par mig sngar mchis so snyam du 'du shes nye bar bzhag 4ste/ tha dad pa'i yul la mi dmigs 555par lus po che'i sngags snga ma lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don par bgyid na/ de'i mtshan mo gzugs bgyis pa de las 'od zer chen po byung nas byang 64chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid gdon mi 'tshal bar mngon sum du lus 7༄ston par 'gyur te/ lus bstan nas mchi ba'i tshe kun dga' ba'i lus kyi byad gzugs su mngon par sprul nas/ dga' zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis rnal 'byor pa de la ci zhig dgos gang zhig smon ces 'dri bar 'gyur bas/ de'i tshe sngags mkhan gyis 'di skad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang / gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi nachos yongs su gnyer ba dang / gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags kyi cho ga thams cad mngon par 'grub pa dang / 'dre gdon thams cad gdul 9zhing ngag nyan par 'gyur bar 'tshal lo zhes lan gdab par bgyi'o/ /de ltar smon 1 pa rnams grub nas kyang bdag nyid rig par bgyi'i 1/ gzhan dag la brjod par mi bgyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di ni bal naras sam btso 1 ras la ri mo 'bris te bgyis na'ang 5rung lags so/ /smon pa thams cad 'grub par 'tshal na chab kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis la a ga ru bsreg stes/ lus po che'i sngags snga ma 93—314

lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas bcu pa smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phyag rgya snga ma bgyis na/ smon pa thams cad bsam 1pa bzhin du 'grub cing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te skye bo mang po thams cad dga' bar 'gyur bar 'tshal na rab tu dga' ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya snga ma bgyis nas lus po che'i sngags kyis til 'bru la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gdab par bgyi'o / /yang na sngags lan re bzlas nas/ lan re zhugs kyi nang du dor ba lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na thams cad yid bzhin du dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /gnod sbyin rnams dga' bar 'tshal na gnod sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba'i ljon shing gi yal ga blangs te/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas kun dga' ra bar bor na dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /mi ma rungs pa smyon dgrar gyur pa gdul dbar 'tshal na shing khong len 'bog la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab nas sngags lan re bzla zhing lan re zhugs su dor ba len 4brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na skyabs su mchi zhing thul bar 'gyur lags so/ /'dre gdon gdul dka' ba zhig mchis na gu gul dang / yungs kur 5la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste / sngags lan re bzla zhing lan re zhugs su dor ba 7lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na 'dre gdon thams cad rang dul bar 'gyur lags so/ /yul phyogs su rims nad byung bar gyur na chab kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis nas/ ba mar bzang po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis 8btab ste/ sngags lan re bzla zhing lan re zhugs su dor ba lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na rims nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na chab nyung zad cig blangs te rims kyis /thebs pa 1 'tshal 903—315

du stsal na 'phral du 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /sngon yul ge byin zhes bgyi bar rims nad byung nas/ gang rims kyis btab pa de dag gdugs zhag gcig gam gnyis las mi 'da' bar 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bram ze tsin 1ti zhes bgyi ba zhig snying rje chen po skyes nas/ cho ga'i sgo 'di bshams nas yul khams gcig gi rims kyis thebs pa thams cad gsos pas thams cad zhi bar gyur te/ rims gtong ba'i 'dre gdon gyi rgyal po'ang 2de'i tshe yul nas byung bar gyur pa'i slad du sman yon che bar rig par bgyi lags so/ /gal te pha rol gyi dmag 4tshogs kyis gtses 5par gyur tam/ chom rkun dang / 'khrug pa byung 6bar gyur na lus kun sdud pa'i phyag rgya dang po bgyis te/ rig sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na dgra dang chom rkun de dag thams cad rang gi ngang gis rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig las kyi rnam par smin pa'i dbang gis 8tshe rabs 9su nye ba'i tshe 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyag rgya snga ma bgyis te/ gdugs re bzhin du mchod pa bgyis nas a ga ru bsregs te/ rig sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas sngags lan re bzlas nas khode'i ming nas lan re 'don par bgyid 11na las kyi sgrib pa de dag yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur nalags so/ /sngon yul bā rā ṇa sīr 1 khyim bdag cig 1 gnas pa las bu gcig las ma mchis pa de lo bcu drug las mi thub par gyur nas/ lo bcwa salnga lon pa dang /khyim bdag khyo shug mya ngan gyis rod nyams par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bram ze zhig sgo kun tu rgyu zhing zas slong ba las khyim bdag de mthong nas ci'i phyir 7mi bde bar gyur ces smras pa dang / khyim bdag gis lo rgyus de dag rgyas par bshad do/ /952—316

de nas bram zes 1khyim bdag de la mya ngan ma byed par bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin du byos shig dang / khyod kyi bu tshe ring bar 'gyur ro zhes smras nas/ de'i tshe bram ze des cho ga'i sgo 'di nyid zhag bdun tshang bar bgyis pa dang / gshin rjes khyim bdag de la khyod kyi bu'i tshe'i 2tshad lo bcu drug las mi thub pas/ lo bcwa 3lnga lon te lo gcig calas ma lus pa las/ deng dge ba'i 5kyen dang phrad pas lo brgya thub par 'gyur ba'i phyir 'dir ne'ongs nas bsgo ba yin no zhes smras pa dang / de'i tshe khyim bdag khyo shug 7rab tu dga' zhing mgu bar gyur pas / khyim gyi nor ci mchis pa bteg 8ste/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang /dge 'dun la phul bas cho ga 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu chen po dang ldan par 9rig par bgyi lags so/ /sngar 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang / rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por lan gsum zhugs pa zhig lags te dkyil 'khor mi 'tshal te/ phyag rgya bgyis nas rig sngags bzlas brjod bgyis pa tsam gyis smon pa rnams mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis la myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par yang 'gyur lags so/ /bud med gang la la zhig bu btsa' ba'i tshe/ sdug bsngal chen po myong bar gyur 1 na/ chab mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags kyis btab ste 'tshal du 11stsal na nges par bde bar 'gyur zhing / 1khye'u 1 dang bu mo btsas pa gang lags pa de dag kyang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur/ dge ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan 1 nas sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i mthus skye bo mang po kun gyi snying du sdug par 'gyur/ rtag par mi'i nang du longs spyod khyad par du 'phags pa dag la longs spyod par 'gyur lags so/ /sems can gang la la zhig mig nad kyis thebs te sdug bsngal zhing 903—317

mi bde bar gyur 1na/ sngags mkhan gyis byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya bgyis nas sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te mig la phyag rgyas btab par gyur na mig kyang 'tsho bar 'gyur la/ rgyu dang rkyen des gang zag de lha'i mig thob par 'gyur bas lha rnams gsal bar mthong zhing longs spyod mchog la longs spyod par 'gyur lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs 'dri rinaba'i cho ga ni ras dkar po khru bcu drug pa'am/ khru nyi shu pa'ang 5rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus ni 'dzam bu'i lagaser gyi kha dog can du bgyis te/ gdong la mig gsum mchis pa sug pa lag pa stong dang ldan zhing sug pa lag pa stong po de dag re re'i mthil du'ang 5mig re re bri'o/ /sug pa lag pa chen po yang dag pa nyid ni bcwa 6brgyad mchis te/ sngar sug pa gnyis kyis ni snying gar 7thal mo sbyar 8bar bgyid do/ /sug pa gcig gis/ ni rdo rje'i tho ba thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni rtse gsum pa thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni glegs bam thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni rin po che'i phyag rgya thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni 'khar gsil rithogs so/ /yang gcig gis 1 ni rin po che'i nor bu thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni rin po che'i 'khor lo thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni pad+ma kha bye 11ba thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni zhags pa thogs so/ /yang gcig gis 15ni lcang ma'i 1 lcug ma thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni 'od zer kha dog lnga 'byin par bgyid do/ /yang gcig gis ni bgrang 7phreng thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni ril ba thogs so/ /yang gcig gis ni zil dngar 5yongs su gtong ba'i lag tu ston to/ /yang gcig gis ni rin po che'i char sna tshogs 'bebs shing mi 93—318

'jigs pa'i lag tu ston to/ /yang gnyis ni lte ba'i thad kur g.yon pa g.yas pas mnan nas mthil bkan te mchis so/ /sug pa lag pa gzhan dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po de 1dag thams cad ni sprul pa'i sug pa lags te/ sug pa de dag kun kyang so so nas mtshon cha dang / phyag rgya rnam 2pa sna tshogs thogs pas / kha cig ni sug pa lag pa'i phyag rgya brkyang ba nyi tshe ba yang mchis te/so so nas mi mthun pas snying po'i mdo las/ ji skad du byang chub sems dpa' de ni lha'i rin po che sna bdun gyi mgo rgyan thogs so/ /lag ngar la ni gdub 'khor 45rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan 5to/ /lus la ni phreng ba thogs shing lha'i rin po che'i gos gya rnam pa dag bgos pa yin no zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /tshon rtsi de dag gi nang du ko ba'i spyin stsal bar mi bgyi'o/ /kun tu ru'i 6khu ba dang sbyar bar bgyi'o / /gang dag yum gyi gzungs kyi cho ga bgyid par 'tshal na sngar de'i gzugs ri mor bri'o/ /gzugs ri mor bri bar yang nges par chos bzhin du bgyi 'tshal bas ri mo 'dri naba'i gnas khang nye 9'khor kun tu tsan+dan dkar po'i chab kyis dog 1 sa la byugs te/ dkyil 'khor bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang ri mo mkhan 'byung 'jug gi tshe/ khrus bgyis nas gos sar 11pa gtsang ma bgos te/ nyin re bzhin sdom pa brgyad yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /chos bzhin du gzugs bris lags nas kyang / ri mo mkhan chos bzhin du ma bgyis par skadogs par gyur na/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa zhig 1 yid la ji ltar mos pa bzhin du bgyis te/ ba dan dang / me tog dang / zhal zas dang / zas dkar gsum dang / me tog dang / phreng ba dang 7/ spos chab dang / me tog sna tshogs kyis kun tu khyab par bkram nas mchod pa rgya cher bgyis te/93—319

rnal 'byor pa dang / ri mo mkhan gang lags pa des gdugs gcig la dus gsum du gzugs bris pa'i mdun du nongs pa rnams mthol 1bshags na/zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tshang ba'i mtshan mo mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs bris pa las 'od zer chen po byung nas/ nyi zla zil gyis mnan te 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dang /tshad ma mchis pa thams cad thogs pa ma mchis par gsal bar bgyid napas/rnal 'byor pa dang / ri mo mkhan gang lags pa de dag dang sems can gang dag 'od kyis reg pa de dag thams cad shin tu lci ba'i kha na ma tho ba ci mchis pa dus gcig tu zhu byang nas yongs su dag par 'gyur lags so/ /cho ga 'di sgrub pa gang lags pa des sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtogs lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gis sngon 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyis kyang phyag stong dang 4spyan stong po 'di dag bstan nas/bdud chen po rnams 'dul 5ba mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das deng 'badag gis kyang lag stong dang mig stong po 'di dag bstan nas bdud chen po rnams btul ba lags te/ sug pa lag pa stong po de dag kyang so so nas 'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal po re re mngon par sprul nas bskal pa bzang po rabs stong gi 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i rgyal po bgyid par gyur 9la/ mig stong po de dag kyang so so nas sangs rgyas re re mngon par sprul nas bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang mtshungs par 'byung 1 bar 'gyur ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' de'i 1 lus bdud 'dul ba'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 903—320

lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa legs so legs so/ /ngas kyang byin gyi rlabs (1kyi mthus bskal pa mthar thug pa'i bar du khyod kyi yum gyi gzungs 'di byin gyis brlab 2par bya'o// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ bam po gsum pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags pa brjod pa thos nas rab tu dga' zhing mgu bar gyur pas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang mig stong lag stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs 4kyi phyag rgya mngon par sgrub par bgyid pa mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas kyang rjes su yi rang gis 5khyod kyis shod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa dang / nam byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs 6dbang phyug gis rig sngags 'di smras pa na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi bar gyi lha'i gnas thams cad kyang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /'og min gyi lha dang / dbang phyug chen po'ang 7mi bde bar shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /'dre gdon ma rungs pa 8thams cad kyang sdug bsngal chen po myong bar gyur pas/ ku co 'don cing shar nub tu byer nas 'gro ba'i gnas kyang 9mi rnyed par gyur to/ /de nas sprul pa'i lus kyis 'khor mang po rnams dang 'dre gdon ma rungs pa rnams la khyed gal te bdag gi rig sngags nyi 3—321

kyi rjes su mi 'brang zhing 'gal bar byas par gyur na mgo tshal par 'gas par tshotsho'agyur ro zhes bsgo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'dis ni ri rnams 'joms par bgyid cing nargya mtsho chen po skams ri par bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'dis ni lha ma yin gyi dpung rnams bcom nas yul rnams srung 4bar bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'dis ni 'dre gdon ma rungs pa thams cad dang / nad thams cad dang / mi ma rungs pa thams cad tshar gcod par bgyid do/ /rig sngags 'dis ni sum cu 5rtsa gsum gyi 6lha rnams 'joms shing dul bar bgyid lags so / /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig rig sngags 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na/ gang zag de'i mthu stobs brjod kyis mi lang ngo rig sngags 'di 'don pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa de dag btsun zhing dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / nam 'tsho'i 7bar du rgyal pos byams shing yid du mchi 8ba dang / smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /gang la la zhig phyir rgol ba'i bdud gdul bar 'tshal na spos gu gul bsregs te/ bdag gis tsholus po che'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 1 bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /skye bo mang po thams cad kyis bdag la byams par 'tshal na lcug ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 1 sngags kyis btab ste/ g.yar khams 12bcas na byams shing bkur bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid spobs pa dang / shes rab dang ldan par 'tshal na/ shu dag la lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ snying gar 1 bskus na thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa thob par 'gyur 7te/ yum gyi gzungs kyi snying po'i phyag rgya bgyi'o / /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ sug pa skalag pa gnyis 9(3—322

rgyab sprad de sbyar nas mthe dzo1)bong gnyis mdun du brkyang bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya 'dis ni bdag kyang bsrung (2)zhing gzhan yang bsrung dbar bgyid do / /phyogs gang dang 5)gang du mchi yang rung ste/ mtshams dgum par 'tshal bas/chab gtsang 6)ma'am thal ba gtsang 7ma la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste/gang du mchis pa'i gnas der chab bam/ thal ba snyim 8pa gang sngar rang gi lus la gtor nas de'i rjes la phyogs bzhir chos bzhin du gtor 9na/ de nyid mtshams su 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig 'dre srin ma rungs pa dang / log pa'i gdon mang po rnams kyis gtses par gyur na bal po se'u'i 1 yal ga dang / grib 11logs kyi lcang ma'i yal ga blangs te/ rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis nas nad pa la gzhus 12na 15nad gang yang rung ste/ mi 'tsho ba ma mchis lags so/ /rig sngags ni 'di lta ste / na maḥs/ sarba bud+dha bodharmas/ saṃ ghā ya/ na ma 1 ār+sā 1 ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo 1 dhi satā 2 ya 1/ na mo badz+ra pā 22 ṇa ye lha/ bo dhi satā ya / tar+ya thā gi/ si bi si bi/ kā ya 2dzisi bi/ pa la sha pa la 2 ni swā hā/ rig sngags kyi phyag rgya 'dis ni log par lta 2 ba'i mu stegs can rnams 'dul bar bgyid do/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig rtag par gdugs dang po 'char ba'i tshe dang gdugs kyi gung dang gdugs bas pa'i 9tshe lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tshobazlas brjod bgyis na/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu la mchod pa 1bgyis pa dang / bye brag tu gyur pa ma mchis pas nam du'ang bud med kyi dngos po len par mi 'gyur/ tshe 'das nas kyang ngan song gsum po dag dang gtan tu 'bral zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi 9(3—323

zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 1)phyag gis spyi bo la byugs te/ khyod nga'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur bas ma 'jigs shig ces bka' stsal par 'gyur/ tshe 'di nyid la yang blo ( bur du 'chi bar mi 'gyur zhing / 'dre gdon dag gis kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi kha na ma tho ba yongs su sbyong ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/'greng nas 'di ltar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa mdun du brkyang ca ste/ sor mo lnga so sor phye nas mdun du phul te sor mo lnga char bsgreng 55ngo / /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo 6lag mthil du bkug ste/ sor mo gzhan bzhi ni khu tshur du bcangs 7nas rna ba g.yas pa'i thad kur bzhag 8ste/ lus po che'i sngags bzlas nas mdzub 9mo ni phan tshun rgyu 1 bar bgyi'o/ /phyag rgya ni gdugs gcig 11la dus gsum du bgyi bar 1 'tshal bas dus gcig gi 1 tshe yang lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis na mtshams ma k+ṇi mchis pa lnga dang sashin tu lci ba bzhi'i kha na ma tho ba lornams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje bskyed par gyur lha na kha na ma tho ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba bsregs nas/ tshe 'das pa'i rjes la'ang 1 sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal 19bar 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu'ang 2 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rgyal po bgyid par 'gyur/ gzhan yang bas pa ma mchis pa'i gter zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs dang / ye shes mnyam pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs thob par 'gyur / gzhan yang mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan par 'gyur/ gzhan yang tshe 'di nyid la mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce la sogs pa bro 'tshal 93—324
