bar mi 'gyur zhing lus kyi nad thams cad kyang yongs su 1'byang bar 'gyur/sngon gyi las dang kha na ma tho ba rnams kyang zhu byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te than pa byung bar gyur na til 'bru yog pa'i 2'bras bu'i mar dang sbyar te/ril bu bgyis nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ chab rdzing du bor nas cadagung char 5'bab par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te char ches na 'bras sā snyolu brngos pa'i me tog yungs 'bru'i mar dang sbyar te/ ril bu 7bgyis nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste 8chab rdzing bur 9bor na 1 dgung char 'chad par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 11stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud rnams btul ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ sor mo bsnol 12mar btang 1 ste/ g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan te/ khu tshur dam du bcangs te spyi bor bzhag 1 nas lus po che'i sngags bzlas brjod bgyis na 'khon 15pa'i dgra thams cad rang dul bar 'gyur lags so/ /cho ga 'di bgyid pa gang lags pa des ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du tshes nyi shu dgu'i mtshan mo tsan+dan dkar po'i phye ma'i dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ me tog sna tshogs bkram nas yongs su dag par khrus bgyis sate/ gos sar 1 pa gtsang ma bgos 1 nas sug par 19pog phor thogs te/ a ga ru bsregs la kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ skyil mo krung 2 bcas nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag stong mig stong dang ldan pa spyi bo la mchis par 'du shes nye bar bzhag ste/ lus po che'i sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na 'di dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang po mchog lags so/ /gzhan yang yungs gar 2 til gyi 'bras 903— 325

bu dang 1gcig natu bsres te brdungs nas phye mar bgyis te/ pho (5)gsum gyis cung zad cig blangs nas lan cig 4sngags kyis btab ste 55zhugs su dor (treb dgung 7bdun tshang bar bgyis la/ gdugs re la yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na slad kyis ci bgyi'o 'tshal mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 'jigs pa ma mchis pa chen po'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags ten/ 'greng nas sug pa rkang pa gnyis gshibs 9te/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yas pa bkan te lag ngar g.yon pa bteg nas pus mo'i steng du bzhag 7par bgyis te/ sug pa lag pa g.yon pa yang de bzhin du bgyis nas/ rtag par ring bsrel gyi mdun du lus po che'i sngags lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ myur du sems can la mi 'jigs pa stsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thob par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang shing kun dang / yungs gar 11dang / shu dag 12dang / ta ta pa'i ril bu 1lhablangs te dngos po 'di dag zhugs kyi nang du bor te bsreg 1 par bgyi'o/ /'di dag sreg sapa'ang lasangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar ram / dkyil 'khor ram1 / gnas gtsang ma dag tu bsregs nas lus po che'i sngags bzlas te / sngags lan re bzla zhing 19lan re bsregs 2 pa brgya rtsa brgyad 21tshang bar bgyis nas spos dang me tog dag gis rig sngags la mchod par 2bgyis na/ ci dang ci smon pa rnams yid bzhin du mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te rig sngags gzhan gyis mi 2 thub pa dag 2 sngags 'dis btab nas 25thams cad thub cing 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te rmi ltas mthong bar 'tshal na sngags 'di bzlas nas phyag rgya bgyis te mig la btab na ci dang ci tsi93—326

mthong bar 'tshal ba de dag thams cad rmi lam du mthong bar 'tshal 1lags so/ /bsod nams ma mchis pa gang dag ci bgyi'o 'tshal yid bzhin du grub 2par mi 'gyur na/ gdugs re bzhin rig sngags 'di lan brgya rirtsa brgyad 'don pa dgung bdun du tshang bar gyur na ci dang ci smon pa thams cad 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag sngon klu'i rgyal po rgya mcho1re gnas su rgya mtsho'i nya ri chos kyi 'dun pasar chos ston pa na/ klu mang po rnams sdug bsngal chen po rnams myong 56bar 7mthong ba dang / klu mang po rnams la snying brtse nanas de dag sdug bsngal las yang dag par 9'da' 1 ba dang / sems can mang po rnams sdug bsngal dang bral zhing 'khon 11pa'i dgra ma mchis par bgyi 1 ba'i slad du chos bstan pa las de'i tshe klu'i bu mos chos 'di gnyer ba'i slad du nor bu rin po che mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ri ba gcig phul ba 1snyedang / bdag gis ni 1 de la yum gyi 15gzungs 'di rgya cher bstan pas sdug bsngal gyi bgegs rnams dang bral bar 'gyur salags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chu shel gyis sna rig sngags 'di yongs su 'dzin pa dag la phan gdags shing bgegs yongs su bsrung 18ba'i phyir sngags 'di smras so/ /bi ma le ma hā bi ma le u ha le/ma hā u ha le/ hu ma le/ ma hā hu ma le/ sa hā le/ ma hā sa hā 19le/ tsi li na te swā hā/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig phyogs gang du gnas kyang rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang 21lag pa 2stong dang ldan pa'i chos kyi cho ga 'di yongs su 'dzin par bgyid na/ bdag kyang rtag par de dag 2 gi rjes su 'brang 2 ste/ yongs su bsrung 5bar bgyid pas bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyi bar dag gis gtse pobar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la 93—327

zhig brel zhing phongs par gyur tam/ pha rol gyi (1)dgras gtses sgyu gyisam chom rkun dag gis gnod pa bgyid par gyur ri na/ tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 4sngags kyis btab ste/ sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud nas / dpung pa g.yon pa la mdud par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sug pa g.yon pa'i srin lag dang / gung mo dang / mdzub 5 mo rnams khu tshur bcangs te/mthe bos steng du mnan nas mthe'u 6chung chom rkun 57gyi phyogs su kha bstan 58༄te/sngags 'di lan brgya / rtsa brgyad bzlas na thams cad rang gyes nas gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /sngon byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gangs ri la gnas te/ chos ston pa dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po'i yul na 1 gnas pa'i skye bo rnams sems can gyi sha khrag 'ba' zhig /sto'atshal zhing dge ba'i sems ci'ang 12ma mchis pa mthong ba dang / de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de thabs la mkhas pas phan gdags shing sems can gdul ba'i ched du rdzu 'phrul gyi 1 mthus de ma thag tu yul de dag tu mchis nas/ mig stong dang lag stong dang ldan pas 1 bdud gdul 15ba'i lus mngon par bstan te/yum gyi gzungs mngon par 'grub pa'i phyag rgya bgyis pa dang / de'i tshe srin po'i yul gyi rgyal po bdag slogi thad du mchis nas/ nongs pa 'thol 1 bshags te / phyag bgyis pa dang / bdag gis kyang mngon par 'grub pa'i phyag rgyas btab pas/ de 1 bla na ma mchis pa'i lam mngon par grub par gyur lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mngon par 'grub 19pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas sug pa rkang pa gnyis gshibs te/snying gar 2 thal mo sbyar te mthe'u chung gnyis pa na snol mar btang zhing / g.yon 903—328

pas ci1)g.yas pa (namanan nas lus po che'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas/cho ga rnam pa sna tshogs gang bgyid kyang rung ste/ thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis da 'gro ba drug po dag sdug bsngal gyi bgegs las yongs su skyobs 4pa'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can sdug bsngal las yongs su skyob par 'tshal na 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyad par bgyi ste/ 'di ltar sor mo bcu'i rtse mo phan tshun phrad par bgyi ste/ lag ngar gyi tshigs dang /lag mthil ni dbye bar bgyi'o/ /sor mo rnams kyi bar yang tshon gang tsam mchis par bgyis ter/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' de 'gro ba drug po dag tu gnas nas sdug bsngal gyi bgegs las yongs su 'das 6pa zhes bgyi ste7/'di ltar phyag rgya'i 'khor lo 'di'i dbang gis thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur napas so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ skyil mo krung 1 bcas nas sngar sug pa g.yon pa brkyang ste/ sor mo 11lnga char 1 bkan nas pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du gzhag 1dgo/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa 1 brkyang steska/ sor mo lnga char 16kha sbub nas/ pus mo 1 g.yas pa'i steng du mnan par bgyi'o/ /'di ni 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i phyag rgya dang 'dra ste / 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mtshungs par phyag rgya 'dis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ba lags pas/ phyag rgya 'dis ni las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sel bar bgyid do/ /rnal 'byor pa bsam gtan sgom pa gang dag ting nge 'dzin mngon 93—329

sum du ma gyur na gdugs mtshan bdun gyi bar du dgon pa'i gnas su 0)mchis nas gzungs 'di 2bzlas te phyag rgya 'di bgyis nas/ sems rtse gcig zhu tu sangs rgyas rnams mig sngar mngon sum du bzhugs par ④yid la bgyis te/gdugs mtshan gcig 5la dus 6drug tu mthol (7)bshags bgyis na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang mngon sum du 'gyur zhing / bsod nams kyi phung po chen po tshad ma mchis dpag tu ma mchis brjod du ma mchis pa rnams kyang 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas sum cu (nasartsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dgug pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo bzhi khu tshur bcang bar bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i mthe bo 9khu tshur bcangs pa bzhin bcangs nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo lag pa g.yas pa'i chang pa'i gong du rtse mo phyung nas sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub 1 mo ni phan tshun du rgyu 11bar bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ku tsi ku tsi ku tsi ku tsa 12ya ri/ tsa ri tsa ri tsa ri 1 le swā hā/gzungs kyi phyag rgya dang sngags 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig mchis nyal kur 1 phyag rgya 'di bgyis te/ sngags 'di lan re bzlas shing snying gar 15phyag rgya lan re bgyi ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar gyur na/ sems la ci dang ci 'dod pa rnams rmi lam du rig cing mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig rtag par phyag rgya 'di bgyis nas/sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na sdig pa thams cad byang nas byang chub kyi sems stong par mi 'gyur bas gang zag de mtshan mo mchis nyal ba'i tshe g.yar lam na rgya cher 'phel zhing bkra shis par 'gyur/ g.yar lam na de bzhin 93—330

gshegs pa byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs nas lung ston pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba'i bar dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / lha rnams kyang rtag tu nye bar mchis nas/rim gro bgyid cing tsho17yongs su srung 2bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas lha dang / klu dang 'dre gdon sde brgyad po dgug pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ 'greng nas sug pa rkang pa gnyis gshibs 3te / sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong palag mthil du bkug nas/sor mo bzhi khu tshur bcangs te snying gar bzhag 5go/ /de'i rjes la sug pa 6g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyis te/ lag pa g.yas pa rna drung du gtad 7nas mdzub 58)mo phan tshun du rgyu 9bar bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ na mo nī 1 la kuṇ+ḍa / na ma ār+ya 11sha pa ta swā hā/ na mo ār+ya 12sha 1lhal swā hā/ e hi e hi swā hā / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gzungs dang phyag rgya 'di len tam 'dzin tam klog 1 gam/ 'don par bgyid tshan/ myur du tshe rabs bdun tshun chad kyi sngon gyi gnas kyi dngos po rjes su dran par 'gyur/ sbrul gdug 4pas zin par mi 'gyur ro/ /dug gis 1 mi tshugs par 'gyur/ mtshon gyis gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur/ rgyal pos gshe bar mi 'gyur/ nams kyang 18sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong 19bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig gdugs re 2 thobazhin du rig sngags 'di 'don par bgyid na/ 'dre srin sde brgyad po rnams rig sngags 'don pa'i drung du nye bar mchis nas/ rig sngags 'don pa nyan par bgyid do/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig 'dre gdon gyis zin par gyur na/ skud pa dkar po la sngags kyis 93—331

btab ste/ 1sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud de/ mdud pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu tshang bar bgyis nas de'i mgul du btags na 25de'i nad sel bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yul gang du ltas ngan 3skudang / rims nad byung ste/yul mi mang du gum par gyur na/ rgyal po'i kun dga' ra ba dang / rdzing dag tu pad+ma stong rtsa brgyad 4blangs te/ pad+ma re re la sngags lan re btab nas zhugs kyi nang du bor te bas par bsregs na rims nad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pa'i rnam par grol ba'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ skyil mo krung 5bcas nas sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i gung mo mthe bo'i rtse mo dang sbyar te bkan la/ sor mo gzhan gsum ni ( brkyang nas pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du gzhag 8par bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du bgyis nas9/ sug pa lag pa pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du kha sbub tu gzhag 1 par bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig rtag par phyag rgya 'di bgyis 1 nas lus po che'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 1 bzlas brjod bgyis na/ smon lam rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing / sdug bsngal rnams kyang rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig mi dge ba bcu dang mtshams ma mchis pa lnga la sogs pa'i dngos sdig rnam pa sna 15tshogs pa 1 bgyis pas 'dzam bu'i 15gleng gi sa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad rdul phra rab tu bgyis la/ rdul phra rab de re re'ang bskal tshapa re re mngon par byung bar gyur na/ gang zag 1 de dngos sdig rnam pa sna tshogs bgyis pa'i dbang gis bskal pa'i 1 grangs de snyed kyi bar du sems can dmyal bar ltung 19nas sdug bsngal myong zhing gtan du 'byung ba'i dus ma mchis pa zhig 903—332

lags na'ang 1/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar zla ba dkar po'i ngo tshes bcwa 2lnga la gdugs mtshan gcig zas bkum ste phyag rgya mdud nas rig sngags stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bzlas na gong du bstan pa'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur te/ gal te byang bar mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ de lta bu'i gnas ma mchis lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mig stong dang ldan pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la rang dbang thob pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/ langs nas 'greng ste 4sngar sug pa g.yon pas sug pa rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo 5la btsir nas khu tshur bcangs pa bzhin du bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i lag ngar gyi steng du btsir nas/lus po che'i sngags lan bdun 'don 6par bgyis na / dpag tshad 8brgya stong du mar mchi 'tshal na'ang 9dka' 1 ba ma mchis par 'gyur lags so/ /sngags 'don pa'i tshe sgra 11'byung bar mi 12bgyi'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' mig stong dang ldan pas 1 rdzu 'phrul la rang dbang thob pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di lags te/sngar sug pa lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos 1 mthe'u chung gi sen mo'i steng 15du reg par bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la sug pa lag pa g.yas pa'ang 10de bzhin du bgyis nas / sor mo gzhan gsum ni so 1 sor yan 1 par bsgreng 19ste/ lag ngar gyi tshigs sbyar nas spyi bo'i steng du bzhag 2 ste/ lus po che'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'don par bgyid na/ drang srong 'phur 1te mchi ba dag dang 'dra bar rang dbang du mchi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems rtse gcig tu spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya ni da'adi lags te/ sug pa gnyis 93—333

nam mkha' la thal mo sbyar te/ lag ngar gyi tshigs sbyar nas(1)/ mdzub ( mo gnyis ni phan tshun rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ a ro li ka ④te len / lo ki 'bi do ya/ sarba ya dru/ pra marta (7)na ka rā 58)ya pu 59)ru swā hā/bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ nyan thos chen po de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / tshangs pa chen po /stodang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la 1 mngon par bstod do// //byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs cho ga dang bcas 1 pa rdzogs sothu// //zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de 15chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur 7te gtan la phab pa 1

༄ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄zag /2 bod skad du / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das drang srong gi ri la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs mang po dang thabs cig 4tu bzhugs te/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te/ gos tshags bcos nas pus mo sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la pad+ma 5du ma tshichen po'i tsan+dan 7gyi snying po'i 'khor lo zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs chen mo smon cing bgyi ba thams cad mngon par 'grub par bgyi ba mchis te/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs 93—355

rje chen pos bdag gis bshad par gnang na/ bdag 1bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyis brlabs 2kyi mthus sems can thams cad la sman par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad par 'tshal lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'di ni gzi byin chen po'i mthu dang ldan pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che chen po dang / yid bzhin gyi ljon shing bzhin du smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so legs so zhes bsngags 45pa brjod nas/ khyod kyis snying brtse ba'i phyir sems can gyi ched du 'di ltar zhugs 5pas na khyod thogs pa med pa'i gzungs 'di bshad par gnang bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de ltar bkas 6gnang ba dang /langs nas thal mo sbyar te phyag byas nas 7slar stan la 'dug sten/ sems rtse gcig tu 'khor 'dus pa dag la rnam par bltas nas snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sems kyis sngags 'di smras so/ /na mo rat+na 7dra yā ya11/ na ma ār+sā 12ba lo ki 1 te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 1 kā ya/tar+ya thā/ o tsakra brte tsin+ta sam ṇi ma hā pad+me tsheru ru tiṣ+ṭha te1 / badz+ra bha 1 ra/ ā ka rā ya 19rtsu swā hā/ 'di ni lus kyi sngags lags so/ /oṃ pad+me/ tsin+ta 21ma ṇi/ rnam hā badz+ra bha ra hūm̐/ 'di ni snying po'i sngags lags 3so/ /oṃ bha ra ta pad+me hūm̐/ 'di ni snying gi snying po'i sngags 25lags 25so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di smras pa dang / sa chen po yang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos par gyur/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam 903—356

mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa'i khang khyim rnams kyang rab tu g.yos par gyur 1bdud kyi rgyal po dang / bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyang shin tu skrag cing 'jigs pa chen po skyes par gyur/ bdud kyi rgyal po'i gzhal med khang yang rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ gnod sbyin dang / 'dre srin ma rungs pa gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs kyang dngang zhing 2skrag pas gdong bkab ste/ sa la 'gyel bar gyur/ sems can dmyal ba'i sgo thams cad kyang 3phye nas sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams la thar te/ lha'i bde ba mchog myong bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe lha rnams kyis kyang rin po che'i me tog dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyi yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char mngon par phab 5par gyur/ lha'i rol mo rnams kyang bar snang la sgra sna tshogs phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ rigs kyi bu khyod sems can la snying brtse 6ba'i phyir gzungs 'di bshad pa nyid kyis sems can rnams kyi 7phan yon chen po thob par 'gyur ba legs so legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu sems can rnams kyi phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rgyal po chen po'i gzungs 'di'i cho ga shod cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ khye'u'am/ bu mo gzhon nu gang la la zhig 943—357

gis tshe 'di 1nyid la rnam par smin pa mngon du myong bar 'tshal na/ gdugs mtshan sems rtse gcig tu nan tan brtson 'grus kyis gzungs 'di mi bskyud par bgyis te/ gdugs dang dus mi 'dam par gtsang yang rung / mi gtsang yang rung ste/ g.yar ston nadu bzlas par gyur na bgyi ba rnams don ri skudang ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /ci yang rung ste/ don ri du bgyi zhing gnyer ba zhig mchis na lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na don brgya stong du ma 'grub par 'gyur bas/ rig 5sngags gzhan gang yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di dang bskrun 6par bzod pa gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'das pa dang / da ltar gyi las ngan pa dang / sgrib pa lci ba rnams rab tu 'joms pas so/ /gang la la zhig gzungs 7'di bzlas 8brjod bgyis na mnar ma mchis pa'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ba'i rigs 9dag kyang thar bar 'gyur la/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa 7rnams kyang 'byang bar 'gyur na/ las ngan pa dang / gdon bgegs dang / bro nad gzhan thams cad lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ gang dag rims 11nad nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin mtshan du bro 'tshal ba'am/ rlung dang / mkhris pa'am12 bad kun la sogs pas bro 'tshal ba dag 1ril rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis par gyur na thams cad 'byang zhing sos par 'gyur lags so/ /gang zhig dug dang byad stems kyis phog par gyur tam/ lhog pa dang / g.yan 7pa dang / mdze nad dam15/ phol mig gam/ rlung nad dam/ smyos pa'am/ klad lapa bro 'tshal ba'am/ rna ba dang / sna dang / mchu dang / lce dang / mid 1 pa 93—358

dang / kha dang / gdong dang / gtsug dang / klad 1rgyas dang / brang dang / rtsib (5)logs dang / snying dang / lto ba dang / rked pa dang / rgyab dang / rkang pa dang / lag pa la sogs pa thams cad bro 'tshal bar gyur na yang thams cad sos par bgyid/ ji tsam du lus kyi bro nad ci mchis pa thams cad kyang sos par bgyid lags so/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / bi nā 5ya ka dang / bdud sdig 4can dang / 'dre gdon dag gis kyang gnod par bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /mtshon cha dang / dmag tshogs dang /chab dang / zhugs dang / rlung dang / char pa dang / ser ba ma rungs 5pa dag gis kyang 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dgra dang / chom rkun dang / rgyal po ma rungs pa dang / rkun po ma rungs pa dag gis kyang gnod par bgyid par mi 'gyur ro/ /glo 'bur du 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ rmi lam ngan pa rmi bar mi 'gyur/ rtsangs pa dang / sprul dang / sdig pa dang / srin bu gyi med dang / rkang mang dang / gcan gzan 7gdug pa ma rungs pa dang /seng ge dang / stag dang / spyang ki nadag gis 9kyang gnod pa 1 tshobagyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /g.yul ngor 'thab pa'i tshe thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te bla'i bgyi ba dag gis rtsod par gyur na yang 'dum par 'gyur 11te/ gzungs 'di lan cig 1 bzlas na gong du bstan pa de dag thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig gis gdugs re gzungs 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad du/ rigs kyi 1 bu khyod ma 'jigs shig /ci zhig smon cing ci zhig yongs su gnyer bar byed/ thams 93—359

cad khyod la sbyin no zhes bsgo bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyang sku mngon du ston par 'gyur/ mdo las gsungs pa bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi bkod pa'i dngos po dag kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mthong bar 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas ri bo 1po ta nal yang mthong bar 'gyur/ dbadag nyid kyi lus kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur bas rtag par rgyal po dang / blon po rnams kyis bkur zhing 4)rim gro bgyid par 'gyur/ skye bo mang pos byams shing bkur bar 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du ma'i mngal du mi skye zhing pad+ma'i steng du skye bar 'gyur/ bkod pa mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par 'gyur/'di nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du nam yang ngan 'gro rnams su mi ltung zhing rtag par sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar skye bar 'gyur lags te/ 'di ni sdig 5pa'i las thams cad rnam par 'joms 6pa'i gzungs zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'joms 7pa'i gzungs kyi le'u ste 8dang po'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sems can la snying brtse 9ba'i phyir yang yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po'i gzungs gsang ba'i cho ga bstan pa su yang rung ba gces pa'i don grub pa zhig mchis na/ thams cad rang zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ 'di lta ste/93—360

'jig rten gyi nor dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nor gang lags so1/ /de la 'jig rten pa'i nor ni gser dang / dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che rnams so/ /'jig 2rten las 'das pa'i nor ni bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi bkod pa rnam pa gnyis dang ldan zhing lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang /skye bo mang pos byams shing bkur ba dang / sdug bsngal ba'i sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa dang / byams pa'i sems rgyas nas blo dang ldan pa rnams bde ba stsol ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad 'phel zhing mthu stobs rtag pa gang lags pa'o/ /gsang ba'i mdzod kyi spyod yul 'di ni gzhan dag la brjod par mi bgyi'o/ /gang la la zhig bdag gi dayid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs kyi dngos grub mchog thob par 'tshal na/ sems rtse gcig tu dus thams cad dang /gnas thams cad du gtsang yang rung / mi gtsang yang rung ste/ rtag par bzlas brjod bgyis na nongs pa ci yang ma mchis pas bzlas brjod bgyi ba'i grangs tshang bar bgyis nas / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming dang / yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs kyi ming dang / gang zag de'i ming nas brjod de/ gal te rgyal po'am/ rgyal bu'am/btsun mo'am/ sras sam/ rgyal po'i bu mo'am/ bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sam / dmangs rigs sam/ gdol pa'am/ skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/khye'u 'am/ bu mo gzhon nu ma'am/ mu stegs sna tshogs dag la brten 5cing /mdza' bar 'tshal na de dag gi ming nas brjod de rtag par tho rangs kyi tshe/bzlas pa'i grangs tshang bar 6bgyi'o/ /gal te dngos grub mchog gnyer zhing rgyal po la brten 7par 'tshal na/ dgung zhag bdun gyi bar du rtag par tho 93—361

rangs kyi tshe lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas na mjal (1bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te btsun mo la brten na par 'tshal na lan dgu brgya bzlas par bgyi'o/ /rgyal bu la brten ripar 'tshal na lan brgyad brgya bzlas par bgyi'o/ /sras (4)dag mthong bar 'tshal na lan bdun brgya bzla bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po'i bu mo la brten 5)par 'tshal na lan drug brgya 6bzla bar bgyi'o/ /bram ze la brten ( skupar 'tshal na lan lnga brgya bzla bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal rigs la brten nasapar 'tshal na lan bzhi brgya bzla bar bgyi'o/ /dmangs rigs la ni sum brgya'o/ /gdol pa la ni nyis brgya'o9/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma la ni lan brgya'o/ /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la ni lan dgu bcu'o/ /khye'u gzhon nu dang /bu mo gzhon nu ma khol ni 11lan drug cu'o12/ /'di ni brten nyugecing mdza' yibar bgyi ba'i cho ga zhes bgyi ste/ nor dang / bran dang / rta dang / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad 'byor par bgyid lags so/ /gang la la zhig snying du sdug cing mdza' ba dag ring po na mchi ba dang mjal bar 'tshal na yid la bsams 1shepa bzhin du rlung bzhin du mchi bar 'gyur lags so/ /ci bgyi'o 'tshal bzlas brjod bgyi ba'i 17grangs tshang bar gyur 17na don de dag 'grub par 'gyur lags so / /gal te byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'tshal na lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na de'i lus yang dag pa nyid mthong zhing bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par bgyid lags so/ /gal te lag na rdo rje mthong bar 'tshal na bzlas brjod lan khri bgyis na lus mngon sum du bstan nas/ de la brtse 1 zhing phas bu la byams pa bzhin du sems kyi smon pa rnams stsol bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te sangs rgyas dang / 'khor 'dus pa 903—362

mang po mthong bar 'tshal na lan khri sum stong bzlas brjod bgyis na de bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te gdugs mtshan bdun gyi bar du rgyun chad pa ma mchis par bzlas brjod bgyis na rig sngags 'chang rnams mngon sum du ston cing / so so nas rang rang gi sngags kyi mthu ci mchis pa gang zag de la stsal nas yongs su bsrung 1bar bgyid de/ zhag bdun pa la ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nadabang po dang / brgya byin lha'i dbang po rnams 'khor dang bcas te mchis nas de'i smon pa rnams stsol bar cabagyid do / /bzlas brjod kyi cho ga gong du bstan pa bzhin du bgyis na smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid de/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod las thams cad byams shing mos par 'gyur ba'i cho ga zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod las thams cad byams shing mos par 'gyur ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ gang gis mthong ba dag byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i musman sbyar nas lus la thogs te 'gro na mchog tu mngon par 'grub cing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'du 'grub pa'i cho ga bstan pa/gi'u (7)wang dang / tsan+dan nanodakar po dang / gur gum dang / ga pur dang /gla rtsi dang / dzā 9nyi pha 7la dang / li shi dang / ka 11ko la dang / pad+ma dang /ut+pal sngon po dang / gser gyi gyim bag rnams cha mnyam par bgyis te/93—363

brdungs nas sbrang rtsi dkar pos sbrus te/ snga ma'i sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas nas lus la bdugs sam1/ gos la bdugs sam/ mig nasil bskus sam/dpral ba la thig le bgyis sam/ lus la byugs na rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang / blon po rnams dang / bran carnams dang / skyes pa dang / bud med la sogs pa byams shing dga' ba dang / lam gyi chos la bkur zhing byang chub tu sems/ bskyed nas/ lus kyi zho sha dang / nor rdzas dag phangs pa ma mchis par gtong zhing 5rim gro bgyid par 'gyur te/ brjod kyis mi lang lags so/ /ji ltar nyi zla thams cad kyis mthong bar mos pa bzhin du sgrub pa'i don rnams 'byor cing 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig sman 'di thogs par 'gyur na kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa rnams zhu byang nas bgegs thams cad las thar bar 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal po'i mthus nan gyis 'phrog pa dang / chab kyis ded pa dang / zhugs kyis tshig pa dang / mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs dang /dug dang / 'ching 6ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur lags so / /bsam pa thag pa nas sman a ka ta sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di bgyis na thams cad kyis byams shing dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /sman 'dis bdugs 7pas bab chol du g.yar khar stsal bar bgyi ste/ 'di ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan dag la byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman gyi cho ga zhes bgyi lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs las gzhan dag la byams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman a ka ta sbyor ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //93—364

byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse 1ba'i phyir thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i sman khar mur ba'i cho ga bstan pa/ ga pur dang / gla rtsi dang / gur gum zhib mor btags te/ gi 2wang dang bsres na gong du bstan pa'i sngags rnam pa na gsum re re cayang lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ chab gtsang mas sbyar nas ril bu riche chung shing mgo 6stong gi 'bras bu tsam du bgyis te / yang sngags gong ma gsum lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas grib ma la bskams ri te/ gdugs dang / rlung gis ma phog par bgyis nas ril bu 8re re la yang gong ma'i sngags rnam pa gsum lan bdun bdun gyis btab ste/ril bu (9gcig khar mur nas rgyal po'am/ blon po nye phan nam/ skye bo'i tshogs mang po dag la gtam bgyis par gyur na bkur sti bgyis nas/ nor dang / rin po che dag phangs 1 pa ma mchis par ci dang ci 'tshal ba thams cad 455 bar 'gyur/ tshig tu smras so 11'tshal thams cad kyis yid ches shing nyan par 'gyur/ bsgo ba zhig mchis na yang thams cad nyan cing bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /khar sman mur ba'i tshe rtag par sngags bzla 'tshal te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smon pa rnams 'grub par bgyid lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyi mdun du spos chab kyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 12chu zheng 1 khru bzhis 'khor ba gcig 1 bgyis te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rtsi shing gi me tog rnam pa sna tshogs ci 'byor pa bkram shing 15tsan+dan dkar sapo bsregs nas sman gyi ril bu 1 snga ma blangs te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bzhag 18nas/ rgyal mtshan bzhi gzugs shing / yol ba dang / bla re 903—365

dkar po bres 915te dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pad+ma dkar po bzhi yang bris te/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa bgyis lags pa'i rjes la snying po'i sngags dang / snying gi snying po'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla bar bgyi'o/ /lus kyi sngags kyang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas tsan+dan dkar po 2bsregs te/ me tog gtor na de'i tshe smon pa thams cad kyang 'grub rdo par 'gyur la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang na mchis pa'i sman blangs te lus la btags na phyogs gang du mchi yang rung ste(4)/ ci dang ci gnyer ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ tshig tu smras pa thams cad kyis yid ches shing nyan par 'gyur / don du sgrub pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtogs te/ 'di (5)ni yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo las sman myur ba'i cho ga zhes bgyi lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo las sman mur ba'i cho ga'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir skye bo mang po thams cad kyis mthong na 96skubyams shing dga' bar 'gyur ba'i cho ga bstan 7)pa/ man ༷2)shi ri ka ku shu dang /pad+ma le brgan 9dang / pad+ma sngon po dang / rgya mtsho'i chab kyi dbu 7ba dang /nya rkun ma nag po'i rus pa dang / ba blas 17dang / ka kun ban su dang / gi'u wang 12dang / gur gum 1lhadang / rgya'i gur gum bedang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / bca' sga 5rnams cha mnyam par bgyis te/93—366

brdungs nas zhib mor btsags te sman snga ma srang gcig 1mchis na gla rtsi dang /ga pur rdo srang phyed stsal nas zhib tu brdar note/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs kyi mdun du sbyar ba tsho rabagyis lags pas/ snga ma'i sngags rnam pa gsum re re yang lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying brtse (5riba'i sems bskyed nas sman de dag byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rkang pa'i drung du gzhag 6par bgyi'o/ /de'i rjes la reg par bgyis nas/ khar ba'i thur mas 7blangs te mig tu stsal na mig dang / klad 985pa bro 'tshal ba dang / ling tog gis 9bsgribs pa thams cad dang / sprin dkar dang / mchi ma 'dzag pa dang / sprin dmar dang /long nad dang / klad 97pa bro 'tshal ba thams cad sos par 'gyur lags so/ /rtag par gdugs re bzhin du sman 'di mig tu stsal na mig nad thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gdugs gnyis stsal na lus kyi bro nad thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gdugs gsum stsal 11na smyo ba'i bro nad rnam pa brgyad cu 32rtsa bzhi 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gdugs bzhi stsal na 1 phyi nang gi sgrib pa thams cad kyis sgrib par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdugs lnga stsal na dgra dang 'thab pa khan thams cad du rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /gdugs drug stsal na sdig pa'i las dang / nyon mongs pa dang / lci ba bzhi dang / mtshams tsham mchis pa lnga dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / byad stems 7thams cad rnam par 'joms shing1 / ngan 'gro rnams su nam yang ltung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gdugs bdun stsal na rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dang / skye bo mang po thams cad rjes su 'brang zhing bkur snyi bgyis nas yid ches shing byams par 'gyur ro/ /93—367

zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar du stsal na rang dbang chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gsum gyi bar du stsal na rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dag dang 1mdza' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bzhi'i bar du stsal na gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rim gro bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag 3lnga'i bar du stsal na lha ma yin dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin rnams nodang / srin po rnams g.yog bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag drug gi bar du stsal na nam mkha' lding dang / srin po lamathu chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis mngon par rdzogs par 5'tshang rgya ba'i bar du yongs su bsrung 6)bar bgyid pas/byad stems dang / 'dre gdon rnams kyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du stsal na lha nag po chen po dang / 'dre srin brgyad rnams nye bar lhags nas rjes su 'brang zhing g.yog bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag brgyad kyi bar du stsal na an+t+rad 7nar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag dgu'i bar du stsal na gter thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu'i bar du stsal na lha ma yin gyi khang khyim gyi sgo rang bye nas/ de na ci mchis pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyuran/ 'byung zhing 'jug pa la thogs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu gcig gi bar du stsal na sman zhugs ltar 'bar ba ji snyed pa thams cad mngon sum du dga' bar 'gyur bas tshe ring bar 'gyur 'tshal lam/ mthu chen po dang ldan par 'tshal na'ang 9de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu gnyis kyi bar du stsal na drang srong mang po rnams kyis rin po che'i gter rnams phye ste/ nye bar bstan nas yid bzhin du longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu gsum gyi bar du 93—368

stsal na/ klu'i gzhal med khang rnams sgo rang bye nas lta ba dag la thogs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu bzhi'i bar du stsal na 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang dag sgo rang bye bar 'gyur bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bco 1lnga'i bar du stsal na mtshan mo mun nag gi nang du yang gdugs 2bzhin du gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu drug gi bar du stsal na sa'i 'og gi rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor yang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu bdun gyi bar du stsal na gling bzhi po rnams su sems can dmyal ba'i sems can ji snyed mchis pa yang thams cad mthong bar 'gyur la / de'i mthu'i dbang gis sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcwa cachibargyad kyi bar du stsal na gang zag 5de nyi ma lta bu'i mthu thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag bcu dgu'i bar du stsal na lag na rdo rje'i lus yang dag pa 96 nyid mthong bar 'gyur bas smon pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do / /zhag bdun phrag nyi shu'i bar du stsal na spya/na ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje chen po dang ldan pa mthong bar 'gyur bas smon pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /zhag bdun phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du stsal na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa thob par 'gyur/ gzugs kyi khams kyi lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang gi sgo rnams rang bye nas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lo gcig gi bar du stsal na yongs su dag pa'i mig lnga 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /gang la la zhig spyod 903—369

pa'i cho ga 'di mngon par 'grub par 'tshal ba gang lags pa des/ bstan pa 'di la shin tu mngon par yid ches par bgyi zhing / sems can la snying brtse bar bgyi ste/ the tshom ma mchis na gong du bstan pa bzhin du thams cad 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te the tshom 1'tshal bar 'gyur rin cho ga rnams grub ( par dka' 4ste/ 'di ni spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi tsan+dan 55)de'i 56)nor bu'i 'khor lo las mig sman gyi cho ga zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sems kyi 'khor lo 57rilas mig gi nasasman gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan yang sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ sgrub pa'i don thams cad grub 9)par byed pa/ nyon mongs pa dang / kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa dang las ngan pa thams cad rnam par 'joms 1 pa/ dgra thams cad 'dul ba/ bi nā 11ya ka khro ba'i sems nye bar zhi nas skye bo mang po la gnod pa mi byed cing / byams pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur ba/ sbyin sreg 12hom bkra shis kyi cho ga bstan pa/ dog sa brkos te zhugs thab khru gang gru bzhi pa cig sna bgyis nas me tog ma 6len tsa su dang / yungs shar 15dang / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / chab mar cha mnyam par bsres 17te/ a ga ru dang / tsan+dan dang / shing dri can so so nas srid du sor bcu gnyis zheng du sor gcig mchis pa gtubs 1 te/ thab tu bsreg /shepar bgyi zhing sman nyung zad cig blangs nas lan cig 1(sngags kyis btab ste/zhugs kyi nang du dor ba lan stong rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis na las kyi sgrib pa 93—370

thams cad rnam par 'joms zhing tsho/ tshe lo brgya nyi shu thub par 'gyur lags so / /zhag bdun gyi bar du rgyun chad pa ma mchis par hom gyi cho ga bzhin bgyis na tshe lo stong thub cing lus kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar du cho ga bgyis na rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po nye phan dang / skye bo phal pa 2rnams kyang skyabs su mchis nas bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun phrag gsum gyi bar du cho ga bzhin du bgyis na sum cu 4rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa dang / nyi zla'i lha dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa yang nye bar lhags nas yongs su srung bar 'gyur/ lag na rdo rjes kyang dngos grub chen po stsol bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis kyang smon pa chen po rnams yongs su skong 95)bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yul 6khams su char dkon par gyur na yungs gar 7tshodang / chab mar la sngags 'dis btab ste/ gdugs gsum gyi bar du zhugs kyi nang na du bsregs na char pa 'bab par 'gyur/ gal te char ches te mi khums na thab de'i thal ba blangs nas sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis btab ste79/ gnam du gtor na char pa khums par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ser ba ma rungs pa babs sam/ rlung drag po glo 1 bur du langs par gyur na yang thal ba de blangs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste/ sprin mchis pa'i phyogs su gtor na zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /sngags 'di rtag 11par bzlas brjod bgyis na mthu stobs mthu bo che dang 'dra bar 'gyur bas/ lus 'di spangs nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba 1 can du skye bar 'gyur/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du skye ba thams cad du sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran 93—371

pa thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tsan+dan 1gyi snying po'i 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di bdag gis bstan pa bzhin du dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/skyes pa'am/ bud med gang la la zhig gis lan cig tshona'achang bar bgyid na gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur bas the tshom ri gyi bsam pa bskyed du par mi bgyi'o / /yid la bsams pa'i don thams cad thob par 'gyur bas shin tu mngon par yid ches par bgyi zhing the tshom rabaskyed par mi bgyi'o56ri/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la khyod snying rje chen pos yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs kyi cho ga gya rnam pa 7'di yang dag par bshad de/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar byas pa legs so legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod do/ /gang la la zhig gis sems bskyed de kha nas bzlas brjod byas na dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yin mod kyi ngas bstan pa bzhin du sems can rnams la yang nas yang du nan tan brtson 'grus kyis rjes su bstan nas dngos grub thob par bya ba'i ched du lus nye bar ston la/ nga'i tshig dag ci 'gal bar ma byed cig dang / nga yang rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis pa nas byams pa dang brtse ba'i sems kyis sems can la rjes su ston cing / rtag par yongs su bsrungs nas dngos grub stsal bar ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis nyamakhyen cing 943—372

dbang du gyur pa lags so/ /sems can rnams kyi slad du yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di bshad pa lags pas/ gang la la zhig gis len cing 'chang ba dang rtag par bdag nyid bzlas brjod bgyi ba'i grangs tshang bar 1bgyis na smon pa rnams grub 25par 'gyur te/ bdag ni de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi mthus sems can thams cad 4sdug bsngal ba rnams yongs su bskyab par bgyid pa lags so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs 'di smras pa dang / 'khor 'dus pa chen po thams cad rab tu dga' nas mngon par yid ches pas yang dag par blangs te spyod par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gzungs las/ sbyin sreg 5༄hom gyi cho ga sman sbyor ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so6// //zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha 7ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa brje 8chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa9 1 93—373

355 (1)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skasdo du smos pa ltar bkod/ (25〈〈li 〉〉 yig mkhan gyis sdeb sbyar ji lta bzhin mthon pa dang / bar skabs su zhus dag pas grags tshod dang mi mthun pa mang po bcos nas 'dug cing / khyad par ut+pal dang / gur gul dang / zhabs 'bring zhabs 'bring dang rgyu'i dkyil 'khor gyi brkyang nul zhes pa zhabs rdzogs ka na 'ga' yar dang po yig mkhan gyis dris 'dug pa ma gtogs/ bskyang nul du bzhag nas ma bcos pa mang po 'dug pa rnams ni kho bos brkyang nul bar bzhugs shing 'di'i thog nas gsubs shul du ma 'dri/ dag pa rnams ma bsgyur bar zhog cing yi ge 'dri ba/ ri mo 'dri ba rnams thams cad 'bri ru bsgyur ba rnams ni 'dir ru bcos yod pas 'bri ru ma ni re re la lung rnam dag gi zin so dang / skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa'i brda chad dang / mdo rgyud kyi don grags tshod la 'thob pa'i dbus gtsang gi chos du ma bzhugs pa rnams dang brda chad gcig par bzhugs kyi bde skyid dang phan bde rab 'byams tshad med pa'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rag lus/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang thos bsam bsgom gsum dri ma med par byed pa dang / sems can gyi 'gro don rnams yin pa la sogs pa du ma la bltos dgos pa rnams ni/tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ dam pa'i don ni mi 'gyur zhes pas kun rdzob gyi chos rnams la blangs dor phyin ci ma log par shes na don dam pa'i chos byed de/ de ni sangs rgyas so/ /rgyu mtshan des na kho bos dka' dgu la ma bsams par bstan pa'i zhabs tog sems can gyi 'gro don khyad par du drung rin po che chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' khrims gnyis kyi rgyu rin po che las grub pa be+e drur+ya'i mthing shog la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzhun mas 'dri ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhings pa'i phyi mo byed pa la dmigs nas shin tu dag par bcos pa po ti re re'i dbur gsal ba gsal bar yod cing 'dir yang zur tsam smos pa ni de dag rnams kyi don la bsams nas dgas kyis mthon pa'i zhus dag bgyis pas chos 'di rnams dbus gtsang gi sa cha na shin tu dag par bzhugs pa yin no/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a sba lo ki te shwa ra te su ko ṣā ༄ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra e ka da sha mu kha nā ma dhā ger tsā/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes ri bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang du mas yongs su bskor te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/4 lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das snying po gdong bcu gcig pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ni/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu gcig gis gsungs pa lags te/ de sems can thams cad la sman pa dang bro nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 5bgyid pa dang sdig pa dang bkra mi shis pa dang / rmi lam 93—379

ngan pa thams cad zlog 1par bgyid pa 2dang / dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad zlog par bgyid pa cadang ma zhugs pa rnams dad par bgyi ba dang /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du bshad par bgyi'o / / bcom ldan 'das snying po 'dis bsrung ba bgyis pa 5dang /yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba 6bgyis pa dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba 7bgyis pa dang chad pa spangs pa dang / mtshon cha spangs pa dang / dug gzhil bar 8bgyis pa dang / gang la la zhig 'gal ba 49bgyid pa de ma mchis te/ de ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa na bdag gis ma 1 mthong ste/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs lags so/ /snying po 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis bstod cing dgongs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rjes su thugs rangs par 11mdzad pa lags so / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dran lags te/ bskal pa gang gā'i 1 klung gi bye ma snyed kyi snga rol na de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma brgya'i spyan gtsug gis chags pa'i dus 'joms pa'i 'od zer gyi rgyal po zhes bgyi ba byung ste/ bdag drang srong du gyur pas de bzhin gshegs pa de las 'di mnos lags te/ thos ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon du gyur/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa yang thob ste/ de ltar bdag gi snying po 'di ni gces spras bgyid pa lags so/ /de ltar 1 lags pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pas gus par bgyis la snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /gzhan yid 93—380

la mi bgyid par rtag tu brjod par bgyi'o/ /nang par langs nas brgya rtsa brgyad bton na tshe 'di la yon tan bcu yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gzung 1bar 'gyur ba dang / des bsgrim mi 'tshal bar nor dang 'bru dang dbyig rnams rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / dgra thams cad khugs shing thul bar 'gyur ba dang / rgyal po'i tshogs 2rnams gsong por smra bar sems par 'gyur ba dang / lus la dug gis mi tshugs pa dang / dbyig dug gis mi tshugs pa dang / rims kyis mi tshugs pa dang / mtshon gyis 4mi tshugs par 'gyur ba dang / chab kyis 'gum pa'i gdus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / zhugs kyis 'gum 6pa'i dus bgyid 7par mi 'gyur ba dang / dus ma lags par 'gum pas 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba 8lags so/ /gzhan yang yon tan bzhi yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ 'gum pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / ngan song rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ya nga ba ma spangs pas 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dran lags te/ 'di nas bskal pa gang gā'i 9klung bcu'i bye ma snyed dag gi snga rol gyi 1 yang ches 1 snga rol na 32de bzhin gshegs pa man dā 1 ra ba'i bsung 7zhes bgyi ba byung ste/ de na bdag khyim par gyur pas 'di bzung tshanas bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil lags so/ /bdag gis snying po 'di bton pas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi snying rje 'jug 7pa ye shes kyi snying po 903—381

zhes bgyi ba thob lags so/ /gang dag bcing bas bcings pa rnams dang /gang dag bcing ba la thug pa rnams dang / chab dang / zhugs dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis nyen pa'i sems can thams cad la bdag gi snying po 'dis gnas 1dang bskyab pa dang skyabs 5dang dpung gnyen bgyi'o/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po sdang ba rnams kyang snying po 'dis bkug naXl byams pa'i sems dang snying rje'i sems su bgyi ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba lags so/ /lan cig ri skubarjod pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 5'gyur/ mtshams rinem mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus par 'byang 7bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bshad na pa bzhin du nan tan bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni smyosangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba lags na/ bzlas brjod bgyid pa dang / sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te bsam 1 pa thams cad yid bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /su zhig bdag gi slad du tshes bcu bzhi'am bco 11lnga la smyung 12ba bgyis na/ de bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil bar 'gyur ba 1snyelags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ming 'dzin pa ni don mchis te sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyi bas lhag lags so/ /bdag gi ming 'dzin pa'i sems can thams cad ni phyir mi ldog pa nyid la gnas par 'gyur/ bro nad thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ sgrib pa thams cad dang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi nyes par spyod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba tsolags so/ /gang la la zhig cho ga bzhin du sbyor ba bgyid na de dag gi sasug par sangs rgyas kyi byang 93—382

chub thob pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod sems can thams cad la de ltar snying rje che ba legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu thabs 'dis sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par nus te/ ngas kyang snying po 'di 1gzung 2zhing rjes su yi 5rang ba byas kyis ri༄rigs kyi bu khyod pasmros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 6zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te snying po 'di smras so/ /na mo rat+na 7dra yā ya/ na ma /ār+ya dzñā 9 na sā tsheg ra bai ro tsa na byu ha 11rā dzā ya12/ ta thā ga tā 1 ya/ ar+ha te/ samyakle bud dhā ya'i/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ ar hata mabh+yaḥ samyakla pudhe tebh+yaḥ1 /na ma 1she ār+ya a 19ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo 2 dhi satā 21ya/ ma hā satā ya /ma hā kā dis ru ṇi sobyutā ya/ tar+ya thā 5/ o dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru / sir+bhe bar+bhe tsho/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me/ ku su ma/ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma 2 pa na ya 2 swā hā/ 'di'i cho ga ni sgrub 21mi dgos par las thams cad byed de/ rims nyin gcig ri pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / 'byung po dang /mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'dre dang lus srul po dang / brjed byed dang / lba ba dang / 'bras kyi phreng ba dang / bas lngags ril sogs pa dang / dug dang /phol mig dang / g.yan pa la sogs pa la 'jim pa la bsngags ri te bsku'o/ /lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis rin las kyi sgrib pa sbyang da bar bgyi'o / /byis pa gdon gyis zin pa la ni 'bru mar ro/ /rna ba bro 'tshal ba la ni ru rta dang 93—383
