༄ga /'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i rig sngags kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/1༄zag / rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mu kha da shi ka bit+yā ma n+t+ra hre da ya nā ma dhā ra tsā/ bod skad dun/ 'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i rig sngags kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na 'od ma'i myu gu'i dkyil 'khor na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med grangs med pa dang thabs cig 4tu bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa ni 5gtso bor gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma tshad med pa snyed dang / lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye tshochen po dang /93—387

grul bum dang / sha za dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa la sogs pa'i 'khor mang po dag gis yongs su bskor nas mchod cing rim gror byas/ bkur ster 1byas / bla mar byas te gsang sngags brjod pa la chos ston par mdzad 5do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug drang srong rig sngags 'chang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa dag gis yongs su bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ g.yas phyogs su lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la rig sngags kyi snying po gdong bcu gcig pa zhes bgyi ba 3mthu chen po dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu gcig gis gsungs pa mchis te/ deng bdag gis sems can thams cad la sman cing bde bar bgyid pa dang / bro nad thams cad zhi bar bgyid pa dang / sdig pa thams cad sbyang ba dang / bkra mi shis pa thams cad bzlog par bgyi ba dang /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad dgag pa dang / cadus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad bzlog pa dang / ngan sems can rnams gdul zhing dang ba thob par bgyi ba dang / mya ngan gyi sdug bsngal 5dang ldan pa dag bde ba thob par bgyi ba dang / 'khon dang bcas pa 6rnams 'dum par bgyi ba dang / bdud dang gdon bgegs rnams zhi bar bgyi ba dang sems kyi smon pa rnams mngon par 'grub par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa la sogs pa la 7gang gis kyang rig 903—388

sngags 'dis bsrung bar bgyis pa dang / 'di len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / yi ger bris nas spel bar bgyid pa de dag la bgegs bgyid pa dang / bdud kyi bar chad dang / mtshon cha dang dbyig pa dang dug dang / byad stems thams cad kyis gnod pa 1bgyid par 'gyur ba ma lags so/ /bdag gis rig sngags 'di gnas pa'i phyogs su ring yang rung nye yang sbyo rung ste/ ci tsam du mtshams bkum pa las 'das nas gnod pa bgyid du mchi ba ma mthong lags te/ sdig pa'i las nges par rnam par smin par gyur pa ni ma gtogs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das des dngos po 'di nges par de lta bu lags par rig par bgyis nas mngon par yid ches pas blang bar bgyi'o / /rnam par rtog pa ni mi bgyi'o/ /de ltar bgyis na gdon bgegs thams cad thag ring du spong bas nye bar mchi zhing glags rnyed par mi 'gyur lags so/ /rig sngags kyi snying po 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mtshungs par bsngags pa brjod cing mtshungs par rjes su thugs rangs par 5mdzad pa lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs shing 6yongs su bsrung ba mdzad pa ri lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mngon par dran lags te/ bskal pa gang gā'i naklung gi bye ma snyed kyi sngon rol na9/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 1 sangs rgyas pad+ma brgya'i 11spyan thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i gtsug tor 1 yon tan rab tu rgyas pa'i 'od zer gyi rgyal po zhes bgyi ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ bdag de'i tshe drang srong du gyur pas bcom ldan 'das de las rig sngags 'di mnos lags te/ rig sngags 'di thob pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang mthong bar gyur15/ mi skye ba'i 903—389

chos kyi bzod pa yang thob par gyur pas rig sngags 'di mthu chen po 51dang ldan par rig par bgyi lags so/ /de lta bas na yongs su dad pa naridang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pa dag gis rig sngags 'di len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / 'don par 'tshal na/ gus pas sems rtse gcig tu dran pas bcangs te/ rtag par nang par langs nas chos bzhin du yongs su dag par bgyis te/ rig sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na tshe 'di nyid la phan yon rnam pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba lags so/ /bcu gang zhe na/ rtag par lus la bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / rtag par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs su gzung ri ribar 'gyur ba dang / nor dang / rin po che dang gos dang / zas bas pa ri4ma mchis pa dag la longs spyod par 'gyur ba dang / dgra thams cad thul cing 'jigs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / ya rabs btsun pa rnams kyis bkur 5zhing gsong por smra bar 'gyur ba dang / dug cadang 'dre gdon gyis mi tshugs shing gnod pa bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / mtshon cha dang / dbyig pa thams cad kyis gnod pa 7bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / chab kyis 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / zhugs kyis 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / dus ma lags par 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dag lags so/ /gzhan yang yon tan gyi sman yon rnam pa bzhi thob par 'gyur te / 'gum pa'i dus kyi 8tshe sangs rgyas rnams mthong bar 'gyur ba dang /nam yang ngan 'gro rnams su ltung 9bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ya nga ba ma spangs pas 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bde 93wa 390

ba can du skye bar 'gyur ba dag lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mngon par dran lags te/ 'di nas bskal pa gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed dag gi snga rol gyi yang ches snga rol na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas man dā ra ba'i dri bsung zhes bgyi ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe bdag khyim bdag chen po zhig tu gyur pas/ sangs rgyas de la rig sngags 'di mnos lags te/ rig sngags 'di thob ma thag tu bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil lags so/ /rig sngags 'di klog pa dang /'dzin pa dag gis gzhan yang sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje chen po'i ye shes kyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i chos kyi sgo thob par 'gyur te/ de'i mthu stobs kyi dbang gis gang dag btson 1ra dam por chud pa dang / btson char nastsal ba dang / dgum pa la thug pa dang /chab dang / zhugs dang / rlung dang chom rkun dang / dug dang byad stems dang mi dang / mi ma lags pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bgegs thams cad las yongs su skyob par bgyid pa lags so/ /bdag ni 'di'i dbang gis sems can thams cad kyi gnas dang skyabs dang / yongs su skyob pa dang / yongs su bsrung ba dang / dbugs 'byin pa dang / gling dang khang khyim du gyur pa lags so/ /rig sngags 'di'i mthus gnod sbyin dang /srin po ma rungs pa la sogs pa thams cad yongs su bsdus shing bzung canas sngar byams pa'i sems dang snying rje'i sems bskyed du stsal nas/ de'i rjes la bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par bgyis 5lags so / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi rig sngags 'di'i zhigazi byin chen po'i mthu 93—391

dang ldan pas/ gang la la zhig gis lan cig tsam bzlas brjod bgyis pa na yang rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi dang / mtshams ma mchis pa lnga ma lus par yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin du sgrub 1)pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ gang dag sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma las dge ba'i rtsa ba skrun napa rnams kyis deng gdod rig sngags 'di thos par gyur pa sa lags na/ len pa dang 'dzin pa dang / ji skad bstan pa bzhin du sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ gang la la zhig gis la gdugs mtshan du rig sngags 'di klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'dzin par bgyid na/ bdag gis de dag gi smon pa ci mchis pa yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyid lags so/ /gang la la zhig gis zla ba phyed cing tshes bcu bzhi'am bco 55lnga la smyung ba bgyis te/sdom pa yang dag par blangs nas chos bzhin du yongs su dag par bgyis te/sems rtse gcig tu bdag rjes su dran par bgyis nas rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni rig sngags 'di'i dbang gis ming btsun zhing thos par dka' bar 'gyur 6lags te/ gang la la zhig gis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma'i mtshan nas brjod cing yid la bsams 7pa dang / gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gis skad cig gcig tsam du bsam pa thag pa nas/ bdag gi ming nas brjod cing rjes su dran par gyur na de gnyis kyi yon tan mnyam zhing mtshungs lags so/ /bdag gi ming nas brjod pa de dag thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob 8par 'gyur/ bro nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur/sgrib pa thams cad dang 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur/ lus dang (303—392

ngag dang yid kyi nongs pa zhu byang bar 'gyur na bdag gis bstan pa'i rig sngags 'di len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / 'don pa dang /ci skad bstan pa bzhin du sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags te/ gang zag de dag ni bla na ma mchis pa'i byang chub lag mthil na mchis pa bzhin du khong du chud cing legs par 'gyur bar rig par bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so legs so zhes bsngags pa brjod nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can thams cad la de lta bu'i byams pa dang snying rje'i bsam pa bskyed 1nas/ rig sngags chen po 'di rnam par phye ste bstan pa yin pas khyod thabs 'di'i dbang gis sems can thams cad kyi nad kyi sdug bsngal dang / sgrib pa dang bgegs dang 'jigs pa dang lus dang ngag dang / yid kyi nyes pa las yongs su skyob cing thar bar byas nas sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar la rnam par 'jog pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu nga yang rjes su yi rangs rinas khyod kyi rig sngags yongs su bzung canas khyod kyis smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rig sngags 'di 'don pa gang lags pa des 'di skad du dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par 93—393

phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod par bgyi lags so/ /tabya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sir+bhe/ brtse1ri/ tsa leci tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me/ ku su me/ ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti tsi ti/ dz+wa la ma rin)pa na ya/ shud+dha tā gciswā hā/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ri kā ya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di rtsa ba'i rig sngags lags te/ gang la la zhig gis rjes su dran zhing bzlas brjod bgyis 5)na gong du bstan pa lta bu'i yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa dag 'thob par 'gyur lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod 6pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 7chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ha ha ha ha/ i li mi li/ tsi li pi li/ khi li hi li swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni chab dang gos la gdab pa'i sngags lags te/ gang la la zhig dkyil 'khor du 'jug par 'tshal na sngar khrus bgyis te de'i rjes la sngags 'dis chab la lan bdun btab ste / lus la gtor nas bsang bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sngags 'dis lan bdun btab ste gzod 8bgo bar bgyi lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs 93—394

pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang 1ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo / /tar+ya thā/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ha ha ha ha swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni pog spos dang / mar me la gdab pa'i sngags lags te/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas pog bsregs te mchod par bgyid pa'i tshe sngar sngags 'di pog spos la lan bdun btab ste/ gdod bsreg par bgyi'o/ /mar me spar bar 'tshal na yang sngar sngags 'dis 'bru mar la lan bdun btab ste gdod mar me spar bar bgyi lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus napar phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ si ri si ri / dhi ri dhi ri/ si ri dhi ri swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni me tog dang /byug spos dang / phreng ba la gdab pa'i sngags lags te/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ me tog dang / byug spos dang / phreng ba dag gis mchod pa bgyid pa'i tshe sngar sngags 'dis me tog la lan bdun btab ste/ sku gzugs la gtor bar 4bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sngags 'dis byug spos la lan bdun btab ste sku gzugs la byug par bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang sngags 'dis phreng ba la lan bdun btab ste sku gzugs la brgyan par bgyi lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum 93—395

la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la gus par 1 phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa ril gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /tabya thā/ sa te sa te/ si ti si ti/ su dhu su dhu swā hā/bcom ldan 'das 'di ni sangs rgyas la mchod cing dbul ba'i zhal zas la gdab pa'i sngags lags te gang la la zhig zhal zas dang / me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pas sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i tshe sngar sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te btab nas de'i rjes la gdod mchod par bgyid lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ ma si ta si/ tsa le tsa le/ hu ru hu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni yam shing la gdab pa'i sngags lags te gal te la la zhig gong du bstan pa'i rtsa ba'i rig sngags kyis bgyi ba mchis te sngar sngags 'di me tog sha ta'i shing la lan cig lagadab par bgyi'o/ /zhugs 'bud par 'tshal na logs shig tu me tog sha chi5ta'i shing blangs nas dum bu sum cur gtubs 6te/ zho dang mar dang sbrang 93—396

rtsi'i nang du sbangs nas/ zhag lon par bgyis te gdugs re dum bu re re blangs nas sngags lan re btab ste zhugs kyi nang du dor bar bgyi'o/ /de dag thams cad bas par bsregs nas de'i rjes la gdod bgyi ba ci mchis pa bgyi lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ i 1li mi li/ bi li ti li/tsi li hi li swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni mtshams dgum pa'i sngags lags 2te mtshams dgum par 'tshal na sngar sngags 'di chab la lan bdun btab ste phyogs bzhir gtor bar bgyi'o/ /yang na yungs kur ram thal ba gtsang ma la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste phyogs bzhir gtor na sems kyis nye ring ci tsam dgum pa mtshams 4su gyur na yongs su bsrung bar 'gyur lags so/ /dkon mchog gsum la 5gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad bkod 6pa'i rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/tsi ṭi tsi ṭi/ bisne bisne / ka tsa ka tsa/ bha ga bān / ār+sha ba 9lo ki te shwa rā 93—397

ya / sa bha 1sa bha sa bha rna swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag slar rang gi gnas su mchi bar bskul ba'i sngags lags te/ bgyi ba ci (gemachis pa bgyis lags nas bdag slar rang gi gnas su mchi bar bskul ba'i tshe sngags 'dis chab la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste 45)phyogs bzhir gtor na bdag slar mchi bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rig sngags 'di ni dngos grub mngon du ma gyur lags kyis kyang las su bgyi pa rnam pa sna tshogs bgyid pas sems rtse gcig tu bzlas brjod bgyis na smon pa rnams mi 'grub pa gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /gang zhig myos cand gdugs re re (5)lan re ldang ba'am/ gdugs gnyis shing lan re ldang ba'am/ gdugs gsum zhing lan re ldang ba'am/gdugs bzhi zhing lan re ldang ba'am/ gdon 'byung pos bgyis pa'am/mkha' 'gro mas bgyis pa'am/ sha zas bgyis pa'am/ lus srul pos bgyis pa'am / smyo byed kyis bgyis pa'am/ brjed byed kyis bgyis pa'am/ 'dre gdon ma rungs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bgyis pa yang rung ste/ nad pa de dag la sngags 'dis lan brgya rtsa brgyad btab na 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te sgrib pa lci ba zhig lags na/ tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la sngags lan re bzla zhing re re mdud de brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bgyis nas nad pa'i mgul pa'am/dpung pa la btags na kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa zhu byang zhing bro nad kyang sos par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te spangs pa dang / 'bras kyi phreng ba dang / shu ba dang phol mig dang / rma 'dzag pa dang / g.yan pa la sogs pa'i nad ma rungs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 6bro 'tshal bar gyur tam ral gri dang / mda' dang / mdung la sogs pa phog ste smyos par gyur tam/ sbrul dang / sdig pa 93—398

dang / rtsangs pa dang / bung ba dang / gdug 51pa la sogs pas zin par gyur na/ sngags 'dis tsho lan bdun bzlas te btab nas /sos par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te sgrib pa lci ba zhig lags na/ dog sa ser po'i 'jim pa la lan bdun sngags kyis btab ste bro 'tshal ba'i dmigs su byugs na sel bar 'gyur lags so/ /gal te rlung nad na ba'am phyogs gcig pa langs par gyur tam rna ba 'on pa'am sna 'tshubs 4pa'am rlung gis zin pa'i nad la sogs pas 5bro 'tshal bar gyur na/ sems rtse gcig tu sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis nas nad pa de dag la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab na nad sos par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te sgrib pa lci ba zhig lags na 'bru mar dang / chab mar dang gro dang / ru rta 6rnams bskol te sngags lan bdun btab nas lus la bskus 7sam rna ba dang snar blugs sam 'tshal du stsal na bro nad sos par 'gyur lags so / /gzhan yang bro nad gzhan rnam pa 8sna tshogs kyis bro 'tshal bar gyur na/sems rtse gcig tu sngags 'di gdab par bgyi'o/ /yang na bdag nyid kyis bzlas brjod bgyis na 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ / gal te 9rig sngags 'di bsgrub par 'tshal na/ sngar sra zhing 'phan 1 skyon ma mchis pa'i tsan+dan dkar po las tsho byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs srid du mtho phyed dang do mchis pa/ sug pa lag pa g.yon pa na pad+ma le brgan 1 dang ril ba thogs pa lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas bgrang 1 phreng thogs shing /'jigs pa ma mchis pa stsol ba'i lag tu ston pa gdong bcu gcig par bgyis te mdun gyi gdong gsum ni byams pa dang snying rje dang bcas pa'i mtshan dang ldan par bgyi'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi gdong gsum ni khro bo'i mtshan can du bgyi'o/ /93—399

g.yas phyogs kyi gdong gsum ni mche ba dkar po gyen du 'byung ba'i mtshan can du bgyi'o/ /rgyab kyi gdong gcig ni khro gtum che zhing rab tu dkon pa'i mtshan can du bgyi'o/ /spyi bo'i gdong gcig ni sangs rgyas kyi zhal gyi gzugs can du bgyi'o / /mgo rgyan de dag thams cad kyi nang na yang sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhugs par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de'i lus ni do shal la sogs pa 1rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan par bgyi'o/ /gzugs bgyis lags nas smon pa rnams grub 5)par 'tshal ba gang lags pa des gos sar pa gtsang ma bgos te smyung ba bgyis nas sdom pa yang dag par blangs te zla ba dkar po yar gyi ngo tshes gcig nas tshes brgyad kyi bar du gdugs gcig la dus gsum du sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad dam yang na dpag tu ma mchis par bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /de slan chad gnas dben pa zhig tu stan gtsang ma bting 4ste byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs bgyis pa bzhag 5nas kha nub phyogs su bstan te nyams kyis ci 'byor pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba dag gis mchod nas a ga 6ru dang du ru ska 7sku'aba' zhig 8gis bsreg par bgyi'o/ /rnal 'byor pa de 'bru phye ri9 dang 'o ma'i zas 'tshal nas snga ma bzhin du bzlas brjod bgyis te gdugs gsum pa la thug pa'i bar du bgyi'o/ /de slan chad mchod pa'i yo byad bshams pa yang snga ma bas ches khyad par du 'phags par bgyi'o/ /rnal 'byor pa de zas dkar gsum tshepo 'di lta ste/ 'o ma dang zho dang / 'bras chan 11'ba' zhig 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi shing blangs nas gzugs de'i mdun du zhugs spar bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang shing de blangs nas dum bu stong rtsa brgyad du gtubs te du ru sku'i 12mar gyi nang du 93—400

sbangs nas gdugs gcig la dum bu gcig blangs te/ sngags lan re bzlas nas 6)zhugs kyi nang du dor bar bgyi zhing thams cad bas par gyur nan de'i tshe sa chen po rnams rab tu g.yo bar 'gyur la de'i dbang gis sku gzugs bgyis pa de ri yang rab tu g.yo zhing nang gi gong na mchis pa'i gdong gi kha nas sgra byung nas rnal 'byor pa de la 'di skad du rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis 'di ltar nan tan brtson 'grus kyis smon pa rnams yongs su gnyer bas bdag gis khyod kyi smon pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /khyod 'di nas nam mkha' la 'phur te 'gro ba'am/ yang na khyod rgyu zhing 'gro ba cal thogs pa med pa'am/yang na drang srong rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po byed par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na bdag ci lta ba bzhin du rang dbang thogs pa med pa nyid du bya'o zhes bsngags 5pa brjod par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pas zla ba dkar po yar gyi ngo tshes bcwa ri lnga la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs gdong bcu gcig pa de sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi nang du bzhag 47ste/ gos sar pa gtsang ma bgos 8la gso sbyong dang sdom pa yang dag par blangs te gdugs mtshan gcig la rab tu smyung bar bgyis nas/su ma na'i me tog stong rtsa brgyad blangs te/ me tog re re blangs nas sngags lan re btab ste9/ thams cad bas pa'i bar du bgyis na de'i tshe gzugs bgyis pa de'i mdun du gdong gcig gi kha nas 'brug sgra lta bu'i sgra byung bar gyur la/de'i dbang gis sa chen po yang rab tu g.yo bar gyur pas rnal 'byor pas de'i tshe rang gi sems bde bar bzhag 1 nas skrag cing 'jigs pa mi bskyed 11par rig sngags dang / smon cing sgrub 12pa gang lags pa 'ba' zhig 1 rjes su dran par 93—401

bgyis te/ 'di skad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nam zhig na sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs su gyur nas sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi smon pa rnams yongs su bskong bar 'gyur zhes brjod par gyur na/ de'i tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis ci ltar smon pa rnams stsol bar 'gyur te/ smon pa rnams stsol ba'i tshe lha dang klu la sogs pa gang gis kyang bar chad dang bgegs bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pas zla ba la gza' zhugs pa'i tshe chab mar sung gcig blangs te/ dngul gyi snod kyi nang du stsal nas gzugs bgyis pa'i mdun du bzhag 1ste/ sngags 'dis bzlas brjod bgyis na zla ba yang snga ma kho na bzhin du skyabs 'og tu gyur pas de nas blangs te 'tshal na lus kyi bro nad rnams mi 'byang ba gang yang ma mchis lags so/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pas ldong ros dang gi wang cha mnyam par bgyis te/ gzugs bgyis pa de'i mdun du bzhag (gunas sngags 'di lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te chab kyis sbrus nas dpral ba la thig le bgyis na/ don rnam pa gsum 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /sngar bstan pa bzhin du chab dron po dang sbyar te khrus bgyis na bgegs thams cad dang bro nad ma rungs pa thams cad bsal zhing 'byang bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gal te pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis g.yul 'phrog par gyur na/ min ci dmar rtsi 'bras bu cig blangs te sngags ca'adi lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis btab nas / gzugs bgyis pa de'i g.yon phyogs kyi khro bo'i gdong la byugs te/dgra'i phyogs su kha bstan na dgra'i dmag tshogs rnams drung du mchi bar mi 93—402

'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gal te yul phyogs su mi dang phyugs la rims nad byung bar gyur na/ gzugs bgyis pa de'i mdun du shing shug pa'i zhugs bus la (1)gzhan yang shing rinade blangs nas dum bu stong rtsa brgyad du gtubs nate dum bu gcig blangs nas yungs 'bru'i mar gyis ri chibaskus te/ sngags lan re bzlas nas zhugs kyi nang du dor bar bgyi zhing thams cad bas pa'i bar du bgyi'o / /gzhan yang skud pa dmar po las mdud pa bdun mdud de mdud pa lan re mdud cing sngags lan re bzlas nas nang gi gong na mchis pa'i gdong gi spyi bo la btags na rims nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur te/ rims nad zhi nas sngags thag 5)kyang dgrol bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang blo bur du mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'byung po la sogs pa'i gdon gyis zin te bro 'tshal bar gyur na/ skud pa dkar po la sngags mdud nyi shu rtsa gcig mdud de sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud nas mdun gyi byams pa dang snying rje dang ldan pa'i gdong gi spyi 'bo la btags nas zhag lon te slar bkrol 7nas nad pa'i mgul du btags na bro nad sos par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te las kyi sgrib pa lci ba zhig lags te sos par ma gyur na sngags thag de blangs nas yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste snga ma'i gzugs kyi spyi bo la btags nas/zhag lon te slar bkrol nanas nad pa'i mgul du btags na nges par 'tsho bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gang la la zhig bro nad rgyun rims kyis btab nas sdug bsngal zhing sos par ma gyur tam/ 'dre gdon ma rungs pa khyim du zhugs par gyur na/ hun lug thang 'brum bu brgya rtsa brgyad blangs te gzugs bgyis pa de'i mdun du 'brum bu re re blangs 9la sngags lan re btab nas 93—403

zhugs kyi nang du dor bar bgyi zhing thams cad bas pa'i bar du bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang skud pa dkar po la sngags mdud (1)nyi shu rtsa gcig mdud de sngags lan re bzla nazhing mdud pa re re mdud nas/ mdun gyi byams pa dang snying rje dang ldan pa'i gdong gi spyi bo la btags 75rinas zhag lon te slar bkrol nas nad pa'i mgul du btags na bro nad rnams 'byang zhing gdon bgegs ma rungs pa rnams 'byer zhing 'gyes par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang mi mdza' ba dag gis glags 5btsal bar gyur tam/ 'thab cing rtsod pa dang / byad stems kyis gnod pa 6bgyid par gyur na me tog dang pog spos la sogs pa sna tshogs kyis gzugs bgyis pa de la mchod cing bi nā (7)ya ma'i gzugs kyi mdun du zhugs sbar 8nas/ 'un te'i 'bras bu 'brum bu brgya rtsa brgyad blangs te sngags lan re 9btab nas zhugs kyi nang du dor bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang skud pa dkar po la mdud pa brgya rtsa brgyad mdud de/ sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud nas gzugs de'i g.yon phyogs kyi khro bo'i gdong gi spyi bo la btags nas zhag bzhi lon te slar bkrol la/ skud pa de blangs te mi mdza' ba de'i ming nas brjod de mdud pa re re nas so so tha dad par sbas khonas re re la yang sngags lan re bzla zhing re re nas gtubs 11te thams cad bas pa'i bar du bgyis na/ mi mdza' ba de dag ci bgyi'o 'tshal mi 'byor cing rang nyid skyabs su mchi bar 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gang la la zhig legs pa'i dngos po grub par 'tshal na/ tshon 1 sna lnga'i skud pa la nyi sngags mdud brgya rtsa skobargyad mdud de/ sngags lan re bzla zhing mdud pa re re mdud nas/ gzhan yang gzugs bgyis pa'i mdun du sngags lan bdun gyis 12btab ste/ byams pa 9(3—404

dang snying rje dang ldan pa'i gdong gi spyi bo la btags nas zhag lon te slar bgrol 1nas bdag nyid kyi lus la btags na smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /gzhan yang gang la la zhig sgrib pa'i bgegs dang ldan pas/legs pa'i dngos po rnams phal cher 2smon pa yid bzhin du grub par ma gyur tam / bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po dag dus dus su rgyu ma mchis par langs par gyur na spos chab kyis gzugs bgyis pa de bkru bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan yang 3chab la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags 4kyis btab ste bi nā (5ya ma'i gzugs bkru bar bgyi'o / /gzhan yang chab la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis btab ste rang nyid kyi lus la gtor na/ sgrib pa dang bgegs thams cad rang gi ngang gis zhu byang nas / smon pa rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis de skad ces 6༄smras pa dang / 'khor mang po thams cad kyis mthun par skyes bu chen po legs so legs so/ /sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa'i phyir rig sngags 'di smras pas/ bdag cag kyang rjes su yi rang zhing yongs su 'dzin par smon to zhes bsngags pa brjod par gyur to7/ /de nas 'khor mang po thams cad dga' mgu rangs par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyag byas te gyes 8par gyur to/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so9// //zhu chen gyi mkhan po lots+tsha ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban+de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur 1 cing zhus te 11gtan la phab pa// //1 93—405

'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das deng bdag ni bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba bla ma'i 'od las blangs pa kun tu bzang po'i gzungs yang dag par ston par 'tshal te/ gzungs de thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa rnams phyir mi ldog cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang sel to / /longs spyod chen po phun sum tshogs pa yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /lus rnam par dag pa yang 'thob bo/ /ngag rnam par dag pa yang 'thob bo/ /sems rnam par dag pa yang 'thob bo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par bgyid do/ /gzungs rgya mtsho thams cad kyang 'thob bo / /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba thams cad kyang mnyes par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob17/rin chen phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob / 'bar ba'i sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob / rgya mtsho'i 4phyag rgya'i 5ting nge 'dzin kyang thob6/ rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin kyang thob / mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi ting nge 'dzin kyang thoban/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob9/ phyogs bcu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob 1 ste/ bcom ldan 'das de la sogs pa 11ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag gang gā'i nyi klung gi bye ma snyed bdag la mngon sum du gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das des na bdag da ltar dran pa 'di lta bu dang ldan/ blo gros 'di lta bu dang ldan/ chags pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes 'di lta bu dang ldan zhing / mthong ba dang thos pa dang bsnyen bkur bgyis pa'i /lha93—427

don mchis par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag thos pa don mchis/gzungs 'di thos pa 1don mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar mdzad cing 'khor bzhi po de yang yongs su dgod du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can dag pa de'i dus la bab par shes na smros shig /de bzhin gshegs pas 'khor bzhi po 'di byin gyis brlabs ri zin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs canas gzungs 'di smras so/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 55sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ kha 6ga me kha ga me/ tsa k+ṣu kha be/ sho tra kha be/ ghā ṇa 7 kha be/ dzi hwa kha be/ kā naya kha be/ ma na kha be/ sa ra kha be/ sa ra kha be/ sa ra kha be / shu na tra kha be/ a na mi 9ta kha be/ a pra ṇi 1 hi ta 11kha be/ sa mā dhi 1 kha be pā ra/ mi tā kha be/ bo dhi kha be/ sa ra sa ra sa ra/ sarba bud+dha 1 a rnyikhri te1 / bha ra bha ra bha ra dharma a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ ka la ka la ka la/ sat+ta a rnyikhri te / na mo dā pon ba ti rnal/ bud+dha 1 ko ṭī 418/ a dhiṣ+ṭhan+tu 19man/ tsa ta sra par+ṣa na do ā 21yur ba lan 22tsa da dan+tu lha/ tar+ya thā/ su ra bhi su ra bhi/ ma hā su ra bhi/ mu ni mu ni/ ma hā mu ni/ ma ti ma ti ma hā ma ti/ na mo rat+na 2 tra yā ya / na ma 2 ār+ya 20a na ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā 2 ya/ sa mṛ dān+tu mā 29na/ sa man+ta t+t+waṃ bha dra dhā ra tī 1swā hā/gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis 93—428

po de dag gis dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to1/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dag ni gzungs sna tshogs thob par gyur to/ /gzungs 'di'i cho ga ni 'di lags te/ nang par langs nas lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /phongs par gyur pa'i tshe lan bdun yid la bgyis na thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rims 2nad thams cad la rna bar bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /rlung gis zin na mar dang 'bru mar la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bgyis te bsku bar bgyi'o/ /so na na so shing la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te bca' bar bgyi'o/ /rna ba na na ras bal gyi sa bon 'bru mar dang lhan cig tu bskol ba la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te/zangs kyi snod kyis rna bar blugs par bgyi'o/ /klad 4pa na ba la 'bru mar ro/ /lto na ba la byab par bgyi'o/ /gdon gyis btab pa la tshon skud sna lnga la 5lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te mgul du gdags so/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon gyis ( btab na 'bru mar la lan bdun bzlas te gshis thams cad du byug go/ /nad thams cad la byab par bgyi'o/ /'di ni sgrub 7pa ma mchis pa'i cho ga'o/ /ji 8ste sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang / gzungs dang /ting nge 'dzin 'thob pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang / mi snang bar bgyi ba dang / mig bsku 9ba dang / ldong ros la sogs pa sgrub par 'tshal na/des sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dang sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ bum pa gang ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzhag 1 la/ gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bres te/ me tog sna tshogs kyis chal 1 par bkang la 93—429

༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ lo ke shwa ra kulpa/ bod skad du/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 2rtog pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten mgon po'i rtog pa ni/ /mdor bsdus 'dir ni brjod bya ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyud chen po/ /'dod pa'i don kun rab ster ba/ /dang por re zhig dararig pa 'dzin pas gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs su hūm̐ gis dag par byas par gnye bar 'dug cing pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā 5ba ād+ma 65ko3 7haṃ zhes brjod la/ thams cad stong pa'i rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la / oṃ tsit+ta /pra ti bho 9sgo ka ro mi/ de ltar brjod la sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bom brgyad par bsgoms nas/ pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par 93wa 434

bya'o / /zla ba'i steng du hrīḥ'i 917sngags gyur pa las bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug tu bsgom par bya ste/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung (2gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ mdog dmar ba/ mchan ri༄du ni gos dkar mo de la 'khyud pa/pad+ma dmar po kha 'byed cing gar gyi tshul can khab kyi phyag rgyas kha 'byed par bsgoms la/ 'di brjod par bya ste/ ji ltar pad+ma dmar po ni / /'dod chags skyon gyis mi (5)gos shing / /de bzhin sna tshogs bag chags skyon/ /khams gsum rnam par dag pa'o/ /dbu rgyan la 'od dpag tu med pa 6bsgom par bya'o / /de nas 'di brjod par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta 7badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma (3ko3 9 rta/ de ltar bsgoms nya tshonas phyogs brgyad du lha mo rnams (lhabasam mo/ /oṃ bi lo ki ni/ a ba lo ki ni/ a ba lo kā 12ya swā hā/shar gyi 'dab yonam la ni 〉rnam par gzigs tsham zhes bya ba'i lha mo pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta tshare tu re swā hā/ lho'i pad+ma la bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma pa la sha'i 'dab ma lta bu'i pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ bhu ri ṇi 1 ma hā tsakra brti ni hūm̐/ nub kyi pad+ma 18la bhu ri ni 19zhes bya ba'i lha mo ut+pa la sngon po lta bu'i pad+ma phyag na 2 snabasnams pa'o/ /oṃ skṛ 21ku ṭī tā re tut+ta 22ma ta 2 rtsu/ byang gi 'dab ma la khro gnyer can zhes bya ba'i lha mo pad+ma ser po ri bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā shrī sa ye ma ṇi sa pad+me hūm̐/ 'di ni pad+ma'i gos can shar phyogs kyi mtshams su btsod lta bu'i pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+me shwa ra ma ra pad+me hūm̐/ lho phyogs kyi mtshams su pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ bi shwa pad+me (28/ 'di ni sna tshogs kyi pad+ma ste/ nub phyogs kyi mtshams su pad+ma nag po bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ bi shwa bag tre 39rtsu/ 'di ni sna tshogs kyi zhal can te/ byang phyogs kyi 93—435

mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ hrīḥ 1pad+ma nadhe (5)shwa ra hūṃ hūm̐ ze 'bru'i dbus su 'dod chags chen po'i bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs kyi 54)dbang phyug go/ /de ltar gang bsgom 5pa dang ldan zhing ting nge 'dzin la goms par byed na dngos grub brtan 6por 'gyur ro/ /de'i 7sangs rgyas nyid dang 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ster ro/ /sangs rgyas pha rol phyin grub cing / /gzungs dang sa yang de bzhin no/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde ston cing / /so so rang nyid rjes su sgrub/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni byang sems nyid/ /rang rgyal nyid kyang de bzhin no/ /yid 'ong sangs rgyas go 'phang ni/ /spyad mi dgos 8par 'grub par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dang 9ga pur bcas/ /tsan+dan khodamar dang rab sbyar te/ /rdo rje chu dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bcud len yin/ /sbyor ba bzang po 'di yis ni/ /bcud kyis len ni 11bde bar 12yang / /'grub 'gyur 'jig rten mgon po yi15/ /gzhon zhing nad med dam bde zhing / /tshe dang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang / /skal 3 bzang ye shes bla na med/ /skye ba 'di la 'grub skapa'o/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub/ /dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba dang / /gsad sadang bskrad pa la sogs pa/ /rengs 1 dang phur bus gdab nyid dang / /nam mkhar 1 'gro ba de bzhin no/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug thob 'gyur zhing / /ting nge 'dzin la gnas par 'gyur/ /de phyir ting 'dzin ldan pa yi 9/ /rdo rje dam tshig de yis ni/ /rig pa dang ni bcas pa'i mchog /'jig rten mgon por 'grub par 'gyur/ / o hrīḥ pad+ma narte 21shwa ra 2 rtsu/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na nyin mo dang nub mo byas pa'i sdig pa nyams par 'gyur ro/ /yang na lnga brgya bzlas brjod byas na 903—436

nad thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na stong bzlas brjod byas na dus ma yin par 'chi ba med par 'gyur ro/ /yang na stong phrag gnyis bzlas brjod byas na/ thams cad kyi 1nomachod pa'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang stong phrag gsum bzlas brjod byas na skal ba bzang ba dang / g.yang rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang stong phrag bzhi bzlas brjod byas na dbul ba med par 'gyur ro/ /2 stong phrag lnga bzlas brjod byas na dgra thams cad kyi snying 'khrug par byed do/ /stong phrag drug bzlas brjod byas na dgra thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag bdun bzlas brjod byas na bdud bzhi las mchog tu rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag brgyad bzlas brjod byas na rig 'dzin ma grub par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag dgu bzlas brjod byas na gnod sbyin mo grub par 'gyur ro/ /khri tsho gcig bzlas brjod byas na lha dang klu dang / mi'i bu mo rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag nyi shu bzlas brjod byas na bar snang la 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor ma rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag sum cu 4bzlas brjod byas na bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag bzhi bcu bzlas brjod byas na mkha' la spyod pa'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag lnga bcu bzlas brjod byas na ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag drug cu 5ribazlas brjod byas na grub pa'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag bdun cu 6bzlas brjod byas 7na sa gsum gyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /stong phrag brgyad cu nabazlas 9na 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gcig bzlas brjod byas na byang chub sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag bcu bzlas brjod byas na rang 11dga'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /bzhi 93—437

cha dang bcas pa'i 'bum phrag bzlas brjod byas na sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro17 / /bye ba phrag gcig 2bzlas brjod byas na/ thams cad du rjes su 'dzin par byed pa'i nus pa can spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lta bu 'grub par 'gyur zhing lus dang ngag dang yid kyang byin gyis rlob bo/ /'di ni bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rjes gsungs pa'o/ /oṃ paṇ+ḍa ri (8)ba si ni ba ri du stade hūṃ/ 'di ni gos dkar mo'i sngags te lan cig 5brjod pas sdig pa'i rigs kyi tshogs sreg 5)par byed do / /nub bdun gyi nang rol du rgyal po blon po dang bcas pa mdun 58)na 'don dang / skye 'gro'i tshogs dang btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi skal 597ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i rim pas 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na gang yang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang nus pa mnyam zhing / dngos su 'phags pa spyan ras 1 gzigs dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bi lo ki /lhani a ba lo kā 12ya swā hā/ 'di'i sbyor ba ni stong phrag bcu bzlas brjod byas na me long dang / mtheb 1 chen dang / nam mkha' la sogs pa la gsal por skopra dbab pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gang sngon byung ba dang tshad ltar dang phyis 'ong ba de ston par byed do/ /yang na so shing la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig mngon par bsngags 9par byas la/ nub mo nyal ba'i dus so shing tu 'chos nas mi smra bar nyal na dgos pa gang yin pa rmi lam na 18ston par byed do/ /de yang 'khrul 17pa med par ston no/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta 2 re tu re swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma 'di 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na 'jig rten gsum 21grub par 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu mo dang / klu'i bu mo dang / mi'am ci'i bu mo dang / gnod sbyin gyi bu mo 93—438

dang / mi'i bu mo ste/ 'di rnams kyi nang nas gang 'dod pa de'i chos 'byung du gur gum 51)dang / rgya skyegs nadang / rang byung gi me tog dang / byang chub kyi sems dang yang dag par ldan pas rtsibs drug pa shin tu rno ba'i 'khor lo dmar po 'khor bzhin pa rnam par bris pa bsams nasal/ chos 'byung de sgrub pa pos ri sul chu ngogs gsang riba'i gnas su bsam 55par bya'o/ /de yang myos shing sgrub pa po'i steng du ltung ba'i rnam pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de bkug 6la rang la chu shing nor dang bcas pa dbang du 'gyur bar blta'o zhes bya'o/ /yang na lha dang / klu dang lha ma yin dang / mi 'am ci dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang /gnod sbyin dang / 'khor los sgyur 7ba dang / blon po dang / skyes bu'am gang 'dod pa de dmar por rnam par bsams la/ de'i snying gar 8rdo rje lcags kyu 'od 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug 59pa'i lcags kyus 'bigs bzhin 1rtapa dang /zhags pas ske ba (stonas bcings la dgug 12bzhin pa 'dod pas myos 1 par gyur par blarab tu gsal por bsam par bya'o/ /bdag nyid nor dang bcas pa 'gugs shing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya'o/ /o bhu ri ni tsham hā tsakra brti tshani hūṃ/ 'di'i sbyor ba ni dri chen dang / rdo rje chu la sogs pas dkyil 'khor byas la ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog gis mnyam par mchod la/ de na gnas 1 pa'i sgrub pa pos gling ngam gling gzhan dang / grong khyer dang grong dang / yul 'khor gyi rgyal por bsam zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ / de yis 1 bdag po nyid du 'gyur zhing longs spyod 19la 2 tsholongs spyad 21nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ skṛ 22ku ṭī tā re tu ta ma ge ta hūm̐/ lha mo khro gnyer can zhes bya ba 'di ni dgra'i rkang rjes kyi rdul blangs la/ dug dang /93—439

tshwa 1dang / ske tshe dang / khrag dang / chu bo'i 'gram gnyis kyi sa dang / dri chen rdo rje chus bsnos la gzugs brnyan byas la mi'i rus pa'i rang bzhin gyi ri phur bus tshigs dang gnad kun la btab la/ thod pa kha sbyar dzo nogyi nang du bzhag 5ste/ dur khrod kyi me la gdung bar bya'o/ /zhag bdun du sbyor ba byas pas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sems la sdig pa med par gyur na zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis ni sangs rgyas kyang 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma hā shrī 6)ye ma ṇi smyo ripad+me rtsu/ lha mo 'di la dri 8dang / me tog dang / mar me dang / bsod snyoms kyi 9zas kyis so sor mchod la bzlas pa byas na thams cad du bsrungs par 1 'gyur ro/ /yul chos kyi rtsod pa las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /nor chen po'i bdag por 'gyur ro/ /yang na pad+ma stong phrag bcu sbyin sreg 11byas na 12rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+me shwa ri ma ra pad+me hūm̐/ rdo rje pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma 'di yid kyis bzlas na dbang dang 15dgug pa la sogs pa byed do/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags ñtsate / gtsug phud mdud na rang bsrung 5zhing rims dang / lkog nad dang /nad thams cad dang / mtshon dang / me dang / rkun po dang / seng ge dang / glang po che dang / sbrul dang / 'ching ba dang / rgya mtsho dang / sha za'i nad stong phrag gcig bzlas pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig gi salas kyis brjed 1 byed kyi gdon dang / zad byed dang / skyug pa dang / bri bar dka' ba dang / bsgom 1 par dka' ba'i gdug pa can gyi sems can thams cad nyams par byed do/ /'bum phrag gcig bzlas na lus 'phel zhing skal ba 19bzang ba dang / lus gzhon zhing nad med par byed cing dus ma yin pa'i 'chi 93—440

ba nyams par byed do/ yang na klu thab khung du bris la der dug dang / ske tshe dang tsha (1ba'i sbyin sreg 2bya zhing klu'i ming dang spel bas 'bum phrag gcig sbyin sreg 4byas na char chen po phab rinas mu ge med par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bi shwa pad+ma nehrīḥ(7risna tshogs pad+me 'di 8ni rmongs pa dang / rengs pa dang / mnan 9pa dang / phur bus 1 tshogadab pa dang / gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa dang / phur bu dang / mig 'phrul dang / ngo mtshar dang mi 11mthong bar byed pa dang / phug tu 'jug pa dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / lcags sgrog gcod 12pa dang /ril por dgug pa gang dang gang yin pa rgyud las bstan pa dang / rgyud gzhan dang yang dag par ldan pa'i las thams cad byed do/ /lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyi dngos grub ster ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'grub cing gang 'dod pa'i las thams cad ni 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bya'o/ /oṃ bi shwa pad+me hūm̐/ sna tshogs rdo rje zhes brjod pa'i lha mo 'dis ni ngag gi dngos grub ster ro/ /tshig shad 1 mkhan du byed cing gzhan gyi ngag rengs par byed do/ /rang nyid bsrung 1 ba dang / gzhan yang bsrung 15bar 'gyur ro/ /rang skal ba bzang zhing gzhan po layang skal ba bzang po'i rang don dang gzhan don byed do/ /ji ltar 'dir 1 ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sems can gyi don la spro zhing brtson pa de bzhin du/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das mas 1 dmyal ba dang / yi dgas 19dang / byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams sgrol bar byed do/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la dad pa rnams la ma nyid kyis bsrung 2 ngo zhes thugs kyi rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /de ltar rtogs 21pa'i rgyal po bsdus pa rab tu bstan 952—441

to / /sems brtan rtog pa med pa yi/ /blo dang ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod lam bstan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun rgyu ji lta bar/ /de ltar 'dir ni rab sbyar nas/ /de nas rtag pa'i go 'phang 'grub/ /ji ltar 'dod par gnas byed cing / /kun la longs (1)spyod kun byed ltar/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i snying rjes dzonasaspyod/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i spyod pa yis/ /'dug pa'am ni langs kyang rung 3/ /'chag 4pa'am ni gang dang de/ /rgod pa'am ni brjod pa'am / /gang de ji bzhin 5don bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs pa'am / /sgrib pa kun dang ldan pa yang / /rang mos lha yi rnal 'byor bdag /bsod nams chung ba'am 6'grub par 'gyur/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /thams cad mkhas pa nyid dang ni/ /thams cad rdo rje 'chang nyid kyang / /skye ba 'di la 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor dag ni gzugs brnyan gyi/ /bcos ma'i sku las 'gyur ba min/ /byang chub sems chen la brtson na/ /rnal 'byor dag ni de lta yin/ /khrag chen po dang ga pur bcas / /tsan+dan 7dmar dang bsres pa ni/ /tshogs kyi nang du zhugs pa na/ /kun las mchog gyur bcud len no/ /sbyor ba bzang po 'di yis ni/ /bcud kyis 2len ni sla ba ru/ /dpal 9rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe bzang dang / /nad med bde ba bzang po 'thob/ /grub pa'i mtshan nyid ji ltar gsungs/ /sangs rgyas pha rol phyin pa dang / /gzungs dang sa yang 7de bzhin 'grub/ /bde ston thams cad thob 'gyur zhing / /rang nyid so so 11rjes su 'grub/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nyid du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos nyid kyang / /sangs rgyas kun ni rab grub 'gyur/ /93—442

gzhan yang rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa byed par 'dod cing sems yongs su dag pa med na de'i tshe thang sku'i sgrub (1pa bshad de/ bsnyen gnas dang ldan zhing smyung nyanabar gnas pa'i lha bzos ri ritshon sna ma 'dres par ri riras gsar pa de yang rang rang gi kun tu khru re'i tshad kyis bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bri bar bya ste/ sna tshogs kyi (5༄pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze 'bru'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das mdog dmar ba mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan 567can/ zhal gsum pa/ zhal gyi gtso bo ni dmar ba ste/'dod chags chen po nyid kyi phyir ro/ /g.yas pa gnag (7pa ste zhe sdang chen po nyid kyi phyir ro/ /g.yon pa dkar ba ste gti mug nyid kyi phyir ro/ /phyag drug pa bya'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gcig gis gos dkar mo'i mgrin pa nas 'khyud pa dang / pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis me tog gi gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas pa gsum du khab kyi phyag rgyas pad+ma kha 'byed pa dang /me tog gi mda' dang / lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /sems dpa'i skyil (8mo krung 9gis gnas pa 1 bya'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la rnam par gzigs ma mdog dkar mo / /pad+ma dmar po dang rdo rje phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la lha mo sgrol ma ljang gu rgya skyegs kyi 11shing gi lo ma dang rin po che phyag na bsnams pa'o / /nub phyogs kyi 'dab ma la bhu ri ni 12ser mo ut+pa la sngon po dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs kyi 'dab sna ma la khro gnyer can ni 1 pad+ma dkar ser lta bu pad+ma ser po dang ral gri phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /shar gyi mtshams su pad+ma'i gos can ma gser lta bu'i mdog btsod lta bu'i pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi mtshams su rdo rje pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma nam mkha'i mdog can dkar mo 93—443

pad+ma 1dang shel gyi phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi mtshams nasu sna tshogs kyi pad+ma ston ku'i zla ba lta bu dkar ser gyi mdog pad+ma nag po dang po ti phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs kyi mtshams 4su sna tshogs rdo rje ma sna tshogs kyi mdog can du byas la/ sna tshogs kyi rdo rje dang / sna tshogs kyi pad+ma bsnams pa'o / /de ltar pad+ma la bkod cing bris la/ sgeg mo la sogs pa rnams 5mtshams 6su'o/ /dzaḥ: baṃ hoḥ'i yi ge las yang dag par byung ba'i lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog dang / dril bu rnams ni 7 shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su'o/ /yang thang nasku gzhan brjod par bya ste/ ston ma'i zla ba lta bu'i dkar ser gyi bcom ldan 'das g.yas na skud pa dang / dbyug pa dang / rtse gsum dang / mchog sbyin pa'i phyag 9can/ g.yon na pad+ma dang /ril ba spyi blugs dang / zhags pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i dam tshig gi po ti bsnams pa'i phyag can/ stag gi pags 1 pa'i sham thabs 'chang ba/sbrul mchod phyir thogs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la 'od dpag med bzhengs pa'am skyil krung 11phyed pas gnas pa dbu rgyan du byas pa'o/ /de'i 12g.yas phyogs kyi cha ru sgrub pa po/ /mchod yon gyi snod dang bdug spos kyi snod lag pas gzung ba 1 bya'o/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das phyag gnyis pa ri gru 'dzin la gnas shing seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ g.yon pa sa la gnas shing zhabs g.yas pa pad+ma'i steng gi gdan stengs su sabazhugs pa'o/ /phyag re re na phreng ba bsnams par sems pa pos phreng ba'i 'og tu 'dren pa'i tshul 'dis bsam par bya ba ni sems pa lta bur gnas pa 15zhes bya'o/ /cho ga gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das dkar zhing dmar ba 10phyag bcu pa ri dgas 1 seng ge'i gdan la pad+ma'i 93—444

steng du skyil krung 1phyed pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas na phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /seng ge dang / glang po che dang / me dang / sbrul gyis 'jigs pa rnams las grol ba'i cha byad can no/ /g.yon na pad+ma dmar po sdong bu gnyis pa steng du po ti can te rkun ma dang / lcags sgrog gis bcings pa dang / mtsho dang /thog chen po dang / sha zas za ba rnams sgrol ba'i cha byad can no/ /gnas de brgyad du sgrub pa 25po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa sngon bzhin du langs pa'am/ 'dug pa 3bsam par bya'o/ /gzhan yang cho ga ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das sna tshogs kyi gzugs 'chang ba/ dbu bcu gsum pa/ spyi bo'i mgo bo 4ni ljang khu'i rta 5zhal lo/ /yang na zhi ba sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhal lo/ /phyag brgya pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'di ni sna tshogs kyi mtshon cha bsnams pa'o/ /yang na zhal brgya pa phyag stong pa yang bya'o/ /kha cig tu rdo rje skyil mo krung gis tshiganas pa'am / bzhengs pa yang bya'o/ /tsam pa ka 7lta bu'i dkar ser gyi bcom ldan 'das so/ /thang sku de kun gyi g.yas phyogs kyi bar du sgrub 8pa po me tog dang /mchod yon gyi snod dang / bdug /spos kyi snod lag pa na 1 gzung ba 11bya'o/ /de rnams kyi dbu la dbu rgyan du 1ge'od dpag med pa'am/ chos kyi rgyal po'i mchod rten bri bar bya'o/ / 'di ni 12thang sku'i cho ga'o/ /thang sku'i mdun du rtsa ba'i sngags ji lta ba 'dod 1 pa de bzla zhing 15bsam gtan yang byas nas/mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod la/ mchod yon snod dang / yongs su gang ba'i bdud rtsi lta bu'i zas dang / sgron ma'i zas la byas nas mchod yon byin te/sngags gang 'dod pa de bzlas pa byas na de la gsungs pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur 93—445

ro / /gsang ba po 1rwani sngags 'di nyid/ /kha cig la yang mi sbyin no/ /blo ldan sems can don brtson pa'i/ /sems brtan pa la sbyin par bya/ /mchod rten las byed nyid la ni/ /blo ldan 'bad pas ( sbyin par bya/ /rang nyid dang ni nor dag gis/ /bla ma la rtag gus par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon rnal 'byor la/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i yon yang dbul/ /gang dang gang ni btang ji byedaka' ba(9/ /mchog tu gyur par 5'dir ni bsngags6)/ /chung ma sring mo dang yang ni/ /bu mo dang ni tsha mo dag /bu mo rgyan kun brgyan par bya(7)/ /glang chen rta dang shing rta dang / /phyugs dang grong khyer rgyal srid dang / /yul 'khor rgyal srid ldan pa dang / /rin chen sna tshogs dag kyang ni/ /gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon dbul//rdo rje slob dpon dgyes gyur pa/ /thams cad rab sbyin dbul bar bya/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa rdzogs sorinas// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzam bha la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha 9)ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa// //nyu sna93wa 446

hūṃ / oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pū dza (1)me gha sa mu dra nasga ra ṇa das ma ye hūṃ/oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ga na dhe 54 pū dza 95)me gha sa mu dra yispa ra ṇa 7sa ma ye hūm̐/oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nai wi r+ya pū na dza 99me gha sa mu dra 1 s+pha ra ṇa 11sa ma ye hūm̐/oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta 1 pū dza (12me gha sa mu dra sasga ra ṇa los ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la pū dza tshame gha sa mu dra 1 tshosga ra ṇa 1nas ma ye hūm̐/ de nas mchod pas 39yang dag mchod/ /stong nyid ye shes las byung ba'i/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis ldan pa'i/ /hrīḥ yig dkar po yang dag bzlas 1/ /sngags kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //2 las dang cho 2geg bstan pa'i phyir/ /dang po zhi ba'i las sgrub na / /yid du 'ong ba'i ljongs 3gedag tu/ /dkar po dang 27po gsal dus su/ /dri zhim chu yis legs byugs te rte/ /me tog dkar po bkram byas nas/ /khrus dang kha zas phyogs mthun ri shepa'i/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug 29ste/ /bum pa dkar po tsan+dan rku chodakar/ /dris bkang shing 1gos 2legs dpar dkri / /maṇ+ḍal dbus su legs par gzhag 5 /hrīḥ 7las byung ba'i sems dpa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ / rgyan rnams rdzogs pa pad+ma bsnams/ /zla ba'i gdan la legs bzhugs pa/ /hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phro ba bsgom / /phyag stong spyan yang de bzhin te/ /rgyas pa'i sku ni mdun bsams nas/ /hrīḥ 9yi 'phro 'du gsal ba ni/ /bzlas pa rab tu gsal ba ste/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya sna/ /na mo rat+na :tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 2dzñā na/ sā ga lhar/bai ro tsa na / 45byu 40ha rā dzā ji ya 8/ ta thā ga tā 9ya/ ar+ha te/ samyakle 93—455

bud dhā ya/1 na maḥsarba ta thā ga te rinasibh+yaḥ/ ar+had bh+yaḥ/k+ṣ-i no samyakle bud+dhā yabya/na ma 5ur+sākyi ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā (7ya/ ma hā kā 98)ru ṇi /kā ya/ a mi 1 ta bha la 11che ge mo shan+tit+pa 12ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o / /r+bha/ rnam par snang mdzad bum pa'i chus3lha/ /gang zhig 7legs par khrus byed pa/ /dri ma thams cad yongs dag nas/ /'bras bu bde ba de bothob 'gyur / /'jigs pa kun las rab sagrol te17/ /myur du chu skyes thob par 12'gyur / /de nas rgyas pa sgrub 'dod na/ /nags tshal shin tu mthug po ru39/ /dri zhim chu yis legs byugs la/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i me tog dgram rmo/ /rgyan rnams yongs su brtags 21nas ni/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 22'dug ste/ /rin chen sna lnga 'bru snar bcas / /rin chen ga 'ur blugs byas las4/ /maṇ+ḍal dbus su legs par gzhag 5 /hrīḥ2 las byung ba sems dpa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser na/ /rgyan rnams rdzogs pa pad+ma 29bsnams/ /phyag stong spyan yang de bzhin te/ /rgyas pa'i sku ni mdun bsams nas/ /mchod pa lnga yis yang dag mchod/ /hrīḥ yi 'phro 'du gsal bar bzlas/ /na mo rat+na mitra yā ya na/ na maḥ /ār+ya dzñā na sā ci ga rā 25yasakyi/ be+e ro tsa nā ya/ byu ci rmoha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya na/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ 9/ ar+had bh+yaḥ samyakle budhe bh+yaḥ 1/ na ma /ār+sā lhab lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā 5ya/ ma hā kā dzin ṇi kā 7ya/ rat+na naku na puṣ+ṭi 9ku ru swā hā/ bang mdzod stong pa'i steng gzhag ste5 / /'bru yis yongs su khongs par 'gyur/ /de nas dbang gi 51las byed na/ /sdud par byed pa'i 52chu klung 'gram/ /pa la sha dang a shwat+tha'i / /me tog dmar por 54ril bu byas/ /93wa 456

bsams nas/ /hrīḥ0)yi 'phro 'du las byung ba'i/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas par byarin/ /na mo rat+na ( tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya 4sidzñā na sā 55)ga rā ri/ya(7) be ro tsa nā ya/ byu naha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya59)/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ1 / ar+had 1mabh+yaḥ/ samyakle budhe bh+yaḥ1 / na maḥ.ār+sā tugeb lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ a 7ka ṭi/ ni ka she15/ ka ṭa ka shes/ ka ro ṭi ka ro ṭa/ tsho/bīḥ 1 swā hā/ oṃ kurma a mo gha/ bi 19badz+ra si ha nā di 3 nirgyu phaṭa/ dri'am byug 5zhunyapa dag la ni/ /btab la lus la byug par bya/ /me tog sngon po mgo la gzhag /maṇ+ḍal chu yis lus la byug /nyi shu rtsa lnga 22bzlas nas 2 ni/ /las rnams thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /de nas bzhi ka na sgrub tsho'adod na/ /bkra shis dus gsum 2 rdzogs dus su/ /ri bo yid 'ong gnas dag tu/ /sa gzhi chag chag legs btab sten / /maṇ+ḍal legs byas me tog ni/ /dri zhim dkar pos yongs gtor te/ /gtsang zhing dag pa'i rdzas rnams dgram/ /gtsang ma bram ze byas te gzhag 9 /khrus dang ku sha'i steng gnas te/ /trīḥ snalas byung ba'i chu skyes steng / /chu shel ri mdog 'dra zhal gsum yang / /'dzum dang ci zhi ba'i bdag nyid /can/ /ljang gu bzhad pa'i gzhal gsum ste(phyo/ /nag po khros ri pa dmar ser skra/ /ser po'i zhal ni na'adzum pa ste/ /dmar po bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu / /ri dgas pags 9pas stod g.yogs shing ci tsho/ /sna tshogs sham thabs mnabs 1pa yi 2/ /zhabs gnyis phyag drug snyemanyam par ribazhengs gi/ /g.yas g.yon dang po thal mo sbyar/ /bar ma pad+ma 7bgrang phreng 'dzin na/ /tha ma mchog /sbyin spyi blugs 'dzin/ /bum pa rnam snang lha mo ni/ / la se 5 ma le gīrti gispe93—458

ste0kyi / nirti nang gi lha mo dganyan /zla ba'i gdan la legs par bzhugs/ /hrīḥdayi yi ge las byung ba'i/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas par bya/ /na mo rat+na 4dra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya 5)tshwa na sā 56)ga rā 577yanas/ bai ro tsa nā 9༄ya/ byu skaha rā 11blo ya / ta thā ga tā (2ya/ ar+ha te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya51ge/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥcha / ar+had 'abh+yaḥ/ samyakle sabudhe bh+yaḥhu / na maḥ.ār+sā 18ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā 19ya rmo/ ma hā kā ru ṇi 2nya'i ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sir+bhe bar+bhe/ tsa ( 2le tsa le/ pra tsa le dpra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma ba 2 re/ i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ye 25swā hā/bum pa'i chu la legs bsgrubs nas/ /lus la byugs pas grub 27par 'gyur/ /cho gas bsgrubs 3 pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas thabs kyi sa rim pa ni29/ /gro ga'am ras sam shing shun la/ /ra yi 'o mas bris pa yi 1/ /tshom bu lnga yi 'khor lo la/ /dbus su sku yi sa bon te ge / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa ste/ /shar du de yang bri bar bya/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pas lhadabus su mtshan/ /lho ru de ni yang dag dgod/ /lnga pa'i dang po bzhi pa'i gsum / /nub tu de ni yang dag dgod /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /e yis 'dirnam par sbyar bas te tsi/ /byang du de ni yang dag dgod/ /dbus su thugs kyi sa bon te/ /shān+ti ri 7ku ru mtshams rnasu'o/ /swā hā dbus su dgod par bya/ /de ltar 'khor lo gsal bkod nas 9/ /dngul lam dkar po'i ga 'ur gzhug /thams cad las kun zhi bar 'gyur/ /yung ba'i chu yis bris pa yi / /puṣ+ṭi 1ku ru mtshams 2su'o/ / tsan+dan dkar po dri zhim zhing / /kham phor ser por legs 93wa 459

par gzhug /rgyas pa'i las rnams grub 17par 'gyur/ /pa la sha yis legs par bris/ /ba shaṃ naku ru mtshams dasu dgod/ /kham phor dmar gapor legs par gzhug /dbang gi las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/5 /nim pa'i chu yis legs par brizhi/ /mā ra ya ni mtshams 7)su dgod/ /lcags sam thod par yang dag gzhug /phrin 8las thams cad grub 9par 'gyur/ /tsan+dan dkar po dri zhim zhing / /zhi 1 bas de ni me la bsreg11 /'bras bu mngar dang 12bcas pa'i shing / /rgyas pas de ni me la bsreg ri /dbang ni pa la sha yi shing / /de la bsregs na khugs par 'gyur/ /nim pa'i shing la tshar gcad sa pa'i/ /bsregs pas phrin tshalas 'grub par 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas las kyi rim pa ni/ /drar laba'i rtswa 1 dang 'bras kyi 'dab/ /til dang yungs kur ci 1 tse la/ /gsang sngags bzlas nas 19grub pa ni/ /da li'i shing la legs bsregs nas/ /thams cad rab tu zhi bar nus / /ku sha star 21bu shug 'brum dang / /stag ma'i 22me tog dmar po lan / /gsang sngags bzlas par 2 rab bya ste pa/ /tsan+dan 26shing la legs bsregs nas/ /rgyas par bya ba'i las grub 2 cing / /nus pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /pa 28la sha yi shing dag dang / /khre dang ci tse mon 29sran la/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa rab bya ste / /pad+ma ka yi 1shing la bsreg 2 /nus pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /thams cad dbang du 'du bar da'agyur/ /gro dang so ba 'bras dang ni/ /bra bo mon sran til nag po/ /gsang sngags rab tu bzlas bya ste ge/ /kha ti ra yi shing la bsreg ne /nus dang ri ldan de 8las rnams ni/ /myur ba nyid du 'grub par 93—460
