chen po 'jam dpal zhes bya ba 'dug ste(1ri/ 'dug par gyur pa de rang gi stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la 92btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dhā /rin rgyal po dbang phyug 'od ces bgyi ba 'khor dang btsun mo dang / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa las rgyal po de mdze dang / phol mig dang /dbugs mi bde ba snying nad 'bar ba byung ste de ji ltar bsal bar bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal sngon 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid la nga 'jam dpal khyed nyid byang chub sems dpa' shes rab chen po zhes bya ba yin la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra 'di nyid byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i mchog ces bya ba yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis stong gsum du sems can gyi don la gshegs pa la seng ge dkar po cig 5dbang du bsdus te chibs pa 6byas/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ mdung 7)rtse gsum pa dang / ral gri dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pa la thogs nas phyin pa la/rgya mtsho chen po las dargal ba'i dus su seng ge bzhag nas khur 9res byas shing byon pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab chen po khyod nyid ni grogs la phan pa'i sems kyis rang gi ral gris rang bkum mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje mchog gi bsam pa la steng 'og bar snang gi klu dang lha la sogs pas bsad dam snyam nas btung ba'i snod bram ze'i thod pa 7lag na thogs/ tri shu 11la rtse gsum pa lag na thogs/ seng ge dkar po la zhon/ mya ngan du ral pa thod du 93—484

bcings nas steng 0 gi lha la bsdigs te/ snying rje'i stobs kyis sems can don byas pas/ /rang gi grogs pos spangs nas gcig tsho rīpu lus/ /lha rnams kun gyis nyes na chad pa'i las/ /grong khyer 'joms shing lha rnams 'gums dpar bgyid / /ces smras 94te/ lha rnams la tri shu 5la gdengs pa dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / mi mjed 6kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / khams gsum gyi lha 7dga' ba'i mdangs phyung ste/ lha'i me tog pad+ma dang / ku mu da nadang / puṇ+ḍa rī 9ka dang / tsam pa ka la sogs pa phul te thod pa bkang ngo / /de nas bar snang gi lha dang / klu dang / dri za dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / grul bum dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci la sogs pa la bsdigs pa/ tri shu 1 la gdengs nas/snying rje'i stobs kyis sems can don byas pas11/ /rang gi grogs pos 1 spangs nas gcig pu lus/ /sde brgyad tshogs kyis nyes na chad pa'i las/ /grong khyer 'joms zhing kyi sde brgyad 'gums 1 par bgyid/ /ces smras te/ sde brgyad la tri shu skal gdengs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen dang / dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzangs saris dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can dang / grul bum gyi rgyal po sprul mgo dgu pa dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can la sogs pa 'khor mang po dang bcas pa dga' ba'i mdangs phyung ste/ seng ge la rin po che'i rgyan phul lo/ /de nas sa'i 'og na gnas pa'i klu la bsdigs te/ snying rje'i stobs kyis sems can don byas pas1 //rang gi grogs pos 1 spangs nas gcig pu lus/ /klu tshogs rnams kyis nyes na 943—485

chad pa'i las/ /grong khyer 'joms shing klu rnams 'gums 6)par bgyid/ /ces smras te/ rgya namatsho chen po tri shu las dkrugs 5)pa dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po ba can ṇa (57dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po dang /de dag la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/ 'od dang ldan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul myong bar byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'bum phrag drug g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa 'dus te/ dga' ba'i mdangs phyung nas klu'i rgyal po ba phyi ru ṇa (3sbrul dkar po gcig tu byas nas phyag 'tshal/ bskor ba lan gsum byas te/byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can/ /khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /klu rnams kun gyi mgon mdzod cig /nyams na klu yi 8rigashed ma mdzod/ /ces smras 9rinas tri shu la la 1 lan gsum dkris 11kha byang chub sems dpa' la bsgyur phuḥphuḥzhes brjod cing gus pas kha nas khrag 'byin cing gnas so/ /klu'i rgyal po gzhan rnams kyang thal mo sbyar nas/ bskor ba lan gsum gsum byas nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can/ /khyod la bdag cag skyabs su mchi'o/ /klu rnams thams cad skyabs su zung 12/ /nyams na klu yi /lhagashed ma mdzod/ /ces smras 1 nas klu chen po brgyad sprul dkar po gcig satu byas nas tshangs skud la 'khris so/ /klu'i rgyal po de rnams kyang bdag cag ni bran bgyid do/ /ci bka' stsal pa nyan no zhes smras nas klu rnams so so'i gnas su dengs so/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' de ni snying rje klu 'dul zhes bya'o/ /snying nad sel ba zhes bya ba'os/ /'jam dpal de ltar sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' shes rab chen po de 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge khyod nyid yin no/ /de'i dus kyi byang chub sems dpa' snying rje mchog de ni da lta'i 'phags pa spyan ras 93—486

gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra klu'i ded dpon chen po 'di nyid yin no/ /'jam dpal ngas rgyal po chen po de'i don du thugs rje chen po'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /yid la zung shig1 /na mo rat+na natra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā lab 5lo ki te shwa rinerarā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā / o a 7ka ṭi bi ka ṭi/ ni ka shen/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi ka ro ṭi/ tsi ti dz+wa 9la ka ro ti bīr tshan swā hā/ gzungs 'di ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cus 11gsungs la/ da ltar nga nyid kyis brjod pa'o/ /'di'i cho ga ni mi dgos pas las thams cad 'grub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sku lugs ma 'am bris sku'i spyan sngar ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung 12bas so sor ma 'dres par maṇ+ḍal brgyad byas te/ maṇ+ḍal re re la me tog tshom bu lnga lnga bkram ste/lha/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /phye ma rnams kyis mchod nas/ maṇ+ḍal re re la gzungs lan bcu gsum bcu gsum gyi bar du bzlas la lci ba de bsdus te/ lci ba lhag ma la bsngags sashing nad pa la byugs na nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lha dang klu la sogs pa'i dug gi nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la grub par ma gyur na/ 'jam dpal thugs rje chen po nyid kyis mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa yin no/ /'jam dpal thugs rje chen po nyid kyis dam bcas pa'i tshig go/ /'jam dpal rgyal po chen po'i gnod pa ni gzungs 'dis snying nad 'bar ba las grol nas skye ba phyi ma la bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal nyon cig /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la sogs pa sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus snying po 'di gsungs so/ /o āḥhrīḥ793—487

si ha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ da lta 1cing nyid kyis brjod de/ rig ri sngags kyi snying po 'di lan cig ri brjod pas sdig tsho pa kun (5)las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /srid pa nyam 6ngar 'gro mi 'gyur/ /lus la mtshon gyis tshugs mi 'gyur/ /dgra dang chom pos mi tshugs shing 7/ /klu 8la sogs pas 'tshe mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bud med lus su mi 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /shi nas bde ba can du 'gro/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob dang /log par dad sel dang / gser thub dang / 'od srung gis kyang gsang sngags 'di gsungs la/ da lta shākya thub pa ngas kyang brjod pa ste/ na mo rat+na 9)tra yā ya / na mo 10ha ya spyi 11hā ya/ na mo lo ki 1 shwa rā ya/ tabya thā/ o hrīḥ/ ku lu yu 1 lu nī la kuṇ+ḍa/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban dha ban dha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hā hā hā hā/ badz+ra kro dha ha ya spyi skab sahrīḥ1 rtsu phaṭa/ 'jam dpal gzungs 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid pad+ma ha 18ya gli 1(ba'i sngags yin te/ lan cig na klog par byed pa'i mi/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /ngan song sgo rnams gcod par 'gyur/ /klu 51sogs gdon gyis 'tshe mi 'gyur/ /byad dang dug las grol 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung na yin no/ /bye ba grangs med mthu las byung / /de yi yon tan dpag tu med / /lan cig bklags 25na sdig pa sel/ /lan gnyis bklags pas dpal dang ldan/ /gsum gyis tshe rnams ring bar 'gyur/ /'bum phrag bcu yis zhal mthong 'gyur/ /pad+ma can gyi zhing der 'gro/ /'jam dpal mi gzhan dag la ni gi/ /khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / /rlung dang grang ba las 93—488

gyur pa dang / /klu rgyal rigs kyis zin pa dang / /klu bram ze'i rigs kyis zin pa dang / klu gdol pa 1dang dmangs rigs 2kyis zin pa ni snying mi dga' ba dang / snying na ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / lto rgyab tu na ba dang /klad kor du na ba dang / gzhogs phyed can ba dang / ma zhu ba dang / sbos pa dang / zha grum gyis btab pa dang / sbrum pa lta bur na ba dang / srog chags su na ba dang / tshigs dang sha khol bur na ba dang / za khu can dang /lud pa glo nacan dang / rus 'khol du na ba dang / 'phres pa dang / zha ba dang / yi ga mi bde ba dang / thor pa lta bu'i nad dang / skran can dang /dmu chu can dang / 'bras dang / me dbal dang / lhog pa dang / gag pa dang / chu thig can dang / grang lhang lhang dang / tsha tsag tsag la sogs pa'i mdze rigs 7can dang / phol mig dang bcas pa dang / lha dang / bdud dang / tshangs pa dang / gshin rje dang / brag srin dang / sems 'khrug gi gdon dang / thab gzhob 8dang / mtsho sman dang / klu la sogs pas zin pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po dang / log 'dren dang / sha za'i gdon rnams kyis zin pa dang / nad sna tshogs 'byung ste/ de yang mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung ba yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal nyon cig /snying po gzungs kyi cho ga 'di/ /dang po thugs rje chen po la/ /gus shing dad pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /snum pa'i sa la dkyil 'khor bya/ /lci ba drir 9bcas byugs nas ni/ /tshon rtsi kha dog 7sna lnga yis/ /dkyil 'khor pad+ma lta bu byi11/ /bum pa gang ba lnga dag kyang / /phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga ru gzhag12 /gang 93—489

ba'i gtor ma lnga yang bshams1/ /seng ldeng (2)phur bu lnga yang dgod/ /dar gyis dkris pa'i mda' bzhi dgod/ /tshon skud lnga yi dra srib bre/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin 4la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gos dkar mo (5la phyag 'tshal lo / /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' klu'i rgyal po ba 6ru ṇa 7skul phyag 'tshal lo/ / ā hrīḥhri tshon po rta rna/ yi ge drug pa'i sngags 'di ni/ brjod 9)pas sdig pa sdug bsngal sel swā hā/ sangs rgyas mchod la brtson par bya/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / phye ma dang / rgyan thams cad kyis mchod nas/ seng ldeng rgya shug me btang la/ /tshon skud bcang zhing 'bru rnams bsreg /rma bya rmag shad lcug ma yis/ /klu yi dug rnams sel bar byed/ / hrīḥnā 31ga le le/ nā ga dum ba le le/ nā ga phuta phuta 12ha le ha le/ hā la hā la/ sgu ṭa sgu ṭa/ nā 1reg khrol khrol shig shig swā hā/ klu dang log 'dren thams cad kyi yid kyi dug dang /mthong ba'i dug dang / bcings pa'i dug dang / kha rlangs kyi dug dang /reg sapa'i dug dang / dug thams cad phyir phud cig swā hā/ dug 'dir ma 'dug ciganyu5 /sbyin par byed pa'i gan du song shigal /'dzin pa'i gan 7du song shig18 /me'i nang du song shig19 /chu'i nang du song shig ri zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ 'jam dpal 'di dag ni de bzhin lhagashegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur geba'o/ / hriḥrlu /i hūm̐ khaṃ/ rigs lngas dbang bskur 2 ba'o/ /rdo rje bsrung 25ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /bkra shis lha mo dpal dang ldan/ /bsnyen 93wa 490

gnas la ni gnas gyur nas/ /dkon mchog rjes dran sems bskyed nas/ /bum chu dag pas las sgrib sel/ /lus ngag sems kyi 1dag pa thob/ /pha rol phyin drug gnas 'gyur zhing 2/ /sangs rgyas sems can mkhyen par 'gyur / /ting 'dzin thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba yi/ /skud pa dkar po sum sgril 4la/ /bzlas brjod nyi shu brgyad byas nas/ /mgul du btags na nad las grol/ /nad la phan pa'i sman rnams la/ /gzungs sngags bzlas shing btab gyur na/ /nad rnams kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /chu la gzungs sngags mang bzlas na5/ /klu nad khong du sel bar 'gyur/ /lo tog za ba kha bcings yin/ /bye ma sa dang thal bas sel/ /ha cang char pa ches pa na / /lha la phul ba'i rnying 7pa la/ /kham phor sar 8pa'i nang du yang / /me tog gtsang ma blangs nas ni/ /bsregs na char pa 'chad par 'gyur/ /ser ba drag po 'ong ba 9)na/ /thal chen yungs kur 1 bzlas brjod kyis/ /ser ba nya lcibs 31lhug ma dang / /lcum po btags te btsugs gyur na/ /ser ba 'chad par 'gyur ba yin/ /lha klu dri za la sogs pa'i/ /gdon ni gnod par gyur pa la/ /dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ /bum pa gtsang ma lnga bzhag ste / /sman sbyar chus ni gang ba la/ /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa 12brgyad bzlas/ /slob ma gos zas dkar por 1 sbyar/ /dkyil 'khor de yi nang du gzhug /bum pa'i chu yis bkru bar bya/ /nad dang gnod pa kun las thar/ /klu sogs gdon rnams dpag med kyis/ /glags kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /bus pa gdon gyis 'jigs pa las/ /gi sawang gis ni srung tsha'akhor bri/ / yungs kur tshedag dang bcas te gdags/ /bus 1 pa gdon dang nad las thar lam du 93—491

zhugs te 'gro ba na/ /thu ba g.yas pa'i gos kyi grwar(1)/ /bzlas brjod bdun byas mdud pa bor/ /song na bde zhing don yang 'grub/ /rta la sogs pa'i phyugs narnams la/ /chu dang yungs kur /ribacas pa la/ /bzlas nas gtor na bde bar 'gyur/ /mi nad phyugs nad thams cad la/ /yungs kur cadang ni bum pa'i chus/ /bkru zhing 5btags na mi nad zhi/ /a mra 6ri yi gzungs sel ltar / /las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal rgyal po 'di'i khong na klu'i dug gis gang nas 'dug ste/ 'di ni klu'i rgyal po ba (7riru ṇa 8 'di yis 9klu thams cad la dbang byed pa yin pas 'dis dbyung tshabar bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po ba 11ru ṇa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po tak+ṣa ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po pad+ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po pad+ma chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po dung skyong la phyag 'tshal lo / /klu'i rgyal po rigs ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o ba 12ru ṇa ya swā hā/o a nan+ta ya swā hā/ o bā gsu kā ya 1 swā hā/ o tak+ṣa kā ya swā hā/ o kur ko ṭā ya swā hā/ o pad+mā 15ya swā hā/ o ma hā pad+mā ya swā hā/ o shaṅka pā lā ya swā hā / o ku li kā ya swā hā/ klu yi tshigazugs ni mang po yang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras zan la/ /legs byas kha dog bsgyur byas la/ /me tog spos dang byug pa dang / /mar me zhal zas sgra snyan dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan me tog phreng / /tshangs pa'i skud pas mnyes par bya/ /rtsa ba lo ma sdong 943—492

bu dang / /me tog 'bras bu sman gyis mchod/ /rma bya gzungs mo me long gis/ /rgyal po 91)khong gi dug thon cigaci ri /rin chen mog shad mchod pa'i rten/ /mi ldog pa yi ri rdzas su chongs/ /bum pa gter gyis gang ba mdzes/ /srog chags yid 'ong gzugs kyis ༷ rimachod/ /zhi 'gyur 'di la the tshom ri med/ / klu yi nergyal po 'jog po yis/ /zin kyang skad cig gcig la thon/ /'jam dpal 'di gzhan gyi mthu ma yin te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de'i mthu'o / /stobs so byin gyis brlabs 7so/ /thugs rje dang ldan pa 'di'i yon tan brjod kyis mi lang yang bdag gis cha shas tsam zhig brjod na/ o bcom ldan 'das/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas/ /khur bor bdag don rjes su brnyes ri / /srid par sbyor 9ba yongs su zad/ /yang dag bka' 1 las rnam par grol/ /sems dpa' 11dbang bsgyur 12thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu pha rol phyin thob pa/ /srid las rgal zhing tshogs/ gnyis rdzogs/ /āḥ1 gzhan la phan brtson thugs rje khucan/ /sems can kun la mchog tu byams/ /khams gsum kun gyi gnyen gcig puska/ /mtha' yas sems can sgrol la mkhas/ /hrīḥsa'agro ba nyam 1 thag kun tu skyob/ /dri ma gsum spangs pha rol phyin/ /mngon shes drug brnyes n+ya gro 18bu/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rnams ni/ /sum cu 19rtsa gnyis dag dang ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes/ /sku mdog shel gyi kha dog 'dra/ /gangs 21ri nyi shar lta bur mtshon/ /sku tshad che la 'od zer 'bar/ /rigs lnga tsho lhasangs rgyas sku la 'phro/ /dbu skra thor tshugs gyen la brjes ri/ /dbu la 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /klu rnams thams cad 'dul mdzad pa/ /rtse gsum sbrul gyis rab tu dkris/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i byin rlabs 'dzin/ /93—493

dug gsum rtsad nas gcod la bstod/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma bsnams/ /shes rab phun sum ral gri 'bar/ /nyon mongs dag pa bram ze'i mgo/ /me tog dri zhim tshogs kyis 1bkang / /klu rnams kun nas dbang bsdus pas/ /sbrul gyi tshangs skud mdzes la bstod/ /si ha/ pad+ma dag tshon)gi gdan la bzhugs/ /bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon rimadzad pa/ /seng ge dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs//'dod pa'i don rnams bsgrub 4pa'i phyir/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan 45gyis brgyan / /ba spu nyag ma re re yang / /sems can kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /phyag 'tshal thugs rje can la bstod/ /tā(6)/ dam chos rgyal tshab dbang bskur ba / /lha mo sgrol ma rjes su 'brang / /'jigs pa brgyad skyob sku mdog ljang / /gnod pa sel ba mi 'jigs sbyin/ /ut+pal thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /btud de )sprul pa mang po 'gyed/ /hūm̐/ gos dkar ma na ni bka' bzhin byed / /yid bzhin 'khor lo bde bar bskor59ri/ /'dod pa'i don yod sdug bsngal zhi/ /'jigs pa brgyad po sel la bstod/ /phaṭa/ ha ya spyi 7ba khro bo'i sku/ /'phags pa rta mgrin bdud bzhi 'joms/ /kro dha mgrin nyu1sngon gdug 12pa 'dul/ /klu bdud 'dul mdzad hūm̐ gis bstod/ /nānyage/ nam mkha' klu rgyal ba 1 ru ṇa/ /chu lha ston pa'i zhal mthong zhing / /bstan la rab dga' klu rnams 'dul/ /sa dang po yi bden pa mthong / /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 'dzin/ /klu rgyal byang chub sems la bstod/ /o tā re tut+ta tsore tu re swā hā/ o saka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni ka ṭi/ ka haṃ ka ra swā hā/ gang gis nyu bstod cing zlos 18pa de mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /93—494

gsang sngags thams cad bzlas par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa stong gi bar du ngan song du mi skye'o/ /bud med 1lus su mi skye'o/ /su zhig nang par langs nas chu dri zhim pos khrus byas tshonasate/ gtsang sbra la gnas nas/ thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i spyan sngar gzungs 'di klog gam/ 'dri 'am/ 'chang ngam/ klog 5tu 'jug gam kha ton tu bton dzinas snying po dang gzungs sngags zlos na ni de'i lus la mdze dang / shu ba dang / phol mig dang / 'bras dang / bas ldags dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang / lhog pa dang / gag pa dang /sbos pa dang / dmu chu dang / skem 7pa dang / mkhal ma rdol ba dang / don snod tshon 'dus pa dang / byad kyi dkyil 'khor la nad sna tshogs 'dus pa dang /glo ba na ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / rlung mkhris 9bad kun 'dus pa thams cad las 7thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzungs 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /su zhig gam rgyal po chen po 17des gzungs 'di glegs bam la bris te 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par byed pa dang / mchod pa dang / yi ger 'dri 1 ba dang / grong ngam / grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs 1dasam/ rgyal po yul 'khor dang bcas pa'am/ gtsug la ga khang du glegs bam 'di 'chang na/ dpal nag po chen po dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / klu'i rgyal po ba 1 ru ṇa dang / klu chen po brgyad rnams slad bzhin 'brang zhing / dpag tshad stong tshun chad 15du slar rgol ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / gdon ma rungs pa thams cad dang / log par 'dren pa dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /bsgom sanyes pa dang / bri nyes pa dang / sngags 93—495

༄zag /na mo rat+na natra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 557ya/ ma hā satā tsho6ya/ ma hā kā 7ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ o a ka ṭi/bi ka ṭi/ ni ka ṭi/ ka tai 8ka ṭi/ ka ro ṭi/ ka ro (9/ bīr+ya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das de'i spyan sngar ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung 1 bas so sor maṇ+ḍal brgyad byas la maṇ+ḍal re re la lan bcu gsum gyi bar du bzlas la/ lci ba lhag ma la sngags bzlas te nad 11pa la nye bar byugs 12na nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te nyi ma bdun nam/ bcu gsum mamanya / nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'grub ste/mtshams med pa lnga byas pa ni ma yin no/ /de ltar ma grub na bdag gis mtshams med pa lnga byas par 'gyur ro/ /seng ge sgra'i gzungs rdzogs so // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang / klogs 15mya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba'o// //903—501

mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/1༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā 2ba lo ki te shwa ra su nā ma aṣ+ṭa sha ta rka54 / bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 5mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas / pho brang ri po ṭa /la'i rtse mo na/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis bkram 9pa/ 'dzam bu na da'i 1 gser gyi kha dog dang 11'dra ba1 / rin po che sna tshogs kyis 1 kun tu 'bar ba'i sa phyogs na bzhugs te/ de na ngalha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang 1lha/ dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / lami dang mi 1 ma yin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas bcom ldan 'das la bsti stang du byas/ bla mar byas/ rim 93—503

gror byas/1 mchod cing bkur stir nabyas te/ yongs su bskor nas mdun du byas pa la chos ston te / thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba / don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ yongs su byang ba/ yongs su dag pa/ ma 'dres pa 4yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su gsal ba5/ 'tshangs par spyod pa 'ba' zhig 7yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/ kye kye sangs rgyas 8bcom ldan 'das/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas9/ /khur bor bdag don rjes su brnyes1 / /srid par 11sbyor ba yongs su zad/ /yang dag bka' la rnam grol sems/ /shes rab shin tu rnam par grol/ /klu 12chen po ni cang shes po1na/ /sems la dbang sgyur 7thams cad kyis/ /mchog tu pha rol phyin pa thob/ /ye shes tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs / /srid pa'i dgon pa rab tu rgalas/ /gzhan la phan pa mdzad la brtson / /thugs rje dang ni 'brel pa'i thugs/ /skye dgu 17kun la rab 918tu byams / / dge ba rab 19brtson 2 byams las byung / /mtha' yas sems can sgrol 21la mkhas/ /bde bar gshegs pa nyid las na skyes/ / bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyi bka'/ /na khams gsum gyi ni 25gnyen gcig po po/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /dri ma gsum ni rab tu spangs/ /rig 2 pa gsum gyi pha rol phyin/ /mngon par shes pa drug kyang brnyes/ /n+ya na gro dha ni 9lta bur zlum/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan rnams ni/ /sum cu 0rtsa gnyis dag dang ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus 1kyang / /sku ni rnam pa kun tu brgyan/ /sku mdog gser gyi kha dog 'dra/ /sku tshad che zhing dkar 5sham po/ /nā ri ga ge sar 93—504

gzhon nu ltar/ /cung zad 1dmar ba 'dra 2ba'i mdog /dbu yi thor tshugs dag dang ldan/ /thor tshugs mang pos nye bar g.yogs/ /dbu la 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /'od zer dag ni rnam par 'phro/ / 'dom gang 'od ni 4rab tu 'bar/ /gser gyi ri 'dra grags pas khyab/ /gzi brjid dag kyang rab tu che/ /shar gyi ri la 'char ba yig/ /nyi ma'i gtsug tor dag dang 6ldan//nor bu rin chen 'bar ba yi7/ /ser la khas 8ni sku phyed brgyan9/ /sa dag 1 la ni rab tu mkhas/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu rnams spyod/ /tshul khrims ma nyams ral ba med/ /thong 11 ka seng ge 'phyong 15ba 'dra/ /sku ni 'jam zhing ldem 1 bag can/ /gzigs shing gshegs pas 'khyu mchog 'dra/ /g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung yang 'dra/ /dpral ba zla ba kham skab 'dra/ /dpral ba'i dbyibs kyi nya rgya yang che/ /smin mtshams 1 bar yang yong 1 ma chad/ / spyan ni nor bu rin chen 'bar19/ /shangs kyi dbyibs ni 2 cung zad mtho/ / tshems kyi sgros kyis rnam par gnon/ /ljags kyis stong gsum khebs mdzad cing / /snyan gyi khung yang rab tu zab/ /21mgur yang 2 bum pa'i mgrin pa 'dra/ /dpung pa dag kyang rab tu zlum/ /phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs kyang ring / /sen da mo 'jam zhing cung zad dmar/ /phyag sor rnams kyi bar yang 'brel 5/ /phyag dang zhabs dzikyi mthil 2 rnams la/ /'khor lo dag gis rab tu brgyan / /ston ga'i 29pad+ma 'dra bar mdzes/ /sku mdog 'jam zhing sha yang ri rgyas/ /gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs 2ltar zab / /yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar 'gyur/ /blta na sdug cing mdangs dga' ba / /pad+ma las byung pad+ma'i mdog 5 /pad+ma dag las kun du skyes/ /pad+ma dag gi dzigadan la bzhugs 7/ /phyag na pad+ma 93—505

bzang po bsnams17/ /ril ba spyi blugs phyag na bsnams/ / kṛt+ta sa ri'i pags 2pa bsnams ni/ /dbyug pa dang ni bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bkra shis dag gis cagatsang mar 'gyur/ /snga 5nas gsung zhing gsong 6por smra(7/ /bdud rtsi'i char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar / /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed9ri/ /bzang por tshonyu snang ba'i ljon shing ltar/ / sems can 11kun gyi gsos su gyur1 / /sangs rgyas kun gyi 1 sprul pa lags/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i cha lugs mnga'/ /1 bde bar gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 15'dzin / /ba spu nyag ma re re yang / /sems can kun gyi lagatso bor 'gyur/ / /bsod nams mdzad cing dge ba mdzad/ /bshol ba med cing nges pa ste18/ /rab tu grags 19pa'i brtson 'grus can/ /'khor ba dag las kun tu rgal rmo/ /dam chos rgyal tshab 1mnga' gsol ba/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo bde bar skorari ci / /don yod zhags pas nyon mongs na 'dren/ / 'phags pa rta mgrin 2 bdud bzhi 'joms / /kro ridha mgrin sngon gdug pa sel/ / chu srin 'dzin khri'i 'jigs las sgrol/ /20lha mo sgrol ma rjes su 'brang 2 / /khro gnyer can ni bka' bzhin byed / /rgyal ba can ni tshul dang ldan/ /mthu chen ldan zhing dran dang ldan/ /yon tan ldan zhing byams dang ldan/ /shes rab ldan zhing dpal dang ldan/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing don dang ldan/ /don rnams kun ni sherig pa po/ /the tshom 29thams cad gcod pa po/ /chos rnams thams cad smra ba po rme/ /'jig rten kun gyi 1ston pa po/ /zhal bzangs nazla ba nya ba 'dra/ /sku ri smad rin chen kun gyis brgyan/ /gser gyi mchod sdong 'dra bar gnas/ /'od zer nyi ma stong bas lhag /tshangs la sogs pas 5phyag bgyis pa'i ne/ / 'jig rten 93wa 506

ra༅phog /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo//tar+ya thā/ ma ti ba hu lce/ ta thā ga tā 5dzñā na dar+sha 5ne pra dzñārto/ gasdi 4re/ bo 5dhi maṇ+ḍa 6)nu sa ri ṇi / a bid+dha / ta mon+dha/ ka ra bi khadha ma ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la / pradzñā dī pe / me dhā 31pa di ni12/ sarba a dhiṣ+ṭha ta1 / su ru su ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ me dhā ā 1 na ya swā hā/ cho ga ni nang par skazhing bzlas brjod byas na/lobs skyen 7par 'gyur ro/ /sman bram hi snyim 1 par bcug ste dud 1 pa byung gi bar du bzlas pa byas te/ zos na thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs rdzogs so19// //93—557

bsdur mchan/557 hunyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈co 〉〉ta/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dar shes—/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dar she/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gam gyi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi gli/9)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bho/ 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉maṇ+ḍa/ 6)〈〈gasngo/nga 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ni/ 9)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gyid dha/ dzin〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ri ba/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kā ra bi/ tho)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rte//〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pi/ (1〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dha/ tunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉na/ /nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉te/ 〈〈khu 〉〉ti/ thoge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dha a/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈'o/la 〉〉dha lha// lo〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉re/ /nye〈〈snar 〉〉rkyen/ tu)〈〈li 〉〉snyims/ tunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉sde 'dud/nyu7〈〈gasdigang 〉〉〈〈:sgo 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉1ste/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (367)93wa 558

༄ga /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha na sa tā ba lo ke na bud dha k+ṣe tra ni ra de sha na byu ha nā ma ma hā yā 2na sru tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri gru 'dzin na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas lha'i nor bu rin po che dpal gyi snying po dang / me tog rgyas pa dang / lha'i seng ge'i khri bkod pa na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang gi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang snying rje 93—559

chen po'i shes pa la gnas pa thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang /skye ba gnyis dang / skye ba gsum dang / skye ba bcu dang / skye ba nyi shu dang /skye ba sum cu dang / skye ba brgya'i bar dag gis thogs pa/ thams cad kyang sa brgyad pa dang / sa bcu pa la gnas pa sha stag ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / 'jam dpal dang / dri med tog dang / nor dpal dang / glog gi tog dang / dri med 'od dang / tsan+dan dang / bdud rtsi'i tog la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdun brgya dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma thams cad kyang lung bstan pa dang ldan pa/ ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa nas 'dus pa lnga stong dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za thams cad kyang sngon gyi sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul mthong ba brgya stong dang / gnod sbyin mo chen mo thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes thob pa/ lung bstan pa thob pa/ phyir mi ldog pa dpe med pa dang / dri med 'od dang / 'od can ma dang / 'jigs byed ma dang / dpal ldan ma dang / 'phrog ma dang / dung can ma la sogs pa gnod sbyin mo chen mo brgyad cu dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /rnam thos kyi bu dang / yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / nor bu bzang po'i bu dang / gang ba bzang po la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi bar dag dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas de dag thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i khri la bzhugs par rig nas rang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la lha'i rgyan 93—560

dang / na bza' dang / me tog dang / me tog phreng dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / rol mo'i sgra rnams kyis mchod par byas/ ri mor byas so/ /kha cig gis ni lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas te bstod do/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la dmigs pa snying rje chen po'i shes pa la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'od kyis snang bar gyur cing / gzugs thams cad snang bas khyab par gyur nas/sems can dmus long gang yin pa de dag gis ni mig gis gzugs rnams mthong bar gyur to/ /'on pa rnams kyis ni rna bas sgra dag thos par gyur to/ /nad kyis btab pa rnams ni nad dag dang bral bar gyur to/ /gos med pa rnams ni gos dag thob par gyur to/ /smyon pa rnams ni dran pa thob par gyur to / /lus nyams pa dang dbang po ma tshang ba rnams ni lus dang dbang po yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /dbul po rnams kyis ni nor dag thob par gyur to/ /sems can gang dag nor dang / yo byad dang / longs spyod med pa de dag ni nor dang / yo byad dang / longs spyod dag dang ldan par gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyang bde ba thams cad dang ldan zhing bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang yin pa de dag thams cad la yang bskul nas thams cad chos mnyan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags te/ sems can gang dag lha rnams kyi nang du skyes pa de dag thams cad kyis ni lha'i bde ba yongs su spangs nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran par byas te chos mnyan pa'i phyir/93—561

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /sems can gang dag mi rnams kyi nang du skyes pa 71)de dag gis kyang mi'i bde ba yongs su spangs nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /sems can gang dag /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za rnams kyi nang na skyes pa de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa so sor thob nas sems can thams cad la byams par gnas pa dang / lus dang sems bde bar gyur nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags so/ /sems can gang dag gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams su mun pa mun nag gi nang du skyes pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi mthus yud tsam zhig dran pa so sor thob nas gcig gis gcig kun tu shes par gyur te/ de dag mun pa chen po de nas yongs su thar bar gyur to/ /sems can thams cad gcig la gcig byams par gnas shing nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang bral bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos te mtho ba dang dma' bar gyur to/ /de nas 'khor 'dus pa der 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dus te 'dug par gyur nas/ des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa chen po kun tu snang zhing 'dus pa chen po'i snga ltas kyang kun tu snang la/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po dag lung ston pa yang kun tu snang zhing chos kyi 'bel ba'i gtam chen po'i snga ltas kyang kun tu snang ba las na rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag gi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing ye 93—562

shes chen po yang 'thob par 'gyur gyis/ rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyed kyis sems can thams cad la snying rje skyed la/ phan pa dang / bde ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya ba'i bar gyi phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yongs su zhus shig /rigs kyi bu phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na sems can sdig pa byed pa/ dbul ba/ nyam chung ba/ lus mdog ngan pa/rga ba dang na bas yongs su gzir ba/ longs spyod chung ba lus yongs su ma bsgoms pa/ tshe thung ba/ blo chung ba/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug gis yongs su gzir ba dag 'byung ba yod de/ rigs kyi bu de dag gi don du chos bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba thob shig dang / rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyod kyis yun ring por sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / sdig pa thams cad bzlog par bya ba dang / sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / bla na med pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar dag byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag yid la byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i dus slad ma'i tshe na sems can rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan gyis non par gyur pa/ dus ma lags par 93—563

'gum pas yongs su gzir ba/ nyam chung ba/ mdog ngan pa/ tshe thung ba/longs spyod chung ba/ lus yongs su ma bsgoms pa dag 'byung bar mchis te/de dag ni ser sna dang / 'chal pa'i tshul khrims kyi sems kyis gcig la gcig 'gum par 'gyur la/ gcig gis gcig gi nor dang / longs spyod dang /dbang phyug dag 'phrog par 'gyur zhing / gad mo dang / 'jo sgeg dang / bro gar dang / rtsed mo dag gis mngon par rtse ba dang / mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shes pa dang / mi sdug pa la sdug par 'du shes par bgyid lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de dag rgyu de dang gzhi des sems can rnams la mi dge ba rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis gtses nas sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag tu yang skye bar 'gyur lags pas/bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du bdag de dag gi don dang / sman pa dang /bde ba dang / re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes thob par bgyi ba'i bar dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar bgyi ba dang / sdig pa thams cad bzlog par bgyi ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs par 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la ni mi mkhyen pa dang / ma rtogs pa dang / ma gzigs pa dang / ma gsan pa dang / rnam par mi mkhyen pa ci yang mi mnga' bas chos kyi 'bel ba'i gtam nyan par 'tshal ba dang / sngon gyi sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang / shes rab dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin can gyi byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha 93—564

ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po mang po lhags pa 'di dag re ba ma mchis par gyur cing / slar mchi bar mi 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol/de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor ji ltar lhags pa de dag gis kyang yan lag lngas phyag byas te tshig mthun par 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs par bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa legs par bshad du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab par thugs su chud nas phyogs bcur rnam par gzigs te/ snyan cing 'jebs la yid du 'ong ba'i gsung dbyangs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yod de/ ngas sngon dang po sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/de bzhin gshegs pa me tog snang ba kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba'i spyan sngar de thos so / /rigs kyi bu ting nge 'dzin de'i ming thos ma thag tu sems can bye ba phrag dgu bcus de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes thob par gyur nas/ thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa dag tu lung bstan te/ngas kyang lung bstan pa thob bo/ /rigs/ kyi bu ngas de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha'i mkhyen pas sngon de bzhin gshegs pa sum khris sems can thams cad kyi don du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad de/ thams cad du yang de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khyod nyid dang /93—565

'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor rnams dang dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor ji ltar lhags pa 'di dag gis kyang thos nas ri mo dang mchod pa dag byas te/ de'i 'og tu sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dag gis lung bstan pa thob cing byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dag kyang thob par gyur nas/ 'dod pa thams cad du 'gro ba dang / re ba thams cad grub pa dang / nad rnams dang bral bar yang gyur la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su smin pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa dang /gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa blta na sdug pa dang / nor dang / 'bru dang /mdzod dang / bang ba rnams 'byor ba dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang /blon po rnams kyis mngon par bstod par 'os pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis phyag bya bar 'os pa dang / dran pa dang ldan pa dang / shes rab dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pa dang ldan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa dang / tshe dang kha dog dang / gzi brjid dang / mthu stobs dbaldan zhing rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan par gyur te/ nam yang sdug pa dang bral bar ma gyur 17cing / sdug pa'i sdug bsngal med par gyur pa de dran te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos smra ba de la mchog tu gus pa'i sems bskyed de/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yan lag lngas phyag byas shing / me tog dang /bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis legs par brgyan nas sangs rgyas 93—566

la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal bar byed pa dang / legs so zhes bya bar sbyin par byed pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa de dag ni yon tan mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni tshe 'di nyid la yang yon tan mang po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ gzugs bzang zhing mdzes la/ blta na sdug pa dang /nad rnams dang bral ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / blo brtan pa dang / dran pa dang ldan pa dang / brtan pa dang ldan pa dang / rgyal po thams cad dang /rgyal po'i btsun mo thams cad dang / rgyal bu thams cad dang / blon po thams cad dang / dgra thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyis mngon par bstod par 'os pa dang / phyag bya bar 'os pa dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'os par 'gyur ro/ /nor dang yo byad mang por yang 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi kha nas tsan+dan gyi dri'i ngad 'byung bar yang 'gyur ro/ /mig ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra bar yang 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis nyin mtshan du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dag mthong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad zad par yang 'gyur ro/ /de dag la lha rnams srung bar yang 'gyur ro/ /de dag 'chi ba'i dus na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dag mthong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /phrag dog med pa dang / sems rnam par g.yengs pa med par 'chi ba'i dus byed par yang 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye ba'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / bsnyen bkur byas te yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / klog pa dang /93—567

mchod par byed pa dang / 'chang ba dang / ming tsam thos par 'gyur ba de dag ni ngas mngon sum du lung bstan pas lung bstan pa yin te/ de dag gis nga mthong zhing bsnyen bkur byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas pa yang yin pas / de dag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la the tsom 6)bskyed par mi bya'o/ /gang dag rna lam du grag par gyur pa de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' yin par yid la byas la bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /de'i sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas gzugs mi mdzes pa dang / longs spyod med pa dang / blo med pa dang /srid pa che ba dang / sdug pa dang bral ba dang / rgyal srid 'khrugs par gyur pa gang yin pa de dag dang / klad pa na ba gang yin pa dang / zan chad pa gang yin pa dang / gos ngan par gyur pa gang yin pa dang / lus dang sems la gnod pa gang yin pa dang / reg na mi bde ba'i mal bcas pa gang yin pa dang / spyo ba gang yin pa'i las kyi sgrib pa de dag thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin 'di thos pa'i mthus yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /des kyang 'di ltar sems bskyed par bya ste/ bdag gis sngon 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe sems can rnams la sdig pa mi dge ba rnam pa sna tshogs bsags pa de dag so sor bshags par bya'o / /bsal dbar bya'o/ /mi bcab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed par bya ste/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i longs spyod kyi 'bras bu med par 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dag dang / pha ma dag la sdig pa'i las byas shing bsags par gyur pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang yongs su zad par 93—568

'gyur zhing dbang phyug chen po dag kyang yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa dang / sdug pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba dang /dmus long du 'gyur ba dang / bud med kyi dngos por 'gyur ba dang /mtshan gnyis par 'gyur ba dang / phrag dog dang / nga rgyal dang / khro ba'i dbang gis gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su 'gyur ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang yongs su zad par 'gyur te / rigs kyi bu de ltar na ting nge 'dzin 'di ni yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni yun ring du gnas par byed pa dang / rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la srung ba tsho17dang /skyob pa dang / sbed par byed pa dang / de dag thams cad kyi yon tan dang /re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / longs spyod pa dang /dbang phyug dang / bde ba chen por byed pa dang / bsam pa dang / 'dod pa thams cad yang dag par 'grub par byed pa dang / las thams cad zad par byed pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad dang ske/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / g.yul thams cad las rgyal bar byed pa dang / tshe dang / mdog dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / mthu che bar byed pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po dang /mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du byed pa dang / rims dang / dug dang / me dang / chu thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / lung bstan pa'i bar dag thob par byed pa'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi dag yod de de 93—569

dag mnyan cing bzung ste bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo dag ni yon tan de dag thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos pa dang / ji ltar lhags pa'i 'khor de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / phye ma dang / byug pa dang / ras bcos bu zung dag gsol te/ legs so zhes bya ba gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi de dag gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/ tat+ya thā/ bud dhe/su bud dhe/ bud dha ma te/ lo ke bi lo ke lo ka /a ti kān te/ satwa a ba lo ki ni/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ sarba ā sha pa ri pū ra ṇi/ byu ti na dha re/ na ra de ba pū dzi te/ ta thā ga ta dzñā na da de/ ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na/ sarba lo ka ma su khri bha ba tu/ pūrba rkarma k+ṣu pa ya tu/ rak+ṣa bha ba tu/sarba ye bh+yasta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na swā hā/ kye rigs kyi bu dag gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa sum khris gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /ngas kyang da ltar sems can thams cad kyi don dang /phan pa dang / bde ba dang / bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar bya ba'i phyir bshad de/ grogs po dag gang la la zhig 'di snyam du bdag gis ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i yon tan de dag thams cad 'thob par 'gyur snyam du sems pa des nang par sngar langs te/ sems can thams 93—570

cad la snying brtse ba'i sems dang / snying rje'i sems dang / byams pa'i sems dang / phrag dog dang / nga rgyal dang / 'chab pa dang / khro ba yongs su spangs pa'i sems dang / rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa shin tu rgya cher byas la phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas te/ gang 'dod pa yid la byas nas me tog la bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad bya zhing de bzhin gshegs pa la re re nas dbul bar bya'o/ /des na de'i re ba thams cad yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /dam pa gang 'dod pa de thob par yang 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar yang 'gyur ro/ /shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang stobs dang / mdog dang / brtson 'grus dang ldan par yang 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad kyang de'i dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di bshad pa na srog chags drug khri mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur nas de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol zhing bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dam 'cha' ba mi 'jigs pa'i gzi brjid ces bgyi ba'i gzungs mchis te/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med bkod pa gzi brjid rgyal po'i spyan sngar de bzung lags so/ /bzung nas kyang sems can thams cad la bshad lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das deng slan chad bdag gis 93—571

mngon par 'tshal te/ gang gi rna lam du gzungs de grag par gyur tam/ glo bar chud par gyur pa de'i lus la nyam nga ba'am/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs sam/bro 1nad dam/ rims sam/ lus bro 'tshal ba'am/ sems gdung ba'am/dus ma lags par 'gum pa'am/ chab kyis 'jigs pa'am/ mtshon gyis 'jigs pa'am/ dug gis 'jigs pa'am/ dug sbyar mas 'jigs pa'am/mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'byung po'i 'jigs pa'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dgra rnams sam/ mi dang mi ma lags pa dag gis tho 'tsham pa'am/ rnam par gtse ba'am / gnod pa bgyid par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma mchis lags so/ /de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la rjes su gnang ba stsol cig dang /bdag gis chos smra ba dang / chos nyan pa de dag gi don du nyan pa rnams dang /ri mor bgyid pa rnams dang / mchod par bgyid pa rnams dang / 'dzin par bgyid pa rnams kyi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dam bca' ba'i phyag rgya dag stsal bar bgyi'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/ sarba bo dhi satā nān/ ar hā tā na/ tar+ya thā/ o badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra kā ya/ badz+ra ba la/ badz+ra te dza/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ta thā ga ta ā dzñā ma pa lā ya/ sma ra pra ti dzñā ma/ sarba byā dhī tshon)na sarba pā bān nā sha ya / de hi me4/ ya the 5ba si ta ma ba ram/ ya na ya me ba a bhi mā yan yā tsa mi tan ta me ba sa mṛ dh+ya tu/ he he/ tu ru tu ru/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha mā bi lam ba/dar+ṣa ya/ badz+ra kā yam/ dar+ṣa (7/ badz+ra kā yam/ bud dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na swā hā/gzungs 'di brjod pa na sa chen po 'di mtho ba dang dma' bar gyur to/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po thams cad kyang rab tu dngangs so/ /lha thams 93—572

cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar dag kyang ngo mtshar du gyur nas sems can chen po rab tu grub par byed pa'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag bshad pa ni legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig byang chub sems dpa'i sa'am/nor dang / 'bru dang / longs spyod kyi dbang phyug gam/ rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug gam/ rig sngags 'chang ba nyid dam/ tshe dang / stobs dang / mdog dang / brtson 'grus dang / tshe ring po nyid 'tshal ba des snga nas bsnyen par bgyis la dgung zla yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad la tsan+dan dkar po las rdo rje 'dzin pa rta gad du dgod cing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snying gar sku gdung stsal ba / sku gdung dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rig sngags 'chang yang dag par dbugs 'byin par bgyid pa bgyis la/ gtsang mas bdug spos kyis bdug cing gdugs mtshan gcig tu smyung ba bgyis la/ de nas tshes brgyad nas tshes bcwa lnga'i bar du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhugs pa'i gnas gtsang mar tsan+dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bgyis la/ bum pa gang ba bzhi yang gzhag par bgyi/ phyogs bzhir yang ro dang ldan pa dang / dri dang ldan pa dang /skyems dang / 'o thug gi gtor ma dag stsal la rad pa dkar po bgos te/sems rtse gcig tu bgyis nas/ dus gsum du bdug spos dang / me tog dang ske/ spos dang mar me dag gis mchod pa chen po bgyi zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa (1)yang mchod pa bgyis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag bgyis nas sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad la bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing / re re 93—573

nas lag na rdo rje la bsnun par bgyi'o/ /des na sgra skad chen po 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / dog sa g.yo ba dang / 'od zer dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur te/de nas dam pa ci 'tshal ba yang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bzlas brjod bgyis pa tsam gyis las thams cad dang dgos pa thams cad kyang yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /bro nad ma mchis pa dang / tshe ring ba dang / sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur zhing yon tan stong yang 'thob par 'gyur lags so / /'gum pa'i tshe na yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das stong mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /bdag mthong bar yang stsal bar bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /phyag rgya 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis 'da' bar bya ba ma yin te/ 'di la som nyi med pa dang / yid gnyis med pa dang /the tsom 1med par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du ting nge 'dzin 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs de las ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / mi rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / yi dgas rnams dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa rnams dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can thams 93—574

cad kyi sems dang sems las byung ba lhag par g.yo ba dang bral bar g.yo ba dag rab tu shes shing (1)/ sems can 'di dag ni bsod nams su nye bar 'gro ba ste legs par spyod pa'i las byed pa/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dag la dad pa 'thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba ste/ nyes par spyod pa'i las byed pa/ sdig pa spyod par byed par shes nas sdig pa'i lta bar gyur pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston par byed cing / sdig pa thams cad las zlog par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la 'god par byed pa dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / phrag dog dang / nga rgyal dang / khro ba dang / ser sna dag sel bar byed pa dang / sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun dag la dad pa rab tu thob nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su skye zhing nam du yang sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mi 'gyur la/ yid mi bde bar mi 'gyur bas na rigs kyi bu de'i phyir ting nge 'dzin 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ste/ 'di thos pa'i sems can rnams ni phyir mi ldog par nges pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du/ rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag lung bstan par 'gyur lags / bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa nyid kyang dka' ba lags te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta ci smos kyang mi 'tshal lags na de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po dang / dka' ba spyod pa ji tsam zhig tu 'gyur lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ngas dang po 93—575

sems bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byas pa gang yin pa dang / mgo dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / mig dang / lus dang /sdug pa'i bu dang / bu mo dang / chung ma dang / bran dang / bran mo dag yongs su btang bar gyur pa gang yin pa bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du bya ba snga ma 'di ni/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mchod pa byed pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang /yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / klog pa dang / 'dzin pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba dang / gzhan dag la yang yang dag par ston par byed pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba gang yin pa dang / chos smra ba de dag la yang mchod pa byed pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba gang yin pa de'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas kun chub par byas shing / bshad pa'i chos de dag thams cad la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / ri mor byed pa dang / mchod pa byed pa dang / bsnyen bkur byas te yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa gang yin pa de bas ni gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang /yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa byed pa dang / yang dag par ston par byed pa dang / nyan par byed na de las bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba ches mang du yongs su sdud par 'gyur te/ des na de bzhin 93—576

gshegs pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa dang / yi ge ra 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa'i bsod nams ni de ltar dka' ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag sdig pa kun tu spyod pa dang / bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / bro gar la mngon par dga' ba dang / mi sdug pa la sdug par 'du shes pa dang / 'dod 91pa dang / khro ba dang / gnod sems mang ba dang / mi bde ba la bde bar 'du shes pa dang / mtshon cha dang / spyo ba dang / bsdigs pa dang / rdeg pa la mngon par dga' ba dang / shes par mi 'gyur ba dang / yid la byed par mi 'gyur ba de dag ni sdig pa'i las kyi gzhi de dang / mi shes pa des mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin cing rga ba dang / na ba dang / mya ngan dang / 'chi bas yongs su zin pas 'chi ba'i tshe na yongs su gdung bar 'gyur te/ dmigs pa na so so nas dur khrod dang 'dra ba kho nar mthong zhing / dge ba'i sems bskyed par yang mi 'gyur la/dad pa mi phyed pa thob par yang mi 'gyur te/ de dag de nas shi 'phos nas kyang / sdug bsngal dag nyams su myong bar 'gyur bas na lung bstan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ma mthong ba dang / lung bstan pa ma thob pa dag gis ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan pa dang / ri mor bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba dang / gzung ba dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir gzhug pa dang / dad par yang mi nus pa/ chos smra ba de la yang bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / bla mar bya ba dang / ri mor bya ba dang / mchod 93—577

par bya bar yang mi nus so/ /rigs kyi bu gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu spyod par 'gyur ba'i yul der ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ji ltar lhags pa'i 'khor de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes bya ba gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang chos smra ba de dang / chos nyan pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pas bsnyen bkur bgyi/ bla mar bgyi/ ri mor bgyi/ mchod par bgyi zhing bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyang nye bar bsgrub par bgyi lags so/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang rgyas par bgyi/ bsrung bar bgyi ste/ des na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring du gnas par yang 'gyur lags so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar lhags pa'i 'khor rnams la rnam par gzigs te/ bka' stsal pa/ kye rigs kyi bu dag legs so legs so/ /khyed cag gis de bzhin du gyis shig /gnod pa byed pa dang /brnyas pa dang / gshe ba dang / bsdigs pa dang / mtshon 'byin pa dang /rgya 'gal bar byed na yang lus dang / srog la mi lta bar byas la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan par bya/ yi ger bri bar bya/ yi ger 'drir gzhug par bya/bklag par bya'o/ /chos smra ba de la yang bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rim gror bya'o/ /yul phyogs de dang / gling de dang / grong khyer de dag kyang 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa dag la bsrung bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag la yang rtag par rgyun du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /bskal pa grangs med stong phrag bye snyed du/ /(33—578

sangs rgyas 'byung ba lan 'ga' rnyed pa la/ /phyi ma'i dus na 'gyod par mi 'gyur bar/ /rigs kyi bu rnams bag yod chos nyon cig /yon tan nyan cing mngon par dad byed pa/ /de dag gis ni ting 'dzin rnyed mi dka'/ /gang gis rkang gnyis gtso bo rnams la ni/ /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /nor dang 'bru dang de bzhin gos dang rgyan/ /spos dang phreng ba byug pa phul ba bas / /gang gis mdo sde 'di la dad byas te/ /nyan cing klog la yi ger 'dri byed pa/ /de la bsod nams tshad ni yod min te/ /bde bar gshegs pas de snyed tshad ma gsungs/ /rtag tu bag yod dgon par sten byed cing / /sems gzhan med par bsam gtan dag sgom dang / /sdug pa'i bu dang bu mo sbyin byed cing / /lag pa rkang pa yongs su gtong ba bas(1/ /gang su mdo sde 'di ni 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni de bas bsod nams mang po 'thob/ /mdo mchog 'di ni nor sbyin byed pa ste/ /de yi ngan song kun kyang rtag tu spangs/ /'di ni nor dang 'bru sbyin byed pa ste/ /gang zhig mdo sde rnam dag 'di 'dzin pa/ /de la yon tan kun kyang mi dkon zhing / /de la tshe stobs brtson 'grus mod pa yin / /'dren pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mthong zhing / /ngas 2de sangs rgyas byang chub lung yang bstan/ /de la nam yang sdig pa yod min zhing / /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams kyang mthong / /de la rtag tu las gang 'byung 'gyur ba / /sems gdung lus na ba 'am de bzhin du/ /klad pa na bas thams cad zad 'gyur zhing / /de ni nams kyang rnam par ltung mi 'gyur/ /des ni mthong ba'i chos la'ang yon tan kun/ /ji ltar bsams shing 'dod pas 'thob par 'gyur / /de ltar rtag tu dge slong pho mo dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang rgyal 93—579

pos rtag tu ni/ /mi yi dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa ltar/ /chos smra ba la rjes su gus byas te/ /mdo sde 'di ni rtag tu gzung bya zhing / /'dzin pa la yang rtag tu bsnyen bkur bya/ /spos dang phreng ba byug pa rnams kyis ni/ /bsnyen bkur byas te yi ger 'drir yang gzhug /phyi ma'i dus la rga nas gdungs gyur la/ /'khrug pa stong phrag du mas g.yen spyo zhing / /sems dmyal yi dgas rnams su yongs 'khyam dang / /za ma ma ning dmad par bya ba dang / /dmus long nyid dang ro dang khyi yi dri/ /rigs dma' bud med rnams su skye bar byed/ /phrag dog che zhing rtag tu sdig byed la/ /khro bas zil non rtag tu ser sna can/ /sangs rgyas chos la gus par ma byas pas/ /de ni de 'dra'i rigs su skye 'gyur la / /der yang sdug bsngal tshor ba myong 'gyur zhing / /de ni phyi ma'i dus la'ang gdung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir gang dag 'dzin cing ston byed pa/ /de dag gis ni rtag tu mchod par bya/ /gang gis de la yongs su spyo ba dang / /smad cing brdegs la bcing ba byas gyur pa/ /de ni nga yang yongs su spyos pa yin/ /'dzin la phu dud byas na nga la'ang byas/ /de phyir de dag gis ni chos smra dang / /gang zhig 'di 'dzin 'dri zhing klog byed pa/ /de dag la ni rtag tu bsnyen bkur zhing / /tshig 'jam snyan pa'ang rgyun du brjod par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rnam par lta ba'i cho 'phrul zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs mchis par rjes su dran te/ bdag gis sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzad ye shes tog ces bgyi ba'i spyan sngar de thos shing bzung 93—580

lags so/ /de mnyan cing bzung la bcangs shing bklags te gzhan dag la yang bsgrags shing bsnyen bkur bgyis 41rinas yi ger bris sam/ yi ger 'brir stsal na / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob par 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i yon tan de dag thams cad kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ des ji ltar bsams pa thams cad kyang yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur/ de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang byang bar 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin kyang 'thob par 'gyur/bro nad rnams dang bral bar yang 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang mthong bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod la de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs zin gyis shod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas te gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag smras so/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/ sarba ā shā pa ri ( pū ra kā nān/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ ha ha ha/ ma ma ma/ dhi ri dhi ri dhi ri/ shān te/ pra shān te/ sarba pā pak+ṣa yang ka ri/ a ba lo kā ya/ kā ru ṇi ka /bo dhi tsit+ta ma ma na si ku ru/ bya ba lo kā ya/ mā ma/ sma ra sma ra/yan twa yā pūrbe/ sat+ya a dhiṣ+ṭha /rna kṛ 4te na/ te na sa h+ye rin/ ba tsa ne na/sarba ā shā me pa ri bru ra ya/ bud dha k+ṣe tram pa ri sho dha ya/ ma me ku6da bi he phyithe ka ro tu/ bud dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ te dze te dze/ ma hā te 93—581

dze / yan ma ma kā ya du: ri ta ma bā/ wāg du: ri tam bā/ ma no dubyu ri tam bā/ dā ri drum bā/ tad sarbe k+ṣu pa ya/ a lo ka ya/ bi lo ka ya/ ta thā ga ta dar+ṣa khon tsa/ a ha ma dhi ṭ+wāṃ k+ṣu mi bo dhi sa t+ya dar+ṣa ṇam/ dhu dhu ma/ da das swa me dar+ṣa ṇa ma/ sarba me ku sha la/ a bhi bar snyan tu/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ sma ra pra ti dzñā ma ma satwa/ si rgyan tu man+t+ra pa dā swā hā/ gzungs 'di brjod pa na sa chen po 'di yang rab tu g.yos shing ga zha'i sgra chen po dang / lha'i me tog gi char dag kyang mngon par rab tu bab par gyur to/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /sems can chen po khyod kyis sems can thams cad bskyab pa'i phyir re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad las srung bar byed pa/ las thams cad byang bar byed pa dang / sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs 'di legs par smras so/ /bdag cag thams cad kyis kyang gzung bar bya/ /bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag gang la la ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su bsgrags pa'i yon tan de dag mngon par 'dod cing lung bstan pa dang / kho bo yang mngon sum du mthong ba dang / ting nge 'dzin 'thob pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang /longs spyod dang dbang phyug 'thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar 'dod pa des zla ba yar gyi ngo la lus legs par khrus byas shing gtsang la/bsnyen te gnas/ 'phags pa 1yan lag brgyad pa la gnas par byas la tshes 93—582

brgyad nas brtsams te/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa phyogs su spos dang / me tog dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag dang /bum pa gang ba dag gis sa phyogs de dang / chos smra ba de yang mchod pa byas nas lus legs par khrus byas pa gtsang mas gos dkar po bgos te/ me tog dang ske/ bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa sna tshogs dag (1)gis mchod nas yi ger bri bar bya'o/ /'dri ba'i tshe na nyin gcig bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bla ma dang / gus pa'i sems nye bar bzhag nas sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems dang snying brtse ba'i sems dang / snying rje'i sems kyis nyi ma phyed tshun chad kyi bar de tsam du bri bar bya'o/ /tshes brgyad nas brtsams te tshes bco lnga'i bar du nyin gcig bzhin du mchod pa yang de bzhin bya'o / /cho ga 'di kho na bzhin du byas te bris na de ma thag tu mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyang 'phel bar 'gyur/ brtson 'grus 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe de nyid la yang lus bde ba 'thob par 'gyur/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang / khro ba dang /phrag dog dang / ser sna dag srab mor 'gyur ro/ /des yi ger 'drir nibacug nas kyang sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sku gdung dang bcas pa dang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs sku gdung dang bcas pa zhal shar phyogs su bstan te bzhag la/ me tog dang —/ bdug spos dang / spos dang / mar me dag gis mchod pa shin du rgya 93—583

cher byas la/ tshes brgyad nas brtsams te tshes bco lnga'i bar du sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed par bya zhing / gtsang ma kha zas dkar po za ba/ bsnyen te gnas pa/ 'phags pa yan lag brgyad pa la gnas pa / grogs po yid gcugs pa dang ldan pa/ nga rgyal dang / khro ba dang /phrag dog dang / ser sna yongs su spangs pas nyin gcig bzhin du mchod pa rgya chen po byas te/ dus gsum du bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / mar me dag kyang phul la/dus gsum du sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad rtsa brgyad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs la gtor bar bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje la yang bdug spos kyis bdug par bya'o/ /phyogs bcur phyag byas la/ nub phyogs kyi lha mo 'jigs byed ma dang / shar phyogs kyi dpe med ma dang / steng gi phyogs kyi dung can ma la sogs pa la phyogs bzhir gtor ma ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang / 'o thug dang / zho dang / 'bras chan dag kyang gtor bar bya'o/ /des na de la rnam par g.yeng ba dang 'jigs pa 'ga' yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing sems 'khrul bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad po thams cad la bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas la bskul bar bya'o/ /cho ga 'di kho na bzhin du sngar bsnyen pa byas la/ de nas tshes bco lnga'i nang par sa phyogs der bum pa gang ba bzhi bzhag la/ bdug spos dang / tsan+dan dang / pog dkar po dang / ga pur dag kyang gzhag /mar me kha bzhi/ me tog dang / bdug spos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dar dang / ba dan sna tshogs dag dang / gser dngul gyi snod dag gis legs par brgyan la/ sbrang 93—584

rtsi dang sbyar ba'i 'o thug dang / zho dang / 'bras chan dang / gzhan yang ci 'byor pa'i lha bshos dang / gtor ma dag kyang phyogs bzhir gzhag go/ /sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad la snga ma bzhin du bzlas brjod lan re byas la phyogs bzhir dor ro/ /de nas sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad phrag gsum la bzlas brjod lan re byas la/ re re nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs la bsnun par bya'o/ /de nas gzugs de 'gul bar 'gyur zhing sgra skad chen po yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'od zer dag kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ sa yang g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas las thams cad dang / dgos pa thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa thob par yang 'gyur/ sems can thams cad kyis phyag bya ba'i 'os su yang 'gyur/ nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang ba rnams 'byor par yang 'gyur/ nad thams cad yongs su spangs pa dang / tshe ring bar yang 'gyur/ dgra thams cad dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang /blon po rnams kyang de la lta 'dod cing gces spras byed par yang 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug spangs par yang 'gyur/ nam du'ang sdug pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /brtan pa dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa dang / gzi brjid dang ldan pa dang / dbang po rno ba dang / blo dang ldan pa dang /sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / cho ga shes pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong ba dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang mthong ba dang / byams pa la 93—585

gnas shing chos ston bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed pa'i bar du yang 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji lta bu 'dod pa dag gam/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs chen po'am/ gang du rjes su dran par byed pa der skye ba dang / gzhan yang yon tan stong phrag du ma dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dang gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag ni yon tan mang po'i 'byung gnas lags te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs ma mchis par mnyan par yang rngo mi thogs la gzung bar yang rngo mi thogs/ klog par yang rngo mi thogs/mchod par yang rngo mi thogs/ yi ge bri bar yang rngo mi thogs/ yi ger 'drir stsal bar yang rngo mi thogs/ dad par yang rngo mi thogs lags so/ /gal te mthong bar gyur na yang nyan par mi 'gyur la/ gal te nyan par gyur na yang de sems rnam par g.yengs pas nyan par 'gyur zhing dad par mi 'gyur/ bsnyen bkur bgyid par mi 'gyur lags so/ /gal te bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur na yang nyon mongs pa dang / gnod sems dang bcas pa'i sems kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /gal te yi ger 'dri'am/ yi ger 'drir stsal par gyur na yang de gzhan dag yid la bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i sngon gyi las kyi 'bras bu lags pa'i slad du ste/de ni las de nyams su myong bar bgyid cing the tsom skye bar 'gyur lags so/ /mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyid pas kyang lan gsum bsgrubs na re ba thams cad yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur lags te/ de la nem nur ma mchis pa dang /yid gnyis ma mchis pa dang / the tsom ga1rimi bskyed par bgyi lags so/ /de 93—586

nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gnod sbyin mo chen mo dpe med ma bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug spos sna tshogs dang / ras bcos bu zung dag gis mchod par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das yul ko'u shām bī na dbyangs can gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sems can thams cad kyi don dang /sman pa dang / bde ba'i slad du dam bcas pa brjod par rjes su dran lags te/bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang rig (15sngags 'chang ba thams cad kyi snying po dag 'tshal lags so/ /de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams kyi don du bdag rjes su gzung du gsol/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/ stad ya the dan/ ha ha/ hi hi/ hu hu/ sa ra sa ra/la hūm̐ la hūm̐/ shī r+ghaṃ/ ma hā bi byā/ sarba bi byā dha ra na ma skṛ te/ ha sa ha sa ki tiṣ+ṭha si/ ki ki tiṣ+ṭha si/ ka na ka bi tsi tra/ ā ba ra ṇa bi bhū na'i t+t+waṃ ge/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ sarba ar+sha na me sā dha ya/tu ru tu ru/ ar+shan sā dha ya/ ar+shan de hi me/ sarba sa tā nān sidhi na/ hā 93—587

hā / pad+me/ pad+me/ ma hā pad+me/ bi ṣa de/ bi ṣa de/ ma hā bi ṣa de/ bha ba bha ba/ bha bod bha bā ya/ ta ma haṃ 0༄sto re/ tan me bi byā ma pra yo dza nā ya/sid dhi ku ru/ sarba ā shā me pa ri pū ra ya/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la yon tan 'tshal ba dang / nor dang 'bru 'tshal ba dang /sems can thams cad dbang du bgyid par 'tshal ba dang / nor gyi dbang phyug chen po dang / rgyal srid dang / rig sngags 'chang chen po nyid dang / bdag kyang mngon sum du mthong bar 'tshal ba des tshes brgyad kyi gdugs la ras dkar po sar pa kha tshar ma bskum pa skra bsal ba la ri mo mkhan gtsang ma bsnyen te gnas pa/ 'phags pa yan lag brgyad pa la gnas pas/ tshon rtsi spyin dang ma 'bags pa snod sar pa'i nang du stsal bas dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs chos ston pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /g.yas phyogs su 'phags pa rdo rje khro bo rad pa dkar po 'tshal ba/ rgyan thams cad dang / me tog phreng dang / zla gam dang / se mo dos brgyan pa/ rdo rje gsor zhing mchis pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /g.yon phyogs su ni gnod sbyin mo chen mo dpe med ma 'dam dbu mda' rgyu'i mdog ltar dkar sham du mchis la/ zad pa dkar po 'tshal ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sug pa na pad+ma thogs shing yang dag par dbugs 'byin pa'i tshul du mchis pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang ma bsnyen te gnas pa/ 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad pa la gnas pa/ rad pa dkar po 'tshal ba/ grogs dang ldan pa/ nas chan 'o ma dang sbyar ba 'tshal bas sngar bsnyen pa bgyi la/ tshes brgyad kyi gdugs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung dang bcas pa'i gnas gtsang mar dang por kho nar 93—588

de bzhin gshegs pa dang / lag na rdo rje la me tog dang / bdug spos dang /spos dag gsol bar bgyi zhing / phyogs bzhir yang 'o thug dang / zho dang /'bras chan dang / ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang / chan sna tshogs kyi gtor ma dag gtor la/ me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / mar me sna tshogs dag gis mchod pa bgyis nas dus gsum du sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad phrag gsum 4 bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad phrag gsum bgyi zhing / re re nas gnod sbyin mo chen mo dpe med ma'i gzugs de la bsnun par bgyi'o/ /de nas zla ba nya'i tshes bcwa 91)lnga'i gdugs la yang cho ga 'di nyid dang / gzhan yang ci 'byor pa dag dang / bdug spos dang / ga pur dang / pog dkar po dang /tsan+dan dang / shing mu sa dag kyang dbul/ 'bru mar dri bda' ba'i zhugs mar kha gnyis kyang dbul bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bdag der rang gi gzugs kyis gnas par bgyi zhing dam pa ci 'tshal ba yang stsal bar bgyi ste/ ting nge 'dzin thob pa dang / nam mkha' la mchi ba dang / lus mi snang bar bgyi ba dang /rgyal srid dang / stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba nyid dang / rig sngags 'chang nyid dang / gter lta 'tshal ba dang / nor sgyur 'tshal ba dang / pha rol gyi sems 'tshal ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / dam pa ci 'tshal ba yang stsal bar bgyi lags so/ /des kyang sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems dang /nga rgyal dang / khro ba dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna yongs su spangs pa'i sems su bgyi'o/ /mchod rten dang / chos dang / dge 'dun gyi nor 'phrog 2pa yongs su spang ba ri nodang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dad pa mi phyed par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te mtshams ma mchis pa bgyid pa zhig gis 93—589

kyang lan gsum bsgrubs te bdag gis ma stsal bar gyur na bcom ldan 'das bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /gal te sangs rgyas la ma dad par gyur pa dang /yid gnyis su gyur pa gang lags pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos bgyis nas 'gyod par mi bgyid pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i sems dang ldan pa gang lags pa de dag la yang bdag mthong ba stsal bar bgyi zhing thob par yang bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin mo chen mo dpe med ma la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ sring mo legs so legs so / /sring mo khyod kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du sdig pa kun tu spyod pa'i sems can rnams la gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di lta bu 'di dag smras shing dam bca' ba yang byas pa ni yang khyod legs so/ /khyod snying rje chen po 'di lta bu 'dis sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu dgod nus par 'gyur gyis khyod kyis de bzhin du gyis shig /de nas lha mo chen mo dung can mas bcom ldan 'das la me tog sna tshogs dang / spos sna tshogs dag gis mchod pa byas te bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba dang / chos smra ba de dag kyang bsrung ba'i slad du dam bca' bar bgyi zhing re 1ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i gsang sngags gzhi rnams stsal bar bgyi lags kyis / de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la rjes su gnang bar mdzad du 93—590

gsol / na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/ tabya thā/ o shang khi ni de bi/ ā gats+tsha/ā gats+tsha/ tiṣ+ṭha dha ne/ dha na dza ye/ bri bri/ bri dhī ka ri/ sgri dh+ri/ sgri ti ka ri / nā nā bi bi dha/ be sha bsta/ ā yu dha dhā ri ṇi/ yu yu ā luṣ+ka la ne/ ta thā ga tā māṃ/ sma ra bo dhi tsita tai/ mā bi lam ba/ de hi me ba ran/ shaṃ khi ni swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag lus la gnas par bgyis na / de'i snyan pa 'phel bar 'gyur zhing / gzi brjid 'phel ba dang /longs spyod 'phel ba dang / dbang phyug 'phel ba dang / tshe ring ba dang /dgra rnams dbang du bgyi ba yang 'phel bar 'gyur lags so/ /sa phyogs gtsang ma'am lha'i gnas su ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma phyogs bzhir stsal la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bdug spos dang / pog dkar po dag gis mchod pa rgya cher bgyi zhing zhugs mar dag kyang phul la/ dgung nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byams pa la gnas pa dang / nges par gnas shing bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad bgyis na/dam pa'i chos spong ba ma gtogs pa rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang ji ltar lhags pa'i 'khor de dag gis lha mo chen mo dung can ma la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/sring mo legs so legs so/ /yon tan mang po dang ldan pa'i dam bca' ba 'di ni legs par smras so/ /sring mo khyod kyis ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin du gyis shig /de nas lha mo chen mo 'jigs byed mas bcom ldan 'das la gser gyi me tog dag gis mchod pa byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos gtugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos smra ba de dag dang / chos nyan pa de dag dang / yi 93—591
