ger 'dri ba de dag dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa bgyid pa de dag gi don du re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa/ dbyig dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang /rgyal srid dang / tshe ring bar bgyid pa/ dgra thams cad dbang du bgyid pa'i gsang sngags gzhi rnams stsal bar bgyi ste/ rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i btsun mo'am / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ bsnyen bkur bgyid dam/ yi ger 'dri 'am/ yi ger 'drir stsol tam/ mchog tu gus pas ji skad gsungs pa'i sgrub pa la sgrub par bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag 6)gis de bsrung bar bya/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi zhing dam pa ci 'tshal ba yang stsal bar bgyi ste / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dag gis mi brel bar bgyi/ thab mo dang /'gyed pa dang / khrag khrug dang / 'khrug klong dag las rgyal bar bgyi/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa nye bar bsgrub par bgyi/ de'i yul dang grong khyer dag kyang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi lags kyis/ de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nān/sarba bo dhi satā nān/ na ma ār+sha ba lo ki te shwa ra/ badz+ra pā ṇi pra skṛ tī nān/tabya thā/ o ma hā de bi/ bhi me dhī ma ma te92ri/ dza ye dza yā ba he ya sho ba ti/ya sho dza ben/ te dza dza beca/ byā ka ra ṇa mā pa te(3)/ sarba satwa a ba lo ki te/kri pa te 6dza pa hu le/ ta thā ga te a nu dzñā tam pā la ya/ sma (7skur pra ti dzñā ma/bud dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na/ de hi me 8ba ran/ sid dhi ku ru/ de bi ma hā de bi sat+ya ba tsan de bi bhi ma sat+ya ba tsa na pra tikhri te gu h+ya ni bā si ni swā hā/ bcom 93—592

ldan 'das bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs shing de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su gnang ba'i gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag smras lags te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar me tog dang /bdug spos dang / spos dang / mar me dag gis mchod pa bgyis la/ phyogs bzhir yang 'o thug dang / ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dag stsal te/ci dang ci 'tshal ba yid la bgyis shing bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mchod pa bgyis na/ re ba de dang de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyis lags so/ /gang la la bdag rang gis gzugs mthong bar 'tshal ba des tshes brgyad kyi gdugs la ras dkar po sar pa kha tshar ma bkum pa skra ma mchis pa la ri mo mkhan gtsang ma 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad yongs su bzung ba'i tshon rtsi spyin dang ma 'bags pa snod sar pa'i nang du stsal bas/ dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs chos ston pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /g.yas phyogs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug chos kyi 'bel ba'i gtam ston pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /g.yon phyogs su ni lha mo chen mo 'jigs byed ma 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i mdog ltar dkar sham du mchis la/ rad pa dkar po 'tshal ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ril ba dang / bgrang phreng thogs shing yang dag par dbugs 'byin pa'i tshul du mchis pa bri bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang gtsang mas sngar bsnyen pa bgyi la/ tshes brgyad nas tshes bcwa 3)lnga'i bar du mchod rten sku gdung dang bcas pa'i gnas su me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dag gis mchod pa bgyi zhing / phyogs bzhir yang 'o thug dang / zho dang / 'bras chan gyi gtor ma 93—593

dag gtor la/ me tog dang / bdug spos dang / mar me sna tshogs dag gis mchod pa rgya cher bgyi zhing lha bshos dkar po dag kyang phul la/ gtor ma ro sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang / gzhan yang ci 'byor pa dag stsal nas sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje'i sems kyis sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad la bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad bgyi zhing re re nas lha mo chen mo 'jigs byed ma'i gzugs de la 'phang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bdag der rang gi gzugs kyis gnas par bgyi/ dam pa ci 'tshal ba yang stsal bar bgyi ste/rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug dang / nam mkha' la mchi ba dang / gter lta 'tshal ba dang / nor sgyur 'tshal ba dang / rig sngags 'chang nyid dang / dus ma lags par 'gum pa bzlog pa dang / bro nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rab tu gzhom pa dang / bu mchis par bgyi ba dang / nor 'du bar bgyi ba dang / sems can thams cad la byams pa skye ba dang / gzhan yang ci 'tshal ba'i las dag kyang bgyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun dag la the tsom 17du gyur pa gang lags pa ma gtogs par mtshams ma mchis pa lnga bgyid pa zhig lags na yang bdag gis re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par ma bgyis par gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ci sring mo legs so legs so/ /sring mo khyod sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs shing / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir 93—594

zhugs pa ni yang khyod legs so/ /sring mo de'i phyir khyod kyis rtag tu dam bcas pa 'di dran par gyis shig /de nas de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yos shing lha'i me tog gi char dag kyang mngon par rab tu bab pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag gis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ sring mo legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis sems can thams cad kyi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i dam bca' ba 'di ni legs par smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang /yi ger 'drir stsol ba dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / 'don pa dang / mchid ton du bgyid pa des bsod nams 'thob par 'gyur lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de'i phyir de khyod nyid la dri yis khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du lan thob shig /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa la ni ma gzigs pa'am/ma gsan pa'am/ ma dgongs pa dang / rnam par mi mkhyen pa mi mnga' bas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bka' stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / 'don pa dang / kha ton du byed pa las bsod nams 'thob par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de ni dpes brjod par yang mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir 93—595

zhe na/ gos dang / rgyan dang / dbyig dang / gser dang / nor bu dang /mu tig dag gis sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par byas te rtser bcug kyang sems can de dag skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa dag las yongs su thar bar mi 'gyur ba nyid yin zhing / lo 'bum du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag gis rtser bcug kyang sems can de dag sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul dag las yongs su thar bar mi 'gyur ba nyid de/ sems can rnams kyi phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan cing mchod pa byed pa dang / yang dag par bstan te/ de'i don kyang mnyan cing nan tan gyis sgrub par byed pa ni skye ba dang / rga ba dang /na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa dag dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad las yongs su thar ba kho nar 'gyur bas de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pas 'di'i bsod nams kyi tshad kyi dpe mi mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dang / chos smra ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang /yi sher 'dri ba dang / mchod pa byed pa de dag gi phyir dbyig yungs 'bru tsam yongs su gtong bar byed dam/ me tog gcig gam/ 'bras bu gcig gam/ba dan nam/ rol mo'i sgra'am/ spos sam/ gos sam/ rgyan gcig tsam zhig yongs su gtong bar byed dam/ yi ger 'dri ba'am/ yi ger 'drir 93—596

'jug gam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ mchod pa byed dam/ yang dag par ston tam/ bsnyen bkur byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par byed pa gang yin pa dang / gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa la lo 'bum du me tog dang /bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis mchod pas mchod par byed/rjed par byed cing / bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / gtsug lag khang dang / 'chag sa dang / skyed mos tshal dag byed du bcug gam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyir rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad phyed pa brgya'am stong byed du bcug ste/ de dag la lo 'bum du mchod pa dag gis mchod par byed pa bas/ gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi sher 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / mchod pa byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa de ni de bas ches 91 bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba ches mang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon sum du mchod pa byed pa de ni de lta ma yin la/ sems can thams cad la sbyin pa byin zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po dag gis rtser bcug pa yang de lta ma yin no/ /de lta bas na rigs kyi bu dang /rigs kyi bu mo dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po dang /blon po de dag gis rtag par rgyun du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mchod par bya'o/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sgrogs par byed pa dang / rjod par byed pa dang /don kyang nye bar sgrub par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag la yang de 93—597

bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'du shes bskyed par bya zhing / de dag gis bsnyen bkur byas te chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan par bya/ gzung bar bya bcang bar bya/ bklag par bya/ yid la bya zhing 'di ltar sems bskyed par yang bya ste / bdag cag don med pa la don du 'du shes pa dang / mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shes pa dang / sdug bsngal ba la bde bar 'du shes shing / lam ma yin par zhugs pa la lam nye bar ston pa gang yin pa dang / bdag cag sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten las yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa byed pa gang yin pa de ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam du sems bskyed par yang bya'o / /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa mdzad pa chen pos yang dag par bshad lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na/lho phyogs kyi rgyud na spyod par 'gyur te/ der yang dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po dang / blon po snod du gyur pa mchod pa byed pa/'dzin par byed pa/ klog par byed pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur zhing / dad par 'gyur / yid ches par 'gyur ro/ /gal te byang dang / shar dang / nub phyogs kyi rgyud dag na spyod par 'gyur na/ yang de na gang dag nyan par mi byed pa dang / dad par mi byed pa dang / yid ches par mi byed pa dang / mchod par mi byed pa dang / brtson 'grus zhan pa dang / brjed ngas pa dang / bu 93—598

smad dang / bran dang / bran mo dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang /bzhad gad dang / 'jo sgeg dang / bro dang / gar dang / glu sna tshogs kyis rnam par g.yengs shing / phrag dog dang / ser sna'i dran pas nyan par mi byed / yid ches par mi byed pa'i sems can de dag ni bdud kyi las la mngon par brtson pa yin te/ de dag ni skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa dag dang / sems can dmyal ba dang /dud 0)'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul rnams las yongs su mi thar ba kho nar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo bdag nyid ngan song thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'dod pa de dag gis bsnyen bkur byas te chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mchod par bya zhing / gzhan dag la yang yang dag par bstan par bya yid la yang gzung bar bya'o / /khrag khrug dang / 'khrug klong dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dag dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / gnag nad dang / phyugs nad dang / mi nad dag dang / nad dang / 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa sna tshogs dag la yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mchod pa byas te bklag par bya'o/ /rgyal mtshan btsugs la me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dag gis mchod cing phyogs bzhir gtor ma gtor la me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dag gis phyag byas te 'jug par byas na/der yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su 93—599

bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /sngon gyi srid par 'dren pas gang gsungs shing / /sems can thams cad rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /da ltar ngas kyang khyod la bshad pa yi/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni zung shig kun dga' bo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog la/ /gang gis khams gsum sbyin par byin pa bas/ /mdo sde 'di la mchod pa byas na ni/ /sbyin pas de yi dper yang mi phod do/ /gang gis sangs rgyas la ni dad byas te/ /tshad med gtsug lag khang dag brtsigs pa bas/ /gang zhig mdo 'di 'dzin pa gang yin pa/ /de ni de bas bsod nams mang por 'gyur/ /gang zhig me tog gcig tsam 'thor byed cing / /gos dang phreng ba byug pa de bzhin te/ /ting 'dzin 'di la bsnyen bkur byed gyur na/ /bsod nams tshogs char snga ma de mi 'gyur/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di la mchod pa'i phyir/ /kār ṣā pa ṇa'i sbyin pa sbyin byed cing / /byang chub phyir ni byams pa'i sems bskyed na/ /de ni de bas bsod nams mang po 'thob/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis sems can la/ /ting 'dzin 'di bshad lung phog de bzhin du/ /bla med byang chub phyir ni bkod gyur na / /de yi bsod nams dper yang mi bzod 'gyur/ /de ltas 3)phan yon 'di dag thos nas kyang / /sems can kun la de bzhin byams byas te/ /mdo 'di gzung zhing yi sher bri bar bya/ /bklag par bya zhing de bzhin bshad par bya/ /rga dang de bzhin na 'chis gnod gyur cing / /sdug bsngal rab drag brgya yis yongs gdungs la/ /sems dmyal yi dgas rnams su skye ba na/ /phyi ma'i dus na 'gyod par gyur ta re/ /'chi ba'i dus na yid skrag 'jigs gyur la/ /yang dang yang du sngam pa 'don byed cing / /bdag gi dpung gnyen skyabs su su 93—600

'gyur zhes/ /byis pa'i blo can phan tshun rtog ga re/ /gang phyir de bzhin gshegs pa ma mchod cing / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nor 'phrogs pa/ /mi bzad gshin rje'i 'jig rten khrid 'gyur zhing / /phyin chad rtag tu skyabs 'gyur 'ga' yang med/ /bu smad yod min nye du rtsa lag med/ /yul 'khor yod min bzhad gad 'jo sgeg med/ /nor dang 'bru dang de bzhin gos dang rgyan / /kun spangs sdug bsngal yang dang yang mi zad/ /ting 'dzin 'di la dad par ma byas pas/ /de 'dra'i sdug bsngal mi bzad myong 'gyur bas/ /sdug bsngal 'di dang phan yon de thos na/ /byis pa'i blo yang su zhig dad mi skyed / /de phyir rtag tu dge slong pho mo dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang rgyal pos khor hunyezug dang / /mdo sde 'di ni rtag tu gzung bya zhing / /'dzin pa la yang rtag tu bsnyen bkur bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung lags te/ ston pa'i 'du shes kyis bcang bar bgyi zhing sems can thams cad la yang dag par bstan par bgyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gal te khyod kyis ngas chos gang bstan pa mnyan te kun bzung ba de dag thams cad 'chang bar mi byed/ klog par mi byed / rgyas par mi byed kyang / des ni khyod kyis nga la nyes pa byas par mi 'gyur zhing gus par ma mnyan par yang mi 'gyur la/ nyan thos nyid ma yin par yang mi 'gyur gyi/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang bar mi byed/ klog par mi byed/ mchod par mi byed/ yang dag par ston par mi byed/ yid la mi byed na ni des na khyod kyis nga la nyes pa byas par 'gyur zhing gus par ma mnyan 93—601

par yang 'gyur la/ nyan thos nyid yin par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na khyod kyis phu dud byas te chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bcang bar bya'o/ /'di ni phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe na sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na srog chags drug khri len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdun brgyas ni ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /lnga brgyas ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad par skye bar lung bstan pa thob par gyur to/ /srog chags dgu khri ni nyon mongs pa thams cad las rnam par grol te mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro thams cad spangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni slad ma'i dus slad ma'i tshe na/ rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo nyan par bgyid pa dang / 'dzin par bgyid pa dang /ri mor bgyid pa dang / mchod par bgyid pa de dag dang / yi ger 'dri bar bgyid pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa bgyid par 'gyur te/ de dag kyang ji lta bu 'tshal ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa dag tu lung bstan pa lags so/ /slad ma'i dus slad ma'i tshe na sems can gang bzhad gad dang /'jo sgeg dang / gar dang / bro dang / glu dang / rol mo'i sgra dag la sna tshogs su g.yeng ba/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi mun pa che ba/ rtsed mo la dga' bar 'du shes pa/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shes pa/93—602

phrag dog dang / ser snas yongs su zin cing / mchod par mi bgyid/ ri mor mi bgyid/ dad par mi bgyid/ glo ba ches par mi bgyid/ 'chang bar mi bgyid/ klog par mi bgyid/ nyan par mi bgyid/ nan tan gyis sgrub par mi bgyid pa de dag ni ngal ba 'di yid byung bar bgyis shing / sngon gyi las kyi 'bras bu de yongs su bas par bgyis nas sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba sna tshogs dang / sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dag nyams su myong bar 'gyur zhing / der yang bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag du mar sdug bsngal nyams su myong nas yang slar sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams su skye bar 'gyur lags te/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang gis yun ring por rjes su 'gyod par 'gyur lags so/ /de lta lags pas na lus dang / ngag dang / yid legs par bsdam par bgyi zhing /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dag la yang dad pa mi phyed par bgyi / sems can thams cad la yang byams pa'i sems dang / phrag dog dang /ser sna dang / 'chal pa'i tshul khrims yongs su spangs pa'i sems dang / khro ba yongs su spangs pa'i sems su bgyi lags so/ /de nas ji ltar lhags pa'i 'khor de dag gis rang rang gi bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la lha'i me tog dang / bdug spos dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dag dang / a la la zhes ca co dang ga zha'i sgra dag dang / lha'i sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dang /glu dbyangs dag gis mchod pa byas nas legs so zhes bya ba gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /sems can thams cad kyi don dang / de 93—603

bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du chos kyi rnam grangs chen po 'di shin tu legs par bka' stsal lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rjes su gnang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnon pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig /rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa 'dus pa chen po zhes bya bar yang zung shig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / 'jam dpal dang / lag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad dang / nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba de dag thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin chen mo dpe med ma dang / dri med 'od dang / 'od can ma dang / 'jigs byed ma dang / dpal ldan ma dang / dung can ma dang / 'phrog ma la sogs pa de dag dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po de dag thams cad dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor ji ltar lhags pa de dag dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge 93—604

bsnyen ma'i 'khor rnams yi 1)rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra (gebo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/559 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ rin〈〈khu 〉〉ya/562 1)〈〈khu 〉〉bu/566 6)〈〈khu 〉〉'gyur/568 gyo)〈〈khu 〉〉tshom/ (ge〈〈khu 〉〉gsal/569 91)〈〈khu 〉〉srungs pa/572 6)〈〈khu 〉〉phro/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉 'jigs pa'am/ 55)〈〈khu 〉〉dri/ (0〈〈khu 〉〉mi/ 55༄〈〈khu 〉〉the/573 3)〈〈khu 〉〉 la/574 41)〈〈khu 〉〉tshom/575 (1)〈〈khu 〉〉zhing /577 1)〈〈khu 〉〉dod/579 3)〈〈khu 〉〉 bas/ (5)〈〈khu 〉〉nges/581 91)〈〈khu 〉〉bgyi/ (ge〈〈khu 〉〉dri/ 5ni〈〈khu 〉〉rnyiṣ+ṭha/ ri ri〈〈khu 〉〉kri/ 5ni〈〈khu 〉〉tu/ dzini〈〈khu 〉〉gyi/582 41)〈〈khu 〉〉pa'i/583 (1)〈〈khu 〉〉bdag/ (nas〈〈khu 〉〉'dir/586 51)〈〈khu 〉〉tshom/587 1)〈〈khu 〉〉rigs/ rige〈〈khu 〉〉ṅgā/93wa 605

588 ①〈〈khu 〉〉nyi/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉'dab/589 6)〈〈khu1 〉〉brtswa/ phyi〈〈khu 〉〉'phrogs/ ponye〈〈khu 〉〉spangs pa/59༷ 6)〈〈khu 〉〉ri/592 ①〈〈khu 〉〉dag ②〈〈khu 〉〉ti/ 0)〈〈khu 〉〉dzo bi/ ④〈〈khu 〉〉bi/ ()()〈〈khu 〉〉ti/ ⑦〈〈khu 〉〉sna/ 9)〈〈khu 〉〉mi/593 6)〈〈khu 〉〉brtswa/59'ju 6)〈〈khu1 〉〉ཿdzam/597 6)〈〈81 〉〉ཿdzas/599 ①〈〈khu 〉〉bdud/6༷༷ 6)〈〈khu1 〉〉hā//6༷1 6)〈〈khu1 〉〉'khor/6༷5 0)〈〈khu 〉〉ye/ 90〈〈khu 〉〉rin+d+ra/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (368)93wa 606

0753༄ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/91sta༄༅gi /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa mthu chen thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ 'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang / mtshan nas brjod pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa thams cad zhi zhing rgyun chad par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis 93—607

rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa dang gnod pa dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / mi dge ba'i chos dang / bdud kyi las skyes pa thams cad byang zhing grol bar gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal rtag tu mthong zhing smon lam ji skad btab pa thams cad kyang myur du thob par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs 91)dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'phags pa gang dag zhal mngon sum du lta zhing dam pa mchog gsol ba thams cad kyang de bzhin du grub par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'jig rten dag na phongs shing nyam thag pa thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar bgyid pa la mthu chen po thob par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 93—608

'tshal lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ 'jig rten dag na mu ge'i dgon pa chen po dang /me dang / chu dang / rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa gang dag byung bas skye bo mang po nyam thag pa de dag zhi ba dang / ma mchis par bgyid par gyur cig /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can gang dag 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu 'chi 'pho ba'i 'jigs pa chen po nye bar gnas pa na yang / 'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug khyod zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing dbugs 'byin pa chen po mdzad par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can gzhan 'chi 'pho ba dag gis kyang nyon mongs pa dag gis ma spros pa chos bdag med pa dran pa dang ldan pa / byang chub kyi sems tshad med par brtan pa/ sems ma zhum pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang ldan zhing / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba thams cad nye bar zhi zhing / dran pa nye bar gzhag bzhin du 'chi 'pho bar gyur cig /tshe rabs thams cad du yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du skye zhing tshe rabs rjes su dran pa dang / byang chub kyi sems phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ 'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug la sogs pa mnyes par bgyid cing / ji skad bstan pa bzhin du grub pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /ji ltar thugs rje'i dbang phyug des thugs rje chen po'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo lhun gyis grub pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje dang ro gcig par gyur cig /ji ltar thugs rje'i dbang phyug gis sems can yongs su smin par mdzad 93—609

pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba de bzhin du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis kyang sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyid pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par gyur cig /ji ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mtshan nas brjod cing bsnyen bkur bgyis par gyur cig /ji ltar dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang bzhin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod cing mchod pa bgyis pas/ thugs rje chen po'i yul du gyur pa sems can thams cad la yang snying rje chen po'i thabs kyi sbyor ba rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar gyur cig /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /de snyed bdag ni lus skyes par/ /de srid mgon po mchod bgyid cing / /de snyed lus sbyor tshogs bgyid shog /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /ji skad bdag gis ngag skyes par/ /de srid mgon po'i mtshan brjod cing / /ngag gi sbyor ba tshogs bgyid shog /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba na/ /de snyed bdag gi yid 'byung ba/ /de snyed mgon po rjes dran zhing / /yid sbyor tshogs par bgyid gyur cig /de ltar lus dang ngag yid kyis / /thugs rje'i dbang phyug rten bgyis pas/ /lus dang ngag yid skyon bral zhing / /yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur cig /de ltar lus ngag yid kyis su/ /93—610

thugs rje'i dbang phyug sku gsung thugs/ /rtag tu sbyor bar bgyis pas na/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs/ /srid gsum re ba'i gnas gcig po//yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de 'drar bdag kyang grub gyur te/ /srid gsum re rdzogs bgyid gyur cig /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā (17ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tsakra brti/ tsin+ta ma ṇi ma hā pad+me ru ru tiṣ+ṭha/ dz+wa la ā mar+sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/rtsa ba'i sngags rdzogs so/ /o pad+me tsin+ta ma ṇi dz+wa la hūṃ/ snying po'o/ /oṃ bha ra ta pad+me hūm̐/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /o ma ṇi badz+re ṇi hūm̐/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /sngags snying bzhi 'byung ba dang / smon lam dang tshigs su bcad pa dang sngags su bcas pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/607 1)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/6༷8 )ni〈〈zhol 〉〉 gzigs/611 915〈〈zhol 〉〉ār+ya a/93—611

༄ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i gzungs phan yon mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/1 ra༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā (2ru ṇi da ka nā ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te 4shwa ra dhā 5)ra tsā (6༄a nu shaṃ sa sa hi ta sru tā (7)ta si gra rin gyi ta/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i gzungs phan yon mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri bo po ṭa 9skul spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas na byang chub sems dpa' grangs med dpag tu med pa'i 'khor gyis bskor nas/ de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs nas thal mo sbyar zhing bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nga la 'di lta bu'i gzungs yod ming ni thugs rje chen po zhes zer sems can kun gyi mi dge ba'i sdig pa 1 shin tu lci ba'i sgrib pa bdud dang 11'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa 'dod pa thams cad 93—613

rab tu tshim par byed pa'i phyir ngas bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das la bshad pa'i gnang ba zhus nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi bu khyod kyis thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas gzungs 3)bshad par 'dod pa'i dus la bab bo/ /myur bar bshad du gsol/ nga dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang rjes su yi (2rang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma'am/ khye'u 'am/ bu mos na 'don pa dang 'chang bar 'dod pas sems can thams cad kyi ched du thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas thog mar 'di lta bu'i 545sems bskyed par bya'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po skul phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis rmechos rnams thams cad myur du rtogs par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis ye shes mig ni myur du thob par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad myur du sgrol bar shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis thabs mkhas pa dag myur du thob par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni 77myur du shes rab gru yis sgrol bar shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni myur du sdug bsngal mtsho las 'da' bar shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni myur du tshul khrims rkang gi lam thob shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni myur du mya ngan 'da' ba'i 8ri 'dzeg 9shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs 93—614

0755khug /ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtog pa chen po/byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa le'u rab 'byam las bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i ga pa zhes bya ba/1༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ud+dhā dza ṭā ma hā kulpa ma hā bo dhi satwa tshanabi kurba ṇa pa ṭa la bi sa 'od bha ga ba cakhri ār+ya tā rā mū 5la kulpa nā ma/ bod skad du/ral pa gyen brjes 6kyi rtog pa chen po/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul 7pa le'u rab 'byam 8las bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma'i gru'i steng gi nam mkha'i mthil na rab tu bzhugs te/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas rab tu phye ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan par bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha'i bu rnams la bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu khyed rnams nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 93—624

dbang phyug gi rmad du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul gyi spyod pa ting nge 'dzin dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi khyad par rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar byed pa dang / tshe dang / nad med pa dang / dbang phyug dang / yid kyi shing rta yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi gzhi/sems can thams cad la phan pa'i ched du bshad kyis17/ de legs par nyon la legs par yid la gyis shig /ngas bshad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes so/ /de nas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de rnams thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis spyod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par so sor thob par byed pa/ rdo rje'i gdan gnon par byed pa/ bdud 'dul bar byed pa/chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor 5bar byed pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad nges par 'byung bar byed pa/ lha dang mi rnams su skye bar byed pa/sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ dbul ba dang nad kyis btab pa thams cad kyi nad sel bar byed pa nyid dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi spyod pa zil gyis mi non pa nyid dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa de gsung du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad don med par gsung bar sa)byed pa ma lags na/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i sems dang / bdag cag dang / sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse ba nye bar bzung nas de gsung du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas thams cad dang ldan 93—625

pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rnam par gzigs nas rnam par dag pa'i yul la 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzod spu nas me tog lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kun du skul 1bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su bskor ba nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa 'das nas nub phyogs kyi char gang gā'i klung brgya stong phrag gi (gyibye ma dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams las 'das pa na/ bde ba can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rjes su zhugs te/ gang du de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bzhugs pa der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa la so sor gnas pa rnams kyi thabs cig dzod tu bzhugs pa de 'od zer gyi snang ba mthong bas cung zad rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal de nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la bka' stsal to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras rnams 'di ni bdag cag rnams kun du skul 4bar byed pa'i 'od zer 'dir 'ongs pa yin par khyed cag gis shes par gyis shig /de nas yang sems dpa' chen po de rnams spyan 'dzums 5pa spyan gdangs nas/ 'di'i 'od zer gyi snang ba gang yin pa der mngon par phyogs te gnas so/ /de nas kun du skul (6bar byed pa'i 'od zer des bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams chen po kun du snang bas 7༄kun du snang bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med la lan 93—626

gsum bskor ba byas nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi ye shes kyi spyi bor nub par gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa' chen po de stan las langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas mgo bos rab tu phyag 'tshal 1te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dgongs su gsol bdag cag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs/ rgyas shākya thub pa gang na ba der song ste bcom ldan 'das mi mjed kyi khams de dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la blta (2chib dang / phyag 'tshal zhing bsnyen bkur ba dang /rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi spyod pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dang /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rtog pa dang / gsang ba'i ras ris kyi cho ga dang /bzlas pa dang / rig pa'i dbang bskur ba thams cad khyad par du bstan pas sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces (8)gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po gang da lta de'i dus la bab par shes na song shigathu /nga'i tshig gis kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la gnod pa chung ngam/nyam nga ba chung ngam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ 5reg par gnas sam zhes med par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po gang gā'i klung brgya stong phrag gang 93—627

gā'i bye ma la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang khyod kyi rigs dang / gsang sngags kyi spyod pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rtog pa dang / gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba dang /phyag rgya dang / ras ris kyi cho ga dang / sbyin sreg dang / bzlas pa'i nges pa hubasam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ sems can thams cad kun nas dga' bar byed pa/ rin po che snang ba'i le'u rab 'byam (gu'adas pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i ye shes rnams kyis rang gi rig sngags dang /gsang sngags la 'jug par byed pa ston pa/ mthar thug par zin pa dang /nang gi dus dang ldan pa dang / dam tshig rab 'byam gyi (8 le'u dang / 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa mtha' dag ma lus par bsdus pa/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la bzhugs (gepa dang / spyod pa mthar thug pa gsung ba dang ldan pa dag gsungs pa la'ang (5)/'di la rjes su yi rang ba kho na'o/ /sems dpa' chen po/ da lta de'i dus la bab par shes na khyod song shig6 /shākya thub pa'i drung du de la mngon du phyogs pas dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 7'di nyon la khyod kyang smra bar 'gyur ro/ /'di la yang nartsa ba'i rig sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo (9ri.a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyakle bud dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo 1 dhi satā 11ya/ ma hā satā 12ya/ na mo bha ga ba s+t+ya ār+ya tā rā yi / bo dhi satā yi/ tar+ya thā/ tā re ṛ 1 dzu ka dharma ni t+ya te/ tā re tut+ta re/shān+ta dharma nir+sā 1 te/ tā re a na bhi lā pyad/ dharma nir+ya te/ tut+ta re/ tu re tu 93—628

re hi ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ o ha ni/ mo ha ni/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ pra bhe / tsan+d+ra pra bhe 91)gyi li hi li/ tsi li tsi li/ bhe 95nig sā mi ni/ kuṇ+ḍi kuṇ+ḍi ma hā kuṇ+ḍari / dha ra dha ra/ dha na pa ni tā re/ hu ru hu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ a haṃ yā ya/ tsin+ta yā mi tsin+ta dha mi 5ku ru swā dhā ya swā hā/ 'di ni sems dpa' chen po khyod kyi 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i rig pa de yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad kyis gsungs shing / gsung bar 'gyur ba ste / khyod kyis kyang da lta smra bar 'gyur ro/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dri rgyas pas rnam par phye ba'i mthar shākya thub pa byon te/ shākya thub pas rjes su gnang ba'o/ /'di la mchog gi snying por 'gyur ba yang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 7ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/'di la nye ba'i snying po yang / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥsarba bud+dha smyo bo dhi satā 9māṃ / oṃ ku ru kul+le swā hā/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang nas / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyu mthun pa 1 byang chub kyi snying po kun du thob par byed pa thams cad kyi bkod pa'i rgyan zhes 1 bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu phyogs bzhi rnams dang /steng dang / 'og dang / thad kya'i mthar thug pa'i thams cad du thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kun du gang bar gyur to/ /rgyal ba'i sras po legs so legs so/ /gang khyod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par 'di lta bu la snyoms par zhugs pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 1 /mi nus te/ byang chub 93—629

sems dpa'i spyod pa la rab tu zhugs pa sa bcu la rab tu bzhugs pa rnams kyis kyang snyoms par 'jug par mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyis thabs cig 1byams pa dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mchog gi snying po mchog gsang ba don thams cad sgrub par byed pa yi ge gcig pa zhes bya ba mchog tu gsang ba'i sems can thams cad kyi (na las thams cad byed ma/rig sngags gzhan rnams kyis kyang rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i khyad par gyis sgrub par byed pa dang mthun ri cipa'i rig sngags gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med yud tsam zhig ci yang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /thams cad du thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis kun du gzigs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dgongs pa byams pa'i bdag nyid kyi sems kyis rig sngags gsungs par 4gyur to/ /na maḥ sarba bud+dha 45/ oṃ bīḥ6 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma'i mchog gi snying po las thams cad byed pa'o/ /de nas byang chub (7risems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas 'di lta ste/ skyes bu stobs dang 8ldan pa zhes bya ba de lag pa bskum pa las rkyong 9ba'am/ brkyang ba las skum 1 pa dang se gol gtogs 17pa tsam gyis kyang mig 'byed 'dzums pa skad cig tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs mgyogs pa'i blo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par rnam par 'phrul pa nyid ces bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su 'ongs nas kyang slar 'khod de steng gi nam mkha'i mthil du nor bu rin po che chen 9(3wa 630

po la so sor 'khod pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du 1'khod nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'od zer chen po'i chodakun du snang bas kun du snang bar byas nas rin po che'i snang ba'i bdag po'i sa rgyan gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu khang pa brtsegs pa rin po che du mas rnam par phye ba dang / rin po che'i gdugs du mas dpag tshad brgya stong phrag tu khyab pa dang / lha'i gos dang / dar gyi rgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa dang / lha'i me tog dang / ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan dang / phreng ba dang / rin po che g.yer kha'i dra ba bcings pa/ sgra snyan pa 'khrol ba 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' so sor gnas par byed pa/ lha'i dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma'i char 'bebs par byed pa/ mngon par sprul te bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la mchod pa'i las ngo mtshar rmad 4du byung ba'i cho 'phrul byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul mthong ngo / /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de rnams dga' ba dang bcas pa spu zing zhes byed do/ /lha'i gnas thams cad rab tu g.yos pa dang ldan pa mthong nas skrag cing / snying 'dar te 'on te 'byor pa yongs su nyams sam ci zhes phan tshun rings thabs su skad mthon pos smra bar rtsom 5zhing / 'di skad ces kyang 6smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su skyobs shig /shākya thub pa yongs su skyobs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i lha'i 'khor la bka' stsal to/ /ma 'jigs shig /ma 'jigs shig /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems 93—631

dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun nas me tog can lta bu nas nga nyid lta ba dang phyag 'tshal zhing bsnyen bkur bar 'dod de/ don chen po spyod pa dang / rig sngags kyi tshig dang / chos kyi tshig rmad du byung ba yang nges par bstan pa'i phyir 'ongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mig mi 'dzums par bltas te zhabs gnyis la btud nas yi ge'i tshig rab tu smras pa 'di rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mkhyen khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchog khyod la/ /spyod pa'i don kun sgrub pa po/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu gtso khyod la/ /don med thams cad bzlog pa po1/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu seng ge khyod / /ngan song thams cad 'joms pa po/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod phyag 'tshal / /bsod nams dri ni mtha' yas pa/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu pad dkar khyod / /srid gsum 'dam ni rnam sbyong ba/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu pad+ma khyod/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rnam grol byed/ /thams cad grol khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdung ba thams cad legs 'dul byed/ /zhi ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags kyi spyod don sgrub pa po/ /thams cad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis kun gyis bkra shis pa/ /bkra shis khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams thams cad kun du rtogs/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig khyod phyag 'tshal/ /chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /spros pa med pa'i rnam pa ni/ /yang dag rjes 'jug ston pa po / /de bzhin gshegs pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /shes dang shes bya'i dngos po kun / /legs par byas shing yang dag thos/ /theg gsum lam dang myang 'das 93—632

la / /rab tu gnas 'jug rab gnas pa/ /kun mkhyen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /zhes yi ge'i tshig rab tu smras pa 'di rnams kyis bstod pa'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mngon par bstod nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di nas gang gā'i klung brgya stong phrag gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'das nas nub phyogs kyi char kun nas me tog ldan zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gyur pa der/ bde ba can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 1nisangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa / 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na med pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur 2ba/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa bzhugs te/ de chos ston par mdzad pa ni/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i tshangs par spyod pa/ yang dag par ston par mdzad cing de 'di ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes rnal chos kyang ston par mdzad do/ /rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi don gyi spyod pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang / lam gsum gyi spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i la ma dang / skyob pa dang /gnas dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / bde ba dang / shin tu mthar thug pa dang / shin tu yongs su mthar gtugs pas sems can thams cad la ston te/ bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi mdzad pas rjes su gnang nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung dang / nye ba 'dir 'ongs te bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa chung ngam/93—633

nyam nga ba chung ngam/ ldang ba yang ngam/ bsnyun mi mnga' 'am/ bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes yongs su 'dri bar byed de/ 'di skad ces kyang gsung ngo ske/ /gang rnam pa 'di lta bu'i snyigs ma'i dus gang du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku de yang chos ston par mdzad cing rjes su rtogs par bya ba'i skye bo la lam gsum gyi byang grol dang / lha dang / mi rnams kyi skye ba 0nirnyed par mdzad pa de ni ngo mtshar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de'i brtson 'grus kyis gang du skal ba med pa'i sems can gyi tshogs srid pa gsum yang dag par 'joms pa'i lam du mthar thug par 'jug par byed gtan du grub pa dang /bde ba'i rjes su mthun (2 pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la sems can rnams rab tu 'god par mdzad pa ni ngo mtshar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho nas mkhyen gyis55/bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnams/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul du shes par 'dod pa'am/ thugs kyi spyad pa spyod pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang / sems pa 4shes par 'dod pa'am/ mtha' dag nges par ston pa ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag rnams kyis kyang brjod par yang ga la nus/gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 5 de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sgrub pa bsdus 6)pa dang / so so ba ma lus pa'i ngo bo 'dus ma byas pa'i 57)chos nyid du (3cibalta 9bar bya ste/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba spong ba dang / ring por mi thogs par spyod pa smra bar 'dod pa'am/ yon tan ston par 'dod pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das kho nas mkhyen gyisal/ bdag gis ni ma 93—634

yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa sprul te/ rin po che chen po'i 1pad+ma la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la blta bzhin du bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gtam gyi (5)rjes su 'brangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtam gyis mthar gyi dri ba sngon du 'gro bas phan tshun chos bstan pa'i mthar rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sgrub pa'i don du nye bar tshogs pa rnams la tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / ka la ping ka ri )dang / ku ta ra dang / bi ta ras bsgrubs pa'i rnga bo che'i dbyangs su grags pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po khyod legs par 'ongs sam/ sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs (4 sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad don yang dag par thob par byed pa dang / rig sngags dang /gsang sngags kyi tshig thams cad dang / gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba dang bcas pa dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / rtog pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / tshe dang / nad med pa dang / dbang phyug dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sgrub thabs thams cad kyi cho ga'i rgyud dang / shes pa dang shes bya dus kyi mthar nub pa dang / rgyal srid dang /zhing 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba mdor bsdus pa las/sems can thams cad kyi 55 bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 93—635

dang / rang gi yon tan 'byung ba 1)/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i mthar 'jug par byed pa/ sems can gzhan dga' bar byed pa/ mi snang ba dang nam mkhar 'gro bar byed pa/ rkang pa rab tu brgyus pa/ yid gzhungs par byed pa/'chugs par byed pa/ sa 'og tu rab tu 'jug par byed pa/ mngon par spyod par byed pa/ don thams cad thob pa/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin mo dang / ci bgyi dang / sha za dang / 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ byis pa dang / rgan po dang / lang tsho ji ltar gnas bzhin du gnas par byed pa ste/ mdor bsdus na las thams cad byed pa/ yid kyi shing rta thams cad rdzogs par byed pa/ rgyas pa can dang /zhi ba can gyi 2las rab tu byed pa/ ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar bar bya bzhin pa/ de lta de ltar bsgrub par bya bzhin pa/ri ) byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang ldan pa phal po che rtog pa chen po rin po che'i le'u rab 'byam / nongs rjes su gnang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa/ dag pa'i sems can rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don/ chos kyi mdzod/ skye bo mang po la phan pa'i ched dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba'i ched du/ lha dang mi rnams dang / sems can thams cad la ston cig /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 5kyis kun tu skul 6bar byed pa rgyan bkod pa'i 'od zer snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu dag pa'i sems can du ma gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams 'od zer gyi snang bas ji srid 'og min gyi srid pa nas 93—636

ji srid mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen po'i bar gyi sems can gang la la sdug bsngal gyis lho)shin tu gdungs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i 'gro ba rnams zhi ba dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag par bskul nas slar yang 'od zer de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyi bor nub par gyur to/ /'di la gzhan shar phyogs la sogs pa rnam par gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang yin pa der sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bskul ba'i 'od zer des rlung gi dkyil 'khor yang dag par bskul bas bsgrubs 95)pa 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba nyid kyi snang ba dri kun du gsal ba'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun du snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sā 3skula'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa rnam par nges pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun du snang ba mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bai ḍūr+ya'i snang ba'i 'od zer gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de lta bu la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas yongs su bskor ba mtha' yas shing mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su sgrol ma'i 93—637

gru'i tshal na gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi spyod pa nges par ston pa'i tshig gi don gyi le'u rab 'byam 51)gsungs pa de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams 'dzum pa yang dag par ston par mdzad do/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang gi phyogs rnams su(5)/ phyogs bral rnams su zhes pas / steng dang / 'og dang / thad ka thams cad du thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su snang bar byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su thams cad du yang bdud kyi gnas thams cad spa (8bkong bar byas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba dang bcas pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pas mdun du bdar nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la gnas pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid chen po nyid lta bar 'dod pa/ mchog gi rig pa'i rjes su spyod pa sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyi le'u rab 'byam cade bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa thogs pa med pa yang gsal bar byed 'dod pas so sor 'khod par gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ lag bzang dang / rin chen bzang po dang / brtul zhugs bzang po dang / spyan bzang po dang 5/ dga' ba bzang po dang / chos gos (6chibazang po dang / dngos grub 'char bzang dang / thams cad 'phags dang / chos 'phags dang / rin chen 'phags dang / rin chen dpal dang / lhun po'i dpal dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dpal dang / 'od byed dpal dang /rab snang dpal dang / snang ba'i dpal dang / don thams cad kyi dpal 93—638

dang / lag na thams cad rin chen dang / gtsug na nor bu dang / lag na rin chen dang / lag na lhun po'i rgyal mtshan dang / rnam par snang mdzad snying po dang / rin chen snying po dang / ye shes snying po dang / don bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snying po dang / chos 'phags snying po dang / mchod sbyin tog dang / tog bzang po dang / mtha' yas tog dang / 'od zer tog dang /dri med tog dang / ma lus tog dang / nam mkha'i tog dang / rin chen tog dang / 'brug sgra dbyangs dang / rnga bo che'i nga ro'i rgyal po dang /mtha' yas gsal ba'i ye shes rgyal po dang / mun pa mun nag thams cad rnam par sel ba'i rgyal po dang / rnam par g.yeng ba thams cad 'joms 1pa'i rgyal po dang / spyod pa thams cad phul du byung ba'i ye shes kyi rgyal po dang / 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal po dang / phul du byung ba'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang /rnam par sel ba'i rgyal po dang / mi g.yo ba'i rgyal po dang / nyi ma'i rgyal po dang / thams cad gsal ba yang dag par 'phags pa'i rgyal po dang / rang bzhin yang dag par 'phags pa'i rgyal po dang / dngos po med par yang dag par 'phags pa'i rgyal po dang / phyogs lhag pa'i rgyal po dang / rang gi dngos po med par snang ba dang / bsod nams snang ba dang / kun du lta ba'i snang ba dang / 'od dpag med dang / dpag na yod snang ba dang / spyan bzang snang ba dang / legs 'byung snang ba dang / mtha' yas snang ba dang /mi tshugs snang ba dang / ma sgyur ba dang / 'og min dang / dri med dang /me dang / snang ba dang / blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang / bde ba dang /bde ba'i mu khyud dang / mu khyud kyi tog dang / 'dod pa'i lha dang / lha'i lha 93—639

dang / lte ba rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten zhi ba dang / nye ba'i 'chi ltas (1)dang /rnga bo che dang / grub pa dang / dkar por grags pa dang / lha rab tu bzod dka' la gdul dka' ba dang / gsal dka' ba dang / ring du song ba dang /ring por len dang / ring por gnas dang / mtho zhing mtho ba'i mun pa dang /mkha' snang dang / kun nas snang dang / snang min dang / khyu mchog dang /kun nas snang ldan dang / nges par mnyam pa dang / lha chen po dang / shin tu nges pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / dri ma mthar thug pa dang / mnyam pa'i mtshan ma bzang po dang / dkar po dang / i mi ki mi dang / tha chung dang /dka' bas 'tsho ba dang / bde bar 'tsho ba dang / legs par skyes pa dang /du ba'i tog dang / mchod sbyin tog dang / dkar po'i tog dang / tog bzang po dang / dbyig gi tog dang / nor dgag tu med pa dang / pha chen po dang / do shal phyed pa dang / 'jig rten grags pa dang / kun du grags pa dang / chen por grags pa dang / mchog tu grags pa dang / skyes pa dang /snang ba dang / ci bgyi dang / mnyam par byed pa dang / 'jig rten byed pa dang / snang ba byed pa dang / nyin mor byed pa dang / 'byung bar byed pa dang / don thams cad byed pa dang / grub par byed pa dang / 'od byed pa dang / kun du gsal bar byed pa dang / rnga bo che'i dbyangs dang / sgra dbyangs dang / dbyangs bzang dang / mtha' yas dbyangs dang / tog gi dbyangs dang / 'byung ba'i thub pa dang / gser thub dang / log par dad sel dang / 'od srung dang / gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob dang /rnam par gzigs dang / shākya thub pa zhes bya ba tshona'adi rnams kyis dang /93—640

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzhan mang po rnams kyis kyang 'khor gyi 1dkyil 'khor chen po kun du snang bar byas nas pad+ma'i gdan la so sor bzhugs par gyur to/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de rnams kyang bzhugs pa 'di lta ste/ phyag na rin chen dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / phyag na bzang po dang /nam mkha'i phyag dang / mtha' yas phyag dang / sa'i phyag dang / snang ba'i phyag dang / shin tu dri med dang / bzang po brtsegs pa dang / mang po brtsegs pa dang / nor bu brtsegs pa dang / rin chen brtsegs pa dang / e na brtsegs pa dang / rin chen glang po dang / kun nas glang po dang / spos kyi glang po dang / bzang 'gro dang / dri ma dang bral bar 'gro ba dang /'jig rten 'gro ba dang / mdzes par 'gro ba dang / mtha' yas 'gro ba dang /mtha' yas grags pa dang / legs grags dang / dri ma dang bral bar grags pa dang / 'gro bar grags pa dang / dri med grags pa nadang / grags pa'i mgon po dang / mgon med kyi mgon por gyur pa dang / 'jig rten mgon po dang / kun nas mgon po dang / rgyun bshes kyi bu dang / mtha' yas bshes kyi bu dang / kun du bshes kyi bu dang / byams ma'i bu dang / mig bzang gi bu dang / phyag 'tshal bshes kyi bu dang / twa ṣa tra'i bu dang /'bras bshes kyi bu dang / rin chen bshes kyi bu dang / skyabs gsum bshes kyi bu dang / theg gsum bshes kyi bu dang / mthu bsgyings dang / shin tu yid du 'ong ba dang / yid 'ong ldan dang / chos kyi dbang phyug dang /dngos po med pa'i dbang phyug dang / kun nas dbang phyug dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / legs gzigs dbang 93—641

phyug dang / rnam gzigs dbang phyug dang / 'jig rten 'dren pa dang /mchod pa bzang po dang / 'brug sgra'i dbang phyug dang / rnga bo che'i dbang phyug dang / bkod pa'i dbang phyug dang / bi ṣa te swa ra dang / char bzang po dang / mchod pa bzang po dang / grags ldan dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang /rab tu skyes pa la gnas pa dang / zla ba'i dbang phyug dang / so ba'i zla ba dang / zla ba nyid dang / mtha' yas dpal dang / kun du dpal dang /'jig rten dpal dang / nam mkha'i dpal dang / nam mkha'i kun sdud dang /nam mkha'i mdzod dang / sa'i dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /sa'i snying po dang / sgrib pa med pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / kun du bzang po dang / bzang skyong dang / nor bzang dang /legs par kun sdud dang / lo thog kun 'gyed pa'i nam mkha' dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / don kun rtogs 1pa dang / thams cad 'byung ba 2dang /ldog bya min pa dang / mi ldog pa dang / ngan song bzod dang / rnam par sgyur med 3dang / bkra shis rnam 'grel dang / gnad thams cad srung la ba zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyis dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang thabs cig 57bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyod yul du sgrol ma'i gru la bzhugs par gyur to/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi spyod pa'i don mtha' yas pa sgrub pa sems can mtha' yas pa dag gi bsam pa rnam par 'jug par byed pa'i lam la rab tu gnas su 'jug pa'i bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rig sngags kyi gzhi rjes su 'dzin par byed pa 93—642

sman gyi cha byad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa rnams dang / 'dab 1chags kyi tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / nor bu dang /sngags dang rin po che'i rgyal po dang / sems can dang / sems can ma yin pa grangs med pa thams cad kun du 'jug cing sems can gyi spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams dang / bsam pa ji lta bas sems can 'dul ba de lta bu'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams dang / de dag so so'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i nye bar bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos nges par 'byung ba de bzhin gshegs pa dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje dang /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad la kun du 'jug pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa las 'da' bar mi bya bar tshig gi lam la rab tu gnas par byed cing / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad par byed pa rnams te/ 'di lta ste / gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa dang / gdugs dkar mngon par 'phags pa dang / lo ma mtha' yas dang / lo ma brgya pa dang / gtsug tor rgyal ba dang / mngon par 'phags pa'i gtsug tor dang / pad+ma'i 'od zer dang / gser gyi 'od zer dang / 'od zer dkar po dang / gtsug tor bkod pa dang / gser gyi phung po dang / dkar po'i 2phung po dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / nor bu'i phung po dang / kun nas phung po dang / rnam par grags pa'i phung po dang / 'byung ba'i phung po dang / bden pa'i phung po dang / dngos po med pa'i phung po dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi phung po ste / 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang gtsug tor gyi rgyal po chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa la rab tu zhugs pa sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 903—643

du mngon par 'dod pa yongs su skong tsho1bar byed pa/ skye bo thams cad kyi yid kyi bsam pa rtogs pa bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gis kyang mi nus pa'i gtsug tor rgyal po nam mkha'i mthar thug pa brjod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang / pha rol gnon pa'i bdag nyid chen po lta bur ston par 'dod pas mtha' dag rgyas par bshad pa las mdor bsdus nas bstan par bya ste / rig 2pa'i rgyal po rnams kyis 'dus pa bshad par bya ba 'di lta ste/mdzod spu 3dang / smin ma dang / spyan dang / rdzi ma dang / snyan dang /mgrin pa dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / snying rje dang / byams pa dang / brtse ba'i tshim pa dang / shes rab dang / 'od zer dang / sems dpa' dang /'od zer cadri ma med dang / chos gos te 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang rig pa'i rgyal po mtha' yas mu med pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas spros pa rnams 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhung bzed dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzims cha dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 5kun du gsal ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i maṣ+ṭha dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gshegs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ma ste 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngags gsungs pa 6rnams te/ rig 7pa'i rgyal po dang / rgyal mo dang / ci bgyi dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / pho nya dang / pho nya mo dang / gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin mo dang / sems can dang 8sems can min pa so sor 9(3—644

khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyan 93)bkod pa'i chos kyi sprin nges par spros pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyi rgyu mthun na pa bye ba brgya stong phrag tshad med pas yongs su bskor ba/ rig pa'i tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du rab tu 'jug bzhin pa'i rig pa'i rgyal po de rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul der rigs bzang por lhag ri dīpar gnas pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyag bcu gnyis dang / phyag drug pa dang / phyag bzhi pa dang / hā la hā la dang / don yod zhags pa dang / rta mgrin dang /mgrin pa mtha' yas dang / mgrin pa sngon po dang / mgrin pa bzang po dang /mgul bzang dang / mgrin dkar dang / mgrin sngon dang / 'jig rten mgrin pa dang / rnam par gzigs pa'i dbang phyug dang / 'od zer stong 'dud dang / rnam par grags pa'i yid dang / pad+ma'i phyag dang / yid kyi shing rta dang / tshig 'byin pa po dang / rab tu bzhad 4pa dang / sgra bzang 5dang —/ skra mtha' dang / rgyu skar dang / rgyu skar 965rgyal po dang / zla ba'i bu dang ske/ skal bzang 7dang / 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang /mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / lha las rnam rgyal dang / 'dod pa phun tshogs byed dang / legs par 'dul ba dang / 'dul ba po zhes pa 'di rnams dang /gzhan yang rig pa'i rgyal mo 84chu skyes gtsug tor la sogs pa rnams kyis chos kyi sprin gyi rgyu mthun pa 9mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur pa brgya stong bye ba khrag khrig du ma'i rig pas yongs su bskor ba dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal mo du ma dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang sku'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par spros pa du ma rnams la 'di lta ste/ sgrol ma dang / bsam pa'i sgrol ma dang /93—645

gar ma dang / khro gnyer can ma dang / a nut+ta ṭī dang / lo ṭī dang / sa thob par byed pa dang / dri ma dang bral ma (1ci dang / dkar mo dang / dkar sham ma dang / dkar sham chen mo dang / gos dkar mo dang / 'jig rten gos ma dang / dri med gos ma dang / byang chub yan lag gi gos ma dang / chu skyes gos ma dang / stobs bcu gos ma dang / grags ldan ma dang / longs spyod ldan ma dang / longs spyod tshe ldan ma dang / ut+na 2kā dang / ṣa lū kā dang / dri med mthar byed ma dang / dri bral mthar byed ma dang / kun du mthar byed ma dang / sdug bsngal mthar byed ma dang / 'byung po mthar byed ma dang / dpal mo dang / dpal chen mo dang / mthar dpal dang / stod pa'i dpal dang / 'jig rten dpal dang / rnam par grags pa'i dpal dang /'jig rten yum dang / kun du yum dang / sangs rgyas yum dang / sring /rimo dang / skal ldan shing rta ma dang / shing rta bzang mo dang / shing rta ldan ma dang / klu 'dul ma dang / 'dul byed ma dang / 'byung po ldan ma dang /dpag med ma dang / longs spyod stobs ma dang / 'gugs byed ma dang /'od zer rmad byung ma dang / ro bzang mo dang / chang ri ldan ma dang / rab tu 'gum dang / mchod ldan ma dang / 'gram ma dang / kun du 'gram ma dang / skar 'od ma dang / zla ba ma dang / zla ba ldan ma dang / rma bya ma dang / nags ldan ma dang / nor sbyin ma dang / chang ldan ma dang / 'jig rten ldan ma dang / 'od 'phro ldan ma dang / stong bu chen mo dang / che ldan ma dang / legs par rgyas byung ma dang / legs par dga' ma dang / dbyig sbyin ma dang / dpal mo dang / dag ldan ma dang / nad mthar byed ma dang /93—646

nad thams cad gso byed ma dang / nad med lha mo dang / grags byed ma dang /dbang byed ma dang / myur byed ma dang / bde sbyin ma dang / bkra shis ma dang / bkra shis thob byed dga' ma dang / zla ba bzang mo dang / zla ba ldan ma zhes bya ba 'di (1)rnams dang gzhan yang rig pa'i rgyal mo ri khrod lo ma can dang / dug sel ma dang / yid las byung ba la sogs pa rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi sgrub pa mtha' yas pa spyod pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa 45)byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par skyes pa yid las byung ba rnams te pho nya dang / pho nya mo dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / ci bgyi 3dang / ci bgyi mo dang / gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin mo dang / srin po dang / srin mo dang / sha za dang / sha za mo pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig la rjes su 'jug pa gsang sngags rnam par spyod pa rnams gang gis 'khor gyi cadakyil 'khor chen po dang ldan pa dag pa'i sems can nges par 'khod pa des rab tu gnas par byed pas rab tu gnas te rang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la mchod pa'i las byed pa la brtson pa'i yid dang ldan par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i nye bar logs der gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes rang gi rig pa'i tshogs la bos par gyur te/ 'dir 'dus par gyur pa khyed rnams ni rig pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba 5khro bo'i rgyal po dang /rgyal mo dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'pho nya mo chen mo dran pa tsam nyid kyis rig pa'i tshogs thams cad 'dus pa rnams 'di lta ste/ rig pa mchog dang / rig pa bzang po dang / legs par grub pa dang / dpung bzang dang / sde bzang dang / lha mthar byed dang / so bzang dang / gang ba bzang po dang / rdo 93—647

rje'i sde dang / rdo rje'i mtha' dang / rdo rje'i lag pa dang / rdo rje'i dpung pa dang / rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje'i ba dan dang / rdo rje'i spyod yul dang / rdo rje mgo bo 'chang dang / rdo rje mche ba dang / dag pa'i rdo rje dang /rdo rje'i spu dang / rdo rje mchod pa dang / rdo rje du ma dang / rdo rje go cha dang /rdo rje mgrin pa dang / rdo rje gsung ba dang / rdo rje lte ba dang / rdo rje mtha' dang / rdo rje gur dang / rdo rje ra ba dang / rdo rje mtshon cha dang / rdo rje gzhu dang / rdo rje mda' dang / rdo rje lcags mda' dang / rdo rje mtshan ma dang / rdo rje dgyes pa dang / rdo rje sa 'og dang / rdo rje 'jigs spyan dang /rdo rje nor mtha' dang / rdo rje khro bo dang / chu'i yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro dang /'byung po'i yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro dang / khro bo chen po'i yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro dang / dbang phyug chen po'i yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro dang / sbyin pa'i bu'i yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro dang / rig pa thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro dang /drag po dang / shin tu drag po dang / 'phen pa dang / nye bar 'phen pa dang /rtag tu 'phen pa dang / 'dul ba'i mtha'i 'phen pa dang / shin tu rnam bkod 'phen pa dang / 'tshol bar 'phen pa dang / stobs dang / stobs po che dang / legs 'byung gsod byed dang / blang 91gi ri ṭi dang / khro bo dang /khro bo chen po dang / mi rgas pa dang / mi gnyid pa dang / gdung ba'i dbyangs dang / klu'i mtha' dang / dbyug chu dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang /lus sbyin dang / lus dmar dang / rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang / sprin dang /sprin chen dang / nag po dang / nag po brtsegs pa dang / sna tshogs nad dang / thams cad 'phen pa po dang / 'dud dang / 'dud chen po dang /93—648

nyam thag pa dang / nyam thag pa chen po dang / dus mthar byed pa dang /gnod sbyin nag po dang / drag po dang / drag po'i gzugs dang / rtse gsum kha gdengs pa dang / mda' bo che dang / be con rab 'joms dang / za ba sdud 1)pa'i dpa' bo dang / dus kyi mtha'i tshon)nyi ma dang / srog 'phrog pa dang /sgra 'joms pa dang / zhe sdang mi 'dzin pa dang / 'khyil pa dang / 'khyil pa min pa dang / mtha' yas 'khyil pa dang / khrag 'khyil pa dang / dpung pa dang / dpung pa chen po dang / gdug pa'i nad chen po dang / me dbal dang / mdze thams cad las rgyal ba dang / 'bros pa dang / rnam par 'bros pa po dang / de bzhin rnam 'bros dang / za ba po dang / tshim med 'tshol ba zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo chen po rnams kyis ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gdul ba dang / sprod pa dang /gzhig pa dang / dgag pa dang / gsod pa dang / rnam par 'joms pa dang / pha dang / zas rnams ster 87bar byed pa dang / zhi ba can dang /rgyas pa can dang / mngon spyod can gyi las rnams shin tu sbyor bar byed pa po rig pa'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la nges par 4sems pas rang gi rig pa'i rgyal po rdo rje'i rigs skyong ba la phyag 'tshal 5te gnang ba nos yinas rang gi rigs la gnas par byed cing gnas pas rang rang gi stan la 'dug par gyur to//bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes phul ba'i pho nya mo rig pa'i rgyal mo khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gis yongs su bskor ba yang rang chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i 93—649

rang bzhin spros pa med pa la dmigs nas gnas der 'dus par gyur pa 'di lta ste / 'og pag ma dang / 'og pag ma bzang mo dang / lu gu rgyud ma dang /rdo rje 'od dang / rdo rje'i lce ma dang / rdo rje'i smin ma dang / rdo rje'i spyan dang / rdo rje'i lte ba dang / rdo rje khro gnyer ma dang / rdo rje snyan 1)ma dang /rdo rje ri mo ma dang / rdo rje khab ma dang / rdo rje khu tshur ma dang / rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje ral gri ma dang / rdo rje thob (5)ma dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang / sā la ldan ma dang / sā la bi ra ṭi ma dang / mchog tu byed ma dang /'dod ldan ma dang / rdo rje 'dod ldan ma dang / 'dod pa'i rdo rje ma dang /mthong can ma dang / mthong ldan ma dang / mthong ba chen mo dang / rtse mo'i gos ma dang / phug len ma dang / phug ldan ma dang / phug gnas ma dang /sgo gnas ma dang / 'dod pa rdo rje ma dang / yid mgyogs ma dang / mi 'pham namagyogs ma dang / myur mgyogs ma dang / spyan bzang ma dang /chang gnas ma dang / bung ba ma dang / bung ba las byung ba ma dang / mchod sbyin grub ma dang / rlung ma dang / gang ba'i gos ma dang / skrag bzang ma dang / hiṇ+ḍa ni dang / sdigs 4rimadzub ma dang / pho nya mo dang / pho nya mo (debazang mo dang / mā ma tī 6)dang / g.yon pa ma dang / gzugs can ma dang /rgyal ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang / dge legs ma dang / bzhad ldan ma dang / bzhad pa'i rdo rje ma dang / 'jig rten ldan ma dang / grags ldan ma dang / rdo rje ldan ma dang / ma dul ma dang / 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed ma dang / dbyug pa tsa)ma dang /dbyug pa chen mo dang / snyan par smra ba ldan ma dang / skal bzang nyid ldan ma 903—650

dang ske/ don ldan ma dang / don chen ldan ma dang / gong ma sreg ma dang /dkar mo dang / shin tu sprul (1)ma dang / shin tu dri med ma dang / dril bu ma dang / ral gri ma dang / rtse gsum kha gdengs ma dang / kham nanom dang /rgyal byed ma dang / gos ma dang / phyag 'tshal ma dang / ming can ma dang /gsang ba ma dang / dbyug 'byin ma dang / gtun (5)shing ma dang / pho nya mo thams cad dbang byed ma zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang pho nya mo chen mo/pho nya mo du ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de nyid du 'dus par gyur to/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu mthun (4)pa yongs su sgom pa'i yid las byung ba'i (5)gzungs ma du ma'i gdug pa'i sems can rnams tshar gcod cing chad pas gcod pa 'di lta ste/ rdo rje'i me rab tu rmongs par byed pa'i gzungs ma dang / ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs ma dang rlo/cirin chen rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs ma dang / sa 'dzin ma dang /legs par brtsegs ma dang / chad pa'i gzungs ma dang / tshar gcod pa'i gzungs ma dang / dgug pa'i gzungs ma dang / dpung rgyan 6rim dang /dpung rgyan ldan ma dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ma dang / rin chen rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ma dang / 'jig rten rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ma dang / ba dan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan (7skum dang / gsum 'khyil ma dang / 'jig rten 'khyil ma dang / stong 'khyil ma dang / nyi ma'i bu 'khyil ma dang / 'byung po kun 'khyil ma dang / tog ldan ma dang / rin chen ldan ma dang / nor bu rin chen gtsug tshonam dang / byang chub yan lag gi stobs dang ldan ma dang / mtha' yas tog dang / kun du tog dang / rin chen tog dang / rnam par grags 93—651

pa'i tog dang / 'byung po thams cad kyi tog dang / mi 'pham 67ldan ma dang /gos shin tu dri med ma dang / gdong drug ma dang / dri bral ma dang / 'jig rten grags ma zhes pa 'di dag dang / gzhan yang gzungs ma brgya stong phrag bye ba du mas yongs su bskor ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de nyid du 'dus par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis na byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan sangs rgyas kyis rnam par spangs pa na rang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bse 3ru lta bu dang / tshogs na 54 spyod pa rnams sems can rnams kyi (5don mdzad pa ni cang mi gsung bar gyur pa lhag par gnas pas chos kyi tshul yang dag par ston pa/ de 'khor ba'i rjes su 'jug pa rtag tu yid skyo ba rgyud 46)la snying rje chen po spangs shing ma 'dres pa'i sems kyi 7 bag chags kyis yongs su bsgos pa/ sngon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ yongs su bsgos pa'i sems pas sa gcig dang / sa gnyis dang / sa gsum dang / ji srid byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa'i bar la yid mi 'jug pa/ 'khor bas yid skyo zhing /'jigs shing 'jigs pa dang ldan pa de rnams kyang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der 'dus par gyur to/ /spos dri len dang / kun nas skye mched dang /kun du 'od dang / tsan+dan dang / dus dang / mu khyud dang / nye ba'i mu khyud dang / 'chi ltas 8dang / nye ba'i 'chi ltas lta dang / logs bzang po dang / rnga bo che dang / nye ba'i rnga bo che dang / 'jig rten grags pa dang /'jig rten 'od dang / rgyal byed dang / rdul med dang / nye ba'i rdul dang /cha shas dang / nye ba'i cha shas dang / mtshan ma dang / mtshan ma bzang po 93—652

dang / nyin mor byed pa dang / legs byed 'od ldan dang / 'od byed dang /'jig rten byed pa dang / rnam thos dang / legs thos dang / mdzes sdug dang / legs 'dzin mtha' dang / dul mdzes dang / mtha' yas mtha' dang / srid mtha' dang / tog dkar po dang / mtshan ma'i tog dang /tog dang / nye ba'i tog dang / rgyal dang / pad+ma'i bla ma dang / pad+ma'i 'byung ba dang / rang 'byung dang / skyes pa dang / yid 'ong dang / yid las byung dang / dbang chen dang / brtsegs par grags pa dang / bum pa dang / mtha' dag spyan dang / bde byed dang / phan byed dang / zhi ba dang / zhi ba'i yid dang / chos dang / nye ba'i chos dang / rnam par snang byed dang / me tog dang / legs sngo 1tshodang / dpal ldan dang / gnyen las thag ring byed pa dang / bzod par dka' ba dang / gser dang / dri med tog dang / zla ba dang / nye ba'i zla ba dang / sde bzang dang / legs par sbyangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / 'dod pa dang / nye dbang dang /nor lha zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang rang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bsam gyis mi khyab cing gzhal gyis mi lang ba smon pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i rang bzhin spros pa med cing 'dus ma byas pa theg pa 'bring la rab tu zhugs shing nges par gtan te gnas pa/ rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba dang bral ba rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bzhugs pa dang thabs cig natu bzhugs par gyur to/ /nyan thos brgya stong phrag bye ba du mas yongs su bskor ba'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig pa 'di lta ste/ 'od srung chen po dang / chu klung ca'od sung dang / ga yā 5'od 93wa 653

srung dang / steng rgyas 'od srung dang / bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang /bha ra dh+wa dza dang / mod gal 1gyi bu dang / mod gal (2)gyi bu chen po dang /shā ri'i bu dang / shā ri'i bu chen po dang / sna tshogs mdzes dang / rab 'byor dang / rab 'byor chen po dang / ba lang bdag dang / ka t+ya'i bu dang / ka t+ya'i bu chen po dang / nye bar 'khor dang / bzang ldan dang /ka pi na dang / dga' bo dang / mdzes dga' bo dang / nye dga' dang /rna ba bye ba ri ba dang / 'jig rten 'byung ba dang / mtha' yas 'byung ba dang / yid 'ong ba dang / nye ba'i yid 'ong ba dang / dga' ldan dang /nye ba'i dga' ldan dang / ma 'gags pa dang / rtsa ba kun du gang ba dang /nye bar gang ba dang / rgyal dang / nab /so dang / ru ru dang / drag (ridapo'i bu dang / ru ru'i bu dang / ku ru dang / lngas rtsen dang / nye ba'i lngas rtsen dang / dus dang / mnyam pa'i dus dang / lha 'dzin dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dang / ljang sngo dang / nye ba'i ljang sngo dang / bsam bya dang / dga' ba sems pa po dang / 'char ka dang / nye ba'i 'char ka dang / dpal ldan dang / ka dru'i bu dang / gyad kyi bu dang / nyer rdzas ldan dang / dum bu dang / rgyal ba dang / nye rgyal dang / rgyal chen po dang / kun du rgyal dang /'bod byed dang / grags sbyin dang / grags ldan dang / nor can dang /nor gyi rgya mtsho dang / nye ba'i nor can dang / pi lin+da'i 5)bu pi pa la ka dang /'bras bu dang / nye ba'i 'bras bu dang / mtha' yas 'bras bu dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang / gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu 'od srung dang / cher sbyin dang / bcu drug sde pa'i dga' byed dang / nye ba'i dga' byed dang /93—654
