yon por yo ba dang / rgyal ba'i zhags pa dang / dbugs 'byin chen po dang /be'u'i bu dang / ku ru kul+le dang / gro bzhin skyes rna ba bye ba ri ba dang /khrag pha rol gyi mthar byed pa dang / gang gā'i bu dang / ri'i rna ba can dang /nye ba'i ze ba dang / dbyar can dang / snang ba dang / mdzes par snang ba dang / dpal sbas dang / 'jig rten sbas pa dang / bla ma sbas pa dang /snang ba la dga' ba dang / zhi byed dang / byis pa dang / nye ba'i byis pa dang / bye ba nyi shu pa dang / mgon med sbyin dang / nye ba'i 'jug pa dang /ldog pa dang / smyo byed dang / kun du 'od dang / mtsho bzang dang / legs pa dang / rab sad dang / legs 'ongs dang / nyer 'ongs dang / nyer 'gro dang / 'jig rten 'gro dang / sdug bsngal mthar byed dang / bskal pa bzang po dang / chen po bzang ldan dang / don spyod pa dang / pha chen po dang / 'gro ldan dang / rgyal skyong dang / rgyal dang / gsal ldan dang /nye ba'i gsal ldan dang / sman chen po dang / gzi brjid chen po dang / lha mtshams dang / sgrub byed dang / tshogs can dang / tshangs pa bzang po dang /mdzes ma bzang dang / 'jig rten bzang dang / mnyam pa dang / yang dag gzhal ba zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa rnam par grol ba'i ro'i ro myong ba/ theg pa gsum la snyoms par 'jug pa/theg pa chung ngu'i lam kun du thob pa/ 'khor ba las bros pa/ rnam par thar pa'i lam gsum gyi bsam gtan bsams pa1/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'i spyod lam la snyoms par zhugs pa/ legs par mnyam par bzhag 2pa/ legs par bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ legs pa'i tshul la rab tu gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das 93—655

pa'i dbyings la mnyam par 'jug pa mnyam pa nyid spros pa med pa blo gros can rnams thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sa bcu pa'i bar ma chad pa dkon mchog gsum gyi gnas su gnas pa dang thabs cig 1tu de rnams kyang der kun du 'khod par gyur to/ /nyan thos ma chen mo mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la rab tu mnyam par 'jug pas rab tu zhugs pa du ma rnams kyang / 'dus ma byas kyi lam gyi theg pa la dmigs pa dag cing 'dod chags dang bral ba kun nas snang ba kun du thob pa sbyin par bya ba'i zhing gi yon tan 'dzin cing rnam par sbyong ba/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ 'jig rten mchog gi bdag mo lhas mchod pa bsod nams kyi zhing / rkang gnyis pa dang / rkang bzhi pa dang /rkang mangs dang / rkang med kyi sems can thams cad kyi mchog gi bdag mo rnams la 'di lta ste/ grags 'dzin ma dang / grags sbyin ma dang / skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo dang / skye dgu'i bdag mo legs skyes ma dang / dga' mo dang / sbom dga' mo dang / mdzes dga' mo dang / sems pa mo dang /mdzes ma dang / mtha' yas ma dang / yid kyi shing rta ma dang / rgyal ldan ma dang / dpa' mo dang / nye ba'i dpa' mo dang / lha mo dang / legs lha mo dang / legs dpal mo dang / dpal ma dang / rab spyod ma dang / rab dga' ma dang / snyan par smra ma dang / snar ma ma dang / yul 'khor srung ma dang / srung ma dang / rje bo ma dang / phun tshogs ma dang / lus can ma dang / pad pa ma dang / dga' ma dang / ral pa ma dang / nye ba'i ral pa ma dang / kun nas ral pa ma dang / 'byung ba ma dang / snang ldan ma dang /93—656

yid mgyogs ma dang / skra ldan ma dang / khyab 'jug len ma dang / khyab 'jug ldan ma dang / yid bzangs ma dang / yid mangs ma dang / dpal ldan ma dang / sdug bsngal mthar thug ma dang / las sbyin ma dang / las 'bras ma dang / rnam rgyal ma dang / rgyal ldan ma dang / nor bdag ma dang /nor sbyin ma dang / chos sbyin ma dang / legs sbyin ma dang / rab za ma dang /a mra ma dang / grags pa 'jug ma dang / yid ldan ma dang / rab bzhad ma dang / srid gsum mthar byed ma dang / 'khor gsum mthar byed ma dang /sdug bsngal ba mo dang / yid 'byung ma dang / lo ma gsum pa dang / pad+ma'i lo ma dang / pad+ma ldan ma dang / pad+ma'i 'od ma dang / dka' zlog 1)rkang spyod ma dang / dka' zlog ri rkang spyod ldan ma dang / 'dab gsum ma dang /'dab bdun ma dang / ut+pa la'i mdog ma zhes pa 'di dag dang / gzhan yang gnas brtan ma chen mo/ nyan thos ma chen mo rnams/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung du phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir nye bar lhags par gyur to/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de rnams nyid byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i mthu mthong bar 'dod nas 'dus shing 'khod par gyur te chos nyan pa'i phyir dang / sngags kyi spyod pa'i don bsgrub 4 pa la brtson par 'dod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas lhag pa'i bsam pa rig pa dang / dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i ngo bo sems can gyi khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa mkhyen nas sems dpa' chen po la bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po sems can gyi don gyi spyod pa la so sor soms shig /bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 93—657

du mngon par 'dod pa'i las kyi 'bras bu la dad pa dang ldan pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa'i don yang dag par thob pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi tshig dang / zhi ba'i tshig dang / thar pa'i tshig dang / rtog pa'i sgrub pa dang / rnam par rtog pa'i mnyam pa nyid thob par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu kun gyi stobs dang / bdud kyi stobs thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed pa zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sgoms shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ ji ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang dag par rab tu g.yos te snang ba chen pos 1gsal bar byas nas/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pa ston par (2gyur cing / rang gi sngags kyi tshig kyang gsungs par gyur to/ /rtog pa'i sngags rnams kyang sngags du ma/ thun mong ba cig gis rim pa las ma 'das par 'byung ba ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ 4a bhā 55ba/ swa bhā ba/ sa muṅga tā dzā/ na maḥpra h+ye ka bud+dhā ār+ya shā ba kā ṭ+wāṃ/ na mo bo dhi satā 456/ da sha bhu mi pra 7tikhri nate sha ra ṇ+ḍaṃ bo dhi satā 94/ ma hā satā rnam/ ma hā satā ṭ+wāṃ/tar+ya thā/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi/ duṣ+ṭa satā da ma ka /a si/ mu sa la/ pa ra shu / pā sha /hasti/ tsa tur mu kha/ ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ ma hā bespyon / bespyon ta ka /bi kṛ tā nan/ sarba bhū 11ta/ bho yaṃ ka ra/ ar+sās/lha/hā sa nā di ne/ byā gh+ra tsarma ni bā sa na/ ku ru ku ru sarba kurma 1 shā/ sbyisdo sgyun+da/bhin+da bhin+da'i/ sa ra mu dro15/ ā kur+sha ā kuṇ+ḍa/ bhū 7tā na/ nirma tha 93—658

na / sarba du/(1)/ pra be sha ya/ maṇ+ḍa la ma h+ye/ be+e ba swa ta dzī bi tān tā naka ra ku ru ku ru ma ma 'irgyu95)/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi lasba sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ t+t+waṃ hūm̐ (4)phaṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ sarba ā shā pa ri pū 55ra ka /he he bha ga bān/ kuñtsi rā ya si 56)ma ma/ sarba ar+sha sā dha ya swā hā/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i khro bo chen po sgrol mas gnon pa zhes bya ba gang 'dod pa de 'gugs par byed cing thob par byed pa/ dbang po dang /gshin rje'i rgyal po yang 'gugs par byed cing 'joms par byed pa yin na sems can rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos gsungs ma thag tu sems can thams cad nyam thag cing 'jigs skrag ste yid skyo zhing snying gas par gyur nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po ma gtogs pa (7skyabs gzhan med/ skyob pa gzhan med/ dpung gnyen gzhan med pas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du nye bar lhags par gyur to/ /de nas gang la la sa la spyod pa dang / mkha' la spyod pa dang / brtan pa 8dang / g.yo ba dang / mngal skyes dang / sgong skyes dang / drod gsher skyes dang / brdzus 9te skyes pa sems can gyi grangs su gtogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas shing mu med pa na rnam par gnas pa steng dang / 'og dang /thad ka dang / phyogs dang phyogs bral rnams su skad cig de dang / yud tsam de la gab pa rnams khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos skad cig la 'dir bkug par gyur to / /khro bo'i rgyal po sgrub par gyur pa 'di 'dod chags dang ma bral bar gyur pa rnams kyi tsomadun du bzlas par mi bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'ang 'chi bar 'gyur ram/ skam par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de tshig byin gyis brlabs 93—659

nas / sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan snga'am/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam mam/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 1spyan sngar tsho bzlas brjod bya'i ri/ las gzhan gyi ched du'am/ gang ya nga rung ba der bklag 4par mi bya ste/ ci'i phyir na ltas ngan chen po dang /mya ngan chen po dang 5/ bdag nyid nye bar 'joms par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'ba' zhig ni thugs rje mchog dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyod pa sgrub cing rjes su 'jug pa sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa/ chos kyi tshul yang dag par gnas par byed pa/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par byed pa/ bstan pa med par bstan pa dang / lam gsum la yang dag par sbyor ba dang / dkon mchog gi gdung rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / sngags kyi spyod pa gsal bar byed pa dang /thugs rje chen po'i mthu'i rgyu mthun 6pa'i thugs kyis bdud kyi stobs zil gyis gnon pa dang / bgegs chen po rnam par gzhig pa dang / gdug pa'i rgyal po bzlog pa dang / bdag gi stobs mngon par 'phel ba dang / gzhan gyi stobs zlog 7par byed pa dang / rengs pa dang / ltung ba dang / nyams dgang 'chos pa dang / skems pa dang / dga' ba dang / rang gi sngags kyi spyod pa gsal bar byed pa dang / tshe dang / nad med pa dang / rang gi dbang phyug mngon par 'phel ba dang / myur du las rjes su sgrub pa dang /byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang /btang snyoms chen po dang / yang dag par sdom pa dang / de dag gi rgyu mtshan 903—660

dang / rgyu la thams cad du rtog ge pa 1dang / rnam par rtog ge pa dang bral ba'i sems kyis smras so/ /de nas klu dang / klu chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin chen po dang / srin po dang / srin po chen po dang / sha za dang / sha za chen po dang / srul po dang / srul po chen po dang / lus srul po dang / lus srul po chen po dang / ma mo dang / ma mo chen mo dang /grul bum dang / grul bum chen mo nadang / gcan gzan tsho skudang / gcan gzan ( chen po dang / ro langs dang / ro langs chen po dang / kum po dza dang / kum po dza chen po dang / sring 5mo dang / sring 96 mo chen mo dang /mkha' 'gro ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma chen mo dang / gzhibs pa dang /gzhibs pa chen po dang / gnon po dang / gnon po chen po dang / byis pa dang / byis pa chen po dang / bram pa dang / bram pa chen po dang / nad dang / nad chen po dang / brjed 7byed dang / brjed nabyed chen po dang /gdon dang / gdon chen po dang / nam mkha' ma mo dang / nam mkha' ma mo chen mo dang / gzugs can ma dang / gzugs can ma chen mo dang /gzugs ngan ma dang / gzugs ngan ma chen mo dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / grib gnon dang / grib gnon chen po dang / sbod gtong dang / sbod gtong chen po dang / ci bgyi dang / ci bgyi chen po dang /gnod sbyin mo dang / gnod sbyin mo chen mo dang / sha za mo dang / sha za mo chen mo dang / rims nad dang / rims nad chen ngo dang / rims nyin gcig pa dang / rims nyin gcig pa chen po dang / rtag pa'i rims dang /rims mi bzad 9pa rnams dang / rtag pa las byung ba'i rims dang / yud 93—661

tsam pa dang / rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kun las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / gcong dang gcong chen po dang / grub pa dang / grub pa chen po dang / sbyor ldan dang / sbyor ldan chen po dang / drang srong dang / drang srong chen po dang / mi'am ci dang /mi'am ci chen po dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / lto 'phye chen po chen po dang /dri za dang / dri za chen po dang / lha ma yin dang —17/ lha ma yin chen po dang /mi dang mi chen po dang / ljongs dang / ljongs chen po dang / rgya mtsho dang /rgya mtsho chen po dang / chu klung dang / chu klung chen po dang / ri dang / ri chen po dang / gter dang / gter chen po dang / sa dang / sa chen po dang / shing dang / shing chen po dang / 'dab chags dang / 'dab chags chen po dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal po chen po dang / brgya byin dang /dbang po chen po dang / nor lha'i bu dang / sgra sgrogs dang / 'byung po'i bdag po dang / dbang ldan dang / gshin rje dang / tshangs pa dang /tshangs pa chen po dang / nyi ma'i bu dang / nor sbyin dang / yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / lus ngan po dang /gang ba bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po dang / lngas rinartsen dang / rmugs 'dzin dang / rengs 'dzin dang / kurmi 'dzin dang / ljang sngo dang / skra ljang sngo dang / seṅge dang / 'phrog ma dang / dga' byed dang / nor byed dang / chu'i dbang po dang / 'jig rten dbang po dang / nye ba'i dbang po dang / gsang ba dang / gsang ba chen po dang / g.yo ba dang / g.yo byed dang / chu stod dang / rtag pa'i ri dang / kha ba'i ri dang / ri chen po dang /93—662

mig brtsegs pa dang / mgo bo gsum pa zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor te/ byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pas chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /gang yang srin po'i rgyal po chen po srin po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor ba khro bo'i rgyal po chen pos bkug pa 'di lta ste/ bros pa dang / 'bros byed dang / rnam par 'ju byed dang / gzer gyi rna ba dang / bum pa'i rna ma dang / kun nas rna ma dang / gshin rje dang / rnam par 'jigs byed dang / 'jigs su rung ba dang —/ drag po dang / shin tu drag po dang / mi bzad 1pa dang / sdig ldan dang / dbang po rgyal dang / 'thab pa dang / legs par 'thab pa dang /mdung dang / mdung rtse gsum dang / mgo bo gsum pa dang / mgo bo mtha' yas pa zhes pa'ang chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dus par gyur to/ /gang yang sha za dang —/ sha za chen po dang / sha za chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba de rnams kyang 'di lta ste/ 'thung gcod dang / nye ba'i 'thung gcod dang / legs par 'thung gcod dang / mtha' yas 'thung gcod dang / yid kyi shing rta dang / legs par yid kyi shing rta dang / legs par 'dren pa dang / za byed dang / spu bzang po dang / drag po'i gzugs can zhes pa de rnams kyang chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dus par gyur to/ /gang yang klu'i rgyal po klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba'i khro bo'i rgyal pos byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pas bkug pa 'di lta 93—663

ste / dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo dang / zla ba dang / nye ba'i zla ba dang /nor rgyas kyi bu dang / mtha' yas dang / 'jog po dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / dung skyong dang / dung dang / dung skyong ma dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / rigs ldan dang / brdzun pa'i btung ba dang / bum pa sbyin dang /rdo rje can dang / tsam pa'i bu dang / yid ldan klu dang / nga rgyal 'joms dang / ḍi 1ku ra dang / nye ba'i ḍi na ku ra dang / la ku ṭā dang / la ku ṭā chen po dang / dkar po dang / dkar po bzang po dang / sngon po dang /sngon po chu sbyin dang / 'o ma'i chu dang / sog 5)ma med dang / rgya mtsho dang /nye ba'i rgya mtsho zhes pa 'di rnams dang gzhan yang klu'i rgyal po chen po klu brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba de rnams chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po cader 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /gang yang drang srong dang drang srong chen po de rnams 'di lta ste/ rgyun shes kyi bu dang / gnas 'jog dang / gau 5ta ma dang / skal ldan shing rta dang / dza snu yidang / e 57gi ra sa dang / a maste dang / su lasti dang / ri byi dang / rgyas pa dang /nag po dang / gau ta ma nag po dang / me dang / me'i rgyud dang / triḥn gi ra sa 9dang / dzā mad asdi dang / yod pa pa dang / thub pa dang / thub pa mchog dang / be+e saspa ya na dang / rtsib 7logs skyes dang / dgra sta 11dang /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / pispa la dang / pispa la za ba dang / grog mkhar ba dang / bdud mda' zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang drang srong chen po brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba de rnams 12'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der nye bar phyin te bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal 1 93—664

nas gsang sngags spyod pa'i don dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mnyan 1cing rjes su yi rang bar 'dod pas naci'akhod par gyur to/ /gang yang lto 'phye chen po'i rgyal po de rnams kyang ri 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der rab tu zhugs shing 'khod par gyur pa 'di lta ste/ bhe raṇ+ḍa dang / bhu ruṇ+ḍa dang / ma 4ruṇ+ḍa dang / 'od zer dang / 'od zer 'bar ba zhes pa'o/ /gang yang nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po de rnams kyang nam mkha' lding brgya stong phrag du mas 5yongs su bskor te 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 6der 'dus par gyur pa 'di lta ste/'dab bzang dang / 'dab dkar dang / klu dang / 'dab 'gro dang /'dab bzang skyes dang / yid mgyogs dang / klu 'joms dang / rnam 'dud bu dang / bha ra dh+wa 7/dza dang / dge mtshan dang / dge mtshan chen po dang / 'dab chags rgyal po ste/ de rnams kyang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der 'dus par gyur to/ /gang yang mi'am ci'i rgyal po mi'am ci brgya stong phrag du mas bskor ba de rnams kyang 'di lta ste/ ljon pa dang / nye ba'i ljon pa dang / legs pa'i ljon pa dang / mtha' yas ljon pa dang / 'jig rten ljon pa dang / ljon pa gsal ba dang / brang rgyas dang / brang rgyas chen po dang /yid kyi gzi brjid dang / gzi brjid chen po dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po dang /rnam par sgrogs pa dang / dbyangs bzang po dang / yid 'ong dang / sems skyed 58)par byed pa dang / smyo byed dang / da na dhā 9ta dang / btang snyoms 7dang / snying rje dang / snying rje med pa zhes pa 'di rnams dang / gzhan yang mi'am ci'i rgyal po stong phrag gis yongs su bskor ba rnams chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dus par gyur to/ /de bzhin du mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang /93—665

tshangs pa chen po dang / kun du 'od gsal dang / rab tu 'od gsal dang /dga' ba'i 'od dang / bsod nams 'od dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / 'og min dang / 'og bzang dang / 'jig rten mtha' dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang / ci yang med pa min pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas min pa nyid dang / gya rnam snang dang / shin tu mthong dang / legs par sprul pa dang / yongs su sprul pa dang / gnas gtsang ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'thab bral dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / rtag myos dang / phreng thogs dang / gzhong thogs dang / pi wang gsum pa dang / ri la gnas pa dang /khang pa brtsegs pa la gnas pa dang / rtse mor gnas pa dang / lcang lo can na gnas pa dang / grong na gnas pa dang / gzhal med khang na gnas pa dang /nang na gnas pa dang / bar snang la rgyu ba dang / sa na gnas pa dang / shing la gnas pa dang / khyim na gnas pa dang / de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po rab tshim dang / stobs ldan dang / thags zangs ris 0nidang / legs bkra dang / dge bkra dang / sgra gcan dang / lag pa la sogs pa'i (0lha ma yin bye ba stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba 'gros rnam pa sna tshogs dang /nor rnam pa sna tshogs dang / lha dang g.yul 'gyed pa'i lha ma yin de rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul lta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'dod pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor der 'dus par gyur to/ /gang yang gza' dang / gza' chen po'i 'jig rten gyi don du spyod nopa bar snang la spyod pa la 'di lta ste/ nyi ma dang /93—666

zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / lhag pa dang / phur bu dang / pa sangs dang ske/ spen pa dang / sgra gcan dang / sa 'gul dang / mjug rings 6 dang / thog gis 'joms pa dang / skar ma dang / rgyal mtshan dang / drag po dang / du ldan dang / du ba dang / rdo rje dang / drang srong dang / char dang ske/ nye ba'i char dang / don nyams dang / nges par nyams dang /dgod pa'i mtha' dang / māṣ+ṭi dang / riṣ+ṭi dang / dga' ma dang / 'jig rten mtha' dang / zad pa dang / rnam par ltung byed dang / mi ltung ba dang /tog dang / gla sgang dang / dus kyi mtha' dang / dur khrod dang / bi shī ta dang / drag po dang / dkar po dang / byi bzhin dang / byi bzhin gyi bu dang / byams pa dang / phur bu dang / phur bu gsum pa dang / lu bha (5dang / ro tra dang / brtan pa dang / nyams byed dang / stobs ldan dang /drag po dang / skya rengs dang / rnam par dgod pa dang / 'chi ltas min pa dang / skem (5)byed dang / sde dang / nye sde dang / gzhon nu dang / rtse byed dang / dgod byed dang / sems par byed pa dang / theng po dang /gzugs ngan zhes pa ste gza' chen po de rnams kyang brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi 4byin gyis brlabs kyis gtsang ma'i gnas der 'khor du 'dus shing 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas rgyu skar nam mkha' la 'gro zhing rjes su 'brang ba brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba 'di lta ste/ tha skar dang / bra nye dang / smin drug dang / snar ma dang / mgo dang / lag dang / nam (3so dang / rgyal dang / skag dang / mchu dang / gre dang /dbo gnyis dang / me bzhi dang / nag pa dang / sa ri dang / sa ga dang /93—667

lha mtshams dang / ljon dang / snrubs 1)dang / chu stod dang / chu smad dang /gro bzhin dang / mon gru dang / mon gre dang / khrums 92)stod dang / khrums smad dang / nam gru dang / lha mo dang / byi bzhin dang / slar yang 'byung ba dang / skar 'od dang / aṅgi ra sā dang / rgyu skar ldan ma dang / nye bar sdu gu dang / nye ba'i gre dang / 'jig rten rab mchog dang / rab mchog ldan ma dang / dpal ldan ma nadang / 'jig rten mgon po dang / chang ldan dang / rgyal ba thob pa dang / nor ldan dang / lha'i nor zhes pa de ltar rgyu skar rgyal po de rnams rgyu skar brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor te/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas gtsang ma'i gnas su 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der 'dus shing 'khod par gyur to/ /khyim sum cu rtsa drug la 'di lta ste/lug dang / glang dang / 'khrig pa dang / kun ṭa dang / seng ge dang / bu mo dang / srang dang / sdig pa dang / gzhu dang / chu srin dang / bum pa dang / nya dang / spre'u dang / nye ba'i bum pa dang / gser bum dang /ral gri dang / glang po che dang / ma he dang / lha dang / mi dang / dge mtshan dang / dri za dang / 'jig rten dgongs pa dang / rgyal ba'i mchog dang / gzi brjid dang / nam mkha' dang / grib ma dang / sa gzhi dang /mun pa dang / rdul dang / nye ba'i rdul dang / sdug bsngal dang / bde ba dang / thar pa'i byang chub dang / rang byang 4chub dang / nyan thos dang /dmyal ba'i rigs 5'dzin dang / gzi brjid chen po dang / gzi brjid chen po 6ldan pa 7dang / byol song dang / yi dgas nadang / lha ma yin dang /sha za 9dang / sha za mo 1 dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po 93—668

thams cad pa dang / phyogs kyi glang po dang / steng 'gro dang / thams cad 'gro dang / rnam bye dang / rnal 'byor 'gro dang / rab tu gnas pa dang /mchog dang / 'bring dang / tha ma zhes pa 'di rnams dang / khyim chen po khyim brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba 'di rnams 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'dus pa gang na ba der nye bar phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal (1)te rang rang gi gnas su 'khod par gyur to/ /gang yang gnod sbyin chen mo gnod sbyin mo brgya stong phrag bye bas bskor ba 'di lta ste/ mig bzang ma dang / smin ma bzang mo dang / skra bzang ma nadang / dbyangs snyan ma dang / blo gros bzang mo dang / dbyig ldan ma dang / mig bkra ma dang / bsam rdzogs ma dang / gsang ba ma dang / 'og pag ma dang / 'og pag bzang mo dang / pad+ma'i dus ma dang / mi 'jigs ma dang / mi 'jigs sbyin ma dang / rgyal ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma dang / nam gru can ma dang /skra 5)ldan ma dang / skra mtha' ma dang / rlung ma dang / yid 'phrog ma dang /yid ldan ma dang / me tog ldan lam dang / me tog grong gnas ma dang /ser skya mo dang / 'phrog ma dang / dpa' mo ldan ma dang / dpa' mo dang /dpa' bzang ma dang / sna bzang ma dang / 'od ldan ma dang / lha mdzes ma dang / ro bzang ma dang / gsang mchog ma dang / brjod pa la gnas ma dang / mya ngan med ma dang / snang bar mdzes ma dang / 'od ldan ma dang /phul byung ldan ma dang / gzugs ldan ma dang / gzugs mdzes ma dang /dkar min dang / zhi ba ma dang / phra mo ma dang / sde ma dang / dga' byed ma dang / nye bar dga' byed ma dang / 'jig rten 'das ma zhes pa ste/93—669

gnod sbyin ma chen mo 'di rnams gnod sbyin ma brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba de rnams kyang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po der bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal 1te 'khod par gyur to/ /gang yang sha za mo dag sha za mo brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba de rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal nate 'dus par gyur pa la 'di lta ste/ rgyan pa mo dang / phyag dar gyi sha za mo dang / drag mo sha za mo dang / ta la la'i sha za mo dang / 'bar ba'i sha za mo dang / thal ba za ma dang / sha la za ba mo dang /'dzin dka' ma dang / 'khrul byed ma dang / rmongs byed ma dang / sgrogs byed ma dang / skyed byed ma dang / 'jig rten mthar gnas ma dang / thal ba'i mtha' can ma dang / 'thung gcod ldan ma dang / mang po ma dang /gdul dka' ma dang / e la mo nodang / mtshan ma can ma dang / du ba'i mtha' can ma dang / du ba ma dang / du ba bzang mo ma zhes pa sha za mo chen mo 'di rnams sha za mo brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba rnams kyang 'khor 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po der rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /gang yang ma mo dang / ma mo chen mo dag 'jig rten gyi rjes su spyod cing sems can la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa gtor ma dang phreng ba nyid sdud par byed pa la 'di lta ste/tshangs ma dang / dbang phyug chen mo dang / khyab 'jug ma dang / gzhon nu ma dang / rgan byad rim dang / phag mo dang / dbang mo dang / gshin rje ma dang / me mo dang / nyi ma'i bu mo dang / 'jig rten bar ma dang / chu lha mo dang / dbang ldan mo dang / rlung lha mo dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog ma dang / zhal rgyan pa mo dang / dge mtshan ma dang / dge mtshan ma chen mo 93—670

dang / srul mo dang / lus srul mo dang / skem byed ma zhes pa ma mo chen mo 'di rnams ma mo brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba de rnams 'khor 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po der/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig tu 'don cing 'khod par gyur to/ /de bzhin du mi dang mi ma yin pa brgya stong phrag du ma dang / sems can dang sems can ma yin pa ji srid dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar skabs 'dir thams cad nam mkha'i (1dkyil du gsal bar gyur to/ /sems can gyi tshogs kyi srog chags 'ga' la yang gnod pa med par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang /byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rgyan gyis sems can thams cad kyi 2spyi bo na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhugs pa yang dag par mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs nas sems dpa' chen po de la bka' stsal to/ /sems can dag tsho )gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don rnam par nges pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u rab 'byam dzo byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod gang da lta de'i dus la bab par shes na shod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas rjes su gnang bas/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyis rgyan bkod pa rdo rje sdug cing sra ba'i rgyun riganozhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 6par zhugs so/ /sems dpa' chen po snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de thams cad dpag tshad brgya stong phrag du mar rdo rje'i rang bzhin rgya chen por lhag par gnas par gyur to/ /der gnod sbyin dang srin po dang /93—671

dri za dang / rlung lha dang / sha za de rnams dang / mdor bsdus na sems can gyi khams thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis gzhal yas khang de rdo rje nor bu rin po che lta bur yang dag par rab tu gnas so/ /'khod par gyur pa rnams phan tshun rnam par 'tshe ba med do/ /de nas sems dpa' chen po de 'khor chen po 'dus par mkhyen nas/ khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa la bos par gyur to/ /kye kye khro bo chen po sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dus pa 'di'i sems can thams cad srungs 51shig /nadabang du gyis shig /gdug pa rnams thul cig /zhi ba rnams sad par gyis shig /ma dad pa rnams dad par gyis shig /ji srid nga'i rig sngags dang / gsang sngags spyod pa rjes su sgrub pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rgya chen po de nyid kyi rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chang ba de srid kyi bar du 'di dag gi phyi rol du song la srungs shig /de skad ces smras pa dang / khro bo'i rgyal po chen po 4bka' mnos nas/ rnam par 'gyur ba chen po'i gzugs yongs su brtags te sems can thams cad bsrung bar bya ba'i don dang / brtan par bya ba'i don du bkod pa chen po'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa khro bo brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba phyogs bzhi kun nas de ltar steng dang 'og dang thad kur sgra drag po 'don bzhin pas rab tu gnas par gyur to/ /de nas sems can de rnams zhi ba nyid kyi yid dang ldan pas yang dag par 'jug pa'i bka' las mi 'da' bar gyur te/ sgra 'di lta bu'ang thos par gyur to/ /gang dam tshig 'di 'da' bar byed pa 'di dag ni ardza ku'i dog pa 93—672

bzhin du mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs kyang de yin no/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' de rang gi rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don du chos kyi tshig gsungs pa chos gcig gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gsang sngags 'grub par gyur to(1)/ /gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i rnam par yang dag par rjes su mi tshan mthong ba'o/ /chos gnyis po dag la rab tu gnas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gsang sngags 'grub par 'gyur te/ gnyis po dag gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi gtong ba dang / sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos gsum rnams kyi rang gi gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don nges par brtan pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ gsum gang zhe na/ sems can yongs su mi gtong ba nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa srung ba nyid dang / rang gi gsang sngags yongs su mi gtong ba nyid do/ /chos bzhi yang dag par ldan na sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rig sngags 'grub par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rang gi gsang sngags rdzogs pa yongs su mi gtong ba nyid dang / gzhan gyi gsang sngags nye bar gcod pa min pa nyid dang / sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems nye bar gnas pa nyid dang /snying rje chen po sgom pa'i sems te chos bzhi po 'di dag dang yang dag par ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /chos lngas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la yang dag par 'jug cing gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i sgrub pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 93—673

yul bsten pa nyid dang / bas mtha'i dgon pa bsten pa nyid dang / sems can gzhan la zhe sdang med pa nyid dang / 'jig rten pa'i sngags la mi lta ba nyid dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / spyod pa la gnas par byed pa nyid de / chos lnga po 'di dag gis sngags kyi spyod pa'i don gyi dngos grub yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos drug ni gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i dngos grub yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ drug gang zhe na/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa nye bar gcod pa med pa nyid dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde zab mo'i tshig gi don mi 'dor ba nyid dang / skyo ba med pa'i sems nyid kyis gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don yongs su tshol zhing dge ba'i phyogs yongs su mi spong ba nyid de/ chos drug po 'di ni rig sngags kyi spyod pa dang / gsang sngags kyi dngos grub la yang dag par kun du 'jug pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /chos bdun rnams ni/ rig sngags grub pa'i cho ga dang / gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la rjes su 'jug par byed pa nyid du 'gyur te/ bdun gang zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul zab mo sgom pa dang / zlos pa dang / nyan pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang /'dri bar byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mos pas dus gsum du ston pa dang / nges par sdom pa dang / bzlas pa dang / sbyin sreg dang /smra bcad dang / dka' thub la ma thogs pa dang / blo gros dang / dran pa dang / shes rab dang / brtan pa dang du len par byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang theg pa chen po'i chos zab mo'i tshul la yang dag par rab tu 'jug pa'i tshul dang / rang gi gsang sngags dang / sngags dgug pa dang / srung ba dang / bsgrub 1pa'i bya ba la mkhas pa nyid dang / snying rje 93—674

chen po dang / byams pa chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dang / dga' ba chen po yongs su sgom par byed pa las dang / sems can gyi khams dang /chos kyi dbyings spros pa med pa'i de bzhin nyid la yang dag par 'jug pa/gnyis su med pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su tshol ba las dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong la theg pa dman pa la dga' ba med pa las te chos bdun po 'di rnams ni rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi dngos grub yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos brgyad ni rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don gyis dngos grub yang dag par 'jug pa nyid du 'gyur te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i 'bras bu la dad pas ngo mtshar bar sems par 'dod pa nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dad pa'i 'bras bu rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa the tshom med pa las dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i gsang sngags 'dzin pa las bla ma la gus pa las dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rang gi sngags dang rgyu 1dang spyod pa nye bar bstan pa mi slu 2bar 'dzin cing bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang ba las dang / dngos grub kyi zhing gnas dang / gnas ma yin pa rmi lam du mthong ba ston pa la mkhas pa nyid dang / ser sna dang / gnyid dang /rmugs pa mtha' dag dang bral bar byed pa/ rtag tu brtson 'grus rtsom la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid 'bul bar byed pa las dang / mdor bsdus na dge ba'i rtsa ba la ngoms mi shes pa'i go cha bgos te bgegs thams cad rab tu sel bar byed pa las dang / byang chub kyi rgyud gnon par byed pa dang / longs spyod chen po dang / dbang che bar grags pa 93—675

bdag nyid so sor 'dod pa dang / dbang che bar grags pa'i gang zag la yang dag par 'grogs pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang yang dag par 'grogs par byed pa ste/ chos brgyad po 'di ni gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don gyi dngos grub la yang dag par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag mdor na byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral zhing dkon mchog gsum la lhag par mos pa mchog tu tshul khrims 'chal (1pa la'ang skyo ba med pa'i yid kyis rtag tu mngon par brtson pas yid sngags kyi le'u rab 'byam namatha' yas shing rmad du byung ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyu mthun 3pa'i yid las byung ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de las gzhan du rtogs par bya ba ma yin no/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i yid du gyur pas nyams sad pa'i rgyur yang bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /de nas yang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos kyi byin gyis brlabs pa rnams 'di skad du rjod par byed de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras sems can thams cad kyi don gyi ched du gsang sngags kyi spyod pa sna tshogs pa'i don bya ba'i chos kyi tshul la rab tu 'jug pa'i rjes su mthun 5pa'i chos ston cig legs so legs so/ /e ma byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams sna tshogs pa'i chos ston pa'i rjes su 'jug par byed pa gsang sngags kyi spyod pa dge ba legs par gsungs so/ /rgyal po chen po gang la la zhig 'dus pa'i le'u 'di 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang ne/ yid la byed par 'gyur ba dang / g.yul du'ang thog mar glang po che'i steng du 'jog par 'gyur ba dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / byug pa rnam pa 93—676

sna tshogs pas mchod par 'gyur ba de la bdag cag mtshungs par brtag par bgyi / phyir rgol ba dang dgra bo dag dbang du bgyi/ pha rol gyi dmag dpung dag 'jig cing bzlog par bgyi/ glegs bam du bris nas rang gi khyim du 'jog 1par 'gyur ba'i/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ rgyal po chen po'am/rgyal mo chen mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/dge bsnyen ma'am/ srung ba chen po dang longs spyod chen po dang / tshe ring por 'gyur ba dang / nad med pa dang / rtag tu longs spyod 'phel ba nyid kyang bgyi'o/ /de skad smras nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ci'ang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /theg pa chen po'i rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi spyod pa nges par bstan pa las/ ral pa gyen brjes (5kyi rtog pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyi le'u rab 'byam las/bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa las 'dus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas/sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig la rjes su 'jug cing kun du lta ba 4zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu lte ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs nas 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba'i 'od zer phyung 55)ste sems can gyi khams thams cad kun nas snang bar 6byas nas sngar nyid 93—677

du 'khor 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po kun du snang bar byas nas 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes dag pa'i sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la smras pa/ sems dpa' chen po'i dam tshig la rjes su 'jug pa las bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u rab 'byam gyi 1spyod pa sgrub pa sems can thams cad dang thun mong du gyur pa khyed kyis tshogs gang du sems can rnams yang dag par rjes su zhugs nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi dngos grub yang dag par thob pa dang ldan pa khyod smros shig smros shig /gsang ba'i bdag po gnod sbyin gyi nadabang pos de skad smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyud gsungs pa/ rig sngags thams cad yang dag par skul bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdzu 'phrul rnam par ston par byed cing lag pa g.yas pa bteg nas sor mo'i rtse mos 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la ston par byed cing / sor mo'i rtse mo der rig pa'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma nges par phyung 4ste phyung nas kyang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de snang ba chen pos kun du snang bar byas nas gnas par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa'i snying po las thams cad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa spyan drangs pa dang / gshegs su gsol ba dang / zhi ba can dang / rgyas pa can dang / mngon spyod can dang / mi snang ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang /sa 'og tu 'jug pa dang / rkang pa rab tu rgyu ba dang / dgug pa dang / rnam 93—678

par snang ba dang / dbang du byed pa dang / dri dang phreng ba dang / mar me thams cad rang gi rgyud kyi sngags kyis rab tu sbyin par byed de/ mdor na ji ltar sbyar ba de bzhin/ de lta de ltar sgrub par byed 1bzhin pa ni yi ge gsum zhes bya ba brtson 'grus chen pos don thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'o/ /de gang zhe na/ oṃ āḥbhū/ 'di ni khro bo chen po de'i snying po las thams cad pa ste dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / gsang sngags spyod pa thams cad la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos nges par bstan te bgegs thams cad 'jig par byed pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis naphyag g.yas pa bteg nas khro bo'i spyi bor bzhag ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dgongs su gsol/ gang la la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rnam par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas shing mu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams dam tshig la lhag par gnas par gyis shig /de skad ces smras nas khro bo'i rgyal po de bskor nas btang bar gyur to/ /khro bo'i rgyal po chen po btang ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag tu song nas skad cig tsam gyis gdug sems can gyi sems can rdzu 'phrul chen po de rnams tshar bcad cing bkug nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dag pa'i sems can la yang dag par bcug ste gnas ji lta ba bzhin du gnas par byas nas sems can gdug pa rnams kyi spyi bor kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs par gyur nas gnas par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis slar yang 'khor gyi dkyil 93—679

'khor la gzigs nas sems can khyed cag thams cad nyon cig /gang yang nga'i dam tshig 'di las 'da' bar byed pa de la khro bo'i rgyal pos tshar gcod par 'gyur te/ gang gi phyir na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dam tshig ni 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rig sngags dang / gsang sngags kyi don gyi tshig gsang chen ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin nges par bstan pa 'chad par byed do/ /de legs par nyon la legs par yid la zung (1shig dang / ngas bshad do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha 90te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te/ shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā (4)ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba h+ye/ ār+ya ta 55rā yi/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya (6)bā/ ṛ 77dzu ka dharma nir+sā 8te/ tā re tut+ta 9 re/ shān+ta dharma nir+sā 7te/ tā re a na rnyi 4kālā bya dharma nir+sā 12te tut+ta re tu re hi sna ni/ tā khas ni/ bi tā ngas ni/ o ha ni/ mo ha ni/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ pra bhe/ tsan+d+ra tsham bhe hi/ hi 1 li hi li/ bi le bi le/ be ga gā mi ni/ kuṇ+ḍi ma hā kuṇ+ḍi/ dha ra dha ra dha na pa ti/ tā re hu ru hu 18ru/ ku ru ku ru/ a haṃ/ māṃ s+t+waṃ/ tsin+ta 19ā mi/ tsin+ti tai me 3 ku ru swā hā / grogs po dag 'di ni/ nga'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i na rig sngags las thams cad byed ma/ srid pa gsum gyi chos nye bar nusagacod pa/ ngan 'gro thams cad zlog ri dpar byed ma'o/ /phyag rgya yang 'dir rtsa ba'i rig sngags shes pa rnam par grags pa de la rab tu sbyar bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir mchog gi snying po las thams cad byed pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thob par byed pa/ zhi ba thams cad byed pa/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du 93wa 680

mthong ba bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ rang nyid nga'i grogs po byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir mchog tu gsang ba'i rig sngags kyi ngo bos nye bar gnas pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed/ gang dang gang dran pa nyid kyis las thams cad mthar byed pa/ 'jigs pa chen po rnams yongs su sbyong bar byed pa ste/ bzlas pas lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de gang zhe na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā (1ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya / ma hā satā ya/ tā re tut+ta (gere swā hā/ phyag rgya yang 'dir ut+pa la zhes kyang 57rnam par grags pa longs spyod thams cad mngon par 'phel bar byed pa'o//'dir nye ba'i snying por gyur pa'ang mchog tu dpal dang ldan pa'i dag byed chen po ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya ri/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satā dzā(5)/ o ku ru kul+le swā hā/ phyag rgya yang 'dir pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes rnam par grags par 'gyur te / sems can thams cad dbang du byed ma'o/ /'dir mchog gi snying por gyur pa yang / na maḥsarba bud+dhā 6rna/ o gī/ 'di ni snying po'i mchog ste (7)mdor bsdu na bya ba thams cad la yon tan chen po rgyas pa ste/ yon tan myur thug par brjod pa ni dus bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas kyang mi (gunas so/ /phyag rgya yang 'dir brtson 'grus chen po zhes rnam par grags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /'dir spyan drang ba'i rig sngags su gyur pa yang / na maḥsarba bud+dhā rmā9/ o he he bha ga ba ti bi shwa rū pi ṇi sarba ba la/ bhā ṣi ti / pra 11bo dha ni 1 ā 1 yā ni/ bha ngag ba ti/ khri ḍa tsha.ut+pa la dhi ni/ ma ma shud+dhā ya/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ a pra ti ha ta/ shā sa na hūm̐/ mā bi lasba ku ru ku ru phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni bcom 93—681

ldan 'das ma spyan drang ba'i rig sngags te/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang /'phags pa nyan thos dang / lha dang / klu (1)dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / sha za dang / srin po dang / 'byung po thams cad kyi yang yin no/ /tsan+dan gyi chu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags (gepa byas te phyogs bzhi dang / de bzhin du steng dang / 'og dang / thad ka thams cad du gtor bar ri bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma dang / 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi gsang sngags 'di yin te/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /na maḥsarba bud+dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā dzā/ o dhu ru dhu ru/ dhu ma bā si ni/ ma nārtsig hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ gdug (4)pa'i rig sngags te/tsan+dan dang / gur gum dang / ga pur gcig tu byas nas bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams thams cad byon pa rnams spos kyi bdug pas yid tshim nas khugs par 'gyur ro/ /'dir phyag rgyar gyur pa'ang 5)pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes grags pa sem/sa can thams cad 'gugs par byed cing zhi ba ste/ spyan drang ba'i rig sngags (phyirala'ang phyag rgya pad+ma'i phreng ba bzang po 'di nyid do/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / sems can thams cad byon pa la'ang mchod yon dbul bar bya ste/ ga pur dang / tsan+dan dang / gur gum chu 93—682

dang sbyar nas dzā 6)ti'i me tog dang dzon// mā li ka gsar pa dang / dbyar ri nogyi me tog dang / pun nā ka dang / ba ku li dang / rgya spos rnams te 'di dag gang yang rung ba'i me tog gam/ dus ji lta ba'i (4 me tog gam/ dri bzang po'i me tog rnams dang bsres nas sngags 'dis mchod yon dbul bar bya'o/ /na maḥsarba bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā (5)sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ tar+ya thā/ he he ma hā kā (6ru ṇi kā / bi shwa rū pa dhā (per ṇi aghi pra tīts+tshaḥnano/ sa ma 997ya ma nu sma ra/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha de ba tā tiṣ+ṭha yin/ ma d+me pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ sarba bud+dhāḥ1/ a nu kai pa ka / grihā grihā 8rgyu/ asba ri bi tsā ri ṇi 1 swā hā/ phyag rgya 'dir gang ba zhes grags te sems can thams cad kyis rjes su 'jug cing brtan pa'o/ /'dir dri'i rig sngags su 'gyur pa yang / na maḥsarba bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta gan+dha 7a ba bhā ṣi tshate shri ye ta thā ga tā ya/ tabya thā/ gan+dhe gan+dhe lī 3 de gan+dha ma no ra me 18pa ti 1muts+tsha rda / galja sa ma nā nu tsā ri ṇi swā hā/ 'dir phyag rgyar 'gyur ba yang lo ma zhes bya ba bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /'dir me tog gi sngags su gyur pa yang / na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi 31satā rmā/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ na maḥse ku su ni mi ta radzñā na su/ ta thā ga tā 2 su/ tar+ya thā / ku su me ku su me ku su mā rgyo ku su mā sru ra bā si/ ku su mā ba ti swā hā/bdug pa'i sngags 'di nyid kyis sngar bshad pa'i bdug pas bdug 25par bya'o/ /rmad byung bsam mi khyab pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag byas nas/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i/ /gtor ma'i rig sngags rab 'chad byed/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satā rmā phyi/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā 2 māṃ/ tar+ya thā/ he he 28bha ga ba ti ma hā satwa sarba bud+dhā a ba lo ki te rte/ mā bi lo ba i dam pa lo groṇ+ḍa ra 93wa 683

pa ya grohā 1ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba ra ra phaṭa (2)phaṭa swā hā/ lha bshos 'dis dbul bar bya ste/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor mar 'gyur ro/ /'dir yang phyag rgya ni dbyug pa ste/ gdug rin)pa thams cad zlog 4par byed pa'o/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā dzā(5)/ sarba ta mo3rnya 95)kā ra bi traṃ (7si tā nī/ na maḥs man+ta byo ti gan+dha a ba bha sa pri yā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ tar+ya thā / he he bha ga bān byo te 98rasmi sha ta sa ha sra/ pra ti maṇ+ḍi (9)ta sha rī rab tsho/bi kur ba bi kur ba ma hā bo dhi satā man+t+ra 11dzo lo byo 12ta mādhihu / khur+ha khur+ha/ a ba lo khri miya/ a ba lo tī dzaya/ maṇ+ḍa la tsosarba satā lho māṃ swā hā/ mar me'i rig sngags te/ 'dis mar me dbul bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni kha bye ba zhes sems can thams cad rnam par snang bar byed pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 432/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tar+ya thā/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dzā 19la ya dzā ji 7la ya hūm̐ bi bo dha ka ha ra kṛt+ta dzi 1ga swā hā/ me'i bya ba byed pa'i rig sngags su 'gyur ro/ /'dir yang phyag rgya ni/ kha sbyor zhes par 2ge'ajig rten grags/ /sems can kun 'od kyis 2shegasal byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan dang / /thub pa mchog gis 2 sngon gsungs pa'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis ge/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po sngags kyi tshig 'di ni/gsang chen dang bcas shing mchog tu gsang ba yin te/ bu khyod la phan drag po'i mtha'/ /mi bzad pa yi da rigs su grags/ /sngags rnams thams cad gang kho na/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya'o/ /spyi bo'i gdu bu zhes grags pa//rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs dag kyang / /de ni nges par gzhig don du/ /rig pa 'di 93—684

ni yang dag brjod/ /na maḥ sarba bud+dha 1bo dhi satā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ / o (mika ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma kādzñā rdza sa bha/ dzi bha sarba sarba cad ha da ha/ sarba badz+ra bi nā sha ka /mān+ta ḍā 5ka dzī ba: 6ta ka rā ma hā bi tri ta rā pi ṇi sgyudzodapa tsa pa tsa sarba du/ 98rim hā ga ṇa 9)pa ti dzī 1 brnye ta ka ra/ ban+dha brnya/sarba gra tsā/sto/ ṣaḍa mu kha ṭha ḍa bhu dza ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa ru dra 1 rimā na ya brah+ma traṃ de ba nān ya mā bi 3snelasba mā bo bi gelasba bhu ṣa hrī maṇ+ḍa la ma sgye pra be sha ya sa ma ya ma lan sma ra tsū hūm̐ ()rdzu hūṃ rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba brtson 'grus chen po sgrol ma'i yan lag zhal drug pa zhes bya ba khro bo'i rgyal po chen po thams cad rnam par 'joms pa po ste/ 'di bklags pa tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyang rnam par 'jig par byed na/ ma rungs pa'i bgegs rnams lta ci smos/ 'di bklags pa tsam gyis srung ba chen po byas par 'gyur ro/ /'dir phyag rgya yang rigs chen po zhes bya bar 'gyur te bgegs rnam par 'jig par byed pa'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po 'di nyid kyi snying po ni/ oṃ hrīḥdz+dzaḥ18 ji kṛ tā na na hūm̐ sarba sha hūṃ stam+bha ya phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'dis dgra thams cad gzer chen po'i nad dang ne/ yang rims nyin gcig 19pas zin par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas pas/ji srid snang bar byams pa nyid du mi 'gyur/ yang na snying rje'i sems thob par mi 'gyur te/ bzlas pa zin gyi bar du grol bar mi 'gyur zhing 'ching bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa byed pa la bya'i / zhi ba'i sems yod pa gzhan la ma yin no/ /phyag rgya mdung chen po'ang 1sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir nye ba'i snying por gyur pa yang / o hrīḥ/ kā la rū paṃ hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ snga 93—685

ma'i mdung chen po'ang 1sbyar bar bya'o/ /gdug pa thams cad la gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur ro/ /mchog gi snying po sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yi ge gcig pa zhes bya ba ni hūm̐ 'di ni las thams cad byed pa ste/phyag rgya mdung chen po'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /phung khrol thams cad zlog (gepar byed pa 'byung po thams cad dbang du byed pa ste/ mdor na khro bo'i rgyal po 'di ni las thams cad la rab tu sbyar bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzlas pas grub pa'i dus su'ang / khyad par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags su gyur pa yang / na maḥsarba bud+dhā 〈(5)/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tar+ya thā/ dza ya dza ya/ su dza ya/ ma hā kā (4)ru ṇi ka bi shwa rū pi ni / gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā ba 455 / sarba budhe 56)su bi sadzā ya/ sa pa ri bā raṃ/ swa bha bā māṃ 7sto da pra be sha ya/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ sanārba swa me si sbyi tu/ bi rgya sa dāḥm no ra the tsa me pa ri pū ra ya swā hā/ 'di ni gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags te las thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /phyag rgya bzang po'i gdan zhes grags pa ste/ 'dis gdan yang sbyin par bya'o/ /yid kyis lan bdun bzlas pas thams cad gshegs su gsol lo/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang / sngags rnams nyid la'ang sngags kyi dngos grub dang / dam tshig dang / bzlas pa dang / dus dang / nges par 6)sdom pa rnams la'ang rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa' chen pos slar yang gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu rnams la kun du gzigs te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la rang gi rig pa'i cho gas sngags kyi le'u rab 'byam 3 tshogasungs par gyur to/ /na maḥsarba bud+dhā 411/ a pra ti ha ta ga tī māṃ o 7ni ṭi 93—686

swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i skra can ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa / las thams cad pa ste dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya'i snying po dug gi las thams cad la kun du sbyar ro/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā (1/rna/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ / o ni ṭi/ 'di ni nye bar spyod pa'i skra can ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa nalas thams cad pa ste/ phyag rgya ni kha bye geb zhes pa gza'i las thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /na maḥ(ges man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ o ni/ rig pa 'di ni sdong bu can zhes bya ba paspyod pa'i dge ba'i las thams cad byed pa ste/phyag rgya ni bzang po'i gdan gyis gnod sbyin mo rnams dgug par bya ba la sbyar rol/ /na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ a tsin+dhad+dha (67ta rū pi 〉(7/ o sne swā hā/mkha' 'gro ma kun 'joms pa yi/ /phyag rgya sbubs can yang dag sbyar/ /byang chub sems dpas bshad pa yi/ /rig sngags thod pa can 8zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi pad+ma nyid/ /rab bsngags lha yi (cigazugs can ma/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 74/ a pra ti ha ta ga ti/ tsā 11ra r+ṇa/ tar+ya thā/ o ba ra de sā 12hā/phyag rgya ut+pa la nyid ni/ /dpal gyi bdag nyid spyan la sbyar/ /gzugs mang 'chang ba'i lha mo ni/ /myur du longs spyod rab sgrub pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ / a tsin+dhad+dha ta rū pi tsā 1/o su ri swā hā/ phyag rgya mdung dang yang dag ldan/ /rims rnams thams cad rnam 'joms pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā thunā/ a tsin+dhad+dha ta rū 7pi ṭ+wāṃ ⑩a tu re swā hā/ bsam pa'i sgrol ma ldan pa zhes/ /rab bsngags 3 snalas rnams thams cad pa/ /dbyug pa'i phyag rgyar yang dag ldan/ /bgegs rnams 'joms byed ma la sbyar/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ a tsin+dhad+dha 18ta rū pi hūṃ/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ bi lo ki ni swā hā/ rig pa snang ldan zhes bya ba/ /93—687

'jig rten thams cad dbang du byed/ /bde ba thams cad rab sbyin pa/ /pad+ma 1phyag rgyas sbyar bar bya/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ a tsiṣ+ṭhasgru (7ta rū pi 〉(kye/tabya thā/ oṃ bi shwe/ bi shwa saṃ bha be bi shwa rū (4)pi hūṃ ka 5)ha ka (6)ha ā bi sha ā bi 7sha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ru ru tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ rig pa brtson 'grus chen mo ni/ /'jig rten 'dren pas bstan pa ste/ /snying po phyag rgya mnyam pa nyid/ /sems can thams cad 'bebs shing dge/ /sna tshogs zhes byar 8)yang dag bsgrags/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ o tsin+dhad+dha ta rū (5pi shā'i/ tar+ya thā/ o shwe te ṅgā ba su swā hā/ pad+ma'i gdan gyi 17rnam par dgod/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 124/ a pra ti ha ta ga ti mā ti ri shā1lha/ tar+ya thā/ a shrīḥ/rig pa 'di ni dpal mo che/ /'jig rten mgon gyis bstan pa ste/ /phyag rgya kha sbyor ldan pa yi/ /rgyal srid chen po rab sbyin byed/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/sarba satā bha ya pra dā yi kā/ tar+ya thā/ o a dzi te ku mā ra rū pi tsā/ o hi a tsogats+tsha ma ma kur yaṃ ku ru swā hā/ mi thub ma zhes rnam grags ma/ /gzhon nu bdud rtsi las byung ba/ /gang ba'i phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /dgra rnams thams cad zlog 7par byed/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā rnal/ a tsin+dhad+dha nyu 7ta rū pi shā/snye/tabya thā/ o dza ye swā hā/ bi dza 19yi swā hā/ a dzi te swā hā/ sring mo bzhi zhes rnam grags pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rjes 'gro ba/ /sa rnams mtha' dag yongs rgyu zhing / /sems can rjes su 'dzin byed pa/ /ming po rtu bu ru zhes grags / /'di rnams kyis ni rjes su spyod/ / gru yi bzhon pa mnyam zhon nas//rgya mtsho la ni nges par gnas/ /khu tshur phyag rgyas rnam par dgod/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ lo kā grwa dhi ba ti ninyudzā/93—688

tabya thā/ o ku mā ri ma hā ku mā huri shrī (miḍa shrī ḍa/ ma hā rāk+ṣa si bo dhi satā nu dzñā ta ma yu rā chas ne pā (4)sha /pa 5)ra shu pā ṇi ra/ 'gri rak+ta gan+ta 7nu le pa na pri ye pri ye(kye/ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ dri t+ya rak+ta puṣ+ṭha rtsi ta myun+ti (7)sa ma nu sma ra/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ bhā ma ya bh+ra ma ya/ hu lu hu lu mā bi lasba'i/ sarba kurmā ṇi me ku ru ku ru / bi tsi tra rū ba dhā ri ṇi/sto/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bud+dhā nu dzñā te 12su hā/sems can rjes su 'dzin byed pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpas bshad pas 1 na/ /sa rnams ma lus kun nas ni/ /rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos/ /sems can kun la phan don dang / /gdug pa'i sems can zlog 'byed pa/ /bdag gi rig pa rtag tu gragasa'i/ /rtag tu srung bar yongs su grags/ /srung ba ltos 'gro de nyid kyi/ /'jig rten mtshan mas legs par mtshan/ /snying rjes thugs ni brlan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' de nas gsungs/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /byis pa rnams la phan don du/ /gang la khosems can spyod gsungs pa/ /'gro ba rnams la rnam spyod ldan/ /phyag rgya dbyug pa'i srog shing ldan/ /bdag nyid chen pos sbyar nas ni/ /tshangs pa la sogs 'gugs byed na/ /mi rnams 'bras bu smos ci dgos/ /gzhon nu'i sems su ma lus pa'i / /rtog pa 'di ni bsdus nas su/ /srin po rnams su grags pa yi/ /rig sngags 'di ni yang dag bstan/ /sems can rjes gzung 1 'dod pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ltar bshad/ /yig gsum zhes bya'i snying po 'di/ /rig sngags 'di ni yang dag bshad/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /nye bar longs spyod 'gugs pa'i mchog /phyag rgya dbyug pa'i srog shing ni/ /rnam bkod las rnams thams cad pa'o/ /o hūm̐ dzaḥ/ rig sngags 'di ni mdor 93—689

bsdus nas/ /mi rnams 'bras bu byed pa yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/sa marnyo byo ti ta mūrti 1rna/ a bi dun kṛ ta gra ha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po 'di yang ni/ /phyag rgya dgra sta yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin 'byung po 'gugs par byed/ /de bzhin gza' nadadang ma mor bcas/ /thams cad phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa/ /bkod na 'bras bu bcas par 'gyur/ /'byung po rnams ni rnam skrag byed/ /gdug ri pa zhugs pa rnam par grol/ /'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i pho nya mo chen mo las thams cad pa ral pa gcig ma zhes bya ba rjes su spyod pa las thams cad pa ste bzlas pa tsam kho nas las thams cad byed do/ /'byung po thams cad skrag par byed pa dang / 'gugs par byed pa dang / dbang du byed pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa ji ltar 'dod pa de thams cad rdzogs par byed do/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā dzā/tabya thā/ o braṅgā su braṅgā braṅgā/ bstsa se shārnyi (5ku ru swā hā/ sngags 'di tshangs pa chen po ste/ /byang chub sems dpas bshad pa yin/ /'byung po zhi ba rab tu thob / /skad cig nyid la bsil bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya pad+ma yang dag ldan/ /myur du dge legs thob par 'gyur/ /mngon spyod kyi ni las rnams la/ /srid srung gi ni rig byed 'dod/ /'di ni mdor bsdus brjod pa ste/ /cho ga 'di ni mdor bsdus pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti (6ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tar+ya thā / oṃ ga ru ḍa ba ha na tsakra pā ni 7 tsa tur bhu dza nartsu hūm̐/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/bo dhi satwa ā dzñā 9pa ya ti swā hā/ byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa / /zhi ba'i don ni myur du byed/ /'byung po rnams ni rnam 'jig byed/ /khyab 'jug gzugs kyi 11lus can yin/ /phyag rgya hu 'khor lor yang dag ldan/ /brtan 93—690

pa'i don ni yang dag byed/ /gang 'di khyab 'jug rgyud du ni/ /cho ga rgyas par bstan pa ste(1)/ /sems can kun gyi sgrub byed de/ /byang chub sems dpas bshad pa yin/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā dzā/ tabya thā/ma hā ma he shwa ra bhu ( tā dhi pa ti bṛ ri rig bha/ dh+wa dza pra lam̐ ba dza ṭa mu ku ṭa dhā ri tī/si ta bhasma dhu sa ra ta/ mūrti sa e phaṭa phaṭa bo dhi satwa ā dzñā (4 pa ya ti swā hā/sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /sngags 'di bdag gis rab tu brjod/ /mdung gi phyag rgya mnyam par ldan/ /'byung po 5thams cad rnam 6'jig pa/ /'di yang bstan pa'i cho ga 'di/ /sems can sa stengs 7gnas pa la/ /sngon ni zhi ba'i rgyud du bstan/ /yon tan sna tshogs rgya che ba/ /zhi ba'i rgyud kyis kyang brjod do/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ tar+ya thā/o sha ku ni pa ta ta pak+ṣi ṇa/ sha 8ka kha kha/ khā hi 9'a hi sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha bo dhi satwa yi.ādzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ sngags 'di brtson 'grus chen po ste/ /nam mkha' lding zhes rnam par grags/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba rnams kyi mchog /gdengs ka 415can gyi dug 12rnams 'joms/ /phyag rgya che dang yang dag ldan/ /phung khrol mi bzad 12bcas pa 'joms/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams ni/ /gso bar byed par the tshom samed/ /gdul bya'i sems can la brtse bas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag bka'/ /nam mkha' lding gi gzugs kyis spyod/ /'dab chags rgyal po 'od chen ldan/ /ji srid nam mkha' lding rgyud du/ /bstan pa'i cho ga rgyas de rnams/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i rgyud/ /bdag gis kyang ni brjod pa yin/ /mkha' lding mngon par brjod rgyud du/ /khro bo'i rgyal po ma bstan na/ /gdengs can dug ni gzhom pa'i phyir/ /'dab chags 93—691

gzugs kyis rnam par rgyu/ /ji srid 'jig rten pa yi sngags/ /de rnams cho ga dper brjod pa/ /gdul bya'i sems can don du ni/ /de lta de ltar rnam par spyod / /gang yang de bzhin gshegs sngags dang / /rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs dag kyang / /de rnams cho ga rab 'byam 1'dir/ /snga ma kho nar gsungs pas yin/ /ji ltar ma ma rnam mang po/ /byis pa 'bad pas srung byed pa/ /de bzhin byis mtha'i blo can la/ /nga ni rig sngags gzugs kyi rgyu/ /stobs bcu ldan pas sngon gsungs pa/ /da lta'ang nga yis gebastan pa yin/ /sngags rgyud don ni ma lus pa/ /rtogs pas rab gsungs 'od chen po/ /rgyal ba mchog gis gang gsungs pa/ /stobs bcu ldan pa'i sras kyis gsungs/ /rmad byung bsam mi khyab gzugs can/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pa'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de la kun du gzigs nas dam tshig thams cad yang dag par skul bar rin)byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gang du ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas sems can ma lus pa'i sgrub pa'i spyod pa'i yid/ sems can thams cad la rab tu gnas par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor chen po gnas rirnam par bkra ba'i phyag na rin po che'i snying po rgyan bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab cing rmad du byung ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sa bcu dang ldan pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug la 93—692

gnas pa rnams kyis kyang / dkyil 'khor de bri ba'am 'drir 'jug par mi nus na / so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor bzang po de'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i gnas la gnas pa byang chub sems dpa' chen pos gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pa rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur zhing dam tshig thob pa thams cad dang / spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams 0)dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa'i sems can thams cad spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nargyu mthun pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyis thugs las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa bdag nyid kyis yang dag par shes par gyur to/ /so so'i skye bo thams cad kyis de yid kyis dmigs par mi nus na/ bri ba'am 'drir 'jug pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig la rjes su rab tu zhugs pa'i sems can de rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag nyon cig /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang 'da' bar mi bya ba'i dam tshig yin na/ sems can rnams dang / 'phags pa gzhan rnams kyang lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas yang sems dpa' chen pos phyag na rdo rje gsang ba pa'i bdag po la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/ mi las 'das pa'i dam tshig yid las byung ba ni nges par bstan to/ /mi rnams la/93—693

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das na yang dag tu sems can rnams yang dag par zhugs nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig pa dang / sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur bar bshad par bya'o/ /de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la smras pa/kye rgyal ba'i sras gang da 1lta dus la bab par shes na gsungs shig gsungs shig /shākya seṅge 'jig rten mgon/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa na/ /mi rnams mchog gi sangs rgyas zhing / /sems can sa stengs 5khyod dkyil 'khor/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'jig rten na/ /sngags kyi dngos grub rab tu skye/ /mi shes cho ga nyams pa'am/ /dam tshig bdag por ma gyur na/ /tshangs pa bdag nyid chen pos kyang / /rig sngags dngos grub mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags la mngon par mi brtson dang / /dam tshig bstan pa mi mthong na/ /rnam pa du mar 'bad byas kyang / /rig pa'i dngos grub mi 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig sbyor ba nyams pa na/ /brgya byin gyis kyang rab 'bad las/ /rig pa'i dngos grub mi 'gyur na/ /sa stengs mi rnams smos ci dgos/ /dam tshig bstan bcos de nyid shes/ /spyod pa'i las rnams sgrub pa de / /'jig rten pa dang 'phags pa'i sngags/ /bklags pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du / /rab zhugs las rnams thams cad byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' bstan pa la/ /de yi rig pa'i dngos grub rtag /de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes/ sems dpa' chen po de la gsol ba btab par gyur to/ /kye kye sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 93—694

gis sems can gyi don gyi phyir dkyil 'khor cho ga gsungs so/ /dang po re zhig cho 'phrul gyi zla phyed dam/ nag pa can nam/ sa ga can gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs la rab tu bsngags pa'i nyi ma dang / gza' bzang po bltas te/ rgyu skar dge ba dang yang dag par ldan pa'i (17dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig dang /zla ba nya ba'am/ dus gzhan la dbyar gyi zla ba spangs te/ snga dro sa rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /grong khyer chen po la brten napa'am/ gang du dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon rang nyid gnas par te/ rgya mtshor 'jug pa'am/ chu klung la brten 95)pa'am/ rgya mtsho'i ngogs dang nye bar grong khyer chen po'i byang shar gyi phyogs kyi char ha cang yang mi ring / ha cang yang 94)mi nye bar dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon song nas/ nyi ma bdun nam/ zla phyed du mtha' gcig tu smyung 5ba'am / nye bar gnas nas so sor gnas par bya'o/ /gang gnas de rnams su'ang gtsang ma'i sa phyogs rdo ba dang / gyo mo dang / thal ba dang / sol ba dang / phub ma dang / thod pa dang / rus pa dang / rus pa gnas pa dang bral ba/ shin tu yongs su sbyang ba byas pa'i sa phyogs su/ srog 'chags med pa'i chu la/ ba byung lnga dang bsres pa'i tsan+dan dang / ga pur dang /gur gum gyi chus khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa stong phrag brgyad kyis mngon par bsngags 7)pa des bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag rgya chen po yang dag par ldan pas/sa phyogs de la phyogs bzhi rnams su mngon par gtor zhing steng dang 'og dang thad ka dang phyogs bral rnams su'ang kun nas gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas sa phyogs der kun nas gru bzhir/ khru bcu drug gam/ khru bcu gnyis sam/ khru brgyad bya ste/ de la chen po ni khru bcu drug go/ /bar ma ni khru bcu gnyis so/ /93—695

chung ngu ni khru brgyad do/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum po 'di/ /thams cad gzigs pas gsungs pa yin/ /rgyal srid 'dod phyir chen po ste/ /bar ma longs spyod 'phel bar byed/ /chung ngu sngags kyi dam tshig ni/ /las rnams kun byed zhi ba yin/ /de la yid la 'dod pa gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /de la sa'i phyogs der khru gnyis tsam brkos la/ der rdo ba dang /sol ba dang / thal ba dang / rus pa 17dang / skra la sogs pa dang / srog chags kyi rigs rnam pa sna tshogs pa gal te mthong na sa'i phyogs gzhan du brko bar bya'o/ /gnod pa med pa dang / nye bar 'tshe ba med pa der 'gyur ro/ /ri'i rtse mo dang / rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung chen po'i chu ngogs rnams su'ang gang rab tu 'bad pa chen pos shin tu so sor brtags te shin tu gtsang zhing srog chags med par byas nas bri bar bya'on/ /sa'i phyogs der slar yang srog chags med pa'i chu la ba'i rnam lnga bsres pas chu klung gi 'gram gyi sa gtsang ma'am/grog mkhar gyi sa'am ri/ gang du srog chags med pa'i sa des dgang bar bya'o/ /bkang nas kyang legs par brdungs te kun nas mnyam par byas la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum bya'o/ /seng ldeng gi phur bu bzhi la khro bo'i rgyal po nyid kyis lan bdun mngon par bsngags 55par byas nas phyogs bzhi rnams su gdab par bya'o/ /tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la khro bo'i rgyal pos lan bdun mngon par bsngags 6par byas nas kun nas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 75pa'i rnam par dkri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dbus kyi gnas su/ nang du'ang zur bzhi'i rnam par bya'o/ /dbus kyi nang na gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis rtsa ba'i rig pa'am/ rtsa ba'i snying po stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /93—696

phyag rgya chen po dang rtsa ba'i sngags kyis gtsug tor bcings te khro bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis grogs bsrungs nas bdag nyid bsrung (15bar byas te/ bzlas pa byed bzhin du phyi rol du byung ste/ dkyil 'khor la g.yas su bskor ba byas nas kha shar du phyogs te ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug nasarinas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid la byas te dkyil 'khor de kun nas gru bzhi'i rnam par dkri bar bya'o/ /de nyid kyi phyi rol du zhag gcig smyung da bar gnas pas rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /de la 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyi sngon spyad pa rnams byas te/ rang gi rig pa dang / sngags dang rgyud la mkhas pa'i mkhan pos sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir theg pa chen po la lhag par mos pas zhag gcig smyung (4)bar gnas pas 59grogs bzang po dang yang dag par ldan pa / bstan bcos rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bya ba mthong bas tshon lnga'i phye ma zhib mo 6'bar bas legs par sbyang ba byas nas/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'i sngags dang snying pos mngon par bsngags tsho pa'i phye ma dkyil 'khor dbus su gdab par bya'o/ /pha rol du'ang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sgreng ba dang / rta babs bzhis brgyan pa dang / chu shing gi sdong bu 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis g.yur za zhing kun nas 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams kyis rab tu 'phyang bzhin pa dang / rnga bo che dang /rdza rnga dang / dung gi sgra nges par sgrogs pa'i sa'i phyogs su bsgrag tsho par bya'o/ /ngos bzhir rjes su mthun 95pa'i bar du bsngags pa'i sgra'i 7chos mnyan par bya'o//phyogs bzhi rnams su theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i glegs bam bklag par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa lho phyogs su bklag par bya'o/ /'phags pa zla ba sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin nub phyogs su'o/ /'phags pa sdong po 93—697

bkod pa byang phyogs su'o/ /'phags pa gser 'od dam pa shar phyogs su'o/ /de ltar glegs bam klog pa po med na mdo sde bzhi po klog par rtogs pa'i gang zag chos smra ba po la chos mnyan pa'i phyir gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon langs nas tsan+dan dang / ga pur dang / gur gum rnam par bsres pa'i me tog dkar po dri zhim pa la rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas te/dkyil 'khor de thams cad du gcal du dgram par bya'o/ /mngon par bkram nas phyi rol du byung ste/ zhag bdun gyi bar du 'dod pa'i kha zas bsten pa gnyis sam/ gsum/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa/ gso sbyong nye bar gnas pa bsten pa la gnas pa'i ri mo mkhan 65de grogs sam/ slob ma des khas blangs pa rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /gang rtsa ba'i rig pa nyid kyis gtsug tor bcing ba nabyas nas/ de nas gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i go 'phang nornam par bkra zhing / 'bar la mdzes pa'i zangs kyi phye ma zhib mo so sor bzung nas longs spyod chen po dang ldan zhing / chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po chen po rnams 'dir gzhug par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba nyid las nges par byang chub la gzhol ba yin nodi / /sngags sgrub par byed pa lta ci smos/ shākya'i 55skyes mchog mya ngan 'das/ /sems can bsod nams chung rnams la/ /'di lta'i longs spyod ga la yod/ /cho ga 'di ni bstan par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od chen ldan/ /skye bo bkren pa gzigs nas ni/ /nyung zhing mdor bsdus dkyil 'khor ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bstan pa yin/ /'bras sā 6lu dang thug po che'i phye ma shin tu zhib mo tshon sna lnga pa 'bar bas/dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po dang / ljang gu'i ga na93—698

kha dog tu kha bsgyur la/ sngar bzhag pa'i phye ma dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis blangs nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag rgya chen po bcings te rtsa ba'i rig pas phye ma la phyag rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /gzhan zhi ba sgrub pa'i slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol (1)lho shar gyi phyogs su rinalas kyi cho ga mthong bas me thab bya'o/ /khru gnyis kyi tshad la dpangs khru gang tsam kho ra khor yug tu pad+ma'i ze ba'i rnam par shing pa lā rin)sha'i yam shing rnams kyis me rab tu sbar te/ shing dpal 'bras kyi yam shing mtho gang tsam gyi tshad la rlan dang bcas pa/ zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pa rnams kyis rtsa ba'i snying pos sam/ phyag rgya dang /rtsa ba'i rig sngags kyis me lha spyan drang bar bya'o/ /spyan drangs nas kyang sngar brjod pa'i yi ge gcig pa nyid kyi gerig pa'am/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'i snying pos slar yang brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg 5bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis gtsug tor gtsang zhing yo byad tshogs par byas nas bdag nyid dang ri mo mkhan ches mkhas pa'am/ slob ma byed du gzhug go/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams yid la byas nas sngar brjod pa'i bdug pa'i rig pas bsreg 6go/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag byas nas phye ma blangs te/ gzugs kyi rnam par bya zhing / ri mo mkhan mkhas pas rdzogs par bya'o/ /cho ga 'di dag gis dang po kho nar re zhig 7sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa rnam pa thams cad kyi 8mchog dang ldan pa rin po che seṅge'i khri la bzhugs pa gnas gtsang ma'i gnas na chos ston par mdzad 93—699

bzhin pa kun du bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis kun du bris nas rjes su sgrub pa pos bdag nyid srung ba'i cho ga dang / rig pa byas nas 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi dang steng dang 'og tu gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas nas me thab dang nye bar song nas gos gtsang ma bgos te gtsang sbra dang / srung ba'i cho ga byas te rtsa ba'i rig pas gur gum dang bsres pa'i mar gyi sreg 91〉blugs stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg 5bya'o/ /de nas ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste de nyid du bzlas pa byed cing de nyid du gnas par bya'o/ /yungs kur dkar po la khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon par bsngags ri note/ mngon par bsngags 4rinas kham phor kha sbyor du gzhag 5༄par bya'o/ /bgegs kyi rnam par 'gyur ba'i gzugs rnams du ma dang / nga ro drag po dang / rlung dang /char dang / yul ngan gzhan dang gzhan gang yang rung ba 'ongs pa mthong na/khros pas yungs kur gyi sreg blugs lan bdun sbyin sreg 6)bya'o/ /de nas bgegs rab tu 'jigs par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i bgegs la ni lan lnga chang 7 pa nas sbyin sreg byas na skyes bu de rengs par 'gyur ba'am/ nus pa med par 'gyur ba'am/ 'chi bar 'gyur ba'am/ skad cig de nyid la mi ma yin pas zin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rjes su sgrub pa pos de nyid du ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug nas khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pas bzlas pa byed cing gnas par bya'o / /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku gzugs kyi 8rigayas kyi gzhogs su rang sangs rgyas gnyis pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa skyil krung gis nye bar bzhugs par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu nyan thos 93—700

chen po gnyis chos nyan par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi'ang 1g.yas su (5bcom ldan ci'adas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ston ku'i sprin gyi mdog ltar dkar ba pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa phyag g.yon pas pad+ma bsnams nas/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa'o/ /de'i yang g.yas su bcom ldan 'das ma gos dkar mo phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal bzhin pa pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ dar la dkar po'i na bza' bsnams pa/ dar la'i stod g.yogs bla gos bsnams pa/ thal ba nag po'i thig le gsum byas pa'o/ /de bzhin du brtan pa dang / khro gnyer can ma yang /rang rang gi gdan la rang rang gi spyod lam du gnas shing nye bar bzhugs (5)pa'ang bya'o/ /de rnams kyi g.yas su bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ma dang / gtsug tor rgyal mo'ang bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug bya ba la/ 'di lta ste / kun du bzang po dang / sa'i snying po dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / ngan song spong 47dang / byams pa phyag na rnga yab thogs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la lta bzhin pa dang / dri ma med pa'i blo gros dang / dri ma med pa'i tog dang / nor bzang dang / zla 'od dang / dri ma med par grags pa dang / nad thams cad gso bar byed pa dang ske/ chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / 'jig rten 'gro ba dang /blo gros chen po dang / mngon par 'dzin pa zhes pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po bcu drug po 'di rnams rab tu zhi ba'i sku dang / rgyan thams cad 93—701

kyis brgyan pa bri'o1/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i gtso bo dang / rig pa'i rgyal mo dang / pad+ma'i rigs kyi 5cigazugs dang / phyag rgya rnams lung las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin dang / gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bri'o/ /mtha'i gnas su'ang gru bzhi'i rnam par gnas gzhag tsho ripar bya'o/ /pad+ma'i me tog legs par byas pa dang / rig pa'i lha gang gis dran pa yang gnas de rnams su gzhag (4)par bya'o / /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i g.yas kyi gzhogs su rang sangs rgyas nam mkha' dang / yongs su zhes bya ba gnyis kyang ngo / /de bzhin du shar du kha bltas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug pa'i sgo rnams bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i g.yon gyi gzhogs su rang sangs rgyas tsan+dan dang / grub pa zhes pa gzhan gnyis kyang kun du bri'o/ /de rnams kyi 'og tu nyan thos chen po 'od srung chen po dang / ka t+ya na dang gnyis kun du bri'o/ /de rnams kyi'ang gzhogs su 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje 555ut+pa la ltar sngo bsangs su snang ba rab tu zhi ba'i gzugs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rnga yab thogs pa/ g.yon pa ne khro bo'i spyi bor bzhag 7 pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur dang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / dpung bzang dang /rdo rje sde rnams cha byad ji lta ba dang / mtshan ma ji lta ba bzhin du bgegs rnams 'joms pa'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po dang / rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gzugs dang phyag rgya la sogs pa rnams ji ltar dran pa bzhin du bri'o/ /de rnams kyi'ang 8g.yon du gru bzhi'i rnam par rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /bris nas kyang gnas gang du rig pa'i tshogs ma dran pa de rnams gnas 'dir bzhugs shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi steng du pha 93—702

rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bcom ldan 'das ma mā ma tī (1kun du bri ste rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rab tu zhi ba'i lus (nasaso/ /de rnams kyi'ang steng du gtsug tor gyi rgyal po brgyad kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ phyag rgya bcings pa rang rang gi 'khor los sgyur (8ba'i rgyal po chen po'i gzugs su kun du bri ste/ gser mdog dbang po rab tu zhi ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la cung zad blta ba sbyin pa rnams 'di lta ste/gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur (4)ba dang / gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa dang /gtsug tor gdugs dkar po dang / rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / pad+ma'i gtsug tor dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / gtsug tor mthon po zhes pa ste/ gtsug tor brgyad po 'di rnams kun du bri'o/ /'jug pa'i phyogs kyi sgor ni byang chub sems dpa' gnyis bya ste/g.yas phyogs su ni 'jig rten las 'das par 'gro ba zhes bya ba rab tu zhi ba'i lus ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pas phreng ba 'dzin pa/phyag g.yon pas spyi blugs 'dzin cing sgo la mngon du phyogs pa/ bzhin cung zad khro gnyer dang bcas pa kun du bri'o/ /'jug pa'i sgo'i g.yon phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba bri bar bya ste/ rab tu zhi ba'i lus ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ phyag g.yon dbyug gu dang / ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas pas bgrang phreng bzung nas mchog sbyin pas rab tu sbyin par byed pa/ bzhin cung zad khro gnyer can 'jug pa'i sgo la mngon par phyogs pa kun du bri'o/ /seng ge'i khri'i 'og tu chos kyi 'khor lo kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa de'i 'og tu rin po che'i gzhal yas khang de la 93—703
