la rig pa ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 6)ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā (5)ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā ren+d+ra tā re (5)tut+ta re tu re 4)swā (5)hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma shin tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sha ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā (6)re tu re tu re swā hā/'phags ma sgrol ma bzhin bzang ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā du tshore tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dbus legs ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā 58)re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma legs spyod ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/tā 95re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma mtshan legs ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ⑩ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā 511re tu re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma lho chung ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā /2ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā 1 re tut+ta re tu re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma legs gnas ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā khab lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā tshare tut+ta re/ tu re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgrol ma nye bar 'dud pa zhes bya ba'o/ /zhes pa 'di bcom ldan 'das bdag gi rig pa chen po mchog gi snying po chen po dang mtshungs pa bya ba thams cad mchog tu grub pa/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas bzhin du skyes pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rjes su yi rang ba/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las skyob pa/93—754

las thams cad byed pa/ byang chub kyi lam ston pa po/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rig pa / rab dang / 'bring dang / tha ma la yang dag par rab tu sbyor ba/ shin tu mdzes pa'i las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ rab tu sbyin pa dang zhi)/bstan pa nub pa'i dus kyi tshe'ang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dam pa'i chos kyi tshul bsrung ( ba'i ched du/ mnyam par 'jug cing 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams sbyor ba chung ngu nyid kyis dzodakyirgyal srid chen po dang / longs spyod chen po'i dbang phyug gi don de rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams shin tu myur bar de'i tshe de'i dus su dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /ras ris kyi cho ga mdor bsdus par gyur pa 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jigs pa chen po dang / snyigs ma lnga'i sems can bsod nams chung ba 4)'byung bar 'gyur te/ dbang chung bar grags pa/ tshe thung ba/ brtson 'grus zhan pas ras ris kyi cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i las bsgrub par bya ba la sogs pa'i las rnams rab tu brtson par mi nus te/de rnams kyi don du 5)ches 6)mdor bsdus te gsungs pa ni/ dang po re zhig ci dpa' bo'i rin gyis 8dog pa nyos/ srang tshad tsam mam srang phyed tsam/dkyus su khru gang tsam la zheng du khru phyed tsam pa'i ras kha tshar dang bcas pa tha ga pas btag par bya'o/ /yang na slar yang skra dang bral ba'i ras kyi dum bu gsar pa steng 'og tu ji ltar 'dod pa khru gnyis sam bzhi'am/ drug gam/ lnga'am/bcu'am / brgyad pa'i ras shin tu dkar ba blangs te/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du ri mo mkhan 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang ga pur dang gur gum gyis bsgos (9pa'i ma 'dres pa'i tshon rtsi de rnams dang / ras tsan+dan dang /gur gum dang / ga pur rnams gcig tu byas pas srog chags med pa'i chu rnyog 93—755

ma 17med pa dang bsres te/ snod gsar par ras spang du bcug nas nyi ma gsum du legs par (narimanan la bzhag go/ /gtsang ba'i phyogs su srung ba byas te bdag nyid kyang gtsang mar byas nas/ dkar po'i ri )phyogs kyi nya la ras kyi snod kyi mdun du kha shar du phyogs pas ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste/ sngags kyi tshig 'di lan stong phrag brgyad brjod par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ o he he bha ga bān / ba hu rū pa dha ra di bya tsak+ṣu gsil/ a ba lo ka ya/ a ba lo ka (5)ya māṃ/sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ ku mā ra rū pa dha ra ṇa/ ma hā bo dhi satwa(6)/ kiñtsa (7)rā ya si nasahūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 'di bzlas pa byas la de nyid du nyal bar bya'o/ /rmi lam du grub pa'am/ mi 'grub par ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas langs nas grub pa'i mtshan ma'i rmi lam mthong na/ ring po mi thogs par9no ras ris bri bar bya'o/ /gal te grub pa'i mtshan ma'i rmi lam ma mthong na ras de snod de nas phyung ste nyi ma la bskam par bya'o/ /bskams nas slar yang snod gsar pa gzhan zhig tu legs par sbas la srung ba byas te gzhag nyu par bya'o/ /de nas slar yang mchog gi snying po de rnams las sngags gang yang rung ba gcig bzung nas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du yi ge drug po rnams las slar yang yi ge 'bum bzlas par bya'o / /de nas ches myur bar ras ris 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dang po re zhig /1ras de blangs 12nas/ cho 'phrul gyi zla phyed dam/ gzhan yang dkar po'i nyi ma dang / rgyu skar dge ba dang / yang dag par ldan pa/ dge ba'i tshes dkar po'i gza'i res kyi nyi ma la shin tu mdzes pa'i dge mtshan dang / bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan mo nam phyed kyi dus kyi tshe/ ri mo mkhan gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pas ras ris de 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /gtsang ma'i 1 phyogs su ga 93wa 756

pur gyi bdug pa bsregs te dang po re zhig 17'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa byas te/ dbu zur phud 95)can skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ gser gyi mdog can/ dar la sngon po g.yo bzhin pa'i sham thabs can dar la sngon po'i bla gos mnabs pa/seng ge'i khri la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs 4te chos 'chad bzhin pa/ zhabs g.yas pa rin po che'i zhabs rten la bzhag pa/ seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ blta na sdug pa bzhin cung zad 'dzum pa/ sgrub pa po la gzigs par gyur pa bri bar bya'o/ /g.yas kyi gzhogs su 'phags pa kun du bzang po bri yang ku ltar sngo bsangs/ rnga yab dkar po g.yob bzhin pa/ phyag g.yon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsnams pa/lus thams cad mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar la sngon po g.yo ba dang bcas pa'i sham thabs mnabs 5pa/ mu tig gi do shal gyi mchod phyir thogs pa can/ phyag g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams 6pa/ phyag g.yas pas 7)rnga yab dkar po gser gyi yu ba can bsnams nas g.yob par byed bzhin pa zhi ba'i rnam pa can spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la blta bar gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa kun du bzang po pad+ma dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs pa ste de dag gnyis ku'ang de ltar mngon par bri'o/ /pad+ma'i sdong bu gcig las 'thon pa'i pad+ma gsum gyi dbu 8ma rtsa ba'i pad+ma'i ze 'bru la byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i seng ge'i khri dang rin po che'i zhabs rten no/ /pad+ma gzhan la ni 'phags pa kun du bzang po'o/ /pad+ma gsum pa la ni 'phags pa mthu chen thob bo/ /pad+ma'i sdong bu de ni mdzes pa/ rin po che mar gad kyi rnam pa la pad+ma'i me tog 93—757

du ma kha bye ba dang / phyed tsam kha bye ba dang / me tog kha ma hu)bye ba dang ldan pa/mtsho chen po ma dros pa las byung ba'i klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis mtsho chen po las skyes pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu la 'dzin pa/ klu'i rgyal po de gnyis kha dog dkar ba/ gdengs ka bdun gyis brgyan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa / lus phyed mi'i lus la sprul gyi gdengs 37kas mtshan pa/ phyed dusbrul gyi lus can la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la nges par rtog bzhin pa/phyed chu'i nang du nub pa/ nor bu rin po che dang gos kyis zhonanye bar mdzes pa bri bar bya'o/ /mtsho chen po de'i khor (phyi yug gi 'og tu ras ris kyi mtha'i grwa g.yas kyi gzhogs su sgrub pa po/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi dkyil 'khor la nges par rtog bzhin pa lag na spos phor thogs pa lus dang pus mo'i lha nga 'dud pa/ cha byad dang kha dog ji lta ba bzhin du mngon par bri'o57ste/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi steng du/ ras kyi mtha' gnyis su lha'i bu phreng ba 'dzin pa gnyis me tog gi phreng ba bzung rinanas nam mkha' la lding ba / me tog gi tshogs chen po 'thor bar byed bzhin pa/ shin tu mdzes pa dag mngon par bri'o/ /ras ris de'i khor ri9)yug tu nā tsog ge sar la sogs pa'i me tog rab tu bkram pa bri bar bya ste/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs gsum lhag par gnas pa'am/ mngon par bri'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug chos ston par mdzad bzhin pa dang / 'phags pa kun du bzang po dang / 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje phyag na rnga yab thogs pa 'drir gzhug par bya'o//sgrub pa po ji ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs gsum po rnams gdon mi za bar 'drir gzhug par bya ste ji ltar 'dod pa'i rnam pa dang / dbyibs ji ltar gnas pa 93—758

bzhin du'am/ sgrub pa po ji lta ji ltar 'dod pa de lta de ltar bri bar bya'o/ /dbus su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ mtha' gnyis su'ang /phyag na rdo rje dang / kun du bzang po ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du gdon mi za bar 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i ras kyi dum bu mtho gang ngam/khru gang tsam la bdag nyid dam/ gzhan gyis sam/ ri mo mkhan gso sbyong med pa'am / dad pa can nam/ gtsang ma'am/ mi gtsang ba'am/ tshul khrims dang ldan (1)pa'am/ tshul khrims 'chal pa'ang rung ste/ ri mo mkhan gyis 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /sgrub pa po bdag nyid ni/ gdon mi za bar sngon spyad pa byas pa/ dad pas byang chub tu (5sems bskyed pa gdon mi za bar 'gyur bas te/ de ltar na sngags 'grub par 'gyur gyi gzhan du sdig pa byed pas nam yang ( ram yin no/ /de ltar dad par gyur pa yis/ /sngags kyi lha rnams bsgrub bya zhing / /dad pa de yis gsang sngags rgyal/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni gzhan du min/ /gang phyir dad pa theg pa'i mchog /gang gis 'dren pa 'gro bar byed/ /dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa las / /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /dad dang ldan pa'i mi rnams la/ /sangs rgyas las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /lha rnams kun dang khyad par du/ /gsang sngags rnams ni thams cad ni/ /dad pa med na mi 'grub bo/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'jig rten 'das de bzhin/ /dad dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /rnyog pa bral bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /yid ni byang chub der son pas/ /de rnams byang chub nges (57par 'grub/ /gzhan gyis 'grub (6par ma gsungs te/ /bstan pa 'di 93—759

las zlog 1pa yin/ /ras ris chung dang chen po dang / /bar ma yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /de ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde las bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma 2)sgrol ma ral pa gyen brjes (gyikyi cho ga las ras ris kyi cho ga rab 'byam 47lnga pa rdzogs so// //de nas yang 5bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ sems can chen po khyod kyis sems can de rnams kyi don gyi phyir bstan pa gang yin pa de rnams ras ris kyi cho ga rab 'byam 6bshad pa 'di thabs nyung ngu nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur te de rnams kyi don gyi phyir sgrub par byed pa thabs yon tan rgyas pa rab tu dbye bas rnam par phye ba las 7rnam par dbye ba de yang dag par mthun (8)par bshad par bya'i9/ de legs par nyon la/ legs par yid la gyis shig sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir bshad par bya'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis 'byor ba bstan 1 par mdzad cing sngags kyi spyod pa'i yon tan sgrub pa'i mthu gsal bar mdzad pa legs par gsungs pa ni legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang da lta de'i dus la bab par dgongs nas /stobadag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad do / /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i nyu2zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer sngon po 93—760

dang / ser po dang / dkar po dang / btsod dang / shel gyi kha dog la sogs pa byung bar gyur to/ /'od zer de byung ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor snang bar byas nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnas thams cad spa 1 bkong bar mdzad nas/ rgyu skar gyi 'od dang / ri'i lha'i tshogs kyi 'od dang / gang du zla ba dang nyi ma 'di ltar mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che ba de dag gi 'od kyang spa (5bkong bar mdzad nas de rnams mi gsal zhing 'od med par gyur te rnam par snang bar mi 'gyur zhing spa bkong bar mdzad de nor bu dang sngags dang sman dang rin po che'i 'od thams cad med par byas nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhal gyi sgor nub par gyur to/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid na 'dus shing 'khod par gyur pa de stan las langs nas/ rings pa'i tshul gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal ldanas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni ji skad smras pa de bzhin du rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad kyi/ rgyu yod/ rkyen yod do/ /gang zhig mdo sde'i dbang po bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i cho ga rig pa'i spyod pa rjes su sgrub pa las sgrub par byed pa'i thabs la yang dag 93—761

par gzhol ba/ chos kyi sprin la brten cing yang dag par rjes su 'jug cing rjes su 'brang bar byed par 'gyur ba dang / 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang /klog par 'gyur ba dang / dad par 'gyur ba dang / glegs 91)bam du bri bar byas nas mchod par 'gyur ba dang / tsan+dan dang / phye ma dang / byug pa dang / bdug pa dang / phreng ba dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs pa'am/ sil snyan gyi rnam pa'i khyad par ram rol mo sna tshogs dang / pheg rdob pa dang / tha na rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgyun du thob pa'am/ spu zing zhes byed pa skye bar byed par 'gyur ba'am/rig pa'i mthu dang nus pa thos (2nas dga' ba skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ rjes su yi rang bar 'gyur ba'am/ spyod pa so sor sgrub par 'gyur ba de rnams ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te de rnams thams cad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir rgyal ba 'dzum pa mdzad kyis rirnam pa gzhan du ma yin no/ /dang po re zhig ri skadam tshig mthong ba/ sngon spyad pa rnams byas pa/ mngon par dbang bskur thob pas / rtog pa'i rgyal po 'di la rtsa ba'i rig pa'am/ snying po'am/ nye ba'i snying po'am/ gzhan gang yang rung ba'i sngags bzung nas yi ge gcig pa'am/ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin yang rung ste/ dgon pa chen por song nas lo bdun du bzlas pa bya ste/ 'bras bu dang / chu'i bza' ba dang / rtsa ba dang / 'dab ma bza' 5)zhing / sngon spyod pa rnams byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas ri'i rtse mor 'dzegs te ras ris kyi thu bo zhal nub du phyogs par bzhag nas/ bdag nyid shar du mngon par phyogs te/ ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug nas pad+ma 93—762

dkar po dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum gyis mngon par btags te/'bum phrag gcig bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos rnams kyi ras ris kyi 'og nas dbul bar bya'o/ /ga bur gyi bdug pa yang ji ltar 'byor pa bsreg 1)go/ /lha'i bu rnams la ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog gis 2mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas cho 'phrul gyi phyogs kyi dkar po'i nya'am/ nya so so la mtshan mo phyed kyi dus kyi tshe ras ris kyi spyan sngar me thab pad+ma'i rnam pa lta bu byas nas tsan+dan dkar po'i shing gi me sbar te/ gur gum dang ga pur gcig tu byas nas sreg ri )blugs ji ltar 'byor pas stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg byas te/ de nas bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa las 'od zer byung ste / ras ris kyi khor yug tu gcig tu 'bar bar gyur pa 'byung ngo / /de nas sgrub pa po tsan+dan dang / gur gum gyis btags pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i me tog gis mchod yon dbul lo/ /de nas sgrub pa pos rings pa'i tshul gyis ras ris la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal 4nas sngar sgrub pa pos bris pa'i ras mtha'i phyogs nas 'jigs pa med pas ras ris gzung (gebar bya'o/ /de nas bzung ba tsam gyis 'phur bar 'gyur te/ se gol gtogs pa tsam la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das te/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su (6)kun du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa me tog yang dag par skyes pa'i dbang gis 7rgyal po de bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston par byed pa dang / bskal 93—763

pa chen po stong du rga ba med pa dang / 'chi ba med par rol par 'gyur ro/ /bris sku gnas pa de nyid du sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs kyang shes so/ /zhing stong phrag kyang 'da' bar byed do/ /lus stong phrag ston par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu du ma yang dag par 'byin par byed par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ro/ /nges par byang chub la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes 915kyi rtsa ba'i cho ga bris sku rab 'byam 2las/ mchog gi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga /las kyi 'bras bu drug pa rdzogs so// //de nas yang sems dpa' chen pos thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 'dug pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag khyed cag nyon cig /las chen po dang bcas pa'i rig pa 'phags ma sgrol ma'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub par byed pa'i las kyi cho ga sgrub pa po srung ba'i don du gsang ba dam pa mchog gi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo gang gis bzlas na sngags thams cad bzlas par 'gyur ro/ /kye kye lha'i tshogs rnams 'di ni 'da' bar byed pa ma yin pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu'i dbang phyug kyang rig pa 'dis 'gugs shing / dbang du byed la yang dag par 'dod par 'gyur bar )byed na de las gzhan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten 93—764

las 'das pa 0)rnams smos ci dgos/ sngags thams cad dang bgegs thams cad 'joms par byed pa ste/ 'di ni brtson 'grus che ba dang / mthu che ba dang / gcig tu dpa' ba/ rig pa thams cad gcig kho nar sngags thams cad kyi mchog tu bshad pa dang / gcig kho na rig pa'i rgyal mo 'jigs pa chen po rnams las mchog tu bshad pa ste/ de gang zhe na/ las chen po thams cad byed pa/ don thams cad sgrub pa/ bya ba thams cad byed pa/ sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ gdug pa'i las rnams rgyananodang sdig pa thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa/ sngags thams cad so sor da rdzogs par byed pa/dge bar byed pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig pa dang /sngags thams cad kyi gong nas gong du rab tu 'jug pa/ thogs pa med pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po yang dag par gyur pa/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ de gang zhe na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+sā 4ba lo ki te shwa rā tshogaciya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 65ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā re tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ grogs po dag 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba dam pa las chen po thams cad byed pa/ rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo sems can thams cad kyis 7ri'ada' bar byed pa ma yin pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bkra shis pa/ rig pa dang sngags thams cad kyis bsgrubs pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rig pa'i dbang phyug thams cad kyi dbang phyug /rnam par sdang ba thams cad la byams pa'i bdag nyid/ skye bo rnams la snying brtse ba dang /bgegs thams cad rnam par 'joms par byed pa ste 8/ mdor na ji lta ji 93—765

ltar rab tu sbyar (1 ba de lta de ltar rab tu byed do/ /ma bsgrubs par yang las rnams byed do/ /rig pa bzlas nas gang la reg pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gos la mngon par bsngags genas gyon na skal (geb bzang por 'gyur ro/ /so shing la mngon par bsngags 54)te thos na so nad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /ka ra bī rilar dkar po la lan bdun mngon par bsngags (6rinas zos na don du ma gnyer bar yang kha zas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mig gi nad la rgyam tsha phye ri ramar byas pa la lan bdun mngon par bsngags 8nas mig bkang na mig nad sel bar byed do / /rna ba'i nad la glang po che'i rgyab nas 'thon pa 'brug sgrogs pa na 'byung ba'i tshi dh+ri 9ka /ka bu sha'i lo mar btums te me chung ngus btso bar bya'o/ /tshos nas phyir btsos pa byas la chu dro kha'ajam la rgyam tsha 11dang sbyar ba byas nas lan bdun mngon par bsngags 15te des rna ba dag par byas te skad cig de nyid la nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /bud med bu 'byung ba'i 12dus su mngal 'gags nas gzer bas zil gyis non par gyur na/ a ṭarlu ṣa ma'i rtsa ba srog chags med pa'i chu la btags nas lte ba'i phyogs su byugs na bde blag tu btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu zug rngus nyams pa'am/ mtshon nang du lus pa la mar rnying pa la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags 〉nas blud 8par bya ba'am/ de'i phyogs su byugs na/ de'i skad cig nyid la zug rngu med par 'gyur ro/ /ma zhu ba dang / gsud sapa dang / tshad pa'i nad la kha ru tsha / dang / rgyam tsha 4shedang / tshwa 19gzhan gang yang rung ba la mngon par bsngags dzu tshonas zos na/nad de las grol bar 'gyur te nyi ma de nyid la bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro(1/ /gtan nad kyi tshad pa'am/ 'phral gyi tshad pa la yang rung ste/ ma tu lung 93—766

ga'i rtsa ba btags nas srog chags med pa'i chu 'thung 91)du gzhug ste gnod pa med par de las grol bar 'gyur te(ge/ lan bdun bzlas pas sam/ gnyis bzlas pas so/ /bud med mo gsham mi skye ba'i chos rnams skye bar 'dod na a shwa gan+dha'i sa)rtsa ba'i mar dang lhan cig bskol tsho4)te ba'i 'o mas bsres te lan nyi shu rtsa lnga yongs su bzlas te/ zla mtshan gyi dus su 'thung 757du bcug nas khrus byas pa'i mthar skyes pa gzhan spang zhing khyim pa yang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa yongs su spangs na(6ci/ rang gi skyes pa'am/ rang gi bdag po'i bu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lo gsum mam/ lo lnga rab tu skyes pa'i dzo dus las lhag pa'am/lo du mar bu ma chags pa'am gzhan gyi sngags dang sman gyi phyag rgyas btab pa dang / gzhan gyis gdug par byas pa'am/ mngal 'dzin pa mi 'dzin par byas pa'am/ nad kun du langs pa'am/ sbyor (87ba gzhan kun du spangs pa'am/nad gzhan gang yang rung ba cung zad kyis yongs su mi 'dzin par byas pa'am/brtan pa dang / g.yo ba dang / bcos ma dang / bcos ma ma yin pa la sogs pa'i dug la sogs pa rab tu zhugs pa'am/ rtsa ba dang / sngags dang /sman dang / mdza' ba dang / mi mdza' ba'i sbyor ba byas pa la/ mar rnying pa dang / rma bya'i mdongs gcig tu byas nas btags la/ sha kha 79nor dang lhan cig sbyar te/ lan nyi shu rtsa bdun mngon par bsngags bonas/ a ru ra tsam bza' bar bya ste/ nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du sha kha 11ra dang ldan pa'i 'o ma bskol nya ba btung bar bya zhing yang dang yang du sngags 1 kyang bzlas so/ /klad pa na ba la bya rog gi gshog 14pa la lan bdun mngon par bsngags 7te des bya bas na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bud med la tsheches spyad pa la sogs pa'i 93—767

nad rnams la a lam bu sha'i (1)rtsa ba 'o ma dang lhan cig btags nas ni li ku'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa la brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon par bzlas nas 'o mas skyo mar sbyar nas btung bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du rims nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / rgyun pa dang / rtag pa'i rims dang / rims drag po la sogs pa rnams la 'o thug mar dang sbyar la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags (nate 'thung du bcug na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro / /de bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon gyis zin pa la/ bdag nyid kyi gdong la lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags ( rinas bltas na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ma mo dang / byis pa dang / srul po dang / ro langs dang / grul bum gyi gdon la sogs pa rnams dang / mi thams cad gdug pa can drag pos mngon par zin pa la bdag nyid kyi lag pa la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags 4༄te/ zin pa de'i mgo bo la reg na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig 95rabazlas pas bdag nyid srung ngo / /gnyis bzlas pas grogs po srung ngo / /gsum bzlas pas khyim srung ngo / /bzhi bzlas pas grong srung ngo / /lnga bzlas pas grong gi spyod yul du gyur pa srung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ji srid stong phrag gi bar du bzlas pas dmag gi tshogs srung ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di rnams sam gzhan yang las phra mo rnams ma bsgrubs par yang byed do/ /de nas sgrub par 'dod na phra mo'i las rnams mi bya bar mtha' gcig tu song nas dben pa'i phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung 'bab pa dang /rgya mtsho'i ngogs dang / gang gā'i tsho6 klung gi ngogs dang / gzhan yang chu klung chen po'i ngogs la brten nas/ phyogs gtsang ma phyag dar byas nas khrus lan 93—768

gsum bya zhing / gos lan gsum brjes te/ smra ba bcad/ slong mo'i kha zas za zhing / lo ma dang / nas zan dang / 'o ma dang 'bras bu za zhing 'bum phrag bcu gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong na/ de nas sgrub pa brtsam (1)par bya ste phyogs de nyid du ras ris thu bo der bzhag la/ ras ris la mchod pa chen po byas nas gser dngul gyi rang bzhin nam/ zangs dang sa'i rang bzhin gyi mar me'i snod/ tu ruṣ+ka'i (5)'bru mar gyis bkang ba'am/ dri zhim po'i ri 'bru mar gyis bkang ba'am/ ba'i mar gyis bkang ba'i mar me'i snod du ras gsar pa dum bu dum bur byas pa'i mar me 'bum phrag gcig ras ris la dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba rnams phul ma thag tu ras ris las 'od zer rnams byung ma thag tu ras ris kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bar 'gyur ro/ /steng gi bar snang la rnga bo che'i sgra sgrogs shing legs so zhes pa yang thos te/ de nas rig pa 'dzin pas rings pa'i tshul gyis ras ris kyi mtha'i zur du sgrub pa po sngar bris par ras ris la brten pa la mchod yon phul nas bskor 4ba byas te sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag byas la gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas bzung 5ba tsam gyis mar me 'dzin pa de rnams thams cad kyi lhan cig tu 'phur bar 'gyur ro/ /gcig gis lhag pa'i gzhal med khang brgyar yang 'gro bar byed do/ /lha'i sil snyan dang so sor yang dag par ldan pa dang / sgra snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sgrogs shing gar byed pa'i rig pa 'dzin ma de rnams kyis 'khor yug tu kun tu khyab par snang ba sgrub pa po rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po chen por dbang skur 6bar byed do/ /mar me 'dzin pa de rnams kyis lhan cig rga ba med cing 'chi ba med par rol par byed do/ /bskal pa chen por 93—769

gnas shing nyi ma 'char ka 'dra ba dang / lha'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa dang / rnam par bkra ba'i gos kyis brgyan (1pa/ de rnams dbang du byas nas mngag gzhug par 'gyur te/ de rnams dang lhan cig spyod par gyur te lha'i rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyang 'di'i bran nyid du nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po chen por 'gyur zhing ring du 'tsho zhing grub pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /skad cig tsam gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du mngon par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin gyis kyang 2)grangs su mi 'gro na de las gzhan pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis lta ci smos/ mthar yang 'dis ( risangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ro/ /las sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan yang yod de/ ches dka' thub byas pa/ de nas mtha' gcig tu song nas lhag par gnas te 'du 'dzi med cing 'du 'dzi dang bral ba'i dgon pa chen por zhugs nas/ gnas gang na pad+ma'i mtsho chen po dang / chu dang bcas pa/ ri bo gcig la brten pa'i ri bo de'i rtse mor 'dzegs te/ rig pa rnams kyi dri dang me tog la sogs pa phul nas de rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du/ 'o ma'am nas zan dang /pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu bza' zhing 'o ma las byung ba zos te rig pa 'bum phrag bcur bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar yang sngar bstan pa'i cho ga de nyid kyis 4ciras ris kyi thu bo bzhag 5nas/ pad+ma'i me tog la tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum gyis btags te seng ldeng gi shing gi me sbar nas sngar yongs su btags 56pa'i pad+mas stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug gis sbyin sreg 7)bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i ras ris las 'od zer 93—770

'byung ste/ des sgrub pa po kun du snang bar byas nas spyi bor nub par 'gyur ro//reg ma thag tu sgrub pa po mngon par shes pa lngar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa thob bo/ /lha'i gzugs kyis ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du rnam par rgyu ste/bskal pa sum cu rtsa drug tu 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing sum cu rtsa drug 'da' bar byed do/ /de rnams kyi mthu yang yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo glu/ /sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa drug mnyes par byed do/ /de rnams kyang mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bas mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar yang byang chub la mchog tu gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po 17dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin par 'gyur ro/ /ji srid byang chub tu mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar du'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen du brjes pa'i rtsa ba'i cho ga las/ las mchog sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga bdun pa'i le'u rab 'byam (2yongs su rdzogs so// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar yang sgrub pa'i las dmachog gsungs te/ rtog pa'i rgyal po 'di la rtsa ba'i rig pa'i sngags yongs su bzung nas gang gā'i 45klung du zhugs nas gru'i bzhon pa la rab tu gnas te/ gang gā'i riganodabus su 'o ma dang chu btung zhing / stong phrag sum cur ji ltar 'dod pa'i nyin zhag gi bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa'i mthar klu thams cad mthong ngo / /de nas sgrub pa brtsams te 6gru'i dbus de nyid du me thab pad+ma'i rnam pa bya'o/ /de nas nā 7rig ge sar la sogs pa'i me tog rnams kyis ras ris 93—771

la mchod pa chen po bya'o/ /ras ris kyi thu bo 17zhal nub tu phyogs par bzhag ste bdag nyid shar du mngon par phyogs te ku sha'i khres la 'dug nas/ nā du ga ge sar gyi me tog re re la lan bdun mngon par bsngags dpa byas nas seng ldeng gi shing gis me sbar 4te/ tsan dan dkar po dang gur gum bsres pa'i nā (5ga ge sar gyi me tog rnams kyis stong phrag bcu'i bar ji srid par sbyin sreg 56bya'o/ /gzhan klu rnams mthong ba na nye bar bcings pa'i dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams rab tu chags pas blang bar mi bya'o/ /gang las sbyin sreg gi mthar gru'i bzhon pa dang lhan cig 'phur bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 57 rnams kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal po thams cad kyang rjes su 'brang zhing bran bzhin du gnas so/ /bar gyi bskal pa sum cur 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /rang dbang du spyod par 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba la thogs pa med do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du mthong ste/ de'i spyi bo la reg par mdzad do / /reg pa tsam gyis mngon par shes pa lngar 'gyur ro/ /nges par sangs rgyas nyid du lhag par 'gro bar byed do/ /gzhan yang mchog gi sgrub pa'i cho ga'i sgrub thabs su 'gyur ba ni sngar bzhin du gang gā'i /klung du zhugs nas bil ba'i shing gi rang bzhin gyi 9shing gcig nyid kyis 1 gru'i bzhon pa byas nas shin tu brtan 11pa legs par byas pa der mngon par 'dzegs nas bil ba'i shing gi rang bzhin gyi skya 12ba des gru de'i rjes su sgrub pa po ches mkhas shing gsal ba nyid kyis g.yab par bya ste/ gang gā'i 1 klung chen po yongs su mi 1 dor bar kun nas thad ga'am rgyun rings su g.yab par bya'o/ /de nas rtsa ba'i rig pa bzung lonas sam / snying po'am/ nye ba'i snying po'am/ yi ge gcig pa'am/ khro bo'am/93—772

pho nya'am/ ring du rjes su 'brang ba'am/ gzhan gang yang rung ba'i sngags bzung nas ras ris kyi thu bo de nyid du/ zhal nub tu phyogs par bzhag nas bdag nyid dang po zhal shar du phyogs la/ phyis ni ji ltar 'dod par bya'o/ /'o ma dang / nas zan dang / 'bras bu bza' ba'am/ chu'am/ pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu bza' zhing / smra ba bcad de/ dus gsum du khrus bya zhing / gos lan gsum brjes te/ shin tu dkar ba'i las kun du spyod cing shin tu dkar ba'i blo dang ldan pas dang po re zhig (17ras ris kyi spyan sngar ji ltar nye bar bstan pa bzhin du sngar cho ga mthong bas rig pa 'bum phrag bcu bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gal te rtsa ba'i rig par 'gyur ro/ /de nas stong phrag drug cu bzlas pa'i mthar gru rgya mtsho chen por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa'i yo byad rnams bsdus te sngar gnas de nyid du gzhag dpar bya'o/ /de nas gru'i bzhon pa rgya mtsho chen por 'gro ba na/ 'jigs par mi bya zhing / bzlog par mi bya'o/ /sgrub pa po'i dbang las ma gtogs par bzlog par nus pa yang ma yin no/ /de nas dpag tshad stong du gnas pa'i rgya mtsho chen por yang yud tsam gyis 'jug par byed do/ /lam thung na lta ci smos/ der zhugs nas chu'i steng du sgrub pa'i las brtsam 5par bya'o/ /de nas me thab sngar gyi rnam pa'am rdza mkhan gyis byas pa'i sa'i snod du seng ldeng gi me sbar la nā cag ge sar gyi ze 'bru dang / me tog tsan+dan dkar po dang / ga pur dang bsres pa'i sreg rablugs ches nyung ba'am/ ches mang ba'i tshad kyang rung ste/ sngar bzhin du rtsa ba'i rig pas 'bum phrag drug cu sbyin sreg 6bya'o/ /sbyin sreg byed pa na/ lang ma'i grong na gnas pa'i srin po gzugs sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams hā hā zhes sgrogs pa dang /93—773

klu'i grong longs spyod ldan na gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'chang ba/ ches zhi ba dang / ches khro ba rnams langs te klu dang srin po rnams kyang 'di skad ces smra'o/ /khyed bzhengs shig 0)bzhengs shigs /bdag cag gi rje bo mdzod cig ces so/ /de bzhin du lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang lha dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grub pa dang / mi ma yin pa thams cad kyang rab tu chags par byed mod kyi ldang bar mi bya'o/ /de nas rig pa 'dzin pas sngags bzla zhing lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub (8)kyis bsdigs par bya'o / /de nas rnam par byol (4)zhing phan tshun rab tu 'bros la 'jigs par byed do/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi mthar gru des sgrub pa po de khyer nas skad cig la 'og min gyi gnas su 'gro bar byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du'ang 5ri'agro zhing 'ong bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems shes par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa lnga dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / mthu chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /klu thams cad dang / srin po thams cad dang / gnod sbyin thams cad dang / lha thams cad dang / lha ma yin thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyang 'di'i dbang du 'gyur te/ bka' bzhin byed pa la bzhag nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos rnams 'di'i sngags grub pa de rnams kyang 'di la byams pa'i bdag nyid du 'gyur ro/ /rjes su 'dod par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang las kyi cho ga mchog sgrub thabs su 'gyur ba ni bil ba'i shing la gru bo che'i bzhon pa byed du gzhug ste/93—774

shing gcig gi bzhon pa'am/ bsdus pa'ang rung ste gnas chen po bya'o/ / gang gā'i 6)dbus kyi gling der gnas pa'i gru'i bzhon par skyes bu brgya nyi shu lag na sgron me thogs pa rnams gru'i bzhon pa la 'dzegs te gos dkar po gyon zhing srung ba byas pa ras ris kyi thu bo sngar gyi cho gas kun du bzhag pa'i spyan sngar gzhag (5)par bya'o/ /de nas ras ris la mchod pa chen po byas nas nā ga ge sar gyi phye ma rnams dang gur gum dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang / ga pur bsres pa dang / seng ldeng gi sreg dzo ciblugs stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug sbyin sreg (5bya'o / /de nas sbyin sreg gi mthar gru de skad cig tsam gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du 'gro zhing 'ong bar 'gyur te ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du rnam par rgyu'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong bar byed do/ /mthong ba tsam las thob par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa lnga dang yun ring du 'tsho zhing bskal pa chen por gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur dziba'i rgyal po chen por 'gyur ro/ /mar me 'dzin pa de rnams kyang 'di'i rig pa 'dzin pa grub par 'gyur ro/ /lhan cig spyod pa de rnams dang / thabs cig 7tu ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du rnam par rgyu zhing / rang dgar 'gro bar 'gyur ro//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur gyis mngon par dgyes par 'gyur ro/ /mthar yang sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang las kyi cho ga'i sgrub thabs dam par gyur pa ni/ chu klung 'gram mam rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ /de bzhin kha ba can gyi rir/ /ri yi 8rgyal po 'bigs byed de/ /der ni las mchog bsgrub 9)par bya/ /sa h+ye ma la ya nyid dang / /ri bo spos kyi ngad ldang dang / /bya rgod phung po'i ri rgyal du/ /las kyi mchog ni 93—775

bsgrub par bya/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i brag dang ni/ /shing sogs me tog ldan pa ste / /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /phyogs 'di rnams su bsgrub par bya/ /rnam par dben pa'i phyogs gtsang ma/ /bas mtha'i 1)grong gi (michos bzhi la/ /mi smra reg pa spangs nas ni/ /rtag tu gci ba bya ba yin/ /lus la lha dganas bshang ba dang / /brtul zhugs can dag gtsang sbra bya/ /reg na gzhon sha can rnams 'dod/ /srog chags spangs pa'i sa rnams ni/ /gsum po tshul cabazhin blangs nas ni/ /rtag pa kho nar bshang lam la'o/ /de bzhin gnyis ma'i mthar rilag pa/ /sngags pas rtag tu sa dag ni/ /sngar bstan ⑥pa dag blangs nas ni/ /zlos pos 7༄rtag tu rkang pa nyid/ /g.yas dang de las gzhan pa ni/ /phan tshun nyid du kun bzhag nas/ /'bad pas rkang pa bkru bar bya/ /rgya cher sngar ni brjod pa bzhin/ /sngags zlos po yi gtsang sbra yang / /dri dang med pa'i gtsang sbra ste/ /rtag tu thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /'di dag mdor bsdus bstan pa yin/ /rgyud rnams kun du mthong ngo zhes/ /mnga' bdag thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /de nas zlos pos nye reg bya/ /sdom brtson dngos grub las la dga'/ /sngar brjod pa yi cho ga yis/ /yid kyi nang gi dag pa yin/ /gtsang sbra rnam pa lnga ru brjod/ /sngags pas sngags rnams thams cad du/ /lus kyi gtsang sbra de bzhin du/ /ngag yid kho nar rab tu bsgrags/ /bzhi pa bden pa'i gtsang sbra ste/ /chu ni lnga par brjod par bya/ /bden pa'i chos ni khro ba thul/ /rgyud shes bstan bcos mthong ba dang / /phra mo'i de nyid don la mkhas/ /sngags shes las la grags pa dang / /rgyu yis nang la mkhas pa ste / /de la dngos grub rnyed mi dka'/ /bden pa'i chos ni rnam spangs pa'i/ /93—776

brdzun pa'i tshig ni smra mi bya/ /bden pa thams cad rnam spangs pa'i/ /ma rungs rab tu ma rungs nyid/ /rnam par sdang 1dang 'khrugs bcas dang / /rtsub cing gnad ni 'gems pa dang / /bden pa'i chos ni rnam par nyams/ /sems can gzhan la gdung bar byed/ /phra ma nyon mongs can sems dang / /chos rnams thams cad spangs pa dang / /de bzhin 'tshe ba'i bdag nyid can/ /rtag tu khrims 'chal chos min spyod/ /sngags zlos pa yis spang bar bya/ /de bzhin nyid du grong 25gi chos/ /khro ba brnab sems 'byung ba yi/ /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa rnams/ /blo ldan rang rgyal bse ru dang / /slar yang rtag tu nyon mongs dang / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis smad/ /de bzhin rtag tu brdzun smra ba/ /'jig rten dngos grub 'dod don gnyer/ /sa stengs brdzun smra nye bar smra/ /mi bzad dmyal ba chen por ltung / /sngon gyis nyes pa las de bzhin / /dga' bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten du/ /rtag tu slar yang der gnas so / /rtag tu brdzun smras nyer 'tsho ba/ /mi bzad ngan 'gror ltung bar 'gyur / /thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang / /yang sos ral gri lo ma dang / /de bzhin shal ma li yi nags/ /der ni bskal pa mang por gnas/ /brdzun du smra ba'i skye bo ni/ /gsang sngags log par smra ba dang / /rmongs pas log par brjod pa yi/ /'byung po rnams la slu byed pa/ /de la grub pa ga la yod/ /de phyir rmongs pa las 'di yis / /sngags kyi dngos grub ma mthong nas/ /sngags pa'i dngos grub med do zhes/ /'di skad du ni tshig smra ba/ /gang gis sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /sa stengs 'dir ni rab spangs pa/ /bskal pa bye ba mang po yis / /de yis grub par ga la 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di ni mi bzad pa'i/ /93—777

'jigs chen mnar med 'tshed par 'gyur/ /yang sos dang ni thig nag dang / /rab tu tsha bar 1 'tshed pa dang 92/ /sems can sdig sbrul la sogs pa(ge/ /spangs pa'i sa phyogs 'dod par bya/ /'bras bu me tog yang dag ldan/ /dri med chu ni rab bsngags la pa/ /sngags rig pas ni sngags bsnyen bya/ /yul gzhan rnams su bsgrags mi bya/ /lha yi gnas sam dur khrod dam/ /brtan pa'i mtshan rim gcig pa dang / /rtags gcig de bzhin bas mtha' (7ru/ /sngags rig sngags ni bsnyen pa bya/ /bdag dang grogs rnams bsrung (7)byas nas//sngar spyad gsang sngags ldan pa dang / /sngags pas rtag tu sngags bzlas bya/ /dgon pa che mchog shing chen dang / /me tog 'bras bu la sogs 'byung / /ri yi rtse dang khung bu dang / / chu yi na gnas ni gtsang mar bcas/ /'bab chu che 'gram yid 'ong bar/ /sngags rig pas ni sngags bsnyen bya/ /sngags shes nas ni nges rtogs byed/ /shar phyogs su yang chu klung che/ /lu hi ta 'gram dge ba dang / /de bzhin kā ma ru pa'i yul/ /grong mchog 'phel bar byed pa dang / /dma' ba gang du 'di 'gro mchog /'dug pa dang ni chu klung mchog /gnas der rtag tu zlos 9pa dang / /gtsang ma blo gros ldan pas bstenate/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'ang der gyis shig /gang gā'i 11sgo ru las rnams kun/ /de bzhin rtag tu gang gā 1 dang / /dug can pa ni phrad pa ru/ /rab tu sbyor ba kun nyid dang / /gtsang ma'i sngags kyis bzlas pa bya/ /dur khrod che dang gzhan nyid ni//zlos pos der ni rtag tu bzlas/ /dri med chu dang 'bab chu ni/ /srog chags rnams kyis spangs pa ru/ /de nyid phyir ni shin tu ni/ /mnyam gzhag 6)sngags kyis bzlas pa bya/ /der ni 'jig rten bsam pa yi/ /bsod nams min pa 93—778

cung zad mthong / /'on kyang sngags kyis nyer bstan pas/ /cung 1zad dus su 'dug par bya/ /de nas gzhan du 'gro bar bya/ /zla ba gzas zin dus der ni / /dus ma bab na'ang dus cung zad/ /der 'dug bya yi gzhan du min/ /gzhan du sngags rig ci nus pas/ /de nas myur du 'gro bar bya/ /bde gshegs mchod rten bzhugs pa yi/ /sa stengs tshonarnams su kun du 'dug /'jig rten mu stegs thams cad ni/ /lta ba ngan par lhung ba rnams/ /mu stegs can gzhan gnas rnams ni/ /sngags rig pas ni rtag tu spangs / /sngags shes der ni mi bsdad cado/ /skyes mchog blo gros rgyu ngan pa/ /rgyal ba mchog gis (5rigang bzhugs dang / /rang rgyal bse ru lta bu dang / /byang chub sems dpa' skal ba (6)che/ /rgyal mchog sras po nyan thos rnams/ /de rnams kun bzhugs sa stengs kyi(7༄/ /yul rnams kun du sngags shes pas/ /'bad pas sngon du bsnyen pa bya/ /mnyam par gzhag 85pas gsang sngags ni/ /gnas de ru ni bzlas par bya/ /gsungs pa'i gnas ni 'di rnams su/ /gsungs pa'i las rnams thams cad dang / /las kyi cho ga'i sgrub thabs rnams/ /'di rnams rnyed par ma gyur na/ /gang yang rung ba'i gnas der ni/ /gtsang mas sngon du bsnyen pa bya/ /dad cing mos pas sgrub thabs kyi/ /cho ga mchog gi las brtsam mo/ /dang po re zhig9ri /bris sku'i thu bo zhal nub tu bstan nas bzhag ste / bdag nyid shar du mngon par phyogs la grog mkhar gyi sa'am/ gang gā'i 9klung gi 'gram gyis blangs nas pu shel tse 11dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang / gur gum dang / ga pur rnams bsres la rma bya'i gzugs byas te/ de bris sku'i spyan sngar bzhag nas rtse mo ma bcad pa'i ku sha gtsang ma'i phyogs nas byung bas 903—779

'khor lo'i rnam pa byas nas bris sku'i spyan sngar lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/lag pa g.yon pas ni rma bya'o/ /dkar po'i zla ba nya ba'i mtshan phyed na bris sku la mchod pa chen po byas nas ga pur gyi 17bdug pa bsregs pa'i dri dang ji srid nam langs pa'i bar de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma 'char ba'i dus kyi tshe de rma bya'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo yang 'bar ro/ /bdag nyid lha'i phreng ba dang gos 'chang zhing rnam par brgyan na pa dang / nyi ma 'char ka 'dra bar 'dod pa'i gzugs can du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas te ras ris la bskor ba byas la ras ris blangs nas rma bya'i gdan de la 'dug na yud tsam gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las 'da' bar byed do/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba'i rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ bskal pa drug cu'i bar du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar 'dod par 'gro zhing / rab tu spyod par 'gyur ro/ /thogs pa med par 'gro'o/ /lha'i phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid 'di'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ro/ /mthar yang sangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dbyig pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / mchod phyir thogs dang / ldong ros dang / gi wang dang /ral gri dang / lcags mda' dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / dgra sta dang /mtshon cha'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ sa'i rang bzhin gyi khyad par dang /rkang gnyis pa dang / rkang bzhi pa dang / bya dang / bzhon pa'i khyad par seng ge dang / stag dang / gzig 4)la sogs pa rnams grog mkhar gyi sa dri 93—780

zhim po'i dri zhim bsres pa las byas pa'am/ stan dang / bzhon pa dang /mal cha dang / gdugs dkar po dang / cod pan dang / rgyan gyi bye brag thams cad dang / rin po che'i bye brag thams cad dang / rab tu byung ba'i yo byad kyi bye brag thams cad la bgrang phreng dang / mchil 91lham dang / lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / khab dang / gri la sogs pa rgyal gyi lcags las byas pa'am/ gzhan yang gang (2)cung zad sems can gyi yo byad snod la sogs pa rgyal gyi lcags las byas pa'am/ grog mkhar gyi sa'am/ chu klung gi sa las byas pa de thams cad pa'i rnam lngas bkrus nas mngon par bsang cagator byas te snga ma bzhin du sbyor 5ba'i sngags sam/ yi ge gcig pa'i sngags sam/sngags gzhan gang yang rung ba brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags tshopa byas nas rtog pa'i rgyal po 'dir gsungs pa ma gtogs pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'i rig pa ji ltar 'dod pa dang / ji ltar mngon par dga' bas bdag nyid srung zhing grogs po yongs su bskyab 7par byas pa/ shin tu gsang thub cing sngags dang rgyud shes pa/sngar bstan pa'i gnas su bris sku zhal nub tu bstan la bzhag ste bdag nyid sngar bzhin du'o/ /bris sku la mchod pa chen po byas nas gtso bor ga pur gyi bdug pa bsregs te sngar bstan pa'i mtshon cha dang yo byad dang sems can gyi khyad par 8rnams sngar bstan pa'i bcos mar byas la/ yar ngo'i zla ba nya ba'i mtshan mo rdzas de rnams gang rung blangs te mtshan mo ji srid du bzlas pa byas na nyi ma 'char ba'i dus kyi tshe bar skabs 'dir bris sku la 'od zer gyi phreng ba chen po kun du mthong ngo / /gal te sgrub pa po bzhon 9pa'i khyad par blangs par gyur na/de la zhon tshanas ji ltar 'dod par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te rgyan gyi khyad 93—781

par ram/ mtshon cha'i khyad par blangs pa'am/ bcangs (1)pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po chen por 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin tshon 'gro zhing / lha'i lus can nyi ma shar ba dang mtshungs pa 'od zer chen po'i phreng ba dang ldan pa glog ltar gsal ba'i sku/ rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /ring du 'tsho zhing bskal pa chen por gnas pa rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor lha'i nor bu rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na spyod pa / sngar yongs su brtags pa'i sa'i ci rirang bzhin gyi bzhin 4pa gang gis grub gcipa de nyid mthu chen por 'gyur te/ de nyid 'di'i bzhon pa dang / de nyid 'di'i grogs po ste/ gzhan gyi sngags kyi dngos grub bzlog par gyur pa bdag gi sngags kyi dngos grub kun tu sbyar bar byas pa/ byams pa'i bdag nyid can/phan par 'dod pa rtag tu rjes su bcings pa/ de nyid 'di'i mtshon cha dang /rgyan dang / rin po che'i bye brag dang / stan dang / mal cha dang / sems can la sogs pa gang yin pa de nyid 'di'i bsrung 6ba dang / bskyab pa dang /sba ba chen po rtag tu rjes su 'brel bar 'gyur ro/ /mthu chen po dang brtson 'grus chen po dang / lus chen por 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du mthong zhing legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste spyi bor byugs nas ji srid byang chub snying po rjes su thob kyi bar du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad de/stobs bcu po rnams nges par kun nas thob ste mchod pa'i 'os su'ang 'gyur ro / /sems can rnams kyis zil gyis mi non pa dang / 'byung po (7thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i mtha'i rigs rgyun mi gcod pa dang / sa thob par yang 'gyur ro/ /stobs bcu dang byang chub sems dpa' 93—782

nyid du nges pa dang ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro93)/ /mdor bsdus nas (snyelas mchog thams cad dang / gnas mchog la gnas pas ras ris mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa mchog la mngon par dga' bas las mchog gzhan nyid bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa nyid nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / sa rjes su thob par byed pa nyid dang / lus 'di nyid kyis 'jig rten gyi khams su tsho dikun du 'gro ba nyid dang / stobs bcu'i rgyud yongs su rdzogs par byed pa nyid kyi phyir dang /'phags pa byams pa mngon sum du mthong ba nyid kyi phyir dang / chos bstan pa don yod pa nyid kyi phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi gcod pa nyid kyi phyir dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun du gnon cing rjes su thob par byed pa nyid kyi phyir dang / chos kyi sprin rnam par 'byor pa la rjes su 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir dang / nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba med cing bdud rtsi'i char gyi rgyun gyis rab tu zhi ba nyid kyi phyir dang / 'jig rten rjes su 'dzin pa la rab tu 'jug cing nan tan byed pa nyid kyi phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi tshul srung ba nyid kyi phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung don yod par byed pa nyid kyi phyir dang / sngags kyi spyod pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga rab tu sgom pa nyid kyi phyir dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos bdag nyid chen po rnams 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ rtog pa'i rgyal po 'di bsgrub par bya ste/sngags kyi mthu (4rab 'byam 55)dang ldan pa ras ris thu bo spyan snga dang nye bar 'dug nas 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi (393—783

sngags kyi cho ga dang / rgyud thams cad du rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i lam ste/mdor na 'dir rtog pa gzhan du gsungs tsho1)pa'i las rnams kyis kyang ras ris kyi rgyal po 'di bsgrub par bya ste/ myur du de rnams kyi dngos grub tu 'gyur te gang ngas bstan pa de dag gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brjes (nasakyi rtsa ba'i cho ga las/ ras ris mchog gi sgrub pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas da slar yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de la gzigs nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po la bka' stsal pa/sems dpa' chen po khyod kyi ras ris kyi cho ga bar ma'i las kyi ( nocho ga'i sgrub thabs bar ma yod do/ /de mdor bsdus nas bshad par bya yis45ri/ legs par yid la gyis shig dang bshad par bya'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ston pa 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can/ sems can thams cad la phan par dgyes pa/ bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i don dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams la gzigs nas gang de'i dus la bab par dgongs na de gsung du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di 6skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /dang po re zhig (7)tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs dang /93—784

gtsang sbra'i kun du spyod pa dang / nges par sdom pa dang / bzlas pa dang /sbyin sreg dang / bsam gtan dang / cho ga dang / gang du rab tu gnas pa ste / sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa sgrub pa'i las 'bras bu dang bcas shing don med par mi 'gyur ba dang / sngags thams cad kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ba de gang zhe na/ de ngas bshad kyis tsho1sems dpa' chen po nyon cig /dang po re zhig rinasarig pa'i brtul zhugs dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blang ba dang po nyid du yang dag par blangs te/ dang po re zhig 57dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis nye bar bstan pa'i dam tshig la yang dag par rjes su 'jug par bya'o/ /khyod kyis rtog pa'i rgyal po gsungs pa/ sngar nges par bstan pa gsal ba/ yid gzhungs pa dang ldan pa/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba thob pa/ khyod kyis bstan pa'i cho ga shes pa/ mkhas pa/ gsal ba/chos dang ldan pa/ bden par smra ba/ spro ba che ba/ byas pa gzo ba/ brtan pa / sems bzang ba/ ha cang mi rgan cing ha cang mi gzhon pa/ rnyed pa dang / bkur snyi thams cad la 'dod pa med pa/ tshangs par spyod pa/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ rnyed pa tsam gyis sam longs spyod rgyur ram/ rjes su chags pa'i rgyur yang brdzun mi smra na/ shin tu chung ngu tsam nyid dang / rnyed pa dang /rmongs pa'i rnam pa lta casmos/ dam bcas pa brtan pa dang / 'byung po thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du snying brtse ba dang ldan pa dang / sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang / sngar spyad pa byas pa khyod kyi 5gsang ba'i rig pa dang / sngags rjes su zlos pa dang / rig pa sngon du bsnyen pa byas pa khyod kyi dkyil 'khor du yang dag par zhugs pa/ 'jig rten shes pa/ yang dag par rjes su 'dzin par byed pa/93—785

'bras bu dang ldan zhing mkhas pa/ legs pa la rab tu zhugs pa/ mi 'jigs shing mi gnod la/ chags pa med pa/ dpa' (1)ba/ brtson 'grus brtan pa/nad med pa ste/ nad gang gis las su mi rung ba'i ngang tshul can dang /rigs che zhing mtho bar rab tu skyes pa zhes pa/ yon tan 'di rnams dang ldan pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon du 'gyur te/ sgrub pa po yang de dang 'dra ba'am / yan lag cung zad ma rdzogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon la mchod pa byas nas 'di'i dun)don du gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rig pa dang sngags dang bcom ldan 'das ma de'i dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig la rjes su 'jug par 'tshal na bdag cag la rjes su brtse ba'i don dang / phan pa'i thugs bskyed nas de slob dpon gyis gsung du gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis sngar bstan pa'i cho gas slob ma ji lta ba bzhin rim gyis brtags nas gzhug (8)par bya zhing sngar bzhin du mngon par dbang bskur ba byin nas rig pa dang sngags byin la rim pa ji lta bar dam tshig bstan par bya'o/ /gsang chen dang / phyag rgya dang / rgyud dang / sngags dang las rnams kyang dus ring mo nyid nas yongs su brtags ri te/ bsam pa shes nas rgyud dang sngags la sogs pa dang / las rnams thams cad bstan par bya'o/ /gzhan du ma yin no zhes pa'i cho ga 'di rab tu bsgrags so/ /de nas slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon la ji ltar nus pas gang gis slob dpon dgyes pa'am bdag nyid dang longs spyod kyang dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon des bu'i 'du shes nye bar gzhag 5par bya'o/ /bu bzhin du bskyang bar bya'o/ /ma bzhin longs spyod 93—786

kyis nye bar bsdu bar bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa 1)po des rig pa dang sngags gang yang rung ba zhig bzung nas mtha' gcig tu song ste/ sngar bstan pa'i gnas rgya cher gong ma bzhin du sbyar bas rig pa la sogs pa de rnams nyid kyis spyan drang ba dang / gshegs su gsol ba dang / mar me dang / dri dang / bdug pa dang / gtor ma dang / lha bshos dag dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa'i cho ga nyid kyis rgyas par byas te spyan drangs nas gdan phul ba thun mtshams gsum du khrus gsum bya zhing gos lan gsum brjes te nyi ma so so la bzlas pa bya'o/ /de la thun mtshams 2kyi dus zhes bya ba ni mtshan mo'i mtha' nas brtsams te ji srid nyi ma 'char ba'i dus tsam gyi bar 'di la dang por bshad do/ /nyi ma gung ni nyi ma shar ba'i mthar dus tsam gyi tshad kyi mtshams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la yang dag par brten pa ni cho ga shes pas gung gi thun mtshams risu shes par bya'o / /nub pa'i dus su yang lhag ma bzhi cha tsam thun mtshams gsum par brjod par bya'o/ /slob dpon mkhas pa bshes gnyen 4can/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs yang dag ldan/ /chen po'i rigs su 'khrungs pa dang / /kun nas brtson 'grus brtan pa ni/ /sngags dang rgyud sogs yang dag ldan/ /bya ba kun la blo gros byang 5/ /phra zhing mkhas la tshad shes pa/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rtag tu 'dzin/ /spro ba che zhing gzi brjid ldan/ /'jig rten chos la ltos pa med / /thub pa mchog gi chos la dad/ /'jig rten pa rnams dor ba dang / /bzlas pa bya zhing nernam dben byas/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rjes brten pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gsang sngags shes / /de las gzhan pa'i rkyen rnams mthong //sangs rgyas kyis gsungs gsang sngags dang / /'jig rten pa yi rab sbyor shes/ /93—787

srung ba byas shing mthu brtan pa/ /gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la rtag dga'/ /sangs rgyas nye bstan lam la ni/ /kun nas rjes su 'jug pa dang / /gsang sngags rgyal bas gsungs pa yin/ /gsang sngags zlos la rtag tu brtson/ /rtag tu mthong chos 'bras bu dang / /'jig rten pha rol de bzhin nyid/ /sdig pa kun la 'jigs pa dang / /phra mo tsam la'ang de bzhin no/ /gtsang zhing mkhas la le lo med/ /yid gzhungs blta 1)na sdug pa dang / /stobs bcu pas bshad sngags gang dang / /de bzhin kho nar rgyal sras dang / /'jig rten pa yi sngags gang nyid/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs dag la'ang / /de la rtag tu ngal bar byas/ /gzhung dang bstan bcos don 'dzin pa/ /nad med nus pa med min pa/ /rga dang nad ni rnam par spangs/ /de bzhin bshes gnyen 92༄can sngags grub/ /kun nas myur du byed pa dang / /mtha' yi ring min zhing de bzhin/ /tshangs par spyod cing shes rab che/ /khyad par du ni shes pa dang / /gcig tu 'du 'dzi med pa dang / /dpa' zhing dbang bskur thob pa dang / /de 'dir byang chub pha rol son/ /srid pa zhi bar byed la brtson/ /de bzhin nyid du rig 9 risngags bya / /mthu chen 'jig rten shes pa dang / /'gro ba sems can rjes sems pa/ /dpal nyid dang ni rab tu ldan/ /sbyin dang 'byung po phan la dga' / /de bzhin khyad 'phags slob dpon la/ /rtag tu gsol ba gdab par bya / /des ni dkyil 'khor bris pa yi/ /sngags kyi dngos grub ster bar byed/ /de nyid kyis ni dbang bskur gyis5ri/ /'bras bu chen po sbyin par 'gyur/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i slob mas kyang / /thub pa bzhin du rtag tu mchod/ /de yi gsung ni mi 'gom pa/ /slob mas 'bad pas bya ba yin/ /ji ltar 'byor 93—788

cing bdog pa yi/ /longs spyod de la dbul bar bya/ /nyung ngu tsam mam mang yang rung / /gang gis 1rimanyes par 'gyur ba dang / /lus ni 'tsho ba'i rgyu yi phyir / /pha (gel nor ni ster ba ltar/ /de bzhin slob ma chos shes pas/ /slob dpon la ni nor dbul bya/ / mtha' yi nanodabang phyug dngos grub thob/ /tshe dang de bzhin nad med dang / /rgyas pa'i 'gro ba thob par 'gyur/ /slob mas bla ma de mchod na/ /de yi sngags rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /lam dang cho ga nyer mthong dang / /bsnyen pa las kyang brten pa las/ /de bzhin ri mor byas mchod las/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rgyal mchog sras rnams dang / /lha rnams thams cad dgyes par 'gyur/ /bla ma rtag tu bsnyen bkur na/ /bla ma sngags rnams mthong ba yis / /'di dag thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /sgrub pos sngon 5nodang thog mar ni/ /dam tshig la ni rjes 'jug bya/ /dman nam 965de dag mnyam yang rung / /gal te ches mchog gyur pa yang / /rmongs pa'am lhag par khro ba yis/ /rtag tu bla ma brnyas mi bya/ /des kyang rgyud 'dir de la ni/ /man ngag rtag tu sbyin par bya/ /gang tshe sngags kyi dngos grub byin/ /'dis ni ser sna byas pa min/ /sngar bstan slob ma de la ni/ /man ngag rtag tu sbyin par bya/ /gang tshe sngags kyi dngos grub byin/ /lus can zhen pa 'phel byed pa'i/ /mig ni gang la yod gyur pa/ /de nyid slob ma nyid bya'o/ /slob dpon nam 7ni slob ma'i rgyur/ /phan tshun rjes su 'jug byed pa/ /gang du zhen pa'i rgyun skyong ba/ /'jam po'i rgyun ni 'dzin pa ste/ /de la sngags ni sbyin par bya/ /slob dpon de bzhin slob ma ni/ /slob ma bla mar mthong ba la/ /rtag tu spro bar 'gyur ba'am/ /gnyis gas 93—789

dngos grub yang dag 'byor/ /de la rtag tu lam nyid dang / /sngags kyi spyod pa rjes bstan bya/ /gnyis gas pha dang bur shes pas/ /sngags ni 'bras bcas rjes 'jug pa/ /brtan dang dga' ba de bzhin thob/ /rtag tu slob mas bla ma ni / /rab tu 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /bu ni bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /sangs rgyas chos rgyun mi 'chad 'gyur/ /de med mgon med de rnams la/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i sngags rnams sbyin/ /sems can bkren dang ma ning la'ang / /thams cad la ni khyad par du/ /1nisngags kyi spyod pa khyad par 'phags/ /tha ma mchog dang bar ma la/ /dus rnams kun tu bya ba'o/ /yongs su thob pa'i chos rnams la/ /rjes su gzung ba'i rgyun bya'o/ /'gro ba blo gros nges pa yi/ /'dod pa rnams la'ang rab sbyin bya/ /de phyir ji ltar 'dod pa'i sngags/ /slob ma nyid kyis blang bar bya/ /de nyid kyis ni nyer bstan pas/ /lam nyid yin no gzhan du min/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gang de la/ /pha ni pha rol song ba na/ /pha bzhin mgo bos phyag byas te/ /de nas ji ltar 'dod par 'gro/ /de nas 'dir ni song nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag 2pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /slong mo slong ba'i rjes 'jug cing / /smra ba bcad de dus gsum bzlas/ /de ltar bstan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /ji lta'i lam la rab 'jug pa/ /de tshe rnam 'gyur de gcod pa/ /khang stong dang ni dgon pa che/ /ri bo che dang chu klung ngogs / /gtsang dang ba lang gnas mtsho chen/ /rnam dben skye bo spangs pa bsten / /lha khang dang ni shing drung dang / /mtshan gcig ri ni mthon po dang / /rgya mtsho che 'gram nyams dga' dang / /chu gling ngam ni gling rnams dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sngar bstan pa'i/ /yul rnams sna tshogs yid 'ong ba/ /'di 93—790

rnams las kyang phyogs gzhan du/ /mnyam par bzhag ga1pas sngags bzlas bya/ /grogs po mtshan nyid ldan pa ni/ /sngags don nges pa'i rtog ge pa/ /ltas ni rnam pa de nyid shes/ /dpa' zhing g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /snying stobs ldan zhing bzod pa can/ /dad dang tshul khrims phun tshogs ldan/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i yul 'dir ni/ /rab bsngags mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ /bzod dang ldan pa'i grogs po yis/ /'bad pa med par nyid kyis 25ni/ /las rnams rgyal ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /tho rangs mal nas langs nas ni/ /'bab chu mtsho chen las byung ba'i/ /srog chags med cing dri ma med/ /chu de nyid la khrus byas nas/ /sa dang ba byung phye ma yis na/ /sngags shes lus ni dril phyis bya//de nas sngags kyis sbyang byas pa'i/ /chu nyid shin tu dri med la/ /zlos po brtson pas khrus bya'o/ /ha cang yun ring 45khrus mi bya/ /de nas langs la lag pa dag /sa dag gis kyang bkru bar bya/ /bdun dang bdun dang yang lan bdun/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig nye reg bya/ /yang der so 5shing kun du spyad/ /so sbyangs nas ni dor bar bya/ /de nas skyob la phyag byas shing 6/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag byas nas/ /sngags rig mchod pa yid 'ong bya/ /bya ba sna tshogs bstod mchod kyis / /yang dang yang du yang dag bstod/ /de bzhin dri zhim me tog gis/ /ston pa skyob la mchod yon dbul/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mgos phyag byas/ /de tshe slob mar gyur pa rnams/ /'jig rten mgon po de rnams kyi/ /spyan snga nyid du sdig pa bshags/ /bdag nyid dag kyang phul byas nas/ /ras ris spyan sngar 'khod par bya/ /ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug /sngags rig gnyis ka 'dug nas ni/ /mtshan nyid ji lta ba bzhin te/ /der ni bgrang phreng nyid 93—791

kyis ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas bzlas pa bya/ /de tshe sngags gzhan mi bzlas so/ /cho ga dman pa yang spang zhing / /ha cang mchog kyang de bzhin no/ /bar ma bar ma'i las dag la/ /brtul zhugs can dag sngags bzlas bya/ /ha cang mthon po spang bar bya/ /gal te tshig ni dman pa'ang min/ /bar ma bar ma'i las rnams la/ /rab tu bsngags 51)par rgyal bas gsungs/ /ha cang mtho (gemin dma' ba min/ /bar mar rtag tu bzlas pa bya/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /tshig ni dpal dang ldan par gsungs/ /gzhan gyi drung du mi bzlas shing / /gzhan gyi las lam rtag tu gsang / /bdag nyid rig pa'i yul du bzlas/ /sngags ni bar ma de bzhin du/ /bzlas pas rab tu 'byor bar 'gyur/ /sngags ni legs par thos pa 'ga'/ /dngos grub 'bring po 'dod pa nyid/ /sngags ni dge bar bzlas par bya/ /de phyir skye bo rin)dang bral bar / /sngags kyi de nyid don legs thos/ /tshogs dang bral zhing rnam dben par / /chos pa pos ni sngags bzlas bya/ /mtshan mo yi ni bzhi cha dang / /de yi phyed kyi phyed nyid kyi/ /skya rengs 4nodamar po'i dus tsam ste/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na/ /thun ni dang por re bzhin du/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog gis gsungs so/ /dus kyi tshad ni bzhi yin te/ /bar mar yongs su bsgrags pa yin / /de nas nyi ma phyed nub na/ /sngags kyi (gebazlas pa de tshe btang / /sngags zlos bor ba de yi tshe/ /mchod yon phul nas gshegs su gsol/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 6rnam gzhan spang 7)/ /de tshe bor ba'i gdugs 8)lhag na/ /thub pa'i bstan la dge ba bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs/ /dam pa'i chos ni klog pa dang / /sa bcu pa yi 9)glegs bam ni/ /mchod dang klog pa rtag 93—792

tu'o / /de nas dus la bab gyur na/ /rang sngags sngags kyi mgon po dang / /thub pa skyes 1)mchog phyag byas nas/ /de nas 'tsho ba la 'gro zhing / /de bzhin dus su spyod par ldan/ /dus su za zhing dbang po 2thul/ /sgrub po chos dang ldan pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dad brtson/ /grong gzhan du ni 'jug pa na/ /mi smra gtsang sbra spyod la dga'/ /sems can rtag tu chos ldan pa'i / /khyim du bsod snyoms dag la 'jug /zlos po srog chags med pa'i chu/ /tshos par grub pa gtsang mar 'dod/ /yang dag lta ba phun sum tshogs/ /sangs rgyas bstan la rab tu dad/ /de lta'i khyim du rtag tu ni/ /bsod snyoms 5don du slong mo blang / /dper na brtson pas go bgos te/ /nyam nga'i yul du rab tu 'jug /rtag tu dgra ni 'joms par byed/ /dgra rnams kyis gzhom mi nus pa/ /de bzhin sngags pa slong pa mos 'tsho/ /rtag tu grong du 'jug pa na/ /de bzhin chags par 'os pa yi/ /gzugs sgra mthong na 5nimi dge ba/ /'dod chags zhi ba'i don gyi phyir/ /mi sdug dge ba bsgom par bya/ /lang tsho'i 6rnam pas brgyan 57)pa yi/ /bud med lus ni mthong nas kyang / /smad cing rul ba'i lus rnams ni/ /srin bus zos shing dur khrod gnas/ /lus kyi mi rtag sdug bsngal ba/ /mi gtsang dri mi zhim par bsgoman/ /gang la byis pa rmongs pa yi/ /'gro ba lnga por 'gro zhing 'khor/ /las kyi srad 9bus brgyus pa ni/ /yun ring bodus su mya ngan byed/ /mi shes sgrib pas rmongs pa ni/ /dmus long 11sdug bsngal rgyu can no/ /gang du blo ni phyin ci log /chags pas skye bo 1 phongs par 'gyur / /rnam pa sna tshogs las lam gyis/ /rnam pa du mar chags gyur pa/ /ring nas khyogs kyis 'gro ba ni/ /'gro dang 'ong ba spyod par byed/ /rtag pa 93—793

nyid phyir rjes chags pa/ /'dzin pa'i kun du spyod pa spyod/ /gang du sems can mi dge dga'/ /lam du yun ring rgyu bar byed/ /zo chun khyud mo'i rnam pa bzhin / /srid pa'i mtsho chung 'byung ba rnams/ /'gro ba de rnams mi bzad pa'i / /sdug bsngal chu bos kun du g.yengs/ /de bzhin bud med sdug bsngal gyi / /rtsa ba 'ba' zhig yin pa ru/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /thub pa rnams kyis gsungs pa yin/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mi 'khrugs pa'i/ /mtsho chen 'di dag bskam par dka'/ /bud med sems 1kyis bslus pa yi/ /sems can gnas gang bying ba de/ /dmyal ba dud 'gro'i 'jig rten dang / /yi dgas (5)'jig rten lha ma yin/ /de bzhin mi yi 'jig rten nyid/ /lha yi 'gro bar 'gro bar bya/ /rtag tu kun nas yongs su 'khor/ /bud med chags pas bslus pa ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho btson ra yi/ /'dam rdo rdzab chen por bying bar 'gyur/ /bud med chags pa'i blun po'i mi/ /ro la chags pa'i ce spyang bzhin/ /gang la sems can rtag dga' ba/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal bzod par byed/ /dkar po chos la nges par nyams/ /sangs rgyas bstan la rab tu gnas/ /srid pa'i mtsho yi sdug bsngal nyid/ /thams cad zlog 4par byed pa yin/ /sngags zlos (5nipa la dga' zhing 'chibartson/ /dbang cher 7grags shing yid dang ldan/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing sngags thub pa/ /de rnams la ni sdug bsngal med/ /yang dag sdom dang tshangs bden shes/ /bla na ma lha la mchod pa byed/ /ma dang pha la gus pa rnams/ /gsum po rnams la sdug bsngal med/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa dang / /gzhan gyi don la rjes su bsnyen/ /bud med lus la 'byung po'i gzugs/ /de 93—794

bzhin 'bras dang zug rngu dang / /blo ngan phung po'i lcags kyus zin/ /'khor ba las ni mi 'da' ba/ /rtag tu bud med chags gyur pa/ /de la dngos grub yod pa min/ /de la mchog 'gro yod ma yin/ /'gro ba 'bring yang yod ma yin / /dngos grub chung ngu'ang yod ma yin/ /'dir ni zlos po khrims 'chal na / /tshul khrims 'chal la thub dbang gis/ /sngags kyi dngos grub ma bstan to(1) / /mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba yi/ /lam yang med cing phyogs dang bral/ /'dir ni byis pa smad pa la/ /sngags grub pa ni ga la yod/ /skye bo tshul 'chal 'di la ni/ /de la bde 'gro'ang yod ma yin/ /bde ba nyid la gzhol ba'ang med / /de bzhin rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngags/ /grub par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos / /ta la'i shing gi mgo bo ni/ /gang tshe bcad na slar yang ni/ /sngon po nyid du mi 'gyur zhing / /myu gu slar yang nam zhig 'gyur/ /de bzhin sngags grub rmongs pa ni/ /tshul khrims 'chal zhing sdig pa'i las/ /rtag tu slar yang bud med chags/ /mi dge'i grogs dang phrad pa la/ /sngags kyi rgyal po ga la 'grub / /de bas gang tshe zlos pa po(5/ /bde bar gshegs pas spangs pa yi/ /bud med nyes pa rnams spyad de/ /gang gi dngos grub bsgrub bya ste/ /byis pa bud med la rmongs pa/ /gzhan gyis grub par ma bstan no/ /de nas dang por blo ldan pa/ /gtsang zhing 'du 'dzi med la dga'/ /rigs ldan brtan zhing dpa' ba dang / /sems bzang ldan zhing mthong na dga'/ /chos dang chos min rnams 4nodapyod shes/ /de rnams grub pa rnyed mi dka'/ /de ltar sngags shes zhugs pa ni/ /grong du bsod snyoms phyir du 'jug /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin song nas/ /sngar ni brtags pa'i gnas dag tu/ /mkhas pas dag 93—795

pa'i blos bza' ba/ /bza' ba phyogs su bzhag 1)nas ni/ /phyi rol song nas rkang pa bkru/ /de nas slar yang gnas de ru/ /srog chags med pa'i chu rnams kyis / /dang po 'dren pa nyid yin te/ /gnyis pa la ni lag g.yon gyis(mi/ /rked pa man chad dril 8)phyis bya/ /kun du g.yas pa slar byin nas/ /lag pa sa yis bkru bar bya/ /sngar bzhag pa yi dag pa dang / /gtsang ma rnams kyi bdun nyid du/ /bza' zhing dag chus gtsang sbrar byas/ /ser skya'i ba las byung ba yi//ba yi lci ba ser po dag /gtsang zhing dri med snod blang la/ /srog chags med pa'i chus sbyar te/ /dang por ston pa thub pa yi/ /mchog la dkyil 'khor bya ba yin / /khyad par khru gang tsam du'o/ /gnyis pa rang sngags mgon po la/ /gsum pa rigs kyi lha mo la/ /gang zhig sngags pa zlos (༄pa po(5)/ /slar yang rtag tu bya ba yin/ /bzhi pa sems can thams cad kyi/ /nye bar longs spyod don du grags/ /g.yas su 'jig rten mgon po yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni rtag tu bya/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi ched du ni/ /dkyil 'khor de ni gru bzhi pa'o / /gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /gsum pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i sras/ /dkyil 'khor bdun po 'di dag ni/ /kun nas gru bzhi pa ru 'o/ /khru gang ngam 6ni khru phyed rung / /nyin re zhing yang bya ba 'o/ /zlos pos 'a༄de tshe sbas pa'i phyogs/ /sdig pa 'joms byed nyin re bzhin/ /de nas sngags pa thub pa langs/ /lag gnyis 'bad pas bkrus nas ni/ /gtsang ma'i chu yis nye reg bya/ /dag cing srog chags spangs pa yi/ /dri ma med pa'i gtsang ma ni/ /'bad pas gtsang ma'i snod du blang / /mtsho chen dang ni 'bab chu'am/ /chu mig chu bo la gnas pa/ /gtsang ma'i phyogs nas byung ba yi/ /sems can 93—796

gtsang ma lag gis bcus/ /sngags pas slar yang nye reg bya/ /gnyis sam gsum du rtag tu yang / /de nas kha la reg bya zhing / /de bzhin nyid du rna ba'i rgyun / /mig dang sna yi bu ga dang / /spyi bo lte ba'i phyogs reg bya/ /dge ba spyod pas lan lnga'am bdun/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bya/ /gtsang sbra'i spyod pa phun sum tshogs/ /zlos po gtsang mar gyur nas ni/ /bsod snyoms snod ni blangs nas su/ /chu yi nang du 'gro bar bya/ /gang du chu bo rab gnas pa / /de bzhin dma' bar gyur pa dang / /chu klung rab tu 'bab la sogs/ /mi yi 'jig rten rjes gzung (1rgyur/ /de bzhin rtag tu sngags bzlas bya/ /de nyid phyir na thub pa'i gtsos/ /brtson 'grus chen pos 'di gsungs so/ /mtshan ni 'od srung zhes bya bas/ /sngon ni 2de tshe sa stengs dader/ /sgrol ma'i rtog pa'i rgyal po 'dir/ /'byung po rnams la legs don du/ /sngags ni rab tu gsungs pa yin/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'jig rten kun/ /dbul zhing skyo la sha thang ba/ /mchog tu nyon mongs gyur pa rnams/ /'di rnams don du gsungs pa yin/ /'byung po rnams la legs pa nyid/ /slar yang kun du bsten pa rnams/ /'byung po kun gyi zas don du/ /gsang sngags 'di ni mchog tu gsungs/ /nga yis gsang sngags 'di brjod kyi/ /byang sems la bsten thams cad dang / /nyan thos rnams ni mnyan par gyis/ /nad kyis 4zin pa 'joms byed cing / /bkres pa'i nad kyis gzir ba dang / /gang yang sems can skom pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi don dang / /'byor pa 'dod rnams mnyan par gyis/ /'od srung 'od ni chen po la/ /thub pa'i gtso bos de skad gsungs/ /nyon mongs rnams ni yid mgu zhanas/ /khyab bdag de 93—797

la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kyi rgyal po thub pa che/ /chos mkhyen 0)gsang sngags bshad du gsol/ /dam tshig mchog la nyer gnas pa'i/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtser tshonamadzod/ /de skad gsol nas thub pa yis/ /sngags mchog rgyas par gsung bar byed/ /ka la ping ka sgra dbyangs dang / /rnga bo che dang sprin gyi sgra / /tshangs dbyangs brtson 'grus chen po dang / /tshangs pa'i sras gang rgyal mchog gis/ /gang yang cung zad 'dir 'ongs pa/ /rkang med pa dang rkang mangs dang / /rkang gnyis pa dang rkang bzhi pa/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /mdor na sems can don kun du/ /bde 'byung sngags ni bshad par bya/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /sems can la sogs 'dir lhags dpa/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /'byor pa 'dod pa rnams nyon cig /na maḥri4sa man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā (5)sa nā māṃ/tar+ya thā/ o tshig ga ne/ ga ga na/ galjo ā na rtso)ya/ sarba la hu la hu/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ ā 8kar+ṣa rte59ri/ mā bi lasba/ ya the pi te saṃ pā dā ya swā hā/bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis de skad ces gsungs nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis/ rig pa'i sngags kyi tshig 'di rgya cher gsungs pa'i bar skabs 'dir nam mkha' thams cad chen po la 'os pa'i zas kyi sprin gyis yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi nam mkha'i mthil thams cad zas kyi sprin gyis rab tu g.yogs par snang bar gyur to/ /bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon par 'dod pa'i don du blang bar khabakru bar bya/ /slar yang de nas langs nas ni/ /gtsug lag khang ngam gnas su 'gro/ /gang su tshonasngon ni 93—798

yang dag bsten/ /gang du gnas pa der 'gro bya/ /song nas zlos pos phyogs de ru/ /lhung bzed de ni gzhag 6)par bya/ /de nas myur du nye reg bya/ /de bzhin slar yang lhung bzed blang / /lhung bzed sa la lo ma 'am/ /dngul lam de bzhin gser nyid dang / /zangs sam shing shun dag kyang rung / /ston pa la ni lha bshos dbul/ /ston la lha bshos phul nas ni/ /slar yang narig sngags rgyal la'o/ /'gron po gcig ni 'ongs gyur dang / /sdug bsngal can la'ang ci nus sbyin/ /bshos nyid kyang ni thams cad du/ /kun nas nges par bza' ba nyid / /ha cang mang po sbyin mi bya/ /sngags shes 'dir ni gdung mi bya/ /kun nas rig (5)pa ldan par bya/ /lto ba'i tshad tsam bzhag nas ni/ /gzhan pa'i zan ni rtag tu'o/ /bkres dang skom pas nyen pa yis/ /sngags don sgrub par mi nus te/ /ha cang nyung dang mang zos na/ /sngags don bsnyen par mi nus so / /de nyid phyir na rgyal dbang gis/ /sems can zas kyis gnas so zhes/ /lus can kun la gsungs pa yin/ /gang gis mi rnams 'tsho ba dang / /lha dang lha min dri za dang / /klu dang gnod sbyin mi 'am ci/ /srin po yi dgas 4sha za dang / /'byung po skar ma gza' dag ni/ /gang zhig zas la mi ltos pa/ /de ni 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /rtag tu kha zas rags 5 pa ni/ / kham gyi 6zas zhes grags pa'o/ /sems can phra mo'i zas can spang / /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ni/ /bsam gtan zas can rtag par ni/ /gzugs ni spyod cing g.yo ba ste/ /gzugs med nyid kyi lha rnams kyang / /ting 'dzin 'bras bu za ba'o/ /srid pa bar ma'i sems can yang / /dri za bar ni rab tu grags/ /de bzhin 'dod khams sems can rnams/ /zas ni rnam pa sna tshogs za/ /93—799

'dod dang ldan pa'i lha dang mi/ / kham gyi (1)zas ni za bar byed/ /de nyid phyir na thub dbang gis/ /sems can zas kyis gnas pa zhes/ /chos kyi rgyu ru bstan pa yin/ /gang de rnams ni rab tu grags/ /zlos po (5)rtag tu brtson pa ni / /zas kyi tshod ni rig par bya/ /gang phyir rig pa bsnyen pa ni/ /zas 'di la ni rab tu gnas/ /kun spyod ma nor dag pa dang / /dge zhing tshangs par spyod pa dang / /zas kyi tshod kyang shes pa la/ /de yis ri nodangos grub rnyed mi dka'ar / /dper na khur ni drang ba'i rgyur/ /shing rta yun ring (6)gnas don du//shing rta'i mig snyi ni sku bar dbyed/ /de bzhin sngags pa sngags rig (9pas/ /zas ni gnas pa'i ched du spyad/ /lus ni gso ba'i don du ni/ /zlos po rtag tu gso bar bya/ /sngags rnams bsgrub 7pa'i don phyir dang / /byang chub tshogs kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /zas thams cad dang / ji ltar mngon par/ srid pa'i bza' ba de/ de rnams su char 'bab par gyur to/ /ji ltar mngon par sred pa'i bza' ba de rnams kyis zas kyi bya ba bkres pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i don dang /skom pa rnams kyis btung ba yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu bo'i rgyun lta bu btung bar bya ba yang yid la 'dod pa bzhin du der bab par gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyang skad cig de la bkres pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang / skom pa thams cad bsal bar byas par gyur to/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor thams cad kyang ngo mtshar thob cing tshim pa thob nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs 1stonas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nyi nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od srung yang 1 de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas la 93—800

yongs su bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa ngas kyang de'i tshe rtog pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga 'di la sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / bkres pa dang / skom pa bsal 3)ba'i don gyi phyir dang / khyad par du sngags zlos dpa po thams cad kyi phyir gsungs pa la mngon par rjes su yi rang ngo / /dang po re zhig ( )zlos pa pos sngags 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /gal te bsod snyoms la 'gro bar mi spro na ri'i rtse mor 'dzegs nas 'bum phrag bdun bzlas pa bya/ /de nas dkar gsum bza' ba'am/ 'o ma btung ba'o/ /ri'i rtse mo de nyid du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i ras ris bar ma sngar bzhin du bzhag nas mchod pa chen po byas te gtor ma dang lha bshos rgya chen po byas nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis 4)gsungs pa'i gsang sngags 'di nyid kyis seng ldeng gi yam shing rnams kyis 555me sbar nas u dum bā tsira'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar la btags pa rlan dang bcas pa'am/ dpal 'bras kyi yam shing kyang rung ste stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg tsho7)bya'o/ /de nas mtshan phyed kyi dus kyi tshe sprin nag po chen po dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'ong bar 'gyur te 'jigs par mi bya / langs na 'gro bar yang mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i snying pos bdag nyid bsrung bar bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang /grogs rnams kyang sngar bzhin bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas rlung nag po'i dkyil 'khor mi snang bar 'gyur te/ bud med kyang rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'od kyi phreng ba dang ldan pas phyogs rnams kyang kun du snang bar byed bzhin pa/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du 'dug ste/ kye kye sems dpa' chen po longs shig /grub pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /de nas sgrub pa pos sna ma'i me tog 93—801

dang bsres pa'i dri chus mchod yon dbul lo/ /de nas de nyid du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma de nas bdag nyid dam 'di'i grogs po nyi shu rtsa lnga la deng nas ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i bza' ba rnams rab tu ster bar byed do/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i yo byad rnams kyang kun du sbyin par byed do/ /de nas sgrub pa pos mchod yon phul nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /ras ris la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas ras ris blangs te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas nas de nas ri'i rtse mo'am/ mi med pa'i gnas su 'gro bar bya'o/ /der bdag nyid dam/ grogs pos phyag dar byas nas dgram par bya ba rnams bkram la gnas der nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i las rnams bya'o / /de nas sgrub pa pos sngar bzhin du ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste ras ris bar ma sngar bzhin du bzhugs su gsol nas seng ldeng gi shing gis (1)me sbar la thun gsum du pad+ma dkar po'i me tog /zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pa rnams kyis nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'am snying po'am nye ba'i snying pos rilas chen po thams cad kyi ched du'am yi ge gcig pa'i ched du stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg dbya'o/ /de nas mtshan phyed kyi dus kyi tshe sbyin sreg gi mthar bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma mngon sum 94༄du mthong bar 'gyur zhing /'dod pa'i mchog gnang bar byed do/ /nam mkha' la 'gro ba'am/ mi snang ba'am byang chub sems dpa'i sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas sam/ mngon par shes pa lnga nyid dam/ tshe ring ba nyid dam/ rgyal srid chen po dang / longs spyod chen po nyid kyi ched dam/ rgyal po chen po mnyes pa nyid dam/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rjes su rnam par spyod pa nyid dam/ mdor na 9(3—802

yid la 'dod pa de thams cad gnang bar byed do/ /gang blangs kyang rung ste/de mthun 0)par gnang bar byed cing / grub pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad kyang thob bo/ /sems can chen po rnams 'gugs par byed pa'am/ mdor na ji lta ji ltar zhus pa de thams cad mdzad do/ /las kyi nyes pa rab tu spags pa yang yang dag par sbyong bar byed do/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gsungs so / /las kyi cho ga gzhan pa bar ma'i sgrub thabs su 'gyur ba ni/ dang po re zhig (0khyad par gyi (5gnas sam/ gtsang ma'i phyogs sam/ chu klung ngam/ chu gling gi 'gram du sngar bzhin du thams cad byas nas ras ris zhal nub tu phyogs par gzhag (4)la/ bdag nyid kha shar du phyogs pas gnas nas ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste/ rgyas par gong bzhin du sbyar bar bya ste thun gsum du 'bum phrag drug bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / dong ma'i me tog tsan+dan dkar po dang bsres pa'am gur gum dang bsres pas snga ma de bzhin kho nar me sbar nas stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg 5bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi mthar ras ris 'gul na blon po nyid do/ /ras ris la 'od kyi snang ba byung na 'od las rgyal srid do/ /ras ris kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs na rgyal po chen po bzhi'i rigs kyi rgyal srid do/ /ras ris la me byung na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dbang phyug nyid de brgya byin nyid do/ /ras ris chos ston par byed pa byung na byang chub sems dpa' gsum gyi dbang phyug nyid do/ /ras ris kyi phyag spyi bor reg na mngon par shes pa lnga dang / sa bdun rjes su thob pa dang / stobs bcu nges pa nyid rim gyis thob par byed pa nyid do/ /de nas sgrub pa pos bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis tshonegasungs pa'i sngags bsgrubs 7te bkres pa dang skom 93—803
