pa phyir gzhil ba'i don rjes su thob pa de nyid kyis dang / cho ga de nyid kyis (1yo byad kyi (5)rig pa'i spyod pa'i don sgrub pa'i thabs rin)kyi cho ga'i chos la yang dag par nan tan bya'i (4)gzhan du grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rim gyis sngags kyi spyod pa la rjes su 'jug cing mdor na (minan tan nges par sgrub par byed de/rdzas dang sman dang yo byad kyi khyad par dang / nor bu rin po che rnams ji ltar sngar nges par bstan pa bzhin du sgrub par byed do/ /sngags shes sngags ni zlos (6ripa po'ang / /cho ga bshad pa la sems pa/ /sngags pa de tshe de phyogs su/ /gtsang ma'i 'gro bas zas kyang ni/ /zos nas yid ni dga' ba dang / /dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /lhung bzed lhag ma rtag blangs te/ /sems bzang chu bo gtsang mar 'gro/ /mtha' gcig tu ni bor nas ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dud 'gro sbyin/ /dud 'gro rnams la mthun 977byin nas/ /'bad pas lhung bzed bkru bar byed/ /lhag ma lhung bzed bya ba ni/ /sgum (8)med zas dang dri bral gang / /lhung bzed lhag mar thub pas gsungs/ /gang du slong ba'i snod du ni/ /de ru zan ni mi bza' ste/ /der ni bza' ba 'bras bu dang / /rdzas rnams rtag tu bza' mi bya/ /pad 'dab kyis kyang ma yin te/ /ut+pa la las byung bas sam/ /dri bzang ldan rnams spangs pa ste59ni/ /sngags pas der ni mi bza'o1 / /gang yang sngags pas ku mu da/ /sla k+ṣa u dum bār 17las byung / /pa ṭi'i 'dab ma dang yang ni/ /tsher ma'i yal ga'i ri khrod byung / /a 1 mra'i 'dab ma ru yang ti min/ /de bzhin sā ṭa la las byung / /sā la'i 'dab ma shi ri ṣa/ /byang chub shing las byung ba dang / /gang du bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni/ /shākya seng ge bzhugs pa yi/ /shing de 'bad pas spang bar bya//93—804

shing de yi ni yal ga dang / /nā (1)ga ge sar shing la'ang min/ /gang du nam yang bza' mi bya/ /mkhas pas de kun cis kyang spang / /thub pa'i lo ma'i spyil po ni/ /rmongs pas nam yang 'gom mi bya/ /sngags pa dam tshig nyams par 'gyur / /zas ni lo ma de rnams las/ /gzhan pa'i lo ma rnams su bza'/ /sa byung zangs su nges bstan dang / /de bzhin gser dang dngul las byung / /shel dang rdo ba las byung ba/ /de bzhin bza' ba blangs nas ni/ /rtag tu sngags pas der ni bza'/ /lo ma'i rgyab tu mi bza' ste/ /de bzhin lag pa'i mthil du'ang min/ /stobs bcu pa yi sras rnams dang / /rang rgyal bse ru lta bu gang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos gtso/ /lo ma gzhan dang lha bshos 'byung / /zlos pos de rnams spang bar bya/ /yi ge rkang pas kyang mi 'gom/ /sna tshogs bza' ba snum khur dang / /de bzhin btung dang bza' ba rnams/ /sngags pas 'bad pas blang bar bya/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mchog rnams dang / /de bzhin nyan thos skyes bu mchog /dkon mchog gsum la phul ba yi/ /lha bshos thams cad nyid kyang rinani/ /zlos pos rtag tu spang bar bya/ /chung ngu tsam yang lus can la/ /sngags rnams de yis mi 'grub ste/ /kun nas bkra shis thams cad dang / /rtag tu dpal ni smos ci dgos/ /rgyal ba can dang zhi ba can/ /lha bshos gtor ma za byed pa/ /de tshe de yi kun mi 'grub/ /gtsang zhing mkhas la tshul khrims ldan/ /snying rje snying rje'i las can dang / /gtsang sbra'i spyod pa la dga' ba/ /rig sngags kun du sgrub par byed/ /sems can gzhan la byin pa'i zas/ /chos pos de ni bza' mi bya/ /gzhan gyis rab tu ma brtags (5)pa'i/ /zas gzhan bza' bar mi bya'o/ /rang la byin pas kha zas 93—805

ni / /cung zad tsam yang blang bar bya/ /sngags shes de ltar 'jug pa ni/ /de yi dngos grub sdig pa'i dgra/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed par gnas/ /zlos pos cho ga 'di yis ni/ /bza' ba len pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /thub pa rnams kyis legs par bsngags91)/ /sngags rnams thams cad sgrub pa la/ /mdor na cho ga mthong ba yis/ /bza' ba kun dang las rnams la'o/ /de nas gzhan yang rab 'chad byed/ /sngags ni thams cad sbyong bar byed/ /de nas zlos pos nye reg bya/ /de tshe sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /de tshe sngags pas lan bdun du/ /lus sbyong byed pa bzlas byas nas/ /'byung po'i tshogs dang lha rnams 'dir/ /de don rgyas pa mnyan par gyis/ /lus kun nye reg byas nas su / /thub pas sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /na maḥsarba bud+dhā māṃ/ a (2)pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba kilbi gci bye/ nā sha ni/ nā sha ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa pra yusto/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ sngags 'dis bslab (47pa'i zas gzhan gang yang rung ba yongs su spyod pa na sngags lan bdun mngon par bsngags 5pa byas nas yongs su longs spyad 6)par bya'o/ /zos nas snga ma bzhin du nye reg byas te spyi bo la sogs pa'i lus thams cad du byugs (7 nas de nas ngal bso bar bya'o/ /ngal sos nas yud tsam phyed rin dam thun gcig la'o/ /de nas ras ris dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mngon par phyag byas nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam bklag par bya'o/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / 'phags pa zla ba sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'phags pa sa bcu pa dang / 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa dang / 'phags pa rma bya chen mo dang / 'phags pa rin po che tog gi gzungs te 'di rnams las gzhan dang 93—806

gzhan gang yang rung ba bklag par bya'o/ /nyi ma'i dus kyi tshad bzhi cha tsam du'o//de nas yongs su zhi nas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bklag par bya ste glegs bam brtul nas gos gtsang ma bgos te dam pa'i chos la phyag byas nas de nas khrus kyi ched du chu klung gi 'gram mam mtsho phran chen por 'jug pas song nas/ srog chags med pa'i chu 6)blangs te lan bdun mngon par bsngags (5)par byas nas rig pa 'dis chu la gdab po/ /gang zhe na/ na maḥ sa man+ta bud dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tabya thā/ o sarba duṣ+ṭa s+t+waṃ bha ya hūm̐/ na dkodī ba ra dha ( ri rte(ge/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'dis srung ba byas nas phyogs rnams bcing ba dang / grogs rnams dang / dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang /kha bcing ba dang / gdug pa dang / rab tu gdug (6pa rnam sa thams cad 'gugs par byed pa dang / bgegs bcing ba la 7yang srad bu la lan bdun bzlas nas rked pa'i phyogs su bcings pas thams cad yongs su 'chags pa dang / bzlas pa'i dus thams cad dang / khrus kyi dus thams cad dang /gdug pa'i bgegs rnam par gzhom pa dang / rab tu zhi ba'i don du sngags 'di stong phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad byed do/ /pad+ma'i gdan la phyag rgya chen po dang ldan pa dgod par bya'o/ /las rnams thams cad du thams cad kyi rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa pos sa las byung ba'i phye ma la sogs pa rnams blangs nas ji ltar bde bar khrus bya zhing srog na chags med pa'i chus khrus byas te/ thams cad du las thams cad la srog chags med pa nyid kyis bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas nas sa'i rang bzhin nam gzhan dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i dri dang / yo byad kyi khyad par gyis rjes su byug 93—807

par bya'o/ /chu'i nang du mchil ma dang / bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /rtse bar yang mi bya'o/ /snying rje dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la so sor brtag par bya ste/ bdag med pa dang /stong pa dang / sdug bsngal dang ldan pa dang / sdug bsngal nye bar 'gags pa dang / tshor bas mngon par non pa dang / chu rlabs bzhin du mngon par 'byung ba'i rab tu sbyor ba'i sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams 'di ltar sgrub pa dang bral ba sngags shes pas gang de bzhin du dug dang / gcod pa dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jigs pa la sogs pa 1rnams kyis sdug bsngal gyi phung po nye bar 'gog par bya bzhin pa(ge/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho thibs po gnas pa'i bdag nyid du mthong zhing gnas med pa dang skyob pa med pa dang / skyabs med pa dang / shin tu dman pa'i yid can gyi bdag nyid du brtags nas sgom pa po mgrin pa nub tsam gyi chu na gnas pa'am/lte ba tsam du gnas pa'i chu de nyid kyi nang du sems rtse gcig tu nye bar gzung kyebar bya'o/ /dang por re zhig 4pad+ma chen po'i 'dab ma la me tog chen po dang ldan pa pad+ma chen po'i lo mas nye bar mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin las byung ba'i sdong bu dang / rin po che ma da ka las grub pa'i pad+ma'i ge sar dang / shel las byas pa'i sdong po legs par kha phye ba dang de'i rjes su skyes pa'i shel dang pad+ma rā ga'i me tog rnams kyis mdzes pa'o/ /de'i steng du seng ge'i khri rin po che du mas nye bar mdzes pa ras bcos bu zung gis bkab pa'o/ /de'i steng du 5 bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsam par bya ste/ chos ston par mdzad cing bzhugs pa gser gyi mdog tu snang ba 93—808

kun nas 'od 'bar ba'i phreng bas khyab pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan 15pa tshad chen po nam mkha' lta bu mchog tu bris bzhin pa/ skyil mo krung gis na nye bar bzhugs pa/ g.yas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ pad+ma chen po'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rnga yab bsnams pa/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i grwa na 'khod de/ lus dmar ser gur gum btags pa'i kha dog lta bu'o/ /g.yon du 'phags pa mthu chen po thob ston ma'i sprin ltar dkar ba phyag na rnga yab thogs pa'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la/ 'phags pa byams pa dang / kun du bzang po dang / sa'i snying po dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje dang / nor bzang zhes pa 4byang chub sems dpa' bcu po 'di rnams kyi g.yas su rang sangs rgyas brgyad bsam par bya ste/ tsan+dan dang / spos rangad ldan dang ske/ tog dang / tog dkar dang / 'dod pa dang / nye ba'i 'dod pa dang / mu khyud dang / 6mu khyud brgyad do/ /de nyid du nyan thos chen po brgyad gnas pa la 'di 7lta ste 'phags pa mod gal nagyi bu chen po dang /'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang / ba lang bdag dang / bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang / pi lin 9da'i bu dang / 'phags pa sgra gcan zin dang /'phags pa 'od srung chen po dang / 'phags pa kun dga' bo zhes pa'i nyan thos chen po de rnams dang nye bar dge slong gi dge 'dun mtha' yas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams dang nye bar rang sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po rnams kyi gnas su'ang byang 93—809

chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun mtha' yas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du kun nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang ldan par bsgom par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdag nyid kyang lte ba tsam gyi chu la gnas bzhin du lha dang mi'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa la me tog man dā (1kyir ba dang / man dā nanor ba chen po dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang /dhā nu sku ri ka dang / pa'i ka dang in+t+ra ba ra'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa tshad chen po phung po chen por gnas pa ri rab tsam gyi ri tshome tog gi phur mas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya zhing / 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phye ma dang / chos gos dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams dang / lha dang mi'i mar me mang po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du gtor ma dang / bdug pa dang / lha bshos dang / mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur la sogs pa yo byad lha dang mi'i nyer mkho 5rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer mngon par 'phro bzhin pas bdag nyid dang phyogs thams cad kyang kun du snang bzhin par bsgom par bya'o/ /sgom pa po bsam gtan la zhugs ma thag tu/tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyi 'chi'abras bu thob bo/ /nges par byang chub mchog tu gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu sogs bsam gtan rnams/ /'jig rten skyes mchog rnams kyis gsungs/ /'byung po kun kyang legs pa dang / /sngags pa rnams la phan don dang / /de tshe bsam gtan dang po'i gtso/ /sngags pa kun la phan don du/ /sems can rnams kyi phyir gsungs so/ /de nas thub mchog 93—810

bdun pa yi/ /rdokyil 'khor rnam par brjod par bya/ /thub pas dang por (1tshogasungs pa yin/ /gnyis pa yi ni dkyil 'khor dang / /gsum par yang ni de las gzhan/ /dang por mchog gi dngos grub ste/ /bar ma la ni de bzhin gzhan / /chung ngu la ni phran tshegs nasa'agrub/ /thub pa mchog gis nanges par gsungs / /de bzhin ras ris bsam gtan ni/ /thu bo bar ma chung ngu ste/ / thams cad sdig pa (4༄'jig byed pa'o/ /de las gzhan yang mkhas pas ni/ /bsam gtan rnam pa rab bsgrub bya/ /bsam gtan de la rab gnas na/ /sngags rnams de la 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i cho ga bshad/ /zlos pos bsam gtan bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags kyi mchod yon der phul nas/ /ji ltar bde bar gshegs su gsol/ /chu tshogs de las bsgral nas ni/ /de nas ji ltar bde bar 'gro/ /gnas ni sngon du nges bstan par/ /cho ga mthong bas legs zhi bar/ /de la sngags pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /sngar las ji ltar brjod pa bzhin/ /rang gi lha ni spyan drangs pa/ /der ni sngags kyis gshegs su gsol/ /de nas bdag nyid de bzhin nyid/ /grogs po rnams ni tshogabasrungs byas nas/ /dge ba'i las kyis de nyid shes/ /cho ga'i las la dga' zhing 'dud/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bstod mchod kyis /gang zag mchog la kun bstod nas/ /rang sngags sngags kyis mgon po dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal bse ru dang / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /'jig rten gsum po rjes 'dzin bzod/ /de nas gsang sngags zlos pa pos / /stan de las 7ni slar langs nas/ /thag ring gnas su song nas ni/ /phyi rol rlung gi rnam par spangs / /snabs dang mchil ma rnam par dor/ /bshang dang gci ba'ang de 93—811

bzhin no/ /nyin par byang du kha phyogs shing / /mtshan mo lho ru kha blta'o/ /sngags zlos pos ni nam yang der/ /don rnams bsam par mi bya'o/ /der ni rang las byed gsungs pa'i/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa mi bya'o/ /rab sngags 'gro ba mtshan sogs kyi/ /de tshe sa stengs (1༄nyer 'dug ste/ /dag pa'i chu yis nye reg bya/ /gtsang ma'i gos mtha' chur gzhug bya/ /sa yi phuji po bdun nyid kyis / /'bad pas rkang pa bkrus byas nas/ /rab tu 'dzag pa bdun blangs nas / /bshang ba 'dzag pa sum cu ste/ /gnyis ga'i mtha' la lag pa dag /mchil ma dor ba nyid dang ni/ /snabs la'ang gnyis de na)de bzhin no/ /de nas 'bad pas nye reg bya/ /gnas la ring du song ba'i sar/ /de bzhin sgra ( ritsam song nas ni/ /lam la sogs pa yangs pa ru/ /de nas gzhan gyi ci 'dod bzhin / /lho phyogs mtha' yi phyi rol tu/ /chu dang g.yang sa med pa dang / /de bzhin bye mas khyab pa dang / /chu klung spangs shing ngogs kyang spangs/ /'bad pas mi gtsang chu spangs par/ /gsang zhing shin tu sbyangs pa dang / /bas mtha' ljongs ni spangs pa dang / /rnam par dben pa'i sar song nas/ /sngags pas mi gtsang dor bar bya/ /zlos po dus ni shes byas nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i shugs dag min/ /de nas dag pa'i phyogs song ste/ /bas mthar de bzhin bshang ba dang / /gci la ba'i bya ba byas nas ni/ /de ru lus ni ci bde bar/ /gnyis ku'ang 55gsang g.yogs sbas pa dang / /skye bo med pa'i sa spang bar6/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin kho nar thams cad du/ /ri bo dang ni tshang tshing dang / /bas mtha'i gnas mal nyams dga' ba / /de bzhin rgyal bas spangs pa yi/ /gdug pa'i sems can rnam bral 93—812

bar / /gsang sngags rgyal po thams cad sgrub/ /rgyal po chos dang ldan pa'i yul / /skye bo gtsang sbra spyod la dga'/ /ma dang pha la gus pa dang / /gnyis skyes rigs kyis dor ba ru/ /lha rnams dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /gnas der yin gyis 5)gzhan du min/ /nyams dga' skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ /ya mu na nyid rab mdzes pa/ /sin dhu nar ma da bak+ṣe/ /zla ba'i cha ni gtsang ma'i 'gram / /kā be rī dzonanodang dbyangs can nyid/ /chu klung chen po shī ta nyid/ /'di grub zhing gzhan ma yin par/ /stobs bcu ldan sras rnams kyis bshad/ /stobs bcu pa yis gsungs pa'i zhing 5/ /byang phyogs lam med ri bo dang / /kha che dang ni rgya yul dang / /bal yul de bzhin mang yul dang / /rgya nag che dang li yul nyid/ /de dag ma lus grub pa'i zhing / /byang gi phyogs su brten pa yi/ /gang yang ri dang chu bo dang 4/ /bsod nams yul du rab tu brjod/ /nas dang gro ni za ba'o/ /gang du sems can snying rje ldan/ /de ru rtag par dngos grub 'gyur/ /dpal gyi ri bo brag ri che/ /lho phyogs yul du gnas pa yi / /dpal ldan 'bras phung 5mchod rten ni/ /sa stengs 6rgyal ba'i ring bsrel 'dzin/ /der ni sngags rnams bsgrub par bya/ /myur du las dang las rnams so/ /rdo rje gdan dang mchod rten che/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mdzes pa dang / /gang du thub gtso zhi bar gshegs/ /der yang dngos grub blta bar bya//lha las babs pa'i mchod rten ni/ /sa pa k+ṣe dang cho 'phrul che/ /ser skya zhes bya'i grong mchog dang / /lum+bi'i tshal du 'khrungs pa der/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal bas bstod cing rab bsngags pa'i/ /bya rgod phung po'i ( niri der dang / /de bzhin brag dang bsil 8ba'i tshal/ /me tog zhes smyo93—813

bya'i grong mchog dang / /de bzhin rtag tu kā sha'i (1)grong / /bcom brlag 3)ka n+ya kub dzi dang / /sa stengs ༄grong ni 'phags rgyal dang / /mchod rten de bzhin yangs pa can/ /rtag tu sa stengs 4mi thi la/ /grong dang grong khyer gtso bo rnams/ /gang gzhan rgyal ba yang dag 'byung / /rab bsngags bsod nams yul dag tu/ /de rnams su ni dngos grub sgrub/ /'di rnams las gzhan yul rnams ni/ /grong dang ljongs dang ri bo dang / /gnas dang grong mchog gtso bo ni / /'o ma'am 'bab chu la brten 55)pa/ /der ni rnam ri nodaben rjes 'jug cing / /bzlas dang sbyin sreg dga' bar 'gyur/ /gnas ni bla gab 9)med pa dang / /rtag tu khang pa stong pa ru/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'o/ /sngags rnams rjes mthun 8las rnams ni/ /sngags pas rtag tu yul dbus su/ /sngags bzlas yang dag 'dod par bya/ /bzlas la rab zhugs rtag tu brtson/ /sngags rig gtong ba dag la goms/ /tshul khrims spyod cing shin tu brtanatsho / /'byung po kun la phan par dga'/ /sngags kyi spyod pa la dad pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyis sngar bzhin bzlas/ /gtsang ma'i yul dang gtsang sbra can/ /kla klo rkun ma spangs pa dang /〉 /der ni bskal pa chen por gnas/ /dam tshig snang ba bral ba'i phyir/ /dmyal ba mi bzad mun pa ru/ /byis pa'i skye bo 'tshed par byed/ /dam pa'i chos la smad pa dang / /mi shes mun pas bsgribs pa dang / /ye shes gyis pa'i ngo bo'am/ /rmongs pa log pa'i nga rgyal can/ /rig pa'i rgyal po brnyas byed pa/ /mi bzad dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sdig pa mi bya zhing / /log par smra ba'ang smad pa yin/ /dam pa'i chos la brnyas pa dang / /log par lta ba smad pa yin/ /de phyir rtag tu dad gyur nas/ /gsang sngags cho 93—814

ga rtag tu bsten0)/ /bden par smra zhing chos shes pa/ /sems can rnams la rtag tu phan/ /sngags shes sngags ni sten 25par byed/ /de yi dngos grub nges par 'gyur/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yis/ /las ni rnam pa sna tshogs byed / /las rnams bya ba rnams kyis byed/ /rtag tu phan pa'i bya ba yis/ /bya ba'i las dang yang dag ldan/ /de la rtag tu grub par 'gyur/ /bya ba'i don dang don kun phyir/ /las ni rnam pa sna tshogs bya / /bya ba'i don du bya min gang / /bya ba'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /'bras bcas nyid kyi bya don gyi/ /bya ba nyid du rtag tu bya/ /bya ba las dang 'bras bu nyid/ /bya ba las 'bras rtag tu'o / /'bras med 'bras bu nyid 'gyur zhing / /'bras bu nyid kyang rtag tu 'bras / /'bras med 'bras bu bcas pa nyid/ /thams cad nyid kyang 'bras bu bcas / /rnal 'byor sngags ni bsgrub bya ste/ /yang dag sbyor dang bral ba yang //bral dang yang dag ldan sgrub po/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed med par ni/ /de la grub pa yod ma yin/ /grub pa'i rdzas ni thams cad kyang / /grub pa'i rgyu dang 'gal ba yin/ /sngags kyi dngos grub ma grub pa/ /sngags ni sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu/ /byed par 'dod pa de las te/ /'dod pa'i las ni byang bar 'gyur/ /las min las ni thams cad la/ /las kyi rgyud ni mi bya'o/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi don ldan pa'i/ /las ni mtha' dag brtsam par bya/ /brtsams dang rtsom pa'i 'dud pa yi/ /las nyid brtsam par mi bya'o/ /bya ba ma brtsams la sngags rnams ni/ /lus can kun la 'grub mi 'gyur/ /sems can kun rjes skyong ba yi/ /thub pa'i gtso bos sngon gsungs pa/ /gsang sngags smra bas bstan pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi yang dag sdom/ /sgrub po sngags ni kun shes shing / /rtog pa'i rgyal 93—815

po 'di la tshig /sngags kyi tshul gyis bstan pa yin/ /lam ni byang chub rgyur gyur pa/ /sngags kun nyid ni sgrub par byed/ /rig pa mnyam par 'gyur ba yin / /de ni ring por mi thogs par/ /mkhas pas dngos grub 'gyur ba yin/ /'byung po thams cad zhi don du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsgrags/ /gsang sngags tshul gyi lam 'dis ni/ /mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba yi/ /de bzhin rtag tu byang chub lam/ /chos don thams cad rdzogs par byed/ /de yi mthar thug dpung gnyen ni/ /dang po gnas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /de bzhin 'dir ni lhun grub tu/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i dngos grub thob/ /sna tshogs las dang chos shes pa/ /sngags rnams byed par 'gyur ba yin/ /tshul khrims bsam gtan rnam thar rnams/ /'di rnams mdor bsdus thob pa yin/ /dngos grub don kun sgrub byed pa/ /rgyal ba gtso bos gsungs pa yin/ /gang zag rkang pa'i don thob pa/ /dam pa'i 'gro bar gnas pa dang / /de bzhin rtag tu gnod sbyin gtso/ /tha mas rgyal srid rgyu yin te/ /lha min lha yi 'jig rten gyi/ /de bzhin de rnams bdag po ni/ /sngags pas thams cad thob par 'gyur / /bya ba 'bras bcas byed par 'gyur/ /gtsang sbra'i kun spyod yang dag ldan / /tshul khrims bsam gtan rtag tu dga'/ /sngags rnams kun tu gsungs pa yin/ /de nas sngags pas sngags bzlas bya/ /sngags pa 'byor pa 'dod pa yis/ /rnam pa sna tshogs las byas te/ /de bzhin mchog dang bar ma dang / /tha ma nyid kyang bya ba yin/ /tha mas longs spyod 'phel ba yin/ /bar mas gong ma'i lus can nyid/ /mchog nyid kyis ni ldang ba nyid/ /zlos pos rtag tu thob par byed/ /sngags pas bzlas mthar ngal bso zhing / /ji srid 93—816

dus su brtag par bya/ /bzlas pa'i dus la bab pa na/ /der ni bsgrub pa bya ba yin/ /de bzhin las rnams sgrub par byed/ /de la rtag tu bzlas pas skyes bu rang gi sdig pa zad par byed do/ /sngags pas sngon las kyi cho ga gang byas pa skye ba brgyud pa rnams su grub par gnas pa de/ de bzhin du las tshogs la rnyed par 'gyur ba de skyes pas sngags bzlas pas/ slar yang sngags zlos pa po'i sdig pa zad pa'i don dang / las de 'joms shing sngags grub par 'gyur te/ de bzhin du mchog dang / bar ma dang tha ma'i 'jig rten gyi mchod pa dang bzlas pas sdig pa ma lus par zad par byed cing / skye ba brgyud pa rnams su gang bar byas / sdig pa de thams cad 'jig par byed de de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sngags bzlas pas/ lus rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan 1pa dang /thub pa rnams kyis gnas pas dga' ba dang / yon tan thams cad kyis grags par 'gyur ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi nakhang par gnas pa'i rgyal po nyid dang /rtag tu don thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob pa dang ldan no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes dkyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa las/ras ris bar ma'i cho ga rab 'byam 4ste 5dgu pa rdzogs so// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyod nyon cig /khyod kyi rig pa'i sngags rjes su spyod pa 93—817

sems can mtha' dag gi don la brtson pa/ sems can rnams gang gis bzlas par bya ba'i rig pa'i sngags dang / gang dang ldan pas bgrang bar bya ba'i bgrang phreng gi cho ga /rgyud thams cad kyi thun mong gi sgrub (1)thabs kyi cho ga sngags thams cad kyi cho ga de legs par nyon la/ legs par yid la zung 9kyishig bshad par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / sems dpa' chen pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la rjes su brtse bas nye bar blangs nas rig pa'i sngags thams cad kyi spyod pa dang / dam tshig la rab tu zhugs pa'i sems can rnams dang / sems can thams cad kyi ri chodon gyi phyir yang de bka' stsal du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 4la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po rnam par dbye ba rgyas par bshad par bya'o nyon cig /gang gis sngags thams cad kyi spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa/ sems can gyi don thams cad sgrub par byed pa de gang zhe na/dang po re zhig5 /sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ na maḥsarba bud+dhā 64/ a tsin+dhad+dha 3rata / rū 2pi māṃ/ tar+ya thā/ o ku ru ku ru sarba ar+sha sā dhā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭa bi mo ha ni/ ga ga nā ba lo be/ bi sho dhā 9ya swā hā/ rig pa 'dis bgrang phreng thams cad la las bya'o/ /sbyang ba dang / dbugs pa dang / blang ba dang /rgyu ba la sogs pa'i las rnams bya'o/ /dang po bgrang phreng nyu shing la ni/ lan grangs sum cu rtsa bdun du/ /de yis mngon par bsngags 11byas nas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bsrung ba bya/ /mtshan mo gcig tu gnyid log nas/ /der ni 93—818

rmi lam brtag par bya/ /mi ma yin gzugs kun rdzogs pa/ /mi sdug lhag par mche ba gtsigs/ /sngags pa la ni des smras pa/ /bcom ldan sems pa ji bzhin long 6)/ /sgrub po tho rangs langs nas ni/ /shing de ru ni 'gro bar byed//mi sdug gzugs ldan gtsigs pa che/ /rmi lam du yang ma mthong na/ /sngags pas shing de bor bar bya/ /de nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /dang po ru druk+ṣa tshon yin te/ /de las 5)gzhan pa dbang po'i shing / /bo de tse dini 'dod pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu 'byung ba yi/ /shing la 'dzegs pa'i legs rdzogs pa'i/ /grogs dang lhan cig 'dzeg (55par bya/ /grogs po med par gyur na ni/ /rang nyid de la 'dzeg chudapar bya/ /steng gi yal ga'i 'bras gnas su/ /'dzegs 7nas phun tshogs brtul zhugs can/ /de la rtag tu bag yod pas/ /steng gi yal ga'i 'bras bu blangs/ /steng gi sa la legs sbyar bya/ /steng gi mchog gi dngos grub tu/ /gang zag mchog gis gsungs pa yin/ /bar mar dngos grub 'bring po ste/ /tha ma la ni 'og ma'o/ /srog chags rnams kyis ma smad pa'i/ /'bras bu de rnams yang dag blang 8/ /nub kyi yal ga las thob pa/ /rdzas kyi rgyur ni bsgrub par bya/ /byang gi gnod sbyin mo la sogs/ /lha rnams lhan cig 'gugs par byed/ /dgug pa'i bya ba bshad pa ni/ /kun gyi don du zhi phyir rol/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed dang / /mi'am ci dang srin po rnams/ /'dod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed/ /'byung po thams cad rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu dang bcas las rnams ni/ /ma lus spyod pa byed pa'o/ /shar gyi phyogs su yal ga dang / /der gnas 'bras bu 'byung ba rnams/ /de bzhin 'bad pas byas gyur na/ /tshe ring po yi don gyi rgyu/ /rtag tu sngags kyis dngos 93—819

grub 'bras/ /rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa yin/ /gang zhig lhor ni 'gro ba yi/ /yal ga lo mar rab ldan pa/ /sems can rnams kyi srog 'phrog byed/ /de ni 1)zlos pos 'bad pas spang / /lho ru rten pa'i yal ga la/ /'bras bu gang du yang dag brjod/ /phyogs der na)gdung dbye dgra rnams kyi/ /srog ni 'jig par byed pa yi/ /bsod nams ma yin mang po'i rgyu/ /de ni zlos pos 'bad pas spangs / /'og tu 'phyang ba'i yal gar gnas/ /'bras bu gang zhig rab bsgrags pa/ /lha ma yin dang ldan pa yi/ /sa yi 'og tu de rnams 'gro/ /de rnams 'bras bcas phreng ba ni/ /blangs nas yang dag rab bsgrags pa/ /'og tu 'gro ba'i 'khri shing la/ /de nas de ni sa 'og 'gro/ /de ru rab tu zhugs nas lha'i/ /bde nyid zlos pos der 'gyur ro/ /lha min bu mos yang dag ldan / /de ni bskal par gnas par byed/ /bgrang phreng 'bras bu kun blangs nas / /de nas zlos pos bzlas pa bya/ /lhan cig srung ba byas nas ni/ /de nas ji ltar bde bar 'gro/ /de nyid ring po'i gnas su ni/ /gtsang ma'i phyogs der sngags pa ni/ /de bzhin rtag tu 'dug par bya/ /bgrang phreng skyes pa sbyar bar bya/ /brtson pas bgrang phreng 'bras bu blang / /de nas kun tu yang dag sbyang / /der ni phreng ba dbugs ril par grags/ /gsum bdun brgyad dang gcig dang ni/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /sngags shes der ni sbyang bar bya / /rtag tu snga ma'i sngags kyis ni/ /brgyad dam bdun du bzlas byas pa/ /de nas de ni dag par 'dod/ /pad+ma'i rtsa lag legs brjod pas/ /bu mos gebakal ba'i srad bu yine/ /sum 'gyur lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis phreng thag bya/ /sngags kyi de nyid shes pas brgyu/ /'bras bu phra mo zlum 793—820

por bcas/ /rtag tu srog chags bu ga med/ /yan lag ma nyams ma smad pa/ /mdzes shing kha dog sdug pa dang / /bu ga med cing gas pa med/ /ril 11bu zlum po ji (7bzhin pa/ /de bzhin ru dāk+ṣa (5)dang ni/ /bo de tse dang in+t+ra (4nak+ṣa/ /'bras nyid rtag tu lung thang mdzes/ /'bras bu dam pa'am gang gi tshe/ /sngags pa mchog tu brtson pa yis/ /'bad pas bgrang phreng brgyu bar bya/ /gser ram yang na dngul dag gam/ /nor bu shel las byung ba dang / /mu tig dung nyid mu sa (5)ra/ /byi 96)ru yis kyang bya ba ste/ /phreng ba rnam pa sna tshogs bya/ /gzhan yang rin chen las byung ba'i/ /bgrang phreng bzang po bya ba dang / /sa las byung ba'i ldum po yi/ /ril bus bgrang kyi phreng can dag ni/ /mnyam par bzhag (8༄ste srad bu brgyu/ /gzhan yang ril bu 'ga' zhig gam/ /'bras bu'am khams las byung ba yis/ /ku sha'i rtse mos brgyus pa yang / /zlos pos 'bad de bya ba yin/ /brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu lnga/ /lnga bcu 'di dag bar ma yin/ /sngags pa mnyam par gzhag pa yis/ /'bras bu'i tshad rnams brgyu bar bya/ /stong rtsa brgyad pa nyid bya ba/ /phreng ba 'di ni thu bo yin/ /phreng ba rnam pa 'di bzhi ('o)ni/ /sngags pas rtag tu brgyu bar bya/ /de nas brgyus 7te sngags rnams ni / /phyi mo gsum mam gnyis nyid dang / /rgya lcags las byung gdu bu dang / /de bzhin gser dang dngul dag dang / /de nas zangs byung gdu bus kyang / /phreng ba kun nas brgyu bar 11bya/ /de nas mtha' ru yang mig 1 bya/ /de la rim gyis dgod par bya/ /'bad pas mdzes par dkri ba bya/ /sangs rgyas ma lus bzhugs par ni/ /yongs su gsal bar byas de nas/ /dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba yin/ /sbrul gyi gdengs ku'i rnam pa bzhin/ /yongs su dkris pas 93—821

brgyan 17pa yin/ /mu tig do shal rnams mtshungs shing / /mgul rgyan rnam par sprul pa'o/ /de nas 'bab chu dge ba'i mthar/ /dri ma med la khrus byas nas/ /go rims 5)ji bzhin khrus byas te/ /chu yi gnas la ldang bar bya/ /de bzhin brtson pas nye reg bya/ /bgrang phreng srad bu blangs nas ni/ /ba yi rnam lngas rab tu bkrugs/ /sa yi phye mas rab bkrus nas/ /gtsang ma'i gos la dri bzang gis / /rjes su nye bar byugs pa dang / /rab tu bsngags pa'i kha dog kyang / /tsan+dan dkar po gur gum dang / /'bad pas dron mos bkru bar bya/ /de bzhin gnyis ka 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ji lta'i gnas su song nas ni/ /gang du ras ris bar pa ni/ /rgyal mchog thub pa'i gtso bo ni/ /shākya seng ge mi yi mchog /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan de bzhin du/ /sa stengs (4)rgyal ba'i ring bsrel can/ /mchod pa de yi spyan sngar dgod/ /de dang nye bar bzhag nas ni//de tshe de yi 55spyan snga ne ru/ /dam tshig la gnas stong rtsa brgyad/ /son pa'am brgya yang gcig tu ni/ /brgyad dang bcas pa bzlas byas nas/ /nyin mtshan smyung bar gnas gyur nas/ /bdun pa'i thub la 8phreng ba dbul/ /snga ma de bzhin bzlas 9༄bya ba/ /tshad nyid de dang mnyam par bya/ /de nas phreng la ⑩yongs su bzlas/ /mtshan mo de nyid du 'khod de/ /ku sha bting hu7ba'i sa gzhi thertel / /sngags shes der ni nyal bar bya/ /rmi lam gang dang gang mthong ba/ /dge ba'i rmi lam mthong na ni/ /rmi lam nges par bstan pa yin snye/ /dngos grub de yis bsgrub par bya/ /sangs rgyas nyan thos bse ru rnams/ /gal te rmi lam mthong gyur na/ /sngags pas 'bras bu bcas par 'grub/ /nges par de yi cho ga bya/ /dge slong gzugs dang bram ze yi/ /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 93—822

mdzes pa mthong / /gal te rmi lam de mthong na/ /phreng ba dbul bya de bzhin du / /sngags kyi don kun sgrub 5)pa po/ /de bzhin gdon mi za bar 'grub/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi 2)rtsa ba'i rtog pa las / ras ris bar ma'i cho ga rab 'byam nalas bcu pa bgrang phreng gi cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam 4rdzogs so// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar yang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la gzigs nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po khyod kyi rig pa'i sngags kyi le'u rdzogs pa'i khyad par gyi cho ga dang / sbyin sreg gi las rab tu sbyor ba'i rig pa'i sgrub pa yod de/ me la nye bar spyod pa'i khyad par gyi cho ga las gang du rig pa'i spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa'i sems can rnams rab tu sbyor zhing gnas par 'gyur ba de gang zhe na/ rig pa'i sngags kyi tshogs gsang chen ni/ tar+ya thā/ o tiṣ+ṭha ha ri piṅga le/ hi rak+ṣa di hi da dā dī 95)bā ya ju phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di ni mchog gi snying po las thams cad byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad ster ba'o/ /dang po re zhig (6 sgrub pa pos me'i snying po 'di lan cig 7bzlas pas/ mar gyi sreg tsho blugs gsum me la sbyin sreg bya ste me lha spyan drangs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rab tu sbyar te/ zhi ba can dang / rgyas pa can dang / drag po'i las rnams la yam shing rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ro/ /mya ngan med shing zhi don 93—823

du / /khyad par brlan dang bcas pa nyid/ /mtho gang 'am /77ni khru gang tsam/ /sor mo gsum du'ang mtho ba yi/ /snam ( pa'i rnam pa rab tu shes/ /cho ga 'di ni bya ba yin/ /bu ga med cing ser ga med/ /de bzhin ne tso'i gshog (5)pa 'dra / /ljang dang dkar ba'i kha dog gam/ /kha dog nag po spang bar bya /srin bu rnams kyis zos pa spang / /bu ga med pa'ang yang dag sbyin/ /gzhan yang kha dog mchog min pa/ /tha ma'i chos kyang spangs pa'o/ /de rnams skam dang rlon pa'ang yin/ /de yi tshe yang brtsam par bya/ /ma rul yon po min nyid dang / /shin tu ring ba'ang spang bar bya/ /de nas me thab byas nas ni/ /kun nas zur ni bzhi pa ru/ /'og nyid du ni 'bad pas brkos)/ /khru bzhi pa yi (5citshad dang ni/ /khru gsum khru ni gnyis pa dang / /de bzhin nyid du khru gcig pa/ /rtag tu srog chags spangs pa dang / /bye mas legs par sbyar ba de/ /de nas pad 'dra'i kha khyer ni/ /kun nas dkyil 'khor rnam pa'o/ /yang na 'bad pas zur bzhi pa/ /'dab ma gsum du bya ba'o/ /zhi ba can dang rgyas pa can/ / 'di yang 6yang dag bsgrags pa yin/ /mngon spyod la ni sa dbus su/ /rdo rje bya zhing 7rtse gnyis su/ /rtse mo gsum du bya ba yin/ /me thab rgya la khru gnyis re/ /gtsang ma'i phyogs su de bzhin bdar/ /chu klung 'gram du de bzhin spyad/ /bstan pa gcig gi phyogs rnams dang / /dur khrod khang pa stong pa ru/ /sbyin sreg legs par brtsam napar bya/ /de bzhin ri bo'i rtse nyid dang / /rtag tu lha khang stong pa dang / /de bzhin nyid du dgon 9pa che/ /gang yang sgrub pa'i phyogs rnams ni/ /gang zag mchog gis gsungs pa dang / /sbyin sreg tshalas ni thams cad la/ /de rnams gnas su gsungs pa yin/ /khru gang tshad du gnas 93—824

pa yi/ /ku sha'i khres la nyer 'dug nas/ /der ni sngags shes khyad par du/ /sbyin sreg 6)gi ni las bya'o/ /gnas de nyid du rab gnas pas/ /myur du dngos grub the tshom med/ /shar dang byang du kha phyogs pas/ /zhi ba can dang rgyas pa bya/ /lho ru drag po'i lam 5rnams te/ /de ni sngags pas spang bar bya/ /shar bltas zhi ba'i dngos grub ste/ /rgyas pa can yang byang du phyogs/ /de yis sngags ni dus rtag tu/ /rig pa'i bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /bil ba arga slak+ṣa dang / /n+ya gro dha yis rgyas las bya/ /mngon spyod shing ni skam po dang / /tsha ba skyur dang rnon po rnams/ /de dag thams cad spang bya ste/ /thub pa rnams kyis rtag tu bkag /zhi (ri ba can dang rgyas pa can/ /rlon pa'i shing gis parab tu shis / /de bzhin drag las la shing skam/ /tsha ga ba skyur dang rnon po rnams/ /yam shing de rnams med na ni/ /shing la de rnams su rtag 96bya/ /rtse mo gnyis su brtag 7)pa bya/ /sngo dang snum dang 'dra ba dang / /rma bya'i mgrin pa dang mtshungs pa'i/ /rnam pa de lta'i ku sha yis/ /kho ra yug tu ku sha ni/ /rtag tu dgram 87par bya ba ni/ /zhi ba can dang rgyas pa can/ /mar gad dang ni mtshungs pas so/ /de bzhin rtag tu skam po'i rtsis9/ /sdig pa'i las ni bya ba ste / /'dir ni rgyal ba mchog gis bkag /dri med chu ni dag pa la/ /rtag tu srin bus spangs pa yi/ /de nas kun nas bsang 7gtor bya/ /g.yas phyogs su ni bskor byas te/ /brtson pas me ni sbar bar bya/ /cho ga ji bzhin nye reg bya/ /gtsang ma'i rtswa /lhayi rtsa ba yis/ /sgron me tshad dang ldan byas nas/ /de nas khu tshur brtsams byas nas/ /'bad pas me ni sbar bar bya/ /kha yi rlung gis mi bya ste / /rtag tu gos kyi mthas 12kyang min/ /sham thabs bla gos mngon par spang / /93—825

gos gzhan gyis kyang lag pa yi/ /rlung gi 91)nye bar gzhom (5)pa la/ /mngon par dga' bas ma yin no/ /gtsang ma'i rlung yab de bzhin gos/ /nor bus kyang ni rlung yab ( bya/ /rlung ni yang dag 'byung ba 'dis/ /me ni mnyam par byas pa la/ /sngags shes pas ni me sbar gi)bya'o/ /sbyin sreg don du mnyam gzhag (snyepas / /de nas g.yas pa min pa yis/ /der ni bsang gtor byas nas ni/ /der ni ba yi 6)mar gyis ni/ /sreg (7)blugs gsum ni sbyin par bya/ /de nas kyang ni phyag bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dang skyob pa dang / /rang sngags sngags kyi mgon po la/ /de nas ci 'dod phyag bya'o/ /de tshe me yi snying po yi/ /sngags ni lan brgya bzlas pa yis/ /brtson ldan dri zhim me tog gis/ /rtag tu me ni spyan drang bya/ /sngags shes rtag tu spyan drangs nas/ /gnas la mkhas pas gdan dang gnas/ /sngags des dbul zhing gzhan gyis min/ /zho dang mar rinastadu bsres pa dang / /sbrang rtsi btags 9pa'i yam shing ni/ /de las lan gsum sbyin sreg sna bya/ /rgyas pa'i don du sngags dang las/ /kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba yis/ /'khrugs pa der ni nges sbyar bya/ /skom pa tshim par bsam par bya/ /zhi ba'i las dang rgyas nyu1pa can/ /de la gsang sngags rig pa yis/ /lha yi gzugs ni dga' ba'o/ /mngon spyod las la thun mong ba'i/ /nges par 'byung ba'i lha rnams las/ /gzhan pa'i gzugs ni blta bar bya/ /rim pa ji bzhin me thab 'dir/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog dang / /mar la lan bdun yongs bzlas pas/ /de tshe spyan drang rnam pa der/ /ji ltar slar yang spyan drangs pa/ /lhag par gnas pas gnyis ka gnas/ /yam shing rdzas dang bsres pa dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi mnyam bstan pa/ /de bzhin mdu ni 3)zho bsres pas/ /stong 93—826

ngam 'bum gyi tshad dang ni/ /brgya 6)dang brgyad du'ang rtag par bya/ /de bzhin sngags pas rig pa bzung / /lan re bzlas shing me la dor/ /'bar ba'i me yi phreng ba dang / /de bzhin me lce gcig gyur pa/ /zhi ba'i las kyi sbyin sreg 5)bya/ /du ba med la 'ang rgyas pa can/ /du bcas drag po'i las rnams ni/ /rgyal bas smad cing spangs pa yin/ /me ni kha dog ldan gyur na/ /sbyin sreg las ni rab tu sbyar/ /zhi ba can la kha dog dkar/ /rgyal ba mchog gis rtag tu bsngags/ /gal te me dkar sbyin sreg byed/ /de la sngags rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rtag tu kha dog dkar/ /rgyas pa can gyis (gedangos grub 'dod/ /nag po du ba'i kha dog dang / /ser skya yang ni sdig pa can/ /kha dog rnam gsum rab bsgyur bas/ /dngos grub rnam gsum 'di dag yin/ /gzhan pa'i kha dog sprin mdog gam/ /slar yang brtan (4pa'i sa stengs (5)der/ /sngags pa de la dngos grub med/ /de lta'i kha dog 'dra ba 'am/ /rnam pa sna tshogs kha dog can/ /me ni 'bar ba de mthong na/ /slar yang las rnams brtsam phyi par bya/ /phyir zhing bzlas pa bya ba yin/ /gal te sngags ni grub gyur na/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis / /slar yang sbyin sreg la rab 'jug /gshegs gsol spyan drang nyid la ni / /me yi sngags ni brjod par bya/ /sngar ni rab tu brtags pas 7kyang / /dkyil 'khor 'di ni gshegs su gsol/ /spyan drang ba 85yi las rnams ni/ /de nyid du ni las rnams kyang / /de nyid kyis ni bya ba yin/ /me yi 9spyod pa de bzhin gzugs/ /ras ris kyi ni spyan sngar brtsam/ /der ni sngags rnams 'grub 'gyur b.ratsha/ /sngon gyi 11de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i las rnams ni/ /thams cad de nyid du bya'o/ /gzhan pa'i las 93—827

ni bya ba ste/ /sdig pa'i las ni khyad par du/ /gang du rgyal mchog gis smod dang / /'jig rten 'gal dang smad rnams so/ /ldang dang 'khor los sgyur 6)ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams dang / /de bzhin mngon shes lnga dang ni / /'jig rten lha nyid ldan pa 'grub/ /rtag tu ras ris la brtson shes/ /sbyin sreg las la mkhas pa ni/ /sa yi 'og gi bdag po 'am/ /yang na bar snang spyod par 'gyur/ /sa bla'i lha dang gnod sbyin nyid/ /rtag tu gnod sbyin mo rnams 'gugs/ /rgyal srid bdag po nyid dang ni/ /yul dang yang na grong nyid dam/ /rig pa 'dzin dang lha min nyid/ /sems can thams cad dbang du byed/ /'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed/ /sems dpa' chen po bdag nyid chen / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /sa bcu la ni yang dag brten/ /sbyin sreg las kyis 'gugs byed na/ /sa stengs ri nimi rnams smos ci dgos/ /sde dpon bdag po de bzhin du/ /khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /'byung po thams cad kun dbang byed/ /de bzhin nyid du mi bdag nyid/ /'byung po thams cad dbang don dang / /yang na sa stengs 47rgyal po mnyam/ /de bzhin rtag tu las kun la/ /thams cad sbyin sreg 45gis ni bya/ /kun nas kun tu brtson ldan pas/ /las kun yang dag bsten par bya/ /de ched nges par bsgrub par bya/ /dpal don las ni mchog yin te/ /bar ma nyid kyang sgrub par byed/ /yang na chung ngu nyid kyang ngo / /de bzhin du ni rdzas rnams kun/ /de bzhin slar yang 'grub par gsungs/ /sbyin sreg las la rab 'jug pas/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i phyidangos grub mthong / /phyag rgya bcing dang rig pa nyid/ /las rnams kun la rtag tu bya/ /sbyin sreg las la rab 93—828

'jug pas/ /bdag nyid srung bar 'gyur ba yin(1)/ /de nas sngags 'di bklag par bya/ /'di ni rtag tu las rnams la/ /bdun bzlas pa 'am brgyad bzlas so/ /na maḥsarba bud+dha 95)bo dhi satā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta ga ti ma ga tā māṃ/tar+ya thā/ oṃ dzā la tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ ru ru bi shwa sam+bha be swā hā/ /sngags kyi rab sbyor 'di yis ni/ /slar yang shing la bzlas bya ba/ /gnyis bzlas pa'am bdun bzlas pa/ /sngags rig des mer sbyin sreg rdo bya/ /me tog bdug pa dri dag gam / /mdor na thams cad nyid kyang ni/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i chu rnams kyis / /'di nyid kyis ni bsang 94)gtor bya/ /de nas las rnams thams cad ni / /rgyu 'dis cho ga brtsam cho5)par bya/ /las 6rnams dag ni thams cad la/ /snga ma'i rab sbyor nyid kyis bya/ /sngar gyi skra can ma bcings nas/ /phyag rgya chen mor grags ldan ma/ /bsrung 97)ba byas par gyur de nas/ /zlos pos rig pa gcig gis ni/ /las rnams thams cad brtsam 87par bya/ /dngos grub rgyu la mkhas pa yis/ /gal te dge mtshan mthong gyur pa/ /rtag tu dge ba'i sgra grags na/ /de la sngags kyi 'bras bu ni/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin mchog stsol 'gyur / /dang po las la rab sbyor dang / /sngags kyi rgyu la rab 'jug pas/ /'bras med 'bras bu 79ribacas pa nyid/ /dngos grub de la brjod par bya/ /rgyal ba'i sgra 'am pa ṭa ha/ /rnga bo che yi sgra grags 7na/ /brtson ldan kun 'gro'i dngos grub ste/ /sbyin sreg las la yang dag brten/ /gzhan yang dge mtshan dpal dang ni/ /'dab chags sgra ni bzang po dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sgra dbyangs sam/ /rgyal bas bsngags shing rab bsngags 11pa/ /bkra shis bzang po yid 'ong dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs sgra dang ni/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba 93—829

dan dang / /bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /de bzhin bum pa gang ba dang / /mchod yon mthong na dngos grub rgyu/ /kha dog rnam pa du ma dang / /rab sngags 1)'jig rten gyis mchod pa'i/ /dge slong rnams dang dge slong ma/ /mthong nas de rnams blta ba la/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul sna tshogs 'grub/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde/bcom ldan 'das ma na'aphags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa las / bgrang phreng srad bu'i cho ga'i le'u rab 'byam ci tabacu gcig pa yongs su rdzogs so// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la gzigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po khyod kyi rig pa'i gsang chen yod do/ /sngags thams cad kyi (4)sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'i dam tshig shes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod las byung ba/ chos kyi sprin la mthun 5par rab tu zhugs pa5yi/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags kyi mnga' bdag ches gtso bor gyur pa sems dpa' chen po dper na de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams cad kyi gtso bo/ ches gtso bor gyur pa lha dang mi rnams kyi 3nang nas skyes bu'i khyu mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin du rig pa'i rgyal po 'di ni sngags thams cad kyi mchog tu bstan 8cing / gtso bo dam pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i 9 klung 93—830

gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brjod du med pa rnams kyis sngar gsungs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gi mchog gi snying po mchog tu gsang ba kun nas bkra shis par 'dod pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yang dag par bstod cing rab tu bsngags la/ sems can thams cad la dbugs 'byin pa / sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa/re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa de gang zhe na/ bar skabs 'dir bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par skul tsho1)bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer byung bar gyur 2to/ /gang 'di/ phyogs bcu steng 'og thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kun du snang zhing sems can thams cad kyi yid kyang tshim par byas nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gtsug tor du nub par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor nas kun nas 'bar ba'i 'phro ba'i lus can blta bar mi nus pa'i sems can kun gang gis kyang mi thub pa/ 'od chen po yang dag par byung ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis lus brgyan pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can/ 'khor los sgyur (4rib chen po'i gzugs dang ldan pa/rig pa'i rgyal po yi ge gcig pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byung nas nam mkha'i dkyil kun du snang bar 5byas te/ rig pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas mdun du bdar nas mchod bzhin pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi bla ma/ rig pa'i 'khor los sgyur 6ba'i rgyal pos mngon par bsngags 7bzhin pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mnga' sgyur 8)bzhin pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 93—831

sa bcu la bzhugs pa rnams kyi rim gro byed bzhin pa'i blo gros chen po/ nam mkha'i dkyil thams cad kyi lha'i rin po ches nye bar mdzes pa dang / nor bu rin po che'i don du byas pas thams cad bkang ste/ mdzes pa'i gzugs can mchog tu 'od gsal ba/ sprul pa po rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 'byin bzhin pa/ yi ge gcig pa'i sgra 'don bzhin pa/'od zer chen po 'bar ba rab tu 'phro bzhin pa bar snang gi phyogs su gnas par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la nye bar phyogs nas lta bar byed bzhin pa / de thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la kun du lta zhing snang bar byed bzhin pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas yi ge gcig pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po 'di bka' stsal to/ /na maḥsarba bud+dhā 14/ r+ghaṃ bka' stsal pa tsam nanyid la 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams thams cad du rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos par gyur to/ /sems can gang la la bkres pa dang skom pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal skyes pa med par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rdzu 'phrul yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir dang sdig pa thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par sbyong bar byed pa'i phyir dang / rtog pa'i rgyal po 'di sems can thams cad yang dag par srung ba'i phyir dang / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i phyir dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba kun du bstan pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzu 93—832

'phrul gyi (1)mthu kun tu bstan pa'i phyir rig pa'i rgyal po chen (napo'i rtog pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /sems dpa' chen po gang la sngags kyi rgyal po 'di sgrub par 'dod na de'i don gyi phyir cho ga 'dir 'gyur ro/ /dang po re zhig ri ma brtags dzo pa dang / mi smra ba dang / mi za bar brjod pa'i mthu dang / sngags kyis ri5'dul ba (5)la rab tu brtson pas 'byung po thams cad la rab tu brtse bas gzhan sdug na bdag sdug par legs par mthong bar byed pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa dbang po rnams legs par bzung ste rnam par g.yeng ba dang bcas pa'i sems dang / nga rgyal dang / ser sna lag pa la 'jug pa/ rab tu dgag pa'i don du rdzas yongs su 'jal ba dang / lha gzhan la phyag mi byed pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la dang ba (77shin tu mngon du gyur pa'i dad pa'i nor gyis bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la mngon par dang ba nadang / snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid dang / legs par brtson pa'i bsam pas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / mdor na byang chub chen por smon lam btab pa/ rgyun du sgrub par 'gyur bar bya'o/ /de la dang po re zhig 9byis sku'i cho gar 'gyur 7te rgyal po thams cad kyi bdag po 'khor los sgyur 11ba/ ma nyams pa'i ras lhag ma min 8pa/ kha dog can la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs 'drir gzhug par bya ste / gser ltar ser ba'i gzugs brnyan 15chos ston par byed bzhin pa seng ge'i khri la nye bar bzhugs pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa lus thams cad kun nas 'bar ba'i do shal can bya'o/ /steng du ri'i rtse mor glog dang sprin dang bcas pa'o/ /'og tu pad+ma'i mtsho bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor 'od zer 1 las byung bzhin pa bya'o/ /sgrub pa po yang gnas dang 93—833

cha byad dang / dbyibs kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin dang / lag na spos phor thogs pa bcom ldan 'das la lta bar byed bzhin pa/ ras ris rnam pa de lta (1)bur bris la sgrub pa po yang dus gsum du khrus bya zhing gos gtsang ma bgos te/skye bo dang bral 2riba'i dben par rgyun chen por ras ris bzhugs su gsol la rnam pa thams cad du lus dang ngag dang / sems yongs su skyo ba med par sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas/ zla ba nya la nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas te sgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /lo ma dang / zan dang /'o ma dang / slong ri rimo'i bsod snyoms kyi bza' ba dang / chu dang / phye'i bza' ba'am/ 'o ma dang nas zan bza' ri dbar bya'o/ /a ga ru'i bdug pa bsregs te 'bum phrag bcur bzlas pa bya'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas pa dang /sngon spyad pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mig sman sgrub par 'dod na dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa'i/ dpa' bo bzang po las byung ba'i mig sman srang gcig blangs nas bram ze'i bu mos ba byung lnga kha byang du bltas pa 'thag tu gzhug par bya'o / /ming med kyi sor mos ril bu bzhi byas la pad+ma'i 'dab mas bkab la skam du gzhug par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi cho ga bzhin du me sbar nas stong phrag rdzogs par sbyin sreg pa bya ste/ de nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la ras ris bzhugs nas mchod pa rgya chen po rgya chen por byas te/phyogs brgyad du pa lā nesha'i shing gis me sbar nas zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pa'i rnam par 'dren pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bzhi rnams su dkyil 'khor byas nas phyogs skyong ba rnams bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor gnyis par rab tu sad par byed pa lag tu yungs kur thogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor 93—834

gsum par legs par grogs bzang po'am/ grogs med kyang rung ste/ sngags kyi mchod pa chen po byas nas bsrung ba bya ste17/ kha shar du phyogs pas nye bar 'dug la ku sha bting zhing nabakram nas a shwat+tha'i ri ci'adab ma gsum gyi steng nas dang ske/ bzhis 'og nas g.yogs te/ lag pas mnan la ji srid dro 4bar gyur pa dang / du ba 'thul ba dang / rab tu 'bar ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /dang po dngos grub ni 'dis rgyal ba'i bdag nyid kyi spyan te/ gang mthong ba dang / gang rnams mthong ba de rnams thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa'i dngos grub ni glang po che dgu'i stobs dang / rlung ltar mgyogs pa dang /lo lnga brgyar 'tsho ba dang / glang po che bcu 'phrogs pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi zil gyis gnon pa ma yin pa dang 'bar zhing 'char ba'i nyi ma dang 'dra ba/ lus rin po ches brgyan 5pa/ bar gyi bskal par gnas shing gzhan 'dren par byed pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa zil gyis mi non pa'i 'khor los sgyur 6ba / gsar du 'gro bzhin pa/ rlung gi lam bdun du rnam par rgyu bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /rna ba'i mig sman bsten pa dang / ldong ros lag pa yang dngos grub rnam pa gsum mo/ /de nas 7rdo rje sgrub par 'dod na thog rdzog pa'i shing nasablangs nas/ sor bcu drug pa'i tshad kyi rdo rje'i rnam pa bya'o/ /zlum skor du khru gang tsam gyi 9tshad kyi 1 mchod rten byas nas/ de'i spyan sngar cho ga 'di mthong bas zla ba nya la mtshan mo gsum du smyung 11bar gnas pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas rdo rje de nyid la nges par sems pas lta bzhin pa dang ldan pas rdo rje blangs te/ dur khrod du 'gro bar bya'o / /shar du rgyun 'bab pa dang mthun 12pa'i rgyun bya'o/ /chu klung gi 'gram 93—835

gnyis kyis 17blangs nas ba byung lngas zlum skor 〈khubya'o/ /zlum skor (gebyas nas khru gang tsam gyi tshad kyi mchod rten byas nas de'i spyan sngar cho ga 'di mthong bas mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod du/ ras ris de'i drung du rdo rje bzhag ste/de'i steng du bzhag nas lag pas mnan la ji srid du gong bu'i 'og gi khung bur ltung ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas nas de nyid du lag pas rdo rje blangs nas rab tu 'jug go/ /bslangs (45pa'i bsod snyoms blangs nas bcom ldan 'das la gtor mas (5༄nye bar mchod de/ khrus byas nas rdo rje de nyid la dur khrod kyi thal ba ji srid sbags par so sor gzhag (6)go/ /cho ga 'dis dur khrod kyi 7)sha la bzlas par bya'o/ /mthar mtshan mo gsum du cho ga bzhin du gtor ma'i mchod pa dbul bar byas nas bdag nyid dam/ grogs bzang po la bsrung 8ba byas te/ lag pa gnyis kyis mnan te ji srid du dngos grub rnam pa gsum du gyur pa de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /dngos grub dang po la gang bltas pa dang gang gis mthong ba de rnams rab tu dga' zhing dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ras ris kyi sa'i rdul phyis pa tsam gyis mi snang ba dang / glang po che stong phrag dgu'i stobs dang ldan pa dang / rlung ltar mgyogs 9༄pa dang / skal ba drug 'phrog pa dang / 'dod pas 'gro ba dang 1 ri/ char 'bebs pa dang /rnam par snang bar byed pa dang / mthu chen por 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la ni nyi ma 'char ka dang mtshungs pa dang / lo stong phrag bcur 'tsho zhing 'khor los sgyur nyu1ba yang 'dren par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i lag par rnam par rgyu ste/ de bzhin du pad+ma dang dgra sta lag pa'i cho gas yang sna ngo / /de nas ril bu sgrub par 'dod na sngon du bsnyen pa byas te lor skyes pa'i sdigs 1rimadzub kyi sor mo 93—836

blangs nas 6)sngar gyi cho gas mchod rten byas te dur khrod du mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas kha shar du phyogs pas rab tu zhugs la de srid du sor mo nges par rig bya ston pas mnan nas rdo rje las 'od zer (5)'phro ba de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /nyin mo nam mkha'i rlung la bsrung ba bya zhing / mtshan mo gnyid mi log par tho rangs ji srid du sor mo rnams dgug par bya'o/ /bkug pa'i gnas der mtshan mo gsum du smyung tshos)bar gnas pa/ ba dang be'u rgyud mtshungs pa/ grags pa dang ldan pa'i 'o ma blangs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal dang / mar gyi mar me rab tu sbar nas ku sha'i khres la 'dug ste stong phrag brgyad mngon par bsngags (4)par byas nas sa'i snod du 'o ma blug par bya zhing / thal bas kyang dkyil 'khor bcings la tho rangs khrus byas nas sngar 'di nyid kyis nges par bsrubs pa'i mar sar (5)blangs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te stong phrag brgyad du mngon par bsngags (6)nas ma reg pa zos nas mthong ba zhes bya ste/ 'dod pa thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /grol bar 'dod na gnas la phan pa'i dri thams cad la sogs pa la dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos te mtshan mo gsum du smyung (7ribar gnas par byas te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa rgya chen po byas te/ mar gyi mar me rab tu sbar nas rang nyid sngags zlos shing brtag tshon par bya'o/ /de nas gzugs brnyan byas nas a shwat+tha'i dzo9'dab ma bdun gyi steng du bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji srid du rang gi 1 tshorig pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas phye mar byas nas phye ma des kun du reg 11pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis nā 1 ga ge sar gyi phye ma la gzugs brnyan byas te/ bdug pa'i kham phor 1 brgyad brgyar sbyin 93—837

sreg byas na gang la rjes su sems pa zhi)de dbang du byed do/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis a pā marga'i yam shing gis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /nor 'dod na shu ba lang gi gnas su song nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar sa la ma lhung ba'i ba byung gis lag pas ma bzos (8)pa'i mchod rten byas la cho ga bzhin du mchod nas gu gul bsregs te stong phrag brgyar bzlas pa bya'o/ /ba lang stong ngam nor rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis mar dang / sbrang rtsi la (gesogs bsreg (snyecing stong phrag brgyar bzlas pa bya'o/ /grong bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis mchod rten byas nas tsan+dan gyis btags pa'i pad+ma'i gdan dang lha bshos stong phrag brgya dbul te yul gyi dpon po thob par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis gu gul gyi bdug pa (rmebasregs te tsam pa ga'i me tog stong phrag brgya dbul te/ gser stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis nā 7ga ge sar gyi me tog stong phrag brgyar dbul bar bya ste/ ras bcos bu'i gos stong rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du me tog thams cad 'dod pa'i cho ga thams cad dur khrod du ro bsregs pa'i thal ba blangs nas zla ba nya la nyin mtshan du smyung 8bar gnas te ming med kyi sor mo'i khrag gis zlum skor (9nobyas nas gzugs brnyan nyu bris te rkang pa g.yon pas mnan nas stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa byas na/ dang po gos bdun dang / mdor na rigs dang bcas pa thams cad rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten byas nas shing a dhi ba la dza la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pa stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gang ston pa'i bu mo des sbyin par byed do/ /mi sbyin na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /sā la'i rgyab nas byung ba'i gzugs brnyan byas la yungs mar gyis 'di bkang nas 93—838

lcags kyi thur mas phug ste tsha ba'i til mar gyis byugs te dur khrod du stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /lus gcig pa'i bud med dam/ dmangs rigs dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la rje rigs dang / rgyal rigs ma'o/ /gsum pa la dge slong dang / bram ze ma'o/ /zhes te mdor na ma bsgrubs par yang las byed par 'gyur ro/ /gi wang 511la lan bdun mngon par bsngags 5pas khyad par du byas nas gang mthong ba dang / gang rnams mthong ba de thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mig sman gyis so/ /tho rangs langs nas lan bdun mngon par bsngags (5)pa'i chus bde bar khrus byas na 4tshogang la bltas pa de sbyin par byed cing de 'bangs su 757yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du til mar so la ma reg par bza' bas 'dod pas khyer 67ba'i chu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags ⑦par byas nas 'thungs na don du ma gnyer bar yang bza' ba rnyed do/ /rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs nas chos gos kyi mtha' nas bzung ste lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu yongs su bzlas nas lag pa g.yon pas mdud pa bya'o/ /rgyab tu mi lta bar song na smra ba thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun gyi nang du song bas kun du 'phrog par bya ba nyid la bzlas pas gtsang bar byed do/ /gcod pa dang /'bugs pa la sogs pa rnams kyi sngags rnams so/ /sā 2lu'i 'bru dang / ka ra bī 99ster dkar po dang / don grub dang / kā ba rnams kyis khogazugs brnyan byas nas lag pa g.yon pas mnan te stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa byas na steng du langs par byas par 'gyur ro/ /rims gzhom par 'dod na gi ri rat+na ka ra'i me tog la 9/lhastong phrag brgyad bzlas pa byas na nyi ma bdun gyis sha za'i 12rims nyams par byed do/ /seng ldeng gi yam shing gis sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas 93—839

na gdon thams cad 'joms par byed do/ /thal ba la lan bdun bzlas pas pha rol gyi sngags rnams 'ching bar byed do/ /chu la lan cig 6)bzlas pas grol lo / /de lta bu la sogs pa'i las rnams so/ /de nas ( yang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar dzod)yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de la gzigs nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po la bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par byed pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /de ni rigs kyi bdag po/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su yi rang ba rtog pa'i rgyal po 'di ④sgrub thabs kyi cho ga bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gsang chen du gyur pa sgrub pa pos gdon mi za ba ri kyikho nar dran par bya ba ste/ de sems dpa' chen po khyod la bshad do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das ma sgrub pa'i don du rigs kyi bdag po gsung du gsol/ 'dod pa phun sum tshogs byed pa/ /bcom ldan rdul mun rnam par grol/ /chags pas mngon par zhi ba dang / /byang chub nges 'byin sdig pa las/ /kun du gzigs pa'i zla ba la/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /srid rine pa'i sa bon rnam 'joms par/ /phyag 'tshal mchod de khyod la brten/ /bshad bya gal te 'byung bar byed/ /slar yang srid par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /tar+ya thā/ shwe te shwe to ge shwe bhu dze shwe ta/ mā lce rā 7lo kṛ te/ dza ye bi dza ye a dzi te a pa rā dzi te swā hā/ dran pa nyid las / 'di'i sngags kyi dngos grub myur du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di'i sngags ni tho rangs langs nas bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub pa pos gtsang mar gyur pa lan bdun byas chu bor zhugs shing thal mo sbyar te 93—840

yongs su bzlas nas shar du mngon par phyogs pas gtor bar bya'o/ /bgegs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang 'byung ngo / /snying khar 1)mthe bong byin nas lan cig (gebazlas na lha rnams kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro / /bdag nyid rnam par dag par 5)yang 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyag rgya yang 'dir sbyar bar bya'o/ /bgegs thams cad med par 'gyur zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang 'byung ngo / /snying khar (4)mthe bong byin nas lan cig 5bzlas na lha rnams kyis (6)byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid rnam par dag par yang 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyag rgya yang 'dir sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi cho gar 'gyur te/ ma nyams pa'i ras skra dang bral ba 'bras bu can nam / ma 'dres pa'i tshon gyis ri mo mkhan gso sbyong can gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i snying po la 'dug pa/stag gi pags 7)pa'i sham thabs can ral pa gyen du brjes pa de yang rab tu 'phyang bzhin pa/ phyag na bya ma bum thogs pa'am/ pad+ma dkar po'i 'dab ma bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gzhogs su lha mo 'phags ma dkar mo chen mo seng ge'i gdan la nye bar 'dug pa/ phyag pad+ma dang / mchog sbyin ma dang / sgrub pa po ni sngon bzhin no/ /de nas rig pa 'dzin pas 'o ma dang nas zan bza' zhing bris sku'i spyan sngar sngon du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /dri zhim po'i me tog lag pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang / mar gyi namar me dang / a ga ru dang / tu ruṣ+ka'i 9bdug spos dang / gtor ma yang rig pa 'dzin pas de bzhin du dbul bar bya'o / /na mo bud+dhā su/ na mo dharmā su/ na maḥse gha su/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te 7shwa rā /rtaya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo ār+sā 12ya/ ma hā satā ya/93—841

tar+ya thā/ su ru me su ru ma(1ri/ ku ru ku ru/ su ru me kurma sā dhā ya/ bud+dha sabye nanon/ dharma sarkye ( smin/ saṃ 4)lha sarkye pon)na/ ā 6)gats+tsha shī r+ghaṃ (7)de ba date (deswā hā / spyan drang ba'i rig pa'o/ /tar+ya thā/ da me da se swā hā/ dri'i rig pa'o/ /tar+ya thā/ hu hu hu ra hu ma hā me de swa re swā hā/ me tog gi rig pa'o/ /tar+ya thā/me gha bi hra (9)te swā hā/ bdug pa'i rig pa'o/ /tabya thā/ tu tu tu tu tu ru ma hā tshetu ru ṇi swā hā/ gtor ma'i rig pa'o/ /'di rnams nyid dang mar me bdun 11gyi phreng ba gnas pa'i ras ris kyi spyan sngar ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste / zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar la btags pa'i pad+ma'i sbyin sreg bya ste 'bum phrag bdun de srid par ro/ /rang nyid 'gul ba dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rang 'dod pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di nyid kyis bil ba'i yam shing gis stong phrag brgyar sbyin sreg byas na gang 'dod pa de yang dag par rdzogs par byed do/ /gang gā'i 15klung gi 'gram du nye bar gnod pa med pa/ skye bo dang bral bar bye ma la mchod rten byas nas dri dang me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pa phul te stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa bya'o/ /nyi ma so so kyi re re zhing mchod rten bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod phal po che theg pa chen po'i mdo sde bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa las le'u rab 'byam tshubacu gnyis pa rdzogs so// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la lha'i 93—842

spyan gyis gzigs nas/ yangs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya 1 ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te yangs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi rgyal po chen po 'di bka' stsal to/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 90ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā / bi ma le bi ma le/ bi pu la pra bhe/ bi pu la pri ye/ bi pu la ma ti/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ twa me/ ba ru r+sā9 kā/ sā (4)snya 957ya sā dha smyo ciya/ gardza gardza/ha na ha na/ bi pu la ma ti/ ṣ+ṭṛ 7)da ya/ ma nu sma ra/ bud+dha satre na / dharma sarkye na/ saṃ (9)lha sarkye na/ bo dhi satā satre na/ bi pu la ma ti satre na/ badz+ra pā ṇi 7sabye na/ sat+ya bā ti sarkye na/ le le le le/ o o o11/ bhu ba bhu ba bhu ba / ga ga ga /ma tha ma tha ma tha/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐/ a ba lo ki te1 / mu tse swā hā/'di ni mthu chen po thob pa yangs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i ting nge 'dzin las byung ba/bklags pas grub pa/ bdag srung ba dang / gzhan srung ba dang / grong srung ba dang / ri'i 'jigs pa dang / gdug pa'i 'jigs pa dang / sha za'i 'jigs pa dang / mdor bsdu na 'jigs pa thams cad bklags pa tsam gyis 12sel bar byed do/ /'di las gzhan yang sngags kyi cho gar 'gyur ba ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma yi.ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ma hā kā (8ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ da de shārnye/ pra san+da tsi te swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma tshamār+sā ba lo ki te 1 shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ shwe te sa ma ye h+ye thā /snye / bi shud+dha bste swā hā/ gos bgos pa'i sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/93—843

na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te 1)shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ mu ne mu ne/ shārnye bi shudhe ga ga na ta le pu gan+dhe gan+dha/ u da ka ba li (na tsa ha ra ha ra ka ra ka ra bi bhu swā hā/ me tog dang / dri dang /bdug pa dang / mar me thams cad la sngags 'dis lan bdun mngon par bsngags dpas lan cig 4 bzlas sam dbul bar bya'o/ /sa'i gong bu dkar pos rtag tu bdag nyid gtsang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la gur gum gyi chu dang / tsan+dan dang / ga pur gyi dri dang / tu ruṣ+ka la sogs pa dang / a ga 5ru'i bdug pa dang / bal+li 6ka'am/ tsam pa ga'i me tog gi phreng ba dang /'o ma sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'gro bar bya ste/ zan gyi gtor ma dang / ba'i mar gyi mar me rnams 7)so/ /de nas 'di'i ras ris 'byung ste/ 'dod pa'i skra dang bral ba kha tshar ma bcad pa ji ltar rnyed par gyur pa la bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gur gum gyis bri bar bya'o/ /chu las skyes pa'i pad+ma'i gdan dang phyag na pad+ma dang pad+ma'i phreng bas brgyan par byas pa/ gos dkar po can mchod phyir thogs pa/ phyag mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa/ ral pa gyen du brjes pa de lta bur bri bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sngar brjod pa'i gnas su ras ris zhal shar du mngon par phyogs par bzhugs su gsol nas 'bum phrag bcur bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa yongs su rdzogs pa na me sbar nas sbrang rtsi dang mar sbyar bas dus gsum du sbyin sreg ji srid 'bum rdzogs kyi bar du byas na nagang mngon par 'dod pa de rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal srid kyi longs spyod 'dod na gur gum dang / tsan+dan dang / me tog brgya pa dang / 'bras yos rnams gcig tu byas nas mar dang sbrang rtsis btags nas thun gsum du sbyin 93—844

sreg 51)bya'o/ /sbyin sreg mtha'i nyi ma la 95)mthong ba stsol bar byed do/ /mtshan ma 'di rnams (7kyang stsol te gtsug pud (4༄gyen du brjes par 'gyur ro/ /skyon med pa'i 'od kyi rgyal mtshan dang / phreng ba 'bar ba'i ras ris rab tu sbyin pa'am smra bar byed do/ /rig pa 'dzin pas yid kyis 5)bzlas pa bya/ nam mkhar lha'i ngag thos na grub pa yin no/ /de nas rgyal srid slar rnyed na chos kyis byed du gzhug go/ /slar yang de nyid ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya bzhin pa ni bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po rkang pa gcig pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po gsungs par gyur to/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+sā (6)ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bud+dha a bhi ṣe ka su pra dz+wa li ta dīp+ta 7rine pra/ bhu dzā ya pra dz+wa li te /dīp+ta ha pu ka maṇ+ḍa lā ya/ tar+ya thā/ hre 9da ya mā brta yi ṣ+pe mi ghu ṭa/ ban dha 1 n+dhu t+t+waṃ r+ghaṃ dhe dhe/ tsa ra tsa ra ba ra ya shasma/ o ka raṃ pra ta/ bit+yā te dza ya ma hā/bit+yā 31ya ya swa yaska pra brta ya ha ra ṇi ra ṇi ra ka ru ṇi/ mu ni mu ni12/ bi mu niyin / shān+ta tsin+ta swā hā/ 'di ni mthu chen po thob pa rkang pa gcig pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po thogs pa med pa bzlas pa tsam gyis 'thab pa dang /'thab mo dang rtsod pa la sogs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa dpag tu med pa'i stobs kyis pha rol gnon pa rig pa'i rgyal po ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub tu sems bskyed pas sgrub pa brtsams te khrus gsum byas te thun gsum du stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /ji srid zla ba nya'i bar du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchod pa chen po byas nas dpag tu med par bzlas par bya'o/ /las phran tshegs rnams thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di rnams ni 'di'i 'khor du 93wa 845

gyur pa'i sngags te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ bi bhu ri bi bhu ri/bhu mi/ ā kā ma bhu mi ā 51〉kā ma bhu mi ā kā ma (na tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bi dza ya/ brta/ sha sha sha sha sha sha /tha tha tha tha tha tha tha tha/ a kun+da / a kun+ta/ a (kan+dhe/pad+ma hastu rigaciya swā hā/ ras ris rab tu gnas par byed pa'i sngags so/ /dang por ri mo mkhan gyi las dang 'og tu ras ris (6)kyi cho gar 'gyur te/ ma 'dres pa'i kha dog gis spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhabs gcig gnas pa 'drir gzhug 7par bya'o/ /me tog sna ma'i phreng ba'i mchod phyir thogs pa can me tog gi phreng ba'i 'od kyis brgyan rin pa dbyug pa dang / ril pa spyi blugs phyag na bsnams pa phrag par g.yang gzhi nag po kun du 'phyang bar bya'o/ /g.yas pas dbugs 'byin par byed pa lta bu'i ras ris 'drir bcug nas de'i spyan sngar dge slong gi tshogs la ston mo bya'o/ /yon yang ci 'byor pa dbul lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 59 a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya / ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ dza la dha ra/ bi muk+ta ya thā ya swā hā/ nye bar byugs pa'i sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 7a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā nyu1ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ su gan+dha / bi muk+ta bi dza ya swā hā/ dri'i 12sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 1nyes ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā tsoru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ su ma na shri ye/ sa saṃ tshadar+sha na so so ma na/ so so ma na swā hā / me tog gi sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 9ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ dhu mra brtsa si ra ra ra ra la 93—846

lā ya/ mu ne 0)swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya ②a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi na)satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na maḥpri (g.yo ka ra/ pri ti (9bi dza ye/ o dza ye bi dza ye saṃ (7kalpa swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya (7)a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ na maḥshu tsi ni/ ma ti bi ma li/ bi shud+dha ga ti swā hā/ nye reg gi sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya ( a ba lo ki 99te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na maḥtar+ya thā/ shwe te paṇ+ḍa bā sna risi ni rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ (teswā hā/ 'dis thams cad du bdag nyid bsrung bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya yoges ba lo ki kyi te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/dha ra dha ri:nye/ dza ba ri shu pa tsi ba ti 0swā hā/ 'dis sa blang bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya 15a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mtshe/ dza li dza li/ tsa lā ra le/ ba ba re/ ra ra re swā hā/sngags 'dis khrus bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 1 a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo dhi yoshesatā ya/ ma hā 19satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ na maḥ shu lam+bi tsho/ bsnyi ta dhā rā ri pha ba ne swā hā/ gos kyi sngags te 'di gos la yongs su bzlas te bgo bar bya zhing 3nye/ de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la'ang dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya py-i ges ba lo ki te shwa 7 lharā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tabya thā/ na ma u tsurmi pa ra ma/ da sha /sho dha na/ sho dha ya swā hā/gci ba dang / bshang ba dang / mchil ma dang / mi gtsang ba thams cad 'dis yongs su phyis na gtsang mar 'gyur ro/ /gtsang sbra'i sngags so/ /rgya spos zhi'am srang gnyis/ tsan+dan gnyis/ 'dab ma can gyi rum ru rna gnyis/93—847

gur gum gnyis/ dri 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya'o/ /ga pur dang / tsan+dan gyi bdug pa'o/ /'di lta bu'i (1)cho gas ji skad gsungs pa'i gnas su ras ris zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs su gsol nas/ khrus gsum bya zhing gos lan gsum brjes (2tshonas rtag tu gso sbyong la gnas pas 'bum phrag drug bzlas par bya'o/ /mthar pad+ma dkar po re bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi 57drung du yongs su dor zhing dbul bar bya ste nyi ma gsum la stong phrag brgyad du'o/ /de nas mtshan mo gsum du smyung ri bar gnas te mtshan thog (55thag mi smra bar pad+ma mar la btags pa rnams kyis sbyin sreg tshone༄bya'o/ /dngos grub kyi mtshan nyid du 'gyur ba ni rig pa 'dzin pa rab tu grol ba rnam pa gsum du rgyu bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grub par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin par 'dod na rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /lha ma yin 'dod na lha ma yin du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal srid 'dod na thams cad pa'i rgyal srid chen por 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dod pa de thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa yangs pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin nges par skye'o/ /rkang pa gcig pa 97zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po yongs su rdzogs so// //de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po de nyid sgom bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i rgyal mo'i rtog par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po gsung bar gyur to/ /de la 'di rnams sngags kyi tshig chen por 'gyur te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+sā 8ba dzi 9ya shrī 1 gar+bha su/ samyakle /1budhe su/ na mo 93—848

ma he shwa re swa/ bo dhi satwa su/ na maḥ51khri sha pra bha su/ bo dhi satwa nasu/ na maḥ.ā kā sha gar+bha su/ bo dhi satwa suri tsho/ na mo badz+ra ma te ri su/ bo dhi satwa su/na ma ār+sā 4)ba lo ki te shwa 6rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ( )ya/ tar+ya thā/ bha ga ba te hre rind ya/ mā 49 bā ha 1 yi byā 11mi/ o ta ra ta ra/ ma o o o bhu ba a bha ya a bha ya ba ra de u 1 tsurmi ti u tsurmi ti lha/ su khā ba ti/ su khā ba timu/ ra ra ra ra la la la la tsu luṣ+ka kha ga /kha ga /ā bogats+tsha ā yigats+tsha bha ga ba te 4 tshom ma ba raṃ/ dā su si/ a bha swa ra/ ma māsta bi pu la ma ti sa mā dhi bi dza te nyu swā hā/ 'jug pa zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal po chen po bklags 67pa tsam gyis grub par 'gyur ba ste 'jigs 7pa thams cad srung ba dang / zhing thams cad du las rnams byed do/ /de nas 'di'i ras ris kyi cho gar 'gyur te bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kun nas dkar ba sngar gsungs pa'i ras ris kyi mtshan nyid kyi rin po che'i pad+ma la gnas pa phyag na pad+ma dkar 31po bsnams pa/ gtsug phud 22grol ba/ phyag na ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa dag tu ji ltar rigs lhabazhin te g.yon gyi gzhogs su gzhon nu dkar po phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa/bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal bar byed bzhin pa/ 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /g.yas kyi gzhogs su bcom ldan 'das ma dpal chen mo phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa/pad+ma la nye bar 'dug pa 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /g.yon gyi gzhogs su sa'i lha mo rin po che sna bzhi'i 2 gzhong pa phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /nam mkha' la 'od gsal gyi byang chub sems dpa' dkar po me tog gi phreng ba yongs su thogs pa 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /g.yas kyi gzhogs su sgrub pa po lag na spos phor 93—849

thogs pa sngar bzhin no/ /rnam pa de lta bu'i ras ris byas nas sngar gsungs pa'i gnas su bzhugs nas mchod pa rgya chen po bya ste/ 'o ma dang nas zan bza' zhing rtsa ba'i sngags kyis spyan drang ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 4)a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na maḥ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sate bh+yaḥ(gyi/ tabya thā/ paṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍa (gul ghu shu tsi bi ma le swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gyi sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya (4)a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥ/ tabya thā/asdi dzu lu dzu lu hu/ ra ma me swā hā/ dri'i sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma (5)ār+ya (6)a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na maḥsarba bo dhi sate bh+yaḥ/ tar+ya thā/ dhu ba sid+dhi brah+ma te dzo swā hā/ me tog gi sngags so / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya (7)a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ri8)ya/ma hā satā ya/ na maḥ9)sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥ/ tar+ya thā/ bi pu la te dza 0brah+ma shwa ra nyu1swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya nyu2a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na maḥ1nasarba bud+dha bo dhi sate bh+yaḥ / ni dhi bi pu ni a bha ya pra da swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /'di nyid mar me'i sngags so/ /pu shel tse dang / bā la ka dang / ga pur cha mnyam pa'i dri'i phreng ba dang / ka ra bī skor dmar po'i me tog dang / sna ma'i me tog lag pa dang / dpal btags pa dang / sra rtsi pog dang / shas tī dang / bu ram sbyar ba'i bdug pa dang / dkar gsum gyi gtor ma dang / ba'i mar gyi mar me ste de lta bur 6byas nas 'bum phrag drug bzlas par bya'o/ /mthar zla ba nya la mtshan mo gsum du smyung 39bar gnas te ka ra bī 1 ra'i me tog zho dang sbrang 93wa 850

rtsi dang mar la btags pa rnams kyis stong phrag brgyad dus gsum du sbyin sreg bya ste / de lta bu'i nyi ma gsum du bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma gsum pa la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas ji skad brjod pa'i cho gas bcu gnyis yongs su 'gyur ba'i kham phor zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'o thug kham phor bcu ku sha'i khres la 'dug ste/srod nas brtsams nas ji srid dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ma byung gi bar de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /lha'i me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / 'brug dang rnga bo che rnams kyang sgra sgrogs pa dang / ras ris 'gul ba dang / mar me'i rtse mo 'phel lo/ /de nas grub pa yin te sa thams cad la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro / /gang mngon par 'dod kyang rung ste thams cad thob par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i yangs pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i rtsa ba'i rtog par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po yongs su rdzogs so// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sems can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du slar yang ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po de nyid sgom bzhin du bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen por skye bo dbul po rjes su gzung ba'i ched du dkar mo chen mo'i rig pa bka' stsal to/ /de la 'di rnams ni don thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i rig pa'i sngags kyi tshig rnams su 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 1a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā 2ya/krohā ri dzi rna ba ra dha ra/ ka ma lā ya/ khrik+ṣi 4pad+ma a sa na sbri a bha ya pra da/93—851

ma gra ha tai/ bhā (1)ga swadz+dza ṭa (gum ku ṭa ( cidha ri/ ṇi pad+ma baṇ+ḍa ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ri (4)ma haṃ 55༄sa ra ṇi pra par+ya(6ri/ tar+ya thā/ shwe te (7)bi dza ye shwe ta bsta/ shwe ta bhu jon/ shwe 59)ta pad+ma a lo 7khrirta tumadza ye bi dza (rteyi/ a bha ye shī tai e shu ma bha ya pra te shwe / lta tsa ga ga na shud+dhi shwe tai bit+yā/thu/ sa ma pra sa ma pra bhe /steshe te (/tabh+yaḥ/bha ba su/ shupho 1 shu raṃ bha bān+ta 42re paṇ+ḍa 6)ra/ pa ṭa ( )pa ṭā ya ra ra ra ra ra ya bi dza ye swā hā/ ba ri khri ri smub le ba re ba rā sa ya swā hā/ 'di ni mthu chen po thob pa'i dkar mo chen mo ( nyi zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal mo ste las thams cad byed ma/dbul ba dang / nad rab tu zhi bar byed ma/ don thams cad sgrub par byed ma / don thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed ma ste/ gang 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la byang chub tu sems bskyed pas rtag tu dran par byed pa dang / mchod pa 2 )byed par 'gyur ro/ /skye bo yongs su skyob ( cigepar byed par 'gyur zhing skye bo thams cad dga' bar yang 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'di yi ri yecho ga ni sngar brjod pa'i cho gas khru bcu pa'i ras byed du bcug nas kha tshar bcad pa la tsan+dan gyi khu bas mnan par bya'o/ /kha dog ma 'dres pas dri'i khu bas gnur na bas bcom ldan 'das bri bar bya'o/ /ston ku'i sprin ltar dkar ba phyag na ril ba spyi blugs thogs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis ri shepad+ma bsnams pa/ ral pa gyen du brjes pa pad+ma'i gdan gos dkar po phreng ba dkar po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma'i phreng ba bcu drug rnams kyis brgyan pa/ thams cad dkar po rnams kyis thams cad dkar po'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug 'og tu bri bar bya'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po rnams phyogs 'khor 29rnams su'o/ /sa'i lha mo 'di bri bar bya ste/ phyag g.yas kyis rtsa gau ṭa ka thogs pa'o/ /93—852
